job.title: Associate Producer, MPR News
job.description:
As a full-time Associate Producer for MPR News magazine programs, you will be expected to pitch ideas for interviews, book guests, edit audio interviews, direct live shows, troubleshoot challenges, and ensure MPR News content is reaching digital audiences. You may also be asked to work with reporters, editors and others across the newsroom.

Candidates need to be curious, creative, organized, patient with details, and have a love daily local news.

Minnesota is approaching 20 percent Black, Indigenous and People of Color and the Twin Cities metro area is approaching 30 percent BIPOC. We need conversations and reporting that reflect our population.

We’re looking for a producer who is devoted to elevating local voices and local stories. You understand the urgent need to practice more equitable journalism and are committed to collaborating with the entire newsroom to do so.

This position sits in the collective bargaining agreement between MPR and Screen Actors Guild—American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (“SAG-AFTRA”).

Expected Compensation Range: $27.75 - $33.30 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Hybrid, St. Paul, MN

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

  • Locate, contact, pre-interview, evaluate guests; book guests and confirm bookings
  • Coordinate guest bookings and technical requirements for remote studio connections
  • Direct shows, manage control room, set rundown timing and coordinate with remote guest
  • Write promos, scripts and edit and fact-check copy
  • Prepare audio for podcast, digital presentation and re-broadcast
  • Research sources/guests for background and context
  • Rewrite copy for accuracy and clarity
  • Support hosts and prepare research notes for hosts
  • Greet and interact with live studio guests
  • Edit pre-recorded interviews and prepare audio from live shows for podcast
  • Contribute to show’s digital presence and look for opportunities to play up certain interviews online
  • Support other MPR News programs and special programming as needed
  • Coordinate the work of interns
  • Other duties as assigned

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
  • 1–4 years’ experience in journalism, broadcasting, or a related field

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Solid news judgment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Reads widely across a variety of current news sources.
  • Ability to generate fresh and strong ideas for the programs.
  • Ability to work interdependently within a team while maintaining effective communication and accountability with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent organizational skills; effective with details and deadlines.
  • Ability to learn new industry specific skills as required.
  • Research skills.

job.title: Deputy Managing Editor - Marketplace
job.description:
Position Summary:

The Deputy Managing Editor (DME) is a senior editorial leader in Marketplace’s News Department, reporting to the News Director and working hand in hand with the Managing Editor to run the daily editorial newsroom. The DME helps lead the team of editors and reporters, executes on Marketplace’s editorial vision, and fills in for the Managing Editor as needed.

The Deputy Managing Editor ensures our journalism is conceived, edited and delivered for our audiences with one voice. Growing our digital audience and our membership are top priorities for Marketplace, and the DME is accountable for making sure the newsroom’s daily and enterprise work contributes to those goals.

The DME also works in close partnership with Marketplace’s broadcast teams (the Executive Producer and the show runners for Marketplace, Marketplace Morning Report, Marketplace Tech and Make Me Smart) to manage editorial standards and safeguard the integrity of daily story production. As stories
move from reporting to air, audio, video and digital, the DME protects their accuracy, fairness and Marketplace’s distinctive voice.

We are looking for a proven leader who is passionate about business and economic storytelling, energized by reaching audiences where they are, and skilled at running a dynamic, deadline-driven, multiplatform news operation.

Expected Compensation Range: $140,000 - $160,000 per year. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Remote

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Position Responsibility:

  • Provide editorial direction across dayparts, platforms and programs, ensuring a consistency of coverage for all Marketplace daily content.
  • Work with show producers and editors to meet needs of ambitious in-depth, enterprise-level editorial agenda.
  • Guide a team of editors and reporters to deliver work that meets the highest journalistic standards in Marketplace's unique style.
    • Manage workflow to reflect editorial priorities.
    • Ensure timely delivery of all staff enterprise and feature stories to digital platforms and, working with Marketplace digital leadership, develop, edit and deliver digital-first and digital-only content.
    • Assist and fill in for managing editor as needed.
    • Hire and lead staff by:
    o Creating a culture of constructive performance coaching and regular, ongoing feedback.
    o Encouraging creativity, invention and productivity.
    o Embracing a variety of experiences
    o Creating and encouraging individualized development opportunities and plans for staff.
    • Work within a team environment, responding to the needs of all Marketplace programs and digital news platforms.
    • Read widely and remain well-informed about news, current events, business, economics, history and public policy.
    • Communicate Marketplace vision, mission, values, and needs within organization, industry and to outside world.
    • Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
• 7+ years of related work experience editing, reporting or producing journalism

job.title: Senior Producer, MPR News with Angela Davis and Call to Mind
job.description:
Position Summary:

MPR News with Angela Davis is the conversation Minnesotans are already having with friends and family. Each hour digs deep into one topic, bringing in people with expertise and lived experience to put the news in context: how we got here, what’s changed, who the helpers are and what comes next. The show makes room for hard conversations while still making space for what’s good, joyful and possible, and listeners’ calls, stories and questions are essential to every hour. Our promise to listeners: You won’t always agree with what you hear, but you’ll leave understanding why others see things differently. So, let’s gather. We need to talk.

We’re looking for a senior producer to lead this award-winning show: a journalist who wants to put their news judgment, sourcing and storytelling to work in live conversation.

You don’t need a background in call-in programs. If you’ve spent your career reporting, editing or producing (finding the right source, asking the question nobody else has asked, making a complicated story make sense) you already do most of this job. A great hour of talk radio is journalism: a sharp angle, the right voices, and a host who is ready for anything. We’ll help you learn the rhythm of a audience-engagement-centered live show. We need you to bring the instincts.

On a typical day you might lead a morning team meeting, rework tomorrow’s show if news breaks, prepare Angela for a tough interview, call the shots in the control room while the phone lines light up, and then figure out how that conversation lives on as a podcast, a social clip and a story on mprnews.org.

While some public radio stations are stepping back from daily talk, MPR News is leaning in. This show is a break from traditional news: a curious, open and inviting host who is equal parts nosy neighbor and friend who keeps it real; conversations with people listeners wouldn’t normally meet; topics with real personal relevance; and voices from rural and metro Minnesota alike. We’re willing to sit in our feelings (laugh, cry, get mad), and we innovate and experiment with intention to find new ways to serve our audiences. You’ll also lead Call to Mind, the APM and MPR News mental health initiative, carrying forward its conversations, coverage and community partnerships.

MPR News is committed to local broadcasting and to equitable journalism that reflects a changing state. Minnesota is approaching 20 percent Black, Indigenous and People of Color, and the Twin Cities metro is approaching 30 percent. You’ll make sure the voices on the air reflect all of Minnesota, and you’ll help build and sustain a team that does too.

This position sits in the collective bargaining agreement between MPR and Screen Actors Guild—American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (“SAG-AFTRA”).

Expected Compensation Range: $83,640.00 - $100,368 per year. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Hybrid, St. Paul, MN

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Are a reporter, editor or producer who loves the interview and wonders what you could do with a whole hour.
  • Know how to find the person nobody else is calling, and how to get them to say yes.
  • Get energy from deadlines and the unpredictability of live broadcasting.
  • Can lean into a hard, necessary conversation and still find room for what’s joyful and possible.
  • Care about how journalism can help people talk more openly about mental health.
  • Think about how a story works on air, in a podcast feed, on social and on the web.
  • Want to lead by example and help other journalists do their best work.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Shape the show
    • Set daily and long-term editorial direction for MPR News with Angela Davis in partnership with the host, guided by the show’s promise to listeners.
    • Originate show ideas, find and book guests who bring both expertise and lived experience, produce segments, and write host prep that goes beyond the obvious.
    • Uphold MPR News standards for accuracy, fairness and balance on every platform; regularly assess the show’s tone, content and priorities.
    • Track the diversity of sources and work with the team to meet MPR News sourcing goals.
    • Make the audience a co-creator: build hours around listeners’ calls, stories and questions, and seek out voices from rural and metro Minnesota.
  • Run the room
    • Line produce the live broadcast: direct the control room, screen calls and adjust on the fly when news breaks.
    • Oversee editing, post-production, promos and archiving of the program.
    • Develop and produce special programs, events and remote broadcasts around the state.
  • Grow the audience
    • Grow the show’s on-demand, podcast and social audiences, and experiment with formats that reach listeners where they are.
    • Collaborate with reporters, editors and digital colleagues so the show’s conversations connect to and strengthen MPR News coverage.
    • Collaborate with Membership during fund drives.
  • Lead Call to Mind
    • Serve as senior producer for Call to Mind, the APM and MPR News mental health initiative, carrying forward its editorial work, events and partnerships.
    • Develop mental health conversations and special programming for MPR News with Angela Davis and other MPR News platforms.
    • Build and maintain relationships with community and mental health organizations, and evaluate partner pitches for events, panels and broadcasts.
    • Deliver a one-hour special hosted by Angela Davis and distributed nationally

    • Provide day-to-day editorial leadership to two producers and interns: assign and edit work and give regular, constructive feedback.

Required Education and Experience:

job.title: Associate Director, Creative Membership
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job overview:

The Associate Director, Creative Membership leverages deep music industry knowledge to cultivate and maintain strong relationships within the London and European creative community and its surrounding areas. In this role, you will serve as a vital bridge to songwriters, publishers, major record labels, entertainment lawyers, managers, and talent agents. A primary emphasis is placed on enhancing ASCAP's local presence through active on-the-ground engagement, which includes attending live shows, hosting industry mixers, and conducting in-person meetings with ASCAP members and local executives.

This position is based in our London office and will report to the VP, Creative Membership located in London. This position currently is subject to ASCAP’s in office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Discovery and development of talent, including songwriters, composers and producers, in the London, European, and surrounding area
  • Perform market research and partner closely with the London Creative Team to identify, attract, recruit and successfully transition local up-and-coming creators to ASCAP, in order to grow the value of the ASCAP repertory.
  • Support and maintain relationships within the London, Europe, and surrounding creative community, including songwriters, composers, publishers, major record labels, entertainment lawyers, managers, and agents.

job.title: Director, Security Engineering
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

About AP Cybersecurity 

Trust is AP's most important asset. Every day, AP journalists, systems and customers depend on technology that must be secure, resilient and available — in newsrooms, in the field and across a global content distribution network that serves media organizations and businesses around the world. 

AP's Cybersecurity team, part of the Technology organization under the Chief Technology Officer, protects AP's people, journalism, platforms and data. We build the security capabilities that let AP report from anywhere, deliver content in real time and adopt new technologies with confidence.  

 

Why this role matters:  

We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Director of Cyber Engineering to lead security engineering across product security, infrastructure and cloud security, cloud governance and network security. Reporting to the Senior Director of Cybersecurity, this is a senior leadership role within AP's security organization. 

You will inherit and lead a team of established engineers, set technical direction for security engineering and turn security strategy into platforms, controls and practices that scale. You will stay close enough to the technology to review architecture, challenge designs and help solve hard problems. 

Building strong partnerships across Technology and the wider AP organization will be central to this role. Security at AP succeeds through collaboration and this leader will help foster a culture where security is clearly understood, valued and built in from the start. 

 

What you will do:  

Lead Security Engineering Strategy & Architecture 

  • Define and execute a security engineering roadmap across products, infrastructure, cloud and network security, aligned with AP's technology and business priorities. 

  • Own security architecture standards and reference designs for AP's cloud, on-premises and network environments. 

  • Advance modern security models such as zero trust, least-privilege access and secure-by-default infrastructure. 

  • Evaluate emerging threats and technologies, including risks introduced by AI, and translate them into practical engineering priorities. 

Product Security 

  • Embed security into the software development lifecycle through threat modeling, secure design reviews, code and dependency scanning, and security testing. 

  • Partner with product and engineering teams to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines without slowing delivery. 

  • Establish clear, practical secure development standards and guidance for engineering teams. 

Infrastructure, Cloud Security & Governance 

  • Lead the security architecture and hardening of AP's cloud and infrastructure environments. 

  • Establish and maintain cloud governance, including policies, guardrails, configuration standards and posture management across cloud accounts and services. 

  • Drive security automation and infrastructure-as-code to improve consistency, reduce manual effort and scale controls. 

Network Security 

  • Own the strategy and engineering of AP's network security controls across offices, data centers, cloud and remote workforce. 

  • Modernize network security architecture, including segmentation, secure remote access and perimeter controls. 

Lead People & Build a Security Culture 

  • Lead, develop and grow a team of established security engineers, and build a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous learning. 

  • Develop trusted relationships with stakeholders across Technology, product, newsroom, legal, commercial and business teams. 

  • Work with those partners to build and grow a security culture across AP, making secure choices the easy choices. 

  • Act as a senior technical leader during security incidents and turn lessons learned into lasting engineering improvements. 

  • Manage vendor relationships and budget for security engineering tools and services. 

  • Communicate risk, tradeoffs and progress clearly to technical teams, senior leadership and nontechnical audiences. 

 

Who you are: 

We expect strong candidates to bring many, but not necessarily all, of the following: 

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in security engineering, security architecture or infrastructure engineering, including minimum 4+ years leading engineering teams. 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.  

  • Deep hands-on experience in at least two of AP's focus areas (product security, cloud and infrastructure security, cloud governance or network security) and working knowledge of the others. 

  • Experience in major public cloud environments and hybrid infrastructure. 

  • Strong grounding in application security and DevSecOps practices in modern software environments. 

  • Experience designing and operating enterprise network security architectures. 

  • Experience with security automation, scripting or coding and infrastructure-as-code. 

  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence without authority across engineering, business and nontechnical teams. 

  • Experience leading security awareness, champions programs or other efforts to shift security culture. 

  • Sound risk judgment: the ability to prioritize what matters most and make pragmatic decisions with incomplete information. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to senior leadership. 

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP or cloud security certifications are a plus. 

  • Experience in media, journalism or other high-visibility environments; supporting a global or distributed workforce; securing AI/ML systems; or growing a small team into a larger function is especially relevant but not required. 

 

 

Why This Role 

AP's journalism is only as trusted as the systems behind it. AP operates at a scale and risk profile few organizations share: a global newsroom, real-time distribution to customers worldwide, and a mission that depends on accuracy and trust. 

For a security engineering leader who wants to build, influence and protect something that matters, this is an opportunity to shape how one of the world's most trusted news organizations secures its people, platforms and journalism. 

 

Location:

This role is based in New York, NY. 

 

Why Join Us? 

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.
  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.
  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions

 

Salary & Benefits: 

The anticipated salary range for this position is $160,000 - $180,000, based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications and location. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:   

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage   
  • Retirement benefits   
  • Company paid life insurance   
  • Paid vacation and sick days   
  • Paid parental leave for any new parent   
  • Mental well-being resources   

 



 

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Video Journalist
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

 

The Associated Press seeks a nimble and enterprising video journalist to cover breaking news in Los Angeles, California. We’re looking for a creative visual storyteller with demonstrated experience independently reporting, shooting, editing and transmitting video, covering live events, writing text stories and making still photographs for news organizations. You’ll join a team delivering accurate, competitive coverage for national and global audiences across digital, mobile and broadcast platforms. This is a newsgathering staff position within U.S. News, covered by AP’s agreement with the News Media Guild.   Responsibilities: You’ll shoot, edit and produce video, including live video, and contribute substantive reporting across formats. You’ll independently gather and verify facts, conduct interviews, write breaking news updates and text stories, and make news photographs with accurate captions. You’ll set up and transmit live video from the field, coordinate feeds with receiving editors, monitor picture and sound, and resolve routine connection and signal problems. You’ll pitch, develop and research distinctive stories, collaborating with colleagues across text, photo, video, audio, digital/social, interactive and graphics. You may occasionally help edit and produce live video, affiliate contributions and video from other AP journalists. Covering extreme weather across California and elsewhere is an essential responsibility. This position requires travel to a variety of news events, sometimes with little to no advance notice, and reports to the US Assistant News Director overseeing California.   Required Qualifications:
  • At least three years of professional electronic newsgathering (ENG) and field videojournalism experience for a broadcast station, news agency, digital news outlet, newspaper or comparable news organization. Candidates must demonstrate direct responsibility for reporting, shooting, editing and filing news video under deadline. A bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience is required separately.
  • Demonstrated experience covering live events and fast-moving general breaking news, including severe weather, wildfires or other emergencies. Candidates must be able to identify the news, verify conflicting information, interview sources and explain the significance of local developments to national and global audiences.
  • Advanced professional competency in independently shooting news video with professional equipment, including manual control of focus, exposure and white balance, strong composition and visual sequencing, interview lighting and recording and monitoring clear interview audio and natural sound.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard editing software such as DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with demonstrated ability to independently edit and transmit complete news packages and rapid updates to technical specifications under deadline.
  • Professional experience delivering live video and transmitting recorded material from the field using LiveU or comparable transmission systems, with the ability to coordinate coverage with receiving editors as news develops.
  • Demonstrated experience reporting and writing text stories for news organizations. Candidates must independently gather and verify information, conduct interviews, and write clear, accurate breaking news updates and complete news stories for editing. Contributing information to another reporter’s story alone does not demonstrate the required writing experience.
  • Demonstrated experience making still photographs for news organizations. Candidates must produce editorially usable news images, control focus and exposure, select and transmit photographs under deadline, and write accurate captions identifying people, locations and events.
  • Excellent news writing and scripting skills, advanced professional competency in written and spoken English, and experience or demonstrated ability to present accurate reporting on camera and/or on audio as assignments require.
  • Proven ability to make sound editorial decisions, manage competing priorities and deliver accurate coverage under deadline pressure. Strong organization, visual creativity, calmness under pressure, curiosity and a collaborative approach to producing trusted journalism are essential.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain sources, report across communities and quickly build working knowledge of California’s institutions and major news issues.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to assignments, sometimes with little to no advance notice, and work nights and weekends as news demands.
  • Ability to carry and operate video equipment and work for extended periods in varied terrain and weather conditions, with or without reasonable accommodation. AP will provide necessary protective equipment, safety training and ergonomic support.
  • All applicants must be able to work in the U.S. or be able to gain permission to do so.
  • You’ll pursue innovative and inclusive coverage while maintaining AP’s standards for accuracy, integrity and objectivity.
  Preferred Qualifications:

California reporting experience, existing California sources, experience in a global-news environment, longer-term enterprise work across formats, innovative digital storytelling and professional competency in a language besides English are preferred.

 

Why join us:

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success. 
  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals. 
  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.

Additional compensation is negotiable based on a job candidate’s skills, qualifications and market location. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:

job.title: Salesforce Business Analyst
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Salesforce Business Analyst to help build and scale our CRM, reporting, and analytics capabilities, as part of our Revenue Operations team.

Why it matters: This role owns and administers our Salesforce Media Cloud instance, ensuring the platform supports the needs of our revenue organization and serves as a trusted source of data. Beyond day-to-day Salesforce administration, this role will develop reporting, analytics, and insights that turn revenue data into meaningful business intelligence. This role will report to the Senior Director of Revenue Strategy and Operations. 

Go deeper: This is an opportunity for someone early in their Salesforce and Revenue Operations career who wants hands-on ownership while expanding their skills across systems, processes, and analytics. You’ll partner closely with Revenue Enablement, Client Partnerships, Client Experience, and Business Development teams to solve business challenges, improve revenue processes, and help teams use Salesforce and data more effectively. Responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the day-to-day administrator for Salesforce Media Cloud, managing users, permissions, page layouts, flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and automation.
  • Partner with Revenue Strategy & Enablement, Revenue Operations, and sales leadership to translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions and operational improvements.
  • Build and optimize a Salesforce environment that supports Axios’ evolving revenue organization, sales processes, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and recurring analyses that give executives, sales leadership, and cross-functional partners actionable visibility into business performance, sales metrics, and KPIs.
  • Support data migration and ongoing data management efforts, ensuring data quality, integrity, consistency, and governance across Salesforce.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
  • Support sales planning and performance management, including sales goals, conversion and segment analysis, Quarterly Business Reviews, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting.
  • Troubleshoot user and system issues, recommend scalable solutions, and support testing, deployment, and change management for Salesforce releases and enhancements.
  • Create and maintain documentation, best practices, and training materials while supporting user adoption of Salesforce functionality, reporting tools, and revenue processes.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, have a passion for the Axios mission, and the following skills and experience:

  • 1–2 years of Salesforce Administrator experience.
  • 1–2 years of experience in sales operations or sales analytics.
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM-201) or plans to obtain certification within the first year.
  • Experience helping build or significantly expand a Salesforce organization from the ground up, or participating in a major Salesforce implementation.
  • Experience building flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, profiles, permission sets, and data management best practices.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-service mindset when supporting end users.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and improve business processes.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Salesforce Media Cloud.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications.
  • Experience supporting a Salesforce data migration from one CRM or Salesforce org to another.
  • Experience working in the media industry.

Within your first year, you'll help establish a scalable Salesforce foundation that supports Axios' revenue organization by:

  • Delivering a stable, well-governed Salesforce environment that users trust.
  • Successfully supporting the migration from our legacy CRM while maintaining data quality.
  • Improving automation and reducing manual administrative work across revenue teams.
  • Increasing Salesforce adoption through thoughtful training, documentation, and user support.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to improve how they leverage data and analytics to understand their business.

job.title: Senior Security Engineer
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a respected media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format known as Smart Brevity™. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI security experience to lead our defensive posture, drive threat modeling and vulnerability management, and embed security controls - including AI-driven defense and monitoring - across our platform and automation pipelines.

Why it matters: As a Senior Security Engineer at Axios, you will architect and implement proactive security strategies to protect our audience, platform, and data assets against evolving threat vectors, including AI-driven attacks. In this role, you will define our security roadmap, leverage internal and third-party AI defense tools, and ensure our cloud systems remain resilient, secure by default, and capable of automated threat detection and response.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architectural design and implementation of security controls across cloud infrastructure, platform services, and AI integrations.
  • Drive vulnerability management, threat modeling, incident response, and proactive security assessments across AWS, Kubernetes, and AI application environments.
  • Shape, maintain, and execute the company’s long-term security roadmap in close alignment with engineering and executive leadership.
  • Embed automated security testing, SAST/DAST, and AI-driven compliance checks directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code workflows.
  • Oversee identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption protocols, and zero-trust architecture standards.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and maintain internal AI security tools and modern third-party defensive solutions to detect, mitigate, and respond to AI-driven threats and sophisticated attack vectors in real time.
  • Promote a strong security culture across engineering by conducting threat modeling workshops and coaching teams on secure coding and infrastructure practices.
  • Partner with product, infrastructure, data, and QE teams to ensure security is integrated seamlessly into every stage of the development lifecycle.

Skills:

  • Deep expertise in cloud and application security, including threat modeling, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, IAM, secrets management, AI security, and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and security controls (IAM, KMS, EKS, RDS, S3).
  • Experience hardening Kubernetes clusters, runtime security, container scanning, and network policy enforcement.
  • Proficiency in integrating SAST/DAST and security automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
  • Solid scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, or Bash for security tooling and automated remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, security logging, automated threat intelligence, and AI-powered monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or modern SOC tooling).
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving security initiatives, defining policy, and guiding engineering teams on security risk.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively balance security requirements and business agility.

What success looks like:

  • Security & Compliance: Focused on proactive security initiatives, including automated vulnerability scans, implementation of controls, remediation, and contributions to the long-term security roadmap.
  • Cloud Security Architecture: Hardened, reviewed, and optimized AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure security to meet strict compliance, resilience, and least-privilege access standards.
  • DevSecOps & Automation: Integrated automated security scans, secret detection, and vulnerability gates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines without disrupting developer velocity.
  • Security Tooling Adoption: Evaluated, piloted, and deployed advanced security and defensive AI tools that measurably enhanced threat detection speed and reduced exposure risk.
  • Threat Detection & Response: Established robust security monitoring, SIEM alerting, and incident response playbooks to maintain real-time visibility and rapid response capabilities across all production platforms.
  • Cross-Functional Security Leadership: Partnered with engineering, product, and QE teams to instill a security-first culture, conduct threat modeling workshops, and guide technical teams on risk mitigation.
  • AI Defense & Security: Evaluated and deployed internal AI security tools and 3rd-party defensive solutions to proactively safeguard infrastructure, applications, and corporate assets against AI-driven threats and emerging attack vectors.

job.title: Beasley Media Group
job.description:
Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Account Executive

Augusta, GA Full Time Mid Level Share Account Executive

Position Summary

As an Account Executive, you will serve as a trusted marketing consultant to local businesses and advertising agencies, helping clients achieve their business goals through innovative advertising and marketing solutions. This role combines prospecting, relationship building, strategic planning, and revenue generation across Beasley Media Group's portfolio of broadcast, digital, streaming, event, and experiential marketing assets.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter with a passion for sales, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop long-term client partnerships while driving new business growth.

Key Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented professional who thrives both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities with attention to detail.
  • Effective negotiator with a customer-focused, consultative sales approach.
  • Ability to identify client needs, develop strategic recommendations, and deliver impactful marketing solutions.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.
  • Passion for building relationships and creating measurable results for clients.
  • Valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and reliable transportation required.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of an MVR check.

Essential Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and outreach efforts.
  • Maintain and grow existing account relationships while increasing revenue and market share.
  • Develop integrated marketing solutions utilizing Beasley Media Group's full suite of advertising platforms.
  • Create and deliver compelling sales presentations and marketing proposals to local businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Identify client business challenges and recommend customized advertising and marketing strategies.
  • Secure sponsorships, promotional partnerships, experiential marketing opportunities, and digital advertising campaigns.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, stakeholders, and business owners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service and responsiveness.
  • Regularly communicate with clients regarding campaign performance, marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through upselling and cross-selling solutions.

Strategic Planning & Market Research

  • Prepare thoroughly for all client interactions by researching industries, market conditions, business objectives, and competitive trends.
  • Analyze client needs, target audiences, and historical advertising investment to develop effective recommendations.
  • Stay informed on emerging advertising, media, digital marketing, and consumer behavior trends.
  • Utilize market insights and audience data to enhance client outcomes and sales effectiveness.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beasley Media Group's products, platforms, pricing, audience insights, and marketing capabilities.
  • Continuously expand expertise in radio, digital advertising, streaming audio, video, events, promotions, and experiential marketing.
  • Understand competitive offerings and effectively position Beasley Media Group's advantages in the marketplace.

Administrative & Reporting Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, activity logs, and sales opportunities within the company CRM.
  • Effectively manage schedules, appointments, account plans, and follow-up activities.
  • Provide timely sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance reports as requested by management.
  • Document client interactions and strategic account activities to support business growth and customer retention.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Maintain regular communication with leadership regarding sales activity, pipeline development, client opportunities, and business needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful execution of advertising campaigns and client initiatives.
  • Support client events, promotions, and experiential marketing activities as needed.
  • Contribute positively to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meeting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Developing strong client relationships that result in long-term partnerships.
  • Generating new business opportunities and expanding existing accounts.
  • Delivering strategic marketing solutions that help clients achieve measurable business results.
  • Serving as a knowledgeable and trusted advisor within the local advertising community.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Share

Apply for this position

Required*

job.description:
Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Board Operator - WGAC-AM

Augusta, GA Part Time Mid Level Share Board Operator

WGAC-AM | Augusta, GA

Beasley Media Group is seeking reliable and detail-oriented Board Operators to join the team at WGAC-AM in Augusta, Georgia. This role is responsible for ensuring smooth and accurate execution of live and syndicated programming, managing on-air operations, and maintaining the highest broadcast standards.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, can multitask under pressure, and is committed to delivering a seamless listener experience. Board Operators work closely with the Program Director, on-air talent, and operations staff to ensure all programming, commercials, and broadcast elements air as scheduled.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute seamless transitions between live, syndicated, and prerecorded programming.
  • Monitor broadcast feeds and quickly troubleshoot technical issues as they arise.
  • Ensure commercials, station imaging, and programming elements air accurately according to program logs.
  • Maintain consistent on-air quality and programming flow.
  • Collaborate with the Program Director and air talent to support daily broadcast operations.
  • Edit audio content using Adobe Audition or similar audio editing software.
  • Adhere to all FCC regulations and help protect the station’s FCC license.

Qualifications

  • Dependable with a strong work ethic and the ability to arrive at least 30 minutes prior to scheduled shifts for programming preparation.
  • Previous experience operating a radio broadcast console and automation systems preferred; training will be provided for qualified candidates.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow commercial and programming logs accurately.
  • Experience with audio editing software, preferably Adobe Audition.
  • Ability to think quickly, make sound decisions, and perform effectively in high-pressure situations.
  • Comfortable multitasking while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.
  • Flexible schedule with availability to work early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and other shifts as needed.
  • Self-motivated team player capable of working independently.
  • Reliable transportation required.

Why Join Beasley Media Group?

Be part of a dynamic media organization with a passion for delivering exceptional local content and entertainment. You'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced broadcast professionals in a collaborative environment committed to excellence.

Beasley Media Group, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Preferred

job.title: Program Director - Foxy 99 (WZFX-FM)
job.description:
Program Director - Foxy 99 (WZFX-FM) | Fayetteville, NC
Position Title: Program Director
Location: Fayetteville, NC
Brand: Foxy 99 (WZFX-FM)

About Foxy 99
Foxy 99.1 (WZFX-FM) is Fayetteville's leading Urban Hits station, delivering today's top Hip-Hop and R&B, compelling local content, entertainment news, community engagement, and digital experiences across broadcast, streaming, social media, and events. The station serves Fayetteville, Fort Liberty, and the surrounding Sandhills region with a strong commitment to localism, culture, and community impact. [foxy99.com]
Position Summary
Beasley Media Group is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking Program Director to lead the strategic vision, content execution, audience growth, and brand development for Foxy 99 (WZFX-FM). The ideal candidate is a passionate content leader with strong programming instincts, a deep understanding of Urban contemporary radio, and the ability to build audience engagement across on-air, digital, social, streaming, and event platforms.
This position requires a hands-on leader who can coach talent, analyze ratings performance, develop compelling content strategies, and collaborate with sales, promotions, digital, and community partners to grow the Foxy 99 brand.
Key Responsibilities
Programming & Content Leadership
  • Create and execute the station's overall programming strategy, brand positioning, and content vision.
  • Manage music scheduling and rotation strategy utilizing industry research, audience insights, and competitive analysis.
  • Oversee all on-air content to ensure consistency with station brand standards and format expectations.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of Hip-Hop, R&B, Urban culture, and emerging music trends.
  • Ensure compliance with FCC regulations and company policies.
Talent Development
  • Recruit, coach, mentor, and evaluate on-air talent and programming staff.
  • Conduct regular airchecks and performance reviews.
  • Foster a culture of creativity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop succession planning and talent pipelines.
Audience & Ratings Growth
  • Analyze Nielsen ratings, audience trends, and market intelligence.
  • Identify opportunities to increase AQH, cume, TSL, and digital engagement.
  • Monitor competitive stations and emerging audio platforms.
  • Develop strategic programming initiatives designed to grow market share.
Digital & Social Media
  • Lead content integration across radio, website, app, podcast, streaming, and social platforms.
  • Collaborate with digital teams to maximize audience engagement and content distribution.
  • Support the creation of compelling audio, video, and social-first content.
Promotions & Community Engagement
  • Partner with promotions teams to create impactful station events, concerts, community initiatives, and listener experiences.
  • Serve as a visible ambassador for Foxy 99 within the Fayetteville community.
  • Support public appearances, client events, and major station activations.
Sales Collaboration
  • Work closely with sales leadership to create revenue-generating programming initiatives.
  • Support integrated marketing campaigns and client partnerships while preserving programming integrity.
  • Participate in presentations and strategic discussions as needed.
Qualifications
Required
  • 5+ years of radio programming experience, including leadership responsibilities.
  • Proven success programming Urban, Rhythmic, Top 40, Hip-Hop, or R&B formats.
  • Strong understanding of Nielsen Audio ratings methodology.
  • Experience with music scheduling software, including MusicMaster or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of WideOrbit, Audiovault, Adobe Audition, and digital content management systems.
  • Strong coaching, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Demonstrated success growing audiences across broadcast and digital platforms.
Preferred
  • Previous Program Director experience in a Nielsen-rated market.
  • On-air experience and talent coaching background.
  • Experience managing digital content strategy and social media growth.
  • Knowledge of military communities and the Fayetteville/Fort Liberty market.
Key Competencies
  • Strategic Programming Leadership
  • Talent Development & Coaching
  • Audience Analytics
  • Brand Building
  • Community Engagement
  • Digital Content Strategy
  • Music Scheduling & Research
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Revenue Partnership Mindset
  • Innovation & Change Leadership
Performance Expectations
Success in this role will be measured by:
  • Ratings growth and audience share gains
  • Digital audience and streaming growth
  • Talent performance and development
  • Programming execution and brand consistency
  • Community visibility and impact
  • Revenue-supporting programming initiatives
  • Compliance with FCC and company standards
Why Join Beasley Media Group?
  • Lead one of North Carolina's heritage Urban brands.
  • Influence content across broadcast, streaming, social, and digital channels.
  • Collaborate with an award-winning media organization committed to local communities and innovation.
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a highly engaged and culturally influential market.

job.title: Director of Engineering - Dome Productions
job.description:
Req Id: 433339

Dome Productions is North America’s leading production and transmission facilities provider, Dome is unique in its business approach and sets itself apart from others with its integration of primary business units of Mobile Production, Host Broadcaster and Media Services, and Transmission services all under its corporate umbrella. Dome Productions’ resume includes work with major worldwide broadcasters, leagues, production companies, government parties and other content creators, with a major emphasis on sports, eSports, and entertainment. 
     
We provide a supportive and inclusive community where all team members can succeed. And through our commitment to environmental, social and governance initiatives, you will feel good about the greater impact you will have – making every day better for people as they connect, work, learn and play. 
 
Join us. You belong at Dome Productions’

Summary

The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, technical direction, operational performance, and ongoing evolution of Dome Productions' engineering organization. This role oversees the maintenance, readiness, and modernization of Dome's mobile production fleet, technical infrastructure, and engineering resources while ensuring the delivery of reliable, industry-leading broadcast solutions.

As a member of the senior leadership team, the Director of Engineering will establish the long-term technology vision for the organization, lead the transition to next-generation IP, cloud, and hybrid production environments, and develop high-performing engineering teams that support North America's most prestigious live sports and entertainment productions.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Technology Innovation

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership for Dome’s engineering organization, establishing the vision and multi-year roadmap for media platforms, mobiles, studios, software, architecture, and infrastructure.
  • Execute Dome's long-term technology strategy and roadmap, ensuring continued leadership in broadcast and production technologies.
  • Lead the evaluation, adoption, and implementation of emerging technologies, including IP-based workflows, cloud-based production, UHD/4K, HDR, and software-defined infrastructure.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to executive leadership, clients, and industry partners regarding technology trends, opportunities, and risks.
  • Collaborate with leaders across Dome Productions, Bell Media and Rogers Media to understand business priorities and future growth plans, translating them into scalable technology strategies and roadmaps.
  • Establish strategic partnerships with technology vendors, service providers, and industry organizations to support current and future business requirements.
  • Represent Dome Productions within industry associations, technology forums, and key vendor partnerships.

Engineering Operations & Infrastructure Management

  • Provide leadership and oversight for Dome's mobile production fleet, studios, control rooms, and supporting technical infrastructure.
  • Guide the evolution of Dome Productions infrastructure and shape the transition to next-generation architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Ensure all systems meet operational, reliability, performance, and broadcast quality standards.
  • Oversee engineering support for major live productions and serve as the senior escalation point for critical operational issues.
  • Lead large-scale engineering projects, system upgrades, equipment acquisitions, and infrastructure enhancements.
  • Ensure effective asset lifecycle management, maintenance planning, and operational readiness across all technical platforms.

Business Partnership & Financial Accountability

  • Partner with division leaders across Dome Productions, Bell Media, Rogers Media, to align technology investments with business objectives.
  • Develop capital plans, operating budgets, forecasts, and business cases that support strategic priorities.
  • Manage/oversee capital projects ensuring adherence to cost, time and quality deliverables. Oversee purchase, delivery, and installation of new equipment. Ensure the smooth integration, training and communication of new equipment or process.
  • Make sound business decisions that balance operational excellence, financial stewardship, and long-term organizational success.

People Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineering leaders, technical specialists, and field engineering personnel responsible for building, maintaining, and continually evolving Dome’s technology ecosystem.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive talent acquisition, succession planning, workforce development, performance management, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Establish training and development programs that advance technical expertise and leadership capabilities across the organization.
  • Promote a safe, inclusive, and high-performing work environment for employees and freelance resources.

Industry Leadership & Client Support

  • Maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, partners, and industry stakeholders.
  • Update and maintain thorough knowledge of the mobile, studio and distribution business including who’s who, trends, technology, changes, relationships, competitive and client landscapes and changes within the industry
  • Support client-facing discussions involving technical strategy, production solutions, and future business opportunities.
  • Ensure exceptional service delivery and client satisfaction across all engineering-supported productions.

Critical Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in broadcast engineering, media technology, or related technical environments.
  • Minimum 5 years in a senior management or director-level role leading technical teams and complex operations.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing technology strategies, infrastructure roadmaps, and large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading high-performing engineering teams within live production, broadcast, media, or technology environments.
  • Strong knowledge of live production and broadcast technologies, including video, audio, routing, replay, intercom, transmission, and contribution systems.
  • Significant experience with SMPTE 2110, IP-based workflows, cloud-based media technologies, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Understanding of modern networking, compute, storage, cybersecurity, and software-defined architectures.
  • Knowledge of broadcast industry standards, including SMPTE, ATSC, UHD/4K, HDR, and related emerging technologies.
  • Experience overseeing complex technology implementations while maintaining highly reliable production operations.
  • Strategic thinker with strong business and financial acumen.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and build cross-functional partnerships.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities in high-pressure environments.
  • Ability to lead through change while maintaining team engagement and operational excellence.
  • Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and delivering exceptional client experiences.
  • Builds trust and credibility across technical, operational, and executive teams.
  • Balances innovation with operational reliability.
  • Develops future-ready engineering capabilities while maintaining exceptional service delivery.
  • Leads confidently in fast-paced, high-stakes live production environments.
  • Creates a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Flexibility to travel domestically and internationally.
  • Degree or diploma in Engineering, Broadcast Technology, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Relevant industry certifications and professional affiliations are considered assets.

 

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec. 

 

Additional Information:

Job Location: Canada : Ontario : Toronto

For work arrangements that are ‘Hybrid’, successful candidates must be based in Canada and report to a set Dome office for a minimum of 3 days a week.  Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, Dome offers flexibility in work hours based on the business needs.

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

Be at the forefront of one of the most exciting and ever-changing industries. On the Bell Media team you will be a part of creating and delivering the best Canadian and international content across digital media, television, radio and out-of-home advertising platforms. You’ll join a team of passionate and driven innovators, who are breaking barriers and expanding the reach of Canada’s most-loved entertainment.

 

At Bell Media, you’ll redefine digital connections and pioneer next-generation services, propelling us to reach new heights, unlock untapped potential and expand horizons for our customers.

 

Job Description

The national journalist is responsible for producing original and/or high-impact reports on Québec, Canadian and international news topics that are broadcast on nationwide programs, while providing distinctive coverage on various broadcasting platforms. This position requires advanced journalistic expertise and the ability to deal with complex, high-impact topics on a regular basis, and entails conducting interviews with key figures in the news. The multiplatform journalist operates in a highly competitive environment, under constant pressure, with nationwide visibility.

Critical Qualifications

  • Suggest and develop original topics
  • Cover events for TV and digital, conduct interviews, write texts
  • Shoot his or her own images; set up / edit / shed light on and produce news reports for both TV and digital
  • Deliver a dynamic presentation live and in studio
  • Adapt formats to digital trends
  • Ability to have a comprehensive view of national and international news and to be able to explain it in simple terms
  • Ability to be deployed daily in real time on national news
  • Ability to travel quickly in the field to cover international issues
  • Cope with the daily pressure of a national audience and the resulting feedback
  • Maintain and develop a network of reliable and specialized contacts
  • Follow editorial standards and guidelines regarding accuracy, ethics and legal issues
  • Ensure that equipment and cell phone are in good working order
  • Configure and use live equipment as needed
  • Perform any other related tasks requested by the immediate supervisor

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, film, communications or the equivalent
  • Minimum of five years of experience in television / the Internet
  • Proven experience in news reporting, and ability to perform in front of the camera
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills and knowledge of local, national and international news and current events
  • Excellent writing and presentation skills
  • Good understanding of social media and its audience
  • Proven filming and editing abilities
  • Proven organizational skills, and ability to work autonomously under tight deadlines
  • Good editorial judgment; demonstrated ability to produce original, enterprising news reports
  • Ability to manage new and emerging technologies
  • Knowledge of iNews an asset
  • Valid driver’s licence and good record

 

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

job.title: Sr. Quality Assurance Analyst
job.description:
Position Summary

Define and execute quality strategies for BMI’s music rights, copyright, and technology platforms in partnership with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

Deliver functional, automated, API, data, integration, performance, and security testing for cloud applications and complex data workflows. Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate QA while independently validating generated output.

Core Responsibilities

Functional & Data Testing

·       Execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and system tests across UI, APIs, backend services, batch processes, and data workflows.

·       Validate music rights, copyright, ownership, and royalty-related data, including works, cues, writers, publishers, shares, territories, agreements.

·       Validate data integrity and transformations across DB2, PostgreSQL, APIs, and downstream systems using SQL.

·       Develop test strategies, plans, cases, scenarios, and test data; reproduce, document, and track defects through resolution.

Test Automation & AI-Assisted QA

·       Build reusable UI, API, and backend automation with Playwright, Cucumber/Gherkin, Selenium WebDriver, REST-based tools, or comparable frameworks.

·       Integrate automated execution, reporting, regression suites, and quality gates into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

·       Use AI for test generation, automation, synthetic data, documentation, defect analysis, and coverage gaps; independently validate generated tests and results.

Cloud, DevOps & Security Testing

·       Test Azure-hosted applications and distributed services; use Azure DevOps for test planning, work items, defects, and release validation.

·       Troubleshoot applications, APIs, databases, cloud services, and test environments using Datadog, logs, metrics, Linux, and command-line tools.

·       Test OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and Microsoft Entra ID authentication and authorization, including sign-in, service-to-service access, tokens, roles, and denied-access scenarios.

Performance & Reliability Testing

·       Run performance, load, scalability, and reliability tests with Apache JMeter, Lighthouse, or equivalent tools across applications, APIs, databases, and workflows.

·       Validate response-time, throughput, concurrency, and reliability targets; isolate performance hot spots with engineering.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience & Technical Qualifications

·       5–8 years of software QA experience, including substantial hands-on functional testing and automation in Agile teams.

·       Strong cloud testing experience, preferably Microsoft Azure, and hands-on Azure DevOps expertise in test management, defects, and CI/CD automation.

·       Experience testing data-intensive applications, APIs, backend services, batch processing, ingestion pipelines, and distributed systems.

·       Hands-on DB2, PostgreSQL, or comparable database experience, with SQL-based validation of complex transformations.

·       Automation with Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Cucumber/Gherkin, or comparable frameworks; API testing with Thunder Client or equivalent tools.

·       Performance testing with Apache JMeter, Lighthouse, or similar tools, particularly for Java services and data-intensive applications.

·       Practical AI-assisted QA experience with independent output validation; familiarity with Datadog or similar diagnostics, Linux, and command-line tools.

·       Experience testing OAuth 2.0/OIDC and Microsoft Entra ID, including JWT access tokens, client-credentials flows, and role/permission-based access.

Preferred Domain Experience

Music industry technology or data experience is strongly desired, especially music rights, copyright administration, publishing, royalty processing, repertoire, and ownership data.

Skills & Abilities

·       Bridge business validation and technical troubleshooting; design maintainable automation and apply strong analytical skills and attention to data accuracy.

·       Communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders; work independently and manage quality across concurrent Agile projects.

Location Requirements

This person must be based in the Nashville area. While the position will have flexibility to work remotely, the candidate must be able to come into the office for the duration of their onboarding, as well as at an ongoing basis as needed.

job.title: Denver Sports On-Call Fill-In Host
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

At Bonneville International, our purpose is to build up, connect, inform, and celebrate communities and families in the markets we serve. As an integrated media company, we provide content, advertising, and digital marketing solutions across 23 radio stations in Denver, Phoenix, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, San Francisco, and Seattle, along with the NBC Affiliate TV station, KSL-TV 5, in Salt Lake. We are responsible for lifting and inspiring with respect and giving voice to all the communities and clients we serve.

 

We believe that empowering our employees to share their ideas and experiences will fuel creativity, innovation, and inspiration. A diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to our ability to create and deliver exceptional content, products, and services that represent our communities. We’re proud of our history and we want talented people to join us as we continue to grow!

 

To learn more about Bonneville and how our local media matters, visit: https://bonneville.com/

 

 

Position Overview

Denver Sports has an immediate opening for a dynamic Fill-In Talk Host.  On an on-call basis, make desired individual contribution to station’s team efforts by performing as an on-air host that attracts targeted audience and builds ratings in line with desired Sports Talk format.

 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an onsite role that requires the employee to regularly work at our Denver site.

 

What You Will Do:

  • Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:
  • Host sports talk show that is relevant to target audience and generates ratings
  • Conduct topical interviews that are compelling, informative, and interesting and adhere to station’s format philosophy
  • Timely and effectively complete commercial and promotional production assignments
  • Monitor sports news on a daily basis
  • Reflect company values and maintain desired station image to listeners while on-air and during personal appearances
  • Other duties as assigned

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • Two years post high school education
  • Sports knowledge
  • Passion for Denver sports teams and sports news
  • Experience in radio hosting
  • Aggressive attitude with a strong desire to advance in the broadcasting media
  • Ability to use humor
  • Spends time researching topics
  • Ability to be respected by newsmakers during interviews

 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.

$40 per hour

Hourly rate to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

Bonneville is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. job.title: Digital Media Strategist
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

At Bonneville International, our purpose is to build up, connect, inform, and celebrate communities and families in the markets we serve. As an integrated media company, we provide content, advertising, and digital marketing solutions across 19 radio stations in Denver, Phoenix, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, and Seattle, along with the NBC Affiliate TV station, KSL-TV 5, in Salt Lake. We are responsible for lifting and inspiring with respect and giving voice to all the communities and clients we serve.

 

We believe that empowering our employees to share their ideas and experiences will fuel creativity, innovation, and inspiration. A diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to our ability to create and deliver exceptional content, products, and services that represent our communities. We’re proud of our history and we want talented people to join us as we continue to grow!

 

To learn more about Bonneville and how our local media matters, visit: https://bonneville.com/

 

Position Overview

We're looking for someone with exceptional digital acumen to act as our Digital Media Strategist in the Seattle market. This role will contribute to achieving digital revenue goals working collaboratively with our team to represent our digital advertising assets, both owned and operated and third-party vendor extension products, to new and existing clients. In addition, this person will work as a trusted consultant providing recommendations of digital advertising strategies to reach key performance goals and providing evaluations of relevant digital performance metrics.

 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.


What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:


  • Work with AE’s on prospecting and identifying digital revenue opportunities, creating digital sales packages, presenting to clients and assisting in closing the sale. 
  • Conduct virtual and in-person meetings demonstrating digital knowledge and expertise.
  • Achieve and grow digital revenue on all digital platforms both existing and newly added.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, platform changes, and emerging ad technologies; translate market intelligence into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Communicate campaign performance and strategic recommendations to stakeholders ranging from marketing managers to C-suite executives.
  • Product knowledge expert. Demonstrate knowledge of selling digital advertising products including digital display ads, SEO, paid media, social media, mobile, programmatic, IP targeting, OTT, e-mail, mobile advertising and website and landing page development
  • Oversee onboarding and fulfillment of digital advertising campaigns, providing valuable audience insights, tactical consultation, and performance evaluations. 
  • Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement to meet revenue goals.
  • Collaborate with account executives to identify and grow new opportunities.
  • Collaborate with account executives to promote retention of customers and overall positive experience with the brand.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • College degree in business, communications, sales, marketing, related field or equivalent, preferred  
  • Excellent project management skills; experience with sales operations preferred 
  • Possess excellent oral, written, presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Three to five years of digital marketing and advertising sales experience, preferably with programmatic placement 
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising products, attribution tool, and conversion metrics
  • The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, positive, persistent, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment
  • Strong analytical abilities
  • Extensive knowledge and experience with DV360, Google Ads, Google Analytics (G4) and TapClicks.
  • Ability to develop client facing presentations 
  • Willingness to embrace AI innovation in accordance with Bonneville’s policies and procedures
  • Ability to create and present comprehensive marketing solutions 
  • Experience with Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools is a must 
  • Proficiency in managing sophisticated advertising programs and delivery methodologies 

 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Maintain a valid driver's license and proven ability to safely drive personal vehicle without exposing company to serious liability risks. 

 

Compensation Range

$81,000 - $95,500 This salary range spans multiple levels for this role.

Salary will be determined by an evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal and external benchmarks.

  • Robust, affordable medical, dental and vision coverage with no wait period for enrollment
  • 401(k) with Company match and employer-funded retirement account, both fully vested from day one
