We’re proud of our history and we want talented people to join us as we continue to grow!

 

To learn more about Bonneville and how our local media matters, visit: https://bonneville.com/

 

POSITION PURPOSE:

Bonneville Sacramento is seeking a dynamic General Sales Manager to oversee and lead, develop, and inspire our sales team. In this role you’ll help grow revenue and market share across all brands and platforms buidling strong client relationships, creating integrated marketing solutions, and coaching Account Executives to deliver meanginful results for clients.

 

You’ll own sales strategies, budgets, pricing, and inventory management to meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals. As a creative problem solver and motivating leader, you’ll attract and develop top sales talent, foster a collaborative, high-performing culture, and help bring Bonneville International Corporation’s vision, commitments, and values to life.

 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.


  • This position is an onsite role that requires the employee to primarily work at our Sacramento site. Specific schedules will be determined based on business needs and evaluated by managers and senior management.

 

What You Will Do:


  • Build and develop a strong sales team. Recruit and attract top talent, and support their success through coaching, training, goal setting, and performance management.

  • Own revenue growth across brands and platforms. Develop and maintain actionable sales strategies to meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual broadcast and digital budgets, increase market share, and improve year-over-year performance.

  • Drive new and existing business. Lead the team in securing transactional business, developing new business, and growing existing client relationships through solutions that address clients’ marketing needs.

  • Create integrated, client-focused marketing solutions. Help the team combine radio, online, mobile, social media, and sponsorship opportunities to deliver results for clients.

  • Maximize inventory and revenue. Manage advertising inventory, pricing, and rate negotiations to achieve sales goals and maximize revenue.

  • Provide consistent, hands-on leadership. Hold weekly one-on-one meetings with Account Executives to review budgets, account progress, and sales activity; lead weekly staff meetings; regularly join sales calls; and participate in other applicable meetings.

  • Lead ongoing learning and development. Plan and deliver training that strengthens the Sacramento sales team’s professional skills and understanding of new and evolving media.

  • Champion your assigned brands. Represent and advocate for the brands internally and externally, building strong relationships with sales representatives, buyers, planners, and clients.

  • Collaborate across sales leadership. Partner with other Sales Managers and the Director of Sales on forecasting, inventory, sales goals, pricing, presentations, revenue-gap solutions, and day-to-day sales activities, encouraging creativity and a unified team effort.

  • Partner across departments to deliver client results. Work closely with Program Directors, Digital Teams, and Marketing to develop and execute effective client solutions.

  • Foster a culture of sales excellence. Set high standards for professionalism, ethics, integrity, customer service, and performance while encouraging collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:


  • Relevant education and experience. College degree in business, communications, sales, marketing, related field or equivalent experience, preferred. At least five years’ successful sales experience, including two or more years effectively managing a team to achieve sales objectives.

 

  • An inspiring leadership approach. Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing team in a positive, collaborative sales environment

  • Strong multi-platform sales expertise. Knowledge of ad agency, direct, digital, and sponsorship sales with a proven record of achieving budgets across multiple platforms.

  • Sound pricing and negotiation skills. A strong understanding of inventory management and effective pricing, along with the ability to negotiate successfully and identify upselling opportunities.

  • Technology and audience-measurement proficiency. Strong proficiency across Microsoft Office applications and a thorough understanding of Nielsen ratings. Experience with sales management systems such as WideOrbit and Boostr is preferred.

  • Analytical thinking and follow-through. Ability to organize, analyze, and interpret statistical data, draw sound conclusions, and follow through on resulting actions.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. Strong verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to clearly communicate information and instructions, accurately receive and interpret direction, and maintain positive relationships with colleagues, vendors, and clients.

  • Strong organization and attention to detail. Ability to manage time, balance multiple priorities, and complete work accurately with consistent follow-through.

 

  • Adaptability and resourcefulness. Ability to manage stress effectively, resolve unexpected problems, accept direction, adapt to changing needs, and take on unscheduled assignments when needed.

 

  • A professional, team-oriented approach. A collaborative mindset, cooperative working style, and professional appearance and demeanor.

Compensation Range:

$106,000 - $191,000.  Salary will be determined by an evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal and external benchmarks.

 

This role is eligible to earn quarterly / annual bonuses based on performance and hitting established metrics.

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.

job.title: KSL On-Call Master Control Operator (Part-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.

 

Position Overview

The On-Call Master Control Operator plays an important role in supporting the daily operations of KSL TV by providing flexible staffing coverage for Master Control, VTR, and streaming operations. This position helps maintain consistent broadcast operations by filling staffing gaps, covering scheduled absences, assisting during periods of increased workload, and providing additional support when operational needs arise.

 

This role is on-site and requires the employee to work at our Salt Lake City site. As an on-call position, hours are not guaranteed and will vary based on staffing requirements, scheduling needs, and operational demands. The employee must be available to work a flexible schedule, including weekdays, evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays. Shifts may be scheduled in advance or requested as needed to address unexpected staffing shortages.

 

What You Will Do

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

 

  • Provide Master Control, VTR, and streaming coverage as needed to support daily operations.
  • Fill in for regularly scheduled employees during vacations, sick leave, and other absences.
  • Assist with staffing shortages, scheduling gaps, and increased operational demands.
  • Monitor multiple incoming and outgoing signals via broadcast and streaming.
  • Maintain broadcast logs and schedule timing.
  • Ensure the continuity and accuracy of station programming.
  • Perform on-air switching of live news and network broadcasts.
  • Set up, control, and monitor broadcast equipment.
  • Prepare content and clips for on-air playback.
  • Support the production of newscasts and other live or recorded programs.
  • Follow FCC and EAS monitoring procedures.
  • Maintain proficiency with broadcast systems and procedures through ongoing training.
  • Cross-train on different shifts and operational responsibilities as needed.
  • Assist with special projects and assignments as requested by management.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For

  • Previous Master Control experience is a plus.
  • Knowledge of NVerzion automation equipment is helpful.
  • Must be a team player who works well with others.
  • Ability to maintain positive and cooperative relationships with staff and management.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain composure and make sound decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Computer literacy is required.
  • Ability to learn specialized broadcast applications and equipment.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Dependable, responsible, and responsive when contacted regarding available shifts.
  • Must be willing and able to work a flexible, on-call schedule, including weekdays, evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays, to meet the needs of a 24/7/365 operation.
  • Must be able to accommodate schedule changes and occasional short-notice staffing requests.

 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Perform substantial physical movements involving the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Ability to extend hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction with good eye and hand coordination.
  • Lift, move, and carry up to 25 pounds on occasion.

 

Compensation

$18.00 – $23.00 an hour. Hourly rate will be determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

 

What We Offer You: Check Out Our KSL Benefits!

Employees at KSL can enjoy a broad offering of benefits, including:

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
  • Access to an entire team of free financial planners
  • Matches on contributions to charitable organizations after one year of service
  • Continuous growth and development opportunities
  • Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration

 

KSL is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. Minority/female/disability PWDNET/veteran are encouraged to apply.

job.title: KSL Podcast Producer (Full-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.

 

Position Overview

KSL Podcasts is looking for an organized, creative and driven podcast producer with strong audio production skills and the ability to lead a project from concept to completion.

 

You’ll help develop and produce compelling news, investigative and documentary podcasts, including projects like COLD, while contributing to existing shows and new podcast launches. The ideal candidate is a thoughtful storyteller, a skilled audio editor and a dependable project leader who can turn complex material into clear, engaging stories.

 

This role combines hands-on production with responsibility for keeping projects organized and moving forward. You’ll collaborate with hosts, reporters, editors and other team members to shape stories, coordinate production and deliver high-quality episodes. Video production and editing experience is a plus.

 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is a hybrid role that requires the employee to work at our Salt Lake City site. Specific hybrid schedules will be determined based on business needs and evaluated by managers and senior management. Employee may need to be on-site during the training period. Employee must be based in Utah.

 

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

 

Audio Production and Storytelling

  • Research, write, record and edit podcast episodes for serialized and episodic formats.
  • Produce polished audio, including dialogue editing, sound design, mixing and preparation for publication.
  • Record interviews and other audio in studio and field environments.
  • Shape complex reporting and source material into clear, compelling, conversational scripts.
  • Conduct interviews and identify, validate and organize information from a variety of sources.
  • Maintain accuracy and uphold journalistic standards throughout the production process.

 

Project Leadership and Collaboration

  • Lead assigned podcast projects from development through publication, coordinating timelines, deliverables and production needs.
  • Collaborate with hosts, reporters, editors and other contributors to develop stories and coordinate production.
  • Organize research, scripts, recordings and production assets so materials are accessible and projects stay on track.
  • Manage multiple priorities, communicate progress and identify potential obstacles early.
  • Take ownership of deadlines and follow through on assignments while contributing to a supportive, collaborative team.

 

Publishing and Audience Support

  • Publish episodes and maintain accurate episode descriptions and related materials.
  • Track and report podcast performance metrics to help inform future production.
  • Collaborate on promotional content for social media, YouTube and other digital platforms.
  • Support video production and editing as skills and project needs allow.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

 

Required

  • A degree in journalism, communications, audio production or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least two years of relevant experience in podcast production, audio journalism or a related production role.
  • Strong audio recording and editing skills, with proficiency in professional audio production software.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a production project, coordinate contributors and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage detailed materials and multiple assignments.
  • Strong research, interviewing and writing skills, including the ability to produce accurate, concise and conversational copy.
  • Experience operating professional audio equipment in studio and field settings.
  • Sound editorial judgment and a commitment to reporting best practices and journalistic standards.
  • The ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaborate effectively with a team.
  • A dependable, self-motivated approach and the ability to adapt under deadline pressure.

 

Preferred

  • Experience producing investigative, documentary or serialized podcasts.
  • Video shooting and editing skills, including experience with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable software.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office.
  • Experience with public records requests, public records law and computer-assisted reporting.
  • Experience publishing podcasts and using audience analytics to evaluate performance.
  • Experience creating promotional content for social media and YouTube.
  • Experience developing sources and handling sensitive interviews with care and professionalism.

 

Work Expectations

  • Work in compliance with company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain a positive, professional and cooperative relationship with colleagues, management and clients.
  • Work the hours necessary to meet production deadlines, which may occasionally include evenings, weekends or holidays.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.

 

Compensation

 $28.00 – 33.00 an hour. Hourly rate to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

 

What We Offer You: Check Out Our KSL Benefits!

  • Paid leave for new parents under our Medical Maternity and Parental Leave policies
  • Opportunities to apply for tuition reimbursement

  • Access to an entire team of free financial planners
  • Matches on contributions to charitable organizations after one year of service
  • Continuous growth and development opportunities
  • Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration

job.title: KSL TV Multimedia Journalist (Full-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com, KSL‑TV, and KSL NewsRadio. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.


POSITION OVERVIEW: KSL TV 5 is seeking a knowledgeable, engaging Multimedia Journalist with skills including reporting, shooting, and editing. The MMJ will enterprise news stories for live-broadcast and our digital platforms. The ideal candidate will produce engaging and demonstrative live shots, conduct in-depth interviews and craft creative copy for broadcast, digital platforms and social media. 


This is an onsite role that requires the employee to regularly work at Utah locations.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Daily news reporting
  • Shoot, produce and edit news stories from various sources as assigned.
  • Contribute to news coverage by pitching or enterprising potential stories, with a priority given to stories.
  • Write copy for on-air quickly, clearly and accurately
  • Cultivate and maintain news sources
  • Present news in a concise, conversational and accurate manner on-air
  • Update / rewrite story scripts for online publication
  • Effectively and appropriately use social media to present stories via all available media channels.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned, including producing daily midday newscasts or fill in assignments on a case by case basis.
  • Work in compliance with Company policies and procedures.
  • Work effectively in a team environment and maintain a positive and cooperative rapport with staff, management, and clients.
  • Consistently work hours required. Work more when required to meet deadlines, including weekends, holidays, and evenings.
  • Project an appropriate professional appearance and demeanor.
  • Work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays under deadlines

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • Minimum three (3) years of commercial TV broadcast journalism/reporting experience or equivalent.
  • Experienced in videography and editing.
  • College degree in journalism, communications, related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to work with moderate supervision, confidential information and be a self-starter.
  • Capable and willing to resolve unexpected problems and be flexible to perform unscheduled assignments.
  • A high level of proficiency with computers, software and new technologies.
  • Ability to handle high stress environment and meet deadlines.
  • Highly familiar with the benefits and shortcomings of all types of media including, but not limited to “heritage” media as well as all types of current and emerging social and digital media.
  • Maintain a valid driver's license and proven ability to safely drive personal vehicle without exposing company to serious liability risks.
  • Possess excellent oral, written, presentation and interpersonal skills.

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

job.title: KTAR.com OC Web Content Editor
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

At Bonneville International, our purpose is to build up, connect, inform, and celebrate communities and families in the markets we serve. As an integrated media company, we provide content, advertising, and digital marketing solutions across 19 radio stations in Denver, Phoenix, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, and Seattle, along with the NBC Affiliate TV station, KSL-TV 5, in Salt Lake. We are responsible for lifting and inspiring with respect and giving voice to all the communities and clients we serve.

 

We believe that empowering our employees to share their ideas and experiences will fuel creativity, innovation, and inspiration. A diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to our ability to create and deliver exceptional content, products, and services that represent our communities. We’re proud of our history and we want talented people to join us as we continue to grow!

 

To learn more about Bonneville and how our local media matters, visit: https://bonneville.com/

 

Position Overview: To update, gather and create news content for KTAR.com, with some support for ArizonaSports.com. Ensure that all news and sports content on the websites is fresh and represents the high standards of the Company. Work closely and alongside the Newsroom and other departments to achieve this goal. This job involves reporting on general news stories, sports stories and then writing articles for the websites. 

 

Note:  Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an onsite role that requires the employee to regularly work at our Phoenix site.

 

What You Will Do: Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Manage daily content, information, news and features for KTAR.com. Produce graphics/images, web pages, stories, audio/video, social media etc. to accomplish this function.
  • Responsible for making sure that websites and social media platforms are continually fresh from both a content and graphical perspective. Ensure that the KTAR News overall image of quality and leadership is carried over to the web.
  • Ensure deadlines are met and projects are completed on time.
  • Develop web/social pages and websites for new site features, events, activities, etc. This includes gathering relevant information and graphic elements from various departments and entities for the website.
  • Ensure that the website provides and promotes sales activities. Help direct site toward becoming a profitable business activity. Put a priority on sales production work.
  • Market and promote the stations via the Internet and the website. This includes stations’ image and brand, events, products, etc. maximize the sites as effective communications medium for stations.
  • Interface and coordinate with technical team regarding technical aspects of web operations (servers, connectivity, etc.). Work with IT to ensure that systems are functioning properly.
  • Ensure that all web related systems are functioning on a daily basis; streaming, content/data feeds, ad servers, etc.
  • Manage online events and special features (interactive contests, message boards, etc.) as well as social media content.
  • Offer ideas, suggestions and other concepts for the stations’ Internet activities that are innovative and creative.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • Two years post high school education in communication/journalism with skills in the following areas: writing, computer and operational skills, related field, or equivalent.
  • Experience working in a newsroom environment. Prefer experience as a reporter, copy editor and/or web editor.
  • Exceptional news writing, editing, and grammar skills. Ability to edit, produce and create accurate, well-presented content in a quick, timely manner.
  • Experience producing graphics/images, audio and video and posting on social media platforms.
  • Must possess typing skills and computer input ability. Basic computer skills and the ability to learn new programs and basic HTML are required. Must enjoy working with computers and technology.
  • Able to produce, gather, edit and update news content for the KTAR News and Arizona Sports websites on a daily basis. Will require the production and gathering of text, images, web pages, audio/video, etc. and work closely with others in the newsroom to accomplish this function.
  • Able to work independently with little supervision. Requires a track record of dependability and evidence of being a self-starter.
  • Experience in a broadcast journalism environment, professional or collegiate level.
  • Knowledge of newswire services and a working knowledge of computer skills.
  • Aggressive attitude with a strong desire to advance in the broadcasting media.
  • Quick learner who is fully committed to meeting the challenge.
  • Strong desire to work at the state’s largest and most respected radio station.
  • Multi-tasking pro.

 

 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.

 

Compensation Range

 $17.00-$18.00 per hour

Hourly rate will be determined by an evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal and external benchmarks.

job.title: Data Architect
job.description:
Opportunity

Brunswick is accelerating its use of AI to strengthen the advice we give clients and how we operate. We are looking for a Data Architect to join our AI Lab and shape the technical and data foundations that enable us to build and scale proprietary AI products securely and effectively.

This is a hands-on, influential role spanning architecture and practical delivery. You will take a portfolio-wide view of how data, applications, models, APIs and shared components fit together, creating reusable patterns and capabilities that help engineers move faster while maintaining high standards of security, resilience and maintainability.

Working closely with AI Engineers, Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams, you will ensure the Lab has the architecture and underlying platform it needs to innovate at pace while aligning with Brunswick’s wider technology environment.

About the Role

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Design and evolve the data and technical architecture underpinning the AI Lab’s portfolio of proprietary products.
  • Define scalable patterns for how applications, data sources, models, APIs and enterprise systems connect and interact.
  • Design approaches to data modelling, access, storage, movement and governance, particularly for sensitive or business-critical information.
  • Identify opportunities to create reusable services, components and data capabilities that accelerate development across multiple products.
  • Establish standards and patterns for data pipelines, APIs, integration, environments, deployment and observability.
  • Work closely with engineers to translate architectural principles into practical solutions, balancing scalability with rapid prototyping and delivery.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams to ensure solutions meet Brunswick’s security, privacy, governance and architectural standards.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape, reduce duplication and improve interoperability across the firm.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that could strengthen the Lab’s platform or unlock new capabilities.
  • Help build the scalable data foundations Brunswick needs to develop and deploy AI responsibly, securely and effectively.

What We’re Looking For

You will combine strong data and solution architecture skills with a practical engineering mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-moving product environment. You will be comfortable moving between strategic architecture and detailed technical decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs between long-term scalability and speed of delivery. The successful candidate will bring:

 

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role.
  • Strong experience designing scalable data and application architectures, ideally in cloud environments.
  • Experience designing data models, APIs, integrations and data flows across databases, SaaS applications and enterprise systems.
  • Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, storage, access patterns, data warehouses, lakes/lakehouses and governance.
  • Experience with cloud platforms; Microsoft Azure experience is particularly relevant.
  • Good working knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering approaches, including Python.
  • Experience designing reusable technical components, shared services or platforms used across multiple products or teams.
  • A strong understanding of data governance, security, privacy, lineage and quality, and how these are embedded into architecture and delivery.
  • An understanding of the data requirements of AI and machine-learning applications, including securely making structured and unstructured enterprise data available to AI solutions.
  • A good understanding of modern software engineering and SDLC practices, including CI/CD, version control, testing and observability.
  • Sufficient hands-on technical depth to work credibly with engineers, review designs and contribute to implementation where useful.
  • Strong judgement and pragmatism, with the ability to balance consistency and reuse with experimentation and speed.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical colleagues.

Desirable experience

  • Architecting applications or platforms incorporating generative AI, large language models or machine learning.
  • Designing data and integration architectures for AI applications, including retrieval and grounding approaches.
  • Building internal developer platforms, shared services or reusable application frameworks.
  • Working with sensitive enterprise data and complex security or governance requirements.
  • Experience in professional services, financial services, advisory or another complex enterprise environment.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

job.title: Office Assistant
job.description:
Opportunity  

Brunswick is seeking a reliable and organized Office Assistant with at least 12 months of administrative experience to support daily office operations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable handling a variety of clerical and coordination tasks in a fast-paced office environment.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract role, based 5 days per week in our London office.

About the Role

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Monitor capital markets developments, earnings announcements, and broader market trends relevant to clients.
  • Develop strong understanding of investor relations practices, investment decision-making processes, and financial communications.
  • Contribute to strategic recommendations for how companies position themselves with investors and other key stakeholders.

Teamwork and Collaboration

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong academic background (finance/economics would be an advantage).
  • Interest in capital markets, investor behavior, and corporate communications.
  • Understanding of financial concepts, including valuation methodologies, capital structure, earnings drivers, etc., and catalysts for investment decisions.

  • High level of attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and comfort working with data and research tools.

job.title: Account Executive, Technology - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

OUR TEAM  

This role offers the opportunity to develop under the guidance of some of the best in the industry and gain first-hand experience working on high-profile international brands. The experience of the 20+ team enables us to deliver integrated communications, from corporate, B2B and consumer communications, to digital & social, influencers, analyst relations, content marketing and public affairs. We understand technology ecosystems, consumer and business audiences, and the power of the influencer.  

Having a passion for technology is essential for this role as you will be working with several of the world’s leading technology brands. We believe that technology has the power to enhance human experience and performance as we enter a new era of intelligence. Whether it’s the latest enterprise software or the hottest consumer device, as we progress into a new era defined by the advancements in AI, it’s crucial we continue to tell human-first stories. 

THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES  

The team is looking to recruit an Account Executive to work with some of its leading global technology brands (opportunities to work for B2B and consumer). The role involves working on media relations, network coordination and account management to reach primarily consumer audiences.

Annual salary for this role starts at £32,000.

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Supporting on day-to-day media liaison, developing solid media relationships and managing media requests and product reviews 
  • Developing press materials, from press releases and blogs, to Q&As and briefing documents, with a high level of attention to detail 
  • Handling junior client relationships, developing a strong rapport with your day-to-day contact 
  • Overseeing the creation of coverage and activity reports for clients   
  • Managing press briefings, product launches, conferences and similar events for clients 
  • Attending and contributing ideas in internal brainstorms, contributing to generating creative ideas in response to client briefs 
  • Monitoring and keeping abreast of relevant industry news in order to build an understanding of industry trends, competitive landscape and how they impact clients 

 

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES  

  • A positive and proactive attitude to seeking out opportunities to add value to clients and teams 
  • A fan of technology that enhances human progress, with an understanding of the consumer technology market, who is excited by its future within society and business 
  • Experience in the technology and/or telecoms sectors – ideally both, but technology experience is a must 
  • A media hound and storyteller who loves to craft compelling pitches and knows how to sell them to business, trade and national media 
  • A global outlook, with the ability to transfer skills across both UK and global client work 
  • Organisational skills and the ability to tightly manage relationships with international Burson offices 
  • Attention to detail and an appreciation of time management 

#LI-BC1 

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our  California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

  • Operational & Financial Tracking: Track account budgets, vendor invoices, and project timelines to ensure campaigns are delivered efficiently and on budget.

job.description:

For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

We are looking for an Account Supervisor, Social, Digital & Influencer to help clients build meaningful connections with audiences across social platforms, digital channels and creator communities. 

This role sits at the intersection of social strategy, content, culture, influencer marketing and intelligence. You will translate client business and communications objectives into practical programs, guiding work from insight and strategy through content development, creator activation, executive visibility, community engagement, social listening and measurement. 

The ideal candidate understands how brands and leaders show up in social and digital environments, what makes content resonate across audiences and platforms, and how creators can credibly extend a brand's story. You will work directly with clients, partner with creative and integrated agency teams, and manage multiple programs from brief through execution. 

This is a client-facing role with meaningful ownership. We are looking for someone who can provide strategic counsel and also write a brief, build an editorial calendar, evaluate creators, review content, analyze conversation and performance data, manage budgets and troubleshoot.

What you'll do:

Social & Digital Strategy 

  • Develop social and digital strategies grounded in client objectives, audience insights, cultural trends and platform best practices.
  • Translate broader brand, reputation and communications strategies into actionable organic and paid social, creator, community engagement and digital content programs.
  • Conduct audience, competitor, industry and cultural research to identify emerging conversations and opportunities for brands and executives.
  • Define channel roles, audience strategies, content pillars, messaging approaches and publishing plans across LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X and emerging platforms.
  • Build integrated plans that connect owned content, corporate channels, executive voices, creator partnerships and employee advocacy.

Influencer & Creator Marketing 

  • Identify and evaluate creators based on audience relevance, content quality and performance, credibility, brand fit, risk and potential program impact using different tools and manual desk research
  • Manage end-to-end creator programs from sourcing and outreach through rate negotiation, contracting, briefing, content development, approvals, publishing, amplification, reporting and payment coordination.
  • Develop briefing books and clear campaign guidance that translate messaging, creative requirements and submission processes into actionable direction for creators.
  • Review creator content for message accuracy, brand alignment, disclosure requirements, brand safety and other campaign-specific compliance needs.
  • Maintain productive relationships with creators, talent managers, platforms and partner agencies, including clear communication when timelines or requirements change.
  • Track campaign performance, contribute to reporting and performance recaps, and translate results into actionable insights and optimization recommendations.
  • Track and manage influencer out-of-pocket (OOP) budgets, including creator fees, payments, product reimbursements and other expenses as needed.
  • Coordinate influencer payments through applicable platforms and payment processes, ensuring accurate and timely processing.
  • Coordinate SAG-AFTRA pension and health contributions, as applicable, using relevant vendors and platforms.
  • Support the management of creator contracts, usage rights, content licensing and paid amplification permissions, coordinating with relevant internal teams as needed.

Content, Editorial & Executive Visibility 

  • Develop social-first content strategies, campaign concepts, executive visibility plans and channel amplification recommendations.
  • Write and edit social copy, executive LinkedIn content, briefs, messaging and other digital communications in distinct brand and leader voices.
  • Partner with creative to develop supporting assets and owned content, and coordinate content through client, legal or regulatory review processes when applicable.
  • Review work with a clear understanding of the differences among brand content, executive content, creator content and culturally relevant community content.
  • Identify appropriate formats for leaders and brands to engage, including original posts, reshares, comments, employee advocacy and cross-channel amplification.

Social Listening, Intelligence & Measurement 

  • Use social listening and native platform data to assess brand, executive, competitor and category conversations, including volume, sentiment, share of voice, emerging narratives and top-performing content.
  • Support recurring reporting, executive engagement recommendations, campaign measurement, quarterly earnings monitoring and rapid-response monitoring during fast-moving issues.
  • Work with analytics partners to define objectives and KPIs and evaluate metrics such as reach, impressions, engagement, video views, clicks, audience growth and creator performance.

About the role: 

We are a dynamic team with a well-established and fast-growing health practice. We are looking for someone who brings a great attitude, energy, curiosity and strong communications skills to support our clients at a critical and fascinating time for Canadian health care.

The Assistant Consultant, Health Communications is an existing role that will support our growing Health practice, the development and execution of integrated communications programs for clients across the health sector. You will help translate complex health, science and policy issues into clear and compelling communications, monitor the evolving health and media landscape, develop content for a variety of audiences and channels, and support media relations and stakeholder engagement.

You will work alongside communications, public affairs, digital, creative and research colleagues, gaining exposure to a range of clients and assignments across the Canadian health landscape.

Here’s what you’d be doing

  • Supporting the development and execution of integrated health communications strategies and campaigns across earned, owned, social and digital channels.
  • Monitoring and reporting on health news, media coverage, industry developments and emerging issues that may affect clients and their audiences.
  • Supporting media relations, including developing media lists, researching journalists, preparing pitches and background materials, coordinating media outreach and tracking coverage.
  • Drafting and editing a range of communications materials, including news releases, key messages, Q&As, briefing notes, media pitches, backgrounders, fact sheets, articles, social content, presentations and executive materials.
  • Helping translate complex medical, scientific, health policy and industry information into clear, accessible and engaging content for different audiences.
  • Conducting research to inform communications strategies, campaigns, thought leadership and client recommendations.
  • Supporting corporate reputation, disease awareness, product and brand communications, patient and stakeholder engagement, executive communications and thought leadership initiatives.
  • Helping project manage communications programs by coordinating timelines, deliverables, approvals and reporting across client and internal teams.
  • Supporting the development of client presentations, communications plans, campaign reports and measurement materials.
  • Coordinating with digital, creative, research, public affairs and other specialists to deliver integrated communications programs.
  • Staying current on conversations and developments across health care, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, patient advocacy and the broader health ecosystem.
  • Supporting new business opportunities, including research, brainstorms, proposal development and pitches.
  • Building strong, collaborative relationships with colleagues, clients, media and health-sector stakeholders.

What’s in it for you?

  • A full health benefits package, including healthy paid time off, schedule flexibility, fitness reimbursement and more.
  • The opportunity to work on meaningful communications programs addressing some of the most important issues in health care.
  • Exposure to a diverse range of clients and assignments across the health sector.
  • The opportunity to work alongside specialists in health communications, public affairs, digital, creative, research and behavioural science.
  • A passionate, collaborative and creative office culture.
  • Strong leadership with a focus on training, mentorship and professional development.
  • Opportunities to develop your skills across media relations, storytelling, integrated communications, digital engagement and health-sector communications strategy.

What you’ll need to get here

  • 1 to 2 years of experience in communications, public relations, media relations, health communications or a related field. Experience in health care, pharmaceuticals, life sciences or an agency environment is an asset.
  • An undergraduate degree in communications, public relations, journalism, health sciences, political science or a related field.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills, with the ability to develop clear, concise and engaging content.
  • A strong interest in health care, health communications and the issues shaping Canada’s health system.
  • An understanding of the Canadian media landscape and an interest in building strong media relations skills.
  • The ability to understand complex health, medical or scientific information and translate it into accessible communications.
  • Strong research, analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Creative thinking, curiosity and initiative, with an interest in finding new ways to tell compelling health stories.
  • Excellent project and time-management skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • The ability to work effectively across multiple client teams and adapt to different clients, audiences and assignments.
  • An interest in integrated communications, including earned media, digital and social media, stakeholder communications and content development.
  • A collaborative attitude, curiosity and a genuine desire to grow your communications skills, health-sector knowledge and professional network.

This role sits within Burson London’s Corporate and Public Affairs division, a team of over one hundred problem solvers who partner with brands, organisations, and governments to navigate complex reputational, policy and regulatory challenges. This is an integrated role combining proactive corporate reputation building, and reactive issues. The work is sector agnostic, but we are particularly interested in corporate people with financial services and payments experience in a consultancy environment. 

The right candidate has built a career over more than five years in agency or fast paced in-house comms environments. They will be as adept at earned media relations as digital reputational building. They will be AI curious and inspired by an agency that is investing in the latest technology to drive efficiency and impact. They will confidently manage complex client relationships and provide strategic counsel, with gravitas and will inspire clients to grow with Burson, and nurture juniors to develop under their guidance.

With a growth mindset, new business is a core driver of growth, and the candidate will have had proven experience of leading and winning pitches. They will also be comfortable networking and happy to leverage their contacts to bring new opportunities in for the agency.

 

What you'll do:

 

  • Be a trusted advisor to clients, add value to client relationships, and provide high level strategic counsel – this is in both a proactive and a reactive (issues) capacity
  • Take a leading role in developing the global and UK client work, retaining existing client work, and growing new business across crisis and issues as well as proactive reputation management
  • Build the visibility and reputation of the team – with a view to winning new business and attracting talent
  • Manage client teams while nurturing current talent and contributing to the creation of a dedicated team culture, while building relationships across the agency
  • Be responsible for budget monitoring, revenue forecasting and planning, resourcing, overseeing client budgets and fee negotiation to ensure correct level of profitability
  • Act as a representative for the team in relevant specialist forums or network groups and participate where appropriate in relevant speaker platforms
  • Apply the latest in thinking and innovation including, but not exclusively, AI

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Experience in an agency or in-house role (some agency experience is essential)
  • Entrepreneurial with evidence of having independently sought and driven revenue growth, including prospect finding, nurturing, acquisition and relationship management
  • Comfortable and experienced working with multiple stakeholder groups including consumers, shareholders, suppliers, employees, and media
  • Comfortable leading new business pitches, as well as inputting to wider corporate and crisis opportunities
  • Proven track record of successfully managing relationships, clients and programmes for multinational corporates or prominent organisations in the UK and abroad
  • Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills with the ability to anticipate risks, develop proactive plans and make critical decisions under pressure
  • Comfortable and competent in developing teams and managing operational areas e.g. commercials, resourcing etc
  • Experience of working on financial services / payments accounts / environments 
  • Ability to flex between 'corpsumer' work and the thornier end of corporate is helpful for this broad reaching role

More about the role:

Burson is building three global Influence & Social Centres of Excellence in the US, Singapore, and London. As part of our UK Centre of Excellence, which serves as the hub for the EMEA region, we are seeking an Associate Director, Influence to play a pivotal, hands-on role in scaling and evolving our Total Influence offer.

This is an exciting opportunity for a mid-to-senior influencer specialist who combines strategic vision with flawless operational execution. Sitting within our multi-disciplinary capability, you will be the day-to-day strategic engine and trusted advisor across all agency practices. You will plan, oversee, and execute best-in-class influencer-led campaigns that earn cultural relevance, protect reputation, and deliver measurable business impact.

As an Influence Associate Director, you will be a dynamic, commercially astute specialist and creative thinker, leading best-in-class, influencer-led content strategies and programmes across all agency sectors. Viewing "influence" holistically, you will provide strategic and practical counsel to clients and internal teams; from identification, vetting, and contracting to creative co-creation, paid integration, and measurement. Partnering with UK head of Influence, you will elevate Burson’s influencer marketing offer, inspire dedicated specialists, and upskill teams to deliver exceptional, measurable results.

What you'll do:

 

Grow: Commercial & Sector Partnership

  • Strategic Influence Partner: Act as a trusted adviser to sector and practice leads, translating client and business briefs into culturally relevant, influencer-led strategies.
  • Commercial & Organic Growth: Partner with the UK Head of Influence and senior teams to develop winning pitches, shape commercial models and identify opportunities to grow influence across existing and new client accounts.
  • Holistic Influence Strategy: Champion a broader view of influence beyond traditional creators, incorporating thought leaders, B2B voices, subject-matter experts and advocates across owned, earned, shared and paid channels.

Enable: Delivery, Operations & Best Practice

  • Best-in-Class Campaign Delivery: Lead end-to-end influencer programmes, from discovery, vetting and contracting through to creator briefing, co-creation, rights management and live campaign delivery.
  • Creative, Paid & Performance Integration: Work closely with creators to deliver authentic, high-quality content while connecting organic influence with paid amplification, licensing, whitelisting and performance marketing opportunities.
  • Governance, Tools & Team Development: Ensure programmes meet ASA, CMA, IP and Burson compliance standards, while embedding tools such as CreatorIQ and GWI and upskilling teams on influencer best practice, cultural trends and effective ways of working.

Transform: Innovation & Modern Measurement

  • Measurement & Impact: Partner with data and intelligence specialists to evolve how influence is measured, moving beyond vanity metrics to demonstrate sentiment, cultural share of voice, reputation shift and conversion.
  • Platform & Innovation Leadership: Build strong relationships with platforms including TikTok, Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn, while testing and embedding AI and emerging capabilities through Burson's AI suite and WPP Open to improve discovery, reporting and workflow efficiency.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Proven Agency Experience: Substantial influencer marketing experience within an agency, PR, or integrated creative environment, operating at Account Director / Junior Associate Director level.
  • Strategic & Creative Rigour: Ability to plan multi-channel content strategies that are influencer-first, with a strong understanding of how audience mapping and data inform creative platforms and creator selection.
  • Negotiation & Contracting Mastery: Deep practical expertise in creator negotiation, complex scope structuring, multi-platform licensing, exclusivity, and contract management.
  • Tech Fluency: Hands-on proficiency with dedicated influencer tech platforms (specifically CreatorIQ) and consumer research tools (such as GWI).
  • Collaborative Leadership: A natural relationship-builder who can seamlessly partner with cross-functional teams (strategy, creative, earned media, paid, data) and mentor junior talent.
  • Client Advisory Skills: Calm, authoritative client-handling skills with the ability to articulate the strategic value of influencer marketing to both senior brand marketers and communications directors.
  • Commercial Acumen: Experience building accurate scopes of work, production budgets, talent fees, and pitch responses that protect agency margins and client ROI.

Burson Buchanan is a boutique advisory firm within the Burson Group, focused on financial communications, litigation and government investigations, and crisis and risk management. Buchanan advises corporate clients, investment firms and organizations on stakeholder engagement and reputation management through moments of transformation, complexity, and opportunity. Our team leverages decades of experience navigating high-stakes matters, while integrating Burson's proprietary technology and insights, enabling us to deliver strategic advisory for the intelligence era. 

Burson Buchanan is seeking a highly driven Associate to support client engagements across capital markets situations, litigation, and high-stakes issues management. This role is ideal for a rising strategic communicator with experience working on sensitive, business-critical challenges for clients.

The Associate will work closely with Buchanan team members on multi-faceted programs involving crisis response, high-profile litigation, and major capital markets events including M&A, IPOs and activist defense. They’ll have a front-row seat and opportunity to shape the most critical and high-profile challenges facing companies today.

The right candidate will bring a fast, focused approach to every engagement. They’ll stay responsive around the clock to clients and colleagues, get up to speed quickly on each client, and take pride in producing polished deliverables under pressure. Above all, they’ll thrive in a close-knit team and enjoy contributing meaningfully in a fast-paced, collaborative, and high-performance environment.

What you'll do:

Litigation & Issues Management

  • Support the development and execution of communications and stakeholder engagement strategies for crisis, litigation, government investigations, policy matters, and corporate reputation challenges.
  • Conduct research, rapid situational analysis and synthesize findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Assist in message development, positioning, and scenario planning for sensitive issues affecting corporate operations and leadership.
  • Draft press releases, statements, talking points, key messages, and media background materials.

Financial & Investor Communications

  • Contribute to financial communications programs, including the development of stakeholder communications materials related to M&A, IPOs, shareholder activism, and quarterly earnings.
  • Conduct research on market trends, investor sentiment, and peer positioning to support strategic recommendations.
  • Assist in preparing materials for interactions with analysts, shareholders, and financial media.

Client Engagement & Account Management

  • Serve as a core member of Buchanan client teams, supporting ongoing project management.
  • Support senior leadership in the development of briefings, memos, media materials, Q&A documents and client-facing research.
  • Help coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution and strong client service.

Media Engagement & Issues Tracking

  • Support proactive and reactive media engagement for corporate, financial, and crisis-related matters.
  • Lead media monitoring efforts on client engagements, tracking notable developments, and delivering impactful insights.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 1-2 years of experience in public affairs, corporate communications, financial communications, or public relations—agency or in-house.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting clients on issues such as litigation, government investigations, crisis and reputational management, policy/public affairs, and corporate financial events (e.g. M&A, IPOs, shareholder activism situations).
  • The ability to prepare quality client-facing materials under compressed timelines.
  • Ability to think critically, analyze complex information, and anticipate risks and opportunities.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills and comfort interacting with senior leaders.
  • Proactive, organized, and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Preferred:

  • Experience with financial research tools including platforms such as the Bloomberg Terminal, AlphaSense, and Capital IQ.
  • Understanding of capital markets, investor relations and financial media engagement.
  • Familiarity with litigation and regulatory communications.
  • Prior agency experience strongly preferred.

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The Harold Burson Summer Internship (HBSI) Program gives early-career professionals an opportunity to explore the world of communications at a top-tier global communications agency during an exhilarating 12-week experience. 

The HBSI culminates a real-world challenge where interns research, design and present a campaign for a current Burson client to the agency’s senior management, receiving feedback, tips and insights that would ordinarily take years to obtain. The summer internship program offers an invaluable career-development experience. So … are you ready to be a Harold Burson summer intern?  

The program will run from June 7– August 31, 2027, and you will be connected to one of our U.S. offices. The health and well-being of our employees, including you as our future intern, are our top priorities. All our offices are open, and we plan to welcome you to them as many days a week as you'd like, but Burson U.S. is currently following an in-office hybrid policy.  

Please note, this application is for one of our client-facing positions within the following practices: Consumer & Brand, Corporate & Public Affairs, Digital, Health & Wellness, Insights & Intelligence, Performance Media, Transportation, Energy & Industrials, Technology, and Grassroots (Direct Impact). To help you understand our practices and to aid in your decision making when choosing your top three areas of interest, please review the descriptions at the bottom of this post.  

There is a separate application for Creative roles on the Burson HBSI landing page. If you are interested in a Creative role and this client facing role, please feel free to apply for both. They are all still a part of the broader Harold Burson Summer Internship, you will just have a different focus area.  

Application requirements (Incomplete applications will not be eligible for consideration):  

  1. Resume 
  2. Cover Letter
  3. Writing Prompt: AI is changing the way we communicate, create and solve problems. As our industry continues to evolve, how we use these tools matters just as much as what they help us achieve. In 500 words, how would you use AI responsibly and thoughtfully while staying true to Burson's core values?

APPLICATION DEADLINE: Friday, January 10, 2027 at 11:59 pm PST. If you have specific questions, please email the HBSI team at HBSIProgram@bursonglobal.com. 

What you'll do:

  • During this paid internship, interns work alongside top professionals in the field, participating in everything from strategy and planning discussions to creative brainstorms aimed at capturing national news, shaping public opinion and sparking community engagement. 

    • Consumer & Brand: We build brands that enhance reputation, create culture and influence consumer behavior. Whether putting brands into pop culture at the speed of news or addressing more deeply seeded societal challenges, we develop communications that create reputation capital for our clients with unrivaled intelligence, innovation and impact. 
    • Corporate & Public Affairs: From policy shifts to trade to supply chain dynamics, our experts have worked directly with policymakers around the world. We understand the drivers and know the players, the power centers and the right messages – and messengers – for success. Our global team of strategic advisors provide seasoned counsel and nuanced strategies that reflect and respond to the multi-layered realities of today’s global communities. 
    • Digital: The Digital team customizes campaigns for their clients. From insights to influence and content to paid media, digital designs engagements for brands that move audiences to action. Whether launching social media pages, introducing always-on paid media campaigns or developing creative that breaks through the clutter, Burson’s digital team is synonymous with change and innovation. 
    • Health & Wellness: We provide strategic counsel and flawless execution from corporate to R&D communications to regulatory milestones and more. We have strong connections to regulatory bodies and a deep understanding of the intersection of advocacy, policy and sustainability. 
    • Insights & Intelligence: Burson's Insights & Intelligence team transforms information into action. We cut through the noise, analyzing brand perception, monitoring online conversations, and conducting custom research to uncover actionable strategies. Leveraging data science and AI, we uncover hidden patterns and predict future outcomes with precision, empower brands and businesses with the insights they need to succeed.
    • Performance Media: The Performance Media team specializes in developing integrated media campaigns that intersect audiences where, how and when they are the most receptive to content. The team is focused on developing programs that not only drive results, but also uplift the brand.  The team works to craft amazing stories on behalf of our clients that get audiences to move in the desired direction to make defendable business impact across digital media channels and develop custom measurement and attribution programs to deliver.  
    • Technology: Technology has never been more transformative, more promising or more risky. Burson deftly navigates that balance, and no one is better prepared to help technology clients navigate what's next. 
    • Transportation, Energy & Industrials: From the way people and goods move to the systems that power our world, we help clients navigate complex, fast-moving environments and position themselves for progress. We combine deep issues expertise with an understanding of the policies, regulations and stakeholder networks shaping these industries to help clients navigate challenges and reach the audiences that matter most.
    • Direct Impact (Grassroots): Our team has a nationwide field network that offers scalable, high impact communications services covering every community, media market, political jurisdiction, and digital landscape in the U.S. We redefine what is means to engage communities and move stakeholders through 21st century grassroots and purpose-driven communications. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • At the start of the internship, must be a recent (May/June) 2027 graduate. 
  • Strong research, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.  

Please note, Burson does not provide any form of relocation/housing assistance. Once hired, it will be up to the individual to find accommodations for the duration of the program.

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.

The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range between:$15—$19 USD

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

job.description:
