WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The Harold Burson Summer Internship (HBSI) Program gives early-career professionals an opportunity to explore the world of communications at a top-tier global communications agency during an exhilarating 12-week experience. 

The HBSI culminates a real-world challenge where interns research, design and present a campaign for a current Burson client to the agency’s senior management, receiving feedback, tips and insights that would ordinarily take years to obtain. The summer internship program offers an invaluable career-development experience. So … are you ready to be a Harold Burson summer intern?  

The program will run from June 7– August 31, 2027, and you will be connected to one of our U.S. offices. The health and well-being of our employees, including you as our future intern, are our top priorities. All our offices are open, and we plan to welcome you to them as many days a week as you'd like, but Burson U.S. is currently following an in-office hybrid policy.  

Please note, this application is for one of our client-facing positions within the following practices: Consumer & Brand, Corporate & Public Affairs, Digital, Health & Wellness, Insights & Intelligence, Performance Media, Transportation, Energy & Industrials, Technology, and Grassroots (Direct Impact). To help you understand our practices and to aid in your decision making when choosing your top three areas of interest, please review the descriptions at the bottom of this post.  

There is a separate application for Creative roles on the Burson HBSI landing page. If you are interested in a Creative role and this client facing role, please feel free to apply for both. They are all still a part of the broader Harold Burson Summer Internship, you will just have a different focus area.  

Application requirements (Incomplete applications will not be eligible for consideration):  

  1. Resume 
  2. Cover Letter
  3. Writing Prompt: AI is changing the way we communicate, create and solve problems. As our industry continues to evolve, how we use these tools matters just as much as what they help us achieve. In 500 words, how would you use AI responsibly and thoughtfully while staying true to Burson's core values?

APPLICATION DEADLINE: Friday, January 10, 2027 at 11:59 pm PST. If you have specific questions, please email the HBSI team at HBSIProgram@bursonglobal.com. 

What you'll do:

  • During this paid internship, interns work alongside top professionals in the field, participating in everything from strategy and planning discussions to creative brainstorms aimed at capturing national news, shaping public opinion and sparking community engagement. 

    • Consumer & Brand: We build brands that enhance reputation, create culture and influence consumer behavior. Whether putting brands into pop culture at the speed of news or addressing more deeply seeded societal challenges, we develop communications that create reputation capital for our clients with unrivaled intelligence, innovation and impact. 
    • Corporate & Public Affairs: From policy shifts to trade to supply chain dynamics, our experts have worked directly with policymakers around the world. We understand the drivers and know the players, the power centers and the right messages – and messengers – for success. Our global team of strategic advisors provide seasoned counsel and nuanced strategies that reflect and respond to the multi-layered realities of today’s global communities. 
    • Digital: The Digital team customizes campaigns for their clients. From insights to influence and content to paid media, digital designs engagements for brands that move audiences to action. Whether launching social media pages, introducing always-on paid media campaigns or developing creative that breaks through the clutter, Burson’s digital team is synonymous with change and innovation. 
    • Health & Wellness: We provide strategic counsel and flawless execution from corporate to R&D communications to regulatory milestones and more. We have strong connections to regulatory bodies and a deep understanding of the intersection of advocacy, policy and sustainability. 
    • Insights & Intelligence: Burson's Insights & Intelligence team transforms information into action. We cut through the noise, analyzing brand perception, monitoring online conversations, and conducting custom research to uncover actionable strategies. Leveraging data science and AI, we uncover hidden patterns and predict future outcomes with precision, empower brands and businesses with the insights they need to succeed.
    • Performance Media: The Performance Media team specializes in developing integrated media campaigns that intersect audiences where, how and when they are the most receptive to content. The team is focused on developing programs that not only drive results, but also uplift the brand.  The team works to craft amazing stories on behalf of our clients that get audiences to move in the desired direction to make defendable business impact across digital media channels and develop custom measurement and attribution programs to deliver.  
    • Technology: Technology has never been more transformative, more promising or more risky. Burson deftly navigates that balance, and no one is better prepared to help technology clients navigate what's next. 
    • Transportation, Energy & Industrials: From the way people and goods move to the systems that power our world, we help clients navigate complex, fast-moving environments and position themselves for progress. We combine deep issues expertise with an understanding of the policies, regulations and stakeholder networks shaping these industries to help clients navigate challenges and reach the audiences that matter most.
    • Direct Impact (Grassroots): Our team has a nationwide field network that offers scalable, high impact communications services covering every community, media market, political jurisdiction, and digital landscape in the U.S. We redefine what is means to engage communities and move stakeholders through 21st century grassroots and purpose-driven communications. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • At the start of the internship, must be a recent (May/June) 2027 graduate. 
  • Strong research, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.

More about the role:

We’re looking for a digital specialist with experience in paid media. 

This existing role will report to our Senior Director, Digital. The Digital Specialist will play a key role in supporting digital research, planning, and paid media solutions for our clients. Based in Toronto, you will work within our Digital team, working closely with our practice teams and consultants across Canada to execute digital paid media across social, programmatic, and search.   

The role is perfect for a digital marketing native, someone who has 2-4 years’ experience working hands-on within the social advertising platforms – including Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Google. They will have a proven ability to manage the end-to-end planning and optimization process. They will be responsible for supporting a range of clients and sectors—such as, Consumer, Health, Tech, Public Affairs, and Energy—with a variety of objectives. Experience in SEO and GEO are a bonus.  

Here’s what you’ll be doing: 

You will be responsible for supporting our sector teams and clients throughout the end-to-end campaign management process, including:   

  • Management and/or QA of paid media campaign creation and set-up process for social and digital paid campaigns
  • On-going monitoring, analysis, and optimization of campaign activity
  • Supporting budget reconciliation and finance management, as required
  • Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies  
  • Research and supporting the development of paid media plans
  • Performance analysis and reporting for social, content, and digital paid media performance 

What you’ll need to get here: 

  • 2-4 years + of hands-on experience setting up, managing and optimizing digital media campaigns for brands – particularly on paid digital and social platforms
  • Agency-side experience is preferable, but in-house experience is also valuable
  • In-depth experience across social platforms – Facebook/Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, SEM, and YouTube (and Google Ads more widely)
  • Web Analytics capabilities is a plus, especially knowledge of GA4 and unpacking acquisition trends
  • Any experience in other areas of digital media (programmatic, paid search, affiliates, SEO, GEO) is preferable, as is any experience in traditional media channels  
  • High attention to detail
  • Experience delivering client service excellence
  • Capability to problem solve; Have a highly numerical and analytical approach

Burson fait partie du groupe WPP (LSE/NYSE : WPP), spécialiste de la transformation créative. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur bursonglobal.com et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn et Instagram.

 

En savoir plus sur le rôle:

Nous vous proposons de rejoindre notre département Corporate, composé d’une équipe de 10 consultants passionnés, qui accompagnent des entreprises françaises et internationales dans la gestion de leur réputation.

Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les expertises de l’agence, Consumer, Tech, Santé, Digital, Gestion de crise et Affaires publiques, nous concevons et déployons des stratégies de communication intégrées et à forte valeur ajoutée, au service des enjeux business et réputationnels de nos clients.

Dans un environnement stimulant, vous accompagnerez des organisations issues de secteurs variés, contribuerez activement au développement de nouveaux comptes et participerez au renforcement de notre expertise corporate.

A ce titre, vos missions seront les suivantes :

Conseil stratégique et accompagnement client

  • Participer activement à l’élaboration de recommandations stratégiques et de plans d’actions.

  • Accompagner les clients sur leurs enjeux de réputation, de visibilité et de transformation.

  • Développer des positionnements, plateformes de messages, éléments de langage et narratifs adaptés aux différents publics cibles.

  • Anticiper les besoins des clients, identifier les risques et leur apporter des recommandations proactives et opérationnelles.

  • Contribuer à la qualité de la relation conseil au quotidien avec les clients.

Relations avec les parties prenantes et influence

  • Concevoir et déployer des programmes de relations avec les parties prenantes des clients, y compris avec les médias  : veille stratégique, identification d’opportunités éditoriales, campagnes de médiatisation et dispositifs de visibilité.

  • Piloter les relations avec les journalistes, médias clés, leaders d’opinion et créateurs de contenus pertinents pour les clients.

  • Organiser interviews, événements presse, rencontres éditoriales et partenariats de brand content.

  • Développer et entretenir un réseau solide de journalistes, médias et influenceurs, en France comme à l’international.

Production de contenus et excellence rédactionnelle

  • Rédiger et/ou superviser la production de contenus à forte valeur ajoutée : communiqués de presse, pitchs médias, tribunes, dossiers de presse, livres blancs, FAQ, articles d’expertise, prises de parole de dirigeants ou contenus digitaux.

  • Garantir la qualité rédactionnelle des livrables clients et accompagner les équipes dans l’amélioration continue de leurs productions écrites.

Gestion de projet et coordination

  • Assurer le pilotage opérationnel des programmes confiés : suivi des budgets, gestion des délais et reporting client.

  • Veiller à la performance des actions mises en œuvre et à la satisfaction des clients.

  • Contribuer à la rentabilité des comptes et au développement durable des relations clients.

Développement commercial et développement de l’expertise

  • Participer activement aux réflexions stratégiques, aux brainstormings et aux travaux de recherche nécessaires aux recommandations.

  • Contribuer à la préparation des propositions commerciales, des appels d’offres et des soutenances de new business.

  • Identifier de nouvelles opportunités de développement auprès des clients existants et prospects.

  • Participer au rayonnement de l’expertise Corporate de l’agence et contribuer au partage des connaissances au sein des équipes.

Collaboration transverse

  • Travailler étroitement avec les autres expertises de l’agence afin de proposer des dispositifs de communication intégrés et innovants.

 

Profil recherché : 

  • Vous justifiez de 4 à 6 années d’expérience en agence de communication ou de relations publics, ou au sein de la Direction de la communication d’une entreprise, avec une expertise reconnue sur les enjeux de réputation et communication corporate. 

  • Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation Bac +3 à Bac +5 (type IEP, droit, affaires publiques, écoles de commerce, sciences politiques). 

  • Vous disposez d’une solide compréhension des enjeux de communication interne, marque employeur, conduite du changement et engagement des collaborateurs. 

  • Vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de relations médias, les stratégies d’influence ainsi que la production de contenus corporate. 

  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité d’analyse, votre sens du conseil et votre aptitude à transformer des problématiques complexes en recommandations concrètes et impactantes. 

  • Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français à l’écrit comme à l’oral et êtes capable de travailler quotidiennement en anglais, dans un contexte international. 

  • Créatif(ve), curieux(se) et force de proposition, vous aimez imaginer de nouveaux dispositifs et faire émerger des idées différenciantes. 

  • Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de rigueur, d’organisation et d’un excellent sens des priorités. 

  • Doté(e) d’un fort esprit d’équipe, vous appréciez les environnements collaboratifs et transverses. 

  • Vous êtes à l’aise dans la gestion de plusieurs projets simultanément et savez évoluer dans un environnement exigeant et dynamique.

 

Ce Que Nous Vous Offrons :

  1. Un environnement stimulant : Intégrez une agence reconnue mondialement, au cœur des stratégies de communication des plus grandes marques.

  4. Une culture d’entreprise forte : Rejoignez une équipe dynamique et collaborative.

job.title: Consumer PR Account Director - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About the Team

The Burson Sport, Brand & Entertainment team works with some of the world’s most ambitious consumer brands, helping them earn attention, build cultural relevance and drive conversation across markets. This role will sit across a varied client portfolio of FMCG, Retail and Travel brands including; TK Maxx UK, RAK, Nestle and Royal Caribbean Cruises, supporting work that spans brand storytelling, influence, earned media and travel communications.

The team is united by a belief in the power of culture, creativity and influence to shape how people discover, engage with and talk about brands. Across fashion and retail, lifestyle and technology, and food and drink, the team develops work that is insight-led, locally relevant and capable of travelling across multiple markets.

More about the role:

We are looking for an ambitious, enthusiastic Account Director to join the Sports, Brand & Entertainment team and work across a portfolio of major consumer clients: TK Maxx, RAK, Royal Carribean and Nestle EMEA. The role requires someone with FMCG, travel and retail experience, strong multi-market experience, a confident understanding of earned and influence, and the ability to bring fresh energy, strategic thinking and operational rigour to a fast-moving client portfolio.

The role will involve leading day-to-day client relationships, shaping earned and influencer-led activity, and managing hub responsibilities including market coordination, toolkit development, content planning and campaign roll-out. The right candidate will bring strong media and creator insight, confidence advising senior clients, and excellent organisational skills to help deliver consistent, culturally relevant work across multiple markets.

The annual salary for this role starts from £52,000. 

What you'll do:

  • Drive Excellence: Play a key role within a driven, ambitious, and collaborative team.
  • Manage Client Relationships: Serve as a trusted advisor and day-to-day lead across TK Maxx, Nestle, RAK and RCC, building strong relationships with senior clients and market teams.
  • Provide Media & Influence Insights: Bring a deep understanding of the evolving media, creator and influence landscape, identifying opportunities that help brands earn attention and relevance.
  • Create Assets: Develop clear, engaging toolkits, assets and content that support both global hub requirements and local market activation.
  • Market Liaison: Act as a central hub to coordinate, advise and align multiple markets, ensuring campaigns are delivered consistently while allowing for local nuance.
  • Strategy & Creativity: Write strategic plans and champion bold, creative work.
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Use data and insights to build and drive effective campaigns.
  • Campaign Coordination: Oversee the planning and delivery of integrated earned, influencer and activation programmes across global, regional and local teams.
  • Leverage Technology: Expertly integrate a broad range of bespoke WPP HAI tools to optimize day-to-day efficiency and outputs.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Strategic & Creative Thinker: A natural ability to think big and connect creative ideas to business goals.
  • Culturally Plugged In: On the pulse of current social trends, street style, and wider culture, with an understanding of how these elements generate campaign cut-through.
  • Proven Track Record: Experience creating and activating impactful campaigns for major consumer brands, ideally across fashion and retail, lifestyle technology, and food and drink sectors.
  • Media, Creator & Influence Expertise: A strong understanding of the media, creator and influence landscape, with the ability to develop credible influencer strategies and earned storytelling across markets.
  • Client Leadership: Proven experience managing clients and leading projects from initial concept design to final delivery.
  • Financial Acumen: Proficient in preparing, tracking, and managing project budgets.
  • Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Detail-Oriented: Exceptional organizational skills with sharp attention to detail, especially when working under pressure or tight deadlines.
  • Multi-Market Mindset: Proven multi-market communications experience is essential, including the ability to manage hub responsibilities, coordinate local market needs and deliver work that travels effectively across regions.

job.description:

For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Burson is seeking a Copywriter who is passionate about health, culture, and big creative ideas to join our growing healthcare team. You’ll help bring a fresh creative lens to pharmaceutical communications, developing work that makes complex health topics more human, relevant, and engaging.

This is a hands-on creative role for someone who wants to dig into the work, challenge the expected, and make the ideas stronger. You’ll collaborate closely with art partners and Associate Creative Directors to concept, write, refine, and bring ideas to life across channels. We’re looking for someone with curiosity, creative ambition, and the drive to continually push the work while contributing to the growth of important client relationships.

You will be joining a team that has won Cannes Lions, Clio, New York Festivals, SABER and PRWeek awards among others .... so you are joining a great team! 

To develop creative communications campaigns for our clients across the earned, owned, paid and shared spaces, we turn to creative and design expertise to come up with original concepts that will break through the noise. 

The Creative team works across the entire Burson client roster to ideate, develop and produce earned campaigns. Our work connects consumers and brands by creating campaigns and content that dig deeper and imagine more. We’ve gathered an intentionally disparate collection of designers, writers, producers, and other creators to give us the expertise to credibly deliver content and programming that can live across any and all platforms. And to that end, we look for people who love what they do and can roll up their sleeves to push our creative even further!

Because your work tells us more than a resume ever could, a portfolio is required. We welcome both published and unpublished work and encourage you to share pieces that best demonstrate how you think, concept, and write. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Click here to see and learn more about our award-winning Creative team: https://www.bursonglobal.com/locations/us/creative-careers-at-bcw-north-america?x-craft-preview=zhHaDwgRpk&token=Hr2_DXhvw31XqcptLeAlGLGTwgjvfPN5 

What you'll do:

  • Ideate and develop thumb-stopping social that tap into cultural trends.
  • Ideate earned- first creative from project brief.  
  • Write and edit strategic client work across all platforms and executions.
  • Work with an art director to deliver creative-forward content as well as breakthrough brand campaign development. 
  • Dig deep for nuggets of inspiration that will help you form ideas. 
  • Participate in collective brainstorms, bringing bold ideas to the team. 
  • Collaborate with art partners, designers, creative directors, strategists and more.
  • Pitch and sell campaigns, activations, and ideas to internal teams and clients, developing the trust of all audiences. 
  • Work to constantly improve your craft, sharpen your storytelling skills, and mature as a creative. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 4-6 years of experience in ideating and writing across various mediums. 
  • Understanding of popular social networks and cultural trends.
  • Experience working with designers, strategists and producers to deliver content in all forms across any and all platforms. 
  • Strong conceptual and brainstorming skills. 
  • Exceptional communication skills within the agency team. 
  • Very high attention to detail. 
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • You’re curious:  you stay up to date on what breaks in culture before it becomes mainstream.
  • You’re humble: You support other people’s ideas like they were your own, taking direction with grace and confidence. 
  • You’re collaborative: You want to work in a diverse and inclusive organization, actively participating in cultural initiatives.

This is an existing opportunity to join our team as a Corporate Affairs Intern – someone curious, creative, proactive, and genuinely excited about the intersection of business, reputation and current affairs.

In this paid internship role, you’ll work alongside experienced corporate communications and advisory professionals supporting clients across a variety of industries, including financial and professional services, energy and technology. From monitoring and analysis and media relations to stakeholder engagement and thought leadership, you'll gain hands-on experience helping organizations tell their stories and build trust with their audiences.

This isn’t just an internship – it’s a launchpad into a career in corporate communications.

Annual Compensation: C$38,462, plus applicable vacation pay

What you’ll be doing (and probably have a blast doing):

  • Developing client-ready deliverables including media lists, pitches, stakeholder maps, meeting agendas and summaries, briefing notes, media monitoring and social listening analysis reports
  • Assisting with media relations in support of client announcements focusing on business, news and trade media
  • Conducting research on companies, industries, competitors and current affairs to support client work and new business opportunities
  • Bringing your big ideas to brainstorms and planning meetings
  • Becoming our trend and news spotter – tracking business news, industry developments, emerging issues, and online conversations, and sharing relevant insights with the team and clients

One day you might be supporting a major corporate announcement or helping position a subject-matter expert as an industry voice. The next? You’re tracking a news announcement, pitching journalists or researching an emerging reputational issue. No two days are the same – promise.

What makes you a great fit:

  • You’re a recent graduate in public relations, journalism, business, political science, or a related field
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments and juggle deadlines with ease
  • You have strong writing and research skills and excellent attention to detail (typos tremble in your presence)
  • You’re proactive, curious, and ready to take initiative
  • You’re curious about the world around you – business, current affairs, crisis communications, issues management, corporate reputation
  • You enjoy meeting new people, learning from others, and building your network
  • You’re interested in understanding how organizations communicate with their internal and external audiences to build and manage reputation

Why Burson Is That Internship:

  • Work with leading organizations across a variety of industries
  • Get mentorship from people who are excited to see you flourish, grow, and learn
  • Build a portfolio that makes future-you proud
  • Join a team that’s ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely fun
  • Gain exposure to corporate communications, reputation management, media relations, executive positioning, and integrated communications
  • Be part of a global network of communications experts and learn how strategic communications shape businesses and society

If you’re looking for an opportunity to do great work with great people – and make your mark in the corporate affairs and communications space – we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Data Engineer, Communications Intelligence & Insights
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More About the Role

 

Are you interested in building the systems that underpin how modern communications intelligence is measured, analysed and scaled?

Burson’s EMEA Intelligence & Insights Hub is a centralised production and engineering capability responsible for developing the data infrastructure, pipelines and workflows that power monitoring, measurement and reporting across the region. Bringing together engineers and analysts, the Hub builds scalable platforms, integrates multiple external data sources and develops AI-enabled workflows that enhance both the efficiency and quality of intelligence delivery.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in developing, maintaining and optimising the engineering systems that sit at the heart of the Hub’s delivery model. You will work across core platform engineering, client-specific solutions and AI workflow development, helping to evolve The Fount and Burson’s wider Data & Intelligence technology stack.

Our technology ecosystem is built on a modern, highly integrated cloud and relational database architecture. Core data-processing pipelines are developed using object-oriented Python and run through scalable cloud-compute orchestration and enterprise ETL tools. Managed SQL environments provide our relational system of record, while raw and semi-structured assets are maintained within secure cloud object storage.

Advanced language models are integrated directly into our processing pipelines to automate enrichment at scale, with the wider ecosystem managed through GitHub, Azure DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex data challenges while building reliable, scalable and reusable systems that support analysts, client teams and global stakeholders.

 

What you'll do:

 

  • Build, develop and maintain Burson’s core data platform and pipelines, supporting scalable ingestion, transformation, storage and delivery of intelligence data across the EMEA Hub.
  • Design and manage robust ingestion pipelines for media monitoring, social listening, APIs, internal datasets and third-party research and analytics sources.
  • Develop transformation and data-modelling layers using SQL and Python, creating both standardised central data models and bespoke client datasets that support downstream reporting, including Power BI.
  • Design and deliver client-specific data engineering solutions, developing custom pipelines, integrations and datasets where off-the-shelf technology does not meet complex or specialist requirements.
  • Optimise the performance, scalability and reliability of data systems, identifying bottlenecks, resolving data-quality issues and continuously improving pipeline efficiency.
  • Develop reusable engineering frameworks, templates and components that enable the Hub to scale solutions consistently across clients, markets and use cases.
  • Contribute to AI-enabled workflows, embedding language models into data pipelines to automate content analysis, classification, tagging, summarisation, relevance, sentiment and other enrichment processes.
  • Develop and refine prompting frameworks and AI-processing workflows, including monitoring and optimising token usage to ensure effective, efficient and commercially sustainable AI enrichment at scale.
  • Partner with analysts, product teams and communications specialists to translate approved business and reporting requirements into clearly defined technical solutions and identify appropriate opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Work within a structured Agile and ticket-driven engineering environment, contributing to sprint planning, daily stand-ups and technical design discussions while delivering against agreed functional specifications and architectural standards.
  • Maintain strong engineering governance and security standards, including consistent code practices, Git workflows, secure credential management, database security and adherence to agreed directory and repository structures.
  • Own high-quality technical documentation, maintaining clear technical guides, markdown documentation, database schemas and system records while contributing to planned refactoring and technical-debt reduction without disrupting production services.

 

 

Experience that contributes to success:

 

  • Strong experience in data engineering, with a track record of designing, building and maintaining reliable production-grade data pipelines and platforms.
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong experience in relational database environments, including data transformation, modelling, optimisation and the creation of data structures for downstream analytics and reporting.
  • Strong Python development capability, including writing clean, readable and object-oriented code, working with pandas and developing concurrent or scalable data-processing workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations and ETL/ELT architectures, with the ability to bring together structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
  • Experience working within cloud-based data environments, ideally Microsoft Azure, including cloud compute, managed databases, object storage and enterprise data-processing services.
  • Strong software-engineering discipline, including experience designing and writing automated unit, integration and regression tests in Python, ideally using pytest.
  • A strong understanding of secure engineering practices, including database security, firewalls and secure secrets and credential management using tools such as Azure Key Vault.
  • Experience with Git-based engineering workflows and CI/CD environments, ideally including GitHub and Azure DevOps, with an appreciation for structured branching, code governance and multi-developer environments.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code, ideally Terraform or Terragrunt, and the ability to safely manage or update environment variables, configuration and access controls within established infrastructure frameworks.
  • Experience or strong interest in AI-enabled data engineering, including exposure to large language models, prompt-based workflows, automated enrichment or the integration of AI services into production data pipelines.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and technical-planning skills, with the ability to diagnose complex data and performance issues, scope engineering work effectively and build scalable solutions rather than short-term fixes.
  • A collaborative and disciplined approach to engineering, comfortable working across multiple projects with analysts, engineers, product teams and business stakeholders while maintaining strong documentation, continuous improvement and adherence to agreed technical standards.

As Director, Intelligence & Insight, UK, you will help lead the growth of Burson’s Intelligence & Insights business across a portfolio of priority clients. Reporting to the Head of Intelligence & Insights, UK, you will act as senior counsel to clients and help the team continue to evolve in delivering outstanding value; identifying where intelligence can answer real business and reputation questions, shaping those opportunities into clear briefs, and turning data-led outputs into recommendations that senior stakeholders act on.

You will also play a leading role in how our intelligence offer evolves. Working with the regional Intelligence & Insight hub, product and technology teams, you will identify where our methodologies need to develop to meet changing client needs, and make sure every new approach is clearly tied to the value it delivers. The role requires a strong understanding of the UK communications market, emerging technologies and the commercial potential of data, AI and intelligence in client work.

What you'll do:

  • Growth: Own the growth agenda for intelligence across priority UK clients. Work with client leads to build, shape and convert pipeline, using Burson’s AI suite, wider tech stack and WPP Open platform to address live client challenges. Hold accountability for the revenue and commercial performance of your portfolio.
  • Senior Counsel: Act as a trusted adviser to senior client stakeholders across communications, marketing and corporate affairs. Frame business and reputation challenges, guide decisions with evidence, and lead senior presentations and workshops that demonstrate the value of intelligence.
  • Opportunity Identification: Spot where intelligence can add value across existing accounts and new business. Lead intelligence input to pitches and work with market leadership to position intelligence as a differentiator in winning and growing client relationships.
  • Methodology Development: Identify opportunities to enhance and evolve our intelligence methodologies so they keep pace with client needs. Work with the regional hub and product teams to test, refine and scale new approaches, ensuring each one delivers measurable client value.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor and develop members of the Intelligence & Insight team, and equip account teams to use data and intelligence confidently and commercially. Set clear briefs for the regional hub and hold quality sign-off on outputs.
  • Thought Leadership: Shape Burson’s point of view on data, AI and their application in communications. Contribute to industry publications, speak at conferences and represent Burson as a leading voice in the data and intelligence space.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the I&I leadership team, account leadership and regional Intelligence & Insight teams to ensure clients benefit from the best of Burson’s data, AI and advisory capabilities.
  • Data Ethics: Ensure all data projects adhere to Burson's data ethics standards and comply with relevant regulations. Promote responsible data practices within the agency and among clients.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Proven experience in data, intelligence, research or measurement, including senior client-facing roles in a communications agency or consultancy.
  • A proven track record of driving commercial growth, including building pipeline, winning new business and expanding client relationships.
  • Experience counselling senior client stakeholders, with the credibility to challenge thinking and guide decisions.
  • Strong methodological grounding across social, press, search and web analytics, research and measurement, with a record of developing approaches that meet evolving client needs.
  • Deep understanding of the communications market, emerging technologies and the application of data and AI in communications.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Experience leading, developing and inspiring teams.
  • Passion for innovation and a commitment to data ethics.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Join Burson’s Digital Experience and Content Strategy team as a storyteller and content strategist who turns complex topics into useful, engaging content for audiences across the digital experience spectrum. In this role, you’ll bring a journalist’s mindset to brand storytelling to support corporate newsroom and owned content creation for major global brands.  

As a Senior Account Executive, you’ll have meaningful ownership of stories from idea through publication. You’ll help write and edit content, coordinate publishing across channels, pitch timely story ideas, and work closely with clients and internal teams to keep projects moving. 

You’ll also use audience insights, search trends, and content performance data to understand what readers care about and identify opportunities to make content more discoverable across traditional search and emerging generative AI and AI-powered search experiences. 

This is an opportunity for someone who loves storytelling but also wants to shape the strategy behind it. You’ll support clients on both ends of the digital editorial strategy process, from maintaining editorial operations and tracking content performance to writing stories and social content, with room to deepen your editorial expertise or grow further into digital strategy and analytics. 

What you'll do:

  • Research, pitch, and write digital newsroom stories that make corporate, business, technology, product, and industry topics clear, relevant, and useful to readers. 
  • Develop compelling story ideas based on company priorities, industry and cultural trends, audience interests, and search behavior.
  • Own stories from initial concept through publication, including research, outlining, drafting, sourcing, factchecking, coordinating through editorial, client, legal, and other review processes, and finalizing for publication. 
  • Apply strong editorial judgment to determine the right angle, structure, level of detail, and tone for each story, including the best images to use from available libraries. 
  • Maintain editorial calendars, story pipelines, and project trackers, ensuring deadlines, responsibilities, and approval stages remain clear and on track.
  • Interview and gather information from client stakeholders, subject matter experts, and other sources to create credible, authoritative content.
  • Serve as a trusted day-to-day client contact for assigned projects, providing timely updates around drafts, deadlines, approvals, potential roadblocks, and next steps.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across content strategy, account management, creative, social, analytics, GEO, and other digital disciplines. 
  • Review content performance through metrics such as traffic, engagement, referral sources, search visibility, and reader behavior to identify what is resonating with audiences. 
  • Turn audience and performance data into actionable editorial recommendations, including new story opportunities and ways to improve existing content. 
  • Help evolve content for an increasingly AI-driven search environment by applying GEO fundamentals including search intent, keyword strategy, headlines, metadata, internal linking, and content structure. 
  • Adapt long-form editorial stories for other digital channels, including LinkedIn and social platforms, tailoring the format and message to each audience. 
  • Contribute additional digital content such as blog posts, executive content, social copy, landing pages, and other brand storytelling as needed. 
  • Stay current on developments in digital publishing, social media, search, generative AI, and corporate storytelling, bringing new ideas and opportunities to the team. 
  • Proactively contribute ideas during editorial planning and brainstorms. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • At least 3 years of experience writing and editing clear, accurate, audience-focused digital content through journalism, communications, digital media, brand publishing, content marketing, or a related field. 
  • Client-facing or agency experience is strongly preferred. 
  • Strong research and reporting skills, including the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar or technical subjects, identify credible sources, verify information, and explain complex ideas in plain language. 
  • A strong sense of what makes a story interesting and relevant, with the ability to uncover the human, business, cultural, or consumer angle within a corporate topic. 
  • Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail. 
  • Experience balancing multiple assignments at different stages while keeping deadlines and stakeholders on track. 
  • Comfort receiving and incorporating feedback from multiple reviewers while maintaining the clarity and integrity of the final content. 
  • Strong professional communication skills and the confidence to interact directly with clients and internal partners. 
  • An understanding of how content performs across digital channels and an interest in using audience data and analytics to inform editorial decisions. 
  • Familiarity with GEO fundamentals and curiosity about how search and content discovery are evolving through generative AI and AI-powered search. 
  • Familiarity with basic image editing and selection principles, such as resizing, cropping, selecting the best visuals from libraries, and drafting captions. 
  • Intellectual curiosity and the ability to quickly become knowledgeable about industries, products, technologies, and topics that may be new to you. 
  • Sound judgment around factual accuracy, sourcing, claims, brand reputation, and sensitive corporate topics. 
  • A collaborative mindset and an interest in working across editorial, strategy, analytics, creative, social, and account teams. 
  • The initiative to identify opportunities, pitch ideas, solve problems, and independently move work forward.

More about the role:

Burson India is looking for a Senior Project Coordinator for the Burson Intelligence & Data Insights Practice at our Gurugram location. You will be the chief facilitator and owner of delivery for a portfolio of retainer clients and key projects, accountable for how that work lands, its quality, its timeliness and the client's confidence in it. This is an accountability role, defined by outcomes rather than a fixed list of tasks. The portfolio you are given is yours to steer to success.

Our clients and team work across time zones, and your working day flexes to meet them. That flexibility in when you connect is part of how we deliver for global clients, and it gives you direct exposure to Burson teams worldwide. Flexibility is part of the role. Clients, priorities and scope will shift as the practice grows, and your remit will grow with them.

 

What you'll do:

  • Own delivery end to end for your assigned retainers and projects, from the first client signal to final delivery, across every channel through which client work arrives.
  • Read the work behind the words. Understand the client's business and conversations closely enough to anticipate what the work requires, and ensure every requirement turns into clear ownership, a clear timeline and tracked execution
  • Drive the team to deliver ahead of time: assign with clarity, follow through relentlessly, and resolve risks before they reach the client.
  • Be the SPOC between internal teams, global project managers, external vendors, and client stakeholders, keeping workflow, quality control and deadlines on track and troubleshooting as needed.
  • Provide strategic counsel to Burson account teams on approach, execution and timing.
  • Be an active part of the development and execution of key projects and initiatives for the practice and our retainer clients.
  • Coach, mentor and train junior team members, delegate with clarity, give continuous constructive feedback, and keep your superiors briefed on team performance. Build an inclusive environment and stay flexible in a changing work environment.
  • Keep the commercial engine healthy: record time in Maconomy; ensure all client activity is documented and budget and status reports are submitted; follow agency procedures for budgets, contract approval, purchase orders and billing; and coordinate with finance to book revenue, close invoices and raise Pos
  • Take on additional responsibilities in support of the practice and its clients as the business evolves.
  • Champion the strategic use of Generative AI tools across all communication programs to enhance planning, ideation, content creation, and operational efficiency.

 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 2-3 years of experience in project management, preferably within an agency.
  • Familiarity with financial or corporate accounts preferred.
  • A track record of owning client outcomes, not just tasks, and of getting work delivered on time through other people.
  • Comfort working with international clients and global teams across time zones
  • A self-starter who is highly organised and agile, and who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Stage en Communication Insights Analyst & Social Listening
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Qui sommes-nous:

Burson, leader mondial de la communication, a pour mission de créer de la valeur pour ses clients par la gestion de leur réputation. Grâce à notre expertise, nos technologies de pointe, nos solutions d'intelligence artificielle et notre créativité, nous anticipons les risques en temps réel, identifions les insights générateurs de préférence et d'engagement, et accompagnons la transformation et la réussite de nos clients. Nous réinventons la réputation pour en faire un véritable atout concurrentiel. Burson est le gardien de votre réputation, le partenaire qui vous guide dans un environnement complexe.

En rejoignant Burson, vous intégrez une communauté mondiale d'experts à la pointe de l'innovation.

Burson fait partie du groupe WPP (LSE/NYSE : WPP), spécialiste de la transformation créative. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur bursonglobal.com et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn et Instagram.

En savoir plus sur le rôle:

Stage conventionné à pourvoir à partir de février 2027.

Missions :

Au sein de l’équipe Lab IA & Data de Burson France, vous contribuerez à des missions variées pour des clients de divers secteurs d’activité, en exploitant notamment des outils et des méthodologies propriétaires basés sur l'intelligence artificielle ou intégrant des composants IA :

  • Veille réputationnelle et reporting quotidien
  • Analyse des conversations en ligne (tendances, produits, marques, entreprises, etc.)
  • Benchmark de communication (concurrentiels, tendances, social media, etc.)
  • Conduite d’études et analyses (analyse quantitative et qualitative, recherche d’insights, élaboration de pistes stratégiques)
  • Décryptage et cartographie de débats/sujets (arguments, acteurs en présence, évaluation de la sensibilité, etc.)
  • En new bizz, analyse qualitative sur un marché, une marque ou une problématique

Vous serez formés aux outils et méthodologies de l’agence, incluant nos plateformes basées sur l'IA.

Profil recherché :

  • Étudiant(e) en communication, sociologie, sciences humaines, lettres, sciences politiques – Master 1 ou 2. Les candidats au profil purement data analyst ne correspondent malheureusement pas à nos attentes pour ce poste.
  • Curiosité pour les réseaux sociaux et les enjeux d’opinion
  • Forte appétence pour la recherche, l'analyse de données et l’IA
  • Bonne culture générale
  • Qualités rédactionnelles, esprit de synthèse et rigueur
  • Français courant et bon niveau en anglais

Notre engagement :

  • Stage professionnalisant avec encadrement personnalisé, vous permettant de travailler avec des outils de pointe intégrant l'IA
  • Suivi régulier avec votre tuteur/tutrice
  • Retours constructifs sur vos missions
  • Découverte des différentes facettes du métier d'insights analyst, enrichies par les dernières innovations en IA.

Rémunération et avantages :

  • Gratification : 750€/mois
  • Télétravail possible et éligibilité à la prime de télétravail (10€/mois)
  • Forfait mobilité durable (45,40€/mois)

job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Burson is seeking a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Team Coordinator to join our team in South Africa, primarily supporting the JLR EMEA account. The role will focus on managing end-to-end travel and logistics across the region, including travel arrangements, accommodation, itineraries and event coordination, alongside broader account administration and operational support.

Working closely with JLR stakeholders, regional teams and travel partners, you will take ownership of travel and logistics requests from start to finish, ensuring arrangements are seamless, timely and well-coordinated. You will also support wider account operations by proactively managing follow-ups and keeping stakeholders informed. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and responsiveness during core European working hours will be essential to success in this role.

What you'll do:

  • Act as a key point of contact for travel and logistics requirements across the JLR EMEA account, supporting employees and stakeholders with travel-related queries and requests.
  • Manage & coordinate end-to-end business travel across EMEA, including flights, accommodation, ground transportation, visas where applicable and travel itineraries, working closely with travel agencies and partners.
  • Take ownership of travel and logistics requests from initial enquiry through to completion, managing bookings, amendments, cancellations, approvals and resolving issues while keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Coordinate logistics for team meetings, events, conferences and regional activities, including venues, catering, transportation and other practical arrangements.
  • Support wider JLR account operations by maintaining trackers, coordinating meetings, monitoring actions and following up on key deliverables and deadlines.
  • Work closely with regional market and brand teams to support day-to-day coordination, facilitate communication and ensure the smooth running of account activities across EMEA.
  • Provide general team coordination and administrative support, including diary assistance, meeting coordination, document preparation and ad-hoc operational requirements.
  • Maintain a proactive and responsive approach during core European working hours, particularly when managing time-sensitive travel arrangements, event requirements and live operational issues

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Excellent organisational and planning capabilities, with the ability to manage competing priorities, multiple requests and tight deadlines effectively.
  • Proven experience in travel management and coordination, administration or operations, ideally supporting regional teams across multiple countries and markets.
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with travel agencies, suppliers and external service providers to manage travel arrangements and resolve issues.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy when coordinating complex travel itineraries, bookings, schedules and documentation.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to proactively manage requests, drive follow-ups and take ownership through to completion.
  • Ability to work effectively across different countries, cultures and time zones, demonstrating flexibility and responsiveness during core European working hours.

job.title: Director of Product
job.description:
Overview:

The Director of Product leads WRAL Media’s product and development team and owns product growth and monetization across our digital platforms, including WRAL.com, the WRAL News app, the WRAL Weather app, and our CTV / smart TV apps, working hand in hand with our WRAL and FOX 50 broadcast properties. The role sits in the revenue organization alongside the Director of Sales. This is a growth and monetization role — not newsroom content ownership. The Director sets the product roadmap, prioritization, user-experience standards, and growth goals across every platform, builds the advertising, sponsorship, and data products our sellers take to market, and maximizes yield across our inventory. Linear remains our largest revenue stream, so the strongest digital products here are built to extend and strengthen broadcast, not run beside it. The Director leads an existing development team and will help shape how the product organization grows from here.


Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions:

  • Owns product growth and monetization across WRAL Media’s digital platforms, including WRAL.com, the WRAL News app, the WRAL Weather app, and CTV / smart TV apps, in coordination with our WRAL and FOX 50 broadcast properties.
  • Sets the product roadmap, prioritization, user-experience standards, and growth goals across platforms.
  • Owns digital and CTV monetization strategy, including advertising and sponsorship products, inventory, pricing, sell-through, and yield across web, apps, and CTV / FAST.
  • Partners with the Director of Sales and sales leadership to translate product opportunities into revenue-ready packages for local, national, and digital sellers, and keeps sellers equipped to sell them; works with Brand, News, and Technology to bring them to market.
  • Owns product-side strategy for personalization, engagement, app utility, distribution, and audience growth.
  • Partners closely with the linear and broadcast teams, including Linear Ops and sales leadership, to develop products together across broadcast, digital, and CTV, so they sell as one connected offering rather than as separate channels.
  • Partners with the Brand Director on brand, social, and creator products, and with Client Marketing on client creative.
  • Establishes measurement and success criteria for product initiatives and reports on growth against goals.
  • Serves as the organizational home for the Data & Insights function, including audience and revenue measurement and client-facing insights.
  • Leads the product and development team and plays a central role in building it out. We want your perspective on where the biggest needs are and which roles to hire first.



Required Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Seven or more years of digital product management experience — ideally in media, news, streaming, or consumer applications — including experience owning a roadmap, leading cross-functional initiatives, and three or more years leading teams that include development or engineering staff.
  • Demonstrated record of growing digital revenue, audience, and engagement across web and mobile; experience with multiple platforms including web, iOS/Android, and CTV/smart TV.
  • Working fluency in digital advertising and monetization, such as ad servers (e.g., Google Ad Manager), programmatic and SSP partnerships, CTV ad insertion, and yield management.
  • Experience hiring, scoping, and building a product, development, or go-to-market team.
  • Proficiency with product analytics platforms (e.g., GA4, Amplitude, or Mixpanel), roadmap and design collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Figma), A/B testing frameworks, and modern web/app content management systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to align and influence stakeholders across Sales, Brand, News, Technology, and executive leadership.
  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking; able to translate ambiguous opportunities into prioritized, measurable product plans.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in local news, broadcast, or a comparable multi-platform media environment, including familiarity with how linear advertising is packaged and sold.
  • Direct experience with CTV / FAST applications and connected-TV product growth.
  • Experience building or managing a data and analytics function.

 

Physical Demands: 

  • Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate office equipment, including computers, phones, and printers.
  • Ability to occasionally lift files, office materials, or packages up to 15 pounds.
  • Clear vision and hearing required for meetings, presentations, and reviewing financial documents.
  • Ability to move about an office environment and attend meetings in various office locations.

 

Work Conditions: 

  • The role is typically performed in a professional office environment. 
  • Occasional travel may be necessary to meet with stakeholders or visit company-owned properties.


Benefits: 

  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Benefits package including:
    • Comprehensive health insurance plan options
    • Vision and Dental Insurance
    • Company sponsored life insurance
    • Numerous voluntary benefit options – legal plans, pet insurance, discounted home and auto and more!
    • 401K with company match
    • Generous paid time off
    • 9 paid company holidays
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Dynamic and inclusive work environment with a supportive team culture.
  • Exciting projects and growth opportunities within a leading organization.
  • Opportunities to attend free local events, such as sporting events, concerts, shows, and more.

 

Pre-Employment Information:

  • A pre-employment drug screening is required. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in E-Verify. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in the Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) program. However, completing the WOTC questionnaire is completely voluntary. Your decision will have absolutely no impact on your hiring chances, and your application WILL be accepted regardless of whether you choose to provide this information or not.

Capitol Broadcasting Company is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Capitol Broadcasting Company, Inc. is a diversified communications leader which owns and/or operates WRAL-TV, WRAZ-TV, WRAL News+ (WNGT-CD), WRAL-FM, WRAL-HD2, WCMC-FM, WCMC-HD1, WDNC-AM, WCMC-HD2, WCMC-HD3, WCMC-HD4, Microspace Communications, and Capitol B Creative in Raleigh, NC; WILM-TV, WILT-LD and Sunrise Broadcasting in Wilmington, NC; The Durham Bulls Baseball Club, Bull City Hospitality, and the Coastal Plain League in Durham, NC; The Holly Springs Salamanders in Holly Springs, NC; the Zebulon Devil Dogz in Zebulon, NC; the American Underground startup hub and workspace in Durham, NC; and real estate interests including the American Tobacco Historic District in Durham, NC, and Rocky Mount Mills in Rocky Mount, NC.

job.title: Health Reporter and Multimedia Journalist
job.description:
OVERVIEW:

WRAL News is seeking a Health Reporter and Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) to lead coverage of the health stories that matter to families in the Triangle and across North Carolina. The role focuses primarily on health journalism, from breaking news and public health emergencies to original reporting on medical research and access to care. This full-time position works across WRAL-TV, WRAL.com, mobile apps, WRAL News+, YouTube and social media. The reporter also supports grant-funded coverage, including recurring health explainers and audience growth reporting.

KEY RESPONSIBLITY AREAS: 

  • Own breaking health news, including outbreaks, exposure alerts and public health emergencies. Monitor alerts, official sources and tips, coordinate with the assignment desk, and deliver verified live reports and updates as stories develop.
  • Develop sources among public health officials, clinicians, researchers, patients, caregivers and community organizations. Use public records, data and independent experts to verify claims, put findings in context and pursue accountability stories.
  • Pitch and produce daily and enterprise stories on emerging research, prevention, treatment and access to care. Answer timely audience questions and explain what developments mean for patients and families.
  • Help launch recurring, in-depth health explainers within the first six months of the grant agreement. Produce them for WRAL.com, YouTube and other WRAL platforms.
  • Independently shoot, write, edit and file stories for WRAL-TV, WRAL.com, mobile apps, WRAL News+, YouTube and social media. Report live from the field and studio, conduct interviews and use graphics to clarify data, findings and timelines.
  • Adapt reporting to each platform, including clear TV scripts, digital articles, longer YouTube explainers and short social video. Follow AP style and WRAL editorial and production standards.
  • Work with producers, photographers, editors and digital teams to publish stories in the WRAL.com Health section, give major breaking health stories prominent homepage and social placement based on news value, and showcase coverage in WRAL’s most-watched newscasts.
  • Maintain a record of grant-supported coverage across platforms, including recurring explainers. Log story links, topics, platform placement, available audience and engagement metrics, and time spent on assignments outside the health beat.
  • Work with newsroom leadership to prepare quarterly updates for grant funders using the coverage log. Establish an audience baseline from initial results and report progress on pageviews, video views, watch time and engagement.
  • Pitch and produce original digital health stories that give audiences more depth and practical context. Use audience data to guide follow-up coverage and grow reach across WRAL platforms.
  • Performs other duties as required or assigned, provided they are reasonably related to the responsibilities outlined in this job description.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, and at least two years of TV newsroom experience as a reporter, MMJ or in an equivalent role.
  • Ability to independently shoot, write, edit and publish accurate, visually clear stories on deadline.
  • Proficiency with ENPS, Edius, FTP and mobile live transmission tools, along with digital publishing and social video tools.
  • Strong news judgment, interviewing and source development skills.
  • Familiarity with media law, journalistic ethics and public records, and the ability to explain complex health information clearly and accurately.
  • A valid driver’s license and clean driving record.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Live reporting experience is strongly preferred.


Work Conditions: 

  • This field-based role includes studio work as needed, irregular hours, nights, weekends, holidays and on-call breaking news response. Occasional assignments outside the health beat may include major breaking news or weather coverage, major station projects or events, and holiday or vacation relief. A valid driver’s license and clean driving record are required.

    Other duties as assigned.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Benefits package including:
    • Comprehensive health insurance plan options
    • Vision and Dental Insurance
    • Company sponsored life insurance
    • Numerous voluntary benefit options – legal plans, pet insurance, discounted home and auto and more!
    • 401K with company match

  • Dynamic and inclusive work environment with a supportive team culture.

Position Title:

Associate Producer, Now or Never (Based anywhere in Canada)

Status of Employment:

Contractee Long-Term (Fixed Term)

Position Language Requirement:

English

Language Skills:

English (Reading), English (Speaking), English (Writing)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-12-01 11:59 PM

Now or Never is looking for a curious, creative, collaborative and highly motivated Associate Producer.


This is a 24-week contract from January 4  - June 20, 2027, and can be based anywhere in Canada.


NOTE: If you are an internal candidate applying for this contract, it is advisable to let your manager know so that they are supportive when it comes to releasing you for the job if you are the successful candidate.


Now or Never is a show that jumps into the action with Canadians who are doing things that take a bit of extra nerve, and nudges listeners to make a leap too. Now or Never pursues stories that are personal, “now” and original. We shine a light on Canadians in authentic moments of vulnerability, and make an extra effort to capture action as it’s unfolding.


As an Associate Producer for Now or Never, you always have your eyes and ears open for people who are in the middle of a Now or Never moment. You are a dogged chaser, relentless about tracking down guests and fearless about getting personal.  


As an idea-generating machine, you come up with original and focused story ideas and pitch them effectively in meetings. 


You love coming up with creative treatments for all platforms, including digital and social.  And you are experienced in gathering sound and images in the field, and weaving those elements into a compelling story arc. 


You are a strong critical thinker and solid journalist. You have a deep understanding and appreciation of diversity of perspective, opinion and experience, and reflect that in the content you create. 


Working under the direction of Now or Never’s Senior Producer, the Associate Producer will be expected to deliver one to two stories per week from inception to execution.


Key Tasks:


  • Generating and pitching focused story ideas and treatments which adhere to Now or Never mission and values
  • Chasing, pre-interviewing and booking guests; writing scripts; and recording audio in the field 
  • Identifying the best method for gathering sound and visuals for a story, whether it’s a field recording, studio link, video call, etc. and ensuring the appropriate technical resources are in place
  • Preparing scripts, background, and question lines and ensuring hosts are briefed prior to interviews
  • Editing audio and multitrack sound mixes quickly and creatively 
  • Producing story segments for web and social platforms using CBC style and employing digital storytelling best practices
  • Actively participating in story meetings and evaluation of all aspects of the production in feedback meetings and listening parties 
  • Being a committed team player, go-getter, and problem-solver
  • Having a broad range of interests, critical thinking skills and the ability to adhere to journalistic standards and practices

Qualifications: 


  • University degree or equivalent
  • Minimum of two years' relevant experience in journalism, and ideally broadcasting
  • A demonstrated commitment to finding diverse, underrepresented voices
  • Strong digital skills including ability to create media-rich posts for the program's website and social media platforms
  • Ability to work effectively in a high-pressure environment and juggle multiple assignments and responsibilities 
  • Ability to take critical feedback and incorporate it into the work
  • Independent and self-motivated, combined with the ability to work well in a team environment
  • Broad knowledge of the media landscape and the ability to understand how Now or Never can stand out from other media

This role offers the possibility of full-time telework. Work schedule to be discussed with the Hiring Manager according to the guidelines defined by the department. 

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:  

  • A mandatory Criminal record check. 

  • Other background checks may be conducted based on the operational requirements of the position.

Your Role 

CBC Ottawa is looking for a high energy, passionate person to fill the role of Associate Producer for “Ottawa Morning” (Ottawa’s number one morning show).


The ideal candidate will bring a strong work ethic, positive outlook and experience in current affairs programming. Ottawa Morning kicks off people's day, with informative, entertaining and accountable programming that reflects our community. 


As Associate Producer, reporting to the Senior Producer of Ottawa Morning, you will work with the morning team to deliver exceptional content from around the region. You will have a grasp of current trends in news programming - on digital and broadcast platforms - as well as emerging storytelling tools and technology. You will have a clear understanding of CBC News Journalistic Standards and Practices.

This is a collaborative work environment, so a team player with first-rate communications skills is a must. You will need to juggle and prioritize multiple stories and tasks, and to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.


Your responsibilities:


  • Pitch and produce original stories that deepen Ottawa Mornings’s community connections and elevate a range of voices.
  • Chase and book guests and stories that reflect the day’s top local news
  • Conduct research and interviews, gather audio, write radio scripts, and package and present content.
  • Give consideration to video elements for certain segments 
  • Assist the senior producer in building show lineup and run sheets.
  • Chase breaking stories while the show is on air.
  • Provide support for on-air personalities. 
  • You will also be able to step in and direct the morning show. 
  • On occasion you may work a variety of shifts and or take on special projects. 
  • Ensure listener feedback is turned around quickly to be reflected on the show.

Your Profile: 

  • Minimum of one year of experience in a news / current affairs environment preferred.  
  • Strong contributor of ideas, stories and treatments.
  • The ability to plan ahead and effectively organize current affairs coverage for the program giving consideration to digital and broadcast platforms.
  • Passionate about exploring the diverse communities that make up Ottawa and surrounding areas.
  • Proven track record of ensuring a diversity of voices is reflected in storytelling. 
  • Personal experience with pitching and producing stories with consideration given to under-represented communities.
  • Innovative with programming and ideas. Curious, incisive and critical thinker.
  • Knowledge of changing audience trends and best practices, and social media.
  • Up-to-date contact network.
  • Knowledge of production methods in the field and newsroom.
  • High level of organization and productivity.
  • Strong & enthusiastic team player with good communication skills.
  • Initiative taker, with ability to be productive in individual and team settings.
  • Able to work flexible hours.

 


Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
