Position Overview:

Reporting to the Senior Manager, HR, you will be a key member of the People & Culture team, providing strategic Human Resources and Industrial Relations (HR/IR) consultation and operational support to leaders across key Corporate groups.


In this  role, you will work collaboratively with corporate leadership teams to ensure the alignment and success of their operational and people strategies. You will serve as a trusted advisor, proactively addressing key business challenges, guiding organizational change, managing labour relations, and partnering with internal Centres of Expertise to drive exceptional employee experiences and foster an inclusive culture.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary HR contact for corporate client groups, providing creative and strategic advice to leaders on a full range of complex HR and labor relations matters.
  • Support leaders in workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, succession planning, and change management initiatives.
  • Ensure productive union-management relations by maintaining positive working relationships with union representatives and managing complex industrial relations matters to resolution in a unionized environment.
  • Support and coach leaders through performance management, talent development, employee engagement initiatives, and complex workplace situations.
  • Collaborate closely with internal Centres of Expertise (Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, Equity & Inclusion) to deliver tailored, high-quality HR solutions aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Guide leaders on corporate policy application, employment legislation, and drive strategic initiatives that align with the evolving reality of a modern digital workforce.

Key Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Industrial Relations, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of progressive HR Business Partner experience, preferably supporting corporate functions within a complex organization.
  • Imperative bilingualism in both English and French, with advanced written and verbal communication skills in both official languages.
  • Direct experience in a unionized work environment is strongly preferred.
  • Professional HR designation (CHRP, CHRL) is preferred.
  • Proven ability to build strong working relationships, exercise influence, demonstrate sound judgment and discretion, and make effective decisions in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Coordinating Technician, Network Control Centre and TV Master Control (T & I) (On-site)
job.description:
Position Title:

Status of Employment:

Temporary (STTRC)

Position Language Requirement:

Language Skills:

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-12-15 11:59 PM

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This role requires full-time on-site presence.

 

Role

 

You are responsible for coordinating the use and ensuring the continuity of acquisition, feed and communication resources for CBC/Radio-Canada networks and external clients. You distribute the signals of programs or program segments, ensuring quality control.

 

Description of Duties

  • Check audio, video, captioning and communication signals for programs or program elements across the entire Radio-Canada distribution system, including those from outside distribution companies (e.g., cable operators, satellite signal providers), along with all technical equipment (e.g., VTRs, servers, external links, internet); make corrections if they are not compliant with standards.
  • Draft reports on irregularities and inform the relevant people.
  • Adjust, test, set up and operate technical equipment (e.g., VTRs, servers, broadcast graphics, digital delay), ensuring everything is clean, secure and in good working order.
  • Contact telecommunications companies to resolve transmission and reception problems.
  • Apply solutions in case of technical failures; coordinate operations necessary to maintain service quality and continuity, and report on your work.
  • Perform tasks involved in operating equipment and making connections as required by schedules or network programming.
  • Adjust Control Centre activities to provide required signals and feeds, reporting any changes or errors and implementing corrections.
  • Receive requests for terrestrial circuits or satellite channels, obtain pricing and place orders with providers.
  • Coordinate and determine the necessary connections for terrestrial circuits, mobile microwave links and satellite channels, and manage the assignment of distribution channels (RF) and common station elements.
  • Ensure the proper operation of satellite dishes, receivers/decoders and transmitters, and communicate any changes to satellite channel assignments.
  • Establish communication links for signal transmission and reception, conduct technical tests and maintain the necessary contacts.
  • Ensure that the return signal for each network broadcast by Radio-Canada is recorded for CRTC purposes.
  • Authorize and initialize Radio-Canada decoders/receivers based on regional and management requests.
  • Record programs, commercials and promos; check their accuracy and technical quality; and take corrective action in case of non-compliance.
  • Route and feed news exchange content from servers, VTRs or other sources to regional stations.
  • Import elements and perform conversions to various file formats for incorporation into edited sequences.
  • Manage disk space by deleting or archiving content associated with your work.
  • Advise technical and production staff on how to resolve issues and/or achieve desired results.
  • Review and apply technical plans and diagrams.
  • Assist in reviewing or developing operating methods and technical standards.
  • Note all relevant information in a log to ensure the required follow-up actions and continuity; consult the log daily.
  • Complete the appropriate forms and documents; share information to ensure proper follow-up and to keep others informed.
  • Familiarize other employees with their duties and the work environment.
  • Carry out, as needed, the duties of another job classification within an equivalent or lower salary group, as well as other related duties.

 

Job Requirements

  • Education or equivalent knowledge: College diploma (DEC) in television production and/or post-production techniques, or any other relevant diploma.
  • Prior experience: Three years’ experience required to perform duties satisfactorily.

 

Selected candidates will be tested as follows:

 

  • Interview.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 
We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

That’s because we can only create and tell the stories that connect Canadians, by having a workforce that mirrors the ever-changing makeup of our country. That’s why we, as an employer, value equal opportunity and nurture an inclusive workplace where our individual differences are not only recognized and valued, but also extend to and pervade all the services we provide as Canada’s public broadcaster. In the event that you become an employee, it will be important to inform us, as quickly as possible, of any situation that, because of your hiring, constitutes or could appear to constitute a conflict of interest.

Please note that we are looking to fill four positions.

 

Function

 

Perform (alone or assisted by other technicians whose work you co-ordinate in conjunction with production teams) duties associated with maintaining production and broadcasting systems/equipment in a cross-functional environment that includes networking, optics, electronics, computer systems, mechanics, machining, welding, hydraulics and pneumatics.

 

Description of duties:

  • Perform all duties associated with maintaining production and broadcasting systems/equipment (function-testing, configuring, installing, inspecting, diagnosing troubleshooting, repairing and refurbishing).
  • Be responsible, as a contributor, for the technical aspect of the work performed by technicians.
  • Coordinate and review the work of other technicians and provide them with advice.
  • Solve underlying or intermittent problems to ensure program production and broadcast.
  • Run tests and make complex adjustments in order to improve performance of technical facilities.
  • Design, modify and manufacture parts, equipment and tools requiring the use of various techniques (mechanics, machining, welding, hydraulics and pneumatics). Adjust, operate and maintain machining, welding, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic machinery and equipment in order to modify and manufacture parts, tools and equipment.
  • Source parts and technical materials, contacting vendors for information as needed and sharing it with the people concerned.
  • Ensure that plans, diagrams and procedures are updated; produce diagrams or sketches as needed.
  • Maintain your skills so that you can perform your assigned duties and keep abreast of technological developments.
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and help develop means and processes enabling better use and easier maintenance of equipment.
  • Advise others on installing, commissioning and using production/broadcasting equipment and systems.
  • Attend meetings as required.
  • Complete the appropriate forms and documents; convey information in person or in writing to ensure proper follow-up and to keep others informed.
  • Familiarize other employees with their duties and work environment.
  • If necessary, carry out all or part of the duties of another job classification within an equivalent or lower salary group, as well as other related duties.

 

Job requirements:

 

Education or equivalent knowledge:

  • College diploma (DSC) in electronics technology (audiovisual, telecommunications or computer systems option) or other relevant field.

 

Prior Experience:

  • Five (5) years’ experience, given the multidisciplinary environment and variety of equipment.

  • Interview

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technologies and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Role Overview

 

This role serves as a strategic bridge, functional reference, and provides advanced analysis for our corporate tools portfolio. Its primary focus is on maximizing user adoption, understanding, and safe usage of our core productivity tools, including the Google Workspace ecosystem, and its rapidly evolving AI capabilities.

 

Moving dynamically between business strategy and technical evaluation, you will be responsible for demystifying AI, scoping business needs, and participating in pilot projects primarily within Google Workspace, but also across the full suite of productivity tools. Furthermore, you will collaborate with other Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) support teams for enterprise platforms such as Workday or Oracle as needed to ensure strategic alignment in the use of AI.

 

You will act as a technology scout and functional tester, ensuring teams understand how to use new tools effectively. With a strong technical background and a focus on increasing organizational productivity, you will evaluate new AI capabilities, deliver engaging training, and participate in cross-functional risk mitigation procedures to ensure secure and compliant rollouts.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Tech Watch, Testing & Functional Configuration
    • Feature Evaluation & Tech Watch: Track the fast-moving AI market, acting as a technology scout for upcoming generative and agentic AI capabilities embedded primarily within the Google ecosystem, assessing other systems like Workday and Oracle as needed.
    • Functional Testing & Test Documentation: Actively test new AI features (such as Workspace Studio, NotebookLM, and Gemini) within sandbox or Alpha environments as soon as they are announced, evaluating user experience, functional limitations, and integration risks. Meticulously document all test plans, execution steps, and outcomes to maintain a clear and reliable functional knowledge base.
    • Technical Configuration & Issue Tracking: Build master templates and configure advanced operational setups (such as automated project structures or intelligent workflows) to support business pilots. Provide specialized guidance for advanced Google products, utilizing scripting where necessary to automate simple workflows. Create, manage, and escalate technical tickets effectively to track bugs, vendor issues, and user feature requests.

 

  • User Adoption, Training & Enablement
    • Driving Adoption & Productivity: Develop and execute strategies to champion the active user adoption of AI tools across the business. Build awareness around enterprise-approved tools while guiding and migrating users away from unapproved tools toward Google Workspace and other supported solutions. Identify opportunities to leverage technology to streamline daily tasks, eliminate bottlenecks, and significantly increase overall workforce productivity.
    • Documentation & Translation: Translate complex vendor release notes and technical evaluations into clear, easy-to-understand functional impact analyses and plain-language user guides.
    • Training & Upskilling: Design and deliver engaging training sessions and workshops to raise the overall AI literacy of employees, acting as an expert to help productivity teams understand how various corporate AI tools intersect.
    • Best Practices Watch: Observe how peer media organizations or similar enterprises use AI in their daily operations.

 

  • Cross-Functional Support & Risk Mitigation
    • Governance Participation: Assist in partnering with internal compliance teams (Legal, Privacy, InfoSec, Accessibility) to ensure corporate AI tools meet enterprise standards. Help prepare functional impact analyses for governance committees, shaping corporate policies without leading the committees.
    • Risk Mitigation: Support the ongoing monitoring of automated vendor updates and the execution of deployment strategies designed to protect sensitive organizational and personal data.

 

  • AI Pilots, Accelerators & Special Projects
    • Business Analysis & Scoping: Partner directly with diverse business units to identify practical AI opportunities, translate complex user requirements into actionable functional use cases, and scope corporate special projects.
    • Pilot Deployment & Value Tracking: Support the analysis and deployment of "AI Accelerator" pilot projects. Define, monitor, and measure business success metrics (such as workflow simplification or time saved) to assess the real-world return on investment for corporate tool AI initiatives, ensuring pilots directly contribute to increased business productivity.

 

Qualifications & Ideal Profile

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Owner, or in a similar role.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a rigorous approach to documenting processes, managing tickets, and maintaining project structures.
  • Demonstrated passion for driving user adoption, change management, and leveraging technology to increase organizational productivity and efficiency.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience).
  • Strong technical knowledge of Google Workspace and its core applications, combined with AI literacy and a sharp ability to rapidly leverage AI tools.
  • Fluency in both French and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both official languages.
  • Comfortable speaking in front of groups, delivering interactive training sessions, and producing clear, high-impact reporting for executive stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of conducting thorough business process analysis, testing tools, and mapping complex workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with legal, privacy, security, or accessibility partners, with the diplomacy needed to balance user innovation against corporate risk frameworks.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

You possess:

About the Opportunity


Radio-Canada is proud to launch an internship program specifically designed to increase the representation of members of Indigenous communities in Canada within the audio and radio industry. This internship aims to foster inclusion, professional development and the growth of Indigenous talent within our teams, aligning with CBC/Radio-Canada’s National Indigenous Strategy and building on the First Peoples – Tell Your Story training initiative for Indigenous storytellers. We are seeking passionate, aspiring professionals from all walks of life who are eager to unlock their potential and pursue a rewarding career in media.


The internship will be from January 11 to April 2, 2027 (12 weeks).


This role requires full-time on-site presence.


Who We’re Looking For:


This internship is open exclusively to First Nations, Inuit and Métis individuals in Canada. We encourage applications from motivated candidates at various stages of their professional journey:

  • Early Career Professionals: Ready to broaden your horizons, diversify your skills and take on fresh challenges? This internship is a perfect opportunity to expand your expertise in the media sector.
  • Recent Graduates: Are you a recent graduate with a passion for media and looking to gain foundational hands-on experience? This internship offers the chance to fully immerse yourself within our production teams.
  • Professionals in Career Transition: Do you have solid experience in another field but dream of a dynamic, creative career in media? This internship will help you acquire essential skills and leverage your transferable expertise.

Skills and Qualities We Value:

  • Adaptability and Eagerness to Learn: You can easily fit into new work environments and quickly pick up new technical and professional skills.
  • A Passion for Audio: You have a keen interest in radio broadcasting, sound production and all forms of audio content.
  • Interest in the Radio-Canada Environment: You are driven to elevate Indigenous programming on our airwaves and platforms, and excited to showcase Indigenous talent at Radio-Canada.
  • Interpersonal and Professional Qualities: You bring leadership, creativity, strong organizational, communication and teamwork skills, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Critical Thinking and Open-Mindedness: You possess strong analytical skills and sound judgment, allowing you to navigate complex information and diverse situations with ease.

Tailored to your background and career goals, this immersive, hands-on internship provides the opportunity to gain experience across multiple areas, including content development, interview preparation and program design. It will allow you to build a versatile skill set while working alongside our teams at Radio-Canada OHdio, ICI PREMIÈRE or ICI MUSIQUE.


If you have previously applied to or participated in the First Peoples program, please let us know in your application.

This position will not be filled until consideration has been made by the CBC/Radio-Canada/APS Workforce Adjustment Committee.


This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Your Role

 

Reporting to the Program Manager, you will join the Digital Products and Innovation team, where a major initiative to modernize CBC/Radio-Canada's digital ecosystem is underway to make it more resilient in a changing media landscape. This work is being done in close collaboration with several departments and will contribute to building the future of the public broadcaster.

 

As a Project Lead, you oversee the entire lifecycle of your projects. While ensuring adherence to deadlines, budgets, and defined scope, you provide motivating leadership to teams to guide their work, distribute responsibilities, and maintain a high level of commitment.

 

To achieve this, you will first need to contribute to the analysis and feasibility of the projects and propose the best approaches to meet the mandate's objectives. You will also need to plan the lifecycle stages of each project, from initiation to launch. Furthermore, you will need to follow up with relevant stakeholders and members of the various teams involved to ensure project progress, implement proactive risk management, and communicate status updates to stakeholders.

 

Note that our working methodology is hybrid (Agile and Waterfall).

 

What will your responsibilities be?

  • Evaluate, coordinate and optimize human resources material, budgetary and project activities.
  • Advise, guide and provide specialist expertise during the evaluation, planning or development of projects.
  • Recommend solutions taking into account management objectives and CBC/Radio-Canada policies.
  • Orchestrate the team's calendar, including agile events such as daily stand-ups, planning (sprint or kanban), retrospectives, reviews, cross-team dependency alignment, and any other relevant meetings.
  • Develop the timeline based on the Product Manager's priorities (and/or sprints), factoring in scope, estimates, target delivery date, required resources, and budget.
  • Formally manage requests for scope changes in evaluating and communicating their impact on timelines, team capacity and initial budgets.
  • Align project timelines with the interdependencies of other initiatives and ensure that communication remains fluid between the different teams and stakeholders.
  • Establish and maintain the project risk register and develop the necessary mitigation plans.
  • Participate in negotiating agreements with internal and external stakeholders as needed for the projects.
  • Establish control processes at different stages of the project and ensure compliance with acceptance criteria.
  • Take full accountability for project reporting and status updates, and, in collaboration with the Product Manager and Program Manager, serve as the primary point of contact for senior leadership and executive committees.
  • With the help of experts, find solutions to both technical and operational problems and constraints.
  • In collaboration with the program manager, he defines and enforces the project governance structure (e.g., steering committees).
  • Transmit blocking elements to higher hierarchical levels if support is needed.
  • Identify, define, track and analyze key indicators to measure team delivery and performance.
  • Fostering a self-organizing and high-performing team culture by promoting autonomy, accountability and cross-functional collaboration, while helping teams establish and overcome barriers to ensure smooth progress and value delivery.

 

How will you make the difference?

  • Knowing how to apply Agile and waterfall work methodologies (waterfall).
  • Adhere to best project management practices in order to strengthen quality and productivity standards.
  • To foster a culture of collaboration across different teams.
  • Support and motivate your team members.

 

What profile are we looking for?

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, master's degree in project management, or other relevant university degree (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum of seven years of experience as a project manager delivering complex digital products and projects, including end-to-end accountability for projects with significant cross-functional dependencies and alignment with governance committees as needed.
  • Proven mastery of the complete project lifecycle: work organization, budget management, capacity management, scope control, risk assessment/mitigation and governance.
  • Ability to manage projects with a strong technical focus.
  • Excellent judgment, strong autonomy, ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Experience in leveraging the iterative cycle: frequent deliveries of new versions enabling rapid improvement.
  • Mastery of Atlassian (Jira, Confluence, Tempo) and Google suite; knowledge of Google's artificial intelligence tools is an asset.
  • Inclusive and unifying leadership, demonstrated ability to mobilize cross-functional teams, build trust and positively influence without formal authority.
  • Demonstrated ability to move with ease and composure in rapidly changing environments. Great personal resilience, ease in the face of ambiguity and ability to positively support teams through change.
  • Ability to quickly assimilate new technologies and adapt to changes by learning.
  • Ability to share one's knowledge.
  • Strong communication skills (oral and written).
  • Excellent level of spoken and written French.
  • PMP certification, agile certification or lean management an asset.
  • Bilingualism (French and English).

CBC Saskatchewan is hiring a reporter-editor for our new bureau in Yorkton, an area with a large agricultural and manufacturing base putting it at the centre of conversations that shape local, provincial and geopolitical trade and economic security.

Adaptability is key to the role of reporter-editor. One day you could be covering a hyper-local story that matters to local residents, or working behind the scenes to line up interviews for a morning radio program. The next day you could be covering a federal announcement on agricultural support, or contributing to broadcast and digital platforms live.  Central to all of your coverage is ensuring voices from the region are reflected in our journalism across digital, radio, social, streaming and TV. 

As the base for the Yorkton Tribal Council, representing six member Treaty 4 First Nations, your reporting will also play a key role in the CBC News strategy to connect and amplify Indigenous content to audiences in Saskatchewan and across Canada.

In this role, you’ll operate independently, under the direction of the CBC Saskatchewan assignment desk. While you’re comfortable taking the initiative and working solo to get things done, you will have a lot of daily support from your colleagues at both the CBC Saskatoon and Regina stations. We’re a collaborative group, here to support you in your daily assignment. You will also have access to ongoing training opportunities to support your development with CBC News.

Affordable housing, short commutes and easy-access to year round activities make this an ideal location for those looking for work-life balance. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the easy access to parks, beaches, trails, fishing and wildlife. Home to North America’s longest running film festival, Yorkton also has a vibrant cultural community.

The role requires you to be full-time on-site in our Yorkton bureau. You will be provided with a vehicle to get to stories throughout the region, which spans east central Saskatchewan and to the Manitoba border.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Pitch, research, gather and produce original story ideas for digital, social, radio, streaming and TV programming that will engage and inform audiences, deepen community connections and elevate a range of voices, especially those who have typically been underrepresented in media.

  • Respond quickly to breaking news events as they unfold.

  • Distill large amounts of complex information under tight time constraints.

  • Cultivate and develop working relationships with a large pool of contacts and community members.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across CBC to develop and break stories, plan and produce features and coordinate long-term coverage.

  • Ensure CBC journalistic standards are met and that our stories are fair, balanced, accurate, thoughtful, immediate and resonate with the communities we serve.

What you bring:

  • Demonstrated experience working in a fast-paced daily news environment, or an equivalent position in a deadline driven environment with transferable skills.

  • Ability to work independently with superior problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to generate, pitch and pursue strong, original stories that meet the needs of audiences.

  • A proven track record of connecting with local communities.

  • Superior writing skills, and experience in gathering, editing and packaging audio and video.

  • Ability to present stories live on-air, from within the studio and out in the field.

  • A willingness to embrace change and take on new tasks as the media industry evolves.

  • A strong desire to live and promote the values of diversity and an inclusive and respectful work culture.

  • Possession of a valid driver’s licence and a driving record that meets the minimum requirements of CBC/Radio Canada’s insurance company.

  • Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends, as required.

  • University degree or college certificate in journalism or equivalent, with a minimum of three years of recent, related experience.

Experience and Skills Required:

  • A proven ability to craft and execute campaigns on digital platforms, with deep, hands-on expertise managing and structuring Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max, etc.) and a curiosity to adapt to other paid media platforms.

The Role

CBC News is looking for an ambitious, creative journalistic leader to serve as the pulse of our Prairies newsrooms. Based in Alberta, Saskatchewan, or Manitoba, you will guide our national reporting teams across all three provinces—setting the news agenda, driving innovative storytelling, and ensuring our coverage reflects the communities we serve.


As Senior Producer, you are a natural leader and self-starter who thrives in fast-paced environments. Operating independently under the direction of an Executive Producer, you will lead, assign, and coach teams across the prairies to respond to daily and breaking news while pursuing high-impact original journalism. 


You will juggle multiple projects, shifting priorities, and competing deadlines across digital, radio, and television platforms, always planning ahead for future coverage and special events while coordinating staff and travel within an assigned budget.


A collaborative mindset is essential to this role. You will break down silos by working closely with local CBC stations across the Prairies and colleagues across CBC to seamlessly share information, content and resources. As a keen observer of the changing media landscape, you embrace experimentation and constantly look for fresh story ideas and formats that reach new, younger, and underserved audiences.


To succeed, you must bring a solid understanding of news across the region, paired with a strong grasp of national and international stories. 

You are skilled at navigating change and conflict, providing constructive feedback, and bringing out your colleagues' creative best.

Above all, you live and promote the values of an inclusive, respectful, and representative work culture.


This role requires a thorough understanding of CBC Journalistic Standards and Practices. This is a permanent, full-time, on-site position that involves regional travel and can be based in Alberta, Saskatchewan, or Manitoba.


Key Tasks:

  • Lead a team of multi-platform journalists located in Calgary, Edmonton, Regina and Winnipeg to file news stories of national interest to CBC’s TV, radio, and digital programs and platforms
  • Work closely with the journalists and leaders in the local CBC stations in each location to ensure news and events from Saskatchewan, Manitoba and Alberta are properly reflected on national programs and that coverage reflects the geographic, racial, cultural and socio-economic diversity of the region
  • Participate in daily meetings with national assignment and story development leaders and other regional assignment producers
  • Pitch Prairies stories for cross-platform rollouts with a focus on shaping these stories to resonate with national audiences
  • Be able to guide reporters, producers and videographers when their help is needed on assignments, whether based in their province or beyond
  • Propose and plan coverage for news events, collaborating with local teams and other CBC teams across the province.
  • Be a leader on major breaking news events, able to quickly build coverage plans, do risk assessments, dispatch field teams and collaborate with local and CBC counterparts to ensure we’re on the story and fast.
  • Ensure storytelling for radio, television and digital platforms has high production values.
  • Have a strong understanding of regional news and knowledge of how to make local stories meaningful to wider audiences
  • Support journalists pursuing enterprise stories, balancing daily demands with original journalism.
  • Work with the Executive Producer of Newsgathering and the Domestic Newsgathering Managing Editor to monitor and support team well-being/mental health, including planning for and recovery from coverage of potentially stressful and traumatic events.
  • Develop and maintain contacts with a wide variety of sources.


Qualifications

  • University degree or equivalent required.
  • Must have 7 years of relevant experience and recognized journalistic and leadership credentials.
  • Exceptional leadership skills and organizational ability.
  • Strong understanding of Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta news.
  • Cultural sensitivity and awareness, with strong connections to diverse communities.
  • Lived experience that broadens journalistic perspectives.
  • Experience pursuing stories in under represented communities.
  • Ability to recognize issues of importance quickly and take effective action to ensure appropriate coverage.

  • high pressure situations. Ability to lead with empathy through stressful situations.
  • Solid technical grasp of broadcast and online production tools and methods.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN. ã

¤ We are CNN. THE WORLD'S MOST ESSENTIAL AND ENGAGING SOURCE OF DIGITAL NEWS. We are in the midst of rapid transformation and need our next generation of innovators, makers, and dreamers who will lead and drive our growth. We aim to make the world a better, more connected place. Your New Role… CNN is seeking an exceptional and strategic Associate Manager of Business Development responsible for supporting CNN’s Commerce team by growing affiliate revenue through content and linking optimizations, new affiliate solutions, and overseeing key merchant relationships. Revenue from affiliate transactions is the primary monetization vehicle of CNN Underscored, and we are looking to grow this revenue for our 2,000+ existing merchant partners, as well as expand the presence of affiliate through new verticals and unique partnership opportunities. Outside of working with merchant partners, the Associate Manager of Business Development will collaborate with Business and Editorial team members to identify new monetization opportunities, operationalize relevant strategies, and analyze performance for continued growth through both Organic and Paid channels. They will also work closely with Product, Engineering, and Revenue Insights on new features and incremental earnings opportunities. Your Role Accountabilities... Partner Management: Oversee a portfolio of priority merchants to nurture and grow affiliate earnings with through performance incentives, commission negotiations, and strategic initiatives. Content & Linking Optimization: Maximize affiliate revenue from content by implementing high-yield partner links, optimizing content to increase click through rate and conversion rate, and oversee network migrations to mitigate revenue loss. Performance Analysis: Analyze merchant and article-level performance to identify alternative monetization tactics that improve core performance metrics through diverse attribution and partner diversification strategies. Cross Collaboration: Work with Business Development, Editorial, Product and Analytics stakeholders to identify, analyze, and develop new business and product solutions that increase user engagement and revenue earnings. New Revenue: Assist Business Development team in sourcing, identifying and developing new opportunities to create revenue on and off platform through Sponsorships, Paid Media, and other digitally driven concepts. Qualifications & Experience… Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, data science, or related field. Minimum 3 years’ experience in digital marketing, analytics, or related field. Experience working with internal and external stakeholders to develop new concepts, strategies, and processes that drive revenue growth. A fundamental understanding of affiliate revenue KPIs such as, earnings-per-click, cost-per-action, revenue-per-impression, click-through rate, and conversion rate. Affiliate marketing experience and familiarity with affiliate network reporting platforms is preferred. The ideal candidate is organized, has strong analytical skills, the ability to problem solve, and can effectively communicate informative findings to others. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. job.title: Account Director
job.description:
Company And Culture

Complex is the definitive platform for global youth culture and music lifestyle, seamlessly integrating cutting-edge content, commerce and live experiences with unparalleled scale. Through innovative content, Complex tells stories of music, streetwear and style, sports, art and beyond. A powerful media juggernaut paired with a curated marketplace, Complex is redefining the way fans interact with their favorite brands and artists and reshaping the future of digital culture and commerce.

Why We're Hiring

At Complex, we're looking for an experienced and motivated Brand Partner with a media background to join our team. This is a high-energy job that requires persistent interaction with clients, proven sales skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with internal teams.

The Director, Brand Partnerships is responsible for driving strategic advertising and sponsorship revenue by developing innovative, multi-platform marketing partnerships for Fortune 500 brands. This role combines consultative selling, executive relationship management, and creative solution development across Complex's portfolio of content, social, experiential, commerce, and branded entertainment properties.

The ideal candidate is a proactive seller with deep agency and client relationships, a proven history of exceeding revenue goals, and experience creating integrated partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

job.title: KIDZ BOP, Brand Marketing Associate
job.description:
Overview

Founded in 2008, BMG is committed to building the world’s most trusted, forward-looking music company. Following its combination with Concord in 2026, BMG brings together global scale, deep expertise, technology, and partnership to unlock new opportunities for creators while protecting and growing the long-term value and cultural impact of their work.  

 

Headquartered in Nashville with 18 offices globally, BMG is privately held and part of Bertelsmann, the international media, services and education company, with a minority stake held by affiliates of Great Mountain Partners. 

 

KIDZ BOP is the #1 music brand for kids, featuring today's biggest hits, "sung by kids for kids." Since 2001, the family friendly music brand has generated 14 billion streams and currently records in 5 different languages. The brand connects with its fans through year-round music releases, music videos, in-school activations, global partnerships, a dedicated channel on SiriusXM (KIDZ BOP Radio channel 135) and live tours. Each year, KIDZ BOP LIVE, the ultimate pop concert for kids (and grown-ups) hits all major cities across the US. 

Responsibilities

Your Mission:

KIDZ BOP is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and creative-minded Brand Marketing Associate to support the development and execution of marketing campaigns across all areas of the brand, including music releases, live touring, brand partnerships, and major seasonal initiatives.

 

This role will be involved in the full lifecycle of marketing campaigns, from developing marketing plans and coordinating creative assets to managing approvals, media execution, and campaign deliverables. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, resourceful self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing creative marketing ideas to life.

 

What You'll Be Doing:

• Marketing Planning & Campaign Management: Work collaboratively with internal teams to develop and execute integrated marketing plans across album releases, live touring, brand partnerships, and key brand initiatives. Help identify marketing opportunities, build campaign timelines, coordinate deliverables, and manage campaigns from planning through execution.• Creative Development & Execution: Partner with creative, video, and social teams to develop campaign assets across digital, social, out-of-home, and other marketing channels. Manage creative briefs, feedback, revisions, and approvals to ensure assets are on-brand, accurate, and delivered on time.• Media Coordination: Work closely with internal and external media teams to coordinate campaign launches, ensuring advertising assets are delivered, placed, and running correctly across paid digital, social, out-of-home, and other media channels.• Live Tour Marketing: Collaborate directly with concert venues, promoters, and touring teams to develop and execute local marketing plans for KIDZ BOP LIVE tour dates. Manage promotional deliverables and identify opportunities to maximize awareness and ticket sales in each market.• Brand Partnerships: Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for brand partners, managing campaign timelines, creative development, approvals, and deliverables to ensure successful execution of sponsorships and marketing partnerships.• Brand Events & Activations: Support the planning and execution of brand events, promotional activations, and experiential marketing initiatives. Serve as the on-site KIDZ BOP brand representative and primary point of contact, coordinating with partners, vendors, and internal teams to ensure events run smoothly and meet brand expectations.• Marketing Materials: Work with internal teams to develop and update brand presentations, pitch decks, sales materials, sizzle reels, and other promotional assets.• Project Management & Administrative Support: Maintain marketing calendars, campaign trackers, budgets, and timelines to keep projects organized and on schedule. Assist with meeting coordination, invoices, payments, and other day-to-day administrative needs.

Qualifications

What You Bring:

• 2+ years of experience in marketing, campaign management, brand marketing, or a related field.• Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.• Proactive, resourceful self-starter who takes ownership of projects and follows through from start to finish.• Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate across multiple departments and external partners.• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a personable, positive attitude and strong interpersonal skills.• Collaborative team player who works well with colleagues, external partners, talent, and families, and is comfortable in kid-friendly environments.• Creative mindset with an understanding of effective marketing content and advertising across digital, social, and traditional media.• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with shifting priorities.• Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with Adobe Photoshop, video editing software, and other creative tools is a plus.• Interest in music, entertainment, pop culture, and consumer marketing.• Willingness to travel and work occasional evenings or weekends for events and activations.  Salary: $60,000/year  *This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days minimum on-site. BMG is an equal opportunity employer. We employ, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We believe that diversity, inclusion and equity is paramount for the creation of music, theater and film that celebrates and empowers all cultures.

At Connoisseur Media San Francisco, we bring together the power of local radio, digital marketing, events, and creative storytelling to help businesses connect with audiences, build brands, and grow. KBLX — 102.9 A heritage Bay Area brand playing the best throwbacks and R&B with deep community roots and a loyal audience. KBAY — 98.5 / 92.1 Bay Country - country music, passionate fans, and opportunities for brands to connect authentically. KEZR — MIX 106.5 - The South Bay’s home for today’s best mix and biggest hits. Connrex Digital — Strategic digital marketing solutions that help businesses reach the right people, strengthen their online presence, and drive measurable results. From broadcast campaigns and digital advertising to sponsorships, events, and customized marketing solutions, you’ll have a portfolio of opportunities to turn client challenges into creative, revenue-generating ideas.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Be a business builder. Identify, prospect, and develop new relationships with local and regional businesses, advertising agencies, and key decision-makers. Lead with curiosity. Ask insightful questions, uncover client needs, understand business objectives, and develop consultative marketing solutions—not cookie-cutter proposals. Think beyond the traditional. Combine radio, digital, promotions, sponsorships, events, and creative partnerships into integrated campaigns that deliver value for advertisers. Turn ideas into revenue. Prepare compelling presentations, recommend strategic solutions, negotiate opportunities, close business, and grow existing accounts. Own your results. Take initiative, manage your pipeline, maintain consistent sales activity, and achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals. Build lasting partnerships. Deliver exceptional service, communicate proactively, and become a trusted marketing resource for your clients. Represent brands that matter. Bring the Connoisseur Media and Connrex Digital story to the marketplace while helping local businesses succeed. WHO YOU ARE You are competitive, resourceful, outgoing, and motivated by the opportunity to make things happen. You enjoy opening doors, building relationships, solving problems, and finding new ways to win. You bring: Strong prospecting, cold-calling, networking, and appointment-setting skills. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities. A consultative mindset and the confidence to speak with business owners and senior decision-makers. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deadlines. A goal-oriented mindset, resilience, and a desire to continually improve. The ability to turn clients’ needs into compelling marketing ideas and business opportunities.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

At least two years of sales experience, preferably in B2B sales, advertising, marketing, media, or a client-facing business development role. A track record of developing business, growing revenue, and working toward measurable sales goals. Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment where initiative and adaptability matter. A valid driver’s license and a fully insured personal vehicle for business use. Even better if you bring:

Experience

selling radio, digital advertising, integrated marketing, sponsorships, or events. A strong local network or knowledge of the San Francisco Bay Area business community.

Experience

creating strategic proposals and delivering engaging client presentations. Familiarity with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field. We value talent, curiosity, drive, and the ability to build meaningful relationships. If you have the right mindset and a passion for helping businesses grow, we want to hear from you. YOUR AMBITION. OUR PLATFORM. BIGGER POSSIBILITIES. At Connoisseur Media, we believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage. We invest in individuals who take ownership of their careers, bring fresh thinking to their work, and want to be part of a team that supports one another and celebrates success. You’ll have the opportunity to work with established local media brands, develop new business relationships, collaborate with creative and digital marketing professionals, and build a career in an industry that continues to evolve. READY TO MAKE YOUR MARK? Bring your ideas. Bring your ambition. Help us shape what’s next for Bay Area businesses and brands. Discover your talent. Build your future. job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description:
Connoisseur Media is looking for a Full-Time Engineer for our North Dallas (Sherman-McKinney, TX) market. The ideal candidate has basic knowledge of, or is willing to learn about, radio broadcast technical systems and equipment to ensure reliable, high-quality audio transmission for our three radio stations - 97.5 KLAK, 93.1 KMKT, and 102.5 KMAD-FM. The ideal candidate works well under pressure, creates solutions, and is a resourceful, diligent, engaged, and creative problem-solver, with not just a “can-do” but a “will-do” attitude. While we seek someone well-versed in, or willingness to learn, broadcast engineering, a candidate’s interpersonal and communication skills, as well as business and personal integrity, are just as important as technical ability.

Responsibilities

for this position include: Compliance with FCC regulations and station policies regarding broadcast standards. Maintenance of safety protocols in all engineering practices. Chief Operator (EAS, Maintenance, and Transmitter Readings log management & review). Regular inspection and maintenance of broadcast equipment, including a mix of solid-state and high-power tube transmitters, audio consoles, studio gear, audio automation systems, remote broadcast systems, and other related equipment. Perform hands-on routine preventive maintenance and repairs on all technical systems. Monitor audio quality and signal strength during radio broadcasts and be able to quickly troubleshoot issues, as needed. Under the direction of Corporate IT, complete all necessary procedures and paperwork relating to the market’s computer system and be the local eyes and hands for remote IT Help Desk support. Oversee the installation of new equipment and technologies, including the planning and implementation of upgrades to existing systems. Work with the Director of Engineering and market Operations Manager to manage capital projects and implement corporate initiatives. Maintain minimal downtime of broadcast, audio and computer systems, including emergency repairs, but also planning and advocating for any necessary improvements to all systems. Provide technical support and expertise, as needed, to other departments in planning and executing initiatives. Clear, professional, and productive communication with employees who do not have technical or programming backgrounds, as well as subcontractors and vendors. Develop clear instructions relating to simple tasks for non-technical employees to understand and perform. Maintain an accurate equipment inventory, maintenance logs, and technical schematics. This includes the preparation of reports relating to asset additions/disposals and technical issues and solutions. Requirements of this position include the following: A minimum of 1-3 years audio engineering, Radio/TV broadcast engineering and/or IT experience. Knowledge of FCC Regulations. Availability to travel to multiple market locations and transmitter sites. Familiarity with, or willingness to learn about, broadcast automation and centralized audio routing systems. Basic knowledge of, or willingness to learn about, computer networks, STL systems, RF & landline, including analog, digital, and IP. A flexible self-manager with the ability to prioritize tasks and shift priorities as needed. This position requires a fully insured personal vehicle and a valid driver’s license. The candidate is required to provide a safe driving record covering the past three years. Must be able to develop collaborative and productive relationships with market employees, so market staff can help troubleshoot effectively when the engineer is off-site. On call availability for transmitter, studio, and remote broadcast technical issues, remote alarm calls, emergencies, and be proactive about coverage when unavailable. ​

Preferred Qualifications

Military or Post-Secondary electronics training. SBE Certification.

Experience

with Axia LiveWire routing. Demonstrated Project Management skills.​

job.description:

This role is responsible for maximizing revenue growth across our broadcast and digital platforms while developing a high-performing sales culture built on collaboration, accountability, innovation, and results. The General Sales Manager will lead, coach, and motivate a team of Account Executives, partner closely with market leadership and fellow sales managers, and drive both new business development and existing account growth. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a passion for developing talent, creating winning sales strategies, and delivering exceptional results for clients and the company. Essential

Responsibilities

Sales Leadership & Revenue Growth Work as a collaborative partner with fellow sales managers to create and maintain a "One Team" culture across the organization. Lead, empower, and motivate a team of local sellers to maximize revenue from broadcast, digital, event, and integrated marketing solutions. Drive opportunities that generate both new business and incremental revenue growth from existing clients. Hold the sales team accountable for leveraging the company's superior media assets to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals. Maintain visibility in the marketplace and build strong client relationships that positively impact revenue growth and client retention. Stay informed on market conditions, competitive activity, and all returning and non-returning business. Coaching, Training & Team Development Conduct weekly one-on-one meetings with direct reports and enforce the consistent use of ShareBuilders and other sales performance tools. Accompany Account Executives on sales calls to provide coaching, training, and professional development. Coach Account Executives on Strategic Account Management planning, focusing on revenue growth, account prioritization, and annual budget implementation. Foster a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and sales excellence. Co-build a strong talent bench by recruiting, hiring, and developing top sales talent in the market. Sales Operations & Forecasting Provide accurate revenue forecasting and pipeline management for direct reports. Approve sales orders and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures. Monitor sales activity and performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement and growth. Create, update, and maintain sales presentations, marketing materials, and sales collateral. Sales Meetings & Team Alignment Prepare for and co-lead weekly sales meetings. Source and approve leads across the San Francisco, San Jose, and Far East Bay sales teams. Work with the team to ensure effective utilization of all sales tools and resources, including ZoomInfo, Futuri, AdMall, Waymark Video, Marketron, Tapscan, Miller Kaplan, Media Monitors, and other company-approved platforms. Communicate market intelligence, sales strategies, best practices, and performance expectations to the team. Events & Cross-Department Collaboration Attend and actively participate in weekly Promotions Meetings. Manage and oversee annual on-air and on-site station events, ensuring successful execution and revenue opportunities. Collaborate with programming, promotions, digital, and market leadership teams to maximize integrated sales opportunities and client success.

education

and experience. Minimum of 5 years of media sales leadership experience, preferably in radio, digital media, or integrated marketing solutions. job.title: Graphic Designer II (Remote)
job.description:
Connrex Digital, a division of Connoisseur Media, is seeking a talented, creative, and detail-oriented Graphic Designer II to help bring client brands and marketing campaigns to life across digital platforms. This 100% remote position is open to candidates anywhere in the United States and offers the opportunity to create engaging, high-impact visual content that supports client goals and delivers strong marketing results. The Graphic Designer II will develop a wide range of creative assets, including HTML5 and programmatic ads, social media and Meta creative, logos, digital advertising, and other marketing materials. This role requires a strong eye for design, the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines, and the confidence to work independently while collaborating with clients and internal teams. The ideal candidate brings strong design skills, creativity, attention to detail, and professional judgment. They are comfortable receiving and applying feedback, take pride in reviewing and refining their work, and consistently deliver polished, on-brand creative that meets quality standards and client objectives.

Responsibilities

Demonstrate clear growth and skill development. Work independently and efficiently. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Show proficiency in self-critique. Demonstrate consistency & client communication skills. Follow all company and team processes accurately. Complete design tasks in a timely manner. Develop skills and design knowledge. Uphold quality standards & best practices. Work with clients to bring their vision into reality. Be open to constructive criticism and implement feedback. HTML5 & Static Programmatic Ads: Design and maintain clean HTML5 and static programmatic ads. Communicate with Ad Managers for any clarification and client approvals. Enhanced Social Graphic Calendars: Work directly with Social Media Managers to aid in bringing the client's monthly social media vision to life. Create static, carousel, or animated graphics to be used on client social channels. Meta, LinkedIn, & Smart Social Ads: Create static and animated graphic ads for Meta, LinkedIn, & other social platforms. Communicate with AdsManagers/Account Managers for any clarification and client approvals. Logo Onboarding & Design: Research, prepare, and conduct client logo onboarding calls. Design multiple logo variations and prepare them in a presentation for client review. Implement any revisions and prepare the finalized logo package for the client. All Other Requested Marketing Materials: Design any marketing material requests. This may include slide deck presentations, brochures, posters, business cards, trade show materials, etc. These may be internal or client-facing. Requirements: Strong understanding of design principles and visual communication. High proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and modern design workflows.

Experience

job.description:

Connoisseur Media Amarillo is looking for an energetic, dependable, and enthusiastic Part-Time Street Team & Board Operator to help bring our stations to life both on the air and in the community. Represent KGNC 97.9 (KGNC-FM), 100.9 The Eagle (KXGL-FM), 102.9 The Rattler (KVWE-FM), and NewsTalk 710 & 97.5 KGNC (KGNC-AM) at concerts, festivals, live broadcasts, sporting events, and community appearances while also helping keep our stations sounding their best behind the scenes. No two days are the same! One day you could be hosting games and giveaways at a concert, and the next you could be running a live sports broadcast or operating the control board during a live show. If you're outgoing, love working with people, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and have a passion for radio and live entertainment, we'd love to meet you!

Represent our stations at live broadcasts, concerts, festivals, sporting events, and community events. Set up and tear down promotional equipment, including tents, banners, sound systems, tables, and displays. Engage listeners through contests, prize wheels, games, giveaways, and on-site promotions. Monitor automation systems, transmitters, and studio equipment to ensure smooth broadcasts. Maintain broadcast logs and accurately report discrepancies. Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and assist with event setup and teardown. Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and occasional last-minute shifts. Valid driver's license and current auto insurance. Must be able to drive a company vehicle. Must be at least 18 years old (21+ preferred for events where alcohol is served).

Previous

experience

in radio, promotions, live events, sports broadcasting, or media.

operating radio automation systems such as Marketron or similar software. Familiarity with FCC rules and EAS requirements.

with social media platforms, WordPress, or digital content creation. Passion for music, sports, entertainment, and connecting with the local community. job.title: Traffic Coordinator (Bay Area)
job.description:
Connoisseur Media is seeking a highly organized, detail-driven Traffic Continuity Coordinator to play a vital role in the success of our broadcast and digital advertising operations. This position will be in the office located in the Bay Area of California. This position sits at the intersection of programming, sales, and revenue, ensuring that premium advertising inventory is managed with precision, accuracy, and care across multiple radio stations. As a key member of our operations team, the Traffic Continuity Coordinator helps keep everything running smoothly—meeting tight deadlines, maintaining flawless logs, and supporting both internal teams and clients with reliable, timely information. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, stays calm under pressure, and takes pride in getting the details right the first time. You’ll collaborate closely with programming and management, use industry-leading tools to manage commercial activity, and contribute directly to the financial performance of the stations. If you enjoy a role where accuracy matters, teamwork is valued, and your behind-the-scenes expertise makes a visible impact every day, you’ll feel right at home at Connoisseur Media. What you need to do to be successful in this position: Prepare and Manage Program Logs: Accurately prepare daily program logs for one or more of our five radio stations, ensuring precision and adherence to strict deadlines. Schedule and Process Commercials: Efficiently schedule radio commercials and process commercial contracts on a daily basis. Provide Inventory Insights: Supply station management with accurate and up-to-date advertising inventory information. Collaborate on Programming: Work closely with station programmers to ensure hourly clocks are accurate and current on all program logs. Reconcile Daily Logs: Reconcile daily program logs for assigned radio stations, verifying all scheduled content aired correctly. job.description:

Division: Technology

Work Status: Full-Time (on-site)

Location: Toronto - Corus Quay

About the Role:

Corus Entertainment is seeking a dynamic and innovative professional to join the Broadcast Operations team at our Toronto location as a Broadcast Network Monitoring Operator.

Reporting to the Lead, Broadcast Network Monitoring, the Broadcast Network Monitoring Operator is part of team that ensures Corus’ broadcast signals are present for over-the-air (OTA) and cable/satellite (BDU) viewers across the country and maintains revenue by ensuring simultaneous substitutions with US networks are in place. The BNM team is also the communication hub for the internal network connecting all of Corus’ news production centres together. The team works extensively with various internal departments and external clients, maintaining a high level of customer service while meeting strict deadlines in a 24/7/365 signal monitoring environment.

You will contribute by:

• Monitor all return broadcast signals originating from Corus for quality, signal integrity, and regulatory compliance and escalate internally and externally accordingly

• Monitor network connectivity and performance within the Corus broadcast and news production footprint and escalate internally accordingly

• Confirm simultaneous substitutions of US network content and communicate information and issues to BDUs in a professional and timely manner

• Accurately create and compile reports detailing issues with broadcast signals, Corus’ network, and simultaneous substitutions

• Perform first-level checks and basic troubleshooting on IP-based broadcast systems such as encoders, decoders, switches and SD-WAN devices

• Help track daily network performance metrics for uptime, stream stability, and error rates

• Gain a firm understanding of broadcast operations technology, workflows and networks to troubleshoot, solve and escalate issues

• Follow existing departmental procedures, workflows, and documentation

• Provide updates and support in a 24/7/365 broadcast and news environment for Corus’ network and all broadcast signals originating from Corus

• Stay current with equipment, workflows and procedural changes required to perform tasks

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Diploma or degree in broadcasting, communications, IT, media or other technology fields or equivalent experience

• Basic knowledge of IP networking (IP addressing, multicast, latency, jitters, bandwidth) and comfort working with network monitoring tools

• A good understanding of video/audio technical standards, cable TV, OTA, satellite (DTH) and IPTV distribution platforms in order to troubleshoot and escalate signal problems

• Experience with broadcast transmission chains, networks, video platforms and associated systems

• Proficiency in computer skills – Microsoft Office suite and other integrated applications and communication tools

• Must be adaptable, able to multi-task and work with acute attention to detail

• Communicate in a positive, friendly manner and with a customer service approach

• Ability to handle challenging situations with professionalism, empathy and sincerity

• Able to work a flexible schedule that includes evenings, overnights and weekends

• Fluency in French is an asset

job.title: Account Executive - Dayton Radio
job.description:
Location: OH-Dayton

Job Title:  Account Executive - Dayton Radio

 

Position Overview

Are you a problem solver? Can you help others identify their goals and get them from where they are to where they want to be? We win when our local business clients get a return on their investment thanks to our creative and innovative digital media solutions. We aim to be more than just exceptional partners; our tools and services are game changers for their businesses.

 

As an Account Executive for Cox Media Group, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and partner to help achieve them. In this role, you will collaborate with local sales managers to evangelize solutions that will help customers reach their target audience. As a CMG employee, you’ll have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips. We’ll also provide ongoing training and professional development across our full range of products, and you’ll be an integral part of a results-driven, close-knit team that is driving growth for CMG.


 
At Cox Media Group we are building the future of media and have an opening for a skilled Account Executive! Cox Media Group is a forward-thinking, fast-paced, and positive culture of top performing sales professionals that work together to produce results.


 
Cox Media Group has a Training Program that will guide you on your way to launching a successful and lucrative career as an Account Executive! Through the program you will be matched with a personal mentor, practice collaborative teamwork

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for generating revenue through the development of new accounts
  • Responsible for generating revenue by growing existing advertising revenue from current clients.
  • Able to develop effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Able to obtain budgets and meet deadlines.
  • Responsible for ensuring superior client relations.
  • Superior management of sales through the entire sales cycle.
  • Use of CRM sales tool for reporting and prospecting
  • Prepare and present both written and oral presentations.
  • Prepare effective advertising schedules.
  • Effectively negotiate advertising rates.
  • Collection of accounts receivable, as required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record of digital and TV sales success in local media setting
  • Ability to work alone and as part of a team
  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience required
  • Excellent presentation, verbal and written skills
  • Hard-working, integrity, relationship-builder with a winning attitude
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills
  • Work with brand teams, ad operations and finance to provide client satisfaction
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and CRM tools
  • Valid driver's license with clean driving record required
  • Relationship building skills are key and candidate must have a winning, positive attitude.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience preferred

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle
job.description:
Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.  This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
