job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Thanks for visiting the Curtis Media Group Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Account Executive

Boone, NC Full Time Mid Level Share Account Executive - Boone, NC 
This is the ideal role for a marketing and sales professional who is looking to join a growing digital and radio business. As our Account Executive, you will be responsible for selling digital and radio campaigns across a wide range of digital products and radio stations in Boone, NC. Account Executive to work directly with VP of Sales, Digital Coordinator, Digital Team Leader, and Executive VP of radio stations.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Account Management: Works directly with clients, prospects, and company account executives to support their needs and communicate client expectations.
  • Going on in-field calls with prospective clients utilizing the sales process of creating digital and radio campaigns for prospective clients utilizing the Client Needs Analysis, Client Pitch Presentations to Closing of the Sale.
  • Ability to achieve revenue goals and expectations without hesitation.
  • Responsible for building and maintaining a billing book of business with guidance from VP of Sales.
  • Work directly with our Digital Coordinator in processing requests for proposals, insertion orders, sample spec ads and reporting. (for digital only)
  • Project Management: the ability to track timelines and due dates for deliverables, reviews, and approval for campaign launches.
  • Continuity with graphics team: Ensure all ads are being worked on and deadlines are being achieved so all schedules can run on time.
  • Maintain working knowledge of radio and digital products offered by the company through continuous training.
  • Monitor Campaigns to ensure all campaigns are hitting the promised impressions goals and spots during their flights. Adjust priority levels as appropriate.
  • Campaign Reports: At month end and/or the campaign ends, review performance reports for all digital and radio campaigns and present results to the client.
  • Client communication: Work directly with clients to ensure campaign execution and performance meet their standards.
Qualifications:
  • Organization and follow-through are critical skills for this position.  Logical, process-oriented person, who is effective and strategically contributes to campaigns.
  • Strong work ethic, self-motivated and high achiever with a sales drive.
  • Professional demeanor; comfortable presenting to and interacting directly with clients.
  • Demonstrates the ability to successfully collaborate with various team environments with dynamic priorities and meeting deadlines.
  • Quick-witted, understanding and offering solutions regarding various responsibilities.
  • In-depth knowledge of performance marketing with special focus on radio and digital capabilities.
  • Self-motivated and strategic thinker with a bias towards action while also being a strong team player.
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and ability to work in a fast-paced environment; Comfort dealing with ambiguity.
  • Strong partnership and influencing skills.
  • Comfort working with Senior Management.
  • Ability to uncover new opportunities to acquire customers efficiently and on a scale through well-developed relationships with core channel partners and media agencies.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications/Marketing preferred and/or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum experience working in sales: 1-3 years preferred.

Account Executive - Raleigh

Raleigh Full Time Mid Level Share

Curtis Media Group has an immediate opening for an Account Executive for our Raleigh, NC market.

Applicants should be enthusiastic with a can-do attitude and have a genuine interest in helping local businesses grow. job.title: Broadcast Operations Manager
job.description:
Thanks for visiting the Curtis Media Group Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Broadcast Operations Manager

Raleigh, NC Full Time Manager/Supervisor Share Curtis Media Group is seeking a Broadcast Operations Manager for our multi-market North Carolina radio stations.  The Operations Manager will work closely with the programming, engineering, traffic and IT staff to oversee the day-to-day operations of our FCC licensed radio stations, digital, networks and additional enterprises.  The Operations Manager will work with ownership and senior management in the administration of operational, compliance and administrative activities.
Duties and Responsibilities
  1. Oversees and coordinates the continuous, multifaceted daily operations of radio stations, ensuring compliance with broadcast standards, FCC rules and regulations, and relevant federal and state laws and regulations.
  2. Maintains accurate schedules, records, discrepancy reports, and follow-through communications, and ensures that all on-air broadcast programming complies with FCC rules and regulations.
  3. Participates in the establishment, organization, and implementation of short- and long-range goals, objectives, policies, and operating procedures; monitors and evaluates program effectiveness and effects changes required for improvement.
  4. Directs and administers the provision of day-to-day operation support to the various sub-units of the station, including the non-engineering portions of the station's physical plant, space allocation and utilization, station supplies and inventory, and station safety and security.
  5. Assigns, allocates work, and generally oversees operational and engineering personnel engaged in continuous station operations; performs recruitment, training, scheduling, retention, problem resolution, and performance management.
  6. Develops and implements systems to maintain records on station operations, equipment, and compliance activities; prepares regular and ad-hoc reports.
  7. Provides advice and assistance to senior station management in the planning, implementation, and evaluation of modification to existing operations, systems, and procedures.
  8. Researches and makes recommendations to management pertaining to acquisition of operating equipment; participates in the development and management of annual operating budgets.
  9. Supervises and maintains station FCC Public files including station Political Disclosure Statements, uploading of information to individual station public files including Issues & Ascertainment, EEO and political and issue advertising orders.
  10. May provide services as an on-air host, as required.
  11. Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Minimum Job Requirements
  • High school diploma or GED; at least 5 years of experience directly related to the duties and responsibilities specified.
  • Completed degree(s) from an accredited institution that are above the minimum education requirement may be substituted for experience on a year for year basis.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required
  • IT and radio automation operations are a must.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with a wide range of personnel
  • Records maintenance skills.
  • Skill in the use of personal computers and related software applications.
  • Knowledge of radio principles, procedures, operations, and standards.
  • Knowledge and understanding of radio communications facilities and distribution, and automation systems.
  • Skill in organizing resources and establishing priorities.
  • Knowledge of inventory management practices.
  • Knowledge of radio organizational structures, workflows, systems, and operating procedures.
  • Ability to develop, plan, and implement short- and long-range goals.
  • Knowledge of project management principles, practices, techniques, and tools.
  • Knowledge of FCC and other federal, state and local broadcasting regulations.
  • Ability to supervise and train employees, to include organizing, prioritizing, and scheduling work assignments.
  • Knowledge of budgeting and fiscal management principles and procedures.
  • Knowledge of facilities management, physical plant, safety, and building safety and security procedures.
  • Ability to create, compose, and edit written materials.
  • Supervision of individual station issues and ascertainment for
  • EEO compliance
  • Uploading of Political and Issue orders to FCC public file database
  • Knowledge of on-air and remote broadcasting processes and procedures.
  • Skills in examining and developing station operations and procedures, formulating policy, and implementing organizational strategies and procedures.
  • Ability to oversee, coordinate, and support the execution of continuous broadcast schedules on a 24x7 basis.
  • Knowledge of current and developing trends in radio.
  • Skill in operating radio equipment.

job.title: Associate Creative Director
job.description:
Job Description:

About You


You're equal parts creative visionary and collaborative leader. You believe the most effective ideas live at the intersection of fan insight, cultural relevance, and business impact. Whether leading a brainstorm, presenting work to clients, mentoring creatives, or refining the details of an experience, you bring energy, curiosity, and a relentless commitment to creative excellence.


We are looking for candidates with 8-10+ years of experience in an agency, design studio, experiential, sports marketing, or similar creative environment, with a strong background in concept development, art direction, design, and brand experience creation. To succeed in this role, you will bring the following:


  • A portfolio that demonstrates breakthrough conceptual thinking, visual storytelling, design excellence, and the ability to translate strategic objectives into impactful creative solutions.
  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, and inspiring creative teams while elevating the quality and ambition of the work. Collaborative approach and a passion for building positive team culture and fostering creative growth.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to confidently articulate, defend, and sell ideas to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • The ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously, balancing creative ambition with timelines, budgets, and production realities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, and InDesign
  • Advanced PowerPoint skills, including visual storytelling, presentation design, and executive-level deck development.
  • Familiarity with 3D modeling, rendering, and visualization tools such as Adobe Substance 3D, Blender, Cinema 4D, or SketchUp.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered creative tools to accelerate visualization, storytelling, and workflow efficiency while applying strong creative judgment and maintaining high standards of craft.
  • Experience in experiential marketing and sponsorship activations with a strong understanding of print production, environmental design, fabrication processes, and technical production specifications.
  • Excellent project management, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently and make sound creative decisions with confidence.

Key Responsibilities


  • Report to the Creative Director and serve as a senior creative leader across assigned accounts and initiatives.
  • Shape strategic approaches in partnership with Creative Strategy, Business Leadership, senior creative leaders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Lead and facilitate brainstorms, workshops, and creative working sessions, inspiring teams to push ideas beyond the expected.
  • Translate brand, sponsorship, and business challenges into compelling creative solutions across experiential, digital, social, content, and physical touchpoints with attention to detail from concept through execution
  • Develop a deep understanding of client brands, fan behavior, and cultural trends to identify opportunities for innovation and differentiation.
  • Lead creative development throughout the entire project lifecycle, balancing ambition, feasibility, timelines, budgets, and production requirements.
  • Anticipate challenges, proactively identify risks, and develop solutions that keep teams and projects moving forward. Recommend improvements to creative processes, workflows, tools, and ways of working.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, supportive, and ambitious creative culture that encourages experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead client-facing creative presentations, workshops, and creative discussions, partnering with senior creative leadership on key engagements.
  • Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, AI-enabled workflows, and creative tools that enhance the agency's capabilities, efficiency, and creative output.
  • Develop compelling presentations, visual storytelling materials, mock-ups, creative narratives, and executive-level presentation decks.
  • Collaborate with Project Management and Production teams to scope projects, inform budgets, and ensure creative solutions align with client objectives and operational requirements.

The Perks


Not only will you be joining a multi-award-winning Agency with great culture, you will also have the unique opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from our other offices across the globe. There is a whole heap of benefits that come with the role- a flexible holiday package starting at 20 days, corporate discounts, commuter benefits, cell phone reimbursement and much more. Our benefit plans have your total well-being in mind, and we offer an extensive list you can choose from to suit your needs.


About MKTG Sports + Entertainment


MKTG S+E is a global agency that harnesses the power of sports and entertainment for brands. For over 20 years, we've ignited fandom and innovated activation in the world of sports and entertainment to make something worth noticing, engaging, liking, sharing and remembering. We leverage deep INSIGHTS and our network of seasoned & creative team members to create IMPACT between properties, fans & brands.

Today, we help brands move at THE SPEED OF FANS which means we aim to know fans better than they know themselves. MKTG S+E is a part of the broader dentsu Sports International network.


Working with us


We’re an agency born of fanatics…fans of sports (yes, even pickleball).

Fans of music (we sing in the shower).

Fans of data (we’re proud nerds).

Fans of art (from exhibitions to film).

Fans of culture (this is huge). And that means we put it all in for what we love, truly understanding what fans need, want, feel, hate and love about the brands and properties we lead.


We’re led by our core values which focus on collaboration, community, inspiring change, pursuing excellence, and celebrating bravery – all of which are foundational to our culture and how we treat each other and our clients.


We’re a community where you are free to be you, where good work gets rewarded, and you are truly energized by the team around you. It’s more than just ‘warm & fuzzies’ – happy humans are vital to our commercial success. And together, we make magic.

Inclusion and Diversity


We’re proud to be different and that starts with our people. To us, representation means more than just diversity, it means true equity. We won’t define people by their race, gender, sexual-orientation, age or disability. Individuality is what makes us great, we want everyone to bring their full self to work and create something amazing. We are constantly evaluating our practices and policies, creating and sustaining pathways to promotion, and intentional in how we create and distribute resources, giving people what they need to grow. That’s what we care about. So, whether you’re joining us, or looking to move to a different part of the business, we work hard to make sure we create opportunities for everyone. We offer team member support through flexible working arrangements and schedules that promote work/life balance along with progressive parental and caregiver programs as well as opportunities to give back to the community as part of our global social responsibility efforts.


If you have any reasonable adjustment needs arising from a disability or medical condition to fully participate in the recruitment process, please discuss this with our recruitment teams.


Additional Information

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, Metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office. 

The annual salary range for this position is $95,500 - $100,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.  


Benefits available with this position include:  


• Medical, vision, and dental insurance, 

• Life insurance,  

• Short-term and long-term disability insurance, 

• 401k, 

• Flexible paid time off, 

• At least 15 paid holidays per year, 

• Paid sick and safe leave, and

job.title: Backend Engineer (NestJS, Node.js, Typescript, PostgresSQL)
job.description:
Job Description:

Job Description: Backend Engineer

Tech Stack: NestJS | Node.js | TypeScript | Prisma ORM | PostgreSQL | Redis | Microsoft Azure | Docker


Total Exp : 6 - 8 Years

Notice Period : Immediate Joiners

Work Timings : 06.00 P.M. to 03.00 A.M


Role Overview

We are looking for a Backend Engineer with strong experience in NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL to build scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of backend architecture, API design, database optimization, caching, asynchronous processing, cloud services, and production reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and REST APIs using NestJS, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Build modular backend architectures using NestJS modules, controllers, services, dependency injection, guards, interceptors, and middleware.
  • Design and optimize database schemas, queries, relationships, indexes, and transactions using PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM.
  • Implement request validation, centralized error handling, consistent API responses, and API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Develop secure authentication and authorization mechanisms, including JWT, RBAC, and permission-based access control.
  • Implement caching strategies using Redis and asynchronous processing using messaging queues and background jobs.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and external systems, handling authentication, rate limits, retries, timeouts, and failures.
  • Optimize API performance, database access, resource utilization, and application scalability.
  • Containerize applications using Docker and deploy backend services using Microsoft Azure.
  • Implement structured logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, health checks, and other observability practices.
  • Write automated tests, participate in code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and maintain technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers and other stakeholders to define API contracts and deliver end-to-end features.

Required Skills

Core Technologies and Architecture

  • Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.
  • Hands-on experience with NestJS is mandatory, including modules, dependency injection, guards, interceptors, pipes, and exception filters.
  • Strong understanding of REST API design, asynchronous programming, modular architecture, SOLID principles, and clean code practices.

Database and Caching

  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience with Redis for caching, TTL management, cache invalidation, and performance optimization.
  • Understanding of database consistency, connection pooling, and efficient data-access patterns.

API Development and Security

  • Experience implementing DTOs, request validation, centralized error handling, and consistent API contracts.
  • Familiarity with class-validator, class-transformer, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC, API security, rate limiting, and secure secrets management.
  • Experience handling pagination, filtering, API versioning, retries, and backward compatibility.

Cloud, Messaging, and Integrations

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or equivalent cloud platforms, with the ability to work with Azure services in production.
  • Familiarity with Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Service Bus, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Cache for Redis.
  • Understanding of messaging queues, background jobs, event-driven architecture, retries, and failure recovery.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs and handling asynchronous workflows.

Performance and Engineering Practices

  • Understanding of Node.js performance, concurrency, caching, database optimization, and scalability.
  • Familiarity with structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, health checks, and monitoring tools such as Application Insights or OpenTelemetry.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and automated testing using Jest or equivalent tools.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests and debugging application issues across development and production environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, domain-driven design, and clean architecture.
  • Familiarity with advanced messaging patterns, idempotency, dead-letter queues, and distributed system reliability.
  • Experience with GraphQL, webhooks, WebSockets, API gateways, or enterprise system integrations.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and Azure Functions.
  • Experience building enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant systems, and role-based access control.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code for implementation, debugging, refactoring, and testing, with the ability to review and validate generated code.
  • Familiarity with monorepos, shared libraries, and CI/CD workflows.

Ideal Candidate

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
  • Writes clean, modular, secure, maintainable, and strongly typed code.
  • Understands the reasoning behind architectural, database, and performance decisions.
  • Takes ownership of features from design and development through testing and deployment.
  • Communicates effectively and collaborates with frontend engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams.

Experience: Mid-level to Senior, depending on technical depth and demonstrated ownership.

Core Stack: NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Redis, REST APIs, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Git.

job.title: Experience Technical Architect, Innovation & Emerging Technologies
job.description:
Job Description:

The Experience Technical Architect, Innovation & Emerging Technologies is a hands-on, full-stack technical architect who owns the technical architecture and implementation of AI and agentic prototype solutions within Horizon's committed-build phase, bringing deep experience building rapid proofs-of-concept and shipping at speed under compressed timelines.


This role translates solution architectures into working, tested code spanning custom integrations and programming languages/frameworks, data pipelines, and agentic automation, with a track record of threading custom development into platforms across the Adobe ecosystem (i.e., AEM, GenStudio, Firefly, CX Enterprise CoWorker, Adobe Experience Platform, and adjacent Adobe products).


Balancing velocity with code quality in an agile, iterative delivery model, the Experience Technical Architect establishes and applies coding standards, drives prototypes to production readiness under compressed timelines, and maintains the patterns and documentation that make knowledge transfer possible.


Key Responsibilities

The responsibilities below reflect core needs for this role.

  • Lead sprint execution, breaking solution architecture into testable, shippable increments across two-week sprints.
  • Build custom integrations, data pipelines, custom interfaces, and agentic automation, including fine-tuned AI models, wiring GenStudio, Firefly, CX Enterprise CoWorker, AEP, and AEM into customer systems via APIs.
  • Design and implement custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors that enable seamless integration between Adobe’s AI/agentic solutions and client enterprise systems, accelerating prototype time-to-value and reducing manual data handoffs.
  • Architect third-party connector strategies and build integration patterns that extend Adobe capabilities into client data ecosystems, knowledge bases, and operational systems while maintaining data governance and security standards.
  • Lead AI hardening and production readiness validation for emerging capabilities and custom builds, identifying edge cases, failure modes, and mitigation strategies before client pilot launch.
  • Define data schemas, lineage, and governance frameworks that support experimental AI use cases, ensuring data quality and traceability as prototypes move from innovation labs into production pilots.
  • Write and ship production-quality code hands-on across the stack (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Node.js, React) and operate within agile build/deploy cadences, including CI/CD pipelines, feature branching, and frequent iterative releases.
  • Establish coding standards, run code reviews, and work closely with other developers to align on technical patterns, quality practices, and integration best practices.
  • Work with solution architects to stress-test technical feasibility and feed implementation learnings back into architecture decisions.
  • Partner with the Lead Architect, Product Manager, and Innovation Strategy Lead to clearly document integration approaches, configuration decisions, and known issues, so future teams can sustain and extend the build.
  • Track technical dependencies and coordinate with customer infrastructure teams to secure timely access to the staging and production environments you need to build, test, and ship.
  • Partner with QA to execute test plans and validate releases before they ship.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering or technical architecture experience, including hands-on development across backend, front-end, and data integration technologies.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing or integrating solutions within the Adobe ecosystem, with experience across one or more Adobe solutions and extending platform capabilities through APIs and custom development.
  • 3+ years of experience designing and building API-based integrations, data pipelines, or event-driven architectures connecting enterprise platforms and customer-experience applications.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building AI-enabled applications or solutions, including experience with AI-assisted coding, prompt engineering, agent/LLM configurations, fine-tuning, or custom AI model integration.
  • Hands-on proficiency in at least 3 relevant programming languages/frameworks, such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Node.js, React, and SQL.
  • 5+ years working in agile software development environments, including Scrum/Kanban, 1-2 week sprints, CI/CD deploy pipelines, feature branching, and frequent iterative releases.
  • Demonstrated experience taking at least 2 rapid proofs-of-concept or prototypes through implementation or production/pilot readiness, ideally within compressed timelines and ambiguous, rapidly changing requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience defining technical patterns and coding standards, conducting code reviews, and working with other developers to maintain code quality.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to operate effectively in emerging-technology environments with minimal guardrails.

Additional Information

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our hybrid way of working combines remote flexibility with regular in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Many of our employees who live within commuting distance (90 minutes) from one of our Headquarter or Hub Offices (New York, Chicago, Detroit, Los Angeles) are required to work in the office 2-3 days per week including one Team Day. The minimum number of days may vary by office and role. Dentsu may designate other HQ or Hub offices at any time. Those who do not live near an office may be designated as a remote employee, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect you to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office from time to time.

 

The annual base salary range for this position is $136,000 - $189,125. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.  Additionally, this position is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. 

 

Benefits available with this position include:  

• Medical, vision, and dental insurance, 

• Life insurance,  

• Short-term and long-term disability insurance, 

• 401k,  

• Flexible paid time off, 

• At least 15 paid holidays per year, 

• Paid sick and safe leave, and 

• Paid parental leave. 

 

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies.  For more information regarding dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.

job.title: Front End Commerce Architect
job.description:
Job Description:

Lead the Future of Digital Commerce

Are you passionate about building modern, high-performance front-end experiences at scale? Do you thrive in a role where you can shape architecture, write code, and mentor others? If so, this opportunity is for you.

We’re looking for a Frontend Commerce Architect to help lead the design and delivery of cutting-edge, composable commerce solutions. In this role, you’ll combine hands-on development with technical leadership—working alongside cross-functional teams to create seamless, scalable, and engaging digital experiences.

What You’ll Do

Shape Front-End Architecture

  • You’ll design and build modern, headless front-end architectures using React, Next.js, and Angular
  • You’ll define rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR) to deliver fast, scalable applications
  • You’ll lead the development of reusable component libraries and design system integrations
  • You’ll guide the adoption of micro frontend and composable architecture approaches

Drive Commerce Innovation

  • You’ll help design API-first, headless commerce solutions that integrate across platforms
  • You’ll partner with backend teams to ensure seamless performance and scalability
  • You’ll bring together commerce, content, and third-party services to create cohesive experiences

Own Data & Integration Strategy

  • You’ll architect GraphQL-based data layers that connect front-end applications to multiple services
  • You’ll ensure performance through smart caching, query optimization, and type-safe integrations

Deliver High-Performing Experiences

  • You’ll optimize Core Web Vitals and ensure fast, responsive user experiences
  • You’ll build accessible solutions aligned with WCAG standards
  • You’ll apply modern best practices for performance, security, and scalability

Lead, Mentor, and Collaborate

  • You’ll mentor engineers and support team growth while staying hands-on
  • You’ll collaborate with product, design, and engineering partners
  • You’ll help solve complex technical challenges and guide teams through implementation

What You Bring

  • You have strong experience building modern front-end applications with React, Next.js, Angular, and TypeScript
  • You’re comfortable designing scalable architectures and making technical decisions
  • You have experience working with GraphQL and API-driven systems
  • You’ve helped deliver high-performance digital experiences at scale
  • You enjoy mentoring others and contributing to a collaborative team environment
  • You understand or have worked with headless or composable commerce architectures

Tech You’ll Work With

  • React, Next.js, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript
  • GraphQL (Apollo or similar)
  • Webpack, Vite, monorepos
  • Headless CMS and composable commerce platforms
  • Modern performance, accessibility, and security standards

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • You’ll work on high-impact, enterprise-scale commerce platforms
  • You’ll have a voice in defining technical direction and best practices
  • You’ll balance hands-on development with strategic leadership
  • You’ll collaborate with talented teams solving meaningful challenges

Interested?

If you’re excited about building modern commerce experiences and want to make a real impact, we’d love to talk!

job.title: Manager, Growth
job.description:
Job Description:

dentsu Media is seeking a Manager, Growth to join our team.

 

Location: The primary office location is New York City. In this hybrid position, you will report to our CGO, Growth and work closely with leadership across the growth organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Harmonize the pitch team from day one. You will assign roles and responsibilities within your team by embracing and empowering your team members' strengths, diverse backgrounds, interests, and learning styles to sustain a high-performing media growth team that thrives internally and delivers positive results for its internal stakeholders and clients. You will ensure the team is well-grounded in the pitch process.
  • Manage the day-to-day growth team Associate and Design resources, ensuring the team is running the pitch process to agency expectations and is achieving designated tasks daily (such as backgrounders, database updates). You will keep the pitch team accountable to each other and to the story/solution we are solving. You will ensure the team is tracking towards long-term department goals and that team members are clear on personal growth goals and tracking towards them.
  • Champion the development of RFPs/RFIs and sales presentations. Drive best-in-class client service by tailoring our responses to customized client needs. Ensure submissions are consistently showcased and delivered in a premium fashion. Lead proposals / SOWs development internally, in partnership with operations and finance leads.
  • Drive expectations for senior-level reviews, ensure accurate timelines, and provide daily pitch updates. Develop winning pitch plans by collecting background information and cross-network information sharing. You will also be responsible for understanding brands and how clients' expectations coincide with market trends, ensuring our positioning and offerings are best-in-class.

Own and Optimize the Growth Process:

  • Lead the day-to-day management of the growth function, ensuring best-in-class execution across RFPs, RFIs, proactive opportunities, and strategic pursuits.
  • Drive process excellence, introducing scalable tools, workflows, and best practices that improve efficiency, collaboration, and win rates across the organization.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to agency leadership, proactively identifying risks, opportunities, and recommendations throughout the pursuit lifecycle.

Responsibilities specific to pitch meetings include:

  • Support the development of overall pitch strategy, narrative architecture, and meeting design to maximize client engagement and differentiation.
  • Shadow the coaching of presenters and leadership teams to deliver compelling, client-centric stories that showcase dentsu's capabilities and culture.
  • Foster strong team chemistry and collaboration across all disciplines participating in client interactions.
  • Ensure and document the clear ownership, preparation, and accountability for all client-facing meeting components.
  • Incorporate client feedback, competitive intelligence, and stakeholder input into ongoing refinements of pitch strategy.
  • Oversee rehearsal plans, executive reviews, and meeting readiness to ensure high-quality delivery.
  • Escalate and resolve challenges proactively while maintaining alignment across leadership and pursuit teams.
  • Provide executive-level updates and recommendations to senior leadership throughout the pursuit process.

 

Qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience in media, marketing, consulting, advertising, ad tech, or growth/new business environments, with increasing responsibility in business development, client strategy, or agency leadership.
  • Proven track record leading successful new business pursuits and managing complex, cross-functional pitch teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and mentoring high-performing teams.
  • Strong understanding of agency operations, commercial development, scoping, staffing models, and financial considerations.
  • Exceptional strategic storytelling, presentation development, and executive communication skills.
  • Deep knowledge of industry trends, media transformation, technology, and competitive market dynamics.
  • Expertise with Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, project management platforms, and collaborative workflow tools.
  • Strong editorial mindset with the ability to synthesize complex information into compelling client narratives.

job.title: Martech Technical Engagement Manager
job.description:
The purpose of this role is to oversee production operations for multi-channel marketing solutions. This role oversees the day to day operations and team supporting the solution and ensures on time and on budget delivery of our production solutions.

Job Description:

The Engagement Lead is one of the ED&D’s primary client-facing owners, who is accountable for bridging delivery execution with strategic advisory, and commercial stewardship. This role owns the ED&D end-to-end client engagement— ensuring delivery excellence, leading the client delivery team (Architects, Data Engineers, Developers, Business Analysts, and Quality Assurance) that supports the solution, deepening relationships (internal and external), identifying (and or leading growth pursuits) growth opportunities, and connecting clients to the broader capabilities of the dentsu organization.


Depending on assignment, this role may have one or more ongoing client engagements, lead project-based work, or do both concurrently. In all engagements the expectation is the same: show up consultatively, own the outcomes, and bring synergy across teams to create genuine value for clients.


Engagement Leads are conversant across modern data and MarTech stacks and can lead value conversations without relying on a technical translator. Data is their lens for every client interaction: understanding how it flows, how it activates, and how it drives measurable customer experience outcomes and business results.

 

Engagement Leads should be familiar with general capabilities such as:

  • Data Platforms: Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric
  • Customer Data Platforms: Adobe Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Data Cloud, Tealium, Segment, Treasure Data, and Hightouch
  • Activation & Orchestration: Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Iterable, Oracle Responsys
  • undefined

Whether embedded in a long-term client relationship or leading a defined scope of work, an Engagement Lead is proactive by default, commercially minded, intellectually curious about clients' businesses, and committed to continuous learning, including hands-on engagement with AI tools as a standard part of how they work.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in client delivery (technology services preferred)
  • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing role with demonstrated relationship ownership
  • Experience supporting or leading technology delivery teams including Business Consultants, Developers, and/or Quality Assurance
  • Experience with or working knowledge of customer data technologies (data platforms, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), identity resolution, or similar)
  • Experience in financial services, insurance, or regulated data environments (including credit bureau and third-party data) is a plus·      
  • Background in financial management: revenue forecasting, margin tracking, resource optimizationBachelor's degree in a related field

Key Responsibilities


Client Ownership & Relationship Development·      

  • Serve as the one of the primary ED&D point of accountability for your assigned client(s) or engagements: covering scope, delivery quality, commercial health, and strategic direction·      
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships at all levels who own or influence technology and data investment decisions·      
  • Drive a structured client communication cadence appropriate to engagement type·      
  • Communicate and consistently demonstrate the value of ED&D engagement, not just what was delivered, but the business impact it enables

Technical Acumen & Consultative Advisory·      

  • Maintain working knowledge of data platforms and activation platforms to credibly lead capability and roadmap conversations·      
  • Translate client business problems into structured data and technology recommendations and bridge business and technical audiences, framing what is possible while grounded in what can realistically be delivered·      
  • Lead or co-lead discovery workshops, business reviews, and strategic planning sessions with client stakeholders·      
  • Understand solution architecture well enough to evaluate design trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and pressure-test recommendations, owning the overall solution narrative while leaving build and configuration to delivery subject matter experts·      
  • Read and interpret technical artifacts, such as architecture diagrams, data flows, integration specs, and data models, to confirm they align with client goals and contracted scope·      
  • Ask the right questions to surface technical risks, dependencies, and feasibility concerns early, before they become delivery issues·      
  • Understand the cost and performance drivers of a solution, including compute, licensing, and resourcing, well enough to guide scope and investment decisions

Delivery Accountability & Team Leadership·      

  • Maintain clear understanding of all contractual commitments for your engagements, including scope, SLAs, deliverables, and financial terms·      
  • Serve as the internal escalation point and external face of accountability when delivery risks arise, resolving proactively rather than reactively·      
  • Coach and empower retained teams and/or pod members (Architects, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and Consultants) to engage directly with clients while retaining overall ownership of the relationship·      
  • Drive consistent application delivery standards, tooling, and ways of working across your accounts and projects
  • Data Governance & Compliance·      
  • Ensure engagements adhere to applicable privacy regulations and client policies, including CCPA/CPRA, other state privacy laws, and consent requirements·      
  • Uphold data security and PII handling standards across the delivery team, partnering with security and privacy teams on access controls and data protection·      
  • Understand the usage restrictions and licensing terms for credit bureau and third-party data (e.g., Experian, Equifax, TransUnion), including FCRA permissible-purpose and prescreen requirements, and ensure data is used only for permitted purposes·      
  • Ensure direct mail and address-related work complies with USPS requirements, including required forms, certifications, and postal regulations·      
  • Support or lead client audits and compliance reviews, particularly for clients in regulated industries such as financial services and insurance

Commercial Growth & Account Expansion·      

  • Partner with the Account Team on commercial health and growth trajectory of your accounts: protect the base through strong renewals and retention, and drive organic expansion into new services, use cases, and platforms·      
  • Take accountability for measurable commercial outcomes appropriate to assignment: renewal rate, account growth, expansion revenue, and margin·      
  • Manage financial performance: revenue forecasting and margin oversight for ongoing accounts; budget tracking and change management for project-based work

Efficiency & AI-Enabled Delivery·      

  • Proactively seek and implement efficiency improvements through people, processes, and technology, including the application of AI tools to accelerate client work and internal delivery·      
  • Use AI as a productivity multiplier: research synthesis, meeting preparation, status reporting, client narrative development, and pattern-spotting·      
  • Stay current on AI capabilities embedded in the platforms your clients operate, and bring informed perspectives on where AI can accelerate their goals·      
  • Pursue continuous learning through hands-on experimentation, not just awareness 

 


At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our hybrid way of working combines remote flexibility with regular in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. job.title: PREDICTIVE Braze Architect
job.description:
The purpose of this role is to develop required software features, achieving timely delivery in compliance with the performance and quality standards of the company.

Job Description:

In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to clients and internal stakeholders alike—translating complex marketing requirements into scalable, high-performing platform solutions. 


Reporting to the Platform Director, you will own the end-to-end technical direction for multiple client engagements, guiding onboarding, solution architecture, and ongoing optimization. You will champion collaboration across account management, operations, and delivery teams, ensuring every solution meets quality, compliance, and performance standards. Success in this role requires more than deep technical knowledge—it demands strong communication, creative problem-solving, and the ability to lead through influence rather than authority. 


What You’ll Do 

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Lead cross-functional teams through the full project lifecycle—from discovery and scoping to launch and post-launch optimization—by setting clear expectations, removing blockers, and fostering accountability. 
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, leading technology discussions with confidence and translating technical concepts into business-friendly language. 
  • Act as a liaison between account management, operations teams, and developer/engineers proactively aligning priorities and ensuring seamless collaboration. 
  • Guide projects through governance processes by balancing time, scope, and compliance considerations while advocating for the best possible client outcome. 

Solution Architecture & Technical Delivery 

  • Gather business, marketing, and technical requirements through active listening and targeted discovery, synthesizing inputs into comprehensive solution designs. 
  • Architect data feeds, platform configurations, and automated campaign workflows that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with client goals. 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve client data feed issues with a resourceful, solutions-oriented mindset—leveraging documentation, platform tools, and peer expertise. 
  • Develop project scoping and estimating guidelines that enable accurate planning and set realistic client expectations. 

Continuous Improvement & Thought Leadership 

  • Stay current on Braze platform updates, cross-channel marketing trends, and emerging third-party integrations, and proactively share insights with the broader team. 
  • Identify patterns in recurring client requests and champion internal process or tooling improvements that raise the bar for the entire organization. 
  • Create, document, and evangelize best practices for the Braze platform, making it easier for teammates to deliver consistent, high-quality work. 
  • Mentor junior team members by sharing technical knowledge, modeling strong client engagement, and providing constructive feedback. 

Who You Are 

You thrive at the intersection of people and technology. You’re the person teammates turn to when the path forward is unclear—not because you have every answer, but because you know how to find it, frame it, and rally others around it. 


Required Qualifications 

  • 3+ years of hands-on architecture experience with the Braze platform. 
  • Demonstrated experience in cross-channel marketing (Email, Push, SMS, Web Push, In-App Messaging). 
  • Prior consulting or client-facing advisory experience. 
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. 

Leadership & Soft Skills 

  • Exceptional communication skills—you can simplify complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders and present with clarity and confidence. 
  • Strong collaborative instincts with a track record of leading cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority. 
  • A resourceful and solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving; you exhaust available tools, documentation, and networks before escalating. 
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and maintain composure under pressure. 
  • A growth mindset—you seek feedback, invest in continuous learning, and help others grow alongside you. 

Nice to Have 

  • Braze certification or equivalent platform credentials. 
  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond Braze (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Klaviyo). 
  • Familiarity with data warehousing, API integrations, or BI/reporting tools commonly used alongside Braze. 
  • Experience mentoring or managing technical consultants.

job.title: Program Director - Temporary Worker
job.description:
Job Description:

**TEMP ROLE   

**12 week assignment (early 2027)

**Hourly,  Non-Exempt on Dentsu Payroll, W2   

**Remote or Hybrid depending on Location  

**Work in EST Time Zone with some flexibility 

**Travel: Possibly  

**Must be US Based    

 

Company Description   

Merkle, a dentsu company, powers the experience economy. For more than 35 years, the company has put people at the heart of its approach to digital business transformation. As the only integrated experience consultancy in the world with a heritage in data science and business performance, Merkle delivers holistic, end-to-end experiences that drive growth, engagement, and loyalty. Merkle's expertise has earned recognition as a "Leader" by top industry analyst firms, in categories such as digital transformation and commerce, experience design, engineering and technology integration, digital marketing, data science, CRM and loyalty, and customer data management. With more than 16,000 employees, Merkle operates in 30+ countries throughout the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.   

 

Job Description   

Position Overview   

We are seeking an experienced Temporary Program Director to lead transformational marketing initiatives for our premier client portfolio while driving excellence across our program management practice. This senior leadership position requires a strategic and operationally sophisticated professional who can oversee one or more high-stakes programs, develop organizational capabilities, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. The ideal candidate brings deep marketing expertise, proven team leadership, and the ability to deliver exceptional results in fast-paced, complex agency environments serving both domestic and international markets.   

 

Key Responsibilities   

Program Portfolio Leadership   

  • Direct a portfolio of enterprise-level marketing programs for 1 or more Fortune 500 clients   
  • Define program vision, objectives, and success criteria in collaboration with client executives and agency leadership   
  • Establish comprehensive program roadmaps that integrate multiple workstreams across digital transformation, customer experience, data analytics, and technology implementations   
  • Ensure programs align with client business strategies and deliver measurable ROI and business impact   
  • Lead program steering committees with senior client stakeholders, facilitating strategic decision-making and governance   
  • Manage program interdependencies, risks, and resource conflicts across the portfolio   

Delivery Excellence & Governance   

  • Partner closely with Creative, Strategy, Data & Analytics, Technology, and CRM leadership to ensure integrated program delivery   
  • Oversee end-to-end program execution ensuring deliverables meet quality standards, timelines, and budget parameters   
  • Implement robust governance structures including escalation protocols, change management processes, and risk mitigation strategies   
  • Monitor program health through comprehensive dashboards tracking scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client satisfaction metrics   
  • Conduct regular program health assessments and implement corrective actions to address challenges   
  • Ensure compliance with agency standards, client requirements, and regulatory obligations across all markets   
  • Lead crisis management and issue resolution for high-impact program challenges   
  • Facilitate post-program retrospectives capturing lessons learned and best practices   

Financial & Resource Management   

  • Manage program budgets ensuring profitability targets are achieved   
  • Oversee resource planning and allocation across programs, optimizing utilization and capability deployment   
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and program profitability   

Operational & Process Excellence   

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance delivery quality, team productivity, and client satisfaction   
  • Establish and refine program management methodologies, tools, and templates aligned with industry best practices   
  • Implement and optimize technology platforms supporting program planning, execution, and reporting   
  • Create standardized frameworks for risk management, change control, and quality assurance   

   

Required Qualifications   

Education & Experience   

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or related field required   
  • 12-15 years of progressive program/project management experience in marketing advertising, consulting, or digital agencies is a MUST   
  • 4-6 years of people management experience   
  • Proven track record managing complex programs valued at $5M-$15M+ individually   
  • Extensive experience with enterprise-level clients and multi-year strategic initiatives   
  • Deep understanding of both US and international market dynamics and client expectations   
  • History of delivering programs that drive significant business outcomes and client satisfaction   

Leadership Competencies   

  • Exceptional leadership presence and influencing skills, comfortable engaging with senior executives   
  • Outstanding communication skills across written, verbal, and presentation formats   
  • Experience leading through ambiguity and complexity in matrixed organizations   
  • Demonstrated emotional intelligence and ability to navigate challenging stakeholder situations   

Technical Expertise   

  • Expert-level knowledge of program management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, and hybrid approaches   
  • Advanced proficiency with program management platforms (Monday.com, Workfront, Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar)   
  • Comprehensive knowledge of integrated marketing channels: digital, social, mobile, and email   

Required Qualifications   

  • Agile/Scrum certifications (CSM, SAFe, etc.) in addition to leading teams in Agile methodology  
  • Extensive experience at recognized marketing agencies or top-tier consulting firms. (12-15 years of progressive program/project management experience in marketing advertising, consulting, or digital agencies is a MUST)   
  • Background in management consulting or digital transformation  

  

Additional Information:

strengthen our teams. Many of our employees who live within commuting distance (90 minutes) from one of our Headquarter or Hub Offices (New York, Chicago, Detroit, Los Angeles) are required to work in the office 2-3 days per week including one Team Day. The minimum number of days may vary by office and role. Dentsu may designate other HQ or Hub offices at any time. Those who do not live near an office may be designated as a remote employee, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect you to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office from time to time. 

 

The hourly pay range for this position is $73.32 - $120.00. The hourly pay rate for the successful candidate is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Temporary employees are eligible for paid holidays in accordance with dentsu policy, as well as safe and sick time. This position is not eligible for any other benefits or other compensation.

job.title: Sales and Delivery Architect, Director
job.description:
Job Description:

The Director, Data Engineer – Technical Leadership & Advisory is a senior technical leadership role grounded in Databricks expertise, client advisory, and delivery excellence. You operate fluidly across pre-sales, discovery, and delivery—building deep credibility with clients by listening to technical challenges, sketching solutions in real time, and leading the delivery of complex data transformation programs. You are equally comfortable in a CMO's boardroom discussing data strategy outcomes and in a technical workshop whiteboarding a Databricks architecture with a client's data engineering team.


You bridge the gap between what clients think they need and what they actually need. Your value comes from the combination of hands-on technical depth, clear business communication, and the ability to be present across the full engagement lifecycle. Clients and internal teams seek you out because you understand both the technical constraints and the business outcomes, and you have a track record of delivering on complex programs.


This role is about deepening client relationships through demonstrated credibility, contributing to practice capability in data platforms, and mentoring internal talent. You help shape how Merkle positions and delivers Databricks work—both through the quality of your delivery and through the relationships you build with clients and partners.


Key Responsibilities

Client Advisory & Pre-Sales Solutioning

  • Participate in and lead pre-sales technical engagements (workshops, architecture reviews, assessments, POCs) that help clients understand their data platform needs and Databricks-fit
  • Develop business cases and proposal content that quantifies the value of data platform and Databricks-specific initiatives (ROI, cost avoidance, speed-to-insight, etc.)
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with technical decision-makers (CDOs, data leaders, platform owners) by providing credible, honest technical counsel
  • Contribute to RFP responses and competitive positioning, with focus on technical differentiation and implementation feasibility
  • Listen actively during discovery and delivery for unmet technical needs and opportunities; surface these to Solutions Architects, leadership, and client stakeholders
  • Represent the firm's Databricks capability in client conversations; be a trusted technical voice in strategic discussions

Technical Leadership & Delivery

  • Own the technical relationship with client data leadership and engineering teams; be the trusted voice on architecture, feasibility, and risk
  • Deliver or lead delivery of complex data transformation programs anchored in Databricks environments; ensure technical quality and client satisfaction
  • Collaborate with Solutions Architects to validate and refine technical designs before execution; ensure feasibility assumptions hold in delivery
  • Make day-to-day technical decisions on architecture, platform configuration, data modeling, and tooling within delivery engagements; explain tradeoffs clearly
  • Design and build reusable Databricks implementations, reference architectures, and accelerators that accelerate future engagements
  • Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments; contribute to technical standards and best practices across the team
  • Surface and escalate data quality issues, integration risks, and scope/schedule impacts proactively; propose remediation approaches
  • As applicable, mentor or lead engineers on engagements; contribute to growing team technical capability


Platform Expertise & Thought Leadership

  • Maintain world-class expertise in Databricks: SQL, Python, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, lakehouse patterns, AI/ML integration, and emerging Databricks AI capabilities
  • Stay current on the Databricks product roadmap and emerging capabilities; advise clients on where Databricks is going and what that means for their architecture
  • Evaluate and recommend data platform tooling adjacent to Databricks: cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), orchestration (Airflow, dbt), and consumption patterns
  • Build and maintain Databricks certifications and thought leadership; consider active participation in Databricks communities, user groups, or speaking engagements
  • Contribute to internal knowledge management: playbooks, reference architectures, and best-practice guides that become assets the practice reuses
  • Mentor and develop engineers; elevate their technical and/or client-facing capability


Client-Facing Communication & Advisory

  • Lead technical discovery workshops with C-suite and director-level stakeholders; frame data platform investments in business outcome terms
  • Explain complex Databricks architecture and data engineering decisions to non-technical audiences (CMOs, CFOs, board members) with clarity and business context
  • Produce thought leadership and advisory content: POV papers, assessment frameworks, and capability maturity models that position Merkle and yourself as authorities
  • Represent the firm in client forums, advisory board meetings, and steering committees where data platform strategy is discussed

What Success Looks Like

  • Large, complex Databricks delivery engagements delivered on time, on budget, with high client satisfaction and clear technical governance
  • A reputation within key client accounts as the trusted technical voice—someone clients ask for and rely on to solve complex data infrastructure problems
  • Deep relationships with client technical and business stakeholders; clients and internal teams seek you out for solutioning conversations and technical advice
  • Reusable Databricks implementations, reference architectures, and accelerators that the practice leverages to compress timelines and improve delivery quality
  • Contributions to pre-sales engagements that demonstrate technical credibility and help shape how Merkle positions Databricks capabilities
  • Internal mentorship and knowledge-sharing; engineers grow in technical capability and client-facing confidence through exposure to your work
  • Demonstrable depth in Databricks: current certifications, awareness of product roadmap and emerging capabilities, and ability to articulate why decisions matter
  • Representation of Merkle's Databricks expertise both internally and externally (internal forums, client presentations, vendor conversations)
  • AI tools embedded in your technical workflow and actively used to accelerate delivery and documentation


Qualifications

Required (Core)

  • 8+ years building data platform implementations on cloud data warehouses, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience with Databricks (including SQL, Python, DLT, Unity Catalog, or equivalent scope)
  • Advanced SQL and Python; ability to code production-quality data pipelines without oversight
  • Deep experience with relational and lakehouse data modeling; design of Customer 360 and conformed data models
  • Demonstrated experience participating in and leading complex, multi-phase delivery programs; clear track record of technical delivery success
  • Exceptional client-facing communication skills; comfortable presenting technical concepts to both C-suite and technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to build credibility and trust with client stakeholders across technical and business functions
  • Experience with data observability, pipeline automation, and formal change control in production environments
  • Demonstrated use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) as a regular productivity tool
  • Active use of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure); working knowledge of cloud data architecture

Strongly Preferred

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Professional level) or Databricks Solutions Architect Certification
  • Active engagement with Databricks thought leadership: community participation, conference speaking, or knowledge-sharing
  • Experience with Databricks AI capabilities (Databricks AI Functions, vector search, or Mosaic AI)
  • Experience with governance and Unity Catalog implementation at enterprise scale
  • Hands-on experience with modern data orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, dbt)
  • Contribution to pre-sales / discovery engagements; ability to articulate technical value propositions
  • Experience with adjacent platforms: Adobe AEP/RTCDP, Salesforce Data Cloud, or cloud analytics platforms
  • Mentoring experience; track record of growing junior engineers' technical and/or client-facing skills

Cultural / Behavioral

  • Growth mindset: genuine curiosity about client business problems and appetite for learning new platforms and use cases
  • Advisory orientation: comfortable with ambiguity, comfortable offering recommendations even with imperfect information, comfortable taking educated risk in solutioning
  • Collaborative leadership: mentors and elevates team members; shares knowledge freely; does not hoard expertise
  • Bias toward clarity: produces clear documentation, architecture diagrams, and business case narratives; commits to making complexity accessible
  • Client advocate: willing to push back on aggressive timelines or scope while remaining collaborative; escalates issues early rather than late

job.title: Salesforce Data 360 Architect
job.description:
Job Description:

Key Responsibilities:

  • You'll lead the full implementation lifecycle of Salesforce Data Cloud, from data acquisition and integration to quality assurance, activation, and ongoing use.
  • You'll design and document scalable and robust solutions on-site with clients, translating business requirements into detailed technical tasks for offshore development teams.
  • You'll serve as the primary technical expert for offshore resources, providing hands-on support, troubleshooting complex issues, and ensuring high-quality deliverables.
  • You'll develop and execute sophisticated data-driven segmentation strategies to enable precise audience targeting and personalized customer journeys.
  • You'll design, document, and implement comprehensive data models, pipelines, and transformations to support data ingestion, integration, and enrichment within Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • You will act as a subject matter expert on Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud Personalization (MCP), and the evolving Salesforce Personalization (Einstein Personalization) landscape.
  • You'll integrate data from diverse sources, including Salesforce Sales and Service Clouds, various databases, and third-party platforms, to create a unified customer profile and support advanced marketing and personalization efforts.
  • You will actively participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, contribute to practice development, and lead internal proof-of-concept (POC) projects and demo builds.
  • You'll guide and support junior-level resources within the offshore team, fostering their technical growth and ensuring adherence to best practices.
  • Stay current with the Salesforce release cycles and emerging industry trends, particularly in AI and cloud technologies, to provide innovative solutions.

Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 5 years of overall experience in a technical role, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience focused on Salesforce Data Cloud and/or custom database solutions.
  • Proven hands-on experience with other Salesforce core products, particularly Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (MCP/Evergage) is highly desirable, along with a proven ability to transfer skills to the new Salesforce Personalization platform.
  • A deep understanding of marketing automation, data segmentation, personalized customer journeys, decisioning, and Next Best Action strategies.
  • Expertise in data modeling, ETL processes, data integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, Informatica), and SQL proficiency.
  • Strong working knowledge of core Salesforce platform concepts such as Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Apex.
  • Experience with Data Actions and Flow integrations, along with API utilization for seamless data exchange.
  • Familiarity with broader cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and data warehousing platforms (e.g., Snowflake) is a significant advantage.
  • Additional Salesforce certifications, particularly the Agentforce Specialist credential, would be a major advantage given the current AI boom.
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Marketing, or comparable work experience.

This is a remote position with up to 25% travel. You will be reporting to the architect—decisioning director. You will not have managerial responsibilities.

job.title: Senior Manager, Retail Media Growth & Ad Operations
job.description:
Job Description:

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Manager, Retail Media Growth & Ad Operations to grow non-endemic advertiser investment in retail media networks (RMNs) and commerce media networks (CMNs), and to build the ad operations that let that growth scale.


This role is part retail media analyst, part ad operations architect. You'll build the case for why brands should invest in retail media, and you'll design the campaign workflows, self-serve enablement, and playbooks that make execution seamless across RMNs and CMNs.


You'll report to the Group Director, Commerce & Retail Media, and partner with dentsu's Audiences, Analytics, and Account Management teams, agency media planners and buyers, and retail and commerce media network partners.


What you'll do: Non-endemic retail media growth & insights

  • Build the business case for non-endemic brands to invest in retail media networks, using sales lift, incrementality, closed-loop attribution, and retail media market trends.
  • Run audience overlap analysis with dentsu's Audiences team, matching advertiser customer bases to retailer loyalty and first-party shopper data, including in clean rooms such as Amazon Marketing Cloud and LiveRamp.
  • Turn retail media performance and audience data into POVs that give agency media planners clear reasons to shift budget from other channels into RMNs and CMNs.
  • Contribute retail media insights to pitches, POVs, and expansion strategies for retail and commerce media clients.
  • Track the retail media landscape, including new networks, ad products, offsite and in-store formats, and non-endemic advertiser demand.

What you'll do: Retail media ad operations & platform enablement

  • Design scalable retail media ad operations workflows across managed-service and self-serve advertising products, from campaign intake and insertion orders through trafficking, pacing, and reporting.
  • Audit current campaign setup and delivery processes and find ways to simplify, standardize, and automate them across retail media teams.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize ad platform enhancements and improve self-serve usability, based on what campaign teams see day to day.
  • Write ad ops playbooks, campaign QA checklists, and runbooks that make retail media execution consistent across networks.
  • Use automation, AI, and ad tech tooling to improve campaign operations efficiency.
  • Lead adoption of new retail media workflows and platform features, including documentation and training for media teams.

What you'll do: Cross-functional partnership & storytelling

  • Turn retail media performance data and ad ops challenges into clear narratives that shape media budget decisions.
  • Build data visualizations and POVs for agency media planners and retail media network partners, focused on clear takeaways over dense reporting.
  • Show media, analytics, and account teams how better data and ad operations drive retail media revenue.
  • Influence without direct authority across dentsu's Audiences, Analytics, and Account Management teams, Product and Engineering, and agency partners.
  • Flag ad operations risks, workflow gaps, and platform dependencies to leadership, with scalable fixes.

What you'll bring

  • A systems thinker who sees both the retail media strategy and the ad operations behind it.
  • A data storyteller who explains retail media performance simply to media planners and non-technical audiences.
  • A cross-functional influencer who aligns media, ad tech, and client-facing teams without direct authority.
  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and emerging ad tech, and eagerness to apply them to media operations.
  • Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-changing retail media market, plus the discipline to build structure around it.
  • Genuine interest in non-endemic retail media and how brands outside a retailer's core categories create value for its media network.

Required qualifications

  • 3–6+ years in digital media or advertising, with at least 2 years in retail media, commerce media, or shopper marketing, on the agency, ad platform, retailer, or media network side.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major retail media network, such as Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Roundel (Target), Kroger Precision Marketing, Instacart Ads, or Albertsons Media Collective.
  • A track record of building retail media performance narratives that moved media budget.
  • Experience designing or scaling ad operations or campaign workflows in retail media, eCommerce advertising, or digital media.
  • Experience leading process improvement within a media, ad tech, or advertising operations team.
  • Comfort with audience data, overlap analysis, and retailer first-party data; loyalty data and clean-room experience a plus.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling to or planning for non-endemic advertisers on a retail media network.
  • Experience with retail media tools and measurement partners such as Pacvue, Skai, Criteo, Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud, LiveRamp, or Nielsen and Circana sales lift studies.
  • Background in sports, retail, travel, or hospitality media networks, such as an airline, convenience-store, or venue media network.
  • Familiarity with loyalty-driven retail media monetization models.
  • Experience supporting self-serve advertising products or ad platform operations.
  • Experience with automation or AI-enabled ad operations workflows.
  • Knowledge of ad servers, order management systems, and campaign management platforms.

Support the SEO team with the implementation of recommendations across client websites. This is an entry-level role designed for someone who is organised, curious and keen to build a career in SEO.
