job.title: Account Strategist
job.description:
Job Title

Account Strategist

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements



  • Respond to RFPs, develop media plans in line with strategic marketing goals.
  • Execute and implement advertising campaigns to ensure delivery and performance. Includes taking a leadership role to coordinate efforts between other cross-functional teams as necessary to implement custom elements.
  • Embody white glove service to our clients and serve as the internal and external point of contact for execution, particularly in post-sale
  • Work with Ad Operations to ensure clients’ ads are trafficked, monitored, and optimized.
  • Maximize campaign performance and company revenue by liaising with RevOps to further increase success rate and renew/grow current business.
  • Update contract management system with campaign change orders (campaign delays, optimizations, etc.) and alert team of changes that will affect revenue.



Hybrid 3x a week- (NYC) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week in New York City - Office is 225 Liberty




About The Team | The Team and/or Brand

The Account Strategy team consists of seven account strategists within People Inc.’s Beauty & Style revenue team. We partner daily with Sales, Marketing, Production, and cross-functional teams to develop strategic media plans and bring advertising campaigns to life. From proposal development through campaign reporting, we connect client objectives with execution, delivering exceptional service, strong campaign performance, and opportunities for continued growth.



About The Positions Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


60% — Campaign Management & Client Service


Manage advertising campaigns from kickoff through completion, serving as the primary contact for clients and internal partners throughout execution. Coordinate deliverables, timelines, and approvals across Production, Ad Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure timely launches and fulfillment of campaign commitments. Monitor pacing and performance, proactively address risks, recommend optimizations, and develop reporting that translates results into actionable insights. Maintain accurate campaign records and communicate changes affecting delivery or revenue.


40% — Strategic Media Planning & Account Growth


Partner with Sales and Marketing to respond to RFPs and develop media plans aligned with client objectives, budgets, and campaign KPIs. Ensure proposals reflect accurate pricing, available products, and executable deliverables. Apply campaign learnings to strengthen recommendations, identify renewal and incremental revenue opportunities, and support long-term client relationships.

All other duties as assigned.


The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education: 

  • 4-year degree required; marketing or business degree preferred. Additional digital marketing or sales experience may substitute for education on a year-for-year basis.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of marketing, sales and/or account management experience; including one year of digital advertising experience required. Project management experience is a plus.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Possess excellent organizational, interpersonal, and influential written and verbal communication skills. Ability to quickly form relationships usually by telephone or email.
  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally; ability to exercise judgment and flexibility in balancing program requirements, milestones, and keeping people and projects moving on schedule.
  • High attention to detail. Strong analytical, quantitative and strategic problem solving. Excellent grammar, spelling and proofreading skills.
  • Positive and confident disposition when responding to frequent deadlines for multiple customers (internal and external).
  • High degree of proficiency in MS Office products. 
  • Ability to quickly build positive team relationships.
  • Be able to think strategically and act tactically.
  • Average deal size is $100K+, and majority of accounts assigned would be campaigns we’d expect renewals on. 

% Travel Required (Approximate): <5 %


It is the policy of People Inc. to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing hr@people.inc.

The Company participates in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For further information about the E-Verify program, please click here: https://www.e-verify.gov/employees

Pay Range

Salary: New York: $75,000.00 - $90,000.00

The pay range above represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position and may change in the future. Actual pay may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of People Inc's total compensation package for employees. Other compensation may include annual bonuses, and short- and long-term incentives. In addition, People Inc. provides to employees (and their eligible family members) a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, unlimited paid time off (PTO), adoption or surrogate assistance, donation matching, tuition reimbursement, basic life insurance, basic accidental death & dismemberment, supplemental life insurance, supplemental accident insurance, commuter benefits, short term and long term disability, health savings and flexible spending accounts, family care benefits, a generous 401K savings plan with a company match program, 10-12 paid holidays annually, and generous paid parental leave (birthing and non-birthing parents), all of which may vary depending on the specific nature of your employment with People Inc. and your work location. We also offer voluntary benefits such as pet insurance, accident, critical and hospital indemnity health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance.

job.title: Art Director
job.description:
Job Title

Art Director

Job Description

People Inc. is the largest digital and print publisher in America. From mobile to magazines, nearly 200 million people trust us to help them make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. has more than 40 iconic brands, including PEOPLE, Entertainment Weekly, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, Food & Wine, The Spruce, Allrecipes, Byrdie, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, and Southern Living. We are building engaging experiences that excite users and amplify the voices of our brands.


We are seeking an Art Director — New Initiatives to work closely with the Senior Creative Director and partners across marketing, editorial, product, commerce, and growth. This new role specializes in branding and marketing design for paid memberships and premium products, including Southern Living Insiders, as well as other cross-brand and net-new initiatives. The Art Director will help develop distinctive identities, launch campaigns, and scalable creative systems that express the value of premium experiences and engage audiences across channels.


As Art Director — New Initiatives, you will be responsible for leading the visual development and execution of high-visibility, high-value initiatives from concept through launch and ongoing optimization. You will create and evolve identity systems, premium brand expressions, and integrated marketing campaigns; translate strategy into clear, compelling creative; and provide flexible senior-level design capacity that can shift as organizational priorities change.


Responsibilities

Own assigned branding, campaign, and premium product design projects from brief through launch and ongoing optimization, following established processes to ensure smooth delivery of creative assets.

Partner with the Senior Creative Director to establish the visual direction for Southern Living Insiders and other priority initiatives, ensuring execution is distinctive, premium, and consistent across teams and channels.

Lead the creation of identity systems, launch assets, integrated marketing campaigns, and scalable toolkits and templates that work cohesively across digital experiences, editorial touchpoints, and promotional channels.

Collaborate with marketing, editorial, product design, commerce, growth, and cross-brand partners to translate business goals and audience insights into effective creative.

Build and maintain identity guidelines and creative systems, and continually optimize work using campaign performance, audience learning, and stakeholder feedback.


II. Essential Job Functions


Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


30%

Creative Direction

Provide creative direction for Southern Living Insiders and other new initiatives; communicate brand standards clearly and ensure a consistently premium level of execution across internal teams and external partners.


30%

Design

Use business requirements, audience insights, and stakeholder feedback to design premium visual assets, including identity systems, launch materials, integrated marketing campaigns, static and motion creative, and reusable templates.


30%

Collaborate Across Marketing, Editorial, Product, Commerce, and Growth

Lead the visual direction for launches, acquisition and retention campaigns, audience engagement, editorial integrations, and cross-brand initiatives.

Present strategic design concepts and solutions, articulate the rationale behind the work, and build consensus among a broad range of stakeholders.

Help build and maintain a collaborative, inclusive, and creatively ambitious culture within the design team.

Lead and participate in brainstorming and critique sessions that foster big-picture thinking, strengthen concepts, and raise the bar on craft and premium brand expression.


10%

Process Management

Keep project plans and tickets up to date, communicate progress and dependencies, maintain organized files and reusable assets, monitor stakeholder feedback, and meet deadlines across multiple concurrent initiatives.


III. Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements | All must be met to be considered.


Education:

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent education and experience


Experience:

3–5 years as an Art Director and 5–10 years as a designer, with experience leading brand and marketing work from concept through execution


Specific Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Strong typography skills

Strong integrated brand and marketing campaign design skills

Strong identity system and brand guideline development skills

Working knowledge of motion graphics

Proficient in Figma

Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, including Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects, and Premiere

Experience in publishing, media, membership, subscription, or other premium consumer products

A portfolio demonstrating brand identities, premium product launches, and integrated marketing campaigns

Self-directed, adaptable, and comfortable moving between priority initiatives

Strong attention to detail

Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills

A collaborative team player ready to work in a fast-paced, matrixed environment

It is the policy of People Inc. to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing hr@people.inc.

The Company participates in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For further information about the E-Verify program, please click here: https://www.e-verify.gov/employees

Pay Range

Salary: New York: $90,000 - $110,000 Washington: $90,000 - $110,000

Actual pay may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. job.title: Associate Brand Director, Walmart
job.description:
Job Title

Associate Brand Director, Walmart

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

The Associate Brand Director, Walmart will play a key role within People Inc.’s Business Management team supporting the Better Homes & Gardens collection at Walmart (BHGxWalmart), with primary responsibility for the strategy and business management of designated product categories.This role will develop deep expertise across assigned categories, building strong relationships throughout the Walmart merchant organization and serving as a primary BHG business partner to drive category performance and growth. Working within the broader strategy and priorities of the BHGxWalmart business, the Senior Brand Manager will connect business performance, consumer and marketplace insights, product and assortment strategy, and cross-functional partners to translate broader objectives into category-specific strategies and actions.


In-office Expectations: This position is remote and based in Bentonville, Arkansas, with no regular People Inc. in-office requirements. The role is expected to maintain an active presence with Walmart partners in the Bentonville area, including in-person meetings and business activities as needed. Occasional travel to People Inc. offices and other business locations will also be required.


About The Team | The Team and/or Brand.

The BHGxWalmart Business Management team sits within People Inc.’s Brand Development organization and supports the Better Homes & Gardens licensed collection at Walmart. The team partners closely with Walmart, external product development partners, and cross-functional People Inc. teams to drive business growth, strengthen the BHG brand, and identify opportunities across the product portfolio.


About The Positions Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


Category Strategy & Business Management (30%)

  • Lead the strategy and ongoing business management of designated BHGxWalmart categories, developing deep expertise in performance, assortment dynamics, product pipelines and Walmart priorities.
  • Evaluate sales, inventory, distribution, digital performance and assortment productivity to identify key business drivers, risks and opportunities.
  • Translate broader BHGxWalmart strategies and objectives into clear category-specific priorities and action plans.
  • Develop a strong point of view on where assigned categories should grow, evolve or improve based on business performance, consumer insights and marketplace dynamics.
  • Maintain visibility across assortment changes, product launches, distribution shifts and other developments impacting category performance.

Walmart Merchant & Partner Management (25%)

  • Serve as a primary BHG business-management partner for designated categories, building strong relationships throughout the Walmart merchant organization.
  • Lead category-level conversations with Walmart merchant partners, developing a deep understanding of their priorities, strategies, challenges and growth objectives.
  • Build productive relationships with external product development partners, creating connectivity across Walmart, People Inc. and external teams around shared category priorities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to advance Walmart category goals and the BHG business, elevating significant opportunities, risks and decisions to Business Management leadership.

Product, Assortment & Consumer Strategy (25%)

  • Represent the business and brand perspective throughout the product development lifecycle, partnering with Walmart merchants and external product development teams on category strategies, assortment plans and future opportunities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of consumer needs, competitive activity and marketplace trends within assigned categories.
  • Partner with People Inc. Research & Insights to identify knowledge gaps and translate consumer, competitive, digital and business insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Identify assortment gaps, priority products, whitespace opportunities and areas for innovation or expansion.
  • Help ensure product and assortment decisions support Walmart business objectives and BHG brand positioning.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Brand Stewardship (20%)

  • Lead and influence cross-functional partners around assigned category strategies, opportunities and business priorities.
  • Serve as a central Business Management connector across People Inc. teams, including Research & Insights, Marketing, Creative, Editorial and Digital/PDP.
  • Translate category opportunities into clear business priorities that inform marketing, content, creative, digital and other brand support.
  • Lead category-level preparation for key Walmart meetings, business reviews, development discussions and strategic planning sessions.
  • Partner with the Associate Brand Manager on operational inputs and maintain visibility with Business Management leadership around major category developments, decisions, risks and opportunities.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:


Education:

Bachelor’s degree preferred in Business, Marketing, Merchandising, Retail, or a related field and/or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in brand management, retail merchandising, category management, account management, licensing, consumer products, or a related brand- or retail-focused role.
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing relationships with key retail, brand, and/or external business partners.
  • Experience managing or influencing category strategy, assortment decisions, business performance, and/or growth initiatives.
  • Experience working within or directly supporting a major omnichannel retailer strongly preferred.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Strong commercial and business acumen, with an understanding of retail merchandising, category dynamics, assortment strategy and product development.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to connect category-level details and opportunities to broader brand and business objectives.
  • Strong consumer orientation with the ability to incorporate consumer research, marketplace trends and competitive intelligence into business decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional workstreams and influence partners without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage multiple categories, initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into a clear business point of view.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external organizations.


% Travel Required (Approximate): 5%


It is the policy of People Inc. to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing hr@people.inc.

The Company participates in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For further information about the E-Verify program, please click here: https://www.e-verify.gov/employees

Pay Range

Salary: Remote: $90,000.00 - $110,000.00

The pay range above represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position and may change in the future. Actual pay may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of People Inc's total compensation package for employees. Other compensation may include annual bonuses, and short- and long-term incentives. In addition, People Inc. provides to employees (and their eligible family members) a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, unlimited paid time off (PTO), adoption or surrogate assistance, donation matching, tuition reimbursement, basic life insurance, basic accidental death & dismemberment, supplemental life insurance, supplemental accident insurance, commuter benefits, short term and long term disability, health savings and flexible spending accounts, family care benefits, a generous 401K savings plan with a company match program, 10-12 paid holidays annually, and generous paid parental leave (birthing and non-birthing parents), all of which may vary depending on the specific nature of your employment with People Inc. and your work location. We also offer voluntary benefits such as pet insurance, accident, critical and hospital indemnity health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance.

Job Title

Associate Manager, Brand Communications

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 

This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.


The Associate Manager, Brand Communications supports the development and execution of integrated communications strategies that elevate People Inc.'s Entertainment, Beauty & Style brands, with a primary focus on PEOPLE. This role partners cross-functionally with editorial, social, events, and external stakeholders to drive media visibility, cultivate key relationships, support high-profile editorial franchises, and execute high-impact communications initiatives that support business objectives. 


The Associate Manager contributes to strategic communications planning while ensuring seamless execution of day-to-day PR initiatives, expanding the reach and cultural relevance of the PEOPLE brands.


About The Team: | The Team and/or Brand.

____________________________________________________________________________________________

This role is part of the Brand Communications team for People Inc.’s Entertainment, Beauty, and Style brands which include PEOPLE, InStyle, Entertainment Weekly, and Byrdie. This team is responsible for developing and executing communications strategies that elevate editorial content, talent, business initiatives, events, partnerships, and brand moments across consumer, trade, broadcast, digital, social, and industry media.



About The Positions  Contributions:

Weight %

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

60%

Support and execute communications strategies that promote PEOPLE's editorial content, brand initiatives, and talent through proactive media relations, strategic outreach, relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration.

25%

Coordinate and support media appearances, editorial launches, events, and other high-impact communications initiatives by managing logistics, materials, external partners, and execution to ensure successful outcomes.

15%

Contribute to communications planning and team operations by monitoring media coverage, identifying opportunities, developing communications materials, supporting reporting and administrative processes, and collaborating on strategic initiatives that advance business goals.




The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent communications experience.


Experience:


2-4  years experience

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:


– Superior written and verbal communication skills.

– Understanding of the media landscape, effective media relations practices and identifying what makes news and why.

– Knowledge of entertainment media including areas of celebrity, pop culture, etc..

– Comfortable working both independently of others and as a team player

– Strong knowledge of social media

– Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

– Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and solution-focused with strong critical thinking skills.

job.title: Graphic Designer, Brand Development
job.description:
Job Title

Graphic Designer, Brand Development

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements


Summary 

People Inc.’s Brand Development team is seeking a talented and motivated graphic designer to join our creative team. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with the team to design and execute compelling visual communications across a variety of platforms, including print, social media, digital content, and presentation decks.


This is an opportunity for an enthusiastic, detail-oriented designer to contribute to and help evolve the visual execution of a growing business through collaboration on design solutions including typography, photography, and conceptual ideas. The ideal candidate is passionate about design, stays ahead of current industry, social, and market trends, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


This is a unique opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking team where your creativity and ideas will help drive the success of leading lifestyle brands.



Hybrid 3x a week- (Des Moines) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.



About The Team | The Team and/or Brand.

The Brand Development department supports licensing functions across People Inc.’s brands. Our work includes product licensing, asset licensing, international media and branded services and experiences. 



About The Positions Contributions:

The Graphic Designer, Brand Development works collaboratively with the design and social production teams to concept, develop and execute creative for the Better Homes & Gardens Collection at Walmart. With a primary focus on graphic design, this role creates engaging, on-brand assets across digital, social, web and print channels.


Reporting to the Associate Creative Director, Brand Development, this role manages multiple design projects, adapts creative to platform specifications and responds to business needs in collaboration with fellow designers, Social Content Producers and cross-functional partners. The role requires strong design skills, attention to detail, and the ability to carry concepts through execution while incorporating feedback and meeting deadlines. The Graphic Designer also contributes to social content production as needed, including brainstorming, capturing content and editing video to tell compelling product stories.

People Inc. is seeking an experienced and strategic Principal Product Manager to lead initiatives across our Health portfolio, with a focus on product innovation, healthcare professional experiences, and companion apps. In this role, you’ll own the product strategy and roadmap for key experiences that help audiences take action on their health and create new opportunities for business growth.


As a senior individual contributor, you’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data science, editorial, marketing, and commercial teams to build intuitive, trusted, and innovative experiences that drive engagement and deepen loyalty.



Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY)

Weight %

25% - Product Leadership

  • An understanding of privacy and audience trust considerations in health-related products.

job.title: Senior Enterprise Security Engineer
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Enterprise Security Engineer

Job Description

People Inc is looking for a Senior Enterprise Security Engineer with a demonstrated track record of innovative thinking, technical expertise, and execution. You’ll be responsible for maintaining (and raising) the security posture across our infrastructure and end-user SaaS applications and endpoints, designing and implementing enterprise security solutions, and reducing toil through automation.


As a highly visible professional within the Security team, you will be responsible for helping to set technical direction for enterprise security, managing technical projects, and partner with other groups within the organization to deliver tools and services that align with our security roadmaps.


Remote or Hybrid 3x a month 

In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance to one of our offices in New York, Des Moines, Birmingham, Los Angeles, orChicago, the expectation is to work from the office three times per month.


About the Position's Contributions:

Security Engineering

  • Harden systems for cyber resilience including Operating Systems, and Network Devices and SaaS platforms
  • Architect and design log management systems to collect security events across multiple log sources
  • Perform orchestration and automated response (SOAR)
  • Oversee vulnerability remediation

Architecture And Design

  • Provide technical leadership and oversight to security architecture activities and initiatives
  • Define security architecture roadmaps and/or strategy
  • Determine security requirements and security controls
  • Provide design and oversight into identity and access management (IAM)
  • Perform threat modeling and reporting

Data Loss Prevention

  • Provide technical leadership and oversight to data loss prevention activities and initiatives
  • Develop and implement strategies for Data Loss Prevention and architect and design DLP solutions and technologies
  • Perform risk assessments to identify gaps in DLP coverage

Identity And Access Management (IAM)

  • Architect and design IAM solutions and technologies including Single Sign On (SSO), Multi-factor authentication, Password-less authentication
  • Evaluate and inspect current IAM access permissions to verify their ongoing necessity
  • Conduct risk-based analysis of users and groups across the enterprise and cloud infrastructure

Compliance

  • Oversee adherence to internal policies or standards
  • Understanding various compliance standards
  • Interpret standards, requirements and their application to the enterprise environment
  • Provide leadership, guidance and subject matter expertise to compliance and audit teams
  • Recommend, document and monitor the implementation of any prescribed corrective actions resulting from risk assessments

About You:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security with 3+ years of experience as a Security Engineer with a focus on securing end user SaaS applications, user endpoints, and associated infrastructure.
  • Experience with hardening infrastructure including network devices, and operating systems.
  • Experience deploying and customizing security tools.
  • Fluent in one or more modern coding languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, etc.).
  • Experience with one or more infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
  • Experience with one of the major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with one or more authentication technologies (Okta, Keycloak).
  • Experience with one or more LLM/GCP technologies (ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, Google Gemini, etc.)

Interpersonal Skills

  • Passion for enterprise security and continuous learning.
  • Able to concisely communicate security risks to both technical and business audiences.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, and as part of a team.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize work effectively.

job.title: Senior Identity & Access Management Engineer
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Identity & Access Management Engineer

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Identity & Access Management Engineer to join the SaaS Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of automations within Okta and other SaaS applications, primarily using Okta Workflows. You will play a key role in streamlining identity and access management processes, improving operational efficiency, and enhancing security.

About The Team: | The Team and/or Brand.

The SaaS Management team is responsible for the overall health, optimization, and security of our core SaaS applications. This includes managing and maintaining critical services like Google Workspace, Okta, Jira, Slack, and Identity Management platforms. The team ensures seamless user experiences, efficient workflows, and cost-effectiveness across these applications. A key focus is automating processes to streamline operations, improve productivity, and enhance security across our SaaS landscape. This involves implementing and managing automations that simplify user onboarding/offboarding, license management, and other key tasks. Through all of this, the team strives to provide a delightful experience for our users, empowering them to do their best work.


About The Positions  Contributions:

Weight % - Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


30%: Manage and maintain the Okta Identity Cloud environment, including user lifecycle management, application integrations, and security policies.


30%: Design, develop, and deploy complex Okta Workflows to automate various identity and access management tasks (e.g., user provisioning, de-provisioning, group management, password resets, multi-factor authentication).
Continuously analyze and optimize existing Okta automations for efficiency, reliability, and scalability. Integrate Okta with other systems and applications using Okta APIs and connectors.


10%: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for Okta automations and processes.


10%: Provide support and troubleshooting for Okta-related issues, including workflow failures, user access problems, and integration errors.


20%: Adhere to security best practices and industry standards in the design and implementation of Okta automations. Keep up-to-date with the latest Okta features, updates, and best practices. Ensure the Okta data is backed and readily available for restorations in emergencies  Foster close collaboration with application owners and teams to ensure seamless integration.


The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education: BA/BS Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering or Information Technology or relevant work experience.


Experience:

5+ years of industry experience in Identity and Access Management.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Deep understanding of Universal Directory (user/group management, directory integration), Single Sign-On (SSO) configuration (SAML, OIDC, WS-Federation), and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
  • Ability to design and build highly complex, multi-step workflows with conditional logic, loops, and error handling. 
  • Expertise in using Okta's built-in connectors and creating custom connectors to integrate with other systems and APIs.
  • Deep understanding of Okta's workflow functions for data manipulation, transformations, and system interactions.
  • Ability to analyze and optimize workflow performance for efficiency and scalability.
  • Experience with managing workflow versions, testing changes, and deploying updates in a controlled manner.
  • Advanced skills in working with Okta's APIs for automation and integration with other systems.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages like JavaScript for extending Okta's functionality and creating custom integrations.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform) for managing Okta configurations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to diagnose and resolve complex Okta-related issues.
  • Expertise in troubleshooting Okta workflows, SSO integrations, and other identity management challenges.
  • Ability to analyze Okta system logs to identify root causes of issues and performance bottlenecks.
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for Okta configurations, workflows, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with IT teams, HR teams, developers, and business stakeholders.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in Identity and Access Management.
  • Possess strong regular expression (Regex) skills for data manipulation and pattern matching.
  • Okta Certifications or/and other industry certifications

% Travel Required (Approximate): 0%

job.title: Senior Social Media Editor, Travel + Leisure
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Social Media Editor, Travel + Leisure

Job Description

Travel + Leisure is seeking a dynamic, creative, and entrepreneurial Senior Social Media Editor to help shape the next generation of social-first storytelling for the world's leading travel media brand: someone whose algorithm and Explore page are filled with extraordinary destinations, emerging experiences, unexpected discoveries, and the creators bringing them to life.


We're looking for someone with the imagination and entrepreneurial drive to turn original ideas into recognizable video franchises. The Senior Social Media Editor must be deeply immersed in social culture, understand the global creator ecosystem, and know what people are watching today—while possessing the creative instincts to develop what new audiences will want to watch tomorrow. Equal parts editorial storyteller, on-camera personality, creative strategist, and franchise builder, this person should understand how entertainment works on social: the personalities people follow, the formats they return to, and the humor, storytelling, and cultural moments that build fandom.


The ideal candidate should be comfortable on camera and understand how to bring out the best in other personalities. While trusted service journalism and destination expertise remain at the heart of our brand, we're looking to expand our storytelling with more humor, spontaneity, and personality—bringing more of the lifestyle and leisure into Travel + Leisure.


The Senior Social Media Editor will collaborate closely with the editor in chief, editorial, social, video, audience development, and commercial teams to build original franchises, identify emerging creators, and expand the brand's reach across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other evolving platforms. They should be nimble, deadline-oriented, and constantly discovering new talent, experimenting with formats, and translating what is happening in the wider social ecosystem into fresh ideas for T+L.


Our Culture: All Travel + Leisure team members are expected to be enthusiastic, entrepreneurial self-starters who embrace experimentation and change; actively seek out new ideas, opportunities, and creative talent; and are eager to grow alongside the brand as it evolves its storytelling.


Location: New York, NY.

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid and requires working in the New York City office three days per week, with the ability to work remotely up to two days per week.


About The Position's Contributions

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


35% — Original Franchise Development & Creative Strategy:

  • Lead the ideation, piloting, production, and evolution of original social-first video franchises that combine travel, culture, entertainment, service, humor, and personality.
  • Develop distinctive, repeatable formats with recognizable hosts, recurring characters, and storytelling that encourages audiences to return for the next episode. Think beyond traditional destination coverage to create original entertainment that can build fandom, attract new audiences, and potentially evolve into larger commercial franchises.
  • Bring an entrepreneurial approach to testing concepts, identifying emerging talent, evaluating performance, and scaling the ideas that resonate.

30% — Content Production & Editorial Oversight:

  • Produce and oversee compelling, platform-native social content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and emerging platforms.
  • Maintain T+L's editorial standards while bringing new energy, creativity, and personality to the feed. Collaborate with junior team members on daily publishing, production, and execution, providing mentorship and editorial guidance while maintaining an active role in high-priority content creation.

20% — Talent Discovery & On-Camera Storytelling:

  • Identify and develop compelling on-camera personalities, including T+L editors, local creators, emerging influencers, and established talent.
  • Appear on camera to host interviews, report from destinations and events, and contribute to original video franchises. Help cultivate recognizable voices and recurring personalities who can build lasting relationships with audiences.

15% — Audience Intelligence, Analytics & Platform Innovation:

  • Stay ahead of emerging travel trends, creators, cultural moments, and platform behaviors.
  • Analyze video performance, audience engagement, and emerging formats to inform creative strategy and identify opportunities for growth.
  • Experiment with new storytelling techniques and platform features, translating insights into actionable ideas for the broader editorial and social teams.

The Role's Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements


Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in social media, digital editorial, video production, or content creation, preferably within a media brand, publisher, travel, hospitality, or lifestyle organization.

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Social Media Editor, Travel + Leisure

Job Description

Travel + Leisure is seeking a dynamic, creative, and entrepreneurial Senior Social Media Editor to help shape the next generation of social-first storytelling for the world's leading travel media brand: someone whose algorithm and Explore page are filled with extraordinary destinations, emerging experiences, unexpected discoveries, and the creators bringing them to life.


We're looking for someone with the imagination and entrepreneurial drive to turn original ideas into recognizable video franchises. The Senior Social Media Editor must be deeply immersed in social culture, understand the global creator ecosystem, and know what people are watching today—while possessing the creative instincts to develop what new audiences will want to watch tomorrow. Equal parts editorial storyteller, on-camera personality, creative strategist, and franchise builder, this person should understand how entertainment works on social: the personalities people follow, the formats they return to, and the humor, storytelling, and cultural moments that build fandom.


The ideal candidate should be comfortable on camera and understand how to bring out the best in other personalities. While trusted service journalism and destination expertise remain at the heart of our brand, we're looking to expand our storytelling with more humor, spontaneity, and personality—bringing more of the lifestyle and leisure into Travel + Leisure.


The Senior Social Media Editor will collaborate closely with the editor in chief, editorial, social, video, audience development, and commercial teams to build original franchises, identify emerging creators, and expand the brand's reach across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other evolving platforms. They should be nimble, deadline-oriented, and constantly discovering new talent, experimenting with formats, and translating what is happening in the wider social ecosystem into fresh ideas for T+L.


Our Culture: All Travel + Leisure team members are expected to be enthusiastic, entrepreneurial self-starters who embrace experimentation and change; actively seek out new ideas, opportunities, and creative talent; and are eager to grow alongside the brand as it evolves its storytelling.


Location: New York, NY.

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid and requires working in the New York City office three days per week, with the ability to work remotely up to two days per week.

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


35% — Original Franchise Development & Creative Strategy:

  • Develop distinctive, repeatable formats with recognizable hosts, recurring characters, and storytelling that encourages audiences to return for the next episode. Think beyond traditional destination coverage to create original entertainment that can build fandom, attract new audiences, and potentially evolve into larger commercial franchises.
  • Bring an entrepreneurial approach to testing concepts, identifying emerging talent, evaluating performance, and scaling the ideas that resonate.

This is a hybrid position based in NYC, with an expectation of working from the office three days per week.

People Inc.’s Social Strategy and Operations team helps a diverse portfolio of iconic brands build audiences, strengthen engagement, and achieve editorial and business goals across social platforms. We partner with brand social, editorial, commerce, audience development, paid social and operational teams to establish scalable strategies, analyze performance, test new opportunities, and share learnings across the organization. The team combines audience insights, platform expertise, and cross-functional collaboration to help brands adapt to a rapidly evolving social landscape.

job.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Technical Product Manager

Job Description

About The Position

We're seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the product strategy for our knowledge graph and content platform that connects People Inc.'s content, taxonomy, usage rights, and audience signals across 30+ brands, reaching over 100M users monthly. Alongside our content system of record, it powers discovery, personalization, and editorial tooling through GraphQL APIs, search and indexing, and vector-based retrieval. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering and product strategy: building scalable, reusable, self-service capabilities that let other teams ship faster without custom work from us.

As a senior IC partner to the engineering leads of Graphene Foundation, Graphene Services, and Search, you will define and champion the roadmap for core platform capabilities and shape how our services are consumed by both developers and AI agents. Success requires technical depth, strong product judgment, and the ability to balance long-term architectural coherence with the tactical needs of consuming teams. This role reports to VP of Product, Core Platform.


Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.
 

About The Positions Contributions:

Strategic Roadmapping

  • Define and maintain a roadmap across the Foundation (content store, GraphQL engine), Services (APIs, relationships, taxonomy, validation), and Search (indexing, site search, internal search) sub-teams, aligned with company goals and engineering priorities.
  • Prioritize investments against the platform's guiding principles: a connected foundation, trust and transparency, enabling intelligence, and self-service.
  • Make deliberate tradeoffs, focusing as much on what not to build as what to include.
  • Define and track platform leverage metrics, such as team adoption, time to first integration, engineering hours saved, search relevance and latency.

Platform-as-a-Product Thinking

  • Champion the platform as a product, not a set of endpoints, through careful, opinionated curation.
  • Avoid the "feature shop" trap by recognizing patterns across brand and team requests and designing extensible, self-service capabilities, such as a generic relationship service that can link data from many sources.

Cross-Org Orchestration

  • Lead multi-team initiatives that span platform engineering, editorial, Data Science and consuming program teams.
  • Partner with editorial, legal, and rights stakeholders as the platform becomes the source of truth for asset rights, attribution, and lineage.
  • Serve as the connective tissue between teams, aligning stakeholders around shared technical outcomes and influencing without authority.

Internal Developer Experience

  • Treat internal product development teams as primary customers, improving API and schema usability, documentation, and onboarding.
  • Lower the barrier to entry so external teams can integrate without hands-on support from our team.
  • Build strong feedback loops and solve real developer pain points with empathy and insight.
  • Shape agent-ready interfaces, such as MCP servers for search, that let other teams and AI agents use our capabilities on a self-service basis with appropriate access controls and guardrails.

Operational Excellence

  • Partner with engineering to ensure reliability, stability, and performance of GraphQL, indexing, and retrieval services as data volume and audience-signal complexity grow.
  • Champion SLOs, observability, and data quality as foundational product attributes, and treat maintenance and stability as first-class roadmap work.


 

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:


Education: Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, and/or equivalent experience.


Experience: 5+ years in product management, including 3+ years owning platform, API, data, or developer-facing products in a B2B or internal tools setting.


Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Strong technical fluency with API-driven platforms, including GraphQL or similar schema-based APIs, data modeling, and distributed system tradeoffs; able to read schemas and technical designs and challenge them constructively.
  • Working knowledge of search and retrieval systems, including indexing, relevance, and vector databases; experience with knowledge graphs, taxonomy, or metadata systems is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with LLM application patterns and emerging agentic tooling, such as MCP, and a point of view on how platform services should be exposed to AI agents.
  • Proven success leading technical products that span multiple teams or business units.
  • Deep fluency in partnering with engineers on architecture, tradeoffs, and system design.
  • Track record of avoiding reactive build cycles by thoughtfully prioritizing platform focus and extensibility.
  • Ability to define and use data to measure platform outcomes, including adoption, reliability, and developer satisfaction.
  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, able to influence without authority and translate technical tradeoffs for senior engineering, editorial, and business stakeholders.

In addition, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing hr@people.inc.

The Company participates in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For further information about the E-Verify program, please click here: https://www.e-verify.gov/employees

Pay Range

Salary: New York: $140,000 - $170,000

The pay range above represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position and may change in the future. Actual pay may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of People Inc's total compensation package for employees. Other compensation may include annual bonuses, and short- and long-term incentives. In addition, People Inc. provides to employees (and their eligible family members) a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, unlimited paid time off (PTO), adoption or surrogate assistance, donation matching, tuition reimbursement, basic life insurance, basic accidental death & dismemberment, supplemental life insurance, supplemental accident insurance, commuter benefits, short term and long term disability, health savings and flexible spending accounts, family care benefits, a generous 401K savings plan with a company match program, 10-12 paid holidays annually, and generous paid parental leave (birthing and non-birthing parents), all of which may vary depending on the specific nature of your employment with People Inc. and your work location. job.title: SVP, Data Operations
job.description:
Job Title

SVP, Data Operations

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

We are seeking a Senior Vice President of Data Operations to lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of our enterprise-wide data infrastructure. As a data-first media company operating at petabyte scale, data is the connective tissue across our editorial, product, advertising, and audience development functions. This is a defining leadership role for someone who can operate at the intersection of deep technical excellence and enterprise strategy — architecting the systems that power how we understand our content, our audiences, and our business.


The SVP of Data Operations will own the full data stack: from ingestion pipelines and data warehousing to real-time streaming, ML/AI platform capabilities, and the governance frameworks that ensure our data is trusted, accessible, and compliant.

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team

People Inc. is a leading digital media company reaching millions of consumers across a diverse portfolio of iconic brands. Our content informs, entertains, and shapes culture and increasingly, data, at multi-petabyte scale, is the engine behind how we create, distribute, and monetize that content. Operating in a real-time, multi-platform ecosystem, we rely on data to understand audience behavior, optimize content performance, power advertising solutions, and unlock new revenue streams. The SVP of Data Platform will build and lead a high-performing team, partnering closely with Engineering, Data Science, Ad Tech, Research, Product, Editorial, Revenue, Business, and Marketing leadership, serving as the company's foremost authority on all things data.

About The Positions Contributions:

Strategy & Vision

  • Define and execute a multi-year data platform strategy, aligned to company-wide goals across content, audience, advertising, and product.

  • Serve as the executive voice of data — advising the CTO and C-suite on data architecture decisions, investments, and organizational structure, influencing how the company measures success. 

  • Translate complex data capabilities into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders.

  •  Establish a data-first culture across the organization, advocating for data literacy, democratization, and responsible use.

  • Lead exploration and strategy around the foundational data products required to support use in both internal and external AI applications 

Platform Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect and oversee a petabyte-scale data platform spanning batch and real-time ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers.

  • Drive the evolution of our data warehouse/lakehouse strategy (e.g., BigQuery,  Snowflake, DBT) and ensure the platform is built for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency at scale.

  • Lead adoption of emerging data and AI technologies.

  • Ensure the platform is designed for both technical and self-serve users, enabling analysts, data scientists, and product, and all other teams which use data to move quickly and independently.

  • Own data pipeline architecture across streaming (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub) and batch frameworks, ensuring low-latency data delivery at scale.

Data Governance, Quality & Compliance

  • Establish enterprise data governance standards including ownership, lineage, cataloging, and data quality SLAs.

  • Drive the company's data infrastructure readiness for generative AI and ML applications — including model training pipelines, embedding stores, and experiment tracking.

SVP, Data Operations

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

We are seeking a Senior Vice President of Data Operations to lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of our enterprise-wide data infrastructure. As a data-first media company operating at petabyte scale, data is the connective tissue across our editorial, product, advertising, and audience development functions. This is a defining leadership role for someone who can operate at the intersection of deep technical excellence and enterprise strategy — architecting the systems that power how we understand our content, our audiences, and our business.


The SVP of Data Operations will own the full data stack: from ingestion pipelines and data warehousing to real-time streaming, ML/AI platform capabilities, and the governance frameworks that ensure our data is trusted, accessible, and compliant.

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team

People Inc. is a leading digital media company reaching millions of consumers across a diverse portfolio of iconic brands. Our content informs, entertains, and shapes culture and increasingly, data, at multi-petabyte scale, is the engine behind how we create, distribute, and monetize that content. Operating in a real-time, multi-platform ecosystem, we rely on data to understand audience behavior, optimize content performance, power advertising solutions, and unlock new revenue streams. The SVP of Data Platform will build and lead a high-performing team, partnering closely with Engineering, Data Science, Ad Tech, Research, Product, Editorial, Revenue, Business, and Marketing leadership, serving as the company's foremost authority on all things data.

job.title: UX Design Lead, MyRecipes
job.description:
Job Title

UX Design Lead, MyRecipes

Job Description

People Inc. is the largest digital and print publisher in America. From mobile to magazines, nearly 200 million people trust us to help them make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. has more than 40 iconic brands, including PEOPLE, Entertainment Weekly, Better Homes & Gardens, Food & Wine, Travel + Leisure, Allrecipes, InStyle,, REAL SIMPLE, and Southern Living. We are building engaging experiences that excite users and amplify the voices of our brands.


We are looking for a User Experience Design Lead to help define experiences for our engaging food sites and utilities, Allrecipes and MyRecipes. In this role you will craft engaging, functional, and elegant experience design solutions based on a deep and empathetic understanding of our user’s needs. You will partner closely with our Product and Engineering teams to quickly iterate on product definition and ship new features, quickly. Listening to users and gathering feedback from them will also be super important in this role. Experience with user research is highly desirable. 


In this role you must be collaborative in your approach to internal stakeholders, while simultaneously and vigorously championing the consumer experience. 


As a UX Design Lead  at People Inc. you will be responsible for collaborating on user research, translating business requirements into concrete ideas, and refining and iterating on those ideas for delivering to engineering teams. You will help design the overall functionality of our products and iterate upon it to ensure a great user experience.


To be successful in this role, we'd expect you to: 

  • Thoroughly understand the wants and needs of our users. 
  • Translate user needs and business requirements into concrete ideas, wireframes, and mockups.
  • Build interactive prototypes suitable for validating design decisions with users.
  • Apply creative problem solving to the design, processes, and tooling of the system itself. 
  • Document design guidelines, share knowledge, and collaborate with the engineering team to ensure products ship on time and as designed. 
  • Help lead our efforts to build accessible digital products (A11y and WCAG), building awareness, and accountability across the rest of our product organization

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

II. Essential Job Functions


Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


60%

User Experience Design

  • Use business requirements, user stories, and data to produce user flows, wireframes, prototypes, high fidelity mockups, and rigorous user interface specifications

30%

Collaborate with Design and Product teams

  • Partner with UX researchers to validate assumptions, test designs, and understand user data
  • Present design solutions and build consensus among a broad range of stakeholders
  • Participate in and lead brainstorming and critique sessions that foster big-picture thinking while identifying opportunities to raise the bar on the details

10%

Process Management

  • Collaborate with broader UX Team to develop and implement best practices



III. Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements | All must be met to be considered.


Education: 

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent education and experience

Experience: 

  • 4-7 years as a UX Designer for mass-market Web and Mobile products

Specific Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 

  • Strong user experience skills including user research, usability testing, and interaction design
  • Experience designing, planning, and building interactive prototypes suitable for validating design decisions with users
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Familiarity with atomic design methodology and an interest in the challenges that come with building and maintaining design systems
  • Expertise in UX software such as Figma. Basic HTML and CSS skills are a big plus
  • A solid grasp of user-centered design and testing methodologies, subsystems, and usability and accessibility concerns
  • Be excited about collaborating and communicating closely with teams and stakeholders distributed across the country

job.title: Workflow Engineer, 1
job.description:
Job Title

Workflow Engineer, 1

Job Description

AI Workflow & Automation Engineering

  • Prototype and productionize new AI-driven automations.

  • Design and implement Slack features including slash commands, message actions, interactive modals, triage flows, and user-friendly bot behaviors.

  • Develop frameworks, templates, and reusable automation components to accelerate future workflow builds — both for code-first builds and for our low-code stack (n8n, Zapier, Google Workspace Studio).

  • Raise concerns when a proposed approach has technical risk, and help shape a better path forward.

Retrieval, Data Pipelines & AI Quality

  • Build and refine retrieval pipelines, vector stores, data-sync workflows, hashing/diffing systems, and content preprocessing pipelines.

  • Implement structured outputs, evaluation loops, hallucination prevention methods, and AI quality assurance systems.

  • Maintain and improve RAG pipelines using content from Confluence, Google Sheets, Jira, Slack logs, and other internal knowledge sources.

Backend, Reliability & Production Readiness

  • Build and maintain backend services, REST APIs, and serverless orchestrators powering our internal automation platforms.

  • Implement logging, monitoring, retry logic, structured error handling, and observability to keep our automations production-grade.

  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows, testing practices, and version-controlled deployment patterns.

Cross-Team Enablement & Expansion

  • Partner with teams across People Inc. to identify processes that can benefit from intelligent automation or AI augmentation.

  • Translate business needs into reliable automated workflows and internal tools.

  • Contribute to documentation, change management procedures, and the overall evolution of People Inc.'s internal AI platform.

  • Take initiative to propose new AI-enabled enhancements, systems, or assistants the organization has not yet defined.

What You'll Likely Work On in Your First 6 Months

  • Dottie as a service: help extract Dottie (our L1 tech support triage agent) from the existing in-process #it-techsupport implementation into a standalone API, define quality metrics, and onboard at least one new consuming surface.

  • Reusable build patterns: turn our "Slack workflow + AI matcher + Apps Script" pattern into proper templates with example code, intake forms, and stakeholder-facing docs so future builds ship faster.

  • Stack-level upgrades: identify where our current Sheets-based audit logs, Apps Script glue, and ad-hoc retrieval should graduate to more durable infrastructure, and help drive the migration where it makes sense.

Required Skills

Background

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful exposure to AI/LLM-based systems.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

Core Engineering

  • Solid experience with Python and JavaScript; comfort working in Apps Script, or willingness to become fluent.

  • Comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven integrations.

  • Experience building and shipping services that have run in production.

AI & LLM

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, OpenAI APIs, embeddings, retrieval pipelines (RAG), and prompt engineering.

  • Familiarity with data normalization, indexing, content segmentation, and retrieval basics.

Cloud & Systems

  • Experience with Google Cloud, particularly Cloud Functions (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, IAM a plus).

  • Experience building on Slack via the SDK, Bolt, or Events API, including interactive UI components.

  • Experience integrating with Jira and similar APIs.

Preferred Skills (Not Required)

  • Experience with low-code or iPaaS tools (n8n, Zapier, Make) used alongside code.

  • Background in agentic workflows or LangChain.

  • Exposure to observability tools and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience designing systems with reliability and a real user-experience focus.

  • Experience operating internal tools — running them, watching usage, iterating — not just building them.

  • Knowledge of Confluence APIs, content hashing, or knowledge retrieval.

  • Experience containerizing AI workloads (Docker) or working with vector databases.

Who Thrives in This Role

  • Engineers who think in systems, not isolated tasks.

  • Builders who enjoy being a strong technical contributor on a small team and want their work to ship and get used.

  • Developers who care about reliability, uptime, and high-quality user experience.

  • Technologists who stay curious about emerging AI advancements and adopt them responsibly.

  • Problem-solvers energized by complex, cross-functional technical challenges.

It is the policy of People Inc. to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

job.title: Account Supervisor, Financial Services Communications
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

About Our Team 

Edelman Smithfield is a global financial communications firm with the power and scope of Edelman, the world’s largest integrated communications company. We specialize in financial markets and strategic situations, serving clients in the United States, Canada, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Edelman Smithfield offers a deep and talented bench of approximately 250 financial market specialists across more than 25 cities and 15 countries.  

 

Edelman Smithfield advises senior leaders and management teams navigating complex matters that impact reputation and valuation and has deep expertise in serving and communicating to the financial markets. 

 

The Role 

We are seeking a strategic, detail-oriented, and proactive Account Supervisor with experience in financial services communications to join our team. This person will play a critical role in client service, project execution, media relations, and strategic communications, ensuring high-impact results for our clients. 

 

This individual should have strong relationships with key reporters, a deep understanding of industry dynamics, and a natural curiosity about the stakeholders and evolving landscape of private capital firms, hedge funds, asset and wealth managers, investment and commercial banks, fintech companies, real estate investors, insurers and other institutional market participants.  

 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Lead communications strategies for financial services clients, from ideation to execution. 

  • Serve as day-to-day lead on teams and client contact, with a focus on timeliness, quality, and budget adherence. 

  • Develop a deep understanding of clients’ businesses, key stakeholders, and industry landscapes, and apply this knowledge to provide strategic recommendations. 

  • Support senior leadership in identifying and mitigating challenges, creating efficiencies and ensuring client satisfaction. 

  • Work with leadership to develop media engagement strategies, maintaining and leveraging relationships with key financial journalists, producers, and influencers. 

  • Craft compelling thought leadership content, including op-eds, speeches, corporate messaging, and media materials. 

  • Provide proactive and reactive media counsel to clients, ensuring message alignment and positioning. 

  • Translate complex financial and regulatory topics into clear, compelling narratives for media, investors, and other key stakeholders. 

  • Oversee the work of junior team members, providing mentorship, feedback, and guidance. 

  • Contribute to new business efforts, supporting proposal development, pitch preparation, and deskside research. 

 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, journalism, communications, or a related field. 

  • At least 4+ years of experience in corporate communications, financial services, public relations, or public affairs, preferably in an agency setting. 

 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience in financial communications, with a strong understanding of financial institutions, the financial services industry landscape and key stakeholder audiences. 

  • Strong media relations expertise, with established journalist relationships and a demonstrated ability to secure high-impact media coverage. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop strategic messaging and thought leadership content. 

  • Strong project management skills, with a proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven mindset. 

  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments, managing multiple priorities simultaneously. 

$83,000 - $110,000 per year

job.title: Coordinator, People Experience Delivery
job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum. 

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

Why This Role Matters:

 

As a proactive and detail-oriented People Operations Team member, you will leverage your HR operations knowledge to ensure smooth, compliant, and efficient processes across a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

This role is essential to delivering exceptional employee experience, enabling scalable HR processes, and driving operational excellence for Edelman Thailand. The ideal candidate will bring strong HR systems capability, excellent communication skills, and a continuous-improvement mindset—including the ability to identify opportunities for AI-enabled efficiency.

 

What You’ll Do:

People Support

Onboarding & Offboarding guiding employees through key life & career moments

·       Manage end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, including pre/post-hire logistics, digital file management, eligibility verification, and induction coordination.

·       Administer and maintain employee records, contractual data, and employment changes in Workday with a high emphasis on accuracy and compliance.

·       Support introductory/probation period management and guide hiring managers through key milestones.

·       Support offboarding for voluntary and involuntary exits and prepare offboarding materials, including resignation confirmations and employee communications.

·       Coordinate offboarding logistics with IT and payroll vendors, including timely return of equipment.

 

Supporting employees through seamless payroll and benefits delivery


·       Manage the HR-side of the monthly payroll cycle, validating data from Workday and partnering with Finance and payroll vendors for accurate processing.

·       Manage holiday and absence tracking via Workday.

·       Support benefits administration, including group insurance, provident fund enrollment and changes, ensuring accurate employee data and smooth coordination with external providers.

·       Provide administrative support for compensation cycles (salary reviews, bonus cycles) using Workday tools and reporting.

·       Support onboarding and documentation for vendors and freelancers, including invoice coordination.

·       Produce regular and ad hoc People reports and analytics, ensuring actionable insights.

·       Support planning and execution of local and regional employee engagement initiatives.

·       Coordinate logistics, communication, and documentation for People programs and cross-functional stakeholder groups.

 

Delivering operational support to drive process improvements and identify opportunities for AI integration

·       Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes, workflow automation, and system enhancements within Workday and other tools.

·       Manage full-cycle intern and freelancer hiring, from sourcing through offer management

·       Maintain and update HR policies, company regulations, templates, and documentation in line with legal requirements and global standards.

·       Ensure compliance with local labor laws and internal governance, partnering closely with the local People Partner.

·       Monitor and update local and regional portals; respond to queries through ServiceNow for a consistent employee experience.

·       Manage operational components of internal transfers, international mobility, and visa-related processes.

·       Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Finance, IT, and Legal to maintain alignment and data accuracy.

·       Support COEs (Talent Management, L&D, Talent Acquisition) through data, process assistance, and logistics.

·       Explore and support the integration of AI tools into HR operations, including workflow automation, chatbot functionality, and smart reporting.

·       Maintain SOPs and process documentation to ensure clarity and consistency across the HR service delivery model.

 

Partnerships across Teams and Cross-Market People Operations

·         Build strong, trusted partnerships with employees, managers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

·         Represent People Operations in stakeholder discussions related to processes, policies, and systems.

·         Partner with local market teams to ensure alignment with regional policies and compliance with country-specific regulations.

·         Act as a Workday and HR operations point of contact for assigned APAC markets, ensuring data accuracy and timely execution.

·         Contribute to regional operational projects, harmonization efforts, and continuous improvement initiatives across APAC.

·         Participate in additional duties and cross-functional projects as required.

 

Skills & Experience Required

  • 1-2 years of experience in People Operations or HR Services roles.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end operations.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Understanding of employment practices, laws, compliance requirements in Thailand.
  • Payroll knowledge, including salary structures, statutory requirements, and tax regulations; experience managing benefits programs.
  • Excellent communication skills with strong attention to detail and a commitment to data integrity.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • High discretion when working with confidential information.
  • Proven experience with Workday (HCM, recruiting, onboarding, and reporting) preferred.

Proficiency in MS365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams).

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
