job.title: Finance Analyst
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

The Financial Analyst will sit within the North American Controllership function and report to the Finance Manager. The Analyst will have primary responsibility for the accounting, reconciliation and forecasting of U.S. workforce-related costs, including salaries, professional freelance and temporary clerical costs, taxable fringe benefits and employee perquisites. The role will also support employee welfare budgeting and play a significant role in redesigning the end-to-end freelance management process.

 

This is a visible role requiring regular partnership across front- and back-office functions, including Payroll, Resource Management, Human Resources & Employee Relations, and various market and practice leaders. The successful candidate will be expected to combine detailed accounting execution with analytical judgment, proactively investigate exceptions and communicate both findings and recommended solutions.


Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance with 2+ years of relevant experience. High degree of confidentiality and ability to manage sensitive data responsibly. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and automation tools including ChatGPT and Copilot. Demonstrated analytical ability and understanding of financial statements, budgeting, and forecasting concepts. Ability to organize and analyze detailed financial data, identify inconsistencies, and clearly communicate findings with explanations and/or proposed solutions in a clean and timely manner.


Preferred Knowledge and Skills

Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring deadlines while responding to ad hoc requests. Consistently demonstrates curiosity, willingness to learn and sound judgment. Comfortable working with large datasets and developing repeatable analytical processes. Familiarity with Workday and Adaptive products a plus. CPA candidates a plus (role will be eligible for Edelman’s tuition reimbursement program after 6 months of employment and CPA testing and licensing fee expense reimbursements, if desired).


Key Responsibilities

Salaries & Freelance Compensation

Own the reconciliation process of salaries and freelance costs as part of month end close by timely, completely and accurately comparing Payroll wage reports and general ledger (GL) balances to forecasted costs within Adaptive and subsequently investigating and resolving all exceptions as appropriate. This may require:

  • Preparing journal entries for month end close including expense accruals and reclassification entries.
  • Coordinating with Payroll and HR to resolve identified discrepancies.
  • Updating forecast for hires, terminations, promotions, compensation changes, and other workforce activity.
  • Maintaining supporting schedules used to forecast for salaries and other employee expenses.
  • Partnering with the Controller and Employee Relations in review of the severance accrual.
  • Preparing monthly forecast-to-actuals variance commentary.

Freelance Process

Manage the freelance tracking process, evaluating spend by practice, analyzing trends and identifying ongoing opportunities for cost savings. Additionally, collaborate with Resource Management and Finance to document existing freelance processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop an efficient process for tracking, managing, and reporting freelance activity. General responsibilities may include:

  • Reviewing requests to engage freelance.
  • Entering and reconciling purchase orders for agency freelancers.
  • Monitoring freelance spend against forecast and approved budgets.
  • Maintaining accurate freelance tracking and supporting schedules, including start dates, end dates, rates, expected costs, and organizational alignment.
  • Partnering with Resource Management and Finance to reconcile the active freelance population and validate ongoing business need.

 

Other Employee Costs

In partnership with HR Compliance and Payroll, coordinate the budgeting and tracking of non-salary compensation and miscellaneous taxable fringe benefits including reimbursed office parking, statutorily required stipends and cash equivalent compensation (gift cards). Responsibilities include reviewing the ledger population for completeness and classification, investigating forecast to actual variances, quarterly compilation of data required by Payroll for processing, and periodic updating of policies and procedures.

 

May also support in the budgeting of employer payroll taxes and pension plan contributions.

 

Other Budget Support:

Support the Finance Manager with maintaining employee welfare budget trackers for market, practice and other business leaders as needed including:

  • Making periodic updates to trackers to reflect actual spend per the GL
  • Maintenance of project codes and providing transaction-level approvals within Workday as needed
  • Assisting leaders in understanding available budgets, actual spending, forecast outlook, and budget purpose
  • Researching and explaining forecast to actuals variances.
  • Coordinating with budget owners to identify accruals and prepare needed monthly entries.
  • Support the Finance Manager and Controller in other areas of budgeting, forecasting, accounting and ad hoc investigations from time to time, as needed.

$56,000 - $70,000 per year

#LI-PP1

An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, travel requirements, revenue-based metrics, any contractual agreements, and business or organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of DJEH’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, a Paid Time Off policy, and region-specific benefits.

DJEH offers a wide range of benefits: medical and dental insurance, vision, 401K, life insurance, disability insurance, paid time off, travel assistance and wellness programing.

job.title: Gerente Sênior de Tributos – LATAM
job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum. 

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

Estamos buscando por uma pessoa para liderar a área tributária da Edelman na América Latina.

A posição é recém-criada e será responsável pela gestão tributária da região, abrangendo consultoria, compliance fiscal, tributos diretos e indiretos, preços de transferência e planejamento tributário.


A atuação será em parceria com o EVP de Finanças Globais, Controller LATAM e as equipes de Contabilidade e Jurídico, assessorando as lideranças de Finanças e de Negócios na tomada de decisões e na gestão de riscos tributários.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência tributária na América Latina, assessorando o negócio em contratos comerciais, novos serviços, precificação, expansão, reestruturações e operações internacionais.
  • Identificar e implementar oportunidades de planejamento tributário e acompanhar mudanças na legislação, incluindo OCDE/BEPS, Pillar Two e reformas tributárias locais.
  • Supervisionar as apurações, declarações e demais obrigações fiscais, incluindo imposto de renda, retenções na fonte e tributos indiretos (IVA/VAT). Gerenciar o calendário fiscal regional e orientar o negócio sobre documentos fiscais eletrônicos e a reforma tributária brasileira.
  • Revisar as provisões anuais de imposto de renda conforme ASC 740, incluindo impostos correntes e diferidos, ajustes de recuperabilidade de ativos fiscais diferidos e posições fiscais incertas. Fornecer informações trimestrais e anuais para a consolidação em US GAAP.
  • Gerenciar prestadores de serviços de contabilidade, tributos e folha de pagamento, incluindo definição de escopo, negociação de honorários, desempenho e revisão das entregas.
  • Liderar a gestão regional de preços de transferência (Transfer Pricing), incluindo contratos intercompany, estudos de comparabilidade e documentação Local File e Master File.
  • Conduzir fiscalizações e atender a questionamentos das autoridades fiscais, reportando riscos relevantes ao EVP de Finanças Globais. Apoiar operações de M&A, due diligence tributária, estruturação, constituição e encerramento de entidades.
  • Desenvolver processos e ferramentas para padronizar o compliance e o reporte tributário, em colaboração com as áreas de Jurídico, Contabilidade, Tesouraria e Operações.

O que buscamos:

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Finanças e/ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pelo menos 8 anos de experiência na área tributária, com responsabilidades crescentes, em Big Four, escritórios de advocacia e/ou departamentos tributários de empresas multinacionais.
  • Experiência em tributos diretos, indiretos e Transfer Pricing em diferentes países da América Latina, com sólido conhecimento de mercados como Brasil, México, Argentina, Colômbia e Peru.
  • Experiência na gestão de prestadores de serviços tributários e consultorias externas.
  • Capacidade de comunicar questões tributárias complexas de forma clara e objetiva para lideranças de outras áreas.
  • Visão de negócios, autonomia, iniciativa, capacidade de negociação, influência junto à liderança, atenção aos detalhes e discernimento técnico na gestão de riscos.
  • Inglês fluente.

Diferenciais:

  • Qualificações profissionais como CPA, JD, LLM ou equivalentes.
  • Fluência em espanhol e/ou português.
  • Experiência em empresas do setor de serviços ou serviços profissionais.
  • Experiência com provisões tributárias (ASC 740), controles internos nos moldes da SOX e conhecimento do ERP Workday.
  • Experiência com faturamento eletrônico e obrigações fiscais digitais na América Latina, operações de M&A e reestruturações societárias.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizem a colaboração, o respeito à diversidade e a construção de um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo.

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

job.title: Senior Account Manager, Corporate Reputation
job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

Edelman is looking for a Senior Account Manager to play a major role within our Reputation team in Canada.


We're looking for an experienced corporate PR professional who can help clients navigate complex business and reputational challenges, strengthen stakeholder trust and communicate effectively across earned, owned, social and digital channels. You'll combine traditional media relations expertise, business and financial communications fluency, and ownership of complex client accounts.


You'll bring sound judgment and the ability to translate complex issues into clear, relevant communications while managing the financial and operational aspects of PR accounts.


Who You Are

You're an experienced corporate communications professional who combines strategic counsel with hands-on media relations and independently manages complex client relationships.


You're comfortable with forecasting, staff planning, resourcing and integrated thinking across multiple workstreams.


You demonstrate strong business judgment, understand client business objectives and reputational challenges, and know when to independently drive decisions versus escalate complex issues to senior leaders.


What You'll Do

  • Lead corporate reputation programs for complex clients and develop communications strategies that strengthen stakeholder trust and support business objectives.
  • Drive traditional media relations and earned media strategies, including proactive pitching, journalist relationships, executive profiling and thought leadership.
  • Own day-to-day client relationships, anticipate needs, provide informed strategic counsel and influence client decision-making through proactive, business-focused recommendations.
  • Oversee account operations, including forecasting, budgeting, staff planning, resourcing, scopes of work and overall account financial health.
  • Drive multiple workstreams and coordinate integrated teams, balancing client priorities while ensuring high-quality delivery.
  • Translate complex corporate, economic and financial issues into clear, compelling narratives across relevant communications channels.
  • Guide and mentor junior colleagues, providing direction and feedback while collaborating across creative, digital, social and insights disciplines.
  • Identify opportunities for organic account growth, contribute to new business initiatives and support the development of integrated communications strategies that drive client impact.

What We're Looking For

  • 5–7 years of experience in public relations, corporate communications or reputation management, with a strong foundation in traditional corporate PR and knowledge of the Canadian media landscape.
  • Demonstrated hands-on media relations experience, including pitching journalists, building media relationships and developing earned media strategies for corporate audiences.
  • Strong understanding of business, economic and financial communications, including relevant corporate issues and business media. Experience supporting banking, insurance, fintech, wealth or asset management clients is a strong asset.
  • Practical experience managing the financial and operational aspects of PR accounts, including forecasting, budgeting, staff planning, resourcing, scopes of work and account financial health.
  • Experience leading complex client accounts and driving multiple workstreams, teams and competing priorities while maintaining high standards of quality.
  • Ability to independently manage day-to-day client relationships, anticipate needs, provide strategic counsel and take ownership of client outcomes with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills, including translating complex business and reputational issues into clear narratives and developing audience-focused, integrated, earned-first communications strategies.
  • A collaborative and inclusive approach, with experience guiding junior colleagues and partnering across disciplines. Experience in public affairs, government communications, crisis communications or investor relations is an asset.

A bachelor's degree in communications, public relations, journalism, business or another relevant field is preferred.


Why Join Edelman?

At Edelman, you'll have the opportunity to work on high-profile, complex client accounts, take meaningful ownership of client relationships and contribute to communications programs that help organizations build trust.


You'll collaborate with colleagues across disciplines, develop your strategic and commercial capabilities, and contribute to impactful work within a global communications firm.


Our work is guided by four core values:

  • Relentless Pursuit of Excellence
  • Courage to Do the Right Thing
  • Freedom to Be Constantly Curious
  • The Commitment to Positively Impact Society

We value different perspectives, collaboration and curiosity, and believe they make our teams and our work stronger.


Pay Range: $70,000–$85,000 CAD/year.

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

job.title: Senior Account Supervisor, Corporate-Tech PR
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

About:

Edelman's Corporate practice helps companies and brands navigate complex reputational opportunities and challenges, strengthen trust, and build commercial value through strategic, integrated communications. Our work spans corporate positioning, narrative development, stakeholder engagement, media relations, executive thought leadership, and issues management.


We are seeking a Senior Account Supervisor (SAS) to join our team in a unique role that spans Corporate and Tech in support of one of Edelman's largest and longest-running global consumer technology clients. The ideal candidate is an experienced communications professional with strong strategic judgment, excellent client management skills and a proven ability to develop and execute integrated communications programs. We're looking for someone who understands the intersection of corporate and consumer and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


We're looking for an ambitious SAS who can bring strategic thinking and creative problem-solving to complex communications challenges. Ideal experience would include supporting launch strategies that drive business growth, executing product launches and planning mid- to large-scale media events. We’re also looking for someone who is driven by mentoring and developing colleagues to be part of a best-in-class team, and has some experience doing so already.


The role:

You will develop product- and corporate-centric strategies. You will master Edelman’s various processes/approaches, messaging and narrative development, product launches, brand engagement, social media and influencer campaigns, and stakeholder mapping exercises and be able to support integrated teams in the execution of these processes for clients. You will be responsible for the supervision of account work performed by junior staff, demonstrating the ability to manage up, as well as manage across with peers and mentor account team members. Most of all, you’ll be extremely skilled at juggling multiple projects and stakeholders while ensuring high-quality deliverables within fast timelines.


We’re looking for an energetic team player with a desire to work across disciplines to drive projects forward across all aspects of integrated communications. You’re an excellent writer, trend spotter, avid news consumer, and creative brainstormer. Your background includes strong media knowledge, proof of strategic thinking and a love of both the operational and cultural management of teams. You will supervise the work of team members, coaching them to master new skills while ensuring excellent quality in everything the team delivers. You’ll also be a go-to deputy for senior team leads, supporting the development of the most important strategies and projects.


Responsibilities:

  • Provide client council, demonstrating advisory skills and ability to build trust and unlock growth opportunities
  • Help lead operational and financial performance of account teams, delivering quality work and effective processes and ensuring that client requests are handled in a timely and strategic fashion.
  • Drive communications plans and launch strategies, including events
  • Oversee the development of product messaging, talking points, and high-visibility press materials for launches
  • Liaise with colleagues across specialties and disciplines to successfully complete integrated projects
  • Work with team members and clients all around the world with a willingness to flex your schedule to collaborate with other time zones
  • Research trends to proactively counsel clients on their business opportunities
  • Demonstrate very advanced writing skills and supervise writing of others
  • Lead junior staff by mentoring, motivating, coaching, consistently providing feedback, holding them accountable, conducting reviews, and overseeing their professional development -- and leading by example with your own excellent work quality and strong judgment in client situations
  • Understanding of and ability to help operationalize the use of AI across the team
  • Lead new business development, RFP responses, and client acquisitions

Basic Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Public Relations, Communications, English, Journalism, Advertising, Business) or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in communications or public relations (agency or in-house preferred)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of experience working in the corporate or consumer communications space, preferably with tech-adjacent clients
  • Have relationships with tech, business, and lifestyle media
  • Excellent writing and storytelling skills
  • Have managed the budgets and team on sizable pieces of business to achieve client goals
  • Have written strategic media plans and a variety of media materials with limited oversight
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally, sometimes for 2 weeks at a time
  • Proven account management and team leadership skills

job.title: Senior Client Finance Analyst
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

Edelman is looking for a Senior Client Finance Analyst to join our Commercial Finance team. This is an exciting opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys managing the financial side of client accounts, partnering with account teams, and helping drive the financial success of projects within a global communications agency.


In this role, you'll support the day-to-day financial management of multiple client accounts, including client billing, project budgeting, revenue forecasting, revenue recognition, and profitability analysis. Working closely with finance leadership, project managers, and account teams, you'll help ensure accurate financial reporting, effective budget management, and smooth financial operations.


You'll also have the opportunity to take ownership of client financial activities, build strong relationships with cross-functional teams, and grow your responsibilities over time.


If you enjoy combining hands-on financial operations with analytical thinking in a collaborative, fast-paced agency environment, we'd love to hear from you.


Who You Are

You're a proactive, detail-oriented finance professional who enjoys working closely with client-facing teams and understands how financial management contributes to the success of client accounts.


You're comfortable navigating project budgets, billing processes, revenue forecasts, and financial reporting while managing multiple priorities. You bring strong analytical and organizational skills, communicate financial information clearly, and take ownership of your work.


You thrive in a collaborative environment where accuracy, problem-solving, and building strong working relationships are essential.


What You'll Do

  • Partner with account teams and project managers to support the financial management of multiple client accounts, including project budgets, financial reporting, and profitability tracking.
  • Coordinate and manage client billing activities, ensuring accurate and timely invoicing, billing reviews, and resolution of discrepancies.
  • Prepare and maintain revenue forecasts based on client contracts, statements of work, project budgets, and billing activity.
  • Support monthly revenue recognition processes, including accruals, deferrals, reconciliations, and revenue tracking.
  • Monitor project financial performance, analyze budget-to-actual variances, and identify potential financial risks and opportunities.
  • Review and process financial documentation, including client contracts, statements of work, purchase orders, service orders, and project financial records.
  • Collaborate with finance leadership and account teams to provide financial guidance, support informed decisions, and maintain accurate client financial information.
  • Take ownership of assigned client financial activities, with opportunities to independently manage client accounts as you grow in the role.

Basic Qualifications

  • A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field and a minimum of two years of relevant finance or accounting experience; or at least four years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, or financial operations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Client Finance, Commercial Finance, Project Finance, or financial operations, ideally within an advertising, public relations, communications, marketing, consulting, or professional services environment.
  • Hands-on experience with client billing, project budgets, revenue forecasting, reconciliations, and project profitability analysis.
  • Understanding of revenue recognition principles, including accruals, deferrals, and month-end financial processes.
  • Experience partnering with account teams, project managers, or client-facing stakeholders to manage project financial activities.
  • Ability to interpret financial information and communicate insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. Edelman is a trusted voice helping organizations earn trust through action. Through the Edelman Trust Barometer, the definitive global study of trust, we inform and advise leaders across business, government, media, and civil society on how trust shapes growth, reputation, and societal expectations. Our work is consistently recognized at the industry's highest levels, including Cannes Lions, WARC, and the IPA Effectiveness Awards.


We are looking for a Senior Vice President, Brand Strategy to join our team in Canada, leading strategic thinking for some of the world's most recognized consumer brands.


This is an opportunity to shape brand strategy across North America while collaborating with global teams to deliver culturally relevant, insight-driven work that connects brands with consumers in meaningful ways.


As a senior strategic leader, you will work at the intersection of brand, culture, creativity, and commerce, helping clients navigate evolving consumer behaviours, identify new opportunities, and build brands that earn attention, trust, and relevance.


You'll partner closely with senior client leaders, creative teams, strategists, and specialists across Edelman's integrated network to develop ambitious ideas grounded in consumer understanding and designed to drive business impact.

This is a role for someone who loves the craft of strategy as much as the opportunity to lead it. You'll be hands-on in shaping the work, a trusted advisor to clients, and an inspiring mentor to the next generation of strategic talent.


Who You Are

You're a strategic thinker and brand builder who understands what makes consumers care, what drives culture, and how brands can show up meaningfully in people's lives.


You bring deep experience working with consumer brands, ideally within CPG, and know how to turn complex business challenges, consumer insights, and cultural tensions into clear, compelling strategies that inspire creative thinking.

You're equally comfortable working directly with senior clients, collaborating with creative teams, and rolling up your sleeves to develop the strategic thinking behind the work.


You thrive in collaborative environments, bring curiosity and fresh perspectives to challenges, and enjoy working across markets and disciplines to create work that makes a difference.


What You'll Do

  • Lead brand strategy for major CPG clients, developing insight-led approaches that strengthen brand positioning, cultural relevance, consumer engagement, and business growth.
  • Shape strategic thinking across North America, collaborating with Canadian, U.S., and global teams to connect local market understanding with regional and global brand ambitions.
  • Turn consumer and cultural insights into creative opportunities, drawing on research, data, audience behaviours, category dynamics, and emerging trends to uncover compelling brand platforms and communications strategies.
  • Partner with creative and integrated teams to inspire distinctive, culturally relevant ideas and campaigns that connect with consumers across earned, social, digital, and other brand touchpoints.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior clients, providing strategic counsel, challenging conventional thinking, and helping brand leaders navigate evolving consumer expectations and business challenges.
  • Drive strategic excellence and business growth, identifying opportunities to expand client partnerships, contributing to new business pitches, and championing work that delivers measurable impact.
  • Lead and develop strategy talent, mentoring strategists, fostering collaboration, and building an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives and bold thinking can thrive.
  • Champion innovation and connected thinking, bringing together expertise from across Edelman's North American and global network to explore new methodologies, tools, and approaches to brand-building.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in brand strategy, communications strategy, advertising, integrated marketing, consulting, or a related discipline, including experience leading strategy for major consumer brands.
  • Strong understanding of the CPG landscape, consumer behaviours, brand-building, and the cultural and commercial dynamics shaping categories such as food, beverage, personal care, and household products.
  • Proven ability to develop compelling brand positioning, creative briefs, communications platforms, and integrated strategies that translate insights into distinctive, effective work.
  • Experience leading large, complex client relationships and collaborating with senior stakeholders across multiple markets, ideally including North America.
  • A track record of inspiring creative work and translating strategic thinking into measurable brand or business outcomes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence clients, inspire creative teams, and mentor strategic talent.
  • A collaborative, curious, and entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to bring together diverse perspectives and navigate complex, cross-functional environments.

Life at Edelman

At Edelman, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of some of the world's most recognized brands while working alongside talented colleagues across strategy, creative, communications, data, and digital.


Our global network brings together different perspectives, expertise, and capabilities to solve complex challenges and create work that matters.

job.title: Solutions Lead, AI Transformation
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

We're transforming how work gets done across Edelman, redesigning specialty workflows around AI, developing the tools and solutions that support them, and translating these new ways of working into more standardized, scalable services and offerings.

 

As the AI Transformation Solutions Lead, you'll support the SVP of AI Transformation in driving Specialty-Based Transformation across the firm, working closely with subject matter experts, product and engineering teams to rethink how work is performed and bring AI-enabled solutions to life.

 

You'll also help translate these redesigned workflows into clearly defined deliverables, service models and pricing frameworks that shape how Edelman scopes, delivers and goes to market with its services.

 

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of AI transformation, solution design and business transformation. You'll help connect the dots from understanding how people work today, to designing and implementing better ways of working, to defining how those capabilities can be consistently delivered and commercially packaged for clients. 


What you'll do 

  • Support specialty workflow discovery and redesign: Work directly with specialty leaders and subject matter experts to understand how work is currently performed, identify pain points and opportunities for AI, and map current-state and future-state workflows end to end. 
  • Translate workflows into AI-enabled solutions: Turn specialist knowledge and business needs into clear scopes, product requirements and workflow documentation that guide the development of new AI-enabled tools and solutions. 
  • Support solution prototyping and development: Use generative AI tools to create mockups, prototypes and early solution concepts, working with product managers and engineering teams to turn ideas into practical applications. 
  • Bridge business and technical teams: Act as a connector between subject matter experts, transformation leaders and engineers, ensuring that solutions reflect real workflow needs, technical requirements are clearly understood, and stakeholder feedback informs development priorities. 
  • Support testing, rollout and adoption: Coordinate user feedback and testing, help develop onboarding and training resources, and track whether new workflows and tools are being adopted and delivering measurable improvements. 
  • Translate redesigned workflows into standardized deliverables: Help connect new AI-enabled ways of working to Edelman's standardized menu of services and deliverables, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize or evolve what we deliver and how we deliver it. 
  • Support service definition and commercial modeling: Work with offering leads and operational stakeholders to define deliverables, validate complexity and effort assumptions, and understand the skills, roles, staffing and costs required to deliver services through transformed workflows. Support the development of consistent scoping and pricing frameworks that reflect these new delivery models and inform how services are taken to market. 

What we're looking for 

  • 3-5 years of experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, operations, AI transformation, service design or a related field. 
  • Strong understanding of generative AI tools and their applications in business, with enthusiasm for exploring how AI can fundamentally change workflows and service delivery. 
  • Experience conducting user research, gathering requirements and documenting workflows, processes or solutions. 
  • Ability to translate in both directions: turning complex business needs into clear technical requirements, and explaining technical concepts in practical terms to non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Strong analytical skills, including confidence working with structured data, spreadsheets and models to identify insights and inform decisions. 
  • Excellent written communication and the ability to turn ambiguous or complex information into clear requirements, frameworks, recommendations and documentation. 
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders and evolving priorities. 
  • Curiosity about how businesses operate, how services are delivered and how technology can improve efficiency, quality and commercial value. 
  • Confidence working collaboratively across specialty teams, product and engineering, operations and business leadership. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail and comfort working in an evolving environment where processes and solutions are still being defined. 

Nice to have:
Experience in PR, communications or professional services; familiarity with AI prototyping, prompt design or product development; exposure to service catalogs, process improvement, workforce planning, commercial modeling or pricing frameworks. 

 

You'll be part of a team fundamentally rethinking how the world's largest global communications firm works and goes to market in an AI-enabled world. 


You'll gain hands-on experience across the full transformation lifecycle, from discovering opportunities and redesigning workflows to developing AI solutions, shaping standardized offerings and supporting new commercial models. 


Working closely with transformation leadership, specialty experts and technical teams, you'll help build tools and ways of working that create real business impact, while contributing to how Edelman defines, delivers and sells its services in the future. 


This is an opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of AI, product development, business transformation and commercial innovation, helping shape not just how people work, but what the firm is able to offer its clients. 


$90-120K per year

job.title: Barista
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

The Coffee Barista delivers an exceptional guest experience, connecting with guests to deliver quality beverages and food during all hours of operations, prioritizing the guest’s needs over tasks. Uphold and maintain the execution of the food and beverage standards.

 

This is an onsite role in Franklin, TN.

 

Here's some of what you will be doing...

  • Greet customers, identify their needs, and answers questions about menu items.
  • Prepare and serve beverages such as coffee, espresso, cappuccino, tea, chai, and similar beverages.
  • May prepare and serve limited food items or baked goods like muffins or bagels.
  • Record sales, operate a cash register, and follow cash handling policies as required. 
  • Order, receive, and distribute stock supplies. Ensure customer service stations are stocked with paper products and beverage preparation items.
  • Clean and sanitize the work areas, utensils, equipment, dishes, and seating area.
  • Stock coffee products, supplies, and merchandise.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Job responsibilities are subject to review and change

Here's some experience and skills we are seeking...

  • High School Diploma, or relevant training with relevant experience, a plus.
  • Minimum 1-2 years of customer service experience.
  • Experience with cash management, a plus.
  • Possess excellent customer service skills, present self in a friendly, service-oriented manner.
  • Ability to work well with others or independently.
  • Possess a good memory.
  • Ability to work well with hands.
  • Knowledge of sanitation regulations, desired.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Able to work well under pressure.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/ministry relationships.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

Employment Requirements...

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

What can we offer you?

Some of our benefits package includes:

  • Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance and company paid Dental
  • Company paid life insurance and short term/long term disability insurance
  • Company 401k with a generous company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.title: Senior Marketing Manager
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

The Senior Campaign Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns in support of assigned brand and product lines. This role serves as a strategic partner within the Marketing team, providing high-level direction and campaign leadership while building strong cross-functional relationships across the Ministry.

 

The Senior Campaign Manager leverages data-driven insights, business acumen, and strategic planning to develop marketing programs that align with organizational goals, maximize reach, and drive audience engagement through owned, paid, and partner channels.

 

This is an onsite role in Franklin, TN.

 

 

Here's some of what you will be doing...

  • Support and contribute to Ministry endeavors by following employment policies and practices and supporting a safe and healthy work environment. Specifically, follow K-LOVE’s Injury Prevention and Safety program, support and maintain safety standards, and participate in safety training.
  • Serve as the lead marketing partner for assigned brands/products, translating organizational goals and audience insights into effective campaign strategies.
  • Develop strategic campaign plans encompassing full lifecycle execution—from ideation through analysis—across digital (web, email, social, SMS), radio, events, direct mail, and other channels.
  • Lead campaign planning meetings, ensuring alignment of messaging, timing, resources, and cross-channel integration.
  • Proactively manage campaign calendars and inventory, anticipating challenges and securing required placements across channels.
  • Collaborate with content producers, designers, and project managers to commission deliverables that align with brand standards and campaign objectives.
  • Direct stakeholder communications, manage review cycles, and ensure timely approvals of all campaign materials.
  • Oversee end-to-end campaign execution, ensuring accuracy, adherence to timelines, and message consistency.
  • Monitor campaign performance in real-time, identifying areas of optimization and implementing data-informed adjustments.
  • Synthesize campaign results into clear, actionable reports, highlighting ROI, audience engagement, and learnings to inform future strategies.
  • Act as a mentor to other Campaign Managers, sharing best practices, tools, and strategies to elevate team capabilities.
  • Shape SOPs for the Mobile Marketing Specialist (MMS), creating a high-accuracy system for sending SMS messages, including messages for campaigns, branded content, fundraising and more. Provide supervision and quality assurance to the MMS as needed.
  • Foster an internal culture of collaboration, service excellence, and ministry alignment through consistent, values-driven communication.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Job responsibilities are subject to review and change

Here's some experience and skills we are seeking...

  • Bachelor's Degree in communication, digital marketing, or combination of education/training with relevant experience.
  • Minimum 5 years’ marketing and customer service experience.
  • Experience in agency or in-house environments with multi-brand/multi-location environments, required.
  • Experienced in full, comprehensive campaign mediums (broadcast, outdoor, print, digital, and mail).
  • Knowledge and understanding of the creative process, ability to commission creative development, and work with creative producers.
  • Good understanding of current marketing trends.
  • Possess exceptional Project Management skills and planning abilities.
  • Ability to manage several marketing campaigns simultaneously.
  • Expert problem-solver with strong skills in time management, budget, and process improvement.
  • Strong computer skills with knowledge of Google and Microsoft Office Products (Google Slides, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Outlook).
  • Experience using Project Management software (Wrike), preferred.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/Ministry relationships.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

Employment Requirements...

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

What can we offer you?

Some of our benefits package includes:

  • Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance and company paid Dental
  • Company paid life insurance and short term/long term disability insurance
  • Company 401k with a generous company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous paid vacation, sick leave and holiday time off
  • Amazing company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, and industry events.

However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Music Assistant Job ID 10165537 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 18, 2026 Music Assistant Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements The Music Assistant maintains, records, and supplies the flow of music from the in-house music archive to the producers for on-air usage, is involved in the input of music cue reporting and coordination of cue sheet tracking, and helps coordinate music shipments in and out of the Bristol Campus.

Responsibilities

Works with others on the Music staff on the implementation of the company’s music procedures and policies as they pertain to ESPN Content. Organizes and inputs audio assets and music cue metadata into the cue sheet management system for all ESPN networks. Assists in the registration of ESPN-owned copyrights and organization of copyright metadata. Management of the storage, organization, updates, and ingest of digital metadata for tracking and monetization. Edits music cuts for thematic, commercial, and library music packages, as needed. Works with Music Coordinators to organize, compile, and deliver series/seasonal music packages for assigned productions. Assists in the preparation, filing, trafficking, and organization of music licenses and related music documentation. Inputs song and license fee information for cleared third-party songs into the departmental database. Cue sheet support including, but not limited to, the approval of music cue sheets, facilitation of cue sheets to licensors, compliance reporting for all ESPN networks, delivery of ESPN cue sheets to affiliated networks and/or publishing entities. Coordinates updates from production music libraries, tracks usage, and liaises with production contacts at the libraries. Assists in the procurement and monitors the circulation of physical audio media. Maintains the department’s Music Resource website. Responsible for the organization, upkeep, and maintenance of the Music Department’s audio equipment. Manages the conversion of music from physical CDs to audio files for storage in digital archives. Exhibits the ability to train incoming employees on the department’s basic functions, cue sheet management system, and administrative systems currently in use. Assists others on the music team with other music-related projects and tasks, as needed. Assists in the preparation of clearance requests, reporting, correspondence, and licensing agreements, as needed.

Required Qualifications

Must be willing to work second shift and weekends. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Prioritizes projects based on time and resources available. Demonstrates the required organizational and communication skills and abilities. Knowledge of both Mac and PC operating systems required, including proficiency in MS Word and MS Excel.

Preferred Qualifications

Minimum of two years of college with some professional

experience

or understanding related to broadcast, technical operations, library science, or music backgrounds preferred. Ability to operate audio/video equipment and recording equipment, including Cart, ENCO, CD duplication, and various digital media software.

Experience

using Adobe Audition audio editing software or a similar DAW.

Experience

using WordPress or a similar Content Management System. Spanish proficiency. Required

Education

High School Diploma or Equivalent. Preferred

Education

job.title: Part-Time Sports Content Researcher
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Part-Time Sports Content Researcher Job ID 10164761 Location Los Angeles, California, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 13, 2026 Part-Time Sports Content Researcher Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements You have a head for stats, an eye for a great story, and the range as a writer to be creative and succinct -- and your passion for sports is the beating heart that fuels it all. This is the type of person who thrives as a Sports Content Researcher at ESPN. This position will work on NFL Network and other shows produced in Inglewood, CA, and be part of the company’s larger Research & Graphics squad – with staff also located in Bristol, CT and Charlotte, NC. Our mission is simple to define but incredibly complex to deliver: Provide ESPN’s television, audio, digital and social platforms with statistics, context and historical perspectives that make our sports coverage as interesting to the sports fanatic as it is understandable to the casual observer. It’s no easy feat, but we do it 24/7, and we think we do it better than anyone else. If this sounds like you and you’re up for the challenge, please apply today! Ok, it’s true: You’re in the office on Super Bowl Sunday. And for the NFL Draft. And the NFL schedule release. But the office is ESPN’s production center in Inglewood, CA, and you’re surrounded by people who share your passion. You’re a member of a tight squad of like-minded professionals who feed an endless flow of differentiating content that lands across ESPN platforms. Sports Content Researchers tap their existing reservoirs of knowledge and use ESPN’s vast resources – including access to world-class advanced metrics -- to hone in on the why and how of the sporting events that are most important to ESPN and sports fans. The NFL, college football, and the NBA are year-round staples, with significant coverage of the NHL, WNBA, and college basketball. Any sport could deliver the story of the day, week, or month.

Responsibilities

Many people say this, but in Research, it really is true: Sports news is constant, so no two days are the same. On any given day or night, you might: Create original full-screen graphics and anchor lead-ins for live shows such as those on NFL Network or any ESPN platform , using research you’ve done and copy you’ve written; Post the most relevant news on the ESPN BottomLine/NFL Network ticker – from Breaking News alerts to in-depth coverage and putting complex news stories into context; Put your deep knowledge to work to create game previews for shows that are informative, factually accurate, and unique enough that even die-hard sports fans really learn something; Collaborate with colleagues for every element of a studio show, from unearthing little-known facts to quickly bringing up relevant stats when things such as trades, coaching changes, or injuries are announced; Provide real-time updates for anchors and announcers while they are on the air; Flex your storytelling muscles by developing interesting segments, and help your colleagues flesh out their own ideas; ESPN is known for its cutting-edge graphics, and you will be one of the people who develop visually appealing, factually revealing visuals for our TV and digital feeds; Drop everything when news breaks and use your deep knowledge of advanced metrics, analytics, and research tools to create supporting content, often with a deadline of minutes or seconds! Working in Research also means you: Work a schedule that will vary by month and/or season -- you’ll get to dive deeply into sports and have enough variety to keep your days and week fresh;

Experience

professional growth and development – in addition to onboarding, training, and coaching that is a constant, you’ll meet with your supervisor formally twice a month and receive quarterly performance updates. Basic

Qualifications

Minimum of 1 year of related

experience

in sports, statistics, research, or a related field Full availability for this position to work days, nights, weekends, and holidays Broad knowledge of most sports and deep knowledge of the NFL and several others, including awareness of current/historical sports statistics, milestones, news, and events Elite writing and grammar skills. Must have aptitude to research, write air-ready scripts for BottomLine as well as Event and Studio productions Must be able to communicate information accurately Must be able to adhere to strict deadlines and react to breaking news Must be able to follow all Disney, ESPN, and department policies and directives

Preferred Qualifications

Minimum 2 years of

experience

working with statistics in an online, television, or print media environment Fluency in reading, speaking, and writing Spanish Demonstrated track record of training others and/or managing team-based projects Required

Education

High School diploma or equivalent Preferred

Education

College degree or equivalent #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Los Angeles is $42,280 to $56,630 per year based on a 28 hour work week. job.title: Production Assistant (Radio) Part Time
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Production Assistant (Radio) Part Time Job ID 10165318 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 23, 2026 Production Assistant (Radio) Part Time Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements The Part Time Production Assistant (Radio) will support Network programming, through the editing of multiple sources of audio and video for on-air content, podcasts, video simulcasts, and remote events. The Part-time Production Assistant will also operate audioboard equipment for live programming and have an understanding of recording podcasts and video editing. Additionally, part-time Production Assistants may receive opportunities to assist the production team with developing live, on air, multi-platform content.

Responsibilities

Edits actualities, play-by-play highlights and audio from ESPN shows, talk shows, podcasts, and remote events across all ESPN platforms. Will make decisions regarding the most relevant audio cuts for ESPN Audio and other ESPN platforms. Expected to have strong general sports knowledge and knowledge of all current ESPN Audio and ESPN programming, podcasts and play by play events. Catalogues all audio and video extensions that have been edited and distribute the most relevant audio and video clips to ESPN Production teams across all platforms. Expected to load playlists, log commercials, sales, and promotional mentions for live, on-air, and multi-platform broadcasts. Expected to log commercials, sales, and promotional mentions for podcasts, as directed. Monitors multi-platform, on-air product for quality control and adherence to industry standards. Expected to complete regularly scheduled technical training sessions. May be asked to assist ESPN Audio producers by generating story ideas, providing research materials for interviews, and producing show and podcast elements. Will contribute to creative concepts for ESPN Audio and multi-platform content, not limited to talk shows, podcast, and remote events. Will assist ESPN Audio imaging team on promos and/or show production. Work is subject to scrutiny and is closely supervised and reviewed for timeliness, accuracy, and adherence to established procedures.

Required Qualifications

A minimum of 1 year in commercial production and a minimum of 1 year working at a network or local radio facility. Expected to have working knowledge of audio operator board and knowledge of ESPN Audio programming.

Preferred Qualifications

A minimum of 2 years working at a commercially operated, local or network radio facility Required

Education

College degree or Equivalent.​ #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $32,842.50 to $44,007.50 per year based on a 29 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Radio Producer I
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Radio Producer I Job ID 10164892 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 23, 2026 Radio Producer I Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements The Producer I (Radio) is responsible for all content for assigned shows and/or live events. They will format and lead the show meetings with members of the audio and video teams. They are responsible for developing the rundown and ensuring the news of the day is covered in an accurate and entertaining fashion that can be consumed on multi-platforms (audio, video, social). The producer will work with a diverse team including audio and video (when simulcast) production teams, and the hosts to drive the content of the show for multi-platform consumption. Producers will be flexible in their thought process to not only demonstrate creativity but also to be able to adjust to developing news stories. The producer is the central communicator to the talent, audio, and video (when simulcast) production teams for the entirety of the multi-platform broadcast.

Responsibilities

Work with members of production staff, talent, audio, and video show units in developing topics and discussion points for all segments within programming. Utilize consistent brainstorming sessions in building segments that translate on audio, video, and social platforms. Ensure talent has necessary information and support audio and/or video to advance topic discussion. Develop and organize show rundowns accordingly and communicate with audio and video production teams. Lead guest booking efforts and video assignments for shows and live events assigned to. Develop relationships and contacts to secure relevant newsmakers as well as topic contributors both inside and outside ESPN. Provide regular feedback to talent as well as other production staff members (audio and video) on all assignments. Deliver bi-weekly performance conversations to direct reports. Coordinate studio logistics for talent hosting programming outside of main Bristol campus studios. Coordinate all sales elements to be incorporated into programming and catalog for sales team accordingly. Review and communicate assignment schedules for show unit and talent, across all platforms, working with management to ensure proper staffing. Monitor live events and games during live programming and adjust live content to accommodate breaking news situations. Monitor ENPS internal news wires diligently during live programming. Direct screening Production Assistant staff in efforts to secure appropriate and relevant audio and video. Directly communicate any show unit performance issues or concerns to management with appropriate correspondence. Develop and maintain an understanding of all measurement metrics and how it impacts our business and objectives in content presentation. Adhere to all departmental procedures pertaining to scheduling, logging time worked, performance assessment, etc. In order to ensure efficient use of work time, minimize time unnecessarily spent on procedural issues. Expected to assist ESPN Audio imaging team on promos and/or specific show production. Make decisions regarding the most relevant audio and video elements for ESPN Audio and other ESPN platforms. Help develop and integrate the use of interactive social media to drive show content. Use mastery of sports knowledge and news judgment to determine the agenda, concepts, and content of assigned news programs. Has a strong knowledge of all ESPN Audio live events and talk programming. Identify and distribute the most relevant audio and video (where available) to ESPN Production teams across all platforms. Design, edit and load sales teases and features for assigned show. Monitor multi-platform, on-air product for quality control and adherence to industry standards. Expected to complete regularly scheduled technical training sessions.

Required Qualifications

A minimum of 7 years in commercial production and a minimum of 5 years working at a network or local radio facility. Expected to have working knowledge of audio operator board and knowledge of all ESPN Audio and video programming. Ability to work early mornings, evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays. Must work quickly and positively on tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Ability to identify and cultivate compelling storylines for multi-platform presentations. Ability to work with and establish relationships with a diverse staff.

Preferred Qualifications

A minimum of 7 years working at a commercially operated, local, or network radio facility Required

Education

College degree or equivalent. #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $80,700 to $108,100 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with ESPN Productions, Inc, which is part of a business we call ESPN. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. ESPN Productions, Inc is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. Hiring Process Where Does Your Story Begin? Explore Disney Careers and the Life at Disney blog to learn about all the amazing opportunities waiting to be discovered at The Walt Disney Company. Be Part of the Story There are many different brands and businesses to explore. Once you've found the opportunity that is right for you, take the next step by completing your application. The Next Chapter Once you've applied, you will receive an email allowing you to access your candidate dashboard. Create your login and make sure to check your dashboard often to see your application progress. Explore this Location Bristol, CT The Heart of Connecticut Bristol, Connecticut is just two hours from Boston and New York and just an hour from the shoreline. From the natural beauty of picturesque hills and fall foliage, to the high tech satellite dishes of ESPN, Bristol’s “City sized” with a small town vibe, offering wonderful memories no matter your pace. job.title: Security Specialist
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Security Specialist Job ID 10164561 Location Southington, Connecticut, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 17, 2026 Security Specialist Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements The Global Security & Safety department is dedicated to protecting the safety, security, and well-being of ESPN employees, guests, facilities, and assets. Our team provides security and safety services across ESPN-owned and leased facilities, as well as remote events around the world. If you are a customer-focused security professional who can remain calm under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and provide a welcoming presence while maintaining a safe and secure environment, we encourage you to apply and Be A Part Of The Story!

Responsibilities

Greet, screen, and assist employees, visitors, vendors, and guests in accordance with established security procedures. Enforce company security, access control, and parking policies consistently, professionally, and fairly. Monitor ESPN facilities and identify, address, and report potential safety and security hazards. Perform access control duties at high-traffic exterior posts, including vehicle and truck inspections in accordance with established procedures. Conduct X-ray screening of packages and mail following required certification and operating procedures. Monitor fire alarm control panels, interpret alarm indicators, determine the type and location of emergencies, and initiate the appropriate response within established timeframes. Complete and issue hot work permits and perform required inspections and fire watch assignments in designated hot work areas. Respond to medical, fire, security, and other safety-related emergencies and incidents in accordance with training and established protocols. Prepare clear, accurate, and comprehensive incident and security reports. Provide a professional security presence at on-campus and off-campus events. Assist with traffic and crowd management by operating gates, establishing barricades, and directing vehicle and pedestrian traffic. Perform routine security system checks and provide general assistance and information to employees and visitors. Assist with scheduling maintenance for company fleet vehicles and operate company transportation as required. Support Command Post and Global Operations Center operations and complete additional security-related assignments as needed. Basic

Qualifications

Minimum of one year of customer service or related professional experience. Minimum of two years of

experience

in security, law enforcement, public safety, military security, or a related field. Valid Connecticut Driver's License and Connecticut Guard Card. Ability to successfully complete required pre-employment screening, including applicable background, DMV, and drug screening requirements. Flexibility to work varying schedules, including weekends, holidays, overtime, and adjusted days off as business needs require. Strong customer service, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and make effective decisions in high-pressure or emergency situations. Ability to take command of challenging situations while remaining calm, professional, and diplomatic. Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively with employees, guests, leadership, emergency responders, and other partners. Ability to work independently and carry out

responsibilities

within established policies, procedures, and guidelines. Professional demeanor and the ability to represent ESPN appropriately in all interactions. Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook and Word. Ability to operate company vehicles and transportation as required. Required

Education

High School Diploma or equivalent. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $44,700 to $59,800 per year. The base pay actually offered will into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Supervising Director
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Supervising Director Job ID 10164749 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 18, 2026 Supervising Director Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements This Supervising Director role is responsible for the supervision of personnel and projects across Studio, Remote and/or Event productions, as well as the direction of the department’s most complex and highest profile productions. The Supervising Director will work within the department to maintain the quality of presentations through oversight while providing direction across multiple departments through collaboration. In addition, will work in conjunction with Coordinating Producers to provide support and guidance on content philosophy and execution. The Supervising Director should possess strong production and technical knowledge, and demonstrate leadership qualities in all interactions and decisions. The Supervising Director will assist in the development of Director s, Associate Director s and Stage Managers.

Responsibilities

• Oversight of multiple studio, remote and/or REMI production projects. • Collaborates with production partners to launch productions and maintain standards, plus identifies workflows to suit changing business needs. • Organizes and leads meetings for assigned projects, both within and across departments, to develop production and operational strategies. • Proficient with all aspects of set design, animation packages, show budgets and remote planning. • Has expert ability to direct the broadest possible range of productions including ESPN’s highest profile shows. • Responsible for staff oversight with concentration toward Associate Director s and Stage Managers. • Provides consistent and comprehensive feedback to Director s, Associate Director s and Stage Managers. • Establishes regular feedback and review sessions with all members of Directing. • Participates in the weekly Directing management meeting. • Leads teams to drive innovation and new workflows that embrace technology. • Builds monthly schedules for Director s, Associate Director s and Stage Managers. • Identifies, implements and tracks staff development opportunities. • Contributes to the team’s recruitment and retention objectives. • Holds staff accountable to maintain the Directing Department performance standards.

Qualifications

• Minimum 7 years directing

experience

with demonstrated leadership and mentorship skills. • In-depth knowledge and proficiency with live directing. • In-depth knowledge and proficiency with production equipment and facilities. • Strong ability to think and react quickly to rapidly changing situations in a high pressure environment. • Strong interpersonal skills. • Travel may be required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Demonstrated proficiency with all aspects of set design, animation packages, show budgets and remote planning. • Appreciation of popular culture and assistance in defining ESPN viewer tastes. • Ability to assess and evaluate job performance, leadership skills, directing skills, forward thinking. • Bilingual (English/Spanish). Required

Education

• High school diploma Preferred

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in broadcasting, communications, journalism or a closely related field. #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, Connecticut is $170,900.00 to $229,100.00 per year based on a 40 hour work week.
