Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

About you

You are an experienced engineering leader with a strong software engineering background and a track record of leading teams responsible for business-critical products and platforms.

You combine strong people leadership with credible technical judgement. You are comfortable setting direction, helping teams make complex engineering decisions and remaining close enough to the technology to understand the health, risks and opportunities within the platforms you own.

You understand that engineering leadership is about more than delivery. You think about the long-term health of technology: architecture, reliability, security, scalability, developer experience, operational performance and the ability of teams to evolve their systems sustainably.

You are comfortable working closely with Product and business stakeholders, translating priorities into engineering plans and making thoughtful trade-offs between new capabilities, technical investment and operational needs.

You are also motivated by developing people and teams. You create clear ownership, coach engineers, build capability and create an environment where people can challenge, learn and take increasing responsibility.

About the team

Commercial Technology is part of the Internal Products group within FT Product & Technology. We are a multidisciplinary group of Engineers, Product Managers and Business Analysts responsible for building and operating the technology platforms that support the FT’s commercial capabilities across Marketing, Sales, Service and Commercial Data.

We are undertaking a significant evolution of our commercial technology landscape, bringing these capabilities together around a more connected Salesforce platform and establishing a strong foundation for how our commercial teams engage with customers and use data.

In Marketing & Commercial Data, we are evolving our marketing technology landscape towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360, while continuing to operate and transition from established platforms including Bloomreach, Marketo and Legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud products for B2B & B2C marketing.

In Sales & Service, we are consolidating a number of Salesforce CRM orgs with their associated processes and procedures into a leaner Commercial Technology estate, utilising data available to us via Data 360, into a setup that aligns with the FT’s future commercial capabilities and setup.

In Commercial Platform, we are establishing a centre of excellence at the heart of the commercial workflow, tasked with ensuring the security, health and viability of our day-to-day commercial operation and providing a primary support route for our business users

The Engineering Manager will lead one of the engineering teams within Commercial Technology, working closely with Product, Senior Engineers, other Engineering Managers and the wider Commercial Technology leadership team.

Our Technology

Our Commercial Technology landscape is evolving. Technologies and platforms within or interacting with Marketing & Commercial Data include:

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next (Advanced Edition)
  • Salesforce Data 360
  • Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud
  • Sales Collaboration & Enablement Tooling
  • Bloomreach
  • Marketo
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • APIs and integration technologies
  • AWS Technologies
  • Data platforms and integrations
  • CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
  • GitHub
  • Monitoring and observability tooling
  • Jira & Confluence

You do not need experience with all of these technologies to apply. We are particularly interested in engineering leaders who can lead teams through technology change and help engineers develop the skills required for an evolving platform.

What you’ll work on

As Engineering Manager within Commercial Technology, you will lead the engineering team responsible for the delivery, performance and continuous evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data capability.

You will be accountable for ensuring the engineering team is effectively organised, supported and resourced to deliver business outcomes. This includes leading delivery and planning, managing engineering capacity and priorities, building strong relationships with Product, Programme and business stakeholders, and ensuring risks, dependencies and resource constraints are understood and actively managed.

You will be leading a team through a significant transformation of the FT's commercial technology landscape, balancing the delivery of new capabilities with the operational health of existing platforms, the development of engineering capability and the longer-term evolution of the Commercial Technology estate.

You will remain close to the technology and provide credible engineering leadership. You will support technical decision-making, challenge approaches where appropriate and ensure the team understands the architecture, risks and operational health of the systems it owns.

You will also work with Principal Engineers and other senior technical leaders on decisions that extend beyond your team's boundaries, ensuring local engineering decisions contribute to a coherent and sustainable Commercial Technology landscape.

You will report to the Principal Engineer for the Commercial Technology domain.

Your responsibilities will include

Engineering Delivery & Planning

  • Own engineering delivery across the Marketing & Commercial Data capability, ensuring agreed business outcomes are delivered effectively and sustainably.
  • Work with Product, Programme, the Technical Lead and wider Commercial Technology leadership to shape priorities, roadmaps and achievable delivery plans.
  • Own the allocation of engineering capacity, balancing delivery commitments with operational needs, technical improvement, team capacity and longer-term capability development.
  • Identify and actively manage delivery risks, dependencies, resource constraints and capability gaps, escalating where necessary.
  • Continuously improve engineering processes, development workflows, documentation and ways of working.

People Leadership & Team Health

  • Leading, supporting and developing engineers, admins and specialists across Marketing Technology and Commercial Data through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback and career development.
  • Setting clear expectations for individual and team performance
  • Create an inclusive, supportive and psychologically safe environment, building a strong engineering culture based on ownership, collaboration, continuous learning and shared accountability.
  • Manage team capacity and sustainable workloads, supporting the wellbeing, effectiveness and long-term development of the team.
  • Identify skills and capability gaps and work with engineers and wider engineering leadership to develop the capabilities required for our future platform.
  • Lead recruitment, onboarding and organisational change within the capability, ensuring engineers are supported through changes to technology, roles and ways of working.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Technical Lead – Marketing & Commercial Data, Together you will provide the complementary people, delivery and technical leadership required to operate and evolve our Marketing & Commercial Data capability successfully.
  • Own the organisational conditions required to execute the technical strategy, ensuring teams have the skills, capacity and ways of working required to deliver it successfully.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and decisions while maintaining clear accountability with the Technical Lead for technical direction, architecture, engineering standards and solution design.
  • Build strong relationships with Product, Programme, business stakeholders and other technology teams, providing clear visibility of delivery, capacity, operational health, risks and dependencies.
  • Work closely with Engineering Managers and Technical Leads across Commercial Technology to coordinate shared priorities, dependencies and engineering practices.
  • Work effectively with external technology partners and delivery vendors where required, ensuring they integrate successfully with FT engineering teams and delivery practices.
  • Represent the needs, constraints and capabilities of the engineering team in programme, planning and stakeholder discussions.

Operational Readiness & Engineering Excellence

  • Be accountable for ensuring Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities are operationally ready, supportable and sustainable throughout their lifecycle.
  • Ensure operational requirements are built into delivery, including observability, monitoring, resilience, documentation, support models, knowledge transfer and clear ownership.
  • Work closely with the Commercial Platform team to ensure new and changed capabilities can be effectively supported within the wider Commercial Technology operating model.
  • Ensure the team remains engaged in the ongoing health of the capabilities it owns, providing specialist domain or engineering expertise when required.
  • Lead the Marketing & Commercial Data team's response to incidents affecting capabilities it owns, working within the Commercial Technology incident-management model led by Commercial Platform.
  • Ensure operational health, capability risks, technical debt and engineering improvements are visible and prioritised alongside product and programme delivery.
  • Ensure learning from incidents, operational issues and business-user feedback is incorporated into future delivery and continuous improvement.

Change & Platform Evolution

  • Lead the engineering team through the evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology landscape.
  • Support the transition from legacy marketing platforms, including Bloomreach and Marketo, towards the FT’s strategic Salesforce-based marketing and data capabilities.
  • Own the people, skills and team structure required to support the transition to the future Marketing & Commercial Data platform, ensuring the capability can be sustainably owned beyond programme delivery.
  • Work with the Technical Lead, Commercial Platform and wider Commercial Technology leadership to introduce platform changes sustainably and maintain operational continuity.

Leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Experience managing or leading software engineers within a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Strong coaching, feedback and people-development skills, with experience helping engineers progress in their careers.
  • Experience leading engineering delivery across complex platforms or products.
  • Experience balancing strategic programme delivery with operational responsibilities and longer-term engineering priorities.
  • Strong understanding of engineering practices associated with secure, resilient and scalable production systems.
  • Experience supporting teams responsible for operating and continuously improving business-critical technology.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in partnership with senior technical leaders, architects or Technical Leads.
  • Comfortable operating across Product, Engineering, Data, Programme and business stakeholders.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, organisational change and evolving priorities.
  • Experience leading teams through significant platform or technology transformation would be beneficial.
  • Experience with Salesforce, marketing technology, customer data platforms or enterprise SaaS ecosystems would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Characteristics we value

  • A people-first approach to engineering leadership.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Empathy, emotional intelligence and a commitment to developing others.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.
  • Pragmatism and sound judgement when balancing business, people and engineering needs.
  • The ability to create clarity and structure in complex or ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn.
  • An appreciation for strong engineering practices, operational excellence and sustainable technology.
  • Calmness under pressure and the ability to lead teams through challenging situations.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to work across organisational and technology boundaries.
  • An interest in how technology and data can enable better customer experiences and commercial outcomes.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

In Sales & Service, we are consolidating a number of Salesforce CRM orgs with their associated processes and procedures into a leaner Commercial Technology estate, utilising data available to us via Data 360, into a setup that aligns with the FT’s future commercial capabilities and setup.

In Commercial Platform, we are establishing a centre of excellence at the heart of the commercial workflow, tasked with ensuring the security, health and viability of our day-to-day commercial operation and providing a primary support route for our business users

The Engineering Manager will lead one of the engineering teams within Commercial Technology, working closely with Product, Senior Engineers, other Engineering Managers and the wider Commercial Technology leadership team.

Our Technology

Our Commercial Technology landscape is evolving. Technologies and platforms within or interacting with Marketing & Commercial Data include:

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next (Advanced Edition)
  • Salesforce Data 360
  • Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud
  • Sales Collaboration & Enablement Tooling
  • Bloomreach
  • Marketo
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • APIs and integration technologies
  • AWS Technologies
  • Data platforms and integrations
  • CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
  • GitHub
  • Monitoring and observability tooling
  • Jira & Confluence

You do not need experience with all of these technologies to apply. We are particularly interested in engineering leaders who can lead teams through technology change and help engineers develop the skills required for an evolving platform.

What you’ll work on

As Engineering Manager within Commercial Technology, you will lead the engineering team responsible for the delivery, performance and continuous evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data capability.

You will be accountable for ensuring the engineering team is effectively organised, supported and resourced to deliver business outcomes. This includes leading delivery and planning, managing engineering capacity and priorities, building strong relationships with Product, Programme and business stakeholders, and ensuring risks, dependencies and resource constraints are understood and actively managed.

You will be leading a team through a significant transformation of the FT's commercial technology landscape, balancing the delivery of new capabilities with the operational health of existing platforms, the development of engineering capability and the longer-term evolution of the Commercial Technology estate.

You will remain close to the technology and provide credible engineering leadership. You will support technical decision-making, challenge approaches where appropriate and ensure the team understands the architecture, risks and operational health of the systems it owns.

You will also work with Principal Engineers and other senior technical leaders on decisions that extend beyond your team's boundaries, ensuring local engineering decisions contribute to a coherent and sustainable Commercial Technology landscape.

You will report to the Principal Engineer for the Commercial Technology domain.

Your responsibilities will include

Engineering Delivery & Planning

  • Own engineering delivery across the Marketing & Commercial Data capability, ensuring agreed business outcomes are delivered effectively and sustainably.
  • Work with Product, Programme, the Technical Lead and wider Commercial Technology leadership to shape priorities, roadmaps and achievable delivery plans.
  • Own the allocation of engineering capacity, balancing delivery commitments with operational needs, technical improvement, team capacity and longer-term capability development.
  • Identify and actively manage delivery risks, dependencies, resource constraints and capability gaps, escalating where necessary.
  • Continuously improve engineering processes, development workflows, documentation and ways of working.

People Leadership & Team Health

  • Leading, supporting and developing engineers, admins and specialists across Marketing Technology and Commercial Data through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback and career development.
  • Setting clear expectations for individual and team performance
  • Create an inclusive, supportive and psychologically safe environment, building a strong engineering culture based on ownership, collaboration, continuous learning and shared accountability.
  • Manage team capacity and sustainable workloads, supporting the wellbeing, effectiveness and long-term development of the team.
  • Identify skills and capability gaps and work with engineers and wider engineering leadership to develop the capabilities required for our future platform.
  • Lead recruitment, onboarding and organisational change within the capability, ensuring engineers are supported through changes to technology, roles and ways of working.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Technical Lead – Marketing & Commercial Data, Together you will provide the complementary people, delivery and technical leadership required to operate and evolve our Marketing & Commercial Data capability successfully.
  • Own the organisational conditions required to execute the technical strategy, ensuring teams have the skills, capacity and ways of working required to deliver it successfully.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and decisions while maintaining clear accountability with the Technical Lead for technical direction, architecture, engineering standards and solution design.
  • Build strong relationships with Product, Programme, business stakeholders and other technology teams, providing clear visibility of delivery, capacity, operational health, risks and dependencies.
  • Work closely with Engineering Managers and Technical Leads across Commercial Technology to coordinate shared priorities, dependencies and engineering practices.
  • Work effectively with external technology partners and delivery vendors where required, ensuring they integrate successfully with FT engineering teams and delivery practices.
  • Represent the needs, constraints and capabilities of the engineering team in programme, planning and stakeholder discussions.

Operational Readiness & Engineering Excellence

  • Be accountable for ensuring Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities are operationally ready, supportable and sustainable throughout their lifecycle.
  • Ensure operational requirements are built into delivery, including observability, monitoring, resilience, documentation, support models, knowledge transfer and clear ownership.
  • Work closely with the Commercial Platform team to ensure new and changed capabilities can be effectively supported within the wider Commercial Technology operating model.
  • Ensure the team remains engaged in the ongoing health of the capabilities it owns, providing specialist domain or engineering expertise when required.
  • Lead the Marketing & Commercial Data team's response to incidents affecting capabilities it owns, working within the Commercial Technology incident-management model led by Commercial Platform.
  • Ensure operational health, capability risks, technical debt and engineering improvements are visible and prioritised alongside product and programme delivery.
  • Ensure learning from incidents, operational issues and business-user feedback is incorporated into future delivery and continuous improvement.

Change & Platform Evolution

  • Lead the engineering team through the evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology landscape.
  • Support the transition from legacy marketing platforms, including Bloomreach and Marketo, towards the FT’s strategic Salesforce-based marketing and data capabilities.
  • Own the people, skills and team structure required to support the transition to the future Marketing & Commercial Data platform, ensuring the capability can be sustainably owned beyond programme delivery.
  • Work with the Technical Lead, Commercial Platform and wider Commercial Technology leadership to introduce platform changes sustainably and maintain operational continuity.

Leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Experience managing or leading software engineers within a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Strong coaching, feedback and people-development skills, with experience helping engineers progress in their careers.
  • Experience leading engineering delivery across complex platforms or products.
  • Experience balancing strategic programme delivery with operational responsibilities and longer-term engineering priorities.
  • Strong understanding of engineering practices associated with secure, resilient and scalable production systems.
  • Experience supporting teams responsible for operating and continuously improving business-critical technology.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in partnership with senior technical leaders, architects or Technical Leads.
  • Comfortable operating across Product, Engineering, Data, Programme and business stakeholders.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, organisational change and evolving priorities.
  • Experience leading teams through significant platform or technology transformation would be beneficial.
  • Experience with Salesforce, marketing technology, customer data platforms or enterprise SaaS ecosystems would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Characteristics we value

  • A people-first approach to engineering leadership.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Empathy, emotional intelligence and a commitment to developing others.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.
  • Pragmatism and sound judgement when balancing business, people and engineering needs.
  • The ability to create clarity and structure in complex or ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn.
  • An appreciation for strong engineering practices, operational excellence and sustainable technology.
  • Calmness under pressure and the ability to lead teams through challenging situations.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to work across organisational and technology boundaries.
  • An interest in how technology and data can enable better customer experiences and commercial outcomes.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

  • Annual bonus scheme
  • 25 days paid leave
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Enhanced Parental Leave policy
  • Food Allowance
  • Multisport Card
  • Both in house and external training programs
  • Your own training dedicated budget (for conferences, courses etc.)

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

job.title: IT Asset Manager
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide. At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world. In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing. Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere. Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced IT Asset & Lifecycle Manager to establish and lead a consistent approach to the management of our technology assets across their full lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role with the opportunity to shape and mature our approach to managing software licences and hardware. You will bring together information, processes and stakeholders across the technology estate, helping us make better-informed decisions about ownership, utilisation, lifecycle planning and cost.

You will establish the foundations of a consistent IT Asset Management capability. This will include defining the operating model, developing a reliable system of record, creating practical processes and supporting teams to adopt them. You will use data and collaboration to identify opportunities for improvement, strengthen governance and deliver measurable value across the asset lifecycle.

The role covers both Software Asset Management (SAM) and Hardware Asset Management (HAM). You will work closely with Infrastructure & Operations, Engineering, Cyber Security, Procurement, Finance, Legal, HR and suppliers to improve visibility, control costs, reduce risk and make better decisions about our technology estate.

What you will do

Build and lead the ITAM capability

  • Define and implement the organisation’s IT Asset Management approach, including policies, standards, processes, roles and responsibilities.
  • Establish a practical and trusted system of record for hardware, software, licences, subscriptions, contracts and ownership information.
  • Define an asset taxonomy, data standards and minimum information requirements, then lead data clean-up and reconciliation across existing sources.
  • Establish clear ownership for assets and lifecycle activities across technology teams and the wider business.
  • Create governance and reporting that gives leaders confidence in the state of the estate, the risks we carry and the decisions we need to make.
  • Develop procedures that are proportionate, easy to follow and embedded into day-to-day technology and procurement processes.

Manage the software and licence estate

  • Build a complete view of software licences, subscriptions, entitlements, contracts, renewal dates, owners, users and costs.
  • Lead regular reviews of software usage and entitlement to identify unused, underused, duplicate or unsuitable licences.
  • Identify and deliver opportunities to reduce avoidable spend, including licence harvesting, right-sizing, consolidation and improved renewal decisions.
  • Support software licence compliance and audit readiness.
  • Provide clear recommendations on whether to renew, renegotiate, replace, consolidate or retire software and services.
  • Improve the connection between software ownership, business need, usage, cost and risk.

Manage the hardware lifecycle

  • Define and manage the end-to-end hardware lifecycle, from demand and procurement through deployment, assignment, support, return, reuse, refresh, retirement and secure disposal.
  • Improve the accuracy and completeness of the hardware inventory across laptops, desktops, mobile devices, peripherals, meeting-room technology and other relevant equipment.
  • Establish clear processes for new starters, leavers, transfers, replacements, lost devices, repairs, returns and equipment held in stock.
  • Improve asset recovery and ensure equipment is returned, securely wiped, reused or disposed of appropriately.
  • Develop lifecycle and refresh plans that identify ageing, unsupported, high-risk or uneconomic equipment before it becomes an operational problem.
  • Ensure asset records are updated as part of normal fulfilment, joiner, mover, leaver, change and disposal processes.

Identify and reduce risk

  • Assess the current state of IT asset management and create a prioritised improvement plan.
  • Identify gaps relating to ownership, data quality, licensing, unsupported technology, security, contracts, disposal and financial control.
  • Maintain an asset risk and issues register, with clear owners, actions and target dates.
  • Work with Cyber Security to ensure asset data supports vulnerability management, endpoint security, access reviews and incident response.
  • Escalate material risks and provide clear options for their treatment, including the impact of taking no action.

Embed the process across the organisation

  • Work with teams to make asset management part of how technology is requested, purchased, deployed, changed and retired.
  • Define who is accountable for each stage of the lifecycle and make responsibilities clear to operational teams and budget holders.
  • Train and support teams in the processes and tools they need to use.
  • Monitor adherence, challenge poor data or process compliance and improve the approach based on experience.
  • Build strong working relationships with Procurement, Finance, Legal, HR, Technology teams and suppliers.

Reporting and commercial management

  • Produce regular reporting on asset coverage, data quality, licence utilisation, renewals, lifecycle risk, compliance, inventory accuracy and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Provide concise insight for senior leaders, including decisions required, risks, trends and benefits delivered.
  • Support technology budgeting and forecasting by linking assets and services to owners, contracts, demand and cost.
  • Contribute to supplier and contract reviews, including performance, pricing, usage, renewal options and commercial risks.
  • Track and report the value delivered through licence optimisation, process improvement, asset reuse and better lifecycle planning.

What you will achieve

During your first 6–12 months, you will be expected to:

  • Establish a clear baseline of the current hardware, software, licence and subscription estate.
  • Agree ownership and accountability for the most important asset classes and suppliers.
  • Put in place a prioritised ITAM improvement roadmap, including the highest-value savings and highest-risk gaps.
  • Implement core lifecycle processes for procurement, deployment, allocation, renewal, recovery, refresh and disposal.
  • Improve the accuracy and usefulness of the existing asset data and system of record.
  • Establish a forward-looking renewal and lifecycle calendar.
  • Identify and realise early savings from unused, duplicated or poorly managed licences and services.
  • Introduce regular reporting for Technology leadership, Finance, Procurement and other key stakeholders.
  • Build enough confidence in the data and controls that decisions can be made based on evidence rather than assumptions.

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience in IT Asset Management, Software Asset Management, Hardware Asset Management or a closely related role.
  • Experience of building or materially improving an ITAM capability in an organisation where processes, data and ownership are not yet mature.
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end hardware and software asset lifecycle.
  • Practical experience managing software licences, SaaS subscriptions, contracts, renewals, entitlements and usage data.
  • Experience identifying cost-saving opportunities and turning them into measurable outcomes.
  • Experience creating and embedding policies, processes, controls and operating procedures.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to reconcile imperfect data and turn it into clear insight and action.
  • Experience working with IT, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Cyber Security, HR, suppliers and senior stakeholders.
  • The confidence to challenge existing practices, clarify ownership and hold people to agreed processes.
  • Excellent organisation and communication skills, with the ability to move between detail and senior-level recommendations.
  • A pragmatic approach: able to build the right level of control without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Desirable experience

  • Experience with ServiceNow, Freshservice, Flexera, Snow, Xensam or similar ITAM, SAM, HAM, CMDB or discovery tools.
  • Experience integrating asset data with endpoint management, identity, procurement, finance, HR or IT service management platforms.
  • Knowledge of software licensing models from major vendors such as Microsoft, Adobe, Oracle, IBM, Atlassian or similar.
  • Experience managing assets across multiple locations, countries or business units.
  • Experience supporting software audits, regulatory reviews or security assurance activity.
  • Experience using automated discovery, SaaS management, usage analytics or AI-enabled tools to improve software visibility and licence optimisation 
  • ITIL Foundation, IAITAM or equivalent IT Asset Management experience or certification.

Why this role matters

This role will give the organisation a much clearer view of what technology we own, what we use, what it costs, who is accountable for it and what risks we carry. It will help us avoid unnecessary spend, improve operational control, strengthen security and make better long-term decisions about our technology estate.

It is an opportunity to create a capability with visible impact across the organisation — combining operational improvement, commercial value, risk reduction and better service to our people.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams. 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

About FT Live:

Financial Times Live (FT Live) is the conferences and events division of the Financial Times newspaper and its group publications. Our mission is to bring our global executive audiences the very latest in knowledge and opinion, and connect them to one another.

Chaired by senior FT journalists, the 200-plus core events, strategic forums and digital webinars organised by FT Live every year gather pre-eminent public and private sector decision-makers, visionaries and strategists from the world’s most important economies and industries for agenda-setting debates that cover the key issues of our time.From unique experiences such as the FTWeekend Festival to our senior-level business summits such as the award winning Global Boardroom and Women at the Top, FT Live has become one of the FT Group’s most successful and fastest-growing divisions, and is at the forefront of the FT’s accelerated development as an essential, interactive information source across numerous platforms.

The role 

The Marketing Assistant, Events will support the Marketing Team to execute campaigns and ensure that we consistently attract the highest quality attendees to our events, deliver delegate revenue and successfully implement FT Live’s delegate growth strategy.

Key responsibilities

Campaign Planning & Execution:

Assisting with outbound marketing campaigns across a range of channels:

  • Building and updating event websites using the CMS
  • Building acquisition emails
  • Building retention emails
  • Creating and distributing assets for the team's advocacy marketing efforts across sponsors, speakers and supporting partners
  • Creating social assets on Canva
  • Assisting with post-event reports
  • Extracting and analysing data, identifying key trends and translating findings into actionable insights to improve campaign performance.

The Roles

Newsletters are key to the FT’s strategy, engaging our subscribers and expanding the reach of our journalism. We are looking for two editors to join our newsletter team in London. In this role you’ll be editing, writing and developing newsletters across multiple topics, in collaboration with our global team of reporters, columnists and editors.

You will be confident editing, writing and curating top-quality global journalism, as well as building relationships across a newsroom spanning multiple countries. You have excellent digital and analytical skills, understanding of the newsletter medium and ideas for innovation. You will be aware of media and audience developments. You will be skilled at writing strong subject lines, calls to action, and accurate, concise, engaging summaries of complex stories across many topics.

One newsletter editor role is a permanent position. One is a 12 month fixed term contract. You can apply for either or both opportunities through this listing. Please indicate in your application form whether you are interested in both opportunities or only one.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Writing, editing and curating a variety of newsletters
  • Using strong editorial judgment, alongside audience data, to inform your decisions
  • Continuously identifying opportunities for improving our newsletters, conducting smart experiments to test ideas and giving recommendations on potential changes
  • Contributing to the development and piloting of potential newsletter launches
  • Helping us to grow our newsletter audience and working with the audience engagement team to promote newsletters
  • Working collaboratively with other members of the newsletter team and cross-functionally with other departments to execute the FT’s newsletter strategy 

 

Your Skills

  • Excellent editing, writing and organisational abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure to tight deadlines
  • Experience working with data to inform editorial decisions
  • A passion for and experience with newsletters
  • Understanding of unique product and design challenges in newsletters and ability to develop innovative ideas to improve the audience experience
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working collaboratively with a variety of stakeholders

 

Your Expertise

  • Knowledge of business, markets, economics, finance, politics, international affairs, arts and culture
  • Knowledge of professional services–including management consulting and accounting–is of special interest
  • Knowledge of the Gulf is of special interest
  • Our newsletters cover a broad range of topics, and we don’t expect candidates to have expertise on all of them. So the ability to learn quickly about areas where you have less experience editing is essential

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Tuesday 1st December 2026.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

The night news operation must work closely with the New York desk, co-ordinating coverage so important stories are handled smoothly between time zones.

The role is based in London and involves evening shifts and regular Sunday working. The existing pattern is four night shifts a week, but we are open to discussing different working arrangements with candidates that would ensure the needs of the news operation are met.

  • Lead the day-to-day administration and delivery of US employee benefits, including medical, dental, retirement and other benefit programs.

  • Experience in a People Generalist, HR Operations or similar role, with a strong understanding of US HR practices and employee lifecycle processes.

This role involves working on intricate products that directly aid journalism production at the FT. Work often starts without a clear brief or defined project. You will need to be comfortable investigating problems, grasping detailed workflows, and helping decide the appropriate course.

job.description:

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

 

About the Role

The Financial Times is globally renowned for premium business and financial journalism. Behind our world-class reporting is a highly sophisticated technological ecosystem that ensures our journalism is structured, discoverable, and rapidly delivered to support a global subscriber base.

We are looking for a highly technical Senior Product Manager to join FT Core and help shape the product strategy for our Content & Metadata (C&M) Platform. The C&M platform acts as the central nervous system between our content creation (Spark CMS) and our downstream consumers—powering FT.com, our mobile apps, Specialist publications, B2B syndication, and new AI-driven experiences.

This is a senior Individual Contributor (IC) role that requires deep technical curiosity and domain expertise. You will not have direct reports; instead, you will partner closely with a Principal Engineer and three Tech Leads, collectively guiding the product vision for an execution team of 12-13 engineers. You will also collaborate extensively across FT Core (specifically Access & Identity), Editorial Tech, Data Science, Commercial (B2B), Editorial, and Legal to ensure our metadata and content pipelines serve diverse and complex needs.

 

What You Will Do

  • Drive Platform Strategy: Co-create and champion the product roadmap for the Content & Metadata platform in partnership with engineering leadership, ensuring FT journalism is treated as a highly structured, reusable, and discoverable asset.
  • Deep Technical Partnership: Work daily with a Principal Engineer and Tech Leads. Your deep understanding of content platforms, API-driven architectures, document stores (MongoDB), and graph databases (Neo4j) will be critical in making collaborative architectural tradeoffs and earning the team's trust.
  • Shape Knowledge Management & Ontologies: Collaborate to guide the evolution of the FT’s Knowledge Graph, helping ensure content is semantically segmented, enriched with accurate metadata, and connected to power advanced search and AI use cases.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the bridge between highly technical engineering teams and cross-functional business stakeholders, translating B2B commercial goals, editorial requirements, and legal compliance into actionable, shared technical goals.

 

Key Focus Areas & Challenges We're Tackling Next

You will be joining a team working on some of the most complex and exciting content architecture challenges in the industry. Over the next 6-12 months, you will help us tackle:

  • The Shift to "Knowledge Component" APIs: We are transitioning from delivering "whole articles" to exposing discrete, machine-readable components. You will help us solve the challenge of achieving near 100% representation of all journalism components (including custom code and graphics) downstream so that AI models, search algorithms, and B2B partners can consume granular data without losing context.
  • Building an In-House AI "Knowledge Layer": You will collaborate with the team to develop in-house, AI-powered natural language processing capabilities that enhance content understanding, metadata enrichment, and knowledge discovery. This involves navigating the complexities of low-latency, real-time tagging.
  • Leveraging the "Abstract Syntax Tree" Foundation: We recently implemented a unified "Abstract Syntax Tree" foundation across our publishing stack. You will get to capitalize on this architecture to collaboratively phase out legacy capabilities (like the Internal Content API) and rapidly introduce new, universally supported content formats.
  • Enabling Production AI Access: You will partner closely with the Access & Identity platform to figure out how best to supply the structured schema and Knowledge Component APIs required to build a production-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, paving the way for secure LLM integrations.

 

What We Are Looking For

  • Domain Expertise: Extensive product management experience within a media company's content platform, or deeply relevant experience working for a vendor of content/metadata management solutions.
  • Technical Depth: You aren't just comfortable around engineers; you are excited by the technical details. You must have practical experience with document databases (e.g., MongoDB), graph databases (e.g., Neo4j), API design, and content distribution technologies like RSS feeds.
  • Taxonomy & Ontology Fluency: A strong, proven background in taxonomies, ontologies, and semantic content structuring.
  • Search & Content Discovery: A good understanding of modern search technologies, information retrieval, and content discovery, including how metadata, semantic search, and AI-powered capabilities improve content accessibility.
  • Senior IC Capabilities: Exceptional ability to lead by influence. You can confidently debate technical details with Principal Engineers while effectively communicating strategic value to commercial and editorial leadership.
  • Systems Thinker: A natural ability to navigate complex, multi-domain environments and understand how a change in the upstream CMS impacts downstream AI models, B2B feeds, and consumer apps.

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Program

  • Enhanced Parental Leave policy
  • Food Allowance
  • Multisport Card
  • Both in house and external training programs

job.title: Singapore Correspondent
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI. 

 

The Role

The Financial Times is seeking a Singapore Correspondent to cover one of the world’s most important financial centres. Normally operating solo - although in close cooperation with the SE Asia correspondent and the finance team around the world - the role covers everything from investment banks to oil trading and local politics. For an enterprising reporter, the scope is considerable.

Singapore has evolved into one of Asia’s main financial hubs and a global centre for commodity trading. All the dealmaking is of core interest to the FT, as are the numerous entrepreneurs and family offices - most especially from China - that have set up shop. The city-state attracts its share of colourful characters and dubious behaviour: from the collapse of Barings to the Wirecard scandal, significant parts of the action were in Singapore.

The city is not just a centre for making deals; it is an important player itself. Temasek and GIC are role models for many of the world’s sovereign wealth funds and their activity is another important source of stories. Singapore’s much-admired social model, and the tensions that exist in Singaporean society nonetheless, often interest the outside world.

The Singapore correspondent also has responsibility for Malaysia, which is enjoying a resurgence in the semiconductor industry, and charting an independent course in regional geopolitics. There may also be opportunities to cover stories elsewhere in SE Asia, especially when following supply chains and deals that pass through Singapore.

News is the heart of the job - and you will find strong demand from FT editors - but we want and expect the correspondent to write across a range of formats, from sharp analysis to magazine features. There will be opportunities for travel. Singapore is an important venue for FT Live and you will be asked to represent the FT at events. 

Your Skills

The core of the job is writing and reporting. You will have solid experience as a journalist, most likely in financial reporting or as a foreign correspondent, with a demonstrated ability to cultivate sources and break news. You should be able to write for all parts of the website and newspaper, from strong spot news to deft analysis on a range of subjects.

You will be motivated and full of ideas for stories, not just waiting for the news to arrive. Good communication skills are important. You should regularly pitch ideas to editors in Hong Kong and deliver copy when promised. You should also be collegiate: forging a close relationship with FT correspondents across the region will be crucial to your success.

Singapore is one of the world’s wealthiest cities and a comfortable place to live. The reporting environment, however, requires a degree of resilience and diplomacy. The state maintains tight control over the local media. Some information may not be publicly announced or readily available, requiring a correspondent to work hard and keep up their sources in order to stay in the game.

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Thursday 3rd December 2026.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

job.description:
Manage, administer, and coordinate the reception and distribution of audiovisual content signals within the production and transmission environment for linear television and OTT services.

Responsibilities

  • Request information from different content providers to supply the contribution resources required for the production of programs and events.
  • Plan signal reception and distribution resources according to programming and production calendar requirements.
  • Distribute the information necessary for the proper execution of technical and operational areas.
  • Reserve remote contribution services.
  • Address questions and requests from affiliates and POPs.
  • Follow up on the availability and proper reception of scheduled signals.
  • Coordinate with the relevant teams to resolve any incidents related to signal contribution or distribution.

Academic Background

Technical degree or bachelor’s degree in any of the following areas:

  • Communications.
  • Electronics.
  • Computer Systems.
  • Information Technology.

Technical Skills and Knowledge

  • Quality control of television signals.
  • Knowledge of satellite links and fiber optics.
  • Experience with television standard conversion systems.
  • Knowledge of audio and video signal distribution and routing systems, both manual and digital.
  • Experience with internet-based transmission and reception systems, such as LiveU, TVU, and Dejero.
  • Knowledge of IP video transmission systems, including SRT and RTMP.
  • Proficiency in the regular use of Microsoft Office tools.

Languages

  • Spoken and written technical English.

Additional Skills

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage stressful situations.
  • Analytical skills for the prevention and resolution of contingencies.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams, operations teams, and vendors.

job.title: Broadcast & Digital Operations Specialist
job.description:
About the Role

Fox Tech runs one of the most complex 24/7 streaming and broadcast operations in the industry. Our overnight and weekend coverage depends on people who can move smoothly between disciplines, so we're hiring a Floating Operations Specialist who can cover wherever the business needs them most.

This is not a single-desk job. On one shift you might be monitoring live event streams for FOX One, FOX Sports, and FOX Nation. On the next, you might be running master control playlists or watching SCTE ad markers and CDN dashboards in the Media Control Center. You'll learn each area, build the skills to work in it independently, and help the team respond quickly when priorities change mid-shift.

If you get energy from switching gears, learning new systems, and adapting to whatever the night brings, this role was built for you.(add in get to expand technical stack)

What You'll Do

  • Digital Operations: Monitor live events, app clients, and video performance across FOX One, FOX Sports, FOX Nation, and Tubi. Run pre-flight checks, encoder validations, entitlement sweeps, and post-event validation (DVR, highlights, short-form), and complete regular app sweeps for functionality and parity.
  • Master Control: Support media ingest, quality control, assembly, playout, and distribution for pre-programmed and live content. Perform on-air switching and run automation playlists in multicast and live sports environments.
  • Media Control Center: Monitor SCTE markers, CDN performance, and transmission dashboards for signal health and delivery quality. Support inbound contribution and outbound distribution across linear and OTT platforms.
  • Incident & Handoff Support: Log incidents accurately in JIRA, PagerDuty, and ServiceNow, escalate issues to the right team, and write clear shift handoff notes for the morning team.
  • Documentation: Help create and update runbooks, checklists, and playbooks as processes evolve.
  • Cross-Team Coverage: Step in to support Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Live Media teams when needed.

What You Need

  • Strong attention to detail, checklists, and ticket documentation/ escalation
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new tools and workflows quickly and apply them under time pressure
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially for handoffs and incident updates
  • Availability for overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts

Nice to Have, not a Dealbreaker

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field
  • Experience in a 24/7 environment such as master control, broadcast operations, a network operations center, or digital streaming operations
  • Bilingual Spanish/English
  • Prior experience leading or documenting incidents

What Success Looks Like

  • You can move from one area to another without losing focus or accuracy.
  • You stay calm when priorities change in the middle of a shift and adjust the plan without being asked.
  • You notice small details, such as a missing ad marker or a slow app load, and act on them.
  • You learn a new system quickly, ask good questions, and document what you learn for the next person.
  • Teammates count on you to cover gaps, and you pick up the work that needs doing.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Broadcast Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
The Broadcast Maintenance Engineer will perform tasks associated with the installation, operation, repair, and maintenance of various media technologies for three FOX owned and operated multi-platform television stations. Examples include master control and production automation systems, encoding/decoding and various streaming technologies, video switchers, audio mixers, cameras, robotics, character generators, playback servers, transmitters, satellite distribution systems, desktop computers, networking equipment, and various facility needs as assigned. System examples include Bitcentral, Evertz, Sony, Panasonic, Calrec, Vizrt Tricaster, Adobe, RTS, LiveU, Arista, Cisco, Rohde & Schwarz, and IHSE. The engineer will play an important role in maintaining and operating these systems to support live programming. Highlights include NFL, NCAA football and basketball, MLB, FIFA, NASCAR, and many more.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintenance of broadcast equipment including routing and switching systems, control room and studio equipment, receivers and links, edit systems, live vehicles, RF and ENG equipment
  • Maintain RF sites and equipment including transmitters, translators, TVROs, STL/TSLs, ICRs, RPUs, 2-way, remote controls and fiber paths
  • Maintain inventory of spare and replacement parts
  • Maintain building, grounds and support systems at RF sites
  • Understand and use technical manuals and diagnostic, test and measurement equipment to complete maintenance duties
  • Ascertain and satisfy other departments’ needs for service and request parts as required for repairs and maintenance
  • Provide documentation including technical drawings, databases, repair logs, procedures and parts account reconciliation
  • Execute preventive maintenance program
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry changes
  • Document and maintain strict FCC, EAS, and OSHA regulation compliance
  • Travel as needed to remote production and transmitter sites. Maintain a clean driving record

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Previous experience within a television station or similar industry supporting and installing broadcast equipment, production systems, video streaming technologies, and/or IT-related components
  • Skilled with both SDI and IP video standards, such as SMPTE 2110, NDI, and Dante
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and willingness to learn new technologies
  • Ability to communicate effectively with management, vendors, and co-workers; work efficiently and meet deadlines
  • Able to work independently and as a member of a team
  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time
  • Flexible with schedule and willing to work weekends, holidays, and occasional overnight shifts
  • Valid driver’s license

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Tricaster experience
  • Bachelor's or associate degree in a television, engineering, or information technology field of study

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Broadcast Production Engineer
job.description:
FOX News is on the hunt for a stellar Broadcast Production Engineer to work in our Washington DC bureau. This role involves providing support and routine compliance for our substantial media and broadcast systems within a competitive, live, 24/7 news environment. As a cornerstone of our Production Engineering team, within the Broadcast and Media Technology group, you'll coordinate with various engineering teams, providing support to IT groups/helpdesk, broadcast production, technical operation personnel, and network operations aggregations.

As our ideal candidate, you are enthused about broadcast engineering/IT and comfortable acclimating to evolving media technologies, concepts, and trends such as Media over IP, Cloud Computing, and Radio Workflows.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support infrastructure for on-air broadcast production systems
  • Oversee studio operations including video walls, video processing systems, and cameras
  • Supervise live control room production systems and subsystems
  • Handle infrastructure systems like routers, intercom, monitoring, KVM, audio suites, and live production-related equipment
  • Provide maintenance and support for off-site remote locations including the White House, Capitol Hill, etc.
  • Address, communicate, manage, and track technical issues in a live 24/7 production environment
  • Perform maintenance of subsystems including software and hardware updates, modifications, and replacements as warranted
  • Develop and retain process benchmarks for deployment and support documentation for operations
  • Collaborate on a team that works hands-on with the latest generation of production systems and technologies
  • Work on complex audio processing tasks and Audio-over-IP setups including gating, compression, equalization of talent microphone audio, and multi-band processing of outbound audio programming using Orban processors
  • Set up up small Dante audio networks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or related majors, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years' experience in broadcast production and live television
  • Extensive knowledge of standards like SMPTE for broadcast television and video environments
  • Strong technical skills in troubleshooting and repairing broadcast equipment
  • Aptitude to troubleshoot traditional SDI and IP audio/video signal routing environments
  • Familiarity with studio technologies including video walls, cameras, VR set technologies, image processing systems, touch screens, and lighting
  • Solid understanding of production control automation (e.g., Ross Overdrive) and Newsroom Computer System (NRCS) workflows
  • Proficiency in MS Windows workstation and server platforms
  • Experience with file-based workflows and knowledge of enterprise Media Asset Management systems (e.g. Dalet)
  • Ability to interpret technical documentation standards 
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of IT/networking theory, topology, and best practices
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks independently and as part of a team.
  • Aptitude to work a flexible schedule based on the needs of a live production environment, including overtime, holidays, weekends
  • Capability to remove, lift, and replace equipment in racks as warranted
  • Experience operating manual and electric mechanical tools is required

In this role, your daily tasks will include researching, pitching and writing multiple articles (round-ups, gift guides, product reviews, etc) for publication across FOX properties, including Fox News and FOX Weather. 

Along with daily assignments, this person will join the core writing team covering tentpole shopping events like Prime Day, Black Friday and Cyber Monday. This person should be a multitasker who can work effectively, efficiently and quickly while managing multiple assignments. The candidate should have excellent writing skills, experience in implementing SEO tactics and have a background in journalism or another related field.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Write daily articles and evergreen stories (6-10 a week)
  • Research new products and trends, as well as competitor content picks, to make sure we always make the best recommendations to our readers
  • Keep on top of new product launches to ensure our content always has the most up to date products. This may involve helping test and review new products
  • Research and pitch new content based on audience insights, historical performance, seasonal search trends and other revenue-generation measures. 
  • Work closely with our partnerships and growth teams to ensure content is optimized for maximum revenue generation
  • Follow in-house style and brand safety guidelines
  • Cover tentpole shopping events like Prime Day, Black Friday and Cyber Monday

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Daily experience working within a CMS (familiarity with WordPress preferred)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including knowledge of AP style
  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills, meticulous and consistent follow up
  • Proven track record of executing revenue-driving articles (both deals-centric and evergreen)
  • Attention to detail, an aptitude for working under tight deadlines and effectively handling multiple priorities simultaneously

ABOUT YOU

  • Strong leadership skills and collaborative work ethic
  • Keen attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn
  • Critical thinker and creative problem solver
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced creative environment 

NICE TO HAVE

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism or related field, or equivalent experience

  • Experience producing both short and long-form product reviews across a range of categories.

job.title: Commercial Administrator
job.description:
The Commercial Administrator involves managing and coordinating commercial content for both linear and digital platforms ensuring that commercials are aired according to agency guidelines and standards. Key responsibilities include confirming the receipt of commercial instructions and media assets, editing and preparing daily program and commercial logs, and maintaining effective communication with Sales, Programming, and Agencies to promptly address any issues or missing elements. Strong organizational skills are essential to meet daily deadlines, and collaboration with On-air and programming teams, as well as Sales Administration and Operations/Live Ops, is crucial for managing schedules, formats, and promo/filler time. The position also involves assisting with additional Commercial Administration tasks as directed by Management, accurately reflecting program schedules and inventory in the system, and updating systems promptly to ensure accuracy and compliance. This role requires excellent organizational and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with various departments to ensure smooth operations.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prepare daily program/commercial logs for air
  • Edit commercial placement in accordance with Sales directives 
  • Adjust log formats as necessary to insure correct log timing
  • Verify billboard and other added value placements as necessary
  • Make needed adjustments to log automation elements
  • Match up commercials ordered with instructions from agencies
  • Verify dates, products, and all other parameters as indicated
  • Contact Agencies to request any missing instructions or tapes or resolve discrepancies
  • Enter copy instructions accurately into Traffic system and use designated reports to verify accuracy
  • Prepare daily delivery of tapes received to operational facility
  • Gather and enter programming and format information into Traffic system. Check against scheduling and Sales information for accuracy
  • Interface with Sales Coordination, Sales, Programming, On-air Promo, Operations as necessary to complete logs
  • Reconcile and post logs after air
  • Any other Commercial Administration duties as assigned by Management

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • High school diploma
  • Prior computer experience
  • Experience with Windows-based software and database programs
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to communicate precise information clearly and accurately
  • Basic math, must be able to use calculator, timing calculator
  • Well organized and able to prioritize and manage time well
  • Able to make judgments within parameters as trained
  • Able to spot discrepancies and problem-solve using reports and other tools as trained
  • Able to balance multiple requirements and know when to bring an issue to Management’s attention
  • Ability to work within deadlines and maintain professional demeanor under pressure
  • Ability to multi-task and manage large volume of work

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • College degree
  • Prior Commercial Administration/Agency/Traffic experience
  • Microsoft Excel experience

job.title: Creative Producer / Editor
job.description:
The Creative Producer/Editor develops and produces compelling marketing and other creative content for FOX TV Stations and related brands across broadcast, streaming and digital platforms. The role combines strong writing, producing, editing and sound design skills with the ability to take a project from initial concept through final delivery. Working in collaboration with creative leaders, station partners and production teams, this position contributes creative ideas early in the process, helps shape stories and messages, organizes creative assets and production needs, and delivers polished work that meets brand, audience and platform requirements. The role may also take on traditional motion design as needed.

Only applications with a portfolio or reel will be considered for this position. Portfolios/Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop creative concepts, messaging and scripts for creative marketing and other video content, shaping each project to its audience, purpose, brand and platform.
  • Produce and edit content from concept through delivery, organizing footage, interviews, stills, music, voiceover and other assets into clear, engaging stories.
  • Write and refine scripts, headlines, voiceover copy and supporting editorial materials with accuracy, clarity and a strong sense of tone.
  • Apply sound design, music, dialogue editing and audio mixing to support the story and deliver a polished final piece.
  • Collaborate with Art Directors, the Vice President of Creative Production, producers, editors, designers, stations and other partners to help shape creative approaches and execute assignments.
  • Manage project details including creative briefs, assets, production schedules, review cycles, revisions and delivery requirements; communicate status and needs clearly.
  • Develop and adapt content for broadcast, streaming, digital and social formats, tailoring storytelling and execution to each platform while maintaining the intent and quality of the creative.
  • Use sound editorial judgment and attention to detail to maintain accuracy, pacing, continuity, technical quality and brand standards.
  • Complete traditional graphic design, motion design or animation assignments when appropriate to the project and team workload.
  • Handle routine versioning, bag and tag, and other operational tasks that support the team’s production pipeline.
  • Stay current with production, editing, sound and design techniques, A.I. workflows.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Degree, certification or equivalent professional experience in video production, editing, communications, journalism, design or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience producing and editing news, creative marketing, broadcast, streaming or digital video content
  • A strong portfolio or reel demonstrating the work, including digital-first examples
  • Excellent writing, storytelling and communication skills, including the ability to shape concise, accurate copy for varied audiences and platforms.
  • Strong editing and sound design skills, with working knowledge of professional video and audio post-production tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro and Audition.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite and the ability to contribute to graphic design or motion design assignments; familiarity with Premiere Pro and After Effects is preferred.
  • Working fluency with generative AI tools including prompting, iteration, responsible use and quality review of outputs. Familiarity with creative AI tools and workflows is a plus.
  • Understanding of branding, visual storytelling, music and sound use, and the creative requirements of broadcast, promotional, newscast, streaming and digital content.
  • Highly organized, collaborative and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects, respond to feedback and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort communicating with creative teams, station contacts, managers and external partners, and proactively clarifying project needs or raising schedule concerns.
  • Flexibility to shift between producing and editing work and occasional traditional design assignments based on project priorities.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.
