job.title: Human Resources Business Partner
job.description:
The Fox Television Stations (FTS) HR team is seeking a business-minded, hands-on HR Business Partner to support our Sales Team, Finance and other corporate functions. This role is for an experienced HR professional who pairs strategic thinking with strong day-to-day execution and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven broadcast and streaming environment.

Reporting to the Senior Regional HR Director, the HRBP will own day-to-day HR support across the full employee lifecycle while acting as a trusted advisor to department leadership. The ideal candidate brings sound judgment, credibility, and the ability to translate business needs into practical people solutions. This individual will be comfortable navigating change and balancing competing priorities.

The HRBP will partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, HR Operations, and Learning & Development, to deliver a consistent and effective employee experience across stations.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a strategic HR partner and advisor to station leadership, providing guidance on employee relations, performance management, staffing models, and people priorities
  • Serve as the primary HR resource for employees and managers, providing guidance on policies, procedures, benefits, and employment practices and resolving issues directly
  • Develop a deep understanding of sales, finance and corporate function, and proactively identify people needs and opportunities
  • Lead talent management and performance processes, including talent reviews, succession planning for key roles, development planning, and performance management
  • Drive employee engagement and retention initiatives that strengthen performance, collaboration, and team culture
  • Manage offboarding and exit interview processes, analyzing themes and trends to inform retention strategies and recommendations to department leadership
  • Provide solutions-oriented counsel on employee relations matters, conducting or coordinating investigations and partnering with Employment Legal and HR leadership as appropriate
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and Compensation on hiring strategies, recruitment, and competitive offer development
  • Own the new hire experience, including onboarding, orientation, and Form I-9 completion and compliance, and continuously improve onboarding practices in partnership with Talent Acquisition and HR Operations
  • Coach and advise managers on employee development, performance, scheduling challenges, team effectiveness, and management practices
  • Use workforce data, including headcount, turnover, and leave trends, to identify issues, influence decisions, and recommend actions to leadership
  • Ensure accurate and timely employee data in Workday, including new hires, job changes, transfers, promotions, and terminations, and regularly audit station data for accuracy

job.title: Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
KTVU FOX 2 is seeking a versatile, hands-on Broadcast Engineer to join our team in Oakland, CA. Maintains and installs equipment at the studio and technical facilities, provides broadcast engineering support for all news and production operations (both linear and streaming), assists and trains operators, and collaborates on technical projects varying in scale. This role is ideal for a proactive engineer with strong troubleshooting instincts looking to contribute to a live, 24/7 news operation.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Studio & Production Support: Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot studio cameras, robotic pedestal systems, production switchers, audio consoles, graphics systems, and news video playback equipment.

Signal Flow & Routing: Maintain central routing, master control systems, TOC, and terminal equipment to ensure flawless linear and streaming video/audio delivery.

Newsroom IT & Systems Maintenance: Assist with the upkeep and integration of newsroom computer platforms, editing bays (NLEs), playout servers, virtual platforms, and production automation systems (e.g., Ross Overdrive, NRCS).

System Integration & Documentation: Design, wire, and integrate equipment racks, patch bays, and IP-based broadcast infrastructure. Develop support documentation and standards for operations personnel.

Operational & Incident Support: Perform operational duties in Master Control and TOC as scheduled. Respond to, manage, and track technical issues as they arise in a live 24/7 environment with urgency.

Compliance & Standards: Ensure all operations and broadcast technology comply with FCC rules, safety standards, and station engineering protocols.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in broadcast equipment maintenance, studio AV setup, system integration, or IT/networking in a broadcast environment.

Technical & IT Skills: Strong diagnostic skills; working knowledge of computer networking (IP, subnets, switchers), virtual computing, basic tools, soldering, and custom cable fabrication.

Emerging Technologies: Familiarity with IP-based broadcast standards (e.g., SMPTE 2110, DANTE, NDI) and compressed video encoding/decoding techniques.

Communication & Logistics: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Must hold a valid driver's license with a good driving record for local travel as needed.

Schedule Flexibility: Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support continuous news operations.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & EDUCATION

Physical Demands: Ability to stand, walk, reach, stoop, climb ladders, work behind equipment racks, and lift up to 50 lbs.

Education & Certifications: Technical degree in Electronics, IT, or equivalent military/trade experience. SBE, Cisco, CompTIA, or Microsoft certifications and AutoCAD experience are a plus.

job.title: Manager, Podcast Marketing
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world’s top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content through advertising, subscriptions, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our proprietary technology stack, including Supercast for subscriptions and Speakeasy for hosting, distribution, and monetization.

Named after Ted Williams’ longest home run at Fenway Park, Red Seat Ventures was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we are the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is looking for a Manager, Podcast Marketing to lead cross-promotional campaigns across our portfolio of nearly 70 podcasts while building relationships with external shows, creators, and platforms. Reporting to the Senior Director, Podcast Marketing, you will own campaigns from initial planning and creative development through ad operations, measurement, and reporting. You will translate campaign performance into clear insights that help senior leaders understand what worked and what we should do next.

This position sits within a growing Audience Development function with established systems and active campaigns already in place. The work is currently hands-on and high-volume as we continue to improve and automate our processes. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys owning complex systems, maintaining operational precision, and turning campaign data into a compelling and actionable story.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Book and manage in-network and out-of-network cross-promotional campaigns, including launches for new shows and always-on promotional rotations
  • Own campaign execution details, including flight dates, frequency caps, audience targeting, creative trafficking, and delivery
  • Build and deliver weekly and monthly reports on net-new listeners, conversion, and retention for senior leadership
  • Develop clear performance narratives and recommendations based on campaign data
  • Maintain consistent campaign naming conventions across booking, hosting, and measurement platforms so promotional activity can be accurately matched to results
  • Research and pitch podcasts and YouTube channels for promotional swaps, collaborations, and client guest appearances
  • Manage scheduling and promotional materials, including biographies and headshots, in partnership with client teams, host-show contacts, and Creator Partnerships
  • Maintain the programming calendar for editorial pitches to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, iHeart, and YouTube
  • Track upcoming show moments, platform requirements, and submission lead times to support timely and relevant editorial pitches
  • Help improve and automate campaign workflows, reporting processes, and other repetitive operational tasks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3–5 years of experience in audience development, marketing operations, campaign management, or ad operations within podcasting, audio, or digital media
  • Hands-on experience booking campaigns in an enterprise podcast hosting and advertising platform
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including experience using pivot tables and lookup functions to create clear reports from raw data exports
  • Familiarity with podcast measurement or attribution platforms such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Strong written communication skills and the confidence to present performance data, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Experience managing outreach or partnerships, including promotional swaps, guest bookings, creator collaborations, or platform relationships
  • Careful and consistent execution, with the judgment to identify incorrect date ranges, mismatched metrics, or other discrepancies before they reach a final report
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive approach to improving systems, solving operational challenges, and identifying opportunities for audience growth

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Day-to-day experience working with podcast attribution tools such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Previous experience working within a podcast network
  • Listener fluency across podcast genres such as news, true crime, comedy, and sports
  • Working knowledge of SQL or light Python
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, and repetitive workflows, including agentic tools such as Claude Code or Codex

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures, in partnership with FOX Corporation, is launching a new membership-based business centered around premium live entertainment experiences. We are seeking Regional Sales Directors to drive new memberships through compelling, relationship-driven sales experiences that convert interest into long-term membership.

Reporting to the VP of Sales, the Membership Advisor  will play a critical role in driving new memberships through high-touch, relationship-driven sales experiences. This role is ideal for an accomplished sales professional who thrives in a startup-style growth environment and excels at engaging discerning high-net-worth individuals. Success in this role requires the ability to convert trial experiences into long-term memberships while representing the brand with professionalism, credibility, and integrity.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

job.title: News Reporter/Anchor
job.description:
The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Reporter/Anchor for our evening news block. The person chosen for this role will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.

You’ll focus on reporting big news of the day, adding depth and context to stories in our newly formatted early evening news block from 5:00-6:30pm. Then you’ll transition to our redesigned newsroom, where you’ll anchor 90 minutes of live, unscripted news, while operating our Tricaster switcher. You’ll end your day, anchoring our 10pm linear news broadcast from our primary studio.

Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital-first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless of format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter.  We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have an insatiable curiosity about the world around you, from local and state government and how decisions by elected officials impact our audience to a daily understanding of what’s happening globally and the ability to take complex subjects and make them compelling and relatable.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have a relentless commitment to accuracy in your reporting, whether scripted or unscripted. You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.  Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. This is not an entry-level position or a position for candidates who do not possess a journalism background. 

We’re a 24/7 news operation, so you must be able to work non-traditional hours, weekends and holidays as needed.  

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Sports Data & Metadata Engineer
job.description:
FOX Sports is looking to add a Sports Data & Metadata Engineer to bolster our AI Solutions team. The Sports Data & Metadata Engineer is responsible for cleaning and structuring both the proprietary data we already own and league data (Sports Radar, MLB BAM, etc.)so it can train models, power generative tools, and surface the right context at the right moment.

You’ll build the automated systems that pull our data out of scattered, non-integrated tools and into one place engineers and producers can actually rely on, and you’ll maintain the source of truth that feeds contextual information to our AI tools. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who knows both the data stack and the sports, and who understands that a stat is only useful if it arrives correct, fast, and in a shape a model can read.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Clean, structure, and normalize FOX Sports data, including player tracking, historical statistics, and sensor data, for model training and inference
  • Work with leagues, teams, and external data providers creating data workflows and processes
  • Work with data providers and league partners to integrate external feeds and resolve discrepancies against our own records
  • Build and maintain automated pipelines that ingest, validate, and reconcile data across FOX Sports systems
  • Develop an automated data management system that eliminates silos and consolidates fragmented, non-integrated architecture
  • Maintain the source of truth database that feeds contextual information to our AI tools
  • Design and document metadata schemas and taxonomies so sports content and data stay consistently machine-readable across platforms
  • Implement data quality monitoring, validation, and alerting so errors are caught before they reach a model or an audience
  • Partner with departments from around the company to understand how the data is actually used, and shape the schema around it

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, including production pipelines you built and maintained
  • Experience integrating third-party data feeds and reconciling conflicting sources
  • Experience designing schemas, taxonomies, and metadata models for large, messy datasets
  • Strong attention to detail and a low tolerance for silent data errors
  • Strong SQL and Python, with experience in modern data warehousing and orchestration tools
  • Familiarity with preparing data for machine learning, including feature pipelines and training datasets
  • Extensive knowledge of sports data: statistics, player tracking, and the context that makes a number meaningful
  • Ability to work nights and weekends, whenever sports are on the air

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

We are seeking a digitally native journalist and dynamic on-air personality to produce and host live streaming content for our growing streaming platform, with a primary focus on evening and breaking news coverage.  

This is not a traditional television role. We’re looking for someone who understands how audiences consume news on digital platforms, thrives in a live environment, and can create compelling, conversational content without relying on a teleprompter. You’ll be responsible for the end-to-end execution of live streams, serving as both the on-camera host and producer while making smart editorial decisions and engaging viewers in real time.

If you understand streaming workflows, live video production, audience engagement, and breaking news coverage, this is an opportunity to help define the future of local journalism.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce and host live streaming programming focused on evening and breaking news coverage.
  • Own the end-to-end production of live streams and VOD content, including editorial planning, technical execution, and on-air presentation.
  • Operate streaming production tools including live switching, encoding, clipping, publishing, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Engage directly with viewers through live chat and audience interaction to create an authentic, community-driven experience.
  • Make strong editorial decisions in real time, adjusting coverage as news develops and audience interests evolve.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership, digital, social, assignment desk, producers, and production teams to align coverage and maximize content across platforms.

  • Occasionally contribute to linear broadcasts as newsroom needs dictate.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience in digital news, streaming, reporting, MMJ work, producing, or live content creation preferred.
  • Strong on-camera presence with the ability to communicate naturally in unscripted live environments.
  • Demonstrated experience producing digital video, live streams, or social-first news content.  
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to make fast editorial decisions under deadline pressure.
  • Technical proficiency with live streaming workflows including switching, encoding, publishing, clipping, and distribution. Experience with TriCaster and Adobe Creative Suite is a plus, but the ability to learn new technology quickly is essential.
  • Experience engaging digital audiences and understanding audience retention across streaming platforms.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.
  • Background in journalism, broadcast media, digital media, or related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and other non-traditional hours as breaking news demands.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • A reel showcasing strong live hosting ability and conversational storytelling.
  • Experience building streaming communities and engaging audiences in real time.
  • A passion for experimenting with new storytelling formats and digital platforms.
  • The ability to seamlessly balance hosting, producing, technical execution, and editorial decision-making during live broadcasts.

job.title: VP, Hospitality
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Red Seat Ventures is launching a new premium membership business and is hiring a Vice President, Hospitality who will lead the delivery of exceptional, high-touch hospitality and member experiences across Red Seat Ventures' portfolio of premium live entertainment events. This leader will oversee all aspects of event hospitality, from pre-event planning and arrival through seating, food and beverage, unique experiences, departure, and post-event feedback, ensuring consistent execution of the company's premium service standards across multiple markets.

With primary responsibility for event hospitality operations, the VP will establish the operating models, processes, procedures, and staffing strategies needed to deliver seamless, scalable experiences. This includes overseeing the recruitment, training, scheduling, and development of Suite Hosts, managing venue and hospitality partnerships, and owning the P&L associated with delivering exceptional event experiences.

The VP will also oversee the Member Experience function through a Director, Member Experience, ensuring the team delivers personalized member service, builds strong relationships, and maintains consistent communication and service standards throughout the membership lifecycle. This leader will provide strategic direction and operational oversight to support member satisfaction, engagement, and retention.

This is a highly operational leadership role ideal for an experienced, multi-market hospitality executive who knows how to translate an elevated service vision into repeatable, scalable execution while building and leading high-performing teams.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the end-to-end hospitality experience at events, from pre-event planning and arrival through seating, food and beverage, unique experiences, departure, and post-event follow-up, ensuring exceptional service across all markets.
  • Translate the company's hospitality vision into scalable operating standards, processes, procedures, and playbooks that drive consistent execution across events, venues, and markets.
  • Oversee all operational elements of event hospitality, including venue coordination, seating layouts, food and beverage, guest flow, and onsite service delivery.
  • Develop and execute event staffing strategies, including recruiting, training, scheduling, managing, and developing a high-performing team of Suite Hosts across multiple markets.
  • Establish policies, procedures, and escalation protocols for anticipating and resolving event-related issues, ensuring teams are equipped to deliver seamless experiences and respond professionally to member needs.
  • Partner with internal teams, venues, vendors, and hospitality partners to ensure operational readiness, consistent service standards, and exceptional event execution.
  • Own the P&L for event hospitality operations, including labor planning, budgeting, vendor management, and cost control, balancing premium service delivery with financial discipline.
  • Oversee the Director, Member Experience, providing leadership and strategic direction for the Member Experience team and ensuring consistent service standards, communication protocols, and member relationship management.
  • Build and scale the hospitality and member experience functions as the business grows, developing leadership talent, strengthening operational processes, and ensuring a consistent, premium experience across all markets.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Extensive experience leading complex, multi-location hospitality, event, or guest-service operations, with a demonstrated track record of delivering consistent, high-quality execution across multiple markets.
  • Proven experience building, managing, and developing large hourly or frontline hospitality teams, including recruiting, training, scheduling, performance management, and leadership development.
  • Strong operational leadership skills, with the ability to translate premium service standards into scalable processes, training programs, playbooks, and measurable operating practices.
  • Demonstrated P&L ownership and financial acumen, including labor planning, budgeting, vendor management, cost control, and balancing exceptional service with financial discipline.
  • Experience overseeing high-touch guest or member experiences, with an understanding of how exceptional hospitality, personalized service, and consistent execution contribute to member satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Proven ability to lead managers and cross-functional teams across multiple markets, establishing accountability, service consistency, and operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently across markets and maintain a hands-on leadership presence during events, particularly as the business and teams scale.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience delivering high-touch guest experiences within luxury hotels, private clubs, premium hospitality, or other membership-based environments.
  • Experience opening, launching, or scaling hospitality operations across multiple locations or markets.
  • Background working with premium live events, sports, entertainment, or venue-based hospitality.
  • Experience overseeing membership services, guest relations, or customer experience teams responsible for building long-term relationships and driving satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Familiarity with workforce management, scheduling, and labor-planning platforms used to manage distributed hourly teams.
  • Experience working in startup environments or new business incubation teams where operating models, processes, and teams are being built from the ground up.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX 29 is seeking an experienced Account Executive to grow digital and broadcast advertising revenue in Philadelphia. Backed by the resources of Fox Corporation, you’ll help local businesses reach audiences through Good Day Philadelphia, sports programming, and a broad portfolio of digital advertising solutions. Join a collaborative sales team that values new ideas, strong client relationships, and measurable results.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Sell broadcast and digital advertising across FOX 29, FLX, FOX Local, Tubi, FOX Sports, and FOXNEWS.com, including multiplatform sponsorships tied to major Philadelphia events.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies to grow revenue, win new business, and exceed sales goals.
  • Build and maintain relationships with local business owners and advertising agencies through regular communication and in-person meetings.
  • Develop, present, and negotiate advertising packages that connect client goals with FOX 29’s local programming, sports, and digital offerings.
  • Manage the sales process from prospecting through closing and campaign execution.
  • Process transactional business, coordinate advertising schedules with station personnel, and complete administrative tasks accurately and on time.
  • Communicate with station and corporate management to support the successful execution of multiplatform campaigns.
  • Maintain accurate revenue forecasts based on the sales pipeline and pending opportunities.
  • Host and attend client events and entertainment engagements to strengthen business relationships.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • At least two years of professional experience in video advertising sales and business development.
  • Knowledge of digital and linear advertising, with demonstrated success developing new business and achieving sales goals.
  • Strong negotiation skills and the ability to manage complex deals from initial outreach through closing in a competitive media market.
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with computers and cloud-based applications.
  • Ability to accurately forecast revenue based on pipeline activity and pending deals.
  • Reliable transportation, or the ability to obtain it, and a valid local driver’s license.
  • Availability for local travel, client entertainment, and in-person business meetings.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, including client events, to support business needs within a 24/7 station operation.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

  • A college degree.
  • Experience using WideOrbit.

job.title: AI Solutions Architect
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Sports is seeking an AI Solutions Architect to help us build products that solve problems. The AI Solutions Architect creates the pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that turn models into systems our producers, editors, engineers and employees can depend on to save time and achieve more.


You will be on the front lines of creating the applications that supercharge our workforce. That means designing real-time video and data pipelines that hold up on an NFL Sunday, integrating LLMs and Computer Vision into the workflow tools our teams already use and developing solutions for business functions around the company. The ideal candidate has deep cloud architecture experience, has put ML systems into production at scale, and can move between a whiteboard with leadership and a conversation with an employee who wants to work more efficiently.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with departments across the company to identify where AI creates real leverage and where it doesn’t
  • Design and deploy scalable AI pipelines for real-time video and data processing across FOX Sports properties
  • Oversee integration of LLMs and computer vision models into our existing workflow and production systems
  • Optimize cloud and compute costs to ensure AI efficiencies remain sustainable, across both operating costs and capital investment
  • Define reference architectures, technical standards, and evaluation criteria for AI systems moving from prototype into production
  • Inform build-vs-buy assessments for AI platforms, models, and vendors, and the technical relationships that follow
  • Establish monitoring, observability, and fallback strategies so AI-dependent workflows degrade safely during live events
  • Use performance and cost data to evaluate deployed systems and guide ongoing architecture decisions
  • Work with Security, Legal, and Standards teams to ensure AI implementations meet FOX’s requirements for rights, privacy, and editorial integrity
  • Train engineers and technical staff, raising the organization’s overall fluency in building with AI

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience in software or systems architecture, with demonstrated production ML/AI deployments
  • Deep experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including compute cost modeling and optimization at scale
  • Hands-on experience deploying LLMs and Computer Vision models in production, including inference optimization, orchestration, and evaluation
  • Strong background in real-time and streaming data architecture; video processing pipeline experience strongly preferred
  • Proficiency in coding tools and familiarity with modern ML tooling and MLOps practices
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous business needs into durable technical architecture, and to explain that architecture to non-technical stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across engineering, production, and business teams
  • Ability to work nights and weekends as needed to support live event windows

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Interest in sports and live media production; experience in broadcast, streaming, or media tech

job.title: Booking Coordinator
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX LATAM

FOX Latinoamérica inició operaciones en junio de 2025 y se ha posicionado como uno de los líderes en la programación deportiva en México y Centroamérica, ofreciendo un sólido portafolio de contenidos deportivos y derechos de transmisión de algunas de las ligas y torneos más prestigiosos del mundo, incluyendo la Liga MX, la Copa de Campeones de la Concacaf, la MLB y una selección de partidos de la NFL. La compañía transmite más de 2,000 eventos deportivos al año y cuenta con un equipo conformado por algunos de los talentos, periodistas y analistas deportivos más reconocidos de la región. La amplia oferta de contenido deportivo de FOX Latinoamérica está disponible a través de FOX y FOX+ en televisión lineal, del servicio de streaming directo al consumidor FOX One y del canal FOX en Tubi, la plataforma gratuita de streaming con publicidad (AVOD).

JOB DESCRIPTION

Manage, administer, and coordinate the reception and distribution of audiovisual content signals within the production and transmission environment for linear television and OTT services.


Responsibilities

  • Request information from different content providers to supply the contribution resources required for the production of programs and events.
  • Plan signal reception and distribution resources according to programming and production calendar requirements.
  • Distribute the information necessary for the proper execution of technical and operational areas.
  • Reserve remote contribution services.
  • Address questions and requests from affiliates and POPs.
  • Follow up on the availability and proper reception of scheduled signals.
  • Coordinate with the relevant teams to resolve any incidents related to signal contribution or distribution.

Academic Background

Technical degree or bachelor’s degree in any of the following areas:

  • Communications.
  • Electronics.
  • Computer Systems.
  • Information Technology.

Technical Skills and Knowledge

  • Quality control of television signals.
  • Knowledge of satellite links and fiber optics.
  • Experience with television standard conversion systems.
  • Knowledge of audio and video signal distribution and routing systems, both manual and digital.
  • Experience with internet-based transmission and reception systems, such as LiveU, TVU, and Dejero.
  • Knowledge of IP video transmission systems, including SRT and RTMP.
  • Proficiency in the regular use of Microsoft Office tools.

Languages

  • Spoken and written technical English.

Additional Skills

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage stressful situations.
  • Analytical skills for the prevention and resolution of contingencies.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams, operations teams, and vendors.

job.title: Broadcast & Digital Operations Specialist
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

About the Role

Fox Tech runs one of the most complex 24/7 streaming and broadcast operations in the industry. Our overnight and weekend coverage depends on people who can move smoothly between disciplines, so we're hiring a Floating Operations Specialist who can cover wherever the business needs them most.

This is not a single-desk job. On one shift you might be monitoring live event streams for FOX One, FOX Sports, and FOX Nation. On the next, you might be running master control playlists or watching SCTE ad markers and CDN dashboards in the Media Control Center. You'll learn each area, build the skills to work in it independently, and help the team respond quickly when priorities change mid-shift.

If you get energy from switching gears, learning new systems, and adapting to whatever the night brings, this role was built for you.(add in get to expand technical stack)

What You'll Do

  • Digital Operations: Monitor live events, app clients, and video performance across FOX One, FOX Sports, FOX Nation, and Tubi. Run pre-flight checks, encoder validations, entitlement sweeps, and post-event validation (DVR, highlights, short-form), and complete regular app sweeps for functionality and parity.
  • Master Control: Support media ingest, quality control, assembly, playout, and distribution for pre-programmed and live content. Perform on-air switching and run automation playlists in multicast and live sports environments.
  • Media Control Center: Monitor SCTE markers, CDN performance, and transmission dashboards for signal health and delivery quality. Support inbound contribution and outbound distribution across linear and OTT platforms.
  • Incident & Handoff Support: Log incidents accurately in JIRA, PagerDuty, and ServiceNow, escalate issues to the right team, and write clear shift handoff notes for the morning team.
  • Documentation: Help create and update runbooks, checklists, and playbooks as processes evolve.
  • Cross-Team Coverage: Step in to support Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Live Media teams when needed.

What You Need

  • Strong attention to detail, checklists, and ticket documentation/ escalation
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new tools and workflows quickly and apply them under time pressure
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially for handoffs and incident updates
  • Availability for overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts

Nice to Have, not a Dealbreaker

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field
  • Experience in a 24/7 environment such as master control, broadcast operations, a network operations center, or digital streaming operations
  • Bilingual Spanish/English
  • Prior experience leading or documenting incidents

What Success Looks Like

  • You can move from one area to another without losing focus or accuracy.
  • You stay calm when priorities change in the middle of a shift and adjust the plan without being asked.
  • You notice small details, such as a missing ad marker or a slow app load, and act on them.
  • You learn a new system quickly, ask good questions, and document what you learn for the next person.
  • Teammates count on you to cover gaps, and you pick up the work that needs doing.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $27.00-31.00 per hour. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

job.title: Creative Producer / Editor (Graphics Hub)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Creative Producer/Editor develops and produces compelling marketing and other creative content for FOX TV Stations and related brands across broadcast, streaming and digital platforms. The role combines strong writing, producing, editing and sound design skills with the ability to take a project from initial concept through final delivery. Working in collaboration with creative leaders, station partners and production teams, this position contributes creative ideas early in the process, helps shape stories and messages, organizes creative assets and production needs, and delivers polished work that meets brand, audience and platform requirements. The role may also take on traditional motion design as needed.


Only applications with a portfolio or reel will be considered for this position. Portfolios/Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop creative concepts, messaging and scripts for creative marketing and other video content, shaping each project to its audience, purpose, brand and platform.
  • Produce and edit content from concept through delivery, organizing footage, interviews, stills, music, voiceover and other assets into clear, engaging stories.
  • Write and refine scripts, headlines, voiceover copy and supporting editorial materials with accuracy, clarity and a strong sense of tone.
  • Apply sound design, music, dialogue editing and audio mixing to support the story and deliver a polished final piece.
  • Collaborate with Art Directors, the Vice President of Creative Production, producers, editors, designers, stations and other partners to help shape creative approaches and execute assignments.
  • Manage project details including creative briefs, assets, production schedules, review cycles, revisions and delivery requirements; communicate status and needs clearly.
  • Develop and adapt content for broadcast, streaming, digital and social formats, tailoring storytelling and execution to each platform while maintaining the intent and quality of the creative.
  • Use sound editorial judgment and attention to detail to maintain accuracy, pacing, continuity, technical quality and brand standards.
  • Complete traditional graphic design, motion design or animation assignments when appropriate to the project and team workload.
  • Handle routine versioning, bag and tag, and other operational tasks that support the team’s production pipeline.
  • Stay current with production, editing, sound and design techniques, A.I. workflows.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Degree, certification or equivalent professional experience in video production, editing, communications, journalism, design or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience producing and editing news, creative marketing, broadcast, streaming or digital video content
  • A strong portfolio or reel demonstrating the work, including digital-first examples
  • Excellent writing, storytelling and communication skills, including the ability to shape concise, accurate copy for varied audiences and platforms.
  • Strong editing and sound design skills, with working knowledge of professional video and audio post-production tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro and Audition.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite and the ability to contribute to graphic design or motion design assignments; familiarity with Premiere Pro and After Effects is preferred.
  • Working fluency with generative AI tools including prompting, iteration, responsible use and quality review of outputs. Familiarity with creative AI tools and workflows is a plus.
  • Understanding of branding, visual storytelling, music and sound use, and the creative requirements of broadcast, promotional, newscast, streaming and digital content.
  • Highly organized, collaborative and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects, respond to feedback and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort communicating with creative teams, station contacts, managers and external partners, and proactively clarifying project needs or raising schedule concerns.
  • Flexibility to shift between producing and editing work and occasional traditional design assignments based on project priorities.

 


We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $70,000.00-89,000.00 annually. job.title: Digital Librarian
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Fox News is hiring a Digital Librarian who will be responsible for all video assets in the Digital Media Services (DMS) department in our Washington, D.C. Bureau. The Digital Librarian will work with a team on the Fox News digital library collection, improving metadata, and managing video files according to departmental rules and producer requests. Additionally, you will research legacy videos for news production and sales purposes for teams in all bureaus, select video and add appropriate metadata to assets for permanent archive.


Must be willing and able to work all shifts (weekends, holidays, late nights, mornings, etc.) as needed.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Properly select and annotate a large volume of media in the Dalet digital asset management system to facilitate retrieval for use in news production
  • Utilize various internal databases and external web resources to organize and confirm the accuracy of metadata for the video
  • Ingest media into the Dalet digital system and provide consistent metadata information for ingested material
  • Catalog duties include screening, shot logging, and adding metadata & restrictions to videos
  • Evaluate video for archiving and rights clearances while maintaining quality control over archiving operations
  • Fulfill producer and staff requests for video to support live air and longer-term projects
  • Shot log ingested legacy video in the Fox Media Cloud database (including the Fox Movietone News collection) and other digital initiatives
  • Manage various special projects and other duties as assigned

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • At least 2 years of professional news library experience.
  • Library Science degree preferred.
  • Flexibility to work a schedule of five days a week, including early morning, late night, Saturdays & Sundays, and holidays.
  • Flexibility to manage last minute schedule changes if/when required.
  • Prior television production experience is preferred
  • Knowledge of digital asset management systems (Dalet, Mimir, Fox Media Cloud, etc) and iNews production application preferred
  • Ability and readiness to learn any new systems (i.e. Mimir) and technology adopted by Fox
  • Excellent knowledge of and interest in history, current events, and news personalities
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Excellent computer skills including typing, online searching, and database experience
  • Strong knowledge of all Microsoft Office applications
  • Willingness to learn all aspects of digital and tape library operations
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within DMS and across various Fox News Media departments
  • Ability to work independently and under deadline pressure

job.title: Director, FAST Licensing
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Entertainment Global is seeking a Director of FAST Licensing to manage content strategy, channel programming, and account management across international FAST digital platforms, working internally with relevant groups within the wider FOX organization. Reporting directly to the Executive Director, TVOD & Revenue Share, this role will drive revenue and viewership growth primarily through the strategic licensing of FOX content to established third party channels and platforms, while simultaneously collaborating with internal teams to establish the foundation for the future launch and management of owned FOX FAST channels.


The Director will serve as a senior, client facing leader responsible for daily platform relationships, commercial strategy, and channel performance. The role will maximize the value of FOX content by applying a deep understanding of ad supported media rights, windowing, audience engagement, programming strategy, and partner business objectives. Success will require strong analytical judgment, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to move complex initiatives forward under strict deadlines.


Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage FAST distribution strategy internationally and leverage relationships across the organization to license FOX content to third party platforms, structuring deals to maximize inventory yield, reach, and revenue
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts, building trusted relationships to support renewals, channel placement, and long-term collaboration
  • Partner directly with OEM platforms and digital partners to negotiate and secure premium in-platform merchandising, promotional placement, and marketing visibility that enhance channel discoverability and viewer acquisition
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Ad Sales to execute distribution plans, track deliverables, and present forecasts to internal leadership
  • Collaborate with internal teams across the organization to help drive the future international rollout of owned FOX FAST channels, partnering to coordinate programming, technical setup, asset delivery, and operational readiness
  • Operationalize KPI frameworks to evaluate viewership metrics, channel performance, and audience retention to inform content selection and optimize engagement
  • Develop joint business plans and evaluate content availability, rights, and windowing to maximize revenue across ad supported and revenue share opportunities
  • Support deal negotiations and review licensing agreements to balance partner needs with FOX financial and strategic objectives

WHAT YOU WILLNEED

  • 7+ years of experience in FAST distribution, digital distribution, licensing, or account management, preferably at a major studio or media company
  • 2+ years of experience operating as a direct client facing primary point of contact and managing daily account activities

job.title: Line Producer, FOX Weather
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Weather

FOX Weather is a 24/7 ad-supported streaming service operated by FOX News Media. Launched in October 2021, the platform builds upon FOX News Channel’s expansive newsgathering units & FOX Television Stations’ added resources with a combined 120 meteorologists for a comprehensive suite of weather products featuring local, regional and national reporting, in addition to live programming. Utilizing multiple radar systems, including an immersive mobile 3D radar, and more than 100,000 HD cameras located around the country, the service offers users an innovative approach to forecasting, including coverage surrounding all weather patterns, from immediate to long-term. FOX Weather is available via foxweather.com, the FOX Weather app on IOS and Android devices, as well as Tubi, Apple TV, Amazon, and Roku, through FOX’s Connected TV Apps.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Weather is looking for a Line Producer to join our team in NY. In this role, you will be in charge of pitching unique story ideas, writing scripts, selecting/building elements, and running the morning rundown meeting. The ideal candidate is a natural leader, a proven go-getter, and someone who can rise to the occasion under the stressful demands of covering critical weather news. You have excellent judgment and make smart decisions in real time.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Pitch stories daily, with topics ranging from the most important breaking weather news to features on weather-related stories of interest
  • Time the show in the control room and communicate effectively with the team to ensure the newscast runs as smoothly as possible
  • Flawlessly pivot during breaking weather news to work in real-time with other show team members and newsgathering resources to provide critical coverage for the audience
  • Manage story placement, teases, graphics, writing, and all other production elements
  • Play a key part in short and long-term content planning
  • Help mentor and train new staff members
  • Select live segments and previously produced content for placement in programming that supplements the live Fox Weather stream, and manage rundown of supplemental blocks

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of relevant production experience, including 2-3 years of line producing and control room experience, or an equivalent combination of skills and demonstrated experience
  • Ability to work under pressure, be decisive, detail-oriented, and meet deadlines
  • Strong communication skills to work collaboratively with team members
  • Expert level segment and show lining in iNews is paramount
  • Field producing experience under adverse conditions is preferable
  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere is an added bonus
  • A passion for weather

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KTVU FOX 2 is seeking a versatile, hands-on Broadcast Engineer to join our team in Oakland, CA. Maintains and installs equipment at the studio and technical facilities, provides broadcast engineering support for all news and production operations (both linear and streaming), assists and trains operators, and collaborates on technical projects varying in scale. This role is ideal for a proactive engineer with strong troubleshooting instincts looking to contribute to a live, 24/7 news operation.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Studio & Production Support: Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot studio cameras, robotic pedestal systems, production switchers, audio consoles, graphics systems, and news video playback equipment.

Signal Flow & Routing: Maintain central routing, master control systems, TOC, and terminal equipment to ensure flawless linear and streaming video/audio delivery.

Newsroom IT & Systems Maintenance: Assist with the upkeep and integration of newsroom computer platforms, editing bays (NLEs), playout servers, virtual platforms, and production automation systems (e.g., Ross Overdrive, NRCS).

System Integration & Documentation: Design, wire, and integrate equipment racks, patch bays, and IP-based broadcast infrastructure. Develop support documentation and standards for operations personnel.

Operational & Incident Support: Perform operational duties in Master Control and TOC as scheduled. Respond to, manage, and track technical issues as they arise in a live 24/7 environment with urgency.

Compliance & Standards: Ensure all operations and broadcast technology comply with FCC rules, safety standards, and station engineering protocols.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in broadcast equipment maintenance, studio AV setup, system integration, or IT/networking in a broadcast environment.

Technical & IT Skills: Strong diagnostic skills; working knowledge of computer networking (IP, subnets, switchers), virtual computing, basic tools, soldering, and custom cable fabrication.

Emerging Technologies: Familiarity with IP-based broadcast standards (e.g., SMPTE 2110, DANTE, NDI) and compressed video encoding/decoding techniques.

Communication & Logistics: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Must hold a valid driver's license with a good driving record for local travel as needed.

Schedule Flexibility: Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support continuous news operations.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & EDUCATION

Physical Demands: Ability to stand, walk, reach, stoop, climb ladders, work behind equipment racks, and lift up to 50 lbs.

 

Education & Certifications: Technical degree in Electronics, IT, or equivalent military/trade experience. SBE, Cisco, CompTIA, or Microsoft certifications and AutoCAD experience are a plus.

Transmitter Operations (Mt. Wilson)

  • Primary Site Ownership: Manage the daily operation, routine calibrations, and emergency troubleshooting of our high-power solid-state/liquid-cooled transmitters and RF switchgear.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KTVU FOX 2 is looking for a bold, energetic, and engaging personality to help redefine morning news on Mornings on 2. We're not just looking for someone who can deliver the news. We're looking for someone audiences want to spend their mornings with. This isn't your traditional anchor role. We want a natural conversationalist with a big personality, a great sense of humor, and a passion for news. Someone who can talk about anything, think on their feet, and connect with audiences without relying on a script.


You're a news junkie with strong journalistic instincts who can confidently and naturally discuss a wide range of topics—from politics, crime, and breaking news to sports, entertainment, pop culture, and everything in between. You're authentic, curious, quick-witted, and excited about the future of local news across broadcast, digital, and streaming.


A Snapshot of Your Responsibilities

  • Bring energy, personality, humor, and authenticity to live morning broadcasts.
  • Lead engaging, unscripted conversations and interviews.
  • Cover breaking news, current events, lifestyle, sports, and trending topics with confidence.
  • Create compelling content for broadcast, digital, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Connect with local communities and bring fresh ideas to the show.

What You Will Need

  • 3 to 5+ years of news reporting or hosting experience, with the ability to speak knowledgeably and conversationally about a broad range of news and current events.
  • Strong on-camera presence and exceptional live, unscripted communication skills.
  • Deep curiosity about news, culture, and what's happening in the world.
  • Natural charisma, quick thinking, and the ability to connect with different audiences.
  • Strong editorial judgment and journalistic credibility.
  • Passion for digital storytelling and the evolution of local news.
  • Experience in broadcast news, digital media, or streaming.

Nice to Have, But Not a Deal Breaker

job.title: News Reporter
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX 5 Atlanta (WAGA-TV), the FOX-owned and operated station in Atlanta, GA, is seeking a dynamic, resourceful Reporter to join our News team. Reporting to the Managing Editor, the Reporter gathers information, edits, prepares, writes, and disseminates general news information and video across broadcast television, live streams, online platforms, and social media. This is an on-site, full-time position working a Monday through Friday schedule at our Atlanta station, with flexibility required for field reporting, overnight assignments, and breaking news coverage.

 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Use contacts and sources to cultivate story ideas daily and actively participate in the news editorial planning process.
  • Produce and present extended live, unscripted content from the field for the station’s live stream, often working alone using a smartphone and related audio/video accessories.
  • Interview subjects in the field and gather news information to produce news reports and generate content for newscasts and digital platforms.
  • Present stories live in studio and at remote locations, assuming responsibility for final content and presentation.
  • Write effective text copy for digital publication of news stories.
  • Actively contribute to station social media accounts across platforms including X, Facebook, and Instagram.
  • Travel on overnight assignments and use file-based video systems to deliver material to the station via computer while on assignment.
  • Make occasional promotional appearances on behalf of the station while communicating clearly, effectively, and politely with the public in person, over the phone, and online.
  • Maintain operational agility by performing other duties as required to support evolving business priorities.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Two (2) years of experience as a Reporter at a commercial television station.
  • Strong writing skills with proficiency in English grammar, spelling, and punctuation, and the ability to utilize conversational broadcast copy style efficiently under daily deadline pressure.
  • Proficiency with newsroom, digital, and broadcast production tools, including iNews (or similar NRCS), BitCentral, LU-Smart (or similar live broadcast smartphone app) with smartphone A/V accessories, bonded cellular transmission equipment, website Content Management Systems (CMS), Microsoft Office, and social media platforms (X, Facebook, Instagram).
  • Excellent on-camera delivery and communication skills.
  • Ability to make independent editorial decisions in the field.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and perform effectively under strict daily deadline pressure.
  • Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

 

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university in Journalism, Broadcast Communications, or a related field.

 

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position operates both in the newsroom/studio and extensively in the field across varying outdoor weather and news environments, often working independently. The role requires travel on overnight assignments as well as schedule flexibility beyond the core Monday through Friday schedule to cover breaking news, live events, evenings, weekends, or holidays as needed.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear, and frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands and fingers, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, or crouch, and must be able to lift and/or carry up to 40 pounds.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $95,000.00-112,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

job.title: News Reporter/Anchor
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Reporter/Anchor for our evening news block. The person chosen for this role will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.


You’ll focus on reporting big news of the day, adding depth and context to stories in our newly formatted early evening news block from 5:00-6:30pm. Then you’ll transition to our redesigned newsroom, where you’ll anchor 90 minutes of live, unscripted news, while operating our Tricaster switcher. You’ll end your day, anchoring our 10pm linear news broadcast from our primary studio.


Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital-first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless of format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter.  We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have an insatiable curiosity about the world around you, from local and state government and how decisions by elected officials impact our audience to a daily understanding of what’s happening globally and the ability to take complex subjects and make them compelling and relatable.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have a relentless commitment to accuracy in your reporting, whether scripted or unscripted. You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.  Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. This is not an entry-level position or a position for candidates who do not possess a journalism background. 


We’re a 24/7 news operation, so you must be able to work non-traditional hours, weekends and holidays as needed.  

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $160,000.00-175,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents.
