job.title: Newscast Director
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

WJBK is seeking an experienced Per Diem Newscast Director to cover staffing gaps during planned absences, vacations, and unexpected leaves for an estimated 3-to-4-month period. In this on-call role, you will step into the control room to direct and technical-direct live newscasts, special broadcasts, and breaking news coverage. This position is ideal for broadcast directors looking for flexible, major-market scheduling.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct and technical-direct fast-paced live newscasts, breaking news cut-ins, and special programming on an as-needed basis.
  • Operate automated production control systems (such as Ross OverDrive or Sony ELC) and production switchers cleanly and accurately under strict live-broadcast deadlines.
  • Collaborate closely with newscast producers, anchors, assignment editors, and audio/graphics operators before and during broadcasts to execute rundown changes seamlessly.
  • Call live camera shots, graphics, video playbacks, and live remote feeds while maintaining station visual standards and pacing.
  • Troubleshoot control room technical issues in real time and communicate clearly with engineering and studio teams during breaking news or unscripted situations.
  • Adapt quickly to varying shift schedules, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

 

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 2+ years of experience directing live local television newscasts; major- or medium-market experience is strongly preferred.
  • Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience operating automated production systems (e.g., Ross OverDrive, Grass Valley Ignite, or Sony ELC), digital production switchers, and newsroom computer systems (e.g., iNews).
  • Control Room Leadership: Ability to stay composed under pressure, make split-second decisions during breaking news, and lead a control room team with minimal ramp-up time.
  • Availability: Flexible schedule with the ability to accept shifts on short notice across mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Production, Communications, Television/Film, or equivalent hands-on control room experience preferred.

**This position is a union position. **

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $40.39-49.95 per hour.

job.title: On-Campus Multiplatform Video Producer/Editor (Purdue) - Big Ten Network
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Big Ten Network is seeking an On-Campus Multiplatform Video Producer/Editor (MVPE) at the Purdue University. The MVPE will support the ideation, creation, and on-site production of Purdue Athletics content across BTN platforms, with a focus on digital and social media opportunities. You will report directly to the Chicago-based Supervisor, On-Campus Content and you will be based in West Lafyette.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create and deliver year-round Purdue Athletics video content for BTN’s social, digital and broadcast channels
  • Collaborate with Supervisor, On-Campus Content to produce video content for digital and social platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Use sound editorial judgement and BTN/Purdue viewer trends to produce content/highlights to serve a Purdue audience
  • Drive day-to-day content collaboration with the Purdue Athletics Department (Communications, Social Media, and Video Teams)
  • Shoot, edit, and produce long-form storytelling content for BTN’s Crossover Franchise series including At The Net (volleyball), On The Pitch (soccer), On The Court (women’s basketball), On The Mat (Wrestling), and At The Plate (baseball/softball)
  • Shoot, edit, and deliver content from live sporting events
  • Perform pre/post video production optimized for social media sharing
  • Ensure all content aligns with brand standards – consistent in style, quality, and voice
  • Cover real-time breaking Purdue Athletics news
  • Occasionally execute duties of field producer on ENG shoots
  • Manage video inventory and share assets with key internal stakeholders

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 1+ years of experience producing custom digital video content
  • Extensive knowledge of digital video production and content management systems
  • Demonstrated production and editing experience with intercollegiate athletics programs or professional sports teams is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to shoot video content at sporting events
  • Demonstrated ability to provide constructive feedback to others as well as seek out and accept constructive feedback for your individual performance
  • Demonstrated ability to be proactive, take initiative, and meet strategic deadlines in a dynamic environment
  • Established ability to create and produce compelling stories; generate and execute ideas from concept to execution
  • Proficiency in the use of technology platforms and graphic design software packages (After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe Premiere Pro, 3D Software) is required
  • Excellent attention to detail and outstanding organizational & project management skills are necessary
  • Able to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays
  • Extensive knowledge of all things culturally relevant to Purdue Athletics, Big Ten Athletics, and pop culture
  • Familiarity with Big Ten Network’s programming, talent, and brand initiatives

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree with an emphasis on digital media production preferred or equivalent experience

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Sports is looking to add a Producer, AI Creative to bolster our AI Creative team. This is a hands-on role creating the next horizon of visual storytelling at FOX.


The Producer, AI Creative will be the first to test new generative image and video products before they are deployed to the rest of the company. You’ll test new models as they launch and form a real opinion on which ones are worth our time, and you’ll run the training that helps producers, designers, and editors put these tools to use in their own work. This role will also be tasked with creating high-level AI features for long-term projects and tentpole events across all platforms. The ideal candidate is a producer first and a technologist second, with the taste to know when the machine got it wrong.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Test new AI video tools and features as they ship, documenting what works, what does not, and where the quality ceiling sits
  • Evaluate tools against real production needs and platform performance data, and recommend what is worth adopting
  • Produce finished generative AI video content for FOX Sports platforms, from concept through final delivery
  • Execute AI-assisted storytelling across all Linear, Digital, and Social platforms
  • Build and maintain prompt libraries, style references, and reusable workflows, so generative output stays consistent with FOX Sports brand standards
  • Support the long-form AI storytelling projects led by the Sr. Director, AI Creative, owning assigned segments end to end
  • Run hands-on training sessions and office hours that teach teams across the company how to use generative AI in their own work
  • Collaborate with producers, designers, and editorial teams across all departments to bring AI-assisted ideas into existing content workflows

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience in video production, content creation, or digital storytelling
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI video and image tools
  • Highly skilled in Adobe Premiere and Photoshop
  • Demonstrated ability to teach or coach others on new tools
  • Comfort working with new and unstable technology, and the judgment to know when output is not good enough to publish
  • Extensive knowledge of storylines, trends, stats and players of the sports that FOX broadcasts
  • Ability to create and ideate digital content with tight deadlines
  • Ability to work nights and weekends, whenever sports are on the air

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Knowledge of After Effects

job.title: Producer, Crime Stories
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Crime Stories is seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented Producer to join our production team in New York. This role must have an excellent understanding of the talent’s vision and have deep knowledge of crime news and the most well known crime stories. The ideal candidate is highly organized, tech-savvy, and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.


As a Producer, you will be involved in all aspects of daily show production. The job will also includes gathering elements, editing sound for the show and doing full show edits as well as creating open animations and specials in addition to delivering the show on multiple platforms. This position requires excellent communication and team unifying skills, strong editorial and legal  judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Daily Production & Editorial Support

  • Support the host and editorial team in all aspects of daily show production
  • Work closely with the entire production team to execute the editorial vision of the program
  • Gather all elements, pictures, video and sound for the show.
  • Monitor breaking news and developing crime stories relevant to the show

Editing

  • Proficiency with video editing software Premiere Pro
  • Skilled in post production management
  • Skilled in creating promo and social media material
  • Creating open animations and title sequences
  • Produce and edit best of show episodes from existing show materials
  • Solid background in media management and organizing video files
  • A strong eye for detail and creativity, the ability to be flexible and work under pressure with tight daily deadlines
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with team members
  • Have excellent working knowledge of crime news content
  • Sequence segments into a creative and logical narrative.
  • Add graphics, special effects, and visual elements to match the hosts conversation

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of professional experience in journalism, media production, or a related field
  • Experience in working closely with talent

job.title: Senior Director, AI Solutions
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Sports is seeking a Senior Director, AI Solutions to lead artificial intelligence adoption and implementation across our content and business operations. This role owns the product direction of our internal AI tools, the change management process, and supports the quality and governance framework.


The Senior Director, AI Solutions will lead the identification of opportunities for improvement across the company and deploy solutions to those areas. This will involve shadowing departments to learn where they could be supported, redesigning workflows to better empower employees, leading training sessions, and future feature deployment. The ideal candidate has led product and people in a creative production environment, is fluent in AI tools and systems, and can inspire groups of people to embrace new technology opportunities.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the product strategy and roadmap for FOX Sports’ internal AI tools
  • Map current team workflows, identify points of friction, and redesign processes with the human user experience at the center
  • Develop and execute change management plans that move teams from established habits to AI-enhanced workflows through hands-on coaching and clear, simple training
  • Act as the voice of the end user: collect qualitative feedback on new tools, close the loop with engineering, and drive wider organizational adoption
  • Establish and enforce human-in-the-loop protocols to verify AI-generated images, stats, and copy before broadcast and publication
  • Monitor automated storytelling and graphics creation for bias, accuracy, and editorial soundness, and own the escalation path when something is wrong
  • Partner with production and design to define the FOX aesthetic for all products
  • Manage rights and clearances for AI-generated content in partnership with Legal and Standards, ensuring nothing inadvertently violates league licenses or third-party copyrights
  • Build and lead a team of AI Architects and Data Engineers, and represent AI adoption to senior leadership across FOX Sports

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 8+ years of experience across product management, production operations, or technology leadership, including direct people management
  • Proven track record shipping internal tools or platforms to creative and production users, with measurable adoption
  • Working fluency in applied AI (generative video, LLMs, and computer vision) sufficient to set direction with engineering teams and evaluate what is genuinely production-ready
  • Demonstrated success leading change management and adoption programs across teams that were not asking for the change
  • Familiarity with rights, clearances, and editorial standards in sports or media, and the judgment to know when to stop a piece of content
  • Deep understanding of live sports production workflows and the pressures of a real-time content operation
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate fluidly between engineering, production, legal, and executive audiences
  • Strong sports fandom
  • Ability to work nights and weekends as needed for live sports and to travel for tentpole events

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree

job.title: Sports Data & Metadata Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Sports is looking to add a Sports Data & Metadata Engineer to bolster our AI Solutions team. The Sports Data & Metadata Engineer is responsible for cleaning and structuring both the proprietary data we already own and league data (Sports Radar, MLB BAM, etc.)so it can train models, power generative tools, and surface the right context at the right moment.


You’ll build the automated systems that pull our data out of scattered, non-integrated tools and into one place engineers and producers can actually rely on, and you’ll maintain the source of truth that feeds contextual information to our AI tools. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who knows both the data stack and the sports, and who understands that a stat is only useful if it arrives correct, fast, and in a shape a model can read.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Clean, structure, and normalize FOX Sports data, including player tracking, historical statistics, and sensor data, for model training and inference
  • Work with leagues, teams, and external data providers creating data workflows and processes
  • Work with data providers and league partners to integrate external feeds and resolve discrepancies against our own records
  • Build and maintain automated pipelines that ingest, validate, and reconcile data across FOX Sports systems
  • Develop an automated data management system that eliminates silos and consolidates fragmented, non-integrated architecture
  • Maintain the source of truth database that feeds contextual information to our AI tools
  • Design and document metadata schemas and taxonomies so sports content and data stay consistently machine-readable across platforms
  • Implement data quality monitoring, validation, and alerting so errors are caught before they reach a model or an audience
  • Partner with departments from around the company to understand how the data is actually used, and shape the schema around it

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, including production pipelines you built and maintained
  • Experience integrating third-party data feeds and reconciling conflicting sources
  • Experience designing schemas, taxonomies, and metadata models for large, messy datasets
  • Strong attention to detail and a low tolerance for silent data errors
  • Strong SQL and Python, with experience in modern data warehousing and orchestration tools
  • Familiarity with preparing data for machine learning, including feature pipelines and training datasets
  • Extensive knowledge of sports data: statistics, player tracking, and the context that makes a number meaningful
  • Ability to work nights and weekends, whenever sports are on the air

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

JOB DESCRIPTION

WTVT FOX 13 Tampa is looking for the next generation of streaming talent to help shape the future of local news. We are seeking a digitally native journalist and dynamic on-air personality to produce and host live streaming content for our growing streaming platform, with a primary focus on evening and breaking news coverage.  

This is not a traditional television role. We’re looking for someone who understands how audiences consume news on digital platforms, thrives in a live environment, and can create compelling, conversational content without relying on a teleprompter. You’ll be responsible for the end-to-end execution of live streams, serving as both the on-camera host and producer while making smart editorial decisions and engaging viewers in real time.

If you understand streaming workflows, live video production, audience engagement, and breaking news coverage, this is an opportunity to help define the future of local journalism.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce and host live streaming programming focused on evening and breaking news coverage.
  • Own the end-to-end production of live streams and VOD content, including editorial planning, technical execution, and on-air presentation.
  • Operate streaming production tools including live switching, encoding, clipping, publishing, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Engage directly with viewers through live chat and audience interaction to create an authentic, community-driven experience.
  • Make strong editorial decisions in real time, adjusting coverage as news develops and audience interests evolve.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership, digital, social, assignment desk, producers, and production teams to align coverage and maximize content across platforms.
  • Pitch original story ideas, cultivate sources, and help shape future streaming coverage alongside newsroom leadership and Streaming Managers.
  • Conduct interviews with newsmakers, experts, and community leaders during live programming.
  • Maintain high journalistic standards while ensuring all content meets legal, ethical, and FOX Television Stations guidelines.
  • Fill time confidently during breaking news, developing situations, or technical interruptions while maintaining viewer engagement.
  • Occasionally contribute to linear broadcasts as newsroom needs dictate.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience in digital news, streaming, reporting, MMJ work, producing, or live content creation preferred.
  • Strong on-camera presence with the ability to communicate naturally in unscripted live environments.
  • Demonstrated experience producing digital video, live streams, or social-first news content.  
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to make fast editorial decisions under deadline pressure.
  • Technical proficiency with live streaming workflows including switching, encoding, publishing, clipping, and distribution. Experience with TriCaster and Adobe Creative Suite is a plus, but the ability to learn new technology quickly is essential.
  • Experience engaging digital audiences and understanding audience retention across streaming platforms.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.
  • Background in journalism, broadcast media, digital media, or related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and other non-traditional hours as breaking news demands.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • A reel showcasing strong live hosting ability and conversational storytelling.
  • Experience building streaming communities and engaging audiences in real time.
  • A passion for experimenting with new storytelling formats and digital platforms.
  • The ability to seamlessly balance hosting, producing, technical execution, and editorial decision-making during live broadcasts.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. job.title: VP, Hospitality
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

ABOUT THE ROLE
Red Seat Ventures is launching a new premium membership business and is hiring a Vice President, Hospitality who will lead the delivery of exceptional, high-touch hospitality and member experiences across Red Seat Ventures' portfolio of premium live entertainment events. This leader will oversee all aspects of event hospitality, from pre-event planning and arrival through seating, food and beverage, unique experiences, departure, and post-event feedback, ensuring consistent execution of the company's premium service standards across multiple markets.


With primary responsibility for event hospitality operations, the VP will establish the operating models, processes, procedures, and staffing strategies needed to deliver seamless, scalable experiences. This includes overseeing the recruitment, training, scheduling, and development of Suite Hosts, managing venue and hospitality partnerships, and owning the P&L associated with delivering exceptional event experiences.


The VP will also oversee the Member Experience function through a Director, Member Experience, ensuring the team delivers personalized member service, builds strong relationships, and maintains consistent communication and service standards throughout the membership lifecycle. This leader will provide strategic direction and operational oversight to support member satisfaction, engagement, and retention.


This is a highly operational leadership role ideal for an experienced, multi-market hospitality executive who knows how to translate an elevated service vision into repeatable, scalable execution while building and leading high-performing teams.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the end-to-end hospitality experience at events, from pre-event planning and arrival through seating, food and beverage, unique experiences, departure, and post-event follow-up, ensuring exceptional service across all markets.
  • Translate the company's hospitality vision into scalable operating standards, processes, procedures, and playbooks that drive consistent execution across events, venues, and markets.
  • Oversee all operational elements of event hospitality, including venue coordination, seating layouts, food and beverage, guest flow, and onsite service delivery.
  • Develop and execute event staffing strategies, including recruiting, training, scheduling, managing, and developing a high-performing team of Suite Hosts across multiple markets.
  • Establish policies, procedures, and escalation protocols for anticipating and resolving event-related issues, ensuring teams are equipped to deliver seamless experiences and respond professionally to member needs.
  • Partner with internal teams, venues, vendors, and hospitality partners to ensure operational readiness, consistent service standards, and exceptional event execution.
  • Own the P&L for event hospitality operations, including labor planning, budgeting, vendor management, and cost control, balancing premium service delivery with financial discipline.
  • Oversee the Director, Member Experience, providing leadership and strategic direction for the Member Experience team and ensuring consistent service standards, communication protocols, and member relationship management.
  • Build and scale the hospitality and member experience functions as the business grows, developing leadership talent, strengthening operational processes, and ensuring a consistent, premium experience across all markets.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Extensive experience leading complex, multi-location hospitality, event, or guest-service operations, with a demonstrated track record of delivering consistent, high-quality execution across multiple markets.
  • Proven experience building, managing, and developing large hourly or frontline hospitality teams, including recruiting, training, scheduling, performance management, and leadership development.
  • Strong operational leadership skills, with the ability to translate premium service standards into scalable processes, training programs, playbooks, and measurable operating practices.
  • Demonstrated P&L ownership and financial acumen, including labor planning, budgeting, vendor management, cost control, and balancing exceptional service with financial discipline.
  • Experience overseeing high-touch guest or member experiences, with an understanding of how exceptional hospitality, personalized service, and consistent execution contribute to member satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Proven ability to lead managers and cross-functional teams across multiple markets, establishing accountability, service consistency, and operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently across markets and maintain a hands-on leadership presence during events, particularly as the business and teams scale.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience delivering high-touch guest experiences within luxury hotels, private clubs, premium hospitality, or other membership-based environments.
  • Experience opening, launching, or scaling hospitality operations across multiple locations or markets.
  • Background working with premium live events, sports, entertainment, or venue-based hospitality.
  • Experience overseeing membership services, guest relations, or customer experience teams responsible for building long-term relationships and driving satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Familiarity with workforce management, scheduling, and labor-planning platforms used to manage distributed hourly teams.
  • Experience working in startup environments or new business incubation teams where operating models, processes, and teams are being built from the ground up.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive/Digital Marketing Consultant (Outside Sales)

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Co, Inc.

Location: This is a hybrid, outside sales role supporting a designated geographic territory. Success in this position requires regular in-market client and prospect engagement. While much of the work is performed remotely and in the field, periodic attendance at a company office for meetings, training, collaboration, and business activities may be required.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped, residual commission and strong earning potential

Quarterly bonuses and incentives in addition to commission

Contests, and recognition programs

Opportunity to build and grow your own book of business

Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

Structured onboarding, coaching, and sales support to help you ramp quickly

Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, award-winning products, and industry-leading tools

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow through advanced, data-driven marketing solutions designed to deliver real results. In this role, you’ll focus on helping businesses reach and convert customers through digital channels—using tools across search, social, display, and more.

You’ll work closely with clients to understand their needs, develop tailored strategies, and drive measurable performance. As part of a team grounded in innovation, insight, and execution, you’ll help businesses make smarter marketing decisions and achieve meaningful growth.

About the Role:

The Digital Marketing Consultant (DMC) role is a consultative, outside sales position focused on helping local businesses grow through LocaliQ’s full suite of digital marketing solutions. DMCs act as growth consultants—prospecting and winning new business, diagnosing client needs, building custom strategies, and guiding clients to smarter, more effective marketing decisions.

This is a full-cycle role. DMCs own the client relationship end-to-end, from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth. Our DMCs are supported by post-sale specialists, ensuring clients receive strong execution and supporting you as you continue to lead strategy, performance discussions, and account growth.

In your first 90 days, you will ramp into the role with clear expectations—starting with intensive prospecting and learning, progressing into full discovery and solution ownership, and transitioning to full territory accountability within your first few months.

What You Will Do

Prospect daily using AI-specific tools and outbound outreach (calls, emails, social, networking) to build new business opportunities

Lead consultative discovery conversations to uncover client challenges and goals

Develop and present customized marketing solutions using LocaliQ’s digital and AI-powered tools

Own the sales process end-to-end with disciplined CRM management in Salesforce

Partner with sales leadership and post-sale teams to ensure smooth onboarding and client success

Grow and manage a book of business, identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities and referrals

Continuously refine your sales approach through coaching, feedback, and learning

Qualifications

3+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development or account growth

Experience managing a consultative, full-cycle sales process

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, and relationship-based outreach

Comfort using CRM and sales tools to manage pipeline and activity

Ability and willingness to learn digital marketing solutions (prior experience is helpful, not required)

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity

Strong communication skills and credibility with a wide range of clients

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

Top performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, and competitive, with a strong track record of outperforming peers and a drive to keep advancing into higher-impact opportunities. They’re coachable and take full ownership of results, energized by real-time performance and rankings. Comfortable with outreach and rejection, they ask thoughtful questions and rely on curiosity, sales skill, and a strong work ethic to drive success.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + uncapped residual commission

401(k) with company match

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO and paid holidays

Flexibility and autonomy: Hybrid/remote work environment

Career Progression opportunities

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives, and contests

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Access to industry-leading tools, resources and marketing expertise

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Expense reimbursement

#LOCALiQ

#LI-Remote

This is an opportunity for driven, consultative sellers who want to own their territory, build lasting client relationships, and grow a career in digital marketing—apply now if you’re ready to take ownership of your success.

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $70,000 and $80,000. Uncapped commission with accelerators. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, location, and union representation, if applicable.

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Account Executive (Integrated Media Specialist) – sales role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Account Executive - Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

2+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance.

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

#LOCALiQ

#LI-Hybrid

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

Grow and manage a book of business, identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities and referrals

job.title: Daily news editor
job.description:
The Salem Statesman Journal and Eugene Register-Guard, the leading news organizations in Salem and Eugene, Oregon, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, seek an energetic and collaborative editor to oversee breaking news and public safety, trending news and food and drink content.

You will identify and champion breaking news and exclusive storytelling in our markets and across Oregon and help reporters tell stories with speed and context through any medium to inform and inspire the public. You must possess sound skills in using metrics and analytics, social media and online tools to identify trending topics and be able to edit and produce multimedia content. Collaboration and clear communication with other editors, digital producers, and photographers is expected.

Our ideal candidate has a proven record of identifying breaking and trending news, driving engagement and growing audience, and is comfortable leading coverage on topics including public safety, courts and criminal justice, local government, wildfires, extreme weather and news of the day. Excellent news judgment and organizational skills, the ability to supervise quick-turn daily coverage and pivot as news happens is essential. A strong understanding of Oregon public records and open meeting laws as well as the legal system and law enforcement is required.

This editor will be adept at coaching and motivating journalists, helping them refine their reporting and writing, manage their beats and leverage multimedia storytelling to reach audiences wherever they are. Previous experience in government, crime, and public safety coverage is highly valued.

Salem and Eugene are located in the Willamette Valley, famed for its agriculture and hundreds of vineyards and wineries. The cities are situated between the Oregon Coast and Cascade Mountain ranges and are known for their vibrant food and drink scene, arts and culture as well as outdoor recreation and sports.Responsibilities

Lead breaking news and public safety coverage in Salem and support Eugene as news demands.

Develop and oversee trending and service journalism that delivers timely, useful information to diverse audiences in both markets.

Edit food and drink coverage in Salem and Eugene with a focus on utility and service journalism, exclusive stories and multimedia content.

Mentor seasonal interns across beats with a focus on breaking, trending and service journalism and exclusive storytelling.

Drive innovative storytelling in all formats—written, video, audio, and graphics—to enhance multimedia engagement.

Identify and fulfill training needs to support dynamic, multimedia-focused newsrooms.

Supervise simultaneous production of print and digital news products with emphasis on immediacy and relevance.

Collaborate with editors across the USA TODAY Network on best practices and regional multi-site initiatives.

Be available to work evenings and weekends to ensure around-the-clock coverage of critical news developments.

Requirements

Bachelor's or master’s degree in communications, journalism or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Minimum 5 years of journalism experience, with at least 2 years in newsroom editing and leadership roles.

Command of media law, libel law, open records law, and ethical standards.

Strong planning and organizational skills, and a proven ability to lead teams in delivering urgent, high-impact news coverage.

Expertise in managing multiple tasks and balancing daily news demands with long-term strategic audience growth.

Ability to make complex stories accessible, with a keen sense for identifying and communicating urgent local issues.

Experience in harnessing public records and data to inform coverage and answer community questions.

Advanced storytelling skills with emphasis on multimedia engagement.

Expert knowledge of audience metrics, social media, and SEO principles for maximizing reach and engagement.

Self-motivation and self-direction and ability to adapt to the evolving needs of a modern newsroom.

Mastery of writing, spelling, grammar, AP and local style.

Able to multitask and excel under the pressures of rapid, deadline-driven coverage.

Understanding of the changing media landscape and a strategic approach to audience and market needs.

Strong competitive instincts, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to public service journalism.

Ability to manage and motivate high-performing teams.

Knowledge of Salem, Eugene and Oregon communities is a plus.

Application InstructionsWe are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single PDF document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job and contribute to leading breaking, trending, and service journalism.

Links to 3-6 online samples of your work, highlighting your experience with multimedia and public safety coverage.

Names and contact information for two references, including at least one person who has supervised your work.

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Director, Digital Operations
job.description:
The Detroit Free Press, Michigan's largest news organization and the largest metro publication in the USA TODAY Network, is seeking a Digital Director to lead and evolve our digital journalism strategy in one of the nation's most competitive and dynamic news markets.

This senior newsroom leader will be responsible for audience growth, digital innovation, platform strategy and newsroom transformation across freep.com, search, social media, newsletters, video, emerging platforms and AI-powered tools. The Digital Director will oversee the digital team, partner closely with newsroom leadership and help ensure that Detroit Free Press journalism reaches the largest possible audience while driving loyalty, engagement and subscriptions.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, forward-thinking newsroom leader with a deep understanding of audience behavior, digital publishing, analytics and emerging technologies. They are passionate about local journalism and understand how to balance editorial excellence with audience needs. They are equally comfortable leading major newsroom initiatives, analyzing performance data, experimenting with new products and coaching journalists to succeed in an increasingly digital and AI-driven media landscape.

Detroit is one of the most competitive local news environments in America. The Digital Director will play a critical role in ensuring the Detroit Free Press remains the leading source of trusted journalism in the region by continuously improving how we discover, package, distribute and engage audiences with our work.

This role reports to the executive editor and serves as a key member of the newsroom leadership team.

Key responsibilities:

Lead and execute the Detroit Free Press digital audience strategy across all platforms, including freep.com, app, search, social media, newsletters, video, push alerts and emerging platforms.

Manage and mentor the digital team, fostering a culture of innovation, experimentation, accountability and continuous improvement.

Partner with editors, reporters, visual journalists and newsroom leaders to maximize the reach, impact and engagement of Free Press journalism.

Use audience analytics, market intelligence and performance data to identify opportunities for growth, improve content strategy and support business objectives.

Lead newsroom SEO strategy, ensuring journalism is optimized for search discovery while maintaining strong editorial standards.

Develop and oversee social media strategy across platforms including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky and future platforms.

Drive innovation in digital storytelling, including video, multimedia, newsletters, live coverage and platform-specific experiences.

Lead the newsroom's exploration and adoption of AI tools and workflows, helping journalists responsibly use emerging technologies to enhance reporting, audience engagement, productivity and story optimization.

Monitor audience, platform and technology trends and translate insights into actionable newsroom strategies.

Work closely with product, marketing, consumer revenue and network partners to support audience growth, subscriptions and engagement goals.

Oversee daily digital publishing operations, story presentation and audience-focused coverage planning.

Lead audience development efforts around major news events, breaking news and enterprise journalism.

Help newsroom staff build digital, audience and AI-related skills through coaching, training and professional development.

Represent the Detroit Free Press in network initiatives and collaborate with peers across the USA TODAY Network.

Establish clear audience goals and regularly communicate performance, opportunities and successes to newsroom staff and leadership.

Ensure all audience strategies uphold Detroit Free Press standards for accuracy, fairness, ethics and journalistic excellence.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, media, marketing or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Seven or more years of experience in newsroom management and digital journalism, audience development or a related field.

Proven success leading audience growth initiatives across multiple digital platforms.

Experience managing teams and coaching journalists in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

Strong understanding of SEO, audience development, analytics and digital publishing best practices.

Demonstrated ability to use audience data and performance metrics to inform editorial strategy and decision-making.

Experience overseeing social media strategy and audience engagement efforts at scale.

Excellent news judgment, editing skills and understanding of digital storytelling.

Strong leadership, collaboration, communication and project management skills.

Ability to manage competing priorities and lead through change.

Commitment to innovation, experimentation and continuous improvement.

Management experience leading digital strategy for a news organization.

Familiarity with Parse.ly, Google Analytics, Google Search Console and other audience analytics platforms.

Experience developing newsletters, video products, creator-style journalism and other audience-growth initiatives.

Demonstrated experience implementing AI-powered newsroom tools, workflows or audience strategies.

Experience working with subscription growth, reader revenue and audience loyalty initiatives.

Knowledge of emerging audience platforms, digital product trends and changing search ecosystems.

Experience collaborating across editorial, product, marketing and business teams.

How to apply:

We are eager to learn more about you and how your skills align with this role. When you apply, don't limit your submission to a resume. Show us how you've led digital transformation, audience growth and innovation in a newsroom.

Please combine the following into a single document and upload it with your application:

Your resume (one to two pages).

A cover letter explaining your interest in the role and how your leadership experience would help advance the Detroit Free Press' digital strategy and audience growth goals.

A statement (up to one page) describing your vision for the future of local journalism, audience engagement and AI's role in the newsroom.

Links to 3-6 examples of work, projects or initiatives that demonstrate success in one or more of the following areas:

Audience growth and engagement

Digital newsroom leadership

SEO and search strategy

Social media strategy

Subscription or loyalty growth

Video or multimedia storytelling

Innovation and experimentation

AI implementation in journalism

Breaking news and major coverage execution

Show us the work you're most proud of and that best demonstrates your ability to lead a newsroom, grow audiences and help shape the future of local journalism.

job.title: Director, Technical Product Management – Audience
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Product Director to lead the evolution of our audience, media, and advertising platform capabilities. This leader will define and deliver product strategy across audience solutions, programmatic advertising, and the integration of owned media into a unified commercial experience.

The role will turn audience insights, media assets, and performance data into differentiated products that are easy to sell, plan, activate, measure, and optimize. It is an opportunity to shape a foundational growth platform at the intersection of product, data, advertising technology, and commercial transformation.

What You Will Own

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

Integrate owned media inventory and audience signals into planning, selling, delivery, and reporting workflows.

Define the target experience across planning, order management, inventory, campaign delivery, optimization, and measurement.

Connect advertising, commercial, data, and reporting capabilities through clear platform boundaries.

Simplify fragmented workflows and reduce manual handoffs.

Programmatic Monetization

Own the strategy for direct and automated media offerings across multiple buying models.

Improve yield and inventory utilization while protecting customer value and premium experiences.

Advance forecasting, pricing, packaging, decisioning, and campaign optimization.

Use performance data and market insights to prioritize investment and validate product-market fit.

Commercialization & Leadership

Build business cases, launch plans, adoption strategies, and success measures.

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Develop product talent and influence matrixed teams across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

5+ years leading complex platform products, major integrations, or multi-team transformation initiatives.

Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, digital media monetization, audience products, campaign workflows, and advertising operations.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

Experience with advertising order-to-cash ecosystems, including booking, pricing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue-recognition processes to connect with ad-serving and reporting platforms.

Understanding modern cloud data platforms and warehouses, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks, including audience tables, identity graphs, data marts, and scalable reporting layers.

Expertise in audience and identity architecture, including first-party identity resolution, consumer graphs, segment taxonomies, known and anonymous audiences, and deterministic and probabilistic matching.

Experience defining API and integration patterns, including REST or GraphQL, event-driven contracts, system-of-record boundaries, and data synchronization across commercial, advertising, and reporting systems.

Strong understanding of media monetization and yield concepts, including CPM pricing, rate cards, floor strategies, margin structures, premium and remnant inventory, and cross-channel revenue attribution.

Knowledge of cross-channel audience activation from owned environments into social, video, and demand-side advertising platforms.

Knowledge of data-modeling and SQL, including dimensional models for campaign, impression, audience, and revenue data; sold-versus-delivered reconciliation; complex joins; window functions; and performance optimization on large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience launching audience-based solutions and enabling commercial teams to bring new capabilities to the market.

Experience integrating advertising, customer-management, order-management, reporting, or revenue platforms.

Familiarity with AI-assisted media planning, campaign optimization, and decision-support products.

Experience integrating customer relationship management and commercial workflow platforms, including campaign planning, quote-to-cash, and opportunity-to-order processes in a media sales environment. Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent platform is beneficial.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms that surface campaign, audience, and revenue insights to commercial teams and customers. Familiarity with tools such as Looker, Tableau, or comparable reporting solutions is beneficial.

Understanding of creative fulfillment workflows, including how creative assets are requested, produced, approved, and routed into advertising delivery systems. Experience with commercial creative workflow platforms is beneficial.

Working knowledge of Python or a similar language for prototyping, data validation, analysis, and workflow automation.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.

Location: Green Bay, WI – Green Bay Press-GazetteSchedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PMPay: $15.73/hourWork Arrangement: In-office – off N. Broadway

Want a Monday–Friday Job That Gets You Out of Retail or Restaurants?

If you're ready for a change from working nights, weekends, or unpredictable shifts, this could be your opportunity to step into a professional office environment — without needing previous office experience.

LocaliQ/USA TODAY is looking for an Office Administrator – Public Notices to join our Green Bay Press-Gazette team.

Enjoy helping customers and working with people

Are comfortable using a computer and learning new programs

Pay attention to details and take pride in getting things right

Can stay organized and keep track of a few things at once

Communicate clearly and professionally

Show up, follow through, and can be counted on

Maybe you're looking for your first office job, returning to the workforce, or simply ready for a different kind of workday. You don't have to check every box to be considered.

We'll train you on public notices, our systems, and the day-to-day responsibilities. Notary experience isn't required, and we can assist with becoming a notary if needed.

A Workday You Can Plan Around

Imagine having your evenings and weekends back.

This is a Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM office position in Green Bay. You'll work with a supportive team, receive training, and have the opportunity to build practical administrative and computer skills you can carry into future roles.

You'll also have access to:

Health, Dental & Vision coverage

401(k) with company match

Paid Time Off

Company holidays

Training and development opportunities

A supportive team environment

If you're looking for a dependable weekday job, want to gain office experience, or are ready to try something new, we'd love to hear from you.

No previous office experience? That's okay. If you're dependable, willing to learn, and ready for a change, apply today.

job.description:
The Columbus Dispatch seeks an investigative/enterprise reporter who uses AI, public records, open-source information and large datasets to find patterns and stories that would be very hard to uncover by hand. This position based in central Ohio is a one-year grant-funded fellowship.

The best candidate has a deep curiosity and unrelenting commitment to get to the bottom of an issue, hold individuals and institutions accountable, and identify solutions. Growth and development, data centers, economic and social disparity, affordable housing, and traffic are among key coverage topics.

This reporter must be proficient in using AI to speed up reporting and other manual processes, creating time and space for more shoe-leather journalism and audience engagement.

We’re also looking for a reporter who is comfortable with ambitious enterprise, text and video coverage, including on-camera video.

What you’ll do:

Find stories in records, court filings, datasets and open-source information across central Ohio.

Use AI to extract, sort and review large document sets and datasets.

Verify digital and open-source material.

Turn promising signals into publishable journalism, confirmed through traditional sourcing and interviews.

Work alongside our journalists, following your own news judgment, to produce exclusive and distinctive stories for our audience.

Bachelor's or master’s in communications, journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

5+ years of news reporting experience.

Strong reporting, writing, editing and storytelling skills.

Experience with practical use of AI in reporting and research.

Comfort analyzing large document sets and datasets.

Scripting (Python or similar) a plus.

Experience creating digital-first content, including video and social media storytelling.

Strong copy editing and self-editing skills.

Strong understanding of audience analytics, SEO and engagement strategies.

Ability to work independently, build trust with stakeholders and manage multiple deadlines.

job.title: High School Sports Reporter (Wilmington DE Guild)
job.description:
Inform readers, celebrate achievement and demand accountability.

We are seeking a High School Sports Reporter to help lead our coverage of local teams and athletes while becoming a prominent on-camera voice. The reporter will produce frequent field video and authoritative rankings of teams, players, games and performances that keep fans returning throughout the season. The role also includes breaking news, major events and distinctive enterprise reporting.

Video and high-interest rankings are central to the job. The reporter will create mobile-first updates, interviews, analysis and personality-driven features, along with recurring lists of top teams, players, games and performances. Other coverage will include daily stories, investigations, explainers, profiles, newsletters and service journalism—all designed to build readership and subscriptions.

What you’ll do:

Partner with our current high school reporter to own the high school sports beat by developing deep knowledge of local teams, athletes, coaches, athletic directors and governing organizations.

Shoot and edit vertical video, conduct interviews and become a recognizable on-camera personality who can host and analyze high school sports coverage.

Break news with urgency and accuracy, including off-field developments, policy changes and other issues affecting student-athletes and school communities.

Publish a regular cadence of authoritative rankings and compelling lists of teams, players, games, matchups and standout performances, backed by clear reporting and analysis. Add timely previews, profiles, trend and investigative stories, reader polls and postseason honors.

Build and maintain a diverse network of sources and consistently identify distinctive stories that competitors do not have.

Use newsletters, social platforms, audience data, reader feedback and verified real-time reporting to strengthen engagement, reach new readers and convert loyal audiences into subscribers.

Work independently on deadline and collaborate closely with editors, photographers and other journalists to set priorities and coordinate coverage.

Pitch ambitious enterprise and accountability stories that examine trends, decisions and institutions influencing high school sports.

What you’ll need:

A bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

At least two years of journalism experience, with demonstrated reporting and writing ability; sports reporting experience is preferred.

Strong news judgment, high ethical standards and a proven ability to source, report and break news.

Clear, engaging writing and the ability to deliver accurate work on tight deadlines.

Demonstrated video production skills, including shooting and editing, plus the confidence and presence to appear regularly on camera and build a credible, engaging connection with viewers.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance breaking news, daily assignments and longer-term projects.

Experience building and engaging digital audiences, using metrics, emerging tools and responsible applications of artificial intelligence to improve reporting, presentation and reach.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, along with the initiative to work independently.

A commitment to inclusive sourcing and coverage that reflects the breadth of the communities we serve.

Work requirements:

This position requires regular night and weekend work based on the sports calendar, as well as travel to games, practices, interviews and other assignments. Reliable transportation is required. The reporter must be comfortable working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and adjusting coverage plans as news develops.

How to apply:

Applicants should submit a resume and three to five work samples that demonstrate reporting, writing and digital storytelling skills. Video or multimedia work samples are required.

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by combining trusted local media, advanced marketing technology, and expert guidance to deliver measurable results. From digital advertising solutions to the reach of the USA TODAY Network, we help businesses connect with the right customers and grow with confidence.

As an Account Manager, you'll play an important role in helping local businesses succeed by building lasting customer relationships, maintaining existing advertising accounts, and identifying opportunities to expand their advertising reach.

About the Role

We're looking for a motivated, customer-focused sales professional who enjoys building relationships, managing an established book of business, and working in a fast-paced, high-activity sales environment.

This position is primarily focused on managing and retaining existing customer accounts (approximately 80% of your time), with the remaining 20% dedicated to new business development. You'll work with an assigned portfolio of customers, primarily supporting basic classified advertising needs, while ensuring accounts remain active, customers receive consistent communication, and opportunities for additional business are identified.

This is a phone-driven role that requires consistent daily outreach, strong follow-up habits, and the ability to manage multiple customer conversations throughout the day. While much of your focus will be on maintaining existing relationships, you'll also be expected to prospect for new business when opportunities arise.

During your first 90 days, you'll learn LocaliQ's products, advertising processes, and technology while developing the skills needed to confidently manage your assigned accounts. With structured onboarding, ongoing coaching, and support, you'll build a strong foundation for long-term success.

Why This Role Stands Out

Base salary of $40,000 plus uncapped commission, with first-year on-target earnings of $55,000–$60,000

Three-month commission guarantee to support your onboarding and ramp

Established book of business with a primary focus on customer retention and relationship management

Opportunity to identify additional revenue through upselling, account growth, and new business development

100% remote work arrangement with a dedicated home workstation

Ongoing sales training, coaching, and professional development

Recognition programs, contests, and performance incentives

Opportunity to build a long-term career with one of the nation's most trusted media organizations

Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and more

What You Will Do

Manage an assigned portfolio of existing advertising customers, focusing primarily on account retention, satisfaction, and long-term relationships.

Maintain consistent communication with customers through a high volume of outbound and inbound calls, averaging 50+ calls per day.

Identify opportunities to retain customers, address concerns, and prevent account cancellations.

Recommend relevant advertising solutions and additional services based on customer needs.

Generate new business through outbound prospecting and follow-up when opportunities arise.

Manage short, transactional sales conversations with a focus on responsiveness, accuracy, and customer experience.

Process advertising orders, campaign updates, and customer requests efficiently.

Maintain accurate CRM activity, account information, and pipeline documentation using Salesforce and other sales tools.

Balance account management, prospecting, administrative responsibilities, and customer follow-up throughout the workday.

Partner with internal support teams to ensure a positive customer experience and successful advertising execution.

Qualifications

Previous experience in inside sales, account management, customer retention, advertising sales, or business development preferred.

Experience managing customer relationships or an established book of business is a plus.

Comfortable making 50+ outbound and inbound calls per day in a high-activity, metrics-driven environment.

Confident communicating with customers, identifying needs, handling objections, and recommending solutions.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, conversations, and follow-up activities.

Comfortable balancing customer retention responsibilities with occasional new business prospecting.

Ability to work independently while remaining accountable to daily activity and performance expectations.

Comfortable learning CRM platforms, sales technology, and multiple internal systems.

Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms is preferred but not required.

Who Thrives Here

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys the relationship side of sales just as much as the opportunity to generate revenue. They're comfortable managing an established customer base, making consistent outbound calls, following up on opportunities, and finding ways to keep customers engaged and satisfied.

Successful Account Managers are proactive, organized, resilient, and motivated by results. They understand that retaining customers requires consistent communication, strong follow-through, and the ability to recognize opportunities before they are missed.

Candidates with backgrounds in high-volume inside sales, advertising sales, customer retention, or account management environments will be particularly well-suited for this role. Experience in transactional, phone-based sales organizations is especially valuable.

This is not a passive account management position. While the primary focus is on maintaining and growing existing relationships, success requires a willingness to make calls, manage activity expectations, and pursue new business when needed.

Remote Work Expectations

This is a fully remote position, with the expectation that employees work from their assigned, dedicated home workstation throughout their scheduled workday.

Employees must:

Perform their work from their designated home workstation using company-issued equipment.

Remain at their assigned workstation and be available throughout scheduled working hours.

Use company-approved systems and technology to perform their job responsibilities.

Maintain a consistent, professional, and productive remote work environment.

This position does not offer a work-from-anywhere arrangement. Working from alternate locations, using personal devices in place of company-issued equipment, or downloading unauthorized applications onto personal devices is not permitted.

Benefits

We believe great performance deserves meaningful rewards, career development, and opportunities for growth.

Base salary plus uncapped commission

Three-month commission guarantee

Fully remote work environment

Career advancement opportunities

Medical, dental, and vision insurance

401(k) with company match

Generous paid time off and paid holidays

Ongoing onboarding, training, and coaching

High-performance culture with recognition and incentive programs
