job.title: Video Producer
job.description:
USA TODAY Co. is seeking a detail-oriented, platform-native video producer to expand video support for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms. This full-time role will use strong editorial judgment and AI-assisted production workflows to turn local reporting, photos, data and graphics into timely, accurate and engaging short-form video.

The producer will work directly with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories that can reach broader audiences through video. Coverage will span the range of local journalism, including breaking news, public safety, weather, government, education, business, consumer issues, community stories, major local events and other topics important to individual markets. This is a hands-on production and service role focused on helping local newsrooms publish more video efficiently across owned and social platforms.

What you’ll do:

Serve as a dedicated video production resource for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms, supporting market needs and network-wide local coverage priorities.

Use AI-assisted platforms, including Stringr, along with templates, automation and editing tools to produce a high volume of accurate, on-brand video from local reporting, photos, data, graphics, user-generated content and newsroom briefs.

Use Stringr AI UGC production capabilities to help local newsrooms identify and develop relevant user-generated content into publishable video while following verification, sourcing, rights and editorial standards.

Use Stringr Clip Gen to create timely clips and short-form video from press conferences, public meetings, interviews, podcasts and other longer recordings.

Use Stringr Show Stacker and other AI-assisted long-form production tools to assemble structured video from local programs, interviews, recurring shows and extended newsroom content.

Partner with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories with strong visual, audience and distribution potential.

Respond quickly to local breaking news and major developing stories while also supporting planned enterprise, service and community coverage.

Create useful explainers that make complex local topics clear, accessible and relevant to the communities our newsrooms serve.

Turn newsroom briefs and published stories into clear video treatments, selecting effective visuals, scripts, on-screen text, audio, pacing and formats.

Adapt local journalism into platform-native vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and other platforms.

Repurpose AI-assisted and automated content for owned-and-operated and social platforms, tailoring each version to the audience, market and platform.

Optimize video length, aspect ratio, captions, headlines, thumbnails, metadata and calls to action using platform best practices and performance insights.

Program videos on corresponding local articles and support distribution workflows that increase the reach and value of local journalism.

Manage and prioritize requests from multiple newsrooms, communicate progress and blockers, and balance planned work with urgent coverage needs.

Maintain editorial, legal, brand and visual standards, including accuracy, sourcing, attribution, captions, fonts, colors and overall presentation.

Track core performance metrics, identify successful local formats and topics, and share repeatable lessons with newsroom and video partners.

Test emerging AI and automation capabilities responsibly, helping improve templates, workflows and production standards for local newsroom use.

Review videos produced by others for quality and accuracy and provide feedback

What success looks like:

Local newsrooms receive reliable, timely video support across a broad range of coverage needs.

More high-priority local stories include relevant video on owned and social platforms.

Story-to-video turnaround improves, particularly during breaking news and other time-sensitive coverage.

Produced videos meet high standards for accuracy, clarity, audience value and brand consistency.

Local newsroom partners have clear visibility into priorities, progress and production capacity.

Strong formats and workflows are identified, documented and applied across additional USA TODAY Network markets.

AI-assisted tools and automation improve production efficiency while preserving editorial judgment and quality.

Who you are:

A digital-first journalist or producer who understands the role video can play in extending the reach and impact of local journalism.

A strong editor with sound news judgment, a sharp eye for visuals and the ability to identify the clearest audience takeaway from a story.

Comfortable producing quick-turn, high-volume video without sacrificing accuracy, quality or brand standards.

Able to move between breaking news, service journalism, enterprise reporting and community stories based on newsroom needs.

Highly organized and able to manage requests from multiple markets, changing priorities and deadline pressure in a remote environment.

A clear, responsive and collaborative partner who can work effectively with local reporters, editors, newsroom leaders and centralized video teams.

Curious and adaptable, with a practical interest in AI, automation and new approaches to newsroom production.

Committed to journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, transparency and responsible use of emerging technology.

Qualifications:

2-5 years Professional experience in digital journalism, video production, social video or a related field.

Demonstrated video editing experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, mobile editing applications or comparable tools.

Experience creating and publishing video for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.

job.title: ESPN Cleveland Spring 2027 Internship
job.description:
ESPN Cleveland Spring 2027 Internship 

(Cleveland, OH) 

Good Karma Sports & ESPN Cleveland are currently recruiting college students for the Spring 2027 Semester. This is a part-time paid internship that will provide an excellent opportunity for students to learn more about sport marketing and media.

The ideal candidate will be an organized self-starter who is interested in hands-on experience in the areas of new business development, promotional event marketing, and sports content creation.

Daily Responsibilities of an Intern: 

  • Take initiative to learn all aspects of the business, ideally becoming competent in marketing execution, the Good Karma Sports partner acquisition process and Good Karma’s content creation strategies and best practices 
  • Assist with event planning, set-up and execution and event breakdown 
  • Engage and interact with local partners and fans during events 
  • Other assigned tasks 
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to the Good Karma core values: Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Listen, Teamwork and Follow Through. 

Hours and Pay 

This internship is approximately 20-30 hours/week from late January to April/May 2027. Interns are paid $11.00 an hour and will gain experience in marketing, sales, and content. 

Opportunity for Growth 

Teammates can continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing our story and core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company. 

How to Apply 

Apply by submitting your resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than November 29, 2026. All are encouraged to apply. 

About Good Karma Sports 

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

job.title: HR Generalist
job.description:
Graham Media Group November 19, 2026 HR Generalist Graham Media Group November 19, 2026

Reporting to the HR Director and supporting employees in the Texas region, currently KSAT-TV (San Antonio) and KPRC-TV (Houston), the HR Generalist is the first point of contact for HR in the assigned region. This role owns tier 1 employee support, onboarding and offboarding, HR transactions, and compliance tracking and audits for the assigned stations. The HR Generalist partners closely with the HR Business Partner assigned to the region, who leads employee relations, investigations and strategic work, and delivers a positive employee experience grounded in our values of Integrity, Teamwork, Innovation and Passion.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Tier 1 employee and manager support

  • Serve as the first point of contact for HR questions from employees and managers at the assigned stations, with a strong commitment to internal customer service

  • Answer questions on policies, procedures and HR processes; guide employees to Workday self-service

  • Recognize issues that need judgment or carry risk, take intake and documentation, and escalate promptly to the HR Business Partner assigned to the region

Onboarding

  • Coordinate pre-hire activities, including background checks, drug testing and follow-up

  • Prepare new-hire documents, complete I-9 verification, and coordinate with local teams so equipment and workspace are ready on day one

  • Deliver orientation that introduces new employees to Graham Media Group and station culture, values, policies and procedures

  • Follow up with new employees and their managers after the first weeks to gather feedback and address issues

  • In the short term, support recruiting (job postings in line with internal policy and FCC/EEO guidelines, interview scheduling, offer letters) while recruiting moves to the Talent Acquisition team and Workday

Offboarding

  • Process resignations and terminations in Workday and coordinate with payroll, benefits and IT

  • Ensure required notices, final-pay handoffs and benefits paperwork, including COBRA, are completed on time

  • Coordinate and complete exit interviews

Benefits, leave and HR transactions

  • Serve as the local resource for health and welfare benefits questions; support new-hire enrollment and annual open enrollment, including employee information sessions/office hours

  • Administer FMLA, ADA and other leave programs, keeping timely, accurate and confidential records; involve the HR Business Partner in complex accommodation conversations

  • Review and process employee changes in Workday (hires, transfers, job and status changes) and raise concerns to the HR Director as needed

  • Maintain accurate personnel files and process employment verifications

  • Administer workers’ compensation claims and incident and accident reporting for the assigned stations

Compliance tracking and audits

  • Assign and track completion of required compliance training, certifications and policy acknowledgments

  • Maintain I-9 compliance, including reverification, and conduct periodic I-9 and personnel file audits

  • Prepare the annual FCC EEO public file report for the assigned stations and maintain all supporting documentation

  • Keep federal, state and local labor law postings current at the assigned stations

  • Run routine HR data audits and support internal and external audits and agency requests

Project support

  • Support company-wide people, culture and engagement initiatives at the local stations

Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and experience

  • 3 or more years of HR experience in a generalist role

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business or a related field, or equivalent experience, preferred

  • Experience supporting more than one location preferred

  • SHRM-CP or PHR certification preferred

Skills and abilities

  • Working knowledge of federal, state and local employment laws, including FMLA, ADA, I-9 and EEO requirements

  • High attention to detail and a track record of accurate, on-time work

  • Excellent communication and organization, with a customer service mindset

  • Sound judgment about what to handle and what to escalate, and a high level of professionalism and discretion with confidential information

  • Proficiency in HR systems and Microsoft Office; Workday experience strongly preferred

  • Confident self-starter who can manage competing priorities across multiple stations

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Primary work location: KSAT-TV in San Antonio, in a typical office environment

  • Travel up to 10% to other assigned stations, currently KPRC-TV in Houston

  • Flexibility to support news operations that run around the clock

  • Assigned region and work location may be adjusted as business needs change

HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates, please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience to careers@grahammedia.com. Please reference HR Generalist in the subject line.

Graham Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In addition to complying with the requirements of federal law, GMG will comply with applicable state and local laws prohibiting employment discrimination. Any offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment drug screening, investigative background check, employment/education verifications and reference checks.

Desired Qualifications/Requirements:

Why You'll Love It Here:
• Innovation: At KSNB and Gray Media, we aren't just watching the future of media happen—we’re building it.
• Real community impact: You’ll be producing the news that your neighbors rely on every single day.
• Growth opportunities: We invest in our people. Whether you want to move into management or master new digital frontiers, we’ll help you get there.
• A team that has your back: We work hard, but we do it together in a supportive, high-energy environment.
Ready to own the evening and make your mark in digital-first news? Let’s talk.

Job Summary/Description:

Do you believe in community journalism? Can you help us build the future of local news? Are you a storyteller who thinks beyond the TV screen—someone who knows that a "newscast" isn't just what happens at 6 and 10, but what’s happening on phones, tablets, and streaming desks all day long? KSNB Local 4 is looking for an Evening News Producer who can own the night. We need creativity and high energy to craft our flagship evening shows while keeping our digital and social platforms buzzing with urgency and impact.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What You'll Do:
• Craft compelling newscasts: Own the 6 PM and 10 PM broadcasts, ensuring every show is packed with information that matters most to our community.
• Learn our streaming desk: Learn and execute streaming platforms, managing live updates and breaking news coverage
• The digital conversation: Update our digital and social media platforms in real-time—because news doesn't wait for the top of the hour.
• Write with punch: Craft scripts that are conversational, accurate, and urgent (no "anchor-speak" allowed here!).
• Collaborate and lead: Work closely with reporters, photographers, and editors to elevate every story through creative showcasing and visual storytelling.
• Own breaking news: Pivot when news breaks, coordinating coverage across all platforms to ensure Local 4 is first and best.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Bring your Can-Do attitude, including:
• A multi-platform mindset: You understand that digital and social aren't "extra" tasks—they are core to how we reach our audience.
• Insightful news judgment: You know a great story when you see one and understand how to frame it for maximum impact.
• A learning mindset: You’re comfortable learning newsroom systems, social media tools, and streaming technology.
• Cool under pressure: Learn to make smart, quick decisions when the countdown hits zero.
• Human qualities: Empathy in your storytelling, a sense of humor in the newsroom, and a relentless drive to succeed.
• The credentials: A degree in Journalism or a related field, and ideally, some experience in a professional newsroom (though we value talent and hustle above all).

job.title: DIGITAL CONTENT CREATOR - WSAW
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WSAW:

WSAW is Wausau's first TV station, debuting 71 years ago in 1954. Together, WSAW/WZAW produce more than 30 hours of news each week. We work hard and celebrate our wins. In 2026, the news team was recognized as the Wisconsin Broadcasters Association "News Operation of the Year" and also the small-market "Station of the Year" (for coverage airing in 2025). Also in 2026, WSAW's podcast "Wisconsin Cold Cases: Who Killed Gerald Mork?" was honored with a Regional Edward R. Murrow Award. These are just a few examples of the honors WSAW has received in recent years.

North Central Wisconsin is also known as "Wisconsin's Basecamp." In Wausau, you will live and work where thousands of people come to vacation each year. Whether you're skiing down the slopes of Granite Peak, boating on Lake Du Bay, or enjoying Concerts on the Square or a show at The Grand Theater in downtown Wausau, there's something for everyone, and you will enjoy the community we serve. Wausau is also located within 3 hours or less of Minneapolis, Milwaukee, and Green Bay; and is just a two-hour drive from Madison, the state's capital city.

WSAW's viewing area covers 11 counties, including the cities of Stevens Point, Wisconsin Rapids, Marshfield, Rhinelander, and the summer retreat hotspot of Minocqua. WSAW is dedicated to serving the community and does so through several weeks-long campaigns such as Share Your Holidays and the annual Diaper Drive.

Job Summary/Description:

Have you ever wondered what it's like to be at the heart of a newsroom where digital isn't just an afterthought - it's the priority? WSAW is looking for a Digital Content Creator who can own the story from the first alert to the last update, ensuring our audience stays connected on every screen.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Own breaking news: Move with lightning speed to send push notifications and update web stories as news unfolds.
- Craft compelling narratives: Write and produce dynamic digital news content that stops the scroll and keeps our audience informed.
- Drive social engagement: Manage our social media presence by posting timely updates and creating content specifically for our digital communities.
- Manage the hub: Split your time between the assignment desk and content creation, helping decide what we cover and how we share it.
- Create multimedia assets: Produce video, photo galleries, and live streams that add depth and visual punch to our local reporting.
- Collaborate for impact: Work closely with crews and producers to ensure our digital voice is consistent, professional, and approachable.
- Lead the charge on digital-only newscast: WSAW produces 715 Live, the only current digital-only newscast in the market. The chosen applicant will produce and anchor the p.m. version of this show.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- College degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or a related field.
- Previous experience in a professional newsroom environment is preferred, but we are willing to train the right candidate.
- Availability for weekend hours; willingness to work flexible shifts for breaking news, specialized coverage, or covering a colleague's PTO.
- A genuine desire to win, the ability to reflect on your work, and a willingness to apply feedback.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with solid knowledge of AP Style *and writing conversationally for Broadcast.
- Ability to edit video in digital formats.
- Proficiency with Photoshop, Canva, or comparable software to create and edit graphics.
- Ability to work well under pressure and collaborate effectively with a diverse team.
- Strong understanding of journalistic principles and ethics.
- Ability to balance long- and short-term projects while consistently meeting daily deadlines.
- Proven record of digital and social media success; must maintain a responsible and professional social media presence.
- Strong research skills and the ability to employ critical thinking to dig beyond the press release and verify incoming tips.
- Ability to carry 35+ pounds of equipment.
- Valid driver's license with a clean driving record (Motor Vehicle Records check required).

WNEM is looking for a forward-thinking, high-energy Digital Content Manager to lead our growing digital operation and oversee the creation and publishing of content across all WNEM multimedia platforms. This role will drive audience engagement and expand CTV/streaming performance, while ensuring the station stays ahead of digital best practices and emerging trends—including SEO and social strategy.

As part of the newsroom leadership team, the Digital Content Manager helps deliver accurate, timely, and compelling content for a diverse audience. The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer and communicator who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.

WKYT in Lexington, Kentucky, is looking for a part-time weekend digital content producer for its award-winning and innovative digital platforms. We have all the tools for success and innovation in digital content: an outstanding, dedicated team in front of the camera and behind the scenes; live streaming capabilities with multiple live trucks and TVUs; access to a drone for enhancing coverage; and a podcasting studio.

This producer will help power both news and sports digital and social coverage on weekends — publishing breaking news fast, supporting game-night highlights/scores/recaps, and creating social-first video for station accounts.

About WMC:

WMC, Action News 5 in Memphis, is the NBC affiliate and legacy news station in the highly competitive Memphis, Tennessee, Market. Action News 5 is driven by the community. We find solutions to problems that impact the people across four states. Through in-depth journalism and local partnerships, we strive to inform, inspire, empower, and support Memphis and the Mid-South. Our team at WMC, Action News 5, is always pushing the technology envelope. Broadcast and digital media innovation are in our DNA. Our team produces 46.5 hours of local programming on broadcast and more than 100 hours on OTT, including nearly 60 NCAA Division I men's and women's sporting events for ESPN Plus. Based at WMC’s studios on Union Avenue, Telemundo Memphis serves Spanish-speaking audiences in the region.

Job Summary/Description:

WMC Action News 5 is looking for a bilingual Digital MMJ to grow Telemundo Memphis’ Spanish-language local news coverage. This is a digital-first newsroom role that combines daily publishing with original field reporting. You’ll pitch stories, interview sources, shoot and edit video, and publish in Spanish for our website and social channels. You’ll also contribute video and reporting for broadcast as needed.

We’re looking for a journalist who can move quickly when news breaks and build the source relationships that lead to original stories. On a given day, you might publish a severe weather update, shoot a vertical video explaining a change at a local school, or interview a Memphis business owner for a story you pitched.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Pitch and report original stories that reflect the experiences, concerns and interests of Spanish-speaking communities in Memphis and across the Mid-South.
- Write, edit, and publish Spanish-language articles, headlines, captions, and social posts. Verify names, facts, quotes, and translations before publishing.
- Adapt selected Action News 5 coverage into Spanish. Add context, local resources or Spanish-language interviews when they help the audience understand culturally or act on the story.
- Shoot, write, edit and present your own stories. Produce vertical videos, explainers and broadcast-ready packages, and report live when assigned.
- Coordinate with the Action News 5 assignment desk, digital team and producers to publish timely breaking news and severe weather updates in Spanish.
- Build relationships with residents, community organizations, and public agencies to develop sources and find stories.
- Use audience data, including video retention and article readership, to guide story selection and publishing decisions.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Fluency in Spanish and English required. Candidates must be able to conduct interviews, write and edit for publication, and deliver on-camera reports in Spanish.
- Experience reporting, producing, or publishing news for a digital or broadcast audience.
- Ability to shoot and edit video independently using a camera or mobile device.
- Strong news judgment, reporting and fact-checking skills, and the ability to meet deadlines during breaking news.
- Familiarity with content management systems, social publishing, and digital audience analytics. Knowledge of AP style in Spanish preferred.
- A bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- A valid driver’s license and the ability to work evenings, weekends, or holidays as coverage needs dictate.

KLTV is the dominant station in the Tyler/Longview, TX area of East Texas. We are an ABC affiliate and have been #1 by every ratings measure, uninterrupted in every newscast for 30+ years. We also have a very powerful, dominant digital presence in the market. We are a leader in the industry in digital innovation and digital products--operating and populating 11 different apps and producing an 19-hour a 19-hour-a-day live streaming news service from our newsroom on OTT, desktop, and on our mobile apps.

Modern facility. Top-notch equipment. Experienced News Managers. Positive, encouraging workplace with an emphasis on teaching job skills and journalism. Dominant station preparing for the future in a very powerful company in this industry. We believe we are among the best newsrooms in the country.

This is a unique position. For the last nine years, KLTV/KTRE has operated a successful, live digital broadcast from our newsroom. Thousands watch each day as our hosts report news as it is breaking, live from our newsroom. East Texas Now is live, local news and talk 19 hours a day and in operation seven days a week. This is an established, mature streaming production that has served as the model for many others in the industry.

The hosts produce, present, and technically direct their shows every day using a special interface developed for and with the input of KLTV/KTRE. East Texas Now is live each day on desktop, mobile devices, in our apps, and on Amazon Fire and Roku OTT devices. If you can talk, love breaking news, and are technically inclined to multitask while talking in front of one of multiple cameras, this is an exciting, groundbreaking position.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Handle Breaking News
- Talk to reporters and news makers via FaceTime and Skype
- Self-direct the show
- Set up and coordinate guests for in-studio or remote appearances
- Plan content for each day
- Perform "live read" commercials from the East Texas Now desk
- Talk a lot!

- Competence in reporting live, online, and on air
- Reporting on digital platforms, often live via FaceTime or Skype
- Setting up guests and reporters
- Computer skills
- Position generally alternates schedules dayside/nightside weekly
- Experience in talk radio is a plus

KALB-TV is the No. 1 television station in the region of Central Louisiana. Our market comprises four primary parishes (counties), including Rapides, Avoyelles, Vernon, and Grant. · Real community impact: Your work ensures that vital news and information reach our neighbors when they need it most.

About WWSB:

Live, work, and play in a unique media market that millions of vacationers consider a top destination. WWSB-TV is the ABC station serving Sarasota and Manatee counties on Florida’s Suncoast. Beautiful, postcard-worthy views are everywhere — and so are opportunities to enjoy the Florida lifestyle. The beaches are minutes away, and you’re a short drive from top attractions in Tampa Bay, Orlando, and South Florida, including major theme parks and cruise ports. While visitors come and go, our station and our newsroom are committed to serving the many thousands of people who call the Suncoast home. You’ll find a special emphasis on hyper-local coverage, while embracing the best practices used in some of the region’s top markets.

Job Summary/Description:

ABC7 Sarasota is searching for a morning executive producer to lead and grow our broadcast, digital, and streaming coverage during this essential daypart. This role is ideal for a strong line producer ready to step into management, guiding a team that is laser-focused on breaking and updating local news on every platform. Our newsroom prioritizes quality and innovation, building newscasts rich in story showcasing, targeted layering, and engaging studio storytelling. You’ll drive a “hungry rundown” — aggressively stacking “happening now” live content, real-time social interaction, and smart, local coverage that reflects how our viewers start their day.

ABC7 Sarasota is ready to add a morning executive producer who can own our biggest growth opportunities in one of the most important dayparts we serve. You’ll lead a team that starts the day with urgency, thinks digital first, and believes smart showcasing and strong studio storytelling are how we win. This is a hands-on role for an experienced producer who is ready to move into management, stay close to the work, and help shape where our morning coverage goes next.

Successful candidates bring solid news judgment, strong producing fundamentals, and a clear understanding of how audiences move between platforms. Together, we break local news on our website, push it on social, and add context and emotion on broadcast and streaming. Writing is at the core of the job, and you’ll be expected to move seamlessly between formats.

Our executive producers focus on quality control, “show wizardry,” and smart content and segment planning. You’ll work with a team of top performers who are hungry for leadership and expect their manager to be in the trenches with them. Our executive producers are considered “best practices producers”: they train new producers and step in to produce newscasts as needed. You’ll help the team commit to lead stories, see what’s possible with the resources we have, and bring breaking news to life on every platform. “Happening now” newscasts centered on unique, local content are a priority in our newsroom.

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

• Manage the morning team and grow weekday and weekend broadcasts
• Review news scripts for accuracy, legal issues, and proper grammar/spelling
• Evaluate and elevate rundowns for maximum showcase opportunities using the producer toolbox
• Develop and maintain plans for daily and future content generation
• Work with newscast and digital producers to enhance storytelling techniques
• Train new producers, editors, and associate producers
• Ensure accuracy and urgency by leveraging ticker, lower thirds, and full screens
• Help maintain producer schedules and produce newscasts as necessary
• Oversee and produce newscast replacement specials as needed
• Recruit producers and MMJs
• Collaborate with other managers to evolve SOPs, plan, and create accountability for newsroom targets
• Attend station-sponsored events
• Write copy for web and edit video for playback
• Edit video for newscasts
• Communicate with newsmakers and field inquiries from viewers

PLEASE NOTE: Executive producers are expected to produce newscasts as necessary, based on business and scheduling needs. WWSB-TV regularly covers extreme weather threats, including strong tropical storms and hurricanes. The morning executive producer leads station efforts to connect broadcast and streaming viewers and digital users with life-saving information. Safety is always our top priority, and all teammates and management are required to be present at the station to serve our local community before, during, and after a storm.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• 2–3 years’ experience line producing in a commercial television newsroom
• Reel that demonstrates a consistent understanding of showcase producing and creative stacking
• Strong news judgment and a solid command of producing fundamentals
• Collaborative, empathetic, training-centered approach to leadership and feedback
• Proven ability to think digital first and integrate web/social elements into newscasts
• Comfortable leading breaking news coverage and pivoting rundowns in real time
• Excellent writing and copy-editing skills across broadcast, streaming and digital formats
• Knowledge of ENPS, Edius, Vizrt and Ross OverDrive preferred

Gray Media Lansing (WILX-WSYM) News 10, home of the highly rated NBC and FOX affiliates in Lansing, Michigan, is on a dynamic growth trajectory. Our combined operations produce over 50 hours of local news per week—and counting. We are Mid-Michigan's undisputed media leader, home to Emmy Award-winning journalists, the Michigan Association of Broadcasters’ “Station of the Year,” your exclusive home for the Detroit Lions on FOX 47, and home to Studio 10, our popular daily local lifestyle show. Alongside our powerhouse primary stations, our family of channels includes MeTV (10.2) and the regional Great Lakes Sports & Entertainment Network (47.2).

Beyond traditional broadcast, we are a true 24/7 multi-platform powerhouse. Through www.News10Lansing.com and our dedicated News 10 and First Alert Weather apps, and our continuous livestreaming channel News10+, our audience stays connected to trusted local coverage whenever and wherever they need it.
We are a breaking news and weather-first station with a fierce commitment to original, local reporting. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. It is a vibrant, diverse, stable, and highly affordable region that offers an outstanding quality of life. Lansing is ideally located just an hour from Grand Rapids and downtown Detroit, and is perfect for day trips “up north” to explore some of the most beautiful scenic spots in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, craft breweries, local wineries, Broadway shows, Big Ten sports, minor-league baseball, and professional NFL, NBA, and NHL games... Michigan has it all! Come grow your career with our winning, forward-thinking team.

Job Summary/Description:

WILX-WSYM, the dominant news leader in Lansing, Michigan, is seeking an experienced, dynamic News Executive Producer/Anchor to lead and host “The 517 Report”, a new local newscast focused on the mid-Michigan market. This is a leadership role for a hands-on journalist who wants to shape a new program from the ground up, combining editorial leadership with a primary on-air presence. 

The ideal candidate will oversee all aspects of newscast production, manage the daily editorial workflow, and anchor the show. A key component of this role is conducting high-impact, live and pre-recorded interviews with local newsmakers, business leaders, and community voices on the most critical issues and events affecting viewers across Ingham, Jackson, Eaton, and Clinton counties. 

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

• Lead the editorial vision, content development, and production of a new local newscast focused on the Lansing and Jackson communities — ensuring high standards of journalism, production quality, and brand consistency.
• Oversee the daily editorial direction of the newscast. Collaborate closely with producers to shape daily content, review scripts, and deliver dynamic newscasts.
• Coach and mentor newsroom staff, providing constructive feedback.
• Anchor newscasts with high energy, credibility, authority, and a conversational delivery.
• Schedule, prepare, and conduct compelling in-depth interviews with local newsmakers, public officials, and community leaders on major issues.
• Pitch, research, write, and produce compelling local news stories.
• Deliver live reports from the field and in-studio during breaking news and severe weather events.
• Publish engaging, timely content to the station’s website, mobile app, and social media channels.
• Conduct live interviews with local newsmakers, community leaders, and experts.
• Represent the station professionally at community events and station initiatives.
• Maintain a collaborative, team-first attitude in the newsroom.
• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• At least two years of professional television news anchoring and reporting experience.
• Proven ability to manage, motivate, and collaborate with a diverse team of journalists and production professionals under tight deadlines.
• Strong news judgment, deep knowledge of journalism ethics, and excellent writing skills for on-air and digital platforms.
• Excellent on-air presence, exceptional ad-libbing and interviewing skills, and a calm, decisive demeanor during live breaking news and unscripted coverage.
• Experience with standard newsroom computer systems (such as ENPS), non-linear video editing (such as Edius), website content publishing, and social media platforms.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KPHO/KTVK:

Home to CBS 5, 3TV, and Arizona’s Family Sports, Arizona's Family produces more than 100+ hours of local news and programming every week. CBS 5 is Arizona’s Most-Watched Television Station, driven by the power of CBS programming and sports, while 3TV is one of the strongest Independent television stations in the country with its highly-rated morning show, Good Morning Arizona. And the reach of Arizona's Family doesn't stop with linear television. Azfamily.com is the market's top performer in local multi-platform unique users. It is also home to Arizona's Family Originals. Our in-house original content production team works on several long-form programs, documentaries, docuseries, and original podcasts, including True Crime Arizona, which is nearing 2 million downloads.

Arizona’s Family Sports is home to the state’s premier sports franchises, including the Arizona Cardinals, Phoenix Suns, Phoenix Mercury, Phoenix Rising, and the Arizona Interscholastic Association high school state championships.

The Training Program:

General Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the role: Step into the shoes of a producer, MMJ, meteorologist, or media sales executive and handle real-world assignments (yes, the kind that may go on air and online).
  • Drive digital engagement: Create content that lives beyond the TV screen, think social media, streaming apps, and web stories because we’re digital-first, always.
  • Collaborate with pros: Work side-by-side with seasoned veterans who are the best in the business, gaining insights you won’t find in any textbook.
  • Commit to the craft: Dedicate 25 hours per week for 10 weeks to mastering your specialty and building a professional-grade portfolio.
  • Make an impact: Tell stories that matter to the community or help local businesses grow through innovative media strategies. 
  • Build your future: Position yourself at the front of the line for full-time career opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 113 stations.

What You Bring;

  • Current enrollment: You’re a college student (Junior or Senior status preferred) chasing a degree in Journalism, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A "doer" mindset: You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty and take initiative; you’re here to work, not just watch.
  • Digital savvy: You understand that media happens everywhere, from the big screen to the palm of someone’s hand.
  • Strong work ethic: You bring urgency, organization, and a "can-do" attitude to every shift.
  • Communication skills: You can tell a story, pitch an idea, or explain a forecast with clarity and confidence.
  • Reliability: You’re ready to commit to the full 10-week program and the 25-hour weekly schedule. 
  • Passion for local: You care about the community and want to see how local media makes a real difference.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Real-world experience: You’ll graduate with more than just a line on your resume; you’ll have the experience of having done the job.
  • Unprecedented access: With 113 stations across the U.S., you’re part of a massive, innovative network that’s leading the future of media.
  • Career fast-track: We love hiring our own. This program is designed to be the ultimate audition for your first full-time role with Gray. 
  • Paid training: Earn while you learn. This is a paid internship.
  • A culture of innovation: We’re evolving on purpose, and you’ll be right there on the front lines of that evolution.

    • Be eligible to work in the United States with a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation

WTAP is THE main voice in the Mid-Ohio Valley. We may be among the smallest TV stations in America, but we are also one of the most dynamic. With state-of-the-art technology, a terrific on-air look, and a dynamic digital presence … you’ll be proud of the work you’ll do here. And you’ll grow quickly because there is so much opportunity! You’ll get to explore whatever you want to do in the communications field, whether it’s on-camera, behind-the-scenes, or in sales. The WTAP team is involved in the communities we cover. From covering high school sports to participating in local events, to helping small businesses grow and thrive through commercials and mobile products, WTAP does it all. And we do it all – together.

The Mid-Ohio Valley includes the communities of Parkersburg, WV, and Marietta, OH and the 50-mile area surrounding them. It’s the kind of place where you can walk down the street and say “hi” to people, and they’ll say “hi” right back at you! It’s the kind of place where local news people become like family to the viewers and online readers they serve and communicate with. There are wonderful parks, great hiking and biking areas, high-quality restaurants, and shopping – whether you like a mall or the uniqueness of small stores on Main Street. Our area is big on heritage, and the many fairs and festivals reflect that passion. Marietta College gives its hometown a New England feel. Ohio University and the community of Athens, Ohio, are nearby.
The Ohio River is the common thread that runs through everything, and the Blennerhassett State Park, located on an island of the same name very close to Parkersburg, is a historic and beautiful place to get away to on a summer day.

There’s much to see and do within a couple of hours' drive from our location in Western West Virginia and Southeastern Ohio. Whitewater rafting, snow skiing, and so much more are available in the mountains of West Virginia. The locally situated Mid-Ohio Valley regional airport and airports in Charleston, West Virginia, and Akron, Columbus, and Cleveland, Ohio, give you access to anywhere you want to go. Wherever you may travel,
Our area is proud of its history and heritage with roots in oil and industry, which have helped shape our region into what it is today. WTAP’s commitment to serve the Mid-Ohio Valley, the place that we call home, shows that it doesn’t matter what the market size is… we are here doing what really matters.

job.title: INVESTIGATIVE REPORTER - WHNS
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WHNS

FOX Carolina is located in Greenville, South Carolina - consistently ranked among the best small cities in the U.S. Our DMA (#36) includes Asheville, North Carolina, and offers a competitive news environment. FOX Carolina is emerging as a news leader, producing 13 hours of news each weekday. Our award-winning team thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative, and fun environment.

Greenville features a vibrant downtown centered on the Reedy River, with top-rated restaurants and breweries, plus miles of walking trails. For outdoor enthusiasts, the Upstate and Western North Carolina offer lakes, mountains, and historic landmarks - all within a short drive. Greenville continues to earn top recognition as a top city, a top foodie destination, and one of the best places in the country for young professionals.

Job Summary/Description:

FOX Carolina (WHNS) in Greenville, SC is looking for a relentless Investigative Reporter who doesn’t just wait for the news to happen—you go out and find the stories that others miss. If you have a passion for holding the powerful accountable and a digital-first mindset that ensures your investigations reach people wherever they are, we want to talk to you. This isn't just about a slot in a newscast; it’s about making a real, measurable impact in the community.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Own the investigation: Dig deep into complex issues, from government accountability to consumer advocacy, and turn them into compelling, multi-platform narratives.
• Contribute daily: Maintain a high-energy pace by providing daily investigative updates, enterprise "quick turns," or digital-first content while working on your long-term deep dives.
• Drive digital engagement: You won't just "post" your stories; you'll build digital-first experiences using interactive elements, social video, and web-exclusive deep dives.
• Cultivate deep roots: Build and maintain a robust network of sources and whistleblowers who trust you to tell the stories that matter.
• Respond with urgency: While you’re a long-form specialist, you’re also a journalist first—ready to jump in with authority when breaking news hits.
• Collaborate for impact: Work closely with our legal team, producers, and digital staff to ensure every investigation is bulletproof and broadly distributed.
• Master the craft: Shoot, write, and edit your own content (yes, you’re a pro with a camera and EDIUS) to maintain total creative control over your vision.
• Maintain the highest standards of integrity and editorial judgment in everything you produce.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• A "Self-Starter" spirit: You don't wait for assignments; you come to the table with a notebook full of pitches and the drive to see them through.
• Relentless curiosity: You’re the person who asks "why" and "how" until you get the real answer.
• Digital-first fluency: You understand that a broadcast piece is just one part of a story’s life cycle on social, web, and streaming.
• Technical versatility: You’re comfortable operating gear in the field and editing under pressure without sacrificing quality.
• A deep understanding of media law and a commitment to accuracy that is second to none.
• Urgency and empathy: You know how to handle sensitive subjects with care while never losing the "get it first" spirit.
• Strong communication, organizational, and time-management skills
• Outstanding Writing Skills & Dynamic Live Presence
• Flexibility: You’re ready to jump in when the big story breaks, whether that means weekends, overnights, or staying through severe weather.
• You believe that news is a team sport and you bring a positive, "can-do" attitude to the newsroom every day.
• A degree in journalism or a related field and a reel that proves you can do it all. Minimum 3 years of reporting experience. (MVR check required).

If you feel you’re qualified and want to work with a great group of people, go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, you may type in the job title, station call letters, or click on "apply now", upload your resume, cover letter, and references

job.title: INVESTIGATIVE REPORTER/ANCHOR - KWCH
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group, with 46 markets, and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency that offers national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KWCH:

KWCH (12 News) is a CBS television affiliate serving Wichita as well as central and western Kansas. KWCH is the market leader, providing viewers with local news, weather, and breaking news coverage. The news team is a 2026 National Murrow Award winner. Wichita is ranked as one of the best cities for young professionals - where you can enjoy a high quality of life, a low cost of living, and a vibrant community.

Job Summary/Description:

Do you have a relentless curiosity that won't let a story go until you've uncovered the truth? Are you the kind of journalist who thrives on the "big story" of the day—not just reporting what happened, but explaining why it matters and providing the deep context our audience craves? 12 News is looking for a dynamic Investigative Reporter/Anchor to join our team. We need someone who can pivot from a months-long deep dive to a high-stakes breaking news situation without missing a beat. Whether you’re behind the anchor desk or out in the field, you’ll be the voice of authority and the face of accountability for our community across every screen.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Uncover the truth: Lead our investigative efforts by producing high-impact, long-form content that holds the powerful accountable and sparks real change.
• Provide instant context: Own the "big story" of the day by digging into the background, records, and data to give our audience a deeper understanding of breaking news as it happens.
• Own the anchor desk: Deliver newscasts with authority, energy, and a conversational style that connects with viewers on TV and streaming platforms.
• Drive digital engagement: Craft compelling investigative stories specifically for digital and social media—because our audience shouldn't have to wait for the 6 PM news to see your best work.
• Master the craft: Shoot, edit, and write your own stories with a sharp eye for visual storytelling and a commitment to journalism ethics.
• Lead in the clutch: Handle breaking news situations on-air with calm, confidence, and the ability to ad-lib when the teleprompter goes dark.
• Connect with the community: Represent 12 News professionally in the field and on social media, building the trust necessary to land the next big tip.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• The right foundation: You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Journalism (or a related field) and at least 2-3 years of on-air television reporting experience—though we’re always willing to train the right person with the right fire.
• Investigative grit: You have a proven track record of digging deep, filing FOIAs, and finding the stories others miss.
• Versatility: You’re just as comfortable anchoring a daily newscast as you are tracking down a lead in the rain.
• Digital-first mindset: You understand that "the story" lives on social media, our app, and our website just as much as it does on broadcast.
• Killer news judgment: You know what matters to our community and can quickly identify the investigative angle in a daily news cycle.
• Technical savvy: You can operate a field camera, light a scene, and edit your own masterpieces (ENPS and AP Style are your second languages).
• Urgency and empathy: You care about the people behind the stories and feel the fire to get the facts right—and get them first.
• A desire to win: You’re a team player who welcomes feedback and is always looking for ways to sharpen your skills.
• Flexibility: News doesn't follow a 9-to-5 schedule, and neither do you. You're ready to work when and where the story takes you.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first - and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About TECH:

If you've ever wanted to work at the heart of one of the most exciting media markets in the country — welcome to Atlanta.

Gray Media's Centralcast Hub is located in the energy-filled core of Midtown Atlanta, one of the most dynamic and fast-growing urban centers in the United States. From our hub, we operate approximately 30 broadcast streams, making this one of the most active and impactful centralized broadcast operations in the nation. Every day, the work done here reaches communities across the country — and you'll feel that purpose in everything we do.

Atlanta isn't just a great place to work — it's a world-class city to call home. Known as a global hub for media, entertainment, and technology, Atlanta is home to some of the biggest names in the broadcast news, cable, and film production industries. A booming film and television production scene has earned the city the well-deserved nickname "Hollywood of the South." If media is your passion, there is truly no better city to grow your career.

Beyond the industry, Atlanta offers a lifestyle that is hard to beat:

* A vibrant, walkable Midtown packed with urban parks, world-class restaurants, live music venues, and cultural attractions
* A thriving university community, with several major research universities calling Atlanta home — keeping the city young, innovative, and forward-thinking
* A booming economy where creatives, entrepreneurs, and the world's biggest brands intersect and inspire one another every single day
* A mild Southern climate with four seasons — and summers made for rooftop patios and baseball games

At Gray Media, we believe in building teams that are as passionate about their craft as they are about each other. This is a place where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your contributions make a real and measurable difference — not just within our walls, but in the communities we serve every day.

Job Summary/Description:

The Master Control Live Pivot Operator is responsible for the technical execution and quality control of live sporting events and local programming broadcasts. This role ensures the seamless delivery of high-profile, live events—including football, baseball, basketball, and more.

This position requires a high degree of scheduling flexibility to match the dynamic nature of live sports broadcasting. The operator will adjust their weekly schedule (including early mornings and late nights) to support peak live event days and will provide critical vacation and shift coverage across first, second, and third shifts.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Live Event & Master Control Operations - Monitor transmitter signals, audio/video levels, and program feeds to ensure compliance with FCC regulations and company quality standards.
* Execute flawless switching, insertion of commercial spots, promos, and emergency alert systems (EAS). Maintain a detailed and accurate master control log of all on-air activities, discrepancies, and live timing adjustments.
* Scheduling Flexibility & Shift Coverage: Adapt weekly schedules to accommodate heavy sports broadcast days (varying from early morning setups to late-night sign-offs). Act as primary vacation relief for staff members, stepping in to cover staff shortages across various shifts. Must be comfortable working non-traditional hours, primarily second shift, with occasional first or third shift coverage.
* Content Ingesting & Media Management: Receive training in and execute the ingestion of digital content into the automation system. Manage promos, program segmentation, and live records. Verify the quality and metadata accuracy of all ingested video files and programming elements before broadcast.
* Additional Duties — Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned, adapting to the evolving operational needs of the Centralcast Hub.

Qualifications/Requirements:

* At least 2- 3 years of experience in a high-volume Live Master Control setting/environment is required.
* Knowledge of Morpheus and Crispin automation systems is a strong plus.
* Scheduling: Ability and absolute willingness to work a highly flexible weekly schedule including various shifts (first, second, or third, holidays, weekends, early mornings, and late nights) is a must.
* Adaptability & Drive: Quick Learner with the ability to acquire new technical skills (including promos, program, and live record segmentation).

About KOSA:

First Alert 7 / KOSA-TV is the top-rated, long-time news leader in West Texas and southeastern New Mexico.

Based in Midland/Odessa, we pride ourselves on being the dominant player in a highly competitive market where there is never a shortage of news that impacts people on the regional level, throughout the state of Texas, and very often on the national stage. Our team of professionals is committed to sharing the most compelling stories every day…and we know that requires outstanding writers, creative photographers, and an innovative production team. Whether we're following local officers to the nation's capital to remember their fallen brothers; traveling to Marine boot camp to highlight a local man's journey; covering a hometown president (George W. Bush) during his eight years in office; or tracking the latest developments in the oil and gas industry – KOSA is located at the epicenter of some of the most important news stories of our generation.

As the only community in the country with an International Air and Space Port, travel to and from Midland from anywhere in the world (and very soon even out of the world!) is quick and easy. We are also nestled in a picturesque region of Texas, often referred to as a hidden jewel that makes for exciting weekend trips for the outdoors adventurer or the lover of rare or unique art.

job.title: MEDIA EXECUTIVE - KSFY/KDLT (SIOUX FALLS)
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KSFY/KDLT:

Sioux Falls and the surrounding area remain one of the fastest-growing regions in the Upper Midwest and are home to 300,000 people, constituting more than 30% of the state's population. Healthcare and finance make up much of a diverse and broad workforce. The business climate in South Dakota continues to be one of the top in the nation, fueled by no state income tax and a diverse workforce.

There is never a shortage of activities or events, with summers packed with outdoor festivals and concerts, including free concerts at the Levitt at the Falls outdoor music venue.

Still, many also enjoy the city’s nearly 30 miles of bike trails and parks, including the namesake of the city, the beautiful waterfalls of the Big Sioux River! Yes, winters can be challenging, but it does not mean people hibernate. Colder temperatures provide plenty of outdoor and indoor activities all winter long. From parades like the annual Parade of Lights down Phillips Avenue to outdoor ice skating parks, life does not slow down in the winter in Sioux Falls.

The city is home to a 12,000-seat arena that is continually hosting major events and entertainment acts, ranging from the Professional Bull Riders, college and semi-professional hockey, indoor football, to concerts with names like Paul McCartney, Garth Brooks, and Elton John.

The city is also home to a new indoor aquatic center, an indoor ice-skating facility, a basketball arena, and an indoor tennis complex. Multiple award-winning golf courses, both public and private, surround the city, offering a relaxing and challenging day on the links

Culinary appetites never need to look far from being satiated, as there is no shortage of places to eat. Not only is Sioux Falls home to many familiar restaurant chains, but it’s also known for many great locally owned, nationally recognized restaurants and restaurateurs. For those looking for a quick weekend getaway, nothing to fear. You can drive to Omaha in three hours, Minneapolis in four, and the Black Hills in five. Since Sioux Falls is centrally located in the Midwest, direct and connecting flights to almost anywhere in the United States are often less than a few hours in length.

Dakota News Now is an award-winning television operation serving viewers in the eastern half of South Dakota as well as portions of southwest Minnesota and northwest Iowa. The stations operate from a relatively new studio in downtown Sioux Falls, branding all stations under the Dakota News Now umbrella. The facilities put Dakota News Now on the cutting edge of television and news gathering technology, making it one of the most state-of-the-art television stations in the market and the region. The Dakota News Now team produces 36 hours of news each week.

Some of our employees have been here for more than 25 years. For others, this is their first job out of college. It’s a great mix that gives us different perspectives while covering the news and assisting local clientele in achieving their marketing goals.

Learn more about Dakota News Now & Sioux Falls here: https://www.dakotanewsnow.com/page/ksfykdlt-careers/

• Build strong relationships with clients and referral sources
• Demonstrate confidence in selling digital products, including streaming, targeted display, social, search, video, retargeting, and other current solutions
• Identify opportunities tied to sports, events, and premium content when appropriate
• Meet or exceed activity goals and revenue expectations
• Collaborate effectively with internal teams to ensure campaigns are executed successfully
• Show clear progress toward becoming a high-performing, self-sufficient Media Executive

The ideal candidate is:

• A proven hunter who enjoys prospecting and closing new business
• Competitive, self-motivated, and goal-oriented
• Passionate about digital advertising and emerging media products
• Comfortable presenting ideas and solutions to business owners and decision-makers
• A strong relationship builder with an existing network they can leverage
• A team player who brings energy, accountability, and a positive attitude
• Organized, persistent, and able to manage multiple opportunities at once

You will also be selling for the FOX affiliate with its massive sports and primetime library. Both networks allow you to sell NFL, NBA, MLB, College Football, NHL, College Basketball, and more! Are you a natural-born hunter who thrives on the thrill of the close? Do you look at a thriving beach community like Wilmington and see more than just a vacation spot—you see a goldmine of untapped business potential? WECT is the undisputed #1 news leader in one of North Carolina’s fastest-growing markets, and we’re looking for a Media Sales Executive who doesn’t just sell "ads," but builds multi-platform marketing empires for our local partners. If you’re ready to dominate the screen (both the big one in the living room and the small one in the palm of your hand), we want to talk to you.

• Hunt for new business: Identify and connect with local businesses that are ready to scale, turning cold calls into long-term partnerships.

• Digital fluency: You understand that "media" means everything from a 30-second spot to a targeted social campaign and a dominant SEO strategy.
• Relentless persistence: You’re the kind of person who views "no" as just the beginning of a conversation.
• Business acumen: You can speak the language of a business owner, understanding their pain points and providing actual solutions.
• High-energy people skills: You build trust quickly and maintain it through authenticity and follow-through.
• A "Career, Not a Job" mindset: You’re looking for a place to plant roots, grow your income, and make a name for yourself in the industry.

About WSAZ:

WSAZ covers a wide, diverse area comprised of three states. Many small towns sit along the Ohio River and smaller rivers and streams that run through rolling hills. Our viewers and customers are extremely friendly and down-to-earth. Although we're not a major metropolitan region, the WSAZ market enjoys relatively close proximity to many large eastern cities, and is easily accessible by interstate, rail, river, and air.

We enjoy all four seasons and the activities that come with each. Nature is always a short distance away, with many surrounding state parks and lakes for recreation. Within the larger towns and cities, there is a vibrant nightlife with many outstanding restaurants and local festivals throughout the year.

Since 1949, WSAZ has been the overwhelming number one choice for Breaking News, Severe Weather coverage, and information in western West Virginia, eastern Kentucky, and southern Ohio. Generations of residents have grown up counting on WSAZ to be a window to their world on-air and now digitally. Our people, on-air and behind the scenes, are trusted friends and neighbors in the community. There is a culture within our walls that recognizes the responsibility we carry to continue what was started more than sixty years ago. We take pride
in our ratings, our content, our status, and the need to maintain the work ethic that got us to where we are.

There has always been a family atmosphere at WSAZ. We care about each other and know that we are stronger as one team than as many individuals. We take our jobs seriously and know that we can be successful and have fun at the same time.

job.title: METEOROLOGIST (W/END) - WIS-TV
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WIS:

WIS is the #1 local media organization in the capital city market of Columbia, South Carolina. It is the market’s top-rated broadcast television station, a digital publisher reaching tens of millions of users each year, and the home of GDM Columbia, a full-service in-house digital advertising agency with national scale. WIS is also the hub for Palmetto Sports & Entertainment, a statewide broadcast sports network, and an affiliate of Telemundo SC.

Serving South Carolina's Midlands since 1953, WIS offers the opportunity to join an award-winning culture for a popular brand built upon decades of market leadership. Named the South Carolina Broadcasters Association's Station of the Year a record 17 times, WIS has earned the Edward R. Murrow Award for Journalism Excellence, the National Association of Broadcasters' Service to America Award, the George Foster Peabody Award, and is an annual attendee of the Southeast Emmy Awards.

Among the many notable former journalists who helped set our standard, NBC Today Show co-host Craig Melvin began his career with WIS as an intern, photographer, reporter, and then anchor.

WIS produces more than 60 hours of local, original programming per week. The station offers a unique variety of multiplatform advertising solutions, sponsored content, and professional creative services for businesses of any size.

Columbia, South Carolina, is a vibrant and growing capital city with a diverse population. It is home to the U.S. Army's largest installation for Basic Combat Training, Fort Jackson, along with the University of South Carolina and multiple other colleges and universities. WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina State House.

Our community combines affordable quality of living with a variety of entertainment and activities to accommodate your lifestyle, whether it's our 50,000-acre Lake Murray, our Columbia Fireflies minor league baseball team, the Riverbanks Zoo & Gardens, nearby Congaree National Park, and so much more.

 Job Summary/Description:  

WIS News 10 is seeking an energetic, digitally savvy Weekend Meteorologist to join our First Alert Weather team in Columbia, South Carolina. We want a dynamic communicator who pairs strong scientific expertise with a digital-first instinct—someone who commands the screen on linear broadcast and thrives in the fast-paced world of digital, streaming, and social storytelling. If you know how to build loyalty on social, turn complex radar data into compelling video, and step up with calm, decisive authority when severe weather strikes, this role is for you.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Lead Multiplatform Storytelling: Produce and deliver compelling weather content across linear broadcast, OTT/streaming platforms, mobile apps, and social channels—tailoring presentations to engage audiences wherever they consume news.
• Drive Digital Engagement: Create dynamic, native digital weather content (quick-turn social videos, live digital updates, and interactive radar breakdowns) throughout the day to grow audience loyalty and engagement.
• Own the Midlands Forecast: Analyze meteorological data and model guidance to build accurate, actionable forecasts for Columbia and our viewing area across the South Carolina Midlands.
• Command Severe Weather: Track severe events with urgency and calm authority, delivering immediate, life-saving coverage across on-air and digital streams during breaking weather.
• Deliver Digital-Only Shows and Discussions: Weather doesn't stop when the show is over; you will have the opportunity to talk science, do science-related stories, and conduct in-depth interviews on our stream and podcasts.
• Maximize Visual Impact: Design clear, visually arresting graphics using the WSI MAX ecosystem to turn complex meteorological concepts into easy-to-digest visual stories.
• Collaborate Across Newsrooms: Partner closely with the Chief Meteorologist, digital content producers, and newsroom leadership to ensure seamless, multi-platform weather coverage.
• Report from the Field: Deliver live, immersive field reporting that brings the impact of significant weather events directly to our viewers.
• This is a weekend evening position.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Experience: Minimum 2 years of on-air and digital broadcast meteorology experience.
• Digital Fluency: Demonstrated track record of creating engaging video content for digital, OTT, and social platforms (YouTube, TikTok/Reels, Facebook Live, etc.).
• Technical Skills: Hands-on proficiency with WSI MAX
• Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science.
• AMS or CBM/NWA seal preferred.
• High-Pressure Execution: Proven ability to handle live, wall-to-wall severe weather coverage with composure and precision.
• Schedule Flexibility: Willingness to work weekends, holidays, and breaking/severe weather shifts as needed.
• Safety: Valid driver’s license with an insurable, clean driving record.

Job Summary/Description:

Do you live for the science of weather but also love the art of digital storytelling? We're looking for a Meteorologist who can forecast with precision, deliver clear, concise weather segments in linear newscasts, create a high-energy, daily weather show on our primary streaming channel, and engage viewers on web and social media. - Own the stream: Produce and host a daily, interactive weather show on our primary streaming channel, making complex science accessible and engaging for a digital audience.

- On-Air Presence: Proven experience presenting weather on-camera with confidence, clarity, and a bit of personality.
- Tech Savvy: Deep understanding of The Weather Company Max products and the ability to navigate CMS and ENPS like a pro.
- Audience-First Mindset: A genuine passion for social media and a knack for creating content that resonates on TikTok, Instagram, and beyond.
- Urgency and Accuracy: The ability to stay calm and deliver life-saving information during high-stakes flooding, severe weather and winter storms.
- Communication Skills: You're a skilled writer and a speaker who can translate complex science into "human speak" effortlessly.
