job.title: TMP/ DIRECTOR (FREELANCE) - (P/T) WKTB/TELEMUNDO ATLANTA (Gray Media Group)
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. The portfolio includes 77 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station, as well as the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 45 markets totaling nearly 1.5 million Hispanic TV Households. The company also owns Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Gray's additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WKTB/Telemundo Atlanta:

Telemundo Atlanta is a premier Spanish-language television station providing award-winning local news and programming. Telemundo Atlanta is available to the Atlanta DMA on a million-watt full-power over-the-air signal on channel 47.1. Telemundo Atlanta has received 61 Emmy® Awards since 2012, including the top honor of Station Excellence in 2013, 2014, 2016, and 2017, and News Excellence in 2017, 2018, and 2019. Telemundo Atlanta was nominated for Best Newscast and News Excellence in 2020. Telemundo Atlanta is the first Spanish-language television station to receive the coveted Overall Station Excellence recognition in Georgia. Telemundo Atlanta produces essential daily local news, which can also be accessed over our website www.telemundoatlanta.com, and mobile application.

Job Summary/Description:  

The Technical Director will function as one of the technical leads for production during live or taped studio broadcast productions. The Technical Director is responsible for the setup and operation of the production switcher and associated technical equipment in the Production Control Room and/or live location environment. They are also responsible for evaluating and then assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels, all while orchestrating the control room setup. Finally, the Technical Director will operate as the “right hand” of the Line Producer to develop and execute the creative and technical “look” of the production by creating special effects via the production switcher and various external effects equipment. This is a "freelance" position.

The Technical Director will be a technical lead for production during live or taped studio broadcast productions. The Technical Director is responsible for the setup and operation of the production switcher and associated technical equipment in the Production Control Room and/or live location environment. They are also responsible for evaluating and then assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels, all while orchestrating the control room setup. Finally, the Technical Director will operate as the “right hand” of the Line Producer to develop and execute the creative and technical “look” of the production by creating special effects via the production switcher and various external effects equipment. This position is a part-time/freelance position.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Live/Taped Productions:

• Set up and operate production switchers and all associated technical equipment in a Production Control Room and/or Live Location environment during live game and/or studio broadcast productions. Orchestrate control room setup while simultaneously evaluating and assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels
• Collaborates with the Producer to execute the technical and artistic vision for each live newscast and/or studio production
• Lead the technical portion of the production team during the production setup and coordinate the faxing of their equipment and show elements since their equipment and work passes through the production switcher
• Collaborate with traffic and HUB entities needed to verify that all video and audio signals are routed correctly and making it to their final destinations
• During a live and/or studio broadcast production, recall video sources, transitions, and effects, and route studio monitors as instructed by Producers. Continuously monitoring all sources used during production to ensure all video levels look correct and stay in timing, which includes external feeds
• Must be able to handle the pressures of live programming and limited time constraints

Job Summary/Description:  

The Technical Director will be a technical lead for production during live or taped studio broadcast productions. The Technical Director is responsible for the setup and operation of the production switcher and associated technical equipment in the Production Control Room and/or live location environment. Job Summary/Description:

Do you have a passion for holding the powerful accountable? Are you the kind of reporter who can take a complex legislative bill and turn it into a story that actually matters to a family in Duluth, Mankato, or Rochester? We’re looking for a high-energy, autonomous State Capitol Reporter to be the face of Minnesota politics for our stations across the state. Based in the heart of the Twin Cities, you’ll be the bridge between the halls of power and the communities we serve—delivering news that lives on every screen, from the 6 PM broadcast to a viral social thread.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

What You'll Do: 

• Own the Capitol: Be the first to know—and the first to report—on the legislative sessions, policy shifts, and political maneuvers that shape Minnesota.
• Tell stories that travel: Craft compelling content for four major Gray stations (KBJR, KEYC, KTTC, KVLY) and occasionally represent Minnesota on a national stage.
• Master the multi-platform pivot: Shoot, write, and edit your own content, ensuring it’s optimized for a digital-first audience before it even hits the airwaves.
• Lead the election charge: Take a featured role during election cycles, breaking down races and results with urgency and authority.
• Connect the dots: Coordinate with newsrooms across the state to provide live hits and localized angles on statewide issues.
• Build a source network: Quickly develop deep relationships with lawmakers, advocates, and community leaders to uncover the stories others miss. 

Why You’ll Love It Here 

• Unmatched reach: Your work will be seen across the state and the country, giving you a massive platform to grow your brand.
• True autonomy: You’re the lead on this beat. We trust you to find the stories and tell them your way.
• Innovation at scale: Join a company that is leading the digital evolution of local news—not just talking about it.
• Community impact: You aren’t just reporting on politics; you’re helping Minnesotans understand the decisions that affect their lives every day.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:

• 2+ years of on-air experience: You’re comfortable in front of the camera and even more comfortable digging through a legislative docket.
• A "Digital-First" brain: You don’t just "post to web"—you understand how to engage an audience on social and streaming platforms.
• Technical scrappiness: You can shoot, edit, and go live from the field (and yes, you can handle the 50 lbs of gear that makes the magic happen).
• Political curiosity: You have a deep interest in state government and the ability to explain "how it works" without the boring jargon.
• Independence and urgency: You thrive in a remote setup where you’re the boss of your beat, meeting deadlines with ease and a "desire to win."
• A clean driving record: You’ll be traversing the Twin Cities and beyond, so a valid license is a must.
• Humanity and grit: You have the empathy to tell human stories and the toughness to ask the hard questions.

KXII-TV’s market dominance begins with a prime offering of CBS, FOX, MyNETWORK & Telemundo; and a delivery of daily newscasts across multiple broadcasts and digital streams including desktop, mobile, over-the-top and CTV. KXII-TV, the area’s leading news broadcaster, has a main studio located in Sherman, Texas, with a bureau & secondary studio in Ardmore, Oklahoma, and serves a combined population of over 300,000 in North Texas and Southern Oklahoma.

A home to many successful broadcasters, KXII-TV has a reputation for preparing reporters, producers, and anchors for their next move, which includes moves to larger metro markets.

Job Summary/Description:

KXII 12, the market leader in the Texoma region, is looking to add a weekend news producer to our award-winning team. In addition to serving as broadcast and digital producer on weekends, this role also includes producing newscasts, as well as to our digital platforms, three weeknights per week.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

ˑServe as primary broadcast producer for station's weekend newscasts
ˑServe as digital producer on weekends
ˑHelp manage station social media accounts, especially on weekends
ˑServe as associate producer three weeknights per week (produces 9p FOX newscast)
ˑPick up other newscasts and digital duties as needed (including holidays)
ˑNewswriting (for both broadcast and digital)
ˑVideo editing
ˑBoothing/timing newscasts
ˑWorking closely with weekend anchor to coordinate news coverage/reporters

Qualifications/Requirements:

ˑBachelor's degree or higher in journalism or related field preferred
ˑSome newsroom/newscast (college included) experience
ˑCompetent news writer and video editor
ˑWorking knowledge of digital news and social media
ˑAble to work independently and as part of team to achieve success
ˑStrong work ethic with drive to win

job.title: WIS NEWSROOM "CRAIG MELVIN INTERNSHIP" SPRING '27 - WIS-TV
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WIS:

WIS is the #1 local media organization in the capital city market of Columbia, South Carolina. It is the market’s top-rated broadcast television station, a digital publisher reaching tens of millions of users each year, and the home of GDM Columbia, a full-service in-house digital advertising agency with national scale. WIS is also the hub for Palmetto Sports & Entertainment, a statewide broadcast sports network, and an affiliate of Telemundo SC.

Serving South Carolina's Midlands since 1953, WIS offers the opportunity to join an award-winning culture for a popular brand built upon decades of market leadership. Named the South Carolina Broadcasters Association's Station of the Year a record 17 times, WIS has earned the Edward R. Murrow Award for Journalism Excellence, the National Association of Broadcasters' Service to America Award, the George Foster Peabody Award, and is an annual attendee of the Southeast Emmy Awards.

Among the many notable former journalists who helped set our standard, NBC Today Show co-host Craig Melvin began his career with WIS as an intern, photographer, reporter, and then anchor.

WIS produces more than 60 hours of local, original programming per week. The station offers a unique variety of multiplatform advertising solutions, sponsored content, and professional creative services for businesses of any size.

Columbia, South Carolina, is a vibrant and growing capital city with a diverse population. It is home to the U.S. Army's largest installation for Basic Combat Training, Fort Jackson, along with the University of South Carolina and multiple other colleges and universities. WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina Statehouse.

Our community combines affordable quality of living with a variety of entertainment and activities to accommodate your lifestyle, whether it's our 50,000-acre Lake Murray, our Columbia Fireflies minor league baseball team, the Riverbanks Zoo & Gardens, nearby Congaree National Park, and so much more.

Job Summary:

WIS offers this exclusive, paid newsroom internship each semester, honoring one of our most notable alumni, NBC TODAY anchor Craig Melvin, who began his journalism career in our Columbia newsroom.

This opportunity places you inside the same award-winning environment that helped launch Craig’s trajectory from WIS intern to NBC network anchor. This internship provides hands-on experience as a valued member of the newsroom team, plus guidance directly from Craig, who will generously share his time and insight.

We’re seeking an intern with Craig’s energy, enthusiasm, and drive. If you’re passionate about informing and serving your community, this internship is your chance to take a meaningful step toward a career in journalism with WIS and Gray Media.

The Internship Program:

As a paid intern, you won’t sit and watch someone else doing their job. Gray’s intern program is an immersive experience where you serve as a valued team member on our award-winning teams.

With 117 television stations across the U.S., Gray Media offers an unprecedented opportunity for students to learn an area of broadcast expertise from seasoned professionals in the business. Whether your interest involves news, production, sales, marketing, or engineering, our stations become a hands-on learning environment for Gray Media interns. If we have an employee doing it, there can be a Gray intern learning and earning.

Not only will you walk away with an expanded resume and portfolio, but Gray’s paid internship also opens doors to begin your full-time career with Gray Media. Many of our current employees started as interns. Our paid internship program puts you at the front of the line for full-time job openings, armed with the training you received from your internship.

Interested in learning more? Check out the program description and apply today!

The intern rate of pay can range from the minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour.

Qualifications/Requirements:

▪️ Be currently enrolled in a college/university (preferred: Junior/Senior)
▪️ Strong work ethic and organizational skills
▪️ Earning a degree in Journalism or related fields, with a desire to get hands-on experience in the local media newsroom

We look forward to hearing from you!

job.title: Building Services Department Manager
job.description:
HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important 

For over 100 years, Hallmark has helped people connect and strengthen the relationships that matter most. Today, we’re building the next century of connection—blending the warmth of in-store experiences with the ease of digital innovation. We’re looking for empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries from all backgrounds to help shape what’s next. If you’re ready to bring fresh ideas and energy, we’d love to have you on the team! As a Building Services Department Manager, you will lead facility operations, infrastructure, and building services at our Lawrence Production Center. You’ll be responsible for ensuring a safe, reliable, and compliant facility environment while overseeing capital improvement projects, contracted services, and emergency response planning. You’ll manage facility resources and budgets, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and support uninterrupted manufacturing operations. You’ll develop talent and align resources to meet the evolving needs of the site. 

The Building Services Department Manager will: 

  • Lead facility operations and building services, ensuring the safety, functionality, and reliability of plant buildings, utilities, HVAC systems, grounds, and site infrastructure.
  • Oversee capital construction, renovation, and facility improvement projects while ensuring projects meet budget, schedule, and quality expectations.
  • Manage vendor relationships and contracted services including janitorial, groundskeeping, pest control, waste management, security, and specialized building trades.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental regulations, fire codes, permits, inspections, and corporate facility standards.
  • Serve as the Facility Emergency Coordinator, leading site preparedness and response for emergencies, severe weather, utility outages, and other facility-related incidents.
  • Develop and manage operating and capital budgets while supporting long-term facility planning and asset lifecycle management.
  • Lead and develop Building Specialists and HVAC Specialists while partnering closely with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Security, and EHS teams.

The role may require occasional weekend or after-hours work, depending on business needs. 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS The following is required to be considered for this role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or four years of demonstrated management experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Four years of experience in building operations.
  • Four years of experience managing front-line employees.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Good aptitude for utilizing business applications and systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Your resume and application will stand out if you have:

  • DOT, EPA Hazardous Waste, and OSHA-related training.
  • Demonstrated experience managing emergency situations and facility-related incidents.
  • Experience overseeing facility operations in a manufacturing, industrial, or commercial environment.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop individuals and teams.
  • Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and vendor management skills.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS: You must show how you meet the basic qualifications (listed above) in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT. In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, we will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. We do not generally provide sponsorship for employment. Employment is contingent upon signing the Employment Agreement, agreeing to arbitration in connection with the Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification, and satisfactory reference checks. 

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

job.title: Data Engineer - Business Intelligence (Remote)
job.description:
WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DO

Hallmark’s Data & Business Intelligence organization turns enterprise data into trusted insights that help teams across Hallmark make better, faster decisions. We build and manage the data platforms, pipelines, semantic models, and analytics solutions that support critical business areas including retail, product, consumer, merchandising, planning, finance, and executive reporting.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING & THE IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE

We are looking for an experienced BI Engineer to design and build scalable, governed analytics solutions that enable trusted and intuitive access to enterprise data. This role will focus on developing Power BI semantic models, reusable business/context layers, and self-service analytics capabilities, leveraging Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and AI-assisted development practices. The ideal candidate will have 6–8 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or related areas, with strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, dimensional modeling, semantic model development, SQL, and modern cloud data platforms. This role also requires an AI-first engineering mindset. The engineer will be expected to use approved AI capabilities to accelerate development, testing, documentation, optimization, and modernization while maintaining accountability for the quality, security, and maintainability of production solutions.

This is a progressive role that will be filled at the level based on the skills and experience of the selected candidate.

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • The salary range for this role is $85,000 - $110,000. Final compensation varies based on several factors.
  • This is a U.S.-based remote role.* We’re committed to creating a connected, collaborative culture, no matter where you are. You’ll have access to virtual tools, team support, and opportunities to engage and grow with us. *Due to state-specific benefits regulations, Hallmark cannot consider candidates for remote positions who reside in Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, or any country outside of the United States.
  • This is a progressive role designed to grow with you. We’ll match the job level to your skills and experience so you can hit the ground running and keep building your career.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.
  • In alignment with our culture of care, Hallmark offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, paid time off, 401K with company match, and profit-sharing.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS (the following is required to be considered for this role):

  • At lease 6 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technology discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including semantic model development, DAX, Power Query/M, dimensional modeling, Power BI Service, data security, and performance optimization.
  • Experience designing and developing dimensional data models using star schemas, facts, dimensions, aggregations, relationships, hierarchies, measures, and KPIs.
  • Demonstrated experience building shared and reusable semantic/business layers, rather than primarily developing individual reports.
  • Experience developing and implementing self-service analytics capabilities for business users.
  • Experience developing and optimizing SQL queries for performance and efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience working with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
  • Experience developing analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
  • Understanding of modern analytical architectures spanning data platforms, analytical data products, semantic models, and visualization layers.
  • Experience designing or developing modern analytical architectures that include data platforms, analytical data products, semantic models, and visualization layers
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into scalable technical and analytical solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating Generative AI or AI coding assistants into real-world development workflows.
  • Ability to use AI effectively to generate, review, refine, and troubleshoot SQL, DAX, M, semantic-model metadata, documentation, and other engineering artifacts.
  • Experience using AI across multiple stages of the development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, troubleshooting, optimization, and documentation.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated solutions for correctness rather than accepting generated code without appropriate engineering review.
  • Experience applying responsible AI development practices, including data protection, security, validation, governance, and human accountability

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (your application will stand out if you have the following):

  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Direct Lake, Dataflows Gen2, and data pipelines.
  • Experience integrating and optimizing Power BI with Snowflake.
  • Experience with medallion or layered data architectures and curated analytical data products.
  • Experience with CI/CD, Git integration, deployment pipelines, source control, and DevOps practices for BI and analytics solutions.
  • Experience establishing BI governance, semantic-model standards, common metric definitions, and self-service analytics frameworks.
  • Experience modernizing legacy BI/reporting platforms to Power BI, Fabric, Snowflake, or other modern cloud analytics platforms.
  • Experience with metadata management, data catalogs, lineage, business glossaries, or Microsoft Purview.
  • Experience developing AI-enabled accelerators, agents, reusable prompts, or automated development workflows for BI and analytics engineering.
  • Experience applying AI to accelerate BI modernization, report migration, semantic modeling, metadata management, testing, and self-service analytics.

 

COME JOIN US! Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF. 

 

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment.

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please.

 

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important

For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like!

When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.

Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the things we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.title: Engineer- Center, TX
job.description:
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO

Center Fixture Operations is one of two U.S. fixture production plants supporting Hallmark Cards, Inc. This plant processes orders and manufactures Hallmark’s product display concepts found in retail stores. We are a talented, small group with many skills. We focus on preventative maintenance and problem solving to reduce unscheduled down time. Our team works in a clean, safe environment and individuals in this department provide the necessary skills to install and maintain production equipment in support of manufacturing and other facility areas.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO & HOW IT SHAPES OUR SUCCESS

We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader who can bring together technical expertise, innovative thinking, and strong business and customer partnership to help move our business forward.

In this role, you’ll apply engineering principles and industry experience to the design and implementation of new or improved products, processes, and services. You’ll help identify opportunities where engineering can create meaningful business value, recommend solutions, and lead work from concept through execution.

You’ll balance big-picture, conceptual thinking with deep technical analysis, bringing together input from a variety of sources to determine the best path forward. You’ll also stay connected to developments within our industry and adjacent industries, identifying new ideas, technologies, and approaches that could benefit Hallmark.

This is a highly collaborative role that works across internal teams as well as with external customers and suppliers. You’ll help shape strategies, build strong partnerships, manage projects and customer relationships, and lead technical resources while continuing to contribute directly to the work.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead engineering innovation and business growth. Champion engineering initiatives that create measurable business value. Help define a desired future state, build alignment around the vision, and develop strategies to bring it to life. Lead project management, quoting, and customer relationships.
  • Develop and deliver technical solutions. Recommend solutions that improve business results, develop plans for execution, and contribute both as a hands-on technical expert and as a leader to deliver successful outcomes.
  • Build strategic relationships. Develop strong partnerships with internal teams, external customers, suppliers, and other collaborators to identify opportunities that create shared value and strengthen Hallmark’s capabilities.
  • Lead and develop technical resources. Manage technical talent, share expertise, and help expand Hallmark’s technical knowledge and capabilities.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

The following are required to be considered for this role: 

  • At least 5 years’ project management or related experience in a manufacturing facility

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Your resume will stand out if you have the following:

  • Bachelor of Science in the field of engineering
  • People leadership experience

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • This is an on-site role at our production center in Center, TX where you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate in person with an amazing team and be part of a vibrant workplace culture.

  • The salary range for this job is between $85,000 and $103,000. Salary will take into consideration several factors including location.

job.title: HR Director - Supply Chain & Retail Strategy/Operations
job.description:
WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DO

People & Business Partnering connects our people strategy with the needs of the business. We partner with leaders and employees to strengthen talent, leadership, culture, organizational effectiveness and the overall employee experience. Working across our Employee Experience capabilities, the team translates business strategies into practical solutions that help our people and businesses thrive while advancing our culture and business priorities.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING & THE IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE

The HR Director, Supply Chain & Retail Strategy & Operations serves as the senior People & Business Partnering leader for these organizations and a trusted advisor to senior leaders on workforce strategy, talent, leadership, culture and organizational effectiveness. Supporting complex, operationally intensive and geographically dispersed teams, this role translates enterprise Employee Experience strategies into practical people solutions that strengthen business performance, workforce capability and employee experience. The HR Director leads the HR team supporting these businesses, partners across Employee Experience functions, and helps leaders anticipate workforce needs, develop talent, navigate change and build high-performing organizations prepared for the future.

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • This position offers a hybrid work arrangement, giving you the best of both worlds: collaborating in person at Hallmark Headquarters in Kansas City, MO and our plant location facilities in Missouri, Kansas, Texas and Illinois, and enjoying the flexibility of working remotely. Employee will be required to be onsite at our plant facilities plus Headquarters for job specific reasons but may also work remotely based on business need.
  • This role is eligible for Hallmark’s Annual Incentive Plan. More information will be shared during the interview process.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.
  • In alignment with our culture of care, Hallmark offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, paid time off, 401K with company match, and profit-sharing.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS (the following is required to be considered for this role):

  • Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in Human Resources or a combination of HR and relevant business/supply chain leadership experience. Candidates must demonstrate substantial experience addressing people, talent, organizational, and employee-related priorities.
  • Minimum 3 years of people leadership experience leading HR professionals and/or multi-level teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (your application will stand out if you have the following):

  • Extensive experience in HR business partnering, workforce and talent strategy, organizational effectiveness, and change management.
  • Demonstrated success advising senior leaders on workforce strategy, succession, leadership development, organizational effectiveness, and complex change or transformation.
  • Strong understanding of talent and culture practices across the employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, performance and development, succession, and compensation planning.
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing HR teams and building future HR talent and leadership capability, ideally within a complex, matrixed environment.
  • Proven ability to use workforce analytics, employee listening, and business insights to inform decisions and organizational priorities.
  • Strong understanding of employee relations, employment practices, organizational risk, and workplace culture.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach and influence leaders on leadership effectiveness, talent, performance, career development, and workplace challenges.
  • Strong executive presence and consulting skills, with the ability to partner across HR disciplines and business leadership, balance strategy with execution, and drive outcomes through others.

 

Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply.

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF. 

 

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment.

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please.

 

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important

For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like!

When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.

Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the things we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.title: Packaging Operator (37) - 3rd Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

The Packaging Operator position reports through the Lawrence Production Center and may be in the Quality, Folding, Page Insert, Specialty Packaging and/or Counter Packaging departments.  Individuals in these departments operate various machines to package greeting card products and perform the quality inspector role.

      

This position is a Full time position Sunday - Friday, 11:30pm - 7:30am. First shift will be Sunday night and last shift of the week is Thursday night into Friday morning.

 

The Packaging Operator in Lawrence sets up and operates automatic production machines that involve standard or high speeds to produce/package specialty or greeting card products.  Operations may include such activities as winding or spooling, wrapping or banding, folding, packaging product, labeling, and other final production processes. Makes judgment calls in the make-ready and production and/or packaging stages in order to insure quality production. Monitors, troubleshoots and corrects machine malfunctions. Completes required paperwork and/or computer input on specific SAP screens to confirm production and spoilage/scrap. Adheres to quality standards and procedures and initiates adjustments as needed to correct product and/or packaging defects. Prepares and maintains necessary paperwork. May perform quality inspections on in-process and finished goods in accordance with the Quality Department procedures. Assesses cause of defects, charging responsible operations. Records and inputs pertinent data.      

 

Maintains a neat and safe working environment. Actively engages and asks probing questions regarding press issues or performance.  Performs required preventive maintenance.  Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities. Identifies potential problems and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation. Demonstrates leadership amongst the team. Flexibility is key as the incumbent will operate multiple machines and perform the quality inspector role, as needed. Incumbent possesses moderate mechanical abilities, but training is obtained on the job. 

 

The Packaging Operator position may be in the Quality, Folding, Page Insert, Specialty and/or Counter Packaging departments, and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.   

 

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready procedures and other press adjustments on a variety of equipment with similar skill set.  Prepare the press to run and maintain or exceed the specified quality and production expectations. Troubleshoot from a variety of maintenance issues which may deal with robots, feeders, batches, bow machines, etc.  
  • Set up and operate a variety of automated production and/or packaging type machines, along with continually improving the specified production including throughput, OEE, etc.  May work with the computer systems to track components, order materials, etc. 
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage. Develop an understanding of a wide range of quality systems and product specifications. Help prepare related paperwork/documentation for shipping accuracy, including completing production data and spoilage. 
  • Determine sample size and perform audit inspections on in-process and finished goods in accordance with the Quality Department standard operating procedures. Record all required production and defect information on inspection sheets and in SAP.
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within the shorter periods of time.  Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities. Identify potential problems and proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Communicate with peers so everyone is current on the day to day process. Creatively think outside the scope to see how you can help others.
  • Utilize good safety practices; understand and follow established safety procedures. Complete regular press maintenance and cleaning including TPM's/MIRC's (monthly inspection, repair & cleaning). Demonstrate mechanical ability by problem solving technical issues on the equipment.

 

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

You must show how you meet basic qualifications (listed below) in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields.  Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT. 

 

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to grasp, lift and carry product weighing up to 15 lbs frequently and 65 lbs occasionally
  • Ability to stand and walk approximately 90% of the time
  • Ability to reach, twist, bend, perform repetitive hand/wrist motion, and use fine motor skills 90% of the time
  • Ability to occasionally work at or above shoulder level  

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Basic math, written and oral communication skills
  • High School Diploma, GED or equivalent
  • Ability to understand the computer and ordering systems and successfully operate both systems
  • Ability to set up area and work under pressure to meet production targets
  • Ability to understand and follow established safety procedures
  • Ability to accept other duties as assigned
  • Ability to learn and retain knowledge
  • Ability to work as a team member

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • Work overtime as required during peak seasons
  • There is some noise and hearing protection is required by Hallmark.
  • This is a climate-controlled manufacturing environment with normal physical injury hazard.   

                                            

This position is located in Lawrence, Kansas.  Relocation is not provided.

  • Conduct quality inspections on in-process and finished goods; remove defective products

  • Collaborate with team members to solve problems, drive results, and share process updates
  • Maintain a clean and safe work area; follow all safety protocols
  • Support multiple assignments and departments as needed; demonstrate flexibility
  • Track and replenish packaging materials to minimize downtime
  • Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities
  • Learn and apply a wide range of quality systems and product specifications

  • Ability to grasp, lift and carry product weighing up to 15 lbs frequently and 65 lbs occasionally
  • Ability to stand and walk approximately 90% of the time
  • Ability to reach, twist, bend, perform repetitive hand/wrist motion, and use fine motor skills 90% of the time
  • Ability to occasionally work at or above shoulder level  
  • Ability to work overtime as needed

job.title: Production Support Specialist (36) - 1st Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

JOB OVERVIEW

You’ll be at the heart of our production center, helping millions of customers across the world enjoy Hallmark products. You will have a variety of duties that support the production process in numerous ways. You’ll be cross-trained across multiple departments by a support team of trainers and supervisors to help you learn every step of the way!


SALARY AND SHIFT DETAILS

  • This position is a full-time, 5-day work week position in the 1st shift from 7:30am to 3:30pm, Monday through Friday.
    Don’t see a shift that works for you? We still encourage you to apply! We’ll work with you to find a shift that fits your lifestyle and gives you the flexibility you need.

The Production Support Specialist in Lawrence has a variety of duties that support production in numerous ways.  Prepares greeting card stock for the Cutter to cut.  Jogs, skids and moves stock to the cutter.  Carries stock to skids and moves finished skids into the outgoing area.  Responsible for complete make-ready, run, monitoring and maintenance.  Removes die cut cards from full sheets either using a hammer or by using an Automatic Card Extractor (ACE).  Performs make-readies on the ACE and prepares rails/bars and press set-up.  Responsible for quality sampling and stacking cards onto skids according to register, blockouts, salvage and spoilage.  Determines when adhesive will be mixed and when test will be performed on the mixture.  Responsible for ensuring that the ingredients are in the area for mixing the adhesive.  Assists the Webtron press operator with press set up and changeover, make-readies, machine adjustments and routine preventative maintenance procedures.  Responsible for supporting the production areas by ordering the correct stock, moving components in and out of the areas, inputting information on the computer system, and maintaining a clean, safe, work environment. 

Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.  Sets up and operates a Gem/Cello machine, wholesale sealer, accumulator and shrink tunnel which shrinks poly film around wholesale unit of specialty items and/or operates a lift truck and keeps track of stock in the OAI.  Performs all paperwork assigned involved in moving stock, either into or out of the department.  Packs finished goods on a packaging line.  Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work assignments as needed.

Important things to know:

  • Position may be in several departments and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

  • In the production areas there is some noise. Hearing protection is provided by Hallmark.
  • Overtime is available and will be covered during the interview process.
  • The reporting area may change as business needs change.

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready duties on the Gem/Cello machines, ACE press and Webtron presses.  Set up wholesale sealer and pack product into shipping containers.  Mix adhesives and assure the proper ingredients and quantities are available in the area. 
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage.  Perform quality and/or adhesive test and report results in a timely manner.  Plan and maintain the workflow through the department in accordance with work schedule.  Order and deliver stock, cartons, and other components needed for production to the work area. 
  • Achieve and continually improve specified production including production goals, throughput, etc. during training.  Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities.  .
  • Complete regular press maintenance and cleaning, including TPM’s.  Move skids of stock into and away from the press, including completion of related paperwork.  Transport and handle hazardous waste material in accordance with all Federal, State, and Local regulations.  Be certified to operate power lift equipment and skid inverting machine. 
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within shorter periods of time.  Effectively communicate information to the next shift to ensure consistency and continuous operation. 
  • Utilize good safety practices.

 

YOUR AREAS OF KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE

Basic Qualifications

  • You’re at least 18 years of age
  • You have the ability to grip and push/pull lifts of stock 2”-3.5” thick, 80-120 times per hour
  • You have the ability to lift 20-30 lb stacks of stock, 60-80 times per hour, with frequent lifting throughout the shift of 40-60 lbs.
  • You have the ability to constantly stand, walk, twist, bend, and reach above shoulder level
  • You have the ability to constantly use repetitive hand/wrist motion and perform fine motor skills
  • You have the ability to operate a computer independently

Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Strong communication- and problem-solving skills

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING AT HALLMARK

We want to help you be your best – at work and at home, now and in the future. It’s why providing benefits to support you and your family’s well-being is one of the most important investments Hallmark makes.

  • Your Health: Medical, vision, and dental plans; Specialized plan option for people with type 2 diabetes; Short-term and long-term disability coverage; Life and accident insurance
  • Your Well-Being: On-site registered nurses who provide health consultations and optional seasonal vaccinations. Health rewards program (earn up to $400 per year).
  • Your finances: A 401(k) with a 4% company match vested from day one. Health savings (HSA) or Flexible spending (FSA) accounts.
  • Your life: During your first year, you’ll receive 18 days (144 hours) of PTO and 10 paid holidays. Paid parental leave, adoption assistance, and comprehensive fertility benefits for eligible employees.
  • Your work environment: Climate-controlled and safety-first environment; On-site café that offers hot and cold meals; On-site Hallmark store where you can shop Hallmark products for 50%-75% off; Inclusive environment and a relaxed dress code, with a few safety rules to follow (close-toed shoes are required). Whether you have purple hair or express yourself through body art, we want you to bring your whole self to work.
  •  Your career: A career with Hallmark can take you anywhere. Our career paths are shaped by your talents and ambitions. Whether you want to take the next step up in a role you know and love or are looking to move into an entirely new area or location. We can help you do just that.

Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply. 

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF.  

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. 

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks. 

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please. 

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important 

For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here.

Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like! 

When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success. 

Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the things we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.title: AI Music Research Intern
job.description:
About Hook Hook is a social music platform, backed by top-tier investors, building the next generation of music discovery, fan expression, and creator growth. We turn the songs people love into sounds they can play with, enabling fans and creators to reimagine music through intuitive, remix-friendly experiences with zero learning curve. By partnering directly with artists, labels, and rightsholders, Hook ensures music is discovered, shared, and expressed in ways that respect and reward the people behind it. At Hook, music isn’t just consumed. It’s experienced, expressed, and made personal. Role

Overview

We are looking for a curious and motivated AI Music Research Intern to help us explore and develop AI-powered tools for music creation, transformation, remixing, and creative interaction. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of music, machine learning, and creative technology, experimenting with emerging AI techniques and helping turn research ideas into practical tools for music creators. You’ll have the opportunity to work on real-world challenges involving generative audio, music understanding, and audio modeling, while collaborating with our music technology, engineering, product, and creative teams. Whether you have

experience

through academic research, coursework, or personal projects, this is an opportunity to apply your technical skills to exciting problems in AI music and help shape new ways for people to interact with music. At Hook, we believe AI should expand creative possibilities while respecting the people behind the music. You’ll contribute to developing tools that support musical expression and responsible use of music and data.

Responsibilities

Explore AI music technologies: Research and experiment with machine learning approaches for music generation, transformation, remixing, and audio understanding. Implement and evaluate models: Use Python and modern ML frameworks to build, test, and evaluate AI models and audio processing techniques. Build prototypes: Develop experimental tools and prototypes that explore new ways to make music more interactive, expressive, and accessible. Work with data and experiments: Process audio datasets, run experiments, and evaluate model performance, audio quality, and musicality. Collaborate and share findings: Work with engineers, music technologists, and producers to explore creative use cases, document experiments, and contribute to responsible AI development.

Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Audio Signal Processing, Music Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Foundational knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, and statistical methods. Proficiency in Python and familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch. Interest in audio, music, generative AI, or creative applications of machine learning. Familiarity with audio processing, digital signal processing, or music-related datasets through coursework, research, or personal projects. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity and a willingness to experiment with new ideas. Ability to work independently on technical tasks while collaborating effectively with a multidisciplinary team. Genuine interest in music, creative tools, and how technology can expand musical expression. Bonus

Qualifications

Academic projects, research experience, or personal projects involving audio processing, music generation, or machine learning. Familiarity with generative audio models, including diffusion-based, autoregressive, or other neural audio architectures.

Experience

with audio libraries, such as librosa or torchaudio, or tools for audio analysis and manipulation. Familiarity with audio embeddings, neural audio codecs, text-audio models, or multimodal learning.

Experience

with music production software, digital audio workstations (DAWs), audio plugins, or creative coding tools.

Experience

collaborating with musicians, producers, or other creative professionals. Familiarity with evaluating generative models or assessing subjective qualities such as musicality, expressiveness, and controllability. Interest in responsible AI practices, including artist consent, music rights, and ethical dataset development. Contributions to research projects, open-source software, machine learning competitions, or relevant technical communities. Our Approach to Responsible AI Music At Hook, we believe AI should expand what people can do with music while respecting the people who create it. We build with artists and rightsholders in mind, developing tools that support creative expression while recognizing the value of human creativity. This means taking a thoughtful approach to the music and data used in model development, respecting rights and permissions, and considering how our technology affects artists, producers, and the broader music ecosystem. We value interns who combine technical curiosity with a thoughtful approach to building AI responsibly and who are excited to help develop technology that

benefits

both music creators and listeners. What We Offer Hands-on

experience

researching and building AI-powered music tools. The opportunity to work on real-world challenges in generative AI, audio modeling, and music technology. Close collaboration with researchers, engineers, music technologists, and producers. The opportunity to experiment with emerging technologies and contribute ideas to product development. Exposure to the process of turning research prototypes into practical creative tools. Mentorship and support for continued technical learning and professional growth. A chance to help shape the future of music discovery, creation, and expression in a responsible, creative environment.

job.title: Machine Learning Engineering Intern, Recommendation Systems
job.description:
About Hook Hook is a social music platform, backed by top-tier investors, building the next generation of music discovery, fan expression, and creator growth. We turn the songs people love into sounds they can play with, enabling fans and creators to reimagine music through intuitive, remix-friendly experiences with zero learning curve. By partnering directly with artists, labels, and rightsholders, Hook ensures music is discovered, shared, and expressed in ways that respect and reward the people behind it. At Hook, music isn't just consumed. It's experienced, expressed, and made personal. Role

Overview

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Intern to help design, build, and improve the recommendation systems that power personalized music discovery and social experiences at Hook. You will work on the engineering and applied machine learning challenges behind large-scale personalization, from processing user interaction data and building recommendation models to developing ranking algorithms and evaluating their performance. You'll have the opportunity to implement ML algorithms, build data processing and feature engineering pipelines, experiment with different recommendation architectures, and contribute to the systems that help users discover music, engage with content, and connect with creators. Working closely with our engineering, research, and product teams, you'll take ideas from experimentation to working prototypes, gaining hands-on

experience

building real-world machine learning systems in a fast-moving startup environment.

Responsibilities

Develop recommendation models: Assist in implementing and experimenting with machine learning models for personalized recommendations, content discovery, and ranking. Build data pipelines: Process datasets, extract relevant features, and prepare data for model training and evaluation. Experiment and optimize: Train, benchmark, and evaluate different recommendation approaches to identify opportunities to improve model performance. Build ML prototypes: Translate ideas and algorithms into working prototypes using Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or scikit-learn. Collaborate and contribute: Work closely with engineering and product teams to test new approaches, document findings, and contribute to improving Hook's recommendation systems.

Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with libraries such as NumPy and pandas. Foundational knowledge of machine learning, statistics, and data analysis. Hands-on

experience

with at least one ML framework, preferably PyTorch. Interest in recommendation systems, information retrieval, ranking, or personalization. Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and willingness to learn and collaborate in a fast-paced engineering environment. Bonus

Qualifications

Experience

building academic or personal projects involving machine learning or recommendation systems. Familiarity with recommendation techniques such as collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, or embeddings.

Experience

working with SQL, real-world datasets, or user interaction data. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks, model evaluation, or experimentation. A personal interest in music, music discovery, or social platforms. What We Offer Hands-on

experience

building and improving real-world recommendation and personalization systems. The opportunity to work on the full ML development lifecycle, from data processing and model development to evaluation and product integration. Exposure to practical engineering challenges involving recommendation algorithms, ranking, retrieval, and personalization. Close collaboration with experienced teammates across engineering, research, and product. Mentorship and opportunities to develop strong machine learning and software engineering skills. The freedom to experiment with new approaches, technologies, and ML architectures. The opportunity to make a direct impact on how millions of people could discover, interact with, and

experience

music.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive

#26-1326

Albuquerque, New Mexico, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KOB-TV

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Mountains, streams, deserts, ancient ruins, world-class art, varied culture and a crazy-good brew and food scene.  That's the New Mexico life KOB 4 employees enjoy every day.  The variety represented in our state drives a news organization that covers a wide range of stories from award-winning investigations and special projects to heart-touching profiles of people and real life issues you won't find anywhere else.  Sound good?  Come live in an amazing state and join the KOB 4 team as we proudly "Stand 4 New Mexico"!

Job Overview

The Account Executive is responsible for selling advertising to clients and developing new business relationships by prospecting, developing and selling new direct-business accounts, making sales presentations, performing collections, maintaining client relations and sales.

Job Responsibilities

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets including spot, digital, and new direct business. Prospect new businesses on a weekly basis.

Prepare and complete sales presentations with decision makers.

Make presentations to include a customer needs analysis, research and supporting documentation, and creative business solutions.

Follow up and close all pending business in a timely manner.

Update Sales Manager weekly on progress of pending business.

Work closely with other departments in creating effective promotional sales solutions for clients.

Create and make presentations to agency personnel, including selling and pre-selling the station audience attributes.

Provide exceptional customer service to direct and agency accounts. Personally contact each active account regularly- defined as an in-person meeting, including the presentation of pertinent sales information.

Obtain credit approval for new accounts.

Ensure all accounts are paid in a timely manner. Follow up and assist in the collection process for past due accounts.

Utilization of and proficiency with Sales software.

Attend special events, such as remotes and broadcasts, which involve clients. These events may occur after business hours and on weekends.

Complete all written business requirements within established deadlines. These requirements include but are not limited to: forecast reports, pending business updates, written orders and advertising copy.

Attend and participate in weekly sales staff meetings, individual meetings with manager and other necessary meetings and training as required by management.

Have a thorough understanding of rates, promotions, inventory, and personnel. Continue to learn and stay abreast of trends in digital and broadcast advertising industry.

Maintain regular, reliable attendance.

Work cooperatively and collaboratively with others. Build working relationships with co-workers, customers, vendors and the general public.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

Previous sales, advertising, digital sales, or media experience preferred

Knowledge of, and familiarity with, (or ability to learn) broadcasting and digital terminology and methodology preferred.

Ability to understand the features and benefits of advertising and competitive media.

Familiarity with Microsoft Word for Windows; sales software knowledge helpful.

Excellent written and oral English language communication skills.

Experience developing presentations for the purpose of direct-business selling and ability to effectively present and communicate.

Ability to respond to questions appropriately and think on feet.

Establish and maintain customer relationships; communicate effectively with a wide range of personalities in a professional manner.

High level of initiative and ability to work independently required.

Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver's license and a safe driving history as determined by the Company for the purpose of meeting clients and attending events. (Driving record will be checked.)

Demonstrate effective negotiation and closing techniques.

Strong analytical skills, good judgment, and a "positive can do attitude" are required.

Ability to read, hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically, analytically, creatively and logically; and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to work evenings and weekends.

Physical Requirements: Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.). Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. The Company may make reasonable accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job function.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

For information regarding our benefits, please copy the link below and paste in your browser:

https://hubbardbroadcasting.com/our-company/working-here/

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets.

Diversity Statement

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. We know the best way to accomplish this is by recruiting and retaining top talent from diverse cultures, life experiences, and world views. With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.

About Us

Mountains, streams, deserts, ancient ruins, world-class art, varied culture and a crazy-good brew and food scene.  That's the New Mexico life KOB 4 employees enjoy every day.  The variety represented in our state drives a news organization that covers a wide range of stories from award-winning investigations and special projects to heart-touching profiles of people and real life issues you won't find anywhere else.  Sound good?  Come live in an amazing state and join the KOB 4 team as we proudly "Stand 4 New Mexico"!

Job Overview

The position of Accounting Coordinator is responsible for assisting the market controller and vice president/general manager with a wide range of accounting responsibilities including accounts receivable, accounts payable, fixed assets, deposits, and billings. This position is also responsible for performing accounting activities for payroll, AP, and AR using the professional application of accounting principles, practices and techniques in accordance with industry standards, current laws and Company policy.

Job Responsibilities

Perform accounts payable duties including invoice review and coding, 1099 reporting and non-cash awards reporting and other year-end and IRS requirements.

Point of contact for Sales and Clients with current account AR balances.

Point of contact for Vendors with basic AP questions and issues.

Assist in Concur expense approvals.

Month end revenue reports and balancing.

Maintain proper records for payments to non-corporate entities for government reporting purposes.

Maintain electronic vendor files of all purchases.

Fixed asset additions and capitalizations.

Master the chart of accounts and code payables appropriately.

Approve credit on sales orders in Wide Orbit system.

Make daily collection calls and write letters to clients on past due accounts.

Host monthly aging meetings with account managers and recommend accounts to be placed with outside agency.

Complete other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Two plus years post high school education in accounting, business, or related field, preferred; or a combination of work experience and education to complete the requirements of the position.

Working knowledge of MS Office products, especially Excel.

Knowledge of Wide Orbit traffic system a plus.

Extremely detailed, highly organized and excellent analytical skills required.

Ability to work quickly and accurately and meet deadlines under pressure situations.

Proven experience working in an environment that requires maintaining confidentiality of information.

Project an appropriate professional appearance and demeanor.

Ability to work in compliance with company policies and procedures.

Ability to function in a team environment.

Ability to work established schedule and other hours as needed

This position is subject to a pre-employment criminal background and consumer financial history background check. A criminal conviction or arrest pending adjudication or adverse financial history information alone shall not disqualify an applicant in the absence of a relationship to the requirements of the position.

This position is subject to pre-employment criminal and consumer financial history background checks.
