job.title: Board Operator
job.description:
Board Operator

#25-1380

St. Louis, Missouri, United States

Apply

Business Unit

WXOS

Employee Classification

Part Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Saint Louis is a full-service media company with legendary radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions. We serve the Greater St. Louis community and offer a menu of marketing services including radio, full-service digital, influencer marketing, creative services, custom content, podcasts and events. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

This position is responsible for operating the board for live, satellite delivered content and syndicated programming. The Board Operator ensures that all preplanned components of a broadcast are carried out as designed, including, set-up, operation and maintenance of electronic equipment used to transmit programs.

Job Responsibilities

Run the board, play the appropriate music, features, billboards, commercials, etc. during live or recorded news and/or brokered radio programs.

Operate and troubleshoot radio equipment used in the course of the production of a live or recorded broadcast.

Technical perfection and flawless execution of control board and equipment to regulate the volume and sound quality during radio broadcasts.

Observe monitors and manage outgoing audio and sounds levels.

Follow program log.

Monitor all systems and make sure they are all running on schedule. Note any issues or concerns on log.

Monitor and update severe weather forecasts.

When required, go on-air to report on life-threatening or emergency situations until further support arrives.

Record, edit or play back any sound requested from broadcasts.

Voice and produce news stories/features as requested/needed.

Answer phone calls during shift and screen calls.

Monitor automation, transmitter controls, which includes pattern/tower changes and record required readings.

Assess emergency situations for the station, and make decisions on when to call for additional support.

Knowledgeable of, and applies as needed, all current FCC rules and regulations.

Report to work on time and work established schedule/hours. Ability to work other hours or alternate schedules as needed, as assigned or requested by Program Director with little or no notice. Such alternate/additional work can include weekdays, evenings and weekends.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

High School diploma, GED or equivalent required, with a minimum one (1) year experience running a radio board preferred; or a combination of education and work experience to perform the essential functions of the job.

Must be able to respond and work well in a crisis and handle last minute and unexpected changes during work shift.

Be able to communicate quickly and clearly to co-workers and others as needed.

Ability to hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically and quickly and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to think spontaneously and ad lib while on air in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.

Ability to learn automation systems.

Knowledge of transmission, broadcasting, switching, control, and operation of telecommunications systems.

Project a professional appearance and demeanor.

Ability to work in compliance with company and FCC policies and procedures.

Multi-task with a variety of duties while running the board.

Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected changes calmly.

Able to make decisions and judgments quickly.

Follow directions well, especially over the phone.

Work well under pressure.

Available to work with short notice including early mornings, late evenings and weekends.

Ability to work established schedule and other hours as needed.

Physical Requirements: Ability to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.) for extended periods of time. Wear headsets and be confined to a specific space during the course of work. Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. Average pushing, pulling, bending, stooping and reaching over head. The Company may make reasonable accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job functions.

Compensation and Benefits

Job Overview

The Client Success Manager (CSM) plays a key role in supporting the onboarding and implementation of digital products for clients. This position helps ensure clients have a smooth, organized, and positive experience from day one--managing timelines, coordinating internal teams, and providing ongoing communication. The CSM provides best-in-class support to both internal and external stakeholders, consistently exceeding expectations, and helping to drive client retention and revenue growth. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on collaboration, enjoys working directly with clients, and is eager to grow in the digital marketing space.

Job Responsibilities

Manage client onboarding from start to finish, ensuring implementation is well-organized and aligned with client expectations.

Serve as an advisor to clients, utilizing 2060 Digital resources, best practices, and tools.

Efficiently manage and oversee multiple client onboarding projects concurrently.

Develop agendas, manage and lead external client meetings, such as kick-offs, and participate in reporting sessions.

Collaborate with clients to ensure proper access and connectivity across their website and advertising platforms--such as Google, Meta, and others--to support accurate tracking, reporting, and campaign execution.

Own the creative request process by coordinating with clients and internal production teams to ensure timely delivery of all necessary assets.

Set clear expectations with the client regarding creative deadlines, approval timelines, and potential impact on campaign launch dates.

Collaborate with the Digital Brand Strategist (DBS) to ensure all creative assets align with the overall campaign strategy and objectives.

Keep stakeholders informed with clear, timely progress updates.

Identify and recommend process improvements and resource enhancements tailored to client needs, supporting continuous optimization efforts.

Liaison with internal teams to present feedback or improvements to internal processes related to onboarding and escalate any issues preventing successful implementations.

Collaborate with team members to gather data and deliver high-quality, accurate, and insightful reports

Support ongoing efforts to optimize the customer experience and foster successful interactions throughout onboarding and across the entire client lifecycle.

Lead client retention efforts by providing exceptional service that ensures client satisfaction and nurtures lasting partnerships.

Provide flexible support across the entire Customer Success Management team as needed to ensure seamless coverage and maintain operational continuity.

Perform additional duties as assigned.

Ideal background includes a degree in marketing, communications, or a related field and 1+ years of experience in a digital agency or equivalent hands-on digital marketing role.

Strong project management and time management skills; familiarity with project management software is a plus.

Ability to support new customers and their success in achieving long-term value from digital solutions.

Exceptional interpersonal skills; adept at connecting with clients from diverse backgrounds and clearly explaining complex technical and business concepts in a relatable manner.

Skilled in building strong relationships and resolving conflicts, with the ability to influence and align internal teams and external partners.

Clear, professional communicator with strong phone and video presence; remains calm and solutions-focused under pressure.

Proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities and effectively prioritize work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Knowledge of current digital marketing trends and tactics

Experience working with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and the broader Google Suite of tools, and the ability to understand, validate, and verify reporting metrics to ensure data accuracy and clarity.

Must be highly creative, adaptable, and detail-oriented, with a strong ability to manage deadlines effectively.

Proven ability to collaborate in a team-oriented environment.

Ability to work in compliance with company policies and procedures

Project an appropriate professional appearance and demeanor

Ability to work established schedule and other hours as needed

Sits, stands and walks on a regular basis.

Ability to communicate in English both verbally and in writing.

Dexterity to manipulate computer keys and other office equipment.

Requires the ability to think critically and to articulate information in a clear and concise manner to others verbally and in writing.

Work under pressure, meeting tight deadlines.

Good vision to see computer screen.

Prepare reports, business correspondence, and business proposals.

Quick and clear thinking required.

Ability to gather and organize large amounts of data and search for patterns and connections.

Requires the ability to think creatively, tactically and to articulate information in a clear and concise manner to others verbally and in writing.

Job Overview

2060 Digital works with a wide range of clients across industries to build their social media presence and create and maintain a consistent brand voice. The Content Manager works directly with the content and creative teams to plan, create, produce, and post social content, manage copywriting tasks and influencer campaigns for a diverse client roster. This role offers the opportunity to exercise creative judgment, develop original ideas, and work independently across social strategy, copywriting, influencer management, and paid social.

Job Responsibilities

Independently develop and execute content and influencer strategies that align with clients' brand goals, target audiences, and campaign objectives, using creative judgement to determine content themes, messaging, and campaign approaches.

Manage content calendars for various clients across industries and markets, including content planning, graphic ideation and management, and copywriting.

Lead creative ideation, write original copy and clear creative briefs, and provide creative guidance to designers and other creators.

Identify, evaluate, and recruit influencers based on audience fit, engagement quality, brand suitability, and budget, per campaign

Manage influencer relationships, outreach, negotiations, contracts, deliverables, and deadlines.

Review content for quality, brand consistency, accuracy, and applicable advertising disclosure requirements.

Coordinate content usage rights and permissions for paid promotion with internal teams and creators.

Manage and execute paid social media boosts and campaigns as related to social media services, influencer management and other client goals.

Manage campaign budgets, maintain clear records, and produce monthly client recaps with insights and recommendations, participate in client meetings, and maintain ongoing client communication.

Test and evaluate content and influencer strategies, track campaign performance and use findings to develop client insights and improvements to content, creative direction and influencer partnerships.

Stay current on platform trends, emerging creators, and changes in audience behavior.

Manage multiple client accounts while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

Work effectively in a team environment and maintain a positive, cooperative rapport with staff, management, and clients.

Qualifications

1-3 years of experience in social media content or influencer marketing; agency experience preferred.

Hands-on experience with Facebook/Instagram paid ad campaigns (Meta Ads Manager) strongly preferred.

Experience assisting with or managing influencer campaigns, from sourcing through reporting.

A portfolio of social content or campaigns you've contributed to -- internship, coursework, freelance or personal brand work all count -- ideally with measurable results.

Excellent writing, editing, storytelling, and creative briefing skills.

Working knowledge of major social platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn.

Experience or coursework in sourcing and vetting influencers, negotiating partnerships, and managing creator relationships.

Ability to interpret campaign metrics such as reach, engagement, clicks, conversions, and return on ad spend.

Familiarity with social publishing, analytics, project management, and influencer discovery tools (e.g. Meta Business Suite and Sprout Social).

Understanding sponsored content disclosures, licensing, and brand safety.

Strong organizational, communication, and client presentation skills.

Self-starter who can work independently and collaborate across creative, content and paid media teams.

Proven ability to handle multiple projects, meet deadlines, and maintain a professional, positive demeanor with clients.

Basic video editing, design, or on-camera content creation skills are a plus.

Business Unit

About Us

Hubbard DC, which includes WTOP, Federal News Network and 2060 Digital, is committed to reporting relevant news for our region. Through continuously evolving brands, we connect consumers with advertisers across a growing number of distribution platforms including radio, podcasts, social media, and websites. We do this with a commitment to our community...while growing our people and profits.

OUR VISION

To be an industry leader and set the standard for equality and inclusivity for all races, genders, ages, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations and religions by creating and fostering principles that integrate our core values.

OUR MISSION

To be proactive in providing a welcoming, professional environment; free of harassment, discrimination and marginalization with on-going habits that incorporate our unique experiences into the overall success and continuous evolution of this organization.

Job Overview

The Federal Drive anchor must have experience in developing ideas, conducting and managing audio and video interviews is strongly preferred, but will consider the right person with the right background in federal issues. This position holds the primary responsibility for the show’s content and adherence to Federal News Network editorial standards and focus areas. Also responsible for ensuring show is prepared and ready for broadcast each work day, five days per week. Audio and video show segments are posted online and published as podcast segments on major distribution networks, the Federal News Network website and multiple social media platforms. Therefore, anchor must treat Federal Drive as a primary contributor to Federal News Network’s website and as a means of attracting audience via multiple listening and watching formats and digital distribution channels.

Job Responsibilities

PLANNING:

Leading the team to determine which guests and topics should be on the show, with a strong preference for federal executives

Working with news staff for suggestions and referrals

BOOKING:

Working with producers to contact potential guests and their public affairs teams to schedule show appearances. Supervising scheduling; frequently supplying interview questions ahead of the interview

CREATING INTERVIEWS:

Reading, understanding background material

Writing teases, leads, tag

Conducting audio and video interviews, typically 2-to-5 per day

CREATING A SHOW:

Deciding which interviews will run on a given day’s show

With the assistance of producers, editing audio and video

Turning interviews into finished show segments, including the voicing of tags and tracking segment length

Creating show scripts

Creating reporter segments. These consist of voicing lead and tag provided by reporter for his or her taped or pre-produced segment. Also engineering and conducting audio and video interviews with staff reporters as daily show segments.

PROMO:

30-second daily element written, voiced and mixed by anchor, to promote subsequent day’s show.

WRITING:

Write newscast items and other news stories, as appropriate

Write occasional columns

TOOLS:

Familiarity with audio editing tools and newsroom content management systems is preferred, but willing to train the ideal candidate.

Qualifications

Experience in the public/federal government sector is strongly preferred.

Experience in journalism is preferred.

Working knowledge of social media platforms

Ability to multitask and work under pressure

Ability to work both alone and as part of a team

Strong leadership and communication skills

Project an appropriate and professional appearance and demeanor

Ability to work in compliance with company policies and procedures

Ability to function well in a diverse team environment

Report to work on time

Ability to work weekdays. Must be able to work mornings and middays

Physical Requirements

Average sitting, standing and office-type movements. Light lifting, moving and pulling abilities. Ability to communicate in English both verbally and in writing. Ability to hear and see clearly. Dexterity to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as other office equipment. Requires the ability to think critically and tactically and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others verbally and in writing. Must be able to think quickly and work under tight deadlines and in high pressure situations. Ability to work in a variety of settings including outdoors. The successful candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job. The Company will make reasonable accommodations to facilitate a person's ability to perform those essential job functions.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Qualifications

Previous experience as an SDR, Account Manager, or AE with strong prospecting chops. Able to quickly identify good prospects and key decision-makers.

Superior communication skills, with an ability to take articulate and thoughtful notes, customize emails and presentations based on client needs, and follow up on every meeting with action steps.

Requires the ability to think critically and articulate information clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing.

Quick and clear thinking required.

Job Overview

The Promotions Coordinator/Social Media Strategist serves as the primary liaison for contest winners, manages prize fulfillment, coordinates station events, and works closely with programming, sales, and promotional partners to ensure flawless execution of station campaigns and experiences. The role also provides support for the station's digital and social media strategy by analyzing audience engagement, evaluating campaign performance, identifying opportunities for growth, and helping shape content strategies that strengthen listener connection and brand impact.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-service focused, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines and moving pieces.

Job Responsibilities

Contest & Promotion Management

Coordinate and execute all on-air and online contests and giveaways.

Manage winner selection, verification, paperwork collection, and prize fulfillment.

Process contest-related documentation, including tax forms and check requests.

Track winner paperwork and ensure compliance with station, legal, and accounting requirements.

Maintain accurate records of prize inventory and distribution.

Monitor and respond to promotions email and phone lines.

Event Coordination

Execute station events, appearances, and promotional activations.

Coordinate event staffing, logistics, and communication with sales, talent, and street team.

Create event materials, schedules, and briefing sheets.

Maintain event supplies, promotional inventory, and station vehicles.

Attend and support station events, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Digital Marketing & Social Media Strategy

Create a station social media strategy for KS95. Provide actionable recommendations to enhance station/brand content performance, audience growth, engagement, and campaign effectiveness.

Assist with content planning and social media calendars, ensuring consistent and strategic messaging across platforms.

Coach and direct the team on best practices in social media posting by platforms.

Analyze social media, digital marketing, and audience engagement performance to identify trends, successes, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Help execute sponsor and client deliverables across social media platforms.

Assist in promoting station events, contests, and community initiatives.

Stay informed on emerging social media trends across platform changes, algorithm updates, digital marketing best practices, and new advertising opportunities across TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

Strong understanding of major social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging digital channels.

Experience using analytics and reporting tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Google Ads, or similar platforms.

Ability to analyze audience, social media, and promotional campaign data; identify what is driving engagement and results; and make strategic recommendations for future content, campaigns, and marketing initiatives.

Strong organizational and project management skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.

Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and Holidays.

Preferred

Experience in radio, media, entertainment, promotions, marketing, or event coordination.

Familiarity with WordPress, VPromo, Asana, Audience, and Canva

Experience with contesting, prize fulfillment, and event logistics.

Responsible for overall content and flow of a live show.

Assist and collaborate with show host on preparations for show on daily basis and for future shows. Make sure all aspects of the talk show are complete before the show airs. Plan ahead and meet deadlines so show can run smoothly for all involved. Important details include booking guests as directed by show host, offering suggestions for guests, confirming guest appearances, daily postings to website on show content, understanding program log, assemble audio clips for daily promo updates and key information.

Notify proper people of any changes or special situations that may come up in a timely manner (i.e. breaking news, cancellations, and technical problems).

Ability to relate and communicate with a variety of people including talent, guests, callers, and other staff.

Assist with daily commercial production including voice-overs and copywriting as directed by Production Department. Ensures that all commercial production is completed as specified and on time.

Develop and write copy for station and show promos.

Working knowledge of radio systems to solve minor, routine problems as needed.

Assess emergency situations for the station, and make decisions on when to call Engineering, ENCO or Programming managers for additional support. When necessary, go on-air to report on life-threatening or emergency situations until further support arrives.

Understands and can articulate station and show's programming directions and philosophies.

One year of professional broadcast experience.

Ability to run the board flawlessly under pressure. Ability to work effectively in a high intensity, environment with on air talent.

Ability to write creative, entertaining and informative copy for commercial production and promos.

Multi-task with a variety of duties while running the show (may have to track down guests and/or talk to listeners while running the technical operation of the show).

Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected show changes calmly. Able to make decisions and judgments quickly, often in a chaotic environment.

Follows directions well, especially over the phone.

Operating knowledge of ENCO system or similar digital radio automation systems.

Ability to work on short deadlines and in pressure situations.

Ability to make basic programming decisions based on emergency situations.

Interview guests and other members involved in particular stories engaging in commentary.

Keep abreast of news developments by studying papers, attending events, and staying in contact with industry professionals.

Articulate information in clear, concise manner to others. Ability to read, hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction. Ability to think spontaneously and ad lib while on air and at appearances in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.

Ability to operate all mechanical functions of preparing and delivering an on-air performance, including the recording, editing and playback of listener telephone calls; the preparation of recorded "bits" and other show elements; the operation of the control room console and studio equipment.

Ability and willingness to be coached and directed by Program Director

Project a professional appearance and demeanor.

Ability to work in compliance with company policies and procedures.

Ability to function in a team environment.

Ability to work established schedule and other hours as needed.

Travel to and attend station promotional appearances including sales appearances.

Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.) for extended periods of time. Wear headsets and be confined to a specific space while work. Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. job.title: WTOP Traffic Reporter/Producer, Freelance
job.description:
WTOP Traffic Reporter/Producer, Freelance

#26-1078

Washington, District Of Columbia, United States

Apply

Business Unit

WTOP-AM/FM

Employee Classification

Part Time Intermittent

About Us

Hubbard DC, which includes WTOP, Federal News Network and 2060 Digital, is committed to reporting relevant news for our region. Through continuously evolving brands, we connect consumers with advertisers across a growing number of distribution platforms including radio, podcasts, social media, and websites. We do this with a commitment to our community...while growing our people and profits.

OUR VISION

To be an industry leader and set the standard for equality and inclusivity for all races, genders, ages, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations and religions by creating and fostering principles that integrate our core values.

OUR MISSION

To be proactive in providing a welcoming, professional environment; free of harassment, discrimination and marginalization with on-going habits that incorporate our unique experiences into the overall success and continuous evolution of this organization.

Job Overview

The Traffic Reporter/Producer works directly with other members of the location Traffic Team to bring each hour's traffic reports to life on-air in a way that is both factually accurate, up-to-date and engaging. The Traffic Reporter/Producer works as part of a diverse team to make the location the leading provider of traffic information.

Job Responsibilities

Anchor live reports of traffic conditions for the region as required in a clear, concise manner with the latest possible information while maintaining high broadcast standards

Continually monitor scanners, cameras and the web/social media to make sure the station is on top of current road conditions and events impacting traffic

Actively pursue traffic tips that come in via email, phone calls or other official sources

Answer phone calls, emails, and social media posts from listeners, providing top-notch customer service

Update internal traffic system with the latest traffic information

Update social media channels with information on current traffic conditions

Keep the news team informed of possible traffic-related story ideas for reporters to pursue

Maintain awareness of the latest local news and how it may impact travel

Contact local agencies for information on traffic incidents

Communicate effectively with the digital team to share new information on major traffic incidents the station is covering and opportunities to tease on digital platforms

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

2-3 years professional on-air broadcasting experience (radio or television preferred)

Degree in Journalism, Communications, Broadcasting or related field, preferred

Extensive knowledge of area roadways

Ability to understand and decipher scanner traffic from local police and fire departments

Working knowledge of social media platforms

Ability to work quickly in breaking traffic situations and handle stressful situations in a calm manner

Ability to multitask and work under pressure

Ability to work both alone and as part of a team

Strong leadership and communication skills

Project an appropriate and professional appearance and demeanor

Ability to work in compliance with company policies and procedures

Ability to function well in a diverse team environment

Report to work on time

Ability to work weekdays and weekends. Must be able to work early morning, midday, and evening shifts

Physical Requirements

Average sitting, standing and office-type movements. Light lifting, moving and pulling abilities. Ability to communicate in English both verbally and in writing. Ability to hear and see clearly. Dexterity to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as other office equipment. Requires the ability to think critically and tactically and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others verbally and in writing. Must be able to think quickly and work under tight deadlines and in high pressure situations. Ability to work in a variety of settings including outdoors. The successful candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job. The Company will make reasonable accommodations to facilitate a person's ability to perform those essential job functions.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  
  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  
  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  
  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.
  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 
  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.
  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.
  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 
  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 
  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 
  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. In addition to salary, this position is also eligible for commissions.


$36,000 - $45,000


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

‎
Required

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

‎

                                                                 

Location:

Latham, NY: 1203 Troy/Schenectady Road, 12110

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

                                                                             

Time Type:

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

                                                                             

We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis.


The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status.


Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law.


Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Click Here to learn about the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance .


Our organization participates in E-Verify.  Click here to learn about E-Verify.

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  
  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  
  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  
  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.
  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 
  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.
  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.
  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 
  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 
  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 
  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Compensation:

This position will be paid on a 100% commission basis.


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

‎
Required

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

‎

iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  
  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  
  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  
  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.
  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 
  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.
  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.
  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

‎
Required

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

‎

                                                                 

Location:

Greenville, SC: 101 N Main St, Suite 1000, 29601

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

                                                                             

Time Type:

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

                                                                             

We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis.


The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status.


Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law.


Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Click Here to learn about the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance .


Our organization participates in E-Verify.  Click here to learn about E-Verify.

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  
  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  
  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.
  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 
  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs

What We Need:

This dynamic Inside Sales Director role is pivotal to the company's growth strategy. Reporting directly to the VP of Inside Sales, you will assume full ownership of Inside Sales functions. Your core mission is to strategically build, lead and aggressively scale a high performing team focused on sustainable revenue generation.

The Director will define key performance metrics and implement best practices to ensure the team consistently meets and exceeds ambitious sales targets. This involves optimizing lead qualification processes, managing the end-to-end inside sales cycle, and leveraging cutting edge sales technology to drive operational efficiency. You will be instrumental in forecasting revenue accurately, developing robust training programs, impacting the bottom line through opportunity development and closed sales.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Be the focal point for Lead Generation and Inside Sales strategy and operations.
  • Recruit, train, lead, inspire, and motivate the team.
  • Develop messaging and scripts to increase lead conversion rates to develop opportunities.
  • Ensure the team has the knowledge, skills and developmental plans to overachieve in their assigned quotas.
  • Build and maintain exciting incentive programs for the SDR team.
  • Ensure that all sales opportunities are being touched by the SDRs, and accurately recorded and maintained in the sales tech stack to enable accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue forecasts.
  • Build and promote a cohesive, customer-centric team with strong internal relationships.
  • Build training and processes to allow for scale and repeatable performance.
  • Manage and resolve escalations, allowing the team to stay focused on sales.
  • Plan and execute marketing events and programs with the Marketing team and external partners.
  • Use customer and employee feedback to collaborate with leadership, refine existing services, and identify new solutions.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • 5+ years of business-to-business sales management experience with a track record of consistently achieving quota.
  • 5+ years’ experience in the media sales space with strong knowledge of the media industry (preferred).
  • Experience building and leading a world-class business development and Inside Sales team.
  • Excellent leadership skills to guide, motivate, and inspire individuals and teams to achieve business goals.
  • Strong sense of self and team accountability.
  • Ability to build and nurture a culture that drives results.
  • Proficiency in the sales tech stack is required, including SFDC, Chorus, Groove, and AI capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical and complex problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, listening, and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • High level of integrity, judgment, and situational awareness.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively with peers, across teams, and with management.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to change.


Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.


$96,000 - $120,000

Required

  • In-Depth knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes

  • Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large accounts and/or complicated business segments

  • Confidence to prospect and quickly build rapport with customers, adapting messaging and style based on customer needs

  • Ease working with senior level executives and using influencing skills to negotiations and drive sales

  • Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust

  • Confidence to solve complex problems using analysis, judgement and multiple sources of information

  • Accountability for your own work and a desire to provide guidance to new team members

  • Business development experience with new and existing customers

job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

The Financial Analyst, Corporate FP&A supports the company's enterprise-wide financial planning process including monthly actuals, budget, forecast, and Long-Range Forecast. This role partners closely with segment finance teams to consolidate results, analyze variances and margin trends, and prepare accurate, well-supported reporting for senior finance leadership

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support the preparation and maintenance of the consolidated Income Statement, Cash Flow, and related schedules across Actual, Budget, Forecast, and Long Range Forecast (LRF) scenarios.
  • Partner with segment FP&A teams across the Multiplatform Group, Digital Audio Group, and Audio & Media Services to consolidate monthly and quarterly results and prepare Budget-vs-Forecast-vs-Actual variance analysis.
  • Build and maintain detailed revenue and expense models, including revenue trends, seasonal patterns, and other key business drivers.
  • Analyze consolidated and segment-level Adjusted EBITDA margins; investigate and clearly explain movement in cost of sales and operating expense trends.
  • Perform detail-level audits of financial models to confirm formula integrity and consistency before models are used for internal or external reporting.
  • Assist with the annual budget and periodic reforecast cycles, including templates, timelines, and consolidation across business units.
  • Identify and help implement opportunities to streamline and automate recurring reporting processes.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, transaction advisory, or public accounting.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (complex formulas, financial modeling, pivot tables) and strong PowerPoint proficiency.
  • Excellent analytical and organizational skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present financial information clearly to non-finance audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines and shifting priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience with Workday ERP and/or SQL or Power BI is preferred.
  • Experience in media, advertising, broadcasting, or another advertising revenue driven industry is preferred.

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.


$68,000 - $85,000

‎
Required

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Accountability for own work and desire to provide guidance to new team members

  • Ability to contribute to several projects at the same time under a moderate level of direction

  • Application of objective judgement, technical skills and prior experience to solve business problems

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including a knack for explaining complex information in a straightforward manner

What We Need:

The Financial Analyst, Corporate FP&A supports the company's enterprise-wide financial planning process including monthly actuals, budget, forecast, and Long-Range Forecast. This role partners closely with segment finance teams to consolidate results, analyze variances and margin trends, and prepare accurate, well-supported reporting for senior finance leadership

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support the preparation and maintenance of the consolidated Income Statement, Cash Flow, and related schedules across Actual, Budget, Forecast, and Long Range Forecast (LRF) scenarios.
  • Partner with segment FP&A teams across the Multiplatform Group, Digital Audio Group, and Audio & Media Services to consolidate monthly and quarterly results and prepare Budget-vs-Forecast-vs-Actual variance analysis.
  • Build and maintain detailed revenue and expense models, including revenue trends, seasonal patterns, and other key business drivers.
  • Analyze consolidated and segment-level Adjusted EBITDA margins; investigate and clearly explain movement in cost of sales and operating expense trends.
  • Perform detail-level audits of financial models to confirm formula integrity and consistency before models are used for internal or external reporting.
  • Assist with the annual budget and periodic reforecast cycles, including templates, timelines, and consolidation across business units.
  • Identify and help implement opportunities to streamline and automate recurring reporting processes.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, transaction advisory, or public accounting.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (complex formulas, financial modeling, pivot tables) and strong PowerPoint proficiency.
  • Excellent analytical and organizational skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present financial information clearly to non-finance audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines and shifting priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience with Workday ERP and/or SQL or Power BI is preferred.
  • Experience in media, advertising, broadcasting, or another advertising revenue driven industry is preferred.

The Market President is the senior sales leader responsible for driving revenue growth, strategic market leadership, and overall sales performance across the Minneapolis market. This role leads a high-performing team of sales managers and Account Executives, develops integrated marketing solutions for advertisers, and partners closely with market leadership to achieve revenue goals across broadcast radio, podcasting, digital, streaming, events, and emerging advertising platforms.

The ideal candidate is a dynamic sales executive with a proven track record of building winning sales cultures, developing talent, expanding client relationships, and delivering consistent revenue growth in a highly competitive media environment.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

Revenue Leadership

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve and exceed market revenue targets.
  • Drive revenue growth across all iHeartMedia products including radio, digital, podcasting, streaming audio, social, events, and custom marketing partnerships.
  • Identify and capitalize on new business opportunities while maximizing existing client relationships.
  • Monitor market conditions, customer trends, and competitive activity to adjust sales strategies accordingly.

Sales Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop Sales Managers and Account Executives to achieve individual and team performance goals.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and customer-focused selling.
  • Recruit, train, and retain top sales talent.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline management sessions, and strategic account planning meetings.

Strategic Client Partnerships

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key clients, agencies, and community stakeholders.
  • Serve as a strategic consultant to clients by delivering integrated advertising and marketing solutions.
  • Participate in high-level sales presentations, negotiations, and contract discussions for major accounts.

Business Operations

  • Partner with programming, finance, and operational leaders to align sales strategies with overall market objectives.
  • Manage sales forecasting, budgeting, and revenue reporting processes.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and revenue recognition standards.
  • Utilize data, analytics, and audience insights to improve sales effectiveness and customer outcomes.

Market Leadership

  • Represent iHeartMedia within the Minneapolis business community and industry organizations.
  • Strengthen the company's market presence through networking, strategic partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Champion innovation and adoption of new products, technologies, and sales methodologies.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive media sales experience with significant sales leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success leading large, high-performing sales organizations.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast, digital media, audio advertising, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Proven ability to drive revenue growth and execute strategic business initiatives.
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen with experience managing budgets and revenue forecasts.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

You'll work closely with senior sellers, leadership and teams across the company to drive new business and carry out digital campaigns. If you're a self-starter with a results-focused mindset and a passion for podcasts, we'd love to hear from you.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support and carry out the national go-to-market strategy for the Direct Response business with a focus on podcasts and digital assets, working with senior sellers and leadership on account and agency plans.

  • Manage and grow a book of assigned accounts and agencies.
  • Meet quarterly and annual revenue goals according to the sales plan.   • Help move performance-driven advertisers from initial test campaigns to ongoing programs, using results data to show value and grow spend.

  • Provide responsive, high-quality service to drive customer satisfaction for direct response accounts.
  • Partner with the operations organization to set proper expectations with customers and meet their needs.
  • Build presentations and proposals for brands and agencies.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders, including product marketing, research, account management and more, to maximize advertising revenue.

  • Demonstrated coachability, openness to feedback, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining engaged, responsive, and collaborative with teammates and leadership.
  • Proficiency with computers, CRM platforms, Microsoft Office, and other sales technology, or the ability to learn new systems quickly.
  • Ability to learn and effectively communicate the value of a diverse portfolio of advertising and digital marketing solutions.

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

What We Need:

iHeartMedia is seeking a motivated, results-driven Outbound Inside Sales Account Executive to join our growing sales team. This fully remote position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with advertisers, and developing customized advertising solutions across iHeartMedia's extensive portfolio of broadcast radio, digital audio, podcasts, and digital advertising products. The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment and is excited about building a successful career in advertising sales.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Proactively prospect and develop new business opportunities through outbound calling, email outreach, and other sales strategies.

  • Conduct discovery meetings to understand advertisers' business objectives, marketing challenges, and advertising needs.
  • Develop and present customized advertising solutions utilizing iHeartMedia's broadcast, digital, podcast, and other advertising platforms.

  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline to consistently achieve individual revenue goals.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop effective advertising campaigns and ensure successful execution.
  • Consistently meet established sales activity expectations, including outbound calls, meetings, and pipeline development.
  • Build strong advertiser relationships that support repeat business and long-term revenue growth.

  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
  • Confidence and comfort conducting high-volume outbound prospecting and cold calling.
  • A self-motivated, competitive mindset with a strong desire to achieve and exceed sales goals.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple prospects and opportunities simultaneously.
  • Ability to identify advertiser needs and communicate compelling advertising solutions.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Ability to work independently and remain productive in a fully remote environment.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms, Microsoft Office, and virtual communication tools.
  • Willingness to accept coaching, adapt to feedback, and continuously develop sales skills.
  • Previous sales experience preferred; experience in advertising, media, or business-to-business sales is a plus.

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. In addition to salary, this position is also eligible for commissions.
