What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  
  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  
  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  
  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.
  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 
  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.
  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.
  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

‎
Required

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

‎
Required

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

‎

                                                                 

Location:

Cedar Rapids, IA: 600 Old Marion Road NE, 52402

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

Do you love the hunt? iHeartMedia is looking for an Account Executive who gets energy from opening doors, starting conversations, and closing new business. You'll build your own book from the ground up, working with local and regional businesses to grow their revenue through the most powerful audio and multimedia platform in America.

This is not an order-taking role. You'll find prospects, earn first meetings, uncover what each business really needs, and build multiplatform campaigns across broadcast radio, podcasts, digital audio, streaming, social, and live events. Your growth and your income are tied directly to how much new business you bring in.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll spend your days creating opportunities, not waiting for them. You'll:

  • Prospect every day through cold calls, research, networking, and walk-ins to fill your calendar with first-time meetings
  • Meet face-to-face with business owners and decision-makers to learn their goals and challenges
  • Build multiplatform campaigns across broadcast, podcasts, streaming, digital, social, and live events that drive real results
  • Tell a compelling, data-backed story in presentations that show clients exactly how iHeart will grow their business
  • Work with internal partners in marketing, digital, programming, and events to deliver standout campaigns
  • Grow your new clients into long-term partners by delivering results and expanding what they buy over time

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • A true hunter mindset. You're self-motivated, competitive, and proactive, and cold-calling and outreach to new prospects energize you instead of draining you. Uncapped commission is the reward.
  • Persuasive communication and negotiation skills. You can earn a meeting, run a strong conversation, and close the deal.
  • A relationship-builder's instincts. You can turn a first meeting into a trusted, long-term partnership.
  • Strong problem-solving skills. You understand how a client's business makes money and build solutions that help it grow.
  • Discipline and organization. You can plan, prioritize, and manage a full pipeline in a fast-paced environment.
  • Tech-savvy. You know your way around Salesforce, Microsoft Office, and social networking platforms.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a high school diploma (college degree preferred).
  • Nice to Have
    • Digital, media, iHeart, or audio advertising sales experience
    • Experience managing complex, multiplatform campaigns
    • Analytics experience
    • Strong connections in the local business community

What you’ll get  

  • You'll get full training on our Broadcast + Digital Marketing products, so you can focus on what you do best: finding and winning new business.
  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

job.title: Programmatic Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

We are seeking a candidate who will target, develop and manage national, cross- platform programmatic campaigns for iHeartMedia, the highest profile and top-rated media company in the business. The high-level responsibilities include being a primary sales lead for national and regional programmatic advertising accounts. The role will require an excellent rapport with clients and ad agencies, solid relationships with existing and potential national advertisers, and perhaps most importantly: strong technical acumen around the constantly-evolving technology and dynamics of programmatic.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Develop new business opportunities.
  • Manage and grow current partnerships; maintain current and develop new relationships with key clients, strategy & investment leads. 
  • Identify client/agency needs, develop proposals to meet needs and maximize opportunities. 
  • Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline. 
  • Prepare custom yet turn-key proposals start to finish. 
  • Follow all procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts, and competitive analysis.
  • Achieve revenue targets by increasing revenue spend per account; meet/exceed established sales targets.
  • Negotiate rates based on iHeartMedia's budgets; collects payments and controls receivables. 
  • Work professionally & collaboratively with internal partners to drive revenue.
  • Maintain client communication; ensure customer requirements are clearly communicated throughout the organization to ensure expectations are met.
  • Ability and skillset to use iHeartMedia’s portfolio of network/regional radio, podcast, digital, social, data and event marketing platforms to drive results for our advertising partners. 
  • Create, propose and close innovative advertising campaigns for advertisers to drive significant revenue.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Minimum 5 years media sales experience, including two in programmatic sales.
  • Great interest in and knowledge of radio and all forms of audio.
  • Skilled at prospecting and understanding the consumer sales cycle: prospecting, buying behaviors, negotiations, overcoming objections and closing.
  • Ability to sell network and regional radio, podcast, all forms of digital advertising, social and event marketing programs.
  • Existing relationships that have the ability and scale to advertise with Premiere Networks, Total Traffic and Weather Network and iHeartMedia.
  • Ability to plan, organize, set priorities and multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Negotiation and closing proficiency.
  • Strong client service relationship-building skills.
  • Attention to detail; high work standards.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, and social networking platforms.

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.


$136,000 - $170,000

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

‎
Required

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Specialized knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes

  • Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large and/or national accounts

  • Experience to anticipate customer needs based on advanced business knowledge and in depth understanding of customer’s strategy

  • Ease counseling and negotiating with senior executives

  • Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust

  • Ability to guide others to solve complex problems using sophisticated analytical thought to identify innovating sales solutions

  • Team leadership experience and/or a desire to act as a role model or mentor to develop others

‎

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 


Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

At iHeartMedia, events are more than just moments—they’re a core pillar of our brand. With over  20,000 local and national events annually, our Promotions & Events teams play a critical role in shaping how audiences experience the power of audio in real life. As a member of the team, you’ll be at the heart of this mission—bringing our stations, talent, and clients to life through unforgettable experiences.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support the planning and execution of local events and promotions that align with station branding and client objectives, including concerts, community activations, and live broadcasts.

  • Coordinate logistics such as venue setup, staffing, signage, giveaways, and technical needs. 

  • Collaborate with Sales, Programming, and Marketing teams to develop integrated promotional campaigns that drive listener engagement and revenue. 

  • Serve as on-site lead during events, ensuring smooth execution and representing iHeartMedia with professionalism and positive energy. 

  • Engage with listeners and clients to create memorable brand interactions and gather feedback. 

  • Maintain promotional inventory and ensure all materials are prepped and transported as needed. 

  • Support digital and social media efforts by capturing content and promoting events across platforms. Track and report on event performance, including attendance, engagement, and client satisfaction. 

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. 

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable engaging with the public and clients. 

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as needed for events. 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with social media platforms and content creation tools is a plus. 

  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required. 

                                                                             

Location:

Indianapolis, IN: 6161 Fall Creek Road, 46220

  • Physical ability to stand for multiple hours and lift or move 40-pound objects

We’re seeking an experienced Broadcast Transmission Engineer to maintain our digital broadcasting electronic systems.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain overall digital broadcasting electronic systems and related equipment for optimum transmission/broadcast performance
  • Maintain traditional radio and digital broadcasting electronic systems and equipment, including, but not limited to, RF switchers, transmitters, transceivers, studio consoles and associated audio equipment
  • Respond to equipment outages, malfunctions and related technical problems
  • Conduct routine diagnostic testing, repair and replacement of all equipment used for radio station broadcasts
  • Assist clients, fellow technicians and service personnel in the installation, training and support of software, hardware and related third party peripheral components, including, but not limited to, file servers, commercial grade workstations, networking switches, NICs, monitors, KVMs and radio equipment
  • Document equipment maintenance, repair and replacements
  • Make decisions about test equipment, parts and related tools needed for use in maintenance and repair
  • Install, maintain and support desktop computer equipment for internal users as well as company-owned sites within market
  • Periodic travel to other iHeartMedia locations to assist in equipment installation or troubleshooting
  • Occasional night and weekend work is expected and must be on-call and available to respond 24-7

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Previous radio broadcast experience is required
  • Associate degree or greater in a technical field or equivalent experience is required
  • SBE certification is a plus
  • Ability to climb ladders, work in small spaces and have the ability to lift 50 pounds
  • Valid state driver’s license and an excellent driving record

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

What We Need:

As Vice President of Sales, you’ll lead a team of Account Executives to grow revenue, win new business, and deepen relationships with key customers across the market. You’ll combine big-picture sales strategy with hands-on leadership, setting goals, coaching in the field, managing performance, and helping your team identify and close opportunities. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how we go to market and building a sales culture that is accountable, motivated, and focused on growth.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Manage local Account Executives with goal of meeting/exceeding station revenue, prospecting and new business targets
  • Translate market and station business strategies into specific actions to generate sales and revenue
  • Direct sales activities and processes that generate new business and deepen existing relationships
  • Set sales goals and guide subsequent goal-setting processes
  • Prepare budgets and revenue forecasts
  • Obtain, allocate and adjust operations resources to achieve sales and service goals
  • Oversee management of available advertising inventory to drive most profitable sales
  • Meet regularly with your key accounts
  • Recruit, hire and ensure ongoing training and development of Account Executives
  • Review and adjust sales territories, product mix targets and assigned call lists
  • Direct other functions such as marketing, advertising, production, traffic and sales operations

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Strong understanding of broadcasting, marketing, promotion, and collection standards
  • Proven ability to grow new business and find new revenue opportunities
  • Excellent leadership and coaching ability
  • Deep understanding of local markets, customers, and competitors in order to target needs and drive sales
  • Ability to create productive, long-term customer relationships
  • Scrappiness to be an entrepreneurial self-starter
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills across multiple groups
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and collaboration with others
  • 3+ years’ experience as an Account Executive or Sales Manager in media industry with proven track record of success
  • College degree preferred, but not required

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

‎
Required

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Accountability for sales results

  • Understanding of the business and how own area integrates with others to achieve sales goals

  • Strong understanding of broadcast, marketing, promotion and collection standards

  • Judgement to resolve customer and employee operational problems; critical thinking skills to understand the broader impact across the organization

  • Leadership skills to increase performance of the sales organization

  • Communication skills to succinctly convey information, set performance expectations and handle sensitive issues

  • Active listening skills with the ability to guide and influence others to adopt a broader point of view

  • Positive energy and the ability to manage stress and serve as a model for others in the sales practice

  • Skills to successfully coach and develop sellers

  • Comfort interacting with individuals of all levels

‎

Jacksonville, FL: 8000 Belfort Parkway, 32256

job.title: Director, Sync Licensing Administration
job.description:
Director, Sync Licensing Administration & Operations

Department: Sync
Location: London, UK
Hybrid Working: 3 days in your local office
Full-time | Permanent

The Role

We’re looking for a Director, Sync Licensing Administration & Operations to oversee our UK sync licensing administration function.

You’ll be responsible for ensuring sync agreements move efficiently from deal through contracting and administration, providing expertise on complex licensing matters and maintaining the contractual and operational standards that protect Kobalt and our creators.

But this role is about more than running the process as it exists today.

We’re looking for someone with a curious, solutions-focused mindset who wants to understand how work gets done, challenge unnecessary complexity and find better ways of doing things. You’ll look for opportunities to streamline workflows, use data more effectively and introduce automation and AI where they can improve speed, accuracy and scalability.

You’ll work closely with our US team and colleagues across Creative, Business Affairs, Legal, Copyright, Product, Technology and Data to help evolve licensing administration into an increasingly data-led and technology-enabled function.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the UK Sync Licensing Administration function, working closely with US counterparts to deliver consistent global standards and ways of working.
  • Oversee the end-to-end administration of publishing sync agreements, ensuring licensing activity is accurate, commercially responsive and appropriately governed.
  • Provide expertise and escalation support on complex licensing and contractual matters.
  • Work closely with Business Affairs and Legal on negotiation principles, contractual approaches and appropriate commercial risk.
  • Get close to existing processes and workflows, identifying bottlenecks, repetitive tasks and opportunities to simplify how work gets done.
  • Take the initiative in designing and implementing more efficient workflows, rather than accepting established processes as fixed.
  • Explore and implement automation, AI and agentic solutions that reduce manual administration and allow the team to focus on higher-value work.
  • Work confidently with large datasets, using SQL and increasingly AWS Athena to query and investigate operational data.
  • Build and interpret dashboards and reporting in Tableau to understand performance, identify trends and inform decisions.
  • Define meaningful operational KPIs and use data to understand licensing volumes, turnaround times, exceptions, risk and opportunities for improvement.
  • Experiment with Kobalt’s available technology and AI tooling to identify practical solutions to operational problems.
  • Translate operational challenges into clear requirements and work with Product, Technology and Data teams where more complex solutions are required.
  • Build strong partnerships across Creative, Sync, Copyright, Royalties, Legal, Finance and Technology.
  • Contribute to the continued development of Kobalt’s global licensing administration operating model.

What You’ll Bring

    • Extensive experience within music publishing sync licensing administration, with a thorough technical understanding of publishing sync agreements, global copyright structures, multi-territory licensing practices, and European copyright nuances.
    • Proven track record of independently managing complex licensing matters and contractual disputes, applying sound commercial judgement to balance revenue opportunity, operational capacity and contractual risk.
    • Evidenced success in identifying operational bottlenecks and implementing measurable process improvements, rather than simply maintaining legacy administration workflows.
    • Strong analytical capability with extensive, practical experience auditing and interrogating large datasets to answer operational questions and resolve discrepancies.
    • Direct, hands-on experience querying structured data using SQL and query engines such as AWS Athena to drive operational reporting and analysis.
    • Proven ability to build, maintain and interpret operational dashboards and business intelligence reporting, specifically using Tableau or comparable platforms.
    • Demonstrable experience designing and deploying workflow automation to eliminate manual, repetitive administrative tasks and improve processing turnaround times.
    • Practical experience applying generative AI and agentic tooling (such as Claude, Gemini, AWS Quick, or NotebookLM) directly within administrative, operational, or documentation workflows.
    • Proven technical autonomy and confidence to experiment, prototype and deploy operational solutions independently, rather than relying solely on Product, Data or Technology teams.
    • Hands-on experience working with contract lifecycle management (CLM), rights management, or legal technology platforms to administer licensing lifecycles.
    • Proven track record of cross-functional stakeholder management, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across Creative, Legal & Business Affairs, Data, Product and Technology.

Key Behaviours for Success

Curiosity & Continuous Improvement: You question how things work today, explore what could work better and proactively turn ideas into practical improvements.

Problem-Solving & Initiative: You don’t simply identify problems or pass them to another team. You investigate the root cause, explore solutions and take ownership of moving improvements forward.

Technology & Data Mindset:You’re comfortable getting hands-on with data and technology and are curious about how emerging tools can improve the way the function operates.

Interview Process

  • Introductory call with a member of our Recruitment Team
  • Interview with the hiring manager
  • Technical/data and problem-solving interview
  • Final stage interview with relevant stakeholders
  • Feedback at each stage

We aim to complete the full interview process from initial application to offer within three working weeks. While we do our best to meet this timeline, there may be occasional delays. If that happens, our Recruitment Team will keep you updated every step of the way.

Why Choose Us

At Kobalt, we’ve championed creators since 2000. Our technology and music services are built to make the industry more transparent, fair, and rewarding for artists, songwriters, and rights holders. We’re proud to work with some of the world’s most influential talents including Phoebe Bridgers, Sam Fender, Paul McCartney, Foo Fighters, Karol G, Young Thug, Kali Uchis, and Andrew Watt as well as acclaimed writers like Simon Aldred (Rag’n’Bone Man, Liam Gallagher, Celeste) and Clarence Coffee Jr. (Dua Lipa, Lizzo, The Snuts).

We’re a company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and progress. Our values: Music First, Transparent, Tech Powered, and Transformative. Shape how we work, build, and grow together. We are a community of people who care deeply about making a meaningful impact in music and technology.

Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in equitable access to opportunities and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know we’re happy to help.

job.title: Manager, Royalties
job.description:
Manager, Royalties

DEPARTMENT: Royalties, Tracking & Business Intelligence

TEAM: Royalties - Data Processing

LOCATION: London (5th Floor, Goldings House, Hays Galleria, 2 Hay's Lane, London, SE1 2HB, United Kingdom) - Hybrid [3 days a week in office]

REPORTING TO: George Wroodgate - Senior Manager, Royalties

Joining the growing Royalties team in our London office, the Royalties Manager will head up the Data Processing (DP) team. You will play a crucial role in managing the ingestion of royalty statements from societies, sub-publishers, direct licensees, and flow-through into our bespoke in-house rights management software.

This role requires a detail-oriented, highly analytical leader who can confidently oversee the Identification process—combining technical and manual methods to accurately match incoming royalties to works, right types, exploitation dates, territories, revenue sources, audio-visuals, and sub-accounts. You will navigate incoming queries, new process requests, oversee bespoke ingestion and identification for non-standard sources, and ensure high accuracy through rigorous scheduled quarterly QC tasks while constantly iterating and improving on existing workflows.

The Role

Joining the growing Royalties team in our London office, the Royalties Manager will head up the Data Processing (DP) team. You will play a crucial role in managing the ingestion of royalty statements from societies, sub-publishers, direct licensees, and flow-through into our bespoke in-house rights management software.

This role requires a detail-oriented, highly analytical leader who can confidently oversee the Identification process—combining technical and manual methods to accurately match incoming royalties to works, right types, exploitation dates, territories, revenue sources, audio-visuals, and sub-accounts. You will navigate incoming queries, new process requests, oversee bespoke ingestion and identification for non-standard sources, and ensure high accuracy through rigorous scheduled quarterly QC tasks while constantly iterating and improving on existing workflows.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

  • Team Leadership & Oversight: Manage, develop, and support the Data Processing team responsible for royalty statement ingestion and complex identification processes.
  • Statement Ingestion: Oversee the ingestion of royalty statements from diverse sources including societies, sub-publishers, direct licensees, and flow-through into our proprietary royalty processing software.
  • Identification & Matching: Lead the work identification processes, utilising both technical and manual methods to accurately match incoming royalties to works, right types (radio, streaming, performance, mechanical), exploitation dates, territories, revenue sources, audio-visuals, and sub-accounts.
  • Bespoke Processing: Design and execute custom ingestion and identification processesfor sources that do not adhere to standard formats or normal processes.
  • Quality Control: Execute a large volume of scheduled QC tasks throughout the quarter to check and maintain the highest accuracy of the team's work.
  • Process Improvement: Constantly review, iterate, and improve upon existing ingestion and identification processes to maximize efficiency and keep up to date with changing industry standards.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Interpret and communicate information received from various stakeholders (Copyright, Tech, Client Relations) to ensure processing methods are altered when necessary.
  • Ad-Hoc Query Resolution: Efficiently manage and resolve ad-hoc queries and process requests from internal teams and external partners, ensuring timely and clear communication.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for all data processing workflows, ingestion rules, and quality control procedures.
  • Team Training & Upskilling: Lead training initiatives to continually upskill team members on new tools, system updates, and changing industry standards.

What You’ll Bring

Essential:

  • Data & Analytics: Numeracy, exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and strong analytical skills.
  • Processing Expertise: Solid understanding of music publishing, copyright & royalty processes, particularly regarding global statement ingestion and data matching.
  • Technical Proficiency: Confident Excel user (calculating percentages, manipulating large datasets using formulas and pivot tables); familiarity with rights management software.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to think of improvements to existing tools and processes to continually enhance what we do to achieve our goals.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills with experience communicating to a wide-ranging audience of varying seniority, skill, and knowledge.

Preferred:

  • People Management: Experience in supervising, managing, and motivating team members.
  • SQL Skills: Background and knowledge of SQL or other domain-specific languages used in programming is preferred.

Additional Skills That Could Add Value

  • Solutions-orientated and adaptable to change.
  • Track-record of excellent organization & prioritisation skills working under high pressure and to tight deadlines.
  • Uses initiative to problem-solve.
  • Positive, determined attitude.
  • Empathetic, open, and honest.
  • Confident in decision-making and own abilities.

Key Behaviours for Success

  • Leads and develops others: Sets clear expectations, coaches with empathy, shares knowledge and holds the team accountable for quality and delivery.
  • Takes ownership of accuracy and outcomes: Prioritises effectively, applies rigorous quality checks and resolves issues promptly to meet processing deadlines.
  • Challenges and improves processes: Uses data and initiative to identify root causes, simplify workflows and implement practical improvements, adapting as requirements change.
  • Collaborates and communicates clearly: Builds effective relationships across teams, translates complex information into clear actions and keeps stakeholders informed of progress, risks and decisions.

Interview Process

  • Introductory call with a member of our Recruitment Team
  • Interview with the hiring manager
  • Interview with relevant members of the Royalties team
  • Final stage interview
  • Feedback at each stage

We aim to complete the full interview process from initial application to offer within three working weeks. While we do our best to meet this timeline, there may be occasional delays. If that happens, our Recruitment Team will keep you updated every step of the way.

job.title: Deputy Managing Editor, Limited Term
job.description:
Title: Deputy Managing Editor

Schedule Format - Location:Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $129,776 - $162,220 Annually



A Deputy Managing Editor at KQED’s primary responsibility is to direct strategy and management of senior editors and reporters on beats across the newsroom, as well as to generate story ideas and execute edits with members of the newsroom. A deputy managing editor at KQED works closely with managing editors to set editorial priorities on coverage across our platforms. A deputy managing editor assists managing editors in shaping coverage, and often manages and directs editors, reporters and producers throughout the newsroom. 

Deputy managing editors work closely with managing editors to work as part of our newsroom leadership to take our editorial priorities and help decide how to greenlight stories and projects with those guiding principles in mind.

Deputy managing editors also provide direction, editing and help to other senior editors as needed, but work as a strong and empathetic leader and manager to senior editors as well.  

California Newsroom Editor Addendum

The California Newsroom, a collaboration of public radio and nonprofit news outlets in the state spearheaded by KQED, is seeking a deputy managing editor to lead statewide content planning and coordination. This position is a six-month, limited-term position with a possibility to be extended.

This position requires a journalist who is skilled in leading collaborations and partnerships across multiple newsrooms. We are seeking an empathetic and human-centered manager who works well with people at all levels of experience, from early-career reporters to seasoned editors. The deputy managing editor will also be a key editorial strategist, working closely with news directors, reporters and editors from multiple outlets to serve the needs of all the partner newsrooms, from major outlets in large markets to smaller stations with limited resources and personnel. 

This editor will work in collaboration with journalists spread across 14 public radio stations and other partners such as the nonprofit news organization CalMatters to ensure coverage of significant issues, assigning and editing daily news and in-depth features and projects. The editor will also be responsible for coordinating California coverage for a national audience in partnership with NPR.

This editor will work closely with the California Newsroom Managing Editor to ensure that content production aligns with larger strategic goals. The Deputy Managing Editor will step in to run the entire California Newsroom operation in the absence of the Managing Editor, so we’re seeking candidates with both impeccable news judgment and advanced managerial skills. This is a remote position, but the editor must reside in California. The Deputy Managing Editor will manage from 1-4 journalists.

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. We value the contributions of marginalized people in society, including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people, and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do. We strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics: https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics
 

The mission that drives us:

KQED provides citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.




Essential Functions:
  • Coordinates with newsroom leaders throughout California on daily news coverage, major breaking news and long-term joint projects.
  • Maintains a running database of assignments and planning.
  • Oversees California Newsroom employees assigned to content production and planning. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Non-Essential Functions:
  • Occasionally fills in for other colleagues.
  • Represents KQED at events.

Knowledge/Experience Required:
  • At least five years of experience in a similar role in a newsroom or news environment.
  • Interest and knowledge in California news.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills; clear communication with colleagues.
  • Excellent news judgment.

job.title: Engagement Producer, Close All Tabs
job.description:
Title: Engagement Producer, Close All Tabs

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $42.00 - $51.00 per hour
 


Close All Tabs, KQED’s tech and internet culture podcast, is looking for a part-time Engagement  Producer specializing in video to join our team. The show breaks down how the digital world impacts our real lives, and we’re bringing that mission to video. 

You’ll create video and social content for our digital platforms. This includes short-form vertical videos like interview highlights, explainers, behind-the-scenes content, and person on the street interviews. You’ll also create image assets, graphics, and caption copy. 

Working closely with the Close All Tabs podcast team, you’ll adapt the show’s audio storytelling into a visual medium and help refine its look and tone. You’ll take each video from idea to publication: pitching, scripting, shooting, editing/post-production, and posting. You’ll also be responsible for helping grow the show’s social presence, expanding to new platforms, and contributing to audience growth. 

This is a hands-on role for an experienced visual storyteller who wants to combine polished video skills with strange, absurd, and compelling stories from the internet. 

This is a part-time, limited term position reporting to the Senior Editor, Close All Tabs.

 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provides citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.


Job duties:
  • Pitch, produce, and edit short-form video content for Close All Tabs’ social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube shorts.
  • Write scripts, production notes, shot lists, and other planning materials
  • Work with the podcast’s producers on a social media plan to promote new episodes 
  • Run single-person or potentially small-crew video production shoots and field work, maintaining professional standards for video and audio recording
  • Direct performance and delivery of host and other on-camera talent
  • Find and license third-party b-roll, photos, music, and other materials, ensuring appropriate rights and permissions
  • Optimize content to perform on each platform (length, format, captions, hashtags, thumbnails, calls to actions) and keep up to date with algorithm changes and new formats
  • Track performance metrics (views, reach, engagement, follower growth, click-throughs to episodes and subscriptions) and use the results to shape creative strategy
  • Maintain an organized archive of assets and templates, and streamline production workflows
  • Follow KQED editorial standards, journalistic ethics, and standards for accuracy and fairness
  • Meet production and publishing deadlines while managing multiple assignments

Knowledge/Experience Required
  • Three or more years of video production, video journalism, or multimedia experience (podcast, newsroom, or digital media preferred)
  • Fluency in video editing and post-production tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Final Cut Pro, plus Descript for selecting and editing video.
  • Comfort with static image design (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva) and motion graphic templates
  • Demonstrated ability to produce compelling short- and long-form video, especially for talk-based or interview-driven formats
  • Strong storytelling instincts: spotting moments that hook viewers, spark emotion, and prompt engagement
  • Experience growing a show’s or brand’s social presence through original, engaging video ideas
  • Strong grasp of how each social platforms works: (Instagram feed, stories, and reels; TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook), including what drives performance and growth
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects at once, prioritize under tight deadlines, and collaborate closely with teammates
  • Solid understanding of journalistic principles, including ethics, accuracy, fairness, attribution, and editorial standards

Knowledge/Experience Desired:
  • Experience working in a public media newsroom or mission-driven journalism organization
  • Familiarity with audio production and sound design
  • Experience with long-form video content, including interviews, video essays, and short documentaries
  • Experience covering technology and the internet, and a real interest in internet culture, online communities, or gaming
  • Experience producing journalism for younger or hard-to-reach digital audiences
  • Experience with professional cameras, lenses, lighting, and audio equipment
  • B.A./B.S. degree in journalism, communications, film, media production, or a related field preferred
  • Love of absurd internet humor a plus

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

job.title: Technical Product Manager
job.description:
KQED

Technical Product Manager

121 Product - San Francisco, CA - Temporary

Title: Technical Product Manager

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $122,808 - $153,510

This role is onsite at KQED's newly renovated headquarters located in San Francisco, CA. Applicants must currently reside in San Francisco Bay Area or be willing to relocate.


KQED is redefining public media to be more inclusive, participatory, and community-powered. In a time when misinformation and distrust in media are growing, we are committed to being the trusted journalistic source serving the needs of the Bay Area.

Within this scope, our Digital Product Team develops experiences to serve the needs of our diverse audiences. This includes partnering with editorial teams on essential content, developing new content formats, and building the infrastructure to power personalized experiences.

To support these efforts our team is looking for a Technical Product Manager, to sit at the intersection of business strategy and deep engineering execution. This role will be responsible for prioritization and translating complex requirements into actionable technical roadmaps. Working closely with engineering and business stakeholders, you will ensure our systems are architecturally scalable, technically feasible, and directly aligned with system needs and business goals.

We are looking for talented individuals to help our team build and maintain our digital systems, which power kqed.org and our mobile apps. We are a media organization and we look for talent who can bring a strong knowledge of functional design to our digital properties and our community.
 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Establish prioritization frameworks to balance feature development, infrastructure upgrades, and technical debt reduction.
  • Partner with engineering teams to evaluate system constraints, review API designs, and translate complex technical requirements into stories and sprint backlogs.
  • Define key product metrics and analyze systems to evaluate system performance.
  • Lead grooming, backlog refinement, and sprint planning in an Agile environment, ensuring clear acceptance criteria and seamless alignment across cross-functional teams.

Core Technical Background:
  • Basic understanding of microservices, cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), databases (SQL vs. NoSQL), API design (REST, GraphQL), and Content Management System (CMS) architecture (headless vs. traditional CMS platforms).
  • Ability to read code, review API documentation, and participate in technical trade-off discussions without getting lost.  
  • Targeted technical knowledge—such as machine learning/AI models, data pipelines, infrastructure, or developer tools (SDKs). 
  • Familiarity with JavaScript/typescript (or other oop language) preferred.
  • Agile methodologies and scrum management experience.

Work Experience & Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related STEM field.
  • Software Engineer, Solutions Architect or Systems Architect experience preferred.
  • At least 5 years working on technical products.

About the Product Team:
We run, and develop, multiple properties (including kqed.org and our mobile apps) and are always building new products on a modern stack with some legacy systems. Some of the technologies that we use are (but are not limited to):
  • Node / React / Webpack / Babel / Yarn
  • Kubernetes / Spinnaker / Docker
  • Elasticsearch / Redis / MongoDB / MySQL
  • JavaScript / Java / Springboot / Rest APIs 

Let us tell you more about our benefits:
Whether you’re single, married, have children, are in a domestic partnership or anything in between, we have you covered. Employees at KQED enjoy a family-friendly workplace offering paid time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, family medical leave benefits, comprehensive health/vision/dental and commuter benefits as well as a 403(b) plan. KQED encourages diversity, openness and offers training to support personal and professional development. In addition, we are proud to offer Employee Resource Groups, wellness programs as well as free KQED membership.

job.title: Director of Financial Planning and Analysis
job.description:
Lee Enterprises is seeking an experienced, hands-on Director of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to lead the company's financial planning, forecasting, and reporting functions. This position will play a key role in supporting financial decision-making across the organization by delivering accurate financial reporting, actionable insights, and forward-looking analysis.

The Director of FP&A will oversee the corporate FP&A team and partner closely with Finance leadership and operational business units to drive financial performance, improve reporting capabilities, and support strategic business objectives.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the company's annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes.

Coordinate financial planning activities across departments and business units, ensuring consistent assumptions, accurate submissions, and alignment with company objectives.

Drive continuous improvement in forecasting accuracy and financial planning processes.

Financial Reporting

Oversee preparation and delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting packages for executive leadership.

Lead financial variance analysis, including comparisons to budget, forecast, and prior-year results, with clear explanations of key business drivers.

Support preparation of financial materials and analysis for executive leadership, Board of Directors meetings, and quarterly earnings reporting.

Partner with Accounting to ensure financial reporting accuracy, consistency, and alignment with monthly and quarterly close processes.

Business Partnership & Financial Analysis

Monitor company performance through financial and operational KPIs, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.

Serve as a key financial partner to departments and business leaders, providing analysis and actionable recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions.

Perform financial analysis related to business initiatives, cost optimization, resource allocation, and investment opportunities.

Develop and maintain models to identify opportunities to improve profitability, manage expenses, and optimize cash flow performance.

Financial Systems & Process Improvement

Oversee administration, maintenance, and ongoing development of the company's financial planning and reporting systems.

Ensure integrity, accuracy, and consistency of financial information across planning, reporting, and accounting systems.

Identify opportunities to automate reporting, streamline financial processes, and improve productivity through technology.

Develop and maintain financial reporting tools and processes, supporting training and adoption across the organization.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop the corporate FP&A team, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial reporting, forecasts, and analysis.

Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities, processes, and talent to meet evolving business needs.

Core Competencies:

Strong financial planning, forecasting, financial modeling, and analytical capabilities.

Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate meaningful insights to executive leadership.

Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to develop and motivate team members.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial results and recommendations clearly.

Desire to improve efficiencies through technology, automation, and process improvement.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of deliverables.

Strong attention to detail with a commitment to financial accuracy and reporting integrity.

Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and build productive working relationships.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field required.

7+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, accounting, or a related discipline.

Prior experience managing or leading finance professionals preferred.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling required.

Experience with enterprise financial planning, reporting, or ERP systems preferred.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools preferred.

Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.

Location

This position will be located at Lee Enterprises' headquarters office in Davenport, Iowa, with hybrid and remote work arrangements considered for qualified candidates.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities. We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match. We also offer generous paid time off to allow the flexibility to balance personal life and work. This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

SUMMER INTERNS

We want our interns to walk away with a rewarding, real-world newsroom experience, a pile of great clips and the skills they need to develop into the next generation of journalists.

Interns will work alongside journalists in our newsroom, who will provide guidance, direction and support. When applying, please submit the following items: a cover letter; a resume detailing relevant journalism experience; and five examples of published journalism work. The deadline to apply is January 15.

job.title: Press Operator or Trainee

job.title: Public Safety Reporter-Rapid City, SD
job.description:
Public Safety Reporter-Rapid City, SD

The Rapid City Journal, South Dakota’s largest newspaper, is looking for a curious, dogged public safety reporter to join our collaborative team in a competitive media market.

Our public safety reporter will tackle crime, courts and breaking news coverage as needed.

Rapid City is located in South Dakota’s Seventh Judicial Circuit and the federal South Dakota District Court’s Western Division, with the Pennington County Courthouse and Andrew W. Bogue Federal Building and U.S. Courthouse located within walking distance of the Rapid City Journal’s office in downtown Rapid City.

For a reporter who is interested in the intersection of legal process and human experiences, there are endless stories to tell. As a now-retired federal judge stationed at the federal courthouse in Rapid City once said, “It’s the kaleidoscope of human behavior that keeps us going.”

Our public safety reporter must possess the ability to take accurate notes in court without the aid of a recording device, along with an aptitude to sensitively communicate with families of victims and defendants alike. They will build relationships with prosecutors, defense attorneys, law enforcement and court staff to ensure all sides of a story are told in a fair and accurate manner. A knack for turning legal jargon and system processes into easily-understandable copy for our readers is paramount, as is the ability to produce quick turns on developing breaking news events, which often fall into the crime category.

Court coverage spans local cases and major crimes from the nearby Pine Ridge Reservation that move through the federal system. There is a disturbing number of missing persons cases on the reservation and in Rapid City, with both communities contending with Murdered and Missing Indigenous Peoples cases specifically. Cultural sensitivity in these cases is an important element for a candidate to possess.

It’s an exciting time to cover public safety for the Journal from an administrative angle as well. The South Dakota Supreme Court is considering a merger of the Seventh and Fourth Judicial circuits, which would create the state’s largest circuit by landmass. The Pennington County Jail contends with overcrowding and reports of issues with conditions as the county eyes a jail expansion, and the state recently opened a women’s prison in Rapid City.

The Journal newsroom is made up of great journalists who work hard and enjoy working together to tell the stories of the people, places and events happening in the Black Hills.

A bachelor’s degree in journalism or a related field is preferred.

Why Rapid City?

Rapid City is a scenic destination and hidden gem in the heart of America with a population over 80,000 that continues to grow. Western South Dakota includes the Black Hills National Forest, Crazy Horse Memorial, Mount Rushmore, Badlands National Park, Ellsworth Air Force Base, the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation, countless lakes, streams and outdoor recreation opportunities and the largest ski resort this side of the Rockies. Rapid City is a bustling and growing city that serves as a regional hub for tourism and commerce.

The Black Hills also holds claim to historic Deadwood, a relic of the Wild West and home to some of the best gaming resorts in the region. The nearby wide-open spaces reflect that same Western flair as well. We have mild winters, gorgeous summers and great people.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities. We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match. We also offer generous paid time off to allow the flexibility to balance personal life and work. This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

Lee Enterprises is a major subscription and advertising platform and a leading provider of local news and information, with daily newspapers, rapidly growing digital products and nearly 350 weekly and specialty publications serving 114 markets in 26 states. Our core commitment is to provide valuable, intensely local news and information to the communities we serve.

Lee Enterprises is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we participate in E-Verify. We are committed to attracting and retaining a workforce whose diversity reflects the communities we serve. Lee embraces change, and we recognize that we must create and maintain a culture of fervent inclusion. For more information about Lee, check us out at www.lee.net.

We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you are excited about this role but do not meet 100% of the qualifications above, we still encourage you to apply at https://lee.net.careers and search for Rapid City. Include a cover letter, resume and several work samples.

job.title: AP Coordinator (Temp)
job.description:
Job Summary:

THE JOB

The Accounts Payable Coordinator will support the accurate and timely processing of vendor invoices and payments across Live Nation's Latin America operations. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring compliance with company policies and internal controls, and supporting month-end close activities. Working closely with local finance teams and internal stakeholders, the ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Receive, review, and process vendor invoices, ensuring accurate general ledger coding, cost center allocation, and project descriptions.
  • Obtain appropriate payment approvals in accordance with the company's System of Authority (SOA), policies, and internal controls.
  • Enter and process invoices in Inspyrus and Oracle, ensuring all required supporting documentation, including DocuSign approvals and email authorizations, is maintained.
  • Reconcile vendor statements, investigate invoice discrepancies, and resolve outstanding payment issues.
  • Assist with payment processing, including preparing payment batches and monitoring outstanding invoices.
  • Support month-end close activities, including identifying outstanding invoices, unrecorded liabilities, and required accruals.
  • Support SOX compliance by maintaining appropriate documentation, assisting with control execution, and responding to internal and external audit requests.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of invoices, payments, vendor accounts, and supporting documentation.
  • Collaborate with local finance teams across Latin America to resolve AP-related issues and ensure timely processing.
  • Assist with additional finance and accounting responsibilities as assigned.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 3–5 years of experience in Accounts Payable or general accounting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including experience working with large datasets and reconciliations.
  • Experience with Oracle, Inspyrus, or similar ERP systems preferred.
  • Strong understanding of accounts payable processes, general ledger coding, and internal controls.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Experience supporting month-end close activities and SOX compliance preferred.
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese language skills are a plus

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. job.title: Bookings Manager - HSMH
job.description:
Job Summary:

About Hindley Street Music Hall:
Join the team at Hindley Street Music Hall, Adelaide's purpose-built home for live entertainment in the heart of the city's vibrant West End. A flexible space offering standing, seated and cabaret configurations, the Hall is designed to deliver exceptional experiences across music, comedy, theatre and more. As part of the Live Nation Group, be part of a venue built for the future of live entertainment in South Australia.

 

About the role:

Adelaide’s live music calendar needs a safe pair of hands and a sharp commercial eye. As Bookings Manager at Hindley St Music Hall, you’ll own the diary for the venue and its sister room, Div-de, working with promoters, agents and clients to lift the show count and keep the doors open more nights of the week.

 

You’ll lock in great shows, develop venue-produced events, turn dark days into private hire wins and lead the Club Bookers at Div-de. You’ll do it as part of Venue Nation Australia, part of Live Nation Australasia, with the backing of a national venue portfolio and plenty of room to spot new opportunities.

 

If bookings are your thing and you’re ready for your next move in Adelaide, we’d love to hear from you. Send through your resume and a cover letter telling us what you’d bring to the calendar.

 

 

What you’ll be doing: 

·       Calendar management: Run the booking diary for Hindley St Music Hall and Div-de, keeping event statuses accurate and venue use at its best.

·       Event development: Lead the creation of venue-produced events and drive private hire on dark days.

·       Relationships and new business: Build strong ties with promoters, agents and clients, and chase new business and cross-selling opportunities across the portfolio.

·       Negotiation and contracts: Work with the Bookings & Programming Director to negotiate deals that sit outside standard hire agreements.

·       Settlements and reporting: Oversee event settlements with the Venue Manager and Finance, and deliver weekly and monthly reporting on bookings, sales, pricing and attendance.

·       People leadership: Coach and support the Club Bookers at Div-de to keep the team engaged and performing.

 

 

 

What you’ll bring:

·       Booking experience: 5+ years in live events, venue booking or programming, ideally in a similar venue or entertainment setting.

·       Relationship skills: A knack for building long-term partnerships with promoters, agents and clients.

·       Negotiation know-how: Confidence working through contracts, artist fees and event-specific terms.

·       Organised and detail-driven: Strong time management and an eye for detail across contracts, event statuses and settlements.

·       Commercial mindset: A proactive, strategic thinker who spots opportunities and goes after new clients.

·       Tech confidence: Familiarity with venue software like VenueElite or Momentus, plus Microsoft Office and Slack.

·       Flexible and passionate: A genuine love of live entertainment and the adaptability to work outside standard hours in a fast-paced environment.

 


The Benefits:

·       A vibrant, music-focused workplace fostering creativity and collaboration.

·       Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

·       A flexible approach to when and where you work, designed to support balance in all aspects of life.

·       Access to concerts, events, and other entertainment perks.

·       A diverse, equitable workplace where every voice matters.

·       Comprehensive benefits, from volunteer days to wellness programs and mental health support.

 

Equal Opportunities: 

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and Homelife. As a growing business, we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.
