WHO ARE WE?

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state-of-the-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction.  The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.


Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac's events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company's premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993.

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Live music is our passion and where we find our common ground. There has never been a better time to join Live Nation.

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

job.title: Senior Category Manager - Technology
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE ROLE

The Senior Category Manager, Technology on Live Nation's Global Procurement team is jointly responsible for strategically managing $250M+ in annual IT spend. This hands-on role leads procurement for stakeholders' highest-priority technology projects – reducing cost structurally and permanently where possible, while supporting stakeholders' broader strategic and operational objectives. The role also shares responsibility for strategic supplier management within the category.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

Stakeholders & Sourcing

  • Jointly develops, with the category leader and key stakeholders, the overarching enterprise-wide procurement strategies for Live Nation's technology spend, primarily software/SaaS, telecom and networking, physical and cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI/ML platforms, and IT professional services.
  • In concert with key stakeholders, owns the category strategy and multi-year sourcing roadmap for assigned technology segments, including developing recommendations and advising on demand prioritization, supplier strategy, and value-delivery plan.
  • In a non-mandated environment, leads multiple simultaneous direct negotiations and full-lifecycle competitive sourcing events (e.g., RFPs) that have two or more of: enterprise-wide impact, material financial exposure, multiple internal decision-makers, novel commercial/risk structure, executive visibility, supplier escalation, or a cross-category dependencies.
  • Advises senior executives on negotiation strategy, supplier selection and qualification, and contracting approach; analyzes business, financial, and legal risk and develops practical mitigation options.
  • Identifies, quantifies, and captures cost reduction, cost avoidance, and other value opportunities across divisions and functions, incorporating rigorous analysis of available spend data and market dynamics with a confident, collaborative, creative and adaptable negotiation style.
  • Partners with IT, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk Management, Finance, and Operations to bring deals to closure.

Suppliers

  • Leads the commercial and operational contracting process for high-profile, complex, and/or strategic procurement projects, ensuring terms reflect Live Nation's business interests and policies.
  • Supports stakeholders’ efforts to manage and maintain ongoing supplier performance, contributing to development and negotiated implementation of solutions to service, quality, and commercial issues and disputes.
  • Represents Global Procurement with account representatives and supplier executives at Live Nation's most strategic incumbent technology suppliers.

Team

  • Serves as a delegated escalation and decision-support point for assigned portfolio matters; prepares executive-ready recommendations and independently advances work through cross-functional ambiguity.
  • Provides functional mentorship to fellow Technology team members, including resolving questions of prioritization, coaching, and quality review of sourcing deliverables.
  • Contributes to Procurement process improvement and automation, including appropriate use of AI and other technology to improve team efficiency and effectiveness.[Designs, pilots, and embeds, including through the appropriate use of AI and other technologies, improvements to sourcing methods, commercial standards, operational efficiency, and/or category analytics that are adopted beyond their own projects.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned, consistent with the nature and level of this role, as business needs evolve.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 8-10+ years of progressively responsible experience in sourcing/procurement, supply chain, or operations transformation; top-tier consulting experience preferred.
  • Proven track record of generating financial and operational value from complex, high-profile procurement projects, ideally in a non-mandated environment; advanced influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Deep knowledge of multiple IT categories: software/SaaS, infrastructure, networking/telecom, cybersecurity, cloud economics, or IT professional services.
  • Proficient with generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) in a procurement context and comfortable validating AI-generated output rather than relying on it uncritically.
  • Exceptional project management skills; thrives self-directed in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with minimal supervision.
  • Strong business acumen, including contract development and risk mitigation.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence audiences from analysts to senior executives. Fluent English required.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement or a comparable source-to-pay platform (SAP Ariba, Coupa) preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree required (Master's preferred); candidates with an Associate's degree and a strong track record of significant professional experience will also be considered

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

job.title: Specialist, North America Pricing (Temporary)
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – SPECIALIST, NORTH AMERICA PRICING
Location: East Coast Remote
Division: Music
Line Manager: Director, NA Pricing
Contract Terms: Temporary Contract: Jan 4 2027 - September 30 2027

THE TEAM
Ticketmaster Music is a passionate team dedicated to supporting the needs of the world’s biggest touring artists (and their promoters, agents, and managers). Tasked with building Ticketmaster’s relationships with the Artist community, this entails being on the pulse of where the business is moving through discussion with major industry players, informing the Artist community of the latest developments within Ticketmaster, assisting with the operations of events, acting as a resource to help maximize ticket sales and awareness, driving incremental revenue throughout the tour cycle, and understanding Artist needs and how Ticketmaster can serve them with new Products and Services.

Within Ticketmaster Music, the Global Pricing team plays a critical role – an invaluable resource for top tours to price their tickets to market and capture fair value on their events, ensuring we sell the right ticket, to the right fan, at the right price.

THE JOB
The role of Pricing Specialist manages a portfolio of events and is responsible for implementing a pricing strategy commensurate with client goals for inventory of premium tickets. This includes market research to develop a unique plan for each client, and management of clients with updates and price adjustments throughout an event’s sales cycle. This position requires client-facing interaction to help build the client relationship. This position will research market trends and work within various technology platforms to make price adjustments and report on sales. In addition, this role will be responsible for recommending front-end and back-end enhancements to improve the efficiency and display of tickets and ensure our offering is cutting edge and delivering maximum value to Artists and promoters. This is a temporary contract running Jan 4 2027 - Sept 30 2027.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Manage a portfolio of events and implement pricing changes through various internal tools
  • Execute a pricing strategy for North America music events under management
  • Identify trends in sales, and be proactive in making price adjustments
  • Find opportunities for case studies to drive revenue and sales goals
  • Research on maximizing revenue for top performing events
  • Collaborate with Product and design teams to build new features – suggest ideas, give feedback on designs, and help prioritize most valuable enhancements
  • Provide guidance and actionable information to clients, and define prioritized events based on revenue opportunities and partner relations
  • Collaborate with Global counterparts to share best practices and strategy on global tours
  • Build relationships with key industry stakeholders – Promoters, Agents, Venues, and Managers
  • Run reports as needed and identify sales trends, anomalies, and other actionable data points
  • Work with cross-functional groups, including - but not limited to - tour execution, marketing, finance, event operations, legal, product teams, data teams, etc., to initiate and execute ad hoc projects within the constraints of tight, and often fluid, time deadlines

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Strong analytical background with creative thinking and problem-solving skills
  • At least 2 years work experience preferred
  • Must have exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail
  • Understanding of the business dynamics between venue, promoter and artist
  • Ticketing experience preferred
  • Highly effective communication skills – written and verbal
  • Must be proficient in Excel, Word, Powerpoint and Outlook
  • Airtable proficiency preferred
  • Must be able to think through, evaluate and solve problems logically and efficiently
  • Knowledge of the Ticketmaster Host system and event build process a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, but not required

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Exhibiting characteristics of integrity, honesty, discretion, loyalty and kindness to peers
  • Ability to build relationships and work collaboratively to drive results
  • Good interpersonal skills, and ability to work effectively with a range of people and personalities
  • Must conduct all matters and communications in a professional and courteous manner as a representative of the company

BENEFITS & PERKS
Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER
We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.
Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.
We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability- We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.
Teamwork- We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team
Integrity- We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent
Belonging- We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

* Monitor and authorize entrance and departure of employees, guests, and other persons to guard against theft and maintain security and safety of the premises.

* May write reports of daily activities and irregularities such as equipment or property damage, theft, presence of unauthorized persons, or unusual occurrences.

* Patrol premises to prevent and detect signs of intrusion and ensure security of doors, windows, and gates.

* Escort or drive motor vehicle to transport individuals to specified locations or to provide personal protection.

* Operate detecting devices to screen individuals and prevent passage of prohibited articles into restricted areas.

* Warn persons of rule infractions or violations and apprehend or evict violators from premises.

This position has a 4 hour minimum.

Qualifications:

* Security/Law Enforcement experience required - active or retired.

* Good working knowledge of security operations, safety practices in a business environment and enforcement procedures.

* Ability to perform duties in a professional manner and appearance; ability to make independent and good judgment decisions within proper policy and procedures.

* Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.

* Acute sense of judgment, tact and diplomacy.

* A strong-sense of teamwork.

* Position requires constant walking, climbing stairs, lifting and carrying 50 lbs+.

job.title: Venue Security Supervisor
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE? 

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com. 

Live Nation’s Concerts Division is where tours are born, artists come to life, and fans get to experience the rush of live music. From our dozens of owned/operated Amphitheaters to our Global Touring team, from Ticketing and Venue Operations to Marketing and Sales... we foster a fun and upbeat work culture with no shortage of opportunities. With perks ranging from free concert tickets to dog-friendly offices, to progressive benefits like student loan reimbursement and adoption/fertility support... it’s no wonder we are certified as a Great Place to Work organization and one of People Magazine’s “50 Companies that Care”. We want everyone to feel like they belong and can thrive in our community, so we strive to help you achieve your career and personal goals. Live music is our passion and where we find our common ground. There has never been a better time to join Live Nation.  

WHO ARE YOU? 

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!   

THE JOB 

The Hollywood Palladium is seeking a Venue Security Supervisor. The Security Supervisor is responsible for supervising and coordinating activities of the security department and staff within the venue. Duties may also include management functions under the direction of the Security Manager and Operations Manager. 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO 

  • Direct and supervise security staff and other employees performing security services for guests. 
  • Provide guest service by greeting and assisting guests and responding to guest inquiries and complaints.
  • Lead staff, ongoing staff training, staff positioning, ensuring that all staff members are well-informed on event specific details and managing breaks. 
  • Assist the Security Manager to ensure compliance with all policies and procedures that relate to the security department, as well as local, state and federal laws and regulations. 
  • Oversees productivity and work assignments of the security staff and communicates with the Security Manager (or designated Manager) any challenges and status of all assignments prior to the conclusion of the shift. 
  • Partner with fellow staff members at the end of show to close the venue- this may include picking up and properly storing event equipment such as bike rack, mags, etc.
  • Train and evaluate security team members in venues. 
  • Assign and schedule team members to specific duties. 
  • Role model and enforce safety, health, and security priorities. 
  • Write reports of daily activities and irregularities such as equipment or property damage, theft, presence of unauthorized persons, or unusual occurrences. 
  • Other tasks as assigned by the Security Manager. 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 

  • High School Diploma or equivalent preferred. 
  • At least 2 years of experience in a similar role.
  • PPSO certified, 16 hrs. total training course, may be asked to provide certificate of completion.
  • CA guard card, 40hrs total, covering powers to arrest, terrorist awareness and chemical agents, posts & job descriptions.
  • Working knowledge of security operations, safety practices in a business environment and enforcement procedures. 
  • Strong strategic thinking and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Acute sense of judgment, tact and diplomacy.
  • A strong sense of teamwork and ability to execute programs.
  • Position requires constant walking, climbing stairs, lifting and carrying 50 lbs.+ and occasional sitting.
  • De-escalation tactics and training experience.

job.title: Marketing Analyst (LA Times Studios)
job.description:
The L.A. Times Studios LLC vision is to be the premier studio for groundbreaking and impactful storytelling, setting high standards for excellence in content creation and production. We push the boundaries of traditional media, exploring new formats and platforms to reach diverse and global audiences. By championing innovative ideas and diverse voices, we aspire to create a more connected world through storytelling and events supported by robust revenue streams from advertising sales, branded content, event production, products and business development.

Join a team of creative, collaborative and innovative professionals, apply today using the link below.

The Marketing Analyst will support the company’s Client Solutions team for B2B marketing efforts. The role of the Marketing Analyst will research market conditions and consumer behaviors and craft compelling sales collateral to showcase our product portfolio for our advertising customers and prospects across various categories. In addition, the Marketing Analyst will lead the process to create integrated marketing solutions that generate revenue and leverage the company’s robust portfolio of branded content offerings, print and online media, events, and promotions.

The role supports a broad portfolio of advertising categories and products and manages assigned co-branded marketing campaigns from initial planning through creative development, approvals, and final delivery. The Marketing Analyst also identifies and develops opportunities to improve team efficiency through AI-enabled tools, workflows, and process improvements.

Responsibilities:

• Research leads, strategize branded content solutions, and work closely with our content division, and the sales team, to develop robust and thoughtful content pitches for existing and new clients

• Generate intel on other publishers’ branded content offerings, capture examples and data on successful campaigns that brands have executed, and present findings to internal partners to inform our own branded content strategy

• Analyze the portfolio of categories and products to identify leads, challenges, opportunities, and trends. Compile findings in a shareable way and present to sales partners

• Conduct competitive analysis using media spending tools including Scarborough, comScore, and other available research platforms to support audience insights, category strategy, client proposals, and RFP responses.

• Develop B2B marketing materials including category and strategic decks, marketing one-sheets, and client proposals/RFPs

• Research consumer demographics, preferences, needs and buying habits and present findings in an easy-to- understand way

• Serve as primary sales contact for all category collateral and updates. Anticipate department needs and goals across an assigned portfolio of categories and products.

• Lead the design and content of B2B prospecting emails targeting assigned category advertisers

• Ideate creative solutions to advertisers’ media and marketing challenges utilizing our full portfolio of offerings and present them in a compelling way

• Manage assigned co-branded marketing campaigns from planning through final delivery, including determining required assets with Sales, developing creative briefs, briefing agency partners, coordinating creative development and revisions, managing internal and external review and approval processes, and delivering approved creative to clients and partners.

• Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, internal stakeholders, agency partners, and other external partners to ensure campaign requirements, timelines, deliverables, and approvals are completed accurately and on schedule.

• Identify opportunities to improve Client Solutions processes and workflows through the use of AI and other technology. Develop, test, and implement AI-enabled tools, agents, and workflows that streamline recurring work and improve team efficiency.

• Collaborates with colleagues to deliver high-quality outcomes, contribute to project meetings by articulating progress and challenges and suggesting solutions

• Demonstrates flexibility in responding to challenges and actively seeks feedback to find new ways to improve.

• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or Communications and 2+ years of prior marketing and/or advertising experience OR 4+ years of prior marketing and/or advertising experience

• Ability to develop customized branded content pitch decks, marketing presentations, proposals, and client-facing materials.

• Knowledge in branded content strategy and content creation process

• Experience supporting or coordinating integrated marketing, branded content, advertising, or co-branded campaigns through multiple stages of execution.

• Ability to manage multiple projects, categories, or client initiatives simultaneously while coordinating deliverables across internal and external stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of fundamental marketing principles, including digital, social, print, branded content, and integrated media.

• Strong research and analytical skills with the ability to generate insights and recommendations from audience, market, competitive, and consumer data.

• Experience using audience measurement, competitive intelligence, media research, or similar tools to support marketing and sales strategies.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present research findings, marketing recommendations, and project updates.

• Ability to learn and apply emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools, to improve marketing processes, research, and workflow efficiency.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, web-based research tools, databases, presentation software, and other business applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Previous experience in a publisher, agency, or experiential corporate setting

• Experience with Branded Content strategy, production and creation

• Experience coordinating advertising or co-branded campaigns with Sales, creative teams, agencies, clients, or external partners.

• Experience with social media marketing and social content creation and posting

• Experience with research tools like Google Analytics, Scarborough, ComScore or comparable audience and market research platforms.

• Experience in design and visual marketing.

• Experience using generative AI tools, automation, or AI-enabled workflows in a marketing or business environment.

• Experience identifying and implementing process improvements that increase team efficiency or streamline recurring work.

The L.A. Times Studios, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive. This Privacy Notice for L.A. Times Studios, LLC sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position with us.

The pay scale the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting is $70,610 to $75,000 and takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, experience, training, licenses, certifications, and other business or organizational needs. Compensation will be determined based on the above factors along with the requirements of the position. At the L.A. Times Studios, LLC, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for the role. We recommend adding our applicant tracking system domain (@dayforce.com) as a safe sender or contact, sometimes these emails get filtered to candidates' spam folders.

job.title: Producer (LA Times Studios)
job.description:
The L.A. Times Studios LLC vision is to be the premier studio for groundbreaking and impactful storytelling, setting high standards for excellence in content creation and production. We push the boundaries of traditional media, exploring new formats and platforms to reach diverse and global audiences. By championing innovative ideas and diverse voices, we aspire to create a more connected world through storytelling and events supported by robust revenue streams from advertising sales, branded content, event production, products and business development.

Join a team of creative, collaborative and innovative professionals, apply today using the link below.

The LA Times Studios is looking for three Producers. One specializing in Social Media, one in Entertainment and one in Sports.

The Producer plays a central role in developing and delivering content across live, streaming, digital, audio, video, podcast, and multimedia programming, with a dedicated focus on an assigned coverage area, program, or production. This position partners closely with talent, editorial teams, production staff, and cross-functional partners to identify compelling stories, develop content, and manage assigned productions from planning and development through production, post-production, publishing, and distribution.

The Producer supports content planning, guest coordination, talent preparation, recording and live production, production scheduling, post-production, and content distribution while contributing to audience growth, content performance, and overall programming success. This position exercises independent judgment within assigned programming and productions regarding content selection, story development, production execution, and delivery while balancing audience engagement, editorial standards, production requirements, and organizational objectives.

Responsibilities:

• Identify, research, evaluate, and develop stories, topics, guests, and content opportunities that align with assigned programming, audience interests, and organizational objectives, while maintaining strong knowledge of the assigned coverage area.

• Partner with hosts, talent, editorial teams, and other stakeholders to develop content angles, segment structures, scripts, interview questions, talking points, rundowns, briefing materials, and other production content.

• Own assigned episodes, segments, programs, or productions from development through production, post-production, publishing, and distribution, ensuring content is completed accurately, efficiently, and within established timelines and quality standards.

• Coordinate production logistics, including guest booking and preparation, talent scheduling, recording sessions, production resources, deadlines, approvals, and other requirements necessary for successful live, recorded, audio, video, podcast, streaming, or multimedia productions.

• Lead or support live, in-studio, and remote production activities, utilizing applicable production, recording, streaming, playout, content management, and publishing systems while providing real-time editorial and production guidance as needed.

• Coordinate post-production activities, including editing, revisions, quality-control reviews, approvals, final asset delivery, publishing, and distribution across applicable platforms and channels.

• Maintain production schedules, content calendars, rundowns, trackers, and workflow documentation for assigned productions; proactively identify production risks, scheduling conflicts, missing assets, and other issues that may impact delivery.

• Collaborate with editorial, social, digital, audience, branded content, sales, and production teams to support content distribution, promotional assets, new programming initiatives, audience engagement, and continuous improvement of production workflows and content performance.

• Other duties as assigned

General Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Production, Broadcasting, Digital Media and 3+ years of experience in live production, content production, digital media, broadcast, streaming, editorial, or multimedia environments OR 6+ years of experience in live production, content production, digital media, broadcast, streaming, editorial, or multimedia environments.

• Experience identifying, curating, and producing content within an assigned coverage area, and evaluating audience behavior and engagement opportunities to surface relevant, timely stories.

• Demonstrated ability to exercise sound editorial judgment and make decisions under deadline pressure and rapidly changing circumstances.

• Demonstrated subject-matter knowledge of an assigned coverage area or beat, including its key sources, platforms, audiences, and emerging trends.

• Familiarity with the content and production workflows, platform best practices, and distribution channels relevant to the assigned coverage area.

• Experience supporting on-air talent, hosts, interviewers, contributors, or content creators.

• Strong writing, research, communication, organizational, and content development skills.

• Experience utilizing production, content management, streaming, playout, broadcast, or digital publishing platforms.

• Experience collaborating with editorial, production, digital, social, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of audience engagement, content strategy, and digital media best practices.

• Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and live event coverage as business needs require.

Specific Requirements:

Producer, Social Media

• Experience identifying, curating, and producing content to be distributed to social media platforms and emerging digital trends.

• Knowledge of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Reddit, and other social platforms.

• Experience evaluating social conversations, viral content, audience behavior, and engagement opportunities.

• Familiarity with social video workflows, platform best practices, and creator-focused content strategies.

Producer, Entertainment

• Strong knowledge of entertainment news, film, television, music, celebrity culture, awards, and industry trends.

• Experience producing entertainment-focused interviews, features, live coverage, or multimedia content.

• Ability to identify emerging entertainment stories and audience interests.

• Familiarity with entertainment industry sources, media coverage, and event-based programming.

Producer, Sports

• Strong knowledge of professional, collegiate, and amateur sports, leagues, athletes, statistics, and industry trends.

• Experience producing sports programming, live event coverage, interviews, analysis, or feature content.

• Ability to identify key storylines, sporting events, audience interests, and emerging sports topics.

• Familiarity with sports media, live event production, and sports content workflows.

Preferred Additional Qualifications:

• Lead complex or high-priority productions from concept through delivery, with accountability for content quality, execution, timelines, and effective use of approved resources and budgets.

• Develop and evaluate story ideas, formats, and creative approaches that align with company priorities and engage intended audiences; translate programming or business objectives into actionable production plans.

• Oversee research, scripts, outlines, and other production materials, providing final production-level review within delegated authority to ensure content is accurate, clear, compelling, and consistent with company standards.

• Direct production workflows and coordinate staff, talent, technical resources, and cross-functional partners; establish priorities, allocate approved resources, and resolve competing demands across concurrent projects.

• Serve as the primary production decision-maker for assigned projects, exercising independent judgment to resolve complex content and production challenges, adjust priorities, and escalate sensitive or high-impact issues that exceed delegated authority.

• Supervise assigned production staff, establishing performance and quality expectations, delegating work, coaching employees, and evaluating performance; participate in hiring and disciplinary actions in partnership with management and HR.

• Collaborate with distribution, marketing, and audience teams to adapt content across relevant platforms; evaluate performance against established objectives and implement improvements based on audience insights, content performance, and production results.

• Partner with leadership to develop future programming and production initiatives; recommend new formats, resource needs, and workflow improvements that increase production capacity, efficiency, and content quality.

• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

• 9+ years of progressively responsible experience in content production, media production, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience supervising production staff, including delegating assignments, coaching employees, evaluating performance, and addressing performance concerns.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex productions or multiple concurrent projects from concept through delivery, with accountability for quality, timelines, and production outcomes.

• Strong content judgment and demonstrated ability to make independent decisions involving sensitive subject matter, production risks, and competing priorities.

• Strong writing, storytelling, verbal communication, and creative direction skills.

• Experience coordinating talent, production staff, technical resources, and cross-functional partners, including setting priorities and resolving resource or workflow conflicts.

• Working knowledge of production workflows and tools relevant to the assigned content format.

• Knowledge of applicable content standards, editorial integrity, and quality-control practices.

• Ability to manage competing deadlines, resolve production issues, and adapt to changing priorities.

• Ability to work flexible schedules based on production requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Media Studies, Film/Television Production, or a related field.

• Experience producing content across multiple formats or distribution platforms.

• Experience developing new content formats or programming initiatives.

• Experience managing production budgets and allocating resources.

• Experience using audience insights and performance metrics to improve content.

• Experience improving production workflows and developing production teams.

Additional Responsibilities

• Shape podcast episode formats, narrative arcs, interview approaches, and scripts in partnership with hosts, reporters, and editors.

• Direct studio, remote, and on-location podcast recordings, guiding host and guest performance and coordinating audio and video needs.

• Oversee podcast post-production, including audio editing, mixing, sound design, scoring, and coordination of video edits.

• Oversee episode publishing, including titles, descriptions, show notes, metadata, and release scheduling across podcast and video platforms.

Additional Requirements

• Demonstrated experience producing professional audio and video podcasts, including weekly, seasonal, or narrative series.

• Strong skills in podcast storytelling, interview development, host preparation, and script editing.

• Proficiency with Adobe Audition, Premiere Pro, Riverside, or comparable audio, video, and remote recording tools.

• Working knowledge of audio editing, mixing, sound design, and podcast delivery standards.

• Familiarity with podcast hosting, RSS feeds, and distribution through Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and YouTube.

• Knowledge of journalistic sourcing, fact-checking, and editorial review practices for news and investigative programming.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing and launching original podcast series.

• Experience producing investigative, documentary, or serialized narrative podcasts.

• Experience integrating sponsorships or branded segments while maintaining editorial standards and applicable disclosures.

• Familiarity with music and archival content permissions and podcast accessibility practices, including transcripts and captions.

job.title: Senior Sales Executive 3 (LA Times Studios)
job.description:
The L.A. Times Studios LLC vision is to be the premier studio for groundbreaking and impactful storytelling, setting high standards for excellence in content creation and production. We push the boundaries of traditional media, exploring new formats and platforms to reach diverse and global audiences. By championing innovative ideas and diverse voices, we aspire to create a more connected world through storytelling and events supported by robust revenue streams from advertising sales, branded content, event production, products and business development.

Join a team of creative, collaborative and innovative professionals, apply today using the link below.

The Senior Sales Executive 3 manages a high-value portfolio of enterprise and studios advertising accounts, engaging executive-level decision-makers with compelling, customized proposals. This individual brings strategic thinking and deep knowledge of integrated media solutions to every client relationship, driving significant revenue growth and delivering fully integrated campaigns. The Senior Sales Executive 3 also serves as a subject matter expert and informal mentor to junior members of the sales team, elevating the collective knowledge and performance of the broader organization.

Responsibilities:

• Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise and studios accounts, delivering against a substantial annual revenue quota.

• Develop and execute long-term strategic account plans that align organizational capabilities with client marketing objectives.

• Build and maintain executive-level relationships with clients, agencies, and key decision-makers.

• Lead the development of sophisticated, integrated campaign proposals spanning digital, print, programmatic, and custom studios content.

• Identify new enterprise opportunities and expand the organization's presence within high-value categories.

• Act as a senior resource and informal mentor to Sales Executives and Sales Executive 1 and 2 colleagues, sharing best practices and market insights.

• Partner with editorial, studios, and product teams to develop bespoke solutions for complex client needs.

• Accurately forecast revenue and maintain detailed pipeline documentation in CRM systems.

• Represent the organization at industry events, client entertainment, and networking opportunities.

• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in marketing, business, or a related field and 5+ years of media, advertising, or digital sales experience with a demonstrated record of managing enterprise accounts and exceeding quota. OR 8+ years of media, advertising, or digital sales experience with a demonstrated record of managing enterprise accounts and exceeding quota.

• Proven experience selling complex, integrated marketing solutions to senior-level clients.

• Deep knowledge of digital advertising, branded content, and custom studios or content marketing solutions.

• Exceptional consultative selling, negotiation, and executive communication skills.

• Strong ability to develop and maintain long-term client relationships at the decision-maker level.

• Experience mentoring or informally coaching junior sales colleagues.

• Proficiency in CRM and sales forecasting tools.

• Executive presence and the ability to command credibility in high-stakes client settings

• Collaborative mindset with a natural inclination to share knowledge and elevate peers

• Analytical thinking that translates market insights into strategic client recommendations

Preferred Qualifications:

• A genuine interest in media, advertising, or digital marketing is a plus.

job.title: Account Director (w/m/d), Advertising – BERLIN
job.description:
Account Director (w/m/d), Advertising – BERLIN


Wir suchen ab sofort eine:n Account Director (w/m/d)
Du bist strategisch versiert, behältst Kundenbedürfnisse und Zahlen gleichermaßen im Blick und willst Verantwortung für große Accounts, spannende Marken und ein motiviertes Team übernehmen? Du liebst es, Konzepte in messbare Erfolge zu übersetzen und gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen Wachstum zu schaffen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Ausgestattet mit Marktverständnis und Weitsicht bist du ein(e) souveräne(r) AnsprechpartnerIn für unser Team sowie unsere Kunden und lieferst mit viel Kreativität, Verhandlungsgeschick sowie Konzeptionsstärke ein optimales Projektmanagement.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du bist die zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für unsere Kund:innen – proaktiv, verlässlich und immer mit strategischem Weitblick.

  • Du entwickelst integrierte Kommunikations- und Marketing-Strategien (online & offline) und setzt diese mit dem Team um.

  • Du verantwortest die Planung, Steuerung und das Reporting von Budgets, Kampagnen-KPIs und P&L-Zielen.

  • Du leitest cross-funktionale Projekte (Kreation, Social, Media, Produktion) und sorgst für termingerechte, qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung.

  • Du führst und entwickelst dein Account-Team – von der Aufgabenverteilung bis zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du präsentierst Konzepte und Ergebnisse kompetent bei Kund:innen und verhandelst Verträge, Scope-Änderungen und Budgets.

  • Du identifizierst Upsell-/Cross-Sell-Potenziale und unterstützt New Business-Initiativen.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass Prozesse effizient laufen und dass Qualität, Timeline und Budget eingehalten werden.

  • Du erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und erarbeitest pragmatische Lösungswege — intern wie extern.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv unsere Agenturkultur mit: offen, kooperativ, ergebnisorientiert und mit Freude an guter Arbeit.

  • Zentraler Ansprechpartner für Kunden vom Briefing über die kreative Entwicklung bis einschließlich der Produktion für alle klassischen und digitalen Medien

  • Übersicht des Projekt-Managements von der Projektplanung über Timing- & Budgetkontrolle bis hin zu Status-Reports

  • Informationsmanagement und Feedback an das Projektteam

  • Planung & Optimierung von Prozessen, Ressourcen & Kapazitäten

  • Erstellen & Halten von Präsentationen & Workshops

  • Beteiligung an Pitches

DEINE SKILLS

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Kommunikation, Marketing, BWL oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Ca. 5-8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Kommunikationsagenturen

  • Mehrjährige Agenturerfahrung in der Kundenführung (Account Management) – idealerweise mit internationalen Kund:innen und komplexen Projekten

  • Erfahrung in der Kunden- und Mitarbeiterführung

  • Ausgeprägte Service- und Qualitätsorientierung und hohe Zuverlässigkeit

  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Operatives Geschick, strategisches Denken und selbstsichere Präsentation intern und vor Kunden

  • Viel Leidenschaft für klare Botschaften und ein gutes Gespür für Kreation

  • Erfahrung in Budget-/P&L-Verantwortung und Projektsteuerung

  • Hohes strategisches Verständnis gepaart mit Hands-on-Mentalität

  • Ausgeprägte Präsentations- und Verhandlungsstärke

  • Organisationsgeschick, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und sicheres Projektmanagement

  • Leadership-Erfahrung und Freude an Mitarbeitendenentwicklung

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Kanälen, Reporting-Tools und gängigen Office-Programmen

  • Proaktive, lösungsorientierte Haltung und Belastbarkeit in dynamischen Situationen

  • Du bringst exzellente Englischkenntnisse mit und beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau

  • Ausgezeichnete MS Office Kenntnisse

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Mitarbeit an spannenden, zukunftsorientierten und interdisziplinären Kundenprojekten

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur

  • Ein kreatives, unterstützendes Team, das zusammen an Zielen arbeitet und voneinander lernt

  • Abwechslungsreiches Kundenportfolio

  • Modernes Design-Büro am Rosenthaler Platz mit inspirierender Arbeitsumgebung

  • Gutschein-Benefits oder Firmen-Deutschlandticket für Festangestellte

  • Trainings- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

ÜBER UNS

M+C Saatchi ist eine globale Agentur für Markenkommunikation, die unter dem Dach des weltweiten M+C Saatchi Netzwerks in London gegründet wurde. Heute zählt die Agentur mehr als 2.000 Mitarbeiter:innen, mit Büros unter anderem in Mailand, London, Sydney, Amsterdam, Kapstadt, New York, Los Angeles und Berlin. Zum Kernangebot gehören Markenstrategie, Kampagnen, PR & Influencer Relations, Sponsoring, Events & Brand Experience, Social Media sowie Content-Produktion. Mit dem M+C Saatchi Deutschland Team realisierte die Agentur in den letzten Jahren unter anderem Projekte für Peloton, The North Face, ING, Porsche, Porsche Design, Mercedes-Benz Vans, Nike, Ferrero, Heineken, WHOOP, UEFA, Riot Games und Volkswagen. Unser Ziel ist es, Kund:innen dabei zu unterstützen, wirkungsvolle 360°-Kommunikation zu schaffen, die ihre Zielgruppen begeistert.

Bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und mit uns zu wachsen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

job.title: Concept Creative Social (w/m/d)
job.description:
Standort: Berlin

Start: asap

Anstellung: Vollzeit

Für diese Rolle sind Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau essenziell.

Wir suchen ab sofort eine:n Concept Creative Social  (w/m/d) für einen großen Retail-Account.  
Du arbeitest hands-on mit starkem Fokus auf Cultural Trends und übernimmst kreative
Verantwortung von der ersten Konzeptidee bis zur finalen Umsetzung.
Du kennst die aktuellen Social-Mechaniken und kulturellen Trends, verstehst, wie Inhalte auf Plattformen funktionieren und welche Formate Menschen bewegen. Du entwickelst Konzepte,
die maximal Aufmerksamkeit generieren – von kreativer Social-Copy über Stories bis hin zu
großen Kampagnenideen, über die ganz Deutschland spricht.
Bei uns kannst du genau das tun: Content und Konzepte gestalten, Marken eine unverwechselbare Stimme geben und mit deinem kreativen Gespür immer wieder neue Impulse setzen.

Dich erwarten spannende kreative Herausforderungen für große nationale und internationale Marken.
In unserem Team mit einem Standort am Rosenthaler Platz bekommst du viel Gestaltungsspielraum und echte Eigenverantwortung — mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und Kolleg:innen, die dich jederzeit unterstützen.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Social-first Ideenentwicklung und plattformgerechte Konzeption von
    Formaten und Kampagnenmechaniken.

  • Entwicklung von Kampagnenmechaniken — von der Idee bis zur finalen Storyline und zur Übergabe an Produktion/Paid.

  • Copywriting für Social: Skripte für Reels/TikToks, Knowledge der gängigen Social Lingo, Funktionseise von Captions, CTAs und mehr.

  • Erstellung inspirierender und involvierender Contents über mehrere digitale Kanäle hinweg (Social Posts, Native Ads, Virals, Stunts, Content-Snippets für Websites).

  • Trend-Research und kontinuierliches Plattform-Scouting:
    du identifizierst relevante Creator-Formate, Cultural Moments und neue Mechaniken.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Art Direction, Social Management, Strategie, Produktion und Paid, inklusive kreativer Qualitätssicherung.

  • Unterstützung bei Präsentationen, Workshops und Pitches sowie aktive Mitwirkung an der Ausarbeitung von Pitch-Ideen.

  • Sicherstellung, dass Konzepte kulturell relevant und technisch für die jeweiligen Plattformen umsetzbar sind.

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du bist Social-first denkend und liebst Social Media — du kennst Funktionen, Verbreitungsweisen und Mechaniken der Plattformen aka bist „chronically online“.

  • Du verfügst über ca. 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung als Concept Creative, Social Creative, Copywriter:in oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Social-Fokus.

  • Du hast ein starkes Gespür für Sprache, Storytelling und Headlines; du verfasst klare, pointierte und conversion-orientierte Copy.

  • Du konzipierst zielsicher und kannst komplexe Themen in appetitliche Häppchen verpacken.

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Kampagnenmechaniken und crossmedialen Content-Formaten ist vorhanden.

  • Du bringst technisches Verständnis mit und weißt, welche Umsetzungsanforderungen (Produktion/Editing) Formate benötigen.

  • Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gern interdisziplinär mit Strategie, Kreation, Social Management und Produktion zusammen.

  • Ein Studium im Bereich Kommunikation/Werbung oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung ist ein Plus — oder du bist ein Naturtalent mit hervorragender Schreibe.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (muttersprachlich) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Einen mutigen und experimentierfreudigen Kunden

  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales Miteinander

  • Modernes Design‑Büro am Rosenthaler Platz sowie Mobile Working nach Absprache

  • Gutschein‑Benefits oder Firmen‑Deutschlandticket für Festangestellte

ÜBER UNS

M+C Saatchi ist eine globale Agentur für Markenkommunikation, welche unter dem Dach des weltweiten M+C Saatchi Netzwerks in London gegründet wurde. Heute zählt die Agentur mehr als 2000 Mitarbeiterinnen, mit Büros u.a. in Mailand, London, Sydney, Amsterdam, Kappstadt, New York, Los Angeles und Berlin. Zum Kernangebot gehören Markenstrategie, Kampagnen, PR & Influencer Relations, Sponsoring, Events & Brand Experience, Social Media sowie Content Produktion. Mit dem M+C Saatchi Deutschland Team realisierte die Agentur in den letzten Jahren unter anderem Projekte für Peloton, The North Face, ING, Lidl, Porsche, Porsche Design, Mercedes-Benz Vans, Nike, Ferrero, Heineken, WHOOP, UEFA, Riot Games und Volkswagen. Unser Ziel ist es, Kundinnen dabei zu unterstützen, wirkungsvolle 360° Kommunikation zu schaffen, die ihre Zielgruppen begeistert.

job.title: Finance Assistant (w/m/d) – BERLIN
job.description:
Finance Assistant (w/m/d) – BERLIN

Wir suchen ab sofort eine:n Finance Assistant (w/m/d) für unseren Standort Berlin.

Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert, hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen und möchtest praktische Erfahrung in einem abwechslungsreichen Finance-Umfeld sammeln? Du bist zuverlässig, genau und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

In dieser praxisnahen Support-Rolle unterstützt du unseren Head of Finance im operativen Tagesgeschäft. Du musst noch kein Finance-Profi sein: Wichtig sind uns Organisationstalent, Genauigkeit, Verlässlichkeit und die Bereitschaft, bestehende Prozesse sorgfältig umzusetzen. Eine umfassende Einarbeitung in unsere Abläufe, Systeme und deine konkreten Aufgaben ist vorgesehen.

  • Du unterstützt den Head of Finance bei den täglichen Finance- und administrativen Aufgaben.

  • Du arbeitest nach bestehenden Finance-Prozessen und stellst sicher, dass Aufgaben sorgfältig und zuverlässig erledigt werden.

  • Du verfolgst offene Vorgänge mit unserem Shared Service Centre nach und unterstützt dabei, dass Anfragen abgeschlossen werden.

  • Du aktualisierst Excel-Tabellen, Reports und Finance-Tracker.

  • Du unterstützt bei einfachen Datenanalysen und prüfst Informationen auf Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit.

  • Du hilfst bei der Pflege von Prozessdokumentationen, erinnerst an Abläufe und beantwortest grundlegende Fragen aus dem Team.

  • Du unterstützt bei Kunden- und Lieferantenanfragen, beim Forderungsmanagement und bei routinemäßigen Mahnläufen; komplexere Themen stimmst du mit dem Head of Finance ab.

  • Du prüfst Reise- und Ausgabenabrechnungen auf Vollständigkeit und klärst offene Punkte.

  • Du unterstützt nach Anleitung bei der Vorbereitung von Umsatzsteuererklärungen, Zahlungsläufen und routinemäßigen Monatsabschlussaufgaben.

  • Du übernimmst weitere klar definierte Finance- und administrative Aufgaben nach Bedarf.

  • Du kannst Anweisungen gut aufnehmen und bestehende Prozesse zuverlässig umsetzen.

  • Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist.

  • Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Interesse an Technologie und KI-Tools, die effizientes Arbeiten unterstützen, ist ein Plus.

  • Mitarbeit an spannenden, zukunftsorientierten und interdisziplinären Kundenprojekten

  • Ein kreatives, unterstützendes Team, das gemeinsam an Zielen arbeitet und voneinander lernt

job.title: Jr. Staff Accountant
job.description:
About M&C Saatchi World Services

M&C Saatchi World Services is a full-service marketing company renowned for using commercial advertising to solve the world's toughest challenges. World Services is a specialty branch of M&C Saatchi Group, and we provide strategic communications, behavior change, and marketing support to Public Sector clients with special emphasis on the US Federal Government and State, Local, Tribal, & Territorial leaders.

M&C Saatchi World Services US is seeking a detail-oriented and dependable Staff Accountant to support the finance function of a growing government contractor. This role covers the core of day-to-day accounting (month-end close, AP, AR, banking, and employee expenses) and adds hands-on ownership of intercompany accounting within a FOCI-mitigated structure.

The Role

Reporting to the Director of Finance, the Staff Accountant will keep the books accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You'll prepare month-end journal entries and reconciliations, manage the flow of vendor payments and client receivables, and run the corporate card and expense program. You'll also own intercompany activity with our M&C Saatchi Group affiliates, making sure every transaction follows our post-FOCI governance and information-separation requirements.

Working with project teams, HR, and our affiliated companies, you'll investigate discrepancies, tighten processes, and help employees get expenses right the first time. The ideal candidate has 1 to 3 years of hands-on accounting experience, is confident in NetSuite and Excel, and is comfortable working independently in a small team where controls matter. Experience in government contracting or with DCAA-compliant practices is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities

Month-End Close and General Accounting

  • Prepare and post month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, depreciation, and other recurring or adjusting entries.

  • Maintain fixed asset schedules and ensure additions, disposals, and depreciation are recorded accurately.

  • Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations and investigate outstanding or unusual items.

  • Support the timely and accurate completion of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close.

  • Assist with financial reporting and variance analysis as needed.

  • Maintain clear and complete supporting documentation for all accounting entries.

Intercompany Accounting and Post-FOCI Compliance

  • Manage intercompany transactions, reconciliations, settlements, and supporting documentation.

  • Coordinate with affiliated entities to resolve intercompany differences promptly.

  • Ensure intercompany activities are recorded in accordance with established post-FOCI processes, governance requirements, and information-separation protocols.

  • Maintain appropriate documentation and controls supporting the company's FOCI mitigation obligations.

Accounts Receivable

  • Manage accounts receivable activities, including invoice tracking, cash application, and aging review.

  • Monitor outstanding balances and coordinate collection follow-up with internal teams and clients.

  • Reconcile client accounts and resolve billing or payment discrepancies.

Accounts Payable and Banking

  • Review and post vendor invoices, ensuring appropriate coding, documentation, and approvals.

  • Prepare scheduled payment runs and supporting bank upload files for review and approval.

  • Maintain vendor records and help resolve invoice and payment inquiries.

  • Perform bank and cash reconciliations and investigate reconciling items.

  • Support cash flow monitoring and maintain accurate banking records.

  • Help maintain appropriate segregation of duties across invoice processing, payment preparation, and approval.

Employee Expenses and Corporate Credit Cards

  • Review employee expense reports for accuracy, documentation, coding, and compliance with company policy.

  • Administer the corporate credit card program, including card issuance, account maintenance, transaction review, and reconciliation.

  • Monitor outstanding credit card documentation and ensure expenses are recorded in the correct accounting period.

  • Train employees on expense and corporate card processes.

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of general ledger accounting, journal entries, accrual accounting, and month-end close.

  • Experience with bank reconciliations, accounts receivable, accounts payable, employee expenses, and fixed assets.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and reconciliation schedules.

  • Experience with an ERP or accounting platform; NetSuite experience strongly preferred.

  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently, investigate discrepancies, and communicate issues clearly.

  • Sound judgment when handling confidential financial, employee, and company information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in government contracting, professional services, advertising, communications, or another project-based environment.

  • Familiarity with intercompany accounting in a multinational or affiliated-company structure.

  • Exposure to FOCI mitigation requirements, government contract accounting, or regulated environments.

  • Familiarity with DCAA-compliant accounting practices and FAR cost allowability.

  • Experience with government invoicing systems (for example, WAWF/PIEE).

Requirements

Educational Requirements: BA or BS in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required. Approximately 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in general ledger accounting, month-end close, accounts payable and receivable, or a related accounting function.

Language Requirements: Fluent written and spoken English required.

Location: Hybrid, New York City

Salary Range: $55,000 to $70,000

  • Relocation Assistance: No relocation assistance available

  • Clearance Required for Start: No

  • Clearance Type: Secret, to be obtained after hire

Eligibility Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship: Must be a United States Citizen, as required by the government contract.

  • Clearance Eligibility: Must be able and willing to obtain a U.S. Government Secret or Top Secret security clearance immediately upon employment.

  • Background Screening: Must be willing to submit to a rigorous federal background investigation, including an in-depth review of personal finances, criminal history, employment history, and drug use.

Our Hiring Process
We aim to keep our process clear and respectful of your time. Here’s what to expect:

  1. Phone screen with our Talent Acquisition team

  2. First interview with Financial Lead

  3. Second interview, in person at our New York office with Head of Finance

  4. Final conversation with a member of our leadership team

We offer a benefits package designed to support your health, family life, financial wellbeing, and growth:

  • 12 weeks’ of full pay for primary caregivers and 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.

  • Choice of three medical plans (HSA at $0 cost; EPO 75% employer funded; PPO 65% employer funded)

  • 70% employer-funded dental and vision coverage

  • Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays,

  • 401(k) with 5% employer match

  • Gym membership reimbursement and/or Wellhub subscription

  • Mental health support through EAP and Self Space services

  • Work from anywhere for up to 2 weeks per year (subject to approval)

  • Social events, happy hours, professional development trainings, etc.

job.title: Praktikant:in Account Management, Sport & Entertainment (w/m/d) – BERLIN
job.description:
Praktikant:in Account Management, Sport & Entertainment (w/m/d) – BERLIN

Standort: Berlin

Start: 4.1.2027

Anstellung: Pflichtpraktikum im Rahmen eines Studiums, Vollzeit

Dauer: mindestens 3 Monate, besser 5-6 Monate

Für diese Rolle sind Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachlerniveau essenziell.

Wir suchen eine motivierte, neugierige und strukturierte Persönlichkeit, die unser Account-Team im Bereich Sport & Entertainment unterstützt. In deinem Praktikum erhältst du Einblicke in die Betreuung nationaler und internationaler Kund:innen und arbeitest an Projekten rund um Sport, Fußball, Lifestyle und Entertainment mit. Du unterstützt das Team im Tagesgeschäft und begleitest Kampagnen, Sponsoring-Projekte, Aktivierungen, Events und Content-Produktionen von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Strategy, Kreation, Social, PR und Produktion zusammen und lernst, wie Briefings, Timings, Budgets, Freigaben und Deliverables in einer internationalen Agentur koordiniert werden. Wir wünschen uns, dass du dich aktiv einbringst, Verantwortung für klar definierte Aufgaben übernimmst und ein echtes Interesse an den Communities, kulturellen Momenten und Geschichten hinter Sport und Entertainment mitbringst.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Unterstützung bei der Betreuung nationaler und internationaler Kund:innen aus Sport, Fußball, Lifestyle und Entertainment

  • Mitarbeit im operativen Tagesgeschäft, von der Vorbereitung von Briefings über Abstimmungen und Freigaben bis zur Umsetzung

  • Unterstützung bei Sponsoring-Projekten, Kampagnen, Aktivierungen, Events und Content-Produktionen

  • Recherche zu Marken, Zielgruppen, Trends, Sportarten, Talents, Partnerschaften und relevanten kulturellen Themen

  • Vorbereitung von Präsentationen, Statusübersichten, Reportings, Meeting-Unterlagen und Projekt-Dokumentationen

  • Koordination von Terminen, Aufgaben und Follow-ups sowie Pflege von Timings und Deliverable-Listen

  • Unterstützung bei der Abstimmung mit internen Teams, Kund:innen und externen Partner:innen oder Dienstleister:innen

  • Aufbereitung und strukturierte Weitergabe von Kund:innenfeedback an die beteiligten Projektteams

  • Unterstützung bei Events und Aktivierungen, bei Bedarf auch vor Ort, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Ablauf, Gästemanagement oder Ticketing

  • Mitarbeit bei Brainstormings, Workshops und Pitches sowie Einbringen eigener Ideen und Perspektiven

  • Unterstützung bei administrativen Aufgaben wie Ablage, Kostenübersichten und Rechnungsunterlagen

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule oder Universität immatrikuliert und musst ein Pflichtpraktikum absolvieren, idealerweise in den Bereichen Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, Sportmanagement, Eventmanagement, Wirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Sport und Entertainment und verfolgst relevante Marken, Plattformen, Communities und kulturelle Trends

  • Du arbeitest organisiert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick

  • Du kommunizierst klar, freundlich und verbindlich und hast Freude an Teamarbeit und Kund:innenkontakt

  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit

  • Du hast Freude an Recherche, Präsentationen und der strukturierten Aufbereitung von Informationen

  • Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel und Word

  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen durch vorherige Praktika, studentische Tätigkeiten oder eigene Projekte im Agentur-, Marketing-, Sport-, Event- oder Medienumfeld sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Du bist bereit, bei Kund:innenterminen, Produktionen, Events und Aktivierungen flexibel zu unterstützen und bei Bedarf zu reisen

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Teams

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Praxiseinblicke und die Möglichkeit, an echten Kund:innenprojekten, Kampagnen, Sponsoring-Aktivierungen, Events und Content-Produktionen mitzuwirken

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales, internationales Team

  • Ein modernes Design-Büro am Rosenthaler Platz

ÜBER UNS

M+C Saatchi ist eine globale Agentur für Markenkommunikation, die unter dem Dach des weltweiten M+C Saatchi Netzwerks in London gegründet wurde. Heute zählt die Agentur mehr als 2.000 Mitarbeiter:innen, mit Büros unter anderem in Mailand, London, Sydney, Amsterdam, Kapstadt, New York, Los Angeles und Berlin. Zum Kernangebot gehören Markenstrategie, Kampagnen, PR & Influencer Relations, Sponsoring, Events & Brand Experience, Social Media sowie Content-Produktion. Mit dem M+C Saatchi Deutschland Team realisierte die Agentur in den letzten Jahren unter anderem Projekte für Peloton, The North Face, ING, Porsche, Porsche Design, Mercedes-Benz Vans, Nike, Ferrero, Heineken, WHOOP, UEFA, Riot Games und Volkswagen. Unser Ziel ist es, Kund:innen dabei zu unterstützen, wirkungsvolle 360°-Kommunikation zu schaffen, die ihre Zielgruppen begeistert.

job.title: Senior Growth Manager
job.description:
M+C Saatchi Group is looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly motivated Senior Growth Manager to help shape how the UK Group shows up, connects and grows.

Sitting at the heart of our UK Growth and Marketing team, and reporting to the UK Head of New Business, you'll play a pivotal role in identifying, developing and converting new business opportunities, leading major pitches and bringing together the collective strength of our specialist businesses.

This is an opportunity to work across one of the UK's most diverse creative communications groups, with clients and opportunities spanning major Government departments, leading commercial brands, sport and entertainment, brand communications, consultancy, social and media.

You'll help drive our proactive growth agenda, develop our recently launched Culture Collective community and deliver marketing initiatives that strengthen our reputation, relationships and commercial pipeline.

You'll also play an important role in bringing our Cultural Power proposition to life, ensuring our thinking, storytelling and market presence reflect our ambition to shape culture and create meaningful connections.

Working closely with senior leadership and specialist teams across the Group, you'll operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two opportunities look the same.

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with exceptional delivery, thrives on complexity and brings clarity, energy and momentum to everything they do.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
This is a varied, high-impact role focused on driving growth through proactive business development, world-class pitching and a compelling marketing presence.

You'll help develop complex, high-value new business opportunities from initial qualification through to final delivery, often bringing together multiple specialisms to develop integrated responses to challenging client briefs.

Our opportunities span major public sector procurement processes, significant commercial pitches and proactive growth initiatives across advertising, PR, sport and entertainment, brand consultancy, social, data and media.

You'll need to be comfortable managing multiple priorities, influencing senior stakeholders, navigating ambiguity and delivering to demanding deadlines without compromising quality.

Beyond pitching, you'll help shape our approach to prospecting, relationship development, thought leadership and industry engagement, ensuring the Group is present in the right conversations, with the right message.

Success will be measured through the quality and conversion of our new business pipeline, the effectiveness of our pitches, the strength of cross-Group collaboration and the commercial impact of our marketing activity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

New Business & Pitch Leadership

  • Lead major new business pitches end-to-end, including opportunity qualification, strategy, team mobilisation, content development, commercial coordination and final delivery.

  • Bring together specialist capabilities and senior stakeholders from across the UK Group to develop compelling, integrated responses to complex client challenges.

  • Lead public sector and commercial procurement processes, including tenders, framework opportunities, RFIs and RFPs, ensuring submissions are strategically strong, compliant and commercially considered.

  • Manage multiple concurrent opportunities against demanding deadlines, maintaining momentum, quality and accountability throughout.

  • Partner with senior leadership to evaluate opportunities, shape competitive positioning and make informed recommendations on where to invest time and resources.

  • Work with finance, commercial and legal teams to support pitch budgets, commercial submissions and governance requirements.

Growth Strategy & Prospecting

  • Partner with the CMO, UK Head of New Business and business leads to shape and deliver our annual growth and marketing strategy.

  • Develop proactive prospecting strategies, identifying priority audiences, building contact plans and nurturing relationships with prospective clients.

  • Identify opportunities to connect Group specialisms, unlock cross-selling potential and develop broader, more valuable client relationships.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Group's capabilities, identifying opportunities to bring together expertise in response to emerging client needs.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, opportunity tracking and reporting through HubSpot.

Marketing, Reputation & Relationships

  • Develop and grow Culture Collective as a platform for meaningful industry connections, prospect engagement and new business opportunities.

  • Support the delivery of the UK Group marketing strategy, bringing our Cultural Power proposition to life through compelling content and market engagement.

  • Contribute to thought leadership, social content, PR and industry events, working closely with communications and specialist teams.

  • Maintain and evolve credentials, case studies, pitch templates and other new business collateral, ensuring consistency, quality and relevance.

  • Coordinate industry award entries, directory submissions and other reputation-building opportunities.

  • Build strong relationships across the UK Group, fostering collaboration and ensuring our collective expertise is represented effectively in the market.

ABOUT YOU

  • You're a natural connector, a strategic thinker and someone who knows how to make things happen.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, ambitious environment where priorities shift, opportunities are complex and collaboration is essential.

  • You're equally comfortable shaping a compelling pitch narrative, influencing senior stakeholders, coordinating multiple teams and getting into the detail to ensure exceptional delivery.

  • You understand that great business development is about more than responding to briefs. It's about spotting opportunities, asking the right questions, connecting capabilities and building relationships that create long-term value.

  • You bring strong commercial instincts, excellent judgement and a genuine curiosity about the wider marketing, communications and cultural landscape.

  • Above all, you take ownership, bring people with you and deliver.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: (Experience and qualifications)

  • Significant experience in business development, growth, client leadership or strategic marketing within a creative, communications or integrated agency environment.

  • A proven track record of leading major new business pitches, from opportunity qualification and strategic development through to final presentation and delivery.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-disciplinary opportunities involving multiple agency specialisms or business units.

  • Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to assess opportunities, understand client challenges and develop compelling, commercially credible responses.

  • Exceptional storytelling, writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear, persuasive narratives.

  • A broad understanding of the marketing and communications landscape, including advertising, PR, social, brand strategy, sport and entertainment, consultancy and media.

  • Experience of significant public sector, Government or complex commercial procurement processes would be advantageous.

  • Strong project management skills, with experience managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously.

  • Confidence using CRM systems, managing pipelines and reporting on business development activity, ideally using HubSpot.

  • A track record of building relationships and influencing senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

WHAT YOU'RE GOOD AT: (Behaviours)

  • Connecting the dots: Seeing opportunities across different businesses, capabilities and client challenges, and bringing the right people and ideas together.

  • Making sense of complexity: Turning ambiguous briefs, competing perspectives and complex information into clear strategies and actionable plans.

  • Driving momentum: Taking ownership, anticipating challenges and keeping people and projects moving, even when priorities shift.

  • Thinking commercially: Understanding what makes an opportunity valuable, where to focus effort and how to create compelling reasons for clients to choose us.

  • Influencing and collaborating: Building trust, navigating different perspectives and aligning senior stakeholders and specialist teams.

  • Delivering under pressure: Remaining calm, resourceful and solutions-focused while maintaining exceptional standards.

  • Balancing strategy and execution: Seeing the bigger picture while being equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and delivering the details.

  • Staying culturally connected: Bringing curiosity, fresh thinking and an informed perspective on the trends and conversations shaping our industry.

WHAT YOU’LL GET:

For the right candidate, we will offer a competitive salary and benefits package which includes 27 days annual holiday, private healthcare, employer contributory pension, life assurance and income protection. We also offer a host of benefits that support wellbeing including subsidised gym membership, whilst our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion sees us offer learning opportunities around D&I, mentoring programmes and the opportunity for all to participate in a number of active Employee Led Networks and associated events. Finally, this role will be supported with all the necessary personal development required to set someone up for success.
