job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

KVDA Telemundo San Antonio is seeking a Multiplatform Producer to join our award-winning team. The Multiplatform Producer will be responsible for successful coordination and execution of a newscast, other special programs as needed, content for all platforms including apps, social media accounts and streaming channels. This role will report to the Executive Producer.

We’re looking for someone who’s passionate about news, loves breaking news and has a creative vision for crafting live programs. You’ll work closely with managers to create innovative, up-to-the-minute content that resonates with our audiences. The ideal candidate loves to collaborate, wants to help lead a team, and is ready to take on new challenges to help us continue to grow.

Responsibilities

  • Understand and follow all Telemundo San Antonio News and NBC standards and ethics.
  • Responsible for multiple news cast production, content, and elements of the shows.
  • Responsible for being a strong communicator in the newsroom- talking with key stakeholders who will participate or provide content for that newscast (i.e. VP of News, Executive Producer, Managing Editor, anchors, Digital, MMJ's and production crews).
  • Coordinate Live Shots and Satellite Remotes during live newscasts.
  • Select, assign, write, and organize news stories. Write news scripts, headlines, teases and topicals.
  • Contribute story ideas, participate in daily coverage decisions and editorial meetings.
  • Must select stories, understand all the elements, and design a newscast that achieves the daily goal.
  • Knowledgeable on daily news events, awareness of past news events and know what news in the market.
  • Respond to breaking news with urgency and accuracy.
  • Develop special projects involving community and social content.
  • Work with Multimedia Journalists to improve story and presentation.
  • Work closely with VP. Of News, Executive Producer and Managing Editor on story/sweeps planning and coordination.
  • Complete discrepancy reports with detail and accuracy to help prevent future problems and cue sheet.
  • Support Talent with the creation of original digital content.
  • Contribute to the creation of video series for OTT, FAST and all platforms.
  • Understand newscast mission, station priorities and be familiar with all the platforms.
  • Leadership: take responsibility for own actions and take risks for the team and be a team player.
  • Be detail oriented, organized, and able to handle intense deadline pressure.

Basic Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages
  • Minimum of 2 years producer experience
  • 1 year experience with writing and/or editing and/or producing daily video
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or media communication or equivalent experience products

Eligibility Requirements

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must have a valid driver's license
  • Must be available to work overtime, evenings, weekends and holidays as needed or required
  • Must have a flexible schedule with ability to work multiple shift and willingness to travel and work long hours and on weekends and holidays with short notice
  • Must be able to carry or lift 25 lbs.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Leadership qualities
  • Team player mentality
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • Excellent news instincts with the ability to react decisively to breaking news
  • Take an active role in selecting the stories of the day - come up with story ideas that reporters can turn in one day
  • Create producer driven content to enhance our coverage of the big story and other stories that appear in the newscast
  • Anticipate problems and address them throughout the course of the shift, eliminate all factual/spelling/other errors that appear in the show. If a problem arises, address it immediately
  • Ability to resolve conflict
  • Bring creativity into every aspect of the newscast
  • Ability to perform under tight time deadlines
  • Editing skills to edit video clips

Additional Job Requirements

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

job.title: Product Design Internships – Summer 2027
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from New York, NY.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

Media Group: The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.   

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Commerce, Product Design: We are seeking a curious, creative, and motivated Product Design Intern to join our team. This role offers an opportunity to collaborate with experienced designers, participate in design workshops, contribute to our Design System, and gain practical experience in the product design process. The ideal candidate is eager to learn, comfortable exploring new ideas, and interested in translating user needs into thoughtful, intuitive design solutions. With guidance from a senior staff designer, the intern will have the opportunity to take ownership of a design initiative from initial concept through execution, building practical experience and contributing meaningful value to the team.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Currently pursuing or recently pursuing studies in product design, human-centered design, interaction design, UX/UI design, or usability research.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Experience creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, or other design artifacts.
  • Exposure to usability research, user testing, or other user-centered design methods.
  • Interest in exploring the intersection of design and artificial intelligence (AI), including AI-assisted design tools and workflows.
  • Experience with Figma, including creating and editing design files, working with components, and organizing design assets.

The hourly rate for student interns is $30.00.

The Film & TV Studio group is looking for a Product Manager to lead the development and ongoing support of the Studio Distribution Applied AI and Analytics portfolio. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that combines product ownership, solution development, and technical leadership. The role partners directly with business teams to understand operational challenges, rapidly develop and iterate on solutions, and scale successful concepts into reliable production applications.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business & Product Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with Theatrical, Home Entertainment and Global Distribution business teams.
  • Learn how our content is created, marketed, and distributed worldwide and serve as the subject matter expert on the systems and data that enable these processes.
  • Identify opportunities for workflow transformation, serving as a trusted expert on operational workflow and data systems.
  • Translate business needs into working prototypes, gather user feedback, and rapidly iterate toward effective solutions.

Hands-On Solution Development:

  • Design and develop production applications, AI agents, analytics solutions, and automated workflows using technologies such as Python, Snowflake Cortex, LangGraph, Power Apps, and related platforms.
  • Take solutions from initial concept and proof-of-concept through production deployment, operationalization, and ongoing support.
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, and data platform teams to translate repeatable business needs into scalable technical solutions.

Technical Leadership:

  • Lead solution design reviews that promote secure, maintainable, scalable solutions and consistent technical patterns across the portfolio.
  • Champion builder best practices including modular design, automated testing, CI/CD, design reviews, observability, and documentation.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other builders, sharing technical patterns, development best practices, and practical guidance.
  • Leverage observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces) and performance analytics to detect issues proactively and drive fast, data-driven root-cause analysis.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience developing and maintaining medium-to-large-scale products, including experience leading technically complex initiatives.
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience, including hands-on development in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar languages.
  • Experience designing, deploying, and supporting applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD workflows and experience using Git-based repositories, automated testing frameworks, and build pipelines.
  • Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience in writing complex queries involving multi-table joins and advanced analytical functions.
  • Experience building AI-powered workflows using LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or similar tools.
  • Experience driving solutions from initial ideation and proof-of-concept through full-scale deployment.
  • Experience working in fast-paced or ambiguous environments where solutions evolve through rapid prototyping and user feedback.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across business and technical teams and bring together expertise from multiple functional domains to deliver solutions.
  • Strong understanding of product development lifecycles, SDLC practices, and iterative delivery methodologies.
  • Excellent written, oral, and presentation skills with the ability to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field.
  • Experience in the global Media & Entertainment industry.
  • Demonstrated interest in evaluating emerging AI technologies and applying them pragmatically to business problems.

Additional Requirements:

This position has been designated as hybrid, which currently requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from New York, NY.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

Media Group: The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.   

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Peacock Global Delivery: Playback Experience, Platform, & Advertising: The Global Delivery team works across business, product, design, engineering, data, operations, and quality assurance to support the delivery of product and technology capabilities for Peacock and other global direct-to-consumer applications. In this role, you will support Project and Program Managers working across Playback Experience, Playback Platform, and Advertising. These areas shape how audiences watch live and on-demand content, interact with the video player, experience advertising, and receive reliable playback across devices. You will gain exposure to the software development lifecycle and contribute to initiatives involving streaming, player experiences, accessibility, advertising, platform services, metadata, analytics, and playback performance. You will work with cross-functional teams and learn how technology initiatives progress from early planning through delivery.
  • Global Delivery, Portfolio Operations: The Project Coordinator Intern will provide project coordination and administrative support to the Portfolio Operations team within Global Delivery. The Portfolio Operations team partners closely with cross‑functional groups across the NBCUniversal Global Streaming organization to support the planning, coordination, and execution of new features and platform enhancements. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated self‑starter with strong organizational and time management skills, a willingness to learn, and the ability to adapt quickly to new tools and processes. This role offers hands‑on exposure to project management, administration and implementation of solutions using various SaaS tools, and delivery initiatives within a fast‑paced streaming environment. 
  • Technology Delivery, Project Management: The Project Management Intern, Technology Delivery, will support initiatives that enable content publication, metadata management, and operational tooling across NBCUniversal streaming products and technical systems. The intern will gain hands-on experience working with Content & Metadata Program Leads and cross-functional partners across Editorial, Operations, Product, Development, and QA to support project delivery, metadata quality, and continuous process improvement. This role provides a unique opportunity to learn how content, metadata, and technology platforms come together to power streaming experiences while developing foundational project management and technology delivery skills.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Interest in streaming media, digital products, advertising technology, application development, or project and program management.
  • Familiarity with, or willingness to learn, project and collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Airtable, Slack, and Microsoft 365.
  • Basic familiarity with Agile delivery, project planning, data analysis, or the software development lifecycle is helpful but not required.
  • Familiarity with generative AI or AI-enabled productivity tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, and an interest in using them responsibly.
  • An analytical mindset and willingness to use data and operational information to support problem-solving and decision-making.
  • Interest in project management methodologies and operational delivery models.
  • Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira and Confluence) for reporting, documentation, and site administration a plus. 
  • Familiarity with using Chat-based LLM’s for generating code.
  • Experience in a coding language such as Python or SQL is a plus. 
  • Interest in technology delivery, metadata management, content operations, streaming products, and digital experiences.

The hourly rate for student interns is $30.00.

job.title: Program Management & Operations Internships – Summer 2027
job.description:
Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 
  • At our Universal City office interns will have access to the NBCUCommutes program, which provides fully subsidized transit passes to full-time lower lot employees, good for unlimited rides on all Metro bus and rail, such as the Metro Red Line.

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Universal City, CA.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

Operations & Technology: O&T functions as a global shared service within NBCUniversal performing critical functions including Media, Broadcast and Studio Operations & Production, Content Supply Chain, Information Technology and Engineering, as well as Cyber Security. The group operates from numerous locations around the world, including New York, New Jersey, Los Angeles, Connecticut, and London. 

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • West Coast Studio Ops, SO Facilities - Emergency Services: NBCUniversal Emergency Services supports the safety, preparedness, and operational resilience of our employees, facilities, and business operations. Within Emergency Services, the Disaster Preparedness team develops and coordinates emergency response programs, employee training, evacuation exercises, and partnerships with local public safety agencies. The Summer Intern will gain hands-on exposure to corporate emergency management through participation in our Public Agency Orientation Program, which brings together fire, law enforcement, emergency medical services, and other municipal partners to discuss emergency response capabilities, resource requirements, and coordination during major incidents. The intern will also support the launch of our 2027 Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) training program, building evacuation initiatives, and emergency equipment readiness programs.

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Currently pursuing a degree/interest in Emergency Management, Homeland Security, Public Safety, Fire Science, Criminal Justice, Public Administration, Occupational Safety, or a related discipline.
  • Foundational knowledge of emergency preparedness, Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) principles, emergency services operations, or the Incident Command System (ICS). Previous CERT participation or completion of FEMA independent study courses is highly desirable.
  • Basic understanding of CPR, AED operation, First Aid, and emergency response procedures. Current CPR/First Aid certification is preferred but not required.

job.description:

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. The Producer/Reporter will generate original story ideas, cultivate sources, conduct interviews, and produce and present assigned stories and segments. Working closely with the Executive Producer, Line Producer, assignment editors, photographers, and other newsroom staff, this individual will contribute to the editorial direction and overall execution of Al Rojo Vivo.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate, pitch, research, and develop a wide variety of compelling story ideas that reflect the interests and needs of our viewers.
  • Actively participate in daily editorial meetings, presenting story pitches, identifying emerging news angles, and contributing to coverage planning.
  • Gather, investigate, and verify information through interviews, observation, research, and other reporting methods.
  • Research, write, produce, field-produce, edit, and present fair, accurate, and engaging news and feature stories for broadcast, digital, and mobile platforms.
  • Develop enterprise, exclusive, and original content that adds depth and perspective to coverage.
  • Independently research and develop assigned segments, working under the guidance of the Line Producer, General Producer, and/or Executive Producer.
  • Write compelling scripts, headlines, teases, and promotional copy that engage viewers and support the overall editorial vision of the show.
  • Collaborate with producers, photographers, editors, and other newsroom personnel to conceptualize, write, shoot, and produce stories.
  • Coordinate with Graphics, Technical Operations, Satellite Operations, the video library, and other departments to secure and track production elements and requests.
  • Assist the Line Producer with the production and execution of the show during and after tapings, including overseeing editorial elements and coordinating necessary content.
  • Communicate regularly with news producers, assignment editors, and newsroom managers regarding story development, field progress, breaking news, and production needs.
  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages. 
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Television Production or an equivalent combination of education and experience 
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Journalism, or related field 
  • Knowledge of iNews and Media Central 

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be 18 years or greater.  
  • Candidates must submit a resume/CV via www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in Los Angeles, CA
  • Must be able to perform job at locations in and outside work environment with varying weather conditions  

Desired Characteristics

  • Passionate about news/entertainment 
  • Energetic, and creative team player 
  • Creative, highly organized and detail oriented 
  • Strong interpersonal & Leadership skills 
  • Proactive thinker/self-starter 
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and successfully manage multiple assignments 

Additional Requirements

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite in Los Angeles, CA.

NBCUniversal Telemundo’s social media marketing team is seeking a Senior Analyst, Social Analytics & Listening to help measure and optimize social media campaigns and always-on social properties. In this role, you will use platform analytics, social listening, sentiment analysis, and audience insights to turn complex performance data and audience conversations into clear, actionable recommendations for internal partners. 

You will work across shows, franchises, brand initiatives, live events, campaigns, and other social properties. You will balance quantitative reporting with qualitative analysis to explain what audiences are saying, sharing, and responding to across social platforms.

Role Responsibilities 

  • Analyze performance across owned social platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Threads, and additional relevant channels. 
  • Track and report social metrics for campaigns, launches, live events, tentpole moments, talent initiatives, and always-on properties. 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, recurring reporting templates, and campaign wrap reports. 
  • Measure performance against objectives, historical benchmarks, platform benchmarks, and campaign KPIs. 
  • Analyze results by platform, content format, show, campaign, talent, creative theme, audience segment, publishing cadence, and organic support, where applicable. 
  • Identify the drivers of strong and weak performance and provide concrete recommendations to improve future content and campaign results. 
  • Conduct data quality checks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all reports. 
  • Develop property-specific benchmarks and performance narratives that help teams understand growth over time. 
  • Deliver mid-campaign performance reports that identify opportunities for real-time optimization. 
  • Own weekly and full recap performance reporting for assigned properties, including show accounts, brand accounts, franchises, talent-related properties, and other designated social channels. 
  • Partner with Social Creative teams to recommend changes to content, platform strategy, timing, and audience engagement. 
  • Create, maintain, and optimize social listening queries for shows, campaigns, cast, talent, brand initiatives, events, hashtags, and relevant cultural conversations. 
  • Monitor conversation volume, sentiment, net sentiment, key topics, fan reactions, audience questions, hashtags, emojis, keywords, emerging narratives, and viral moments. 
  • Analyze both quantitative social-listening data and qualitative fan commentary to understand why audiences are responding positively, negatively, or neutrally. 
  • Monitor sentiment changes before, during, and after major campaigns, episodes, premieres, finales, talent moments, and live events. 
  • Identify potential reputational issues, misinformation, recurring complaints, sensitive themes, and escalation-worthy conversations. 
  • Surface positive advocacy, fan-generated content, creator activity, and talent-related opportunities that can be amplified by the broader social team. 
  • Conduct competitive, industry, and cultural benchmarking as needed. 
  • Partner closely with Social Creative, Community Management, Production, Marketing, Production, Paid Media, and other relevant stakeholders. 
  • Participate in campaign planning, content planning, performance readouts, and post-mortem discussions. 
  • Work with Community Management to identify recurring fan feedback, sentiment issues, questions, and engagement opportunities. 

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, Social Sciences, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field. 
  • 5+ years of experience in social analytics, digital analytics, marketing research, social listening, audience insights, campaign measurement, or a related area. 
  • Demonstrated experience developing social media reports, dashboards, campaign recaps, and actionable insights. 
  • Strong knowledge of social platform metrics, content performance, audience behavior, social-media measurement, and reporting best practices. 
  • Experience using social listening tools, including building Boolean queries, developing keyword taxonomies, monitoring sentiment, and analyzing online conversations. 
  • Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Sprout Social, ListenFirst, Pickaxe, Comscore Social, Meta Business, TikTok Studio, and Talkwalker. 
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, data cleaning, formulas, lookups, charts, and reporting automation. 
  • Professional fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to analyze and communicate audience insights across bilingual and multicultural communities. 
  • Strong written, visual, and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple reporting deadlines, campaigns, stakeholders, and priority changes in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Strong attention to detail, quality control, curiosity, organization, and problem-solving skills. 

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience in entertainment, television, streaming, news, sports, consumer media, or a fandom-driven industry. 
  • Familiarity with U.S. Hispanic audiences and bilingual social behavior. 
  • Experience with Sproutsocial, Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Meltwater, Synthesio, or similar social intelligence platforms. 
  • Experience measuring paid social campaigns or working with performance marketing teams. 
  • Experience analyzing live-event social conversation, talent engagement, awards shows, premieres, finales, or major cultural moments. 

Additional Requirements

  • This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

The Senior Data Engineer, Data Mgmt and BI will design, build, and support scalable data solutions that enable trusted analytics, operational reporting, and data-driven decision making across the organization. This role will partner closely with product, analytics, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous business needs into reliable technical solutions, while helping establish strong engineering standards across data pipelines, cloud platforms, data models, APIs, automation, and observability. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can work independently, mentor others, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners, and continuously improve how data is delivered, governed, tested, and supported in a fast-moving environment. 

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and publish structured and semi-structured data from internal and external sources. 
  • Translate business and product requirements into technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and execution plans that support reliable analytics and operational workflows. 
  • Develop reusable, maintainable code using modern data engineering practices, with an emphasis on performance, testability, observability, and long-term supportability. 
  • Build and optimize batch, event-driven, and serverless data processing patterns using cloud-native services and distributed processing frameworks. 
  • Contribute to architecture decisions across data lake, warehouse, orchestration, metadata, API, and application integration patterns. 
  • Implement data quality checks, monitoring, alerting, and operational runbooks to ensure pipelines are accurate, reliable, and supportable in production. 
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment workflows, and infrastructure-as-code patterns that improve delivery speed and reduce operational risk. 
  • Partner with analytics, BI, product, and business teams to enable timely, trusted, and well-documented data products and reporting solutions. 
  • Evaluate source systems, APIs, files, data contracts, and transformation logic to identify risks, dependencies, data gaps, and opportunities for simplification. 
  • Participate in Agile delivery practices including sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, release planning, incident response, and retrospectives. 
  • Mentor engineers, promote engineering best practices, and help raise the quality bar for code, documentation, testing, and production readiness. 
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, data lineage notes, implementation guides, and support materials as systems evolve. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience designing, building, testing, deploying, and supporting production data pipelines. 
  • Strong experience with data modeling, data architecture, ETL/ELT patterns, metadata, data quality, and data warehouse or data lake methodologies. 
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data engineering services such as AWS S3, Lambda, Athena, EMR or EMR Serverless, Glue, Step Functions, SNS, SQS, or comparable technologies. 
  • Strong programming experience in Scala, Java, SQL, or similar languages used for data processing, automation, and integration. 
  • Experience with distributed processing and modern data platforms such as Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, Hive, Redshift, Postgres, SingleStore, or comparable technologies. 
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, automated testing, and deployment practices using GitHub Actions or similar tools. 
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevOps practices, incident response, production support, monitoring, and performance tuning. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex data, application, and platform issues. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, and leadership. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Experience working in media, advertising, streaming, analytics, or other data-intensive business environments. 
  • Experience building pipelines that integrate files, APIs, event streams, relational systems, data lakes, and warehouse platforms. 
  • Experience with orchestration and workflow tools such as Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Amazon MWAA, or similar platforms. 
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, cloud security, IAM, secrets management, and secure engineering practices. 
  • Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Tableau, MicroStrategy, Looker, or similar tools. 
  • Experience designing performant data models, curated datasets, APIs, or interfaces that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision making. 
  • Familiarity with data governance, lineage, observability, data contracts, and production support practices. 
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous situations, drive clarity, identify dependencies, and move work from concept through delivery. 
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to balance delivery speed, engineering quality, stakeholder communication, and operational readiness. 
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, analytics, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders. 
  • Curiosity about emerging data engineering, automation, and AI-assisted development practices, with a practical focus on improving engineering productivity and solution quality.

The Senior Development QA Tester partners directly with designers, engineers, and artists to test features throughout the development cycle. You’ll validate functionality, identify issues early, analyze root causes, and help maintain build stability. You will collaborate closely with developers, review requirements, and use tools to perform functional, regression, and performance tests, ensuring software is reliable, secure, and user-friendly.

  • Test new features during development and provide clear, actionable feedback to developers.
  • Identify, reproduce, and document bugs with detailed steps, logs, and supporting evidence.
  • Analyze issues to determine severity, patterns, and potential root causes.
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to understand feature intentions, edge cases, and technical constraints.
  • Verify bug fixes and ensure regressions are caught early.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and checklists for ongoing features.
  • Support integration testing when new systems, builds, or content are merged.
  • Participate in daily stand‑ups, feature reviews, and sprint planning to stay aligned with development progress.
  • Use debugging tools, logs, and engine features to investigate issues more deeply.
  • Provide feedback on usability, clarity, and player experience from a QA perspective.
  • Help maintain build stability by identifying blockers quickly and communicating them effectively.

RESPONSABILITÉS

La personne responsable des tests QA senior en développement travaille directement avec les équipes de conception, d’ingénierie et d’art afin de tester les fonctionnalités tout au long du cycle de développement. Vous validerez les fonctionnalités, repérerez rapidement les problèmes, analyserez leurs causes fondamentales et contribuerez à maintenir la stabilité des builds. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, examinerez les exigences et utiliserez différents outils pour effectuer des tests fonctionnels, de régression et de performance afin de garantir que le logiciel est fiable, sécuritaire et convivial.

  • Tester les nouvelles fonctionnalités pendant le développement et fournir aux équipes de développement une rétroaction claire et exploitable.
  • Repérer, reproduire et documenter les bogues en fournissant des étapes détaillées, des logs et des éléments probants à l’appui.
  • Analyser les problèmes afin d’en déterminer la gravité, les tendances et les causes fondamentales potentielles.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie et de conception afin de comprendre les objectifs des fonctionnalités, les cas limites et les contraintes techniques.
  • Vérifier les correctifs de bogues et veiller à ce que les régressions soient détectées rapidement.
  • Créer et tenir à jour des plans de test, des cas de test et des listes de vérification pour les fonctionnalités en cours de développement.
  • Soutenir les tests d’intégration lorsque de nouveaux systèmes, builds ou contenus sont fusionnés.
  • Participer aux réunions quotidiennes, aux revues de fonctionnalités et à la planification des sprints afin de rester au fait de l’avancement du développement.
  • Utiliser des outils de débogage, des logs et les fonctionnalités des moteurs de jeu afin d’analyser les problèmes plus en profondeur.
  • Fournir une rétroaction sur la convivialité, la clarté et l’expérience des joueurs du point de vue de l’assurance qualité.
  • Contribuer à maintenir la stabilité des builds en repérant rapidement les blocages et en les communiquant efficacement.

Basic Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (QA), software testing, or a related testing role, preferably within game development.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Selenium, Jira, SQL, or scripting languages.
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycles (SDLC) and debugging tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to simulate real-world user scenarios.
  • Strong understanding of game development workflows and common tools (Unity, Unreal, or proprietary engines).
  • Ability to write clear, concise, and reproducible bug reports.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with developers.
  • Ability to stay organized and detail‑oriented in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Passion for games and curiosity about how systems and features are built.

Exigences de base :

  • 4 ans ou plus d’expérience en assurance qualité (QA), en tests logiciels ou dans un rôle connexe en matière de tests, de préférence dans le domaine du développement de jeux.
  • Familiarité avec des outils tels que Selenium, Jira, SQL ou des langages de script.
  • Connaissance des cycles de développement logiciel (SDLC) et des outils de débogage.
  • Grand souci du détail et capacité à simuler des scénarios d’utilisation réels.
  • Solide compréhension des processus de développement de jeux et des outils couramment utilisés (Unity, Unreal ou moteurs propriétaires).
  • Capacité à rédiger des rapports de bogues clairs, concis et reproductibles.
  • Solides compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et aisance à travailler directement avec les équipes de développement.
  • Capacité à rester organisé et à faire preuve de minutie dans un environnement au rythme soutenu.
  • Passion pour les jeux et curiosité à l’égard de la façon dont les systèmes et les fonctionnalités sont conçus.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience with console certification requirements or platform‑specific testing.
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Perforce, Git).
  • Experience in embedded QA, feature‑focused QA, or Dev QA roles.

Caractéristiques souhaitées :

  • Expérience des exigences de certification des consoles ou des tests propres à une plateforme.
  • Connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de versions (Perforce, Git).
  • Expérience dans des rôles de QA intégrée, de QA axée sur les fonctionnalités ou de Dev QA.

 Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Conditions d’admissibilité :

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être prises en considération.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à travailler à notre bureau de Montréal au moins 4 jours par semaine.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à faire des heures supplémentaires lorsque requis, conformément aux normes du travail du Québec.
  • La personne retenue doit être légalement autorisée à travailler au Canada.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à voyager pour des raisons professionnelles, au besoin.

The Senior Director, Digital Advertising & Partnerships will lead NBCUniversal's digital advertising monetization strategy across Latin America, driving revenue growth through CTV, streaming, programmatic, and emerging digital advertising solutions. This leader will oversee commercial strategy, partnerships, revenue operations, inventory optimization, and digital transformation initiatives while collaborating across sales, finance, product, content, and technology teams to maximize business performance. We’re looking for an exceptional, results-oriented individual who uniquely combines the interpersonal skills to act as a primary liaison between NBCU and our new, established, and emerging partners with the quantitative skills to analyze and grow the business.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Revenue Growth & Monetization

  • Develop and execute digital revenue strategies across LATAM markets.
  • Deliver against digital advertising revenue goals and growth targets.
  • Identify new monetization opportunities across streaming, CTV, and digital platforms.
  • Lead commercial negotiations and strategic partnership development.

Digital Strategy & Product Collaboration

  • Partner with Product and Technology teams to shape the digital advertising roadmap.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and market opportunities.
  • Champion new advertising capabilities and monetization products.

Revenue Operations & Inventory Management

  • Own digital inventory strategy, yield optimization, and revenue management.
  • Lead forecasting, budgeting, KPI reporting, and long-range planning activities.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve operational efficiency and revenue performance.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the key liaison between Sales, Finance, Insights, Traffic, Operations, Product, and Technology teams.
  • Drive alignment across stakeholders to ensure successful execution of business initiatives.

Talent Development & Change Leadership

  • Build, coach, and develop a high-performing team.
  • Lead digital capability-building efforts across the organization.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

BASIC REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in in digital media, advertising sales, ad technology, streaming, or related industries.or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Deep expertise in CTV, OTT, AVOD, FAST, and streaming monetization models.
  • Understanding of audience targeting, attribution, measurement, and identity solutions.
  • Expertise in programmatic advertising ecosystems, including DSPs, SSPs, private marketplaces, yield management, and ad-tech partnerships.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and lead through a matrixed organization.
  • Experience managing forecasting, annual operating plans, long-range planning, and revenue modeling.
  • Understanding of platforms and technologies that support digital content distribution and monetization (e.g. OTT, mobile, DAI, ad serving, measurement, etc.)
  • Uniquely combine quantitative skills needed to analyze the business with interpersonal skills needed to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Direct experience and high comfort level performing real-time business analysis and execution of priority initiatives.
  • Experience in and understanding of the Latin America market.
  • Passion for simplifying complex concepts, defining value propositions, and championing the voice of advertising sales.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive self-starter with the ability to thrive in an ambiguous, fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
  • Strong track record of cultivating relationships.
  • Keen attention to accuracy and detail.
  • Systems and tools: Demonstrate an understanding of key ad sales, planning and financial systems (e.g. CRM, NBCU Internal budgeting systems) and tools.

Platform Distribution and Partnerships is a division of NBCUniversal's media group responsible for the distribution and monetization of the company’s multi-billion-dollar linear and streaming services portfolio to pay-tv providers, NBC broadcast affiliates, consumer technology platforms and devices, and consumer brands. A key revenue-generator, the division is comprised of content distribution, affiliate relations, and strategic partnerships across NBC, Peacock, Bravo, Telemundo, and various FAST channels.

The Senior Director, Platform Distribution & Partnerships will report to the Senior Vice President, Platform Distribution & Partnerships and lead a team responsible for managing and growing v/MVPD, Peacock and FAST distribution. This role oversees the negotiation, execution, and ongoing management of distribution agreements across major v/MVPD, Peacock and FAST partners for NBCU’s portfolio of media assets. The Senior Director will drive strategic partner initiatives from incubation through implementation, ensuring strong execution and alignment with business objectives. This is a highly cross-functional role with touchpoints across Marketing, Product, Technology, Legal, Finance, Decision Sciences, Ad Sales, and Operations, requiring deep collaboration to maximize partner impact and optimize distribution strategies.

  • Develop and implement comprehensive partnership strategies to drive subscriber acquisition, engagement, and revenue growth for NBCU’s suite of products.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with distribution partners, serving as a key point of contact to align on mutual goals, drive execution, and resolve challenges.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal stakeholders – including marketing, product, content, finance, and legal – to support partnership initiatives, ensure operational excellence, and deliver on key business objectives.
  • Analyze market trends, competitive dynamics, and platform performance to identify new growth opportunities, refine strategies, and inform decision-making.
  • Structure, model, and evaluate partnership agreements to optimize terms and drive measurable business impact, balancing short-term objectives with long-term strategic positioning.
  • Act as a thought leader within the organization, influencing internal stakeholders and advocating for innovative distribution approaches to maximize reach and engagement.
  • Represent NBCUniversal at external meetings, industry events, and partner engagements, reinforcing the company’s position as a leader in media distribution.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Senior Director, Programmatic Strategy will report to the VP, Programmatic Strategy, owning strategy development, partnership relationship management, and business analysis for Programmatic supply. You be responsible for supply health and signal audits and product vetting to maximize programmatic fill and revenue.

As CTV transforms to a performance media vehicle and NBCUniversal’s advertising sales business shifts toward more automated, data-driven ways of transacting with strategic first-party audiences at its core, the opportunity to launch and scale partnerships and monetization with live sports and device partnerships is accelerating.

You will represent priorities future-proofing NBCUniversal’s advertising business while maintaining distribution agreements with streaming device platforms, working closely with stakeholders across the entire Ad Sales division.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the strategy and business plan for addressability and supply health for all programmatic supply and endpoints
  • Cross-functional stakeholder alignment for Programmatic supply workstreams across Product, Operations, Planning, Marketing, Sales and other relevant teams.
  • Analyze programmatic supply performance and build dashboard/products with DSP and SSP partners, and internal BI team
  • Set prioritization for the programmatic product roadmap to explore and expand addressability and signaling products, including upside analysis and post mortems
  • Day-to-day contact for supply partners, managing communication around performance, possible troubleshooting, and/or progress of new initiatives
  • Assist in structuring partnership frameworks and deal terms alongside internal Business Development leads inclusive of revenue and product development goals.
  • Manage onboarding and commercialization process of new distribution partnerships and integrations across CTV, desktop and/or mobile
  • Diagnose supply health and sell through across all subsets of supply (genre, rating, mobile, etc) and identify opportunities
  • Clearly communicate partnership status updates to executive leadership.
  • Ensure partners adhere to contractual requirements and uniformity within NBCU’s programmatic technology offering.
  • Stay abreast to new developments within the broader media and advertising technology industry and within NBCUniversal’s ad tech ecosystem.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years’ experience directly working in retail media, programmatic, or advanced advertising at a leading corporation, agency, technology platform and/or management consulting firm.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support the daily financial operations for the NBCUniversal Local Television stations serving Orlando, Tampa and Fort Myers.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, this role serves as a key finance partner supporting financial planning, analysis, forecasting, reporting, month-end close and operational finance activities. The Senior Financial Analyst will play an integral role in maintaining financial accuracy, supporting budget oversight, and providing timely analysis and insights that drive informed business decisions.

Responsibilities:

The primary responsibilities of this role include, but are not limited to:

  • Support monthly close activities including journal entries (accruals and reclasses), variance analysis, AP processes, etc.
  • Build, maintain, and analyze financial forecasts, budgets, and estimates.
  • Monitor actual versus budgeted spend, identify risks and opportunities, and provide actionable insights to finance and operational leadership.
  •  Prepare consolidated close reporting packages, variance analyses, overtime and T&E reporting for station management.
  • Support capital planning and reporting, including project pacing, variance analysis, project close-outs, and coordination with operating partners.
  • Serve as the primary finance contact for accounts payable activities including vendor onboarding, vendor maintenance, payment processing, and invoice management.
  • Serve as a day-to-day finance liaison with local operations team including department heads to provide financial support, insights, performance tracking, and decision-making assistance.
  • Support ad-hoc financial analysis, special projects, process improvements, and automation initiatives that enhance reporting efficiency and financial transparency.
  • Maintain compliance with company policies, financial controls, and accounting standards while ensuring accuracy of financial records and supporting documentation.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • 2+ years of finance experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; strong proficiency with MS Office Suite products.
  • Experience using financial/accounting software and applications (SAP and BPC preferred).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities across markets.
  • Clear and effective communication skills with ability to present complex data to non-financial stakeholders.

Desired Characteristics

  • Ability to quickly reassess priorities and adapt as required.
  • Demonstrated interpersonal & leadership skills; ability to effectively interact with individuals at all levels of the organization.
  • Solid business partnering skills and ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Pioneering spirit – continuously seeking and implementing best practices.
  • Excellent time management skills, with deadline orientation.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail oriented and self-starter; can work independently and take initiative in challenging situations.
  • Work experience in Media, Entertainment or Advertising industry desirable.
  • Spanish-language proficiency is preferred.
  • Must be willing and able to work flexible hours as needed to support business requirements, deadlines, and key financial deliverables

NBCUniversal is seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in SAP SuccessFactors Core, SAP HCM, ABAP, and SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI). This is a key role in NBCUniversal's HR technology transformation and is responsible for technical solution design, technical specifications, development leadership, governance, and quality assurance across enterprise HR technology initiatives 

The successful candidate will serve as the technical lead for SuccessFactors and SAP integrations, partnering with Product Managers, Functional Consultants, Architects, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into detailed technical designs. The role will lead ABAP and BTP development teams, review completed builds against approved specifications, validate technical unit test evidence, and coordinate Center of Excellence (COE) review and approval.

  • Lead the technical design and delivery for SAP SuccessFactors Talent modules. 
  • Translate business requirements into solution architecture, technical designs, integrations, and RICEF specifications. 
  • Lead the design, development, and support of integrations using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI), APIs, and middleware technologies. 
  • Lead SAP BTP, ABAP, and integration development teams, including vendors and offshore resources. 
  • Facilitate architecture reviews, governance approvals, and design checkpoints. 
  • Coordinate testing, deployments, cutover, production support, and incident resolution. 
  • Mentor engineers and drive SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BTP best practices. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience; or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 
  • Experience developing technical designs, integration specifications, and RICEF specifications. 
  • Strong technical and functional expertise in SAP SuccessFactors Talent Management, including Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning, Compensation, and Performance & Goals. 
  • Hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting integrations using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI), including API, file-based, and middleware integrations leveraging OData, Compound Employee API, REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, and SFTP. 
  • Experience developing and extending cloud applications using SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP). 
  • Experience conducting technical reviews and ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture, governance, and development standards. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

Desired Characteristics

  • SAP Integration Suite (CPI) certification preferred. 
  • Certification in two or more SAP SuccessFactors Talent modules, including Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning, Compensation, or Performance & Goals. 
  • Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), including Cloud Foundry, API Management, Cloud Connector, Event Mesh, Build, Work Zone, Cloud ALM, SAP Joule, and ABAP Cloud. 
  • Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Signavio, and SAP Fieldglass.   
  • 2+ years of experience integrating SAP SuccessFactors with SAP HCM, Employee Central Payroll (ECP), SAP S/4HANA, SmartRecruiters, Onboarding, and other third-party applications. 
  • Preferred to have experience with at least one SmartRecruiters implementation. 
  • Experience supporting large-scale HR transformation and SAP SuccessFactors implementation programs. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive technical decisions in complex enterprise environments 
  • Media and entertainment industry experience is desired.

  • Experience managing engagement, moderation, and real-time conversations across social platforms.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Sprout, Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Talkwalker, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of entertainment, pop culture, fandoms, and U.S. Hispanic audiences.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the VOD Engineering team, responsible for building and evolving large-scale media processing systems. This is a high-impact, hands-on role focused on designing, building, and operating distributed systems that power the ingestion, processing, and delivery of video content at scale.

We are looking for someone who is not afraid to take ownership, proactively identify improvements, and build systems that are reliable, performant, and scalable in real-world conditions.

What the team does

  • The VOD Engineering team builds E2E video on demand solutions
  • The VOD team is responsible for the automated media pipeline delivering content to NBCU’s streaming platforms including Peacock.
  • Troubleshoots issues arising in the VOD pipeline.
  • Configures encoding of video, audio and subtitles for delivery across various platforms/devices.
  • Research new technologies in the media space and conduct POCs.
  • Collaborates with Operations, player and client teams to drive innovation and improvements in video delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and continuously improve scalable media pipelines for processing, transforming, and delivering large-volume media content.
  • Implement and productionize core algorithms for media analysis, computer vision, or machine learning workloads where they can materially improve the platform.
  • Build distributed systems and services that raise the bar on reliability, performance, observability, and operational scale.
  • Partner across engineering and product to identify problems and opportunities early, then turn them into technical design, milestones, and execution plans.
  • Bring a builder’s mindset to day-to-day engineering, using strong judgment, modern tooling, and pragmatic execution to move systems forward.

Required Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience building, operating, and improving media pipelines at scale
  • Experience designing, deploying, and evolving distributed systems in production
  • Fluency in Python, plus proficiency in Go, C++, and/or Rust
  • Experience with performance optimization, observability, and reliability engineering for large-scale platforms
  • Experience working with Unix-based environments, source control, and production software development workflows
  • Ownership mindset, with the ability to identify problems, drive solutions, and turn business needs into scalable technical systems
  • Comfort working in agent-assisted development workflows, using AI tools to accelerate implementation, iterate on solutions, and produce production-quality pull requests

Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field
  • Min 2 years of experience in engineering, software architecture and design
  • Familiarity with video compression concepts, including inter-frame encoding concepts
  • Familiarity with container, transport, and multiplexing formats used in media workflows, plus exposure to FFmpeg, x264, and x265
  • Experience with machine learning, computer vision, or media analysis systems
  • Experience with open-source projects, experimentation, and pushing systems beyond the obvious solution
