Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from New York, NY.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

NBC News: More Americans watch NBC News than any news organization in the world. NBC News’ leading and award-winning television news broadcasts include TODAY, NBC Nightly News, Meet the Press, and Dateline NBC. The rapidly-growing NBC News Digital Group – including its streaming news services NBC News NOW and TODAY All Day – and the network’s award-winning original podcast and audio unit provide continuous content to consumers wherever they are, whenever they want it. 

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • NBC News Mobile App Development: The team is responsible for designing, developing and testing NBC News’s flagship Android/iOS applications. The intern will be working on native mobile applications across all the NBC News brands and collaborate with developers, product and project management in shipping out features. The intern will be mentored by senior developers in the team and will be guided in their work. The intern will be working on various team initiatives following engineering best practices and writing quality code.
  • NBC News Digital, Software Engineering: As a Software Engineer Intern, you will partner with the Product, Operations, Design, and Editorial teams to bring NBC News Digital content to life. You will be a significant influence on our product roadmap, bringing a technical and strategic perspective. You will work alongside fellow inspired developers in a fast-paced environment using technologies like Sass, React.js and GraphQL to help shape the future of digital news.

 

Media Group: The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.   

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Global Video Engineering, Video-On-Demand SRE: The Jupiter SRE Team is a SRE Team that is embedded as part of the Video on Demand (VOD) team in the Global Video Engineering Group. The VOD team is a mix of software engineers and video engineers, that define and maintain the VOD workflow (The Path a piece of content follows to get on to the streaming Platform).  The SRE Team is responsible for deploying and maintaining availability of all Infrastructure and applications that are part of this workflow. Currently the VOD team uses a mixture of vendor and in house-built applications to implement this workflow. However, we are in the middle of an exciting transition bringing many of these workflows in-house and therefore this internship is an exciting opportunity to get real world exposure to all the work necessary to get content ready for streaming.
  • Global Delivery, Quality Engineering: Our Global Quality Engineering Team is responsible for broad scale of quality by testing integrated systems and the client applications focused on delivering flawless experience for our customers. Our teams analyse requirements, create test plans and perform feature testing for Peacock & all of its propositions which includes backend integration of components and application front end across all the major device platforms. Our goal is to educate the interns on Software Development Life Cycle and importance of Software Quality Assurance.
  • Video-On-Demand Engineering, Workflows: The VOD Engineering team is hiring a summer intern to join the VOD Workflows team, which builds and supports the automated media pipeline that delivers video-on-demand (VOD) content to NBCUniversal’s streaming platforms. The intern will work with engineers on business-critical video workflows and cloud services. They will gain exposure to how the team troubleshoots VOD workflows and playback and configures encoding for video, audio, and subtitles across platforms. Day to day, the work is scoped and guided: contributing to the pipeline, learning how media-processing and cloud delivery systems are operated, and helping improve them.
  • Peacock, Live, Play, and DAI: Global Video Engineering’s Live, Play, and DAI group builds and runs the systems behind Peacock’s live events, video playback, and direct ad insertion. These are the paths viewers hit when they watch a live game, press play, and see an ad. The work is user-facing and revenue-critical, and it has to stay up while millions of people are watching at once. The group is organized as product engineering teams with embedded Site Reliability Engineers. Live covers event orchestration, encoding, and distribution. Play covers playback, and the services that get a stream to the device. DAI covers ad decisioning and inserting ads into live and on-demand video. SREs sit with those teams and own reliability across the stack: AWS, Kubernetes, networking, the application, and the telemetry that shows whether it is healthy. An intern will work with engineers who ship code and operate what they ship. They see how a live event is prepared and run, how an ad decision becomes a break in the stream, and how playback failures show up in metrics, logs, and traces. They will contribute to real systems with a focus on improving reliability, performance, observability, and automation that removes repetitive operational work.
  • Global Streaming Tech, Live Play & DAI: Our Backend Video Engineering team builds and maintains the technology that powers video content and advertising delivery across NBCUniversal’s digital platforms. The team develops scalable backend services and APIs using Go (Golang), helping ensure reliable and efficient video experiences for audiences. Interns will gain hands-on exposure to backend software engineering while collaborating with experienced engineers and learning how large-scale video systems are designed, developed, tested, and maintained.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Infrastructure as Code – Exposure to CloudFormation or Terraform etc.
  • Proficiency with Python and/or Go, JavaScript, Java or related programming languages.
  • Basic AI Knowledge – Exposure to generating Code and Docs with LLMs management tools.
  • Knowledge or experience in testing Mobile applications on both Android and iOS platforms.
  • Knowledge or experience working in an Agile development environment.
  • Knowledge or experience in Automation and GenAI.
  • Exposure to cloud systems, particularly AWS, or to workflow, ETL, or data-pipeline concepts, Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Git and a CI system, and comfort reading an existing codebase before changing it.
  • Exposure to observability (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar) or to debugging with logs and metrics.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and basic networking (DNS, HTTP, load balancers, TLS).
  • Interest in video streaming, advertising technology, or large-scale distributed systems.
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, and Git.

The hourly rate for student interns is $30.00 for roles within Media Group.

The hourly rate for student interns is $40.00 for roles within News Group.

job.title: Specialist, Marketing Strategy
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Integrated Sales Marketing Specialist supports NBCU Local's NY business development and sales-marketing initiatives, developing strategic sales proposals, client-specific materials, sponsorship programs, and creative marketing solutions that address advertiser needs and advance campaign objectives within a collaborative team of media professionals. 

This role manages projects from concept through production, approval, execution, and recap, ensuring accurate, efficient, and timely delivery. The Specialist serves as a key liaison among Sales, Sales Management, Creative Services, Production, Research, Content, and other internal partners. 

The ideal candidate is a strategic and creative thinker with impeccable attention to detail, strong communication and relationship-management skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. This individual should demonstrate initiative, sound judgment, resourcefulness, and a commitment to developing effective solutions for both internal and external clients. 

Responsibilities 

  • Partner with the Sales team to create external communications, proposals, and category- and brand-specific materials that highlight the value and capabilities of the NBCU Local portfolio. 

  • Respond to client and brand briefs by developing comprehensive business cases, customized marketing solutions, and media-plan recommendations that align with advertiser objectives. 

  • Serve as a primary liaison among Sales, Sales Management, Creative Services, and Production for local sales sponsorships, including weather, traffic, sports, and other recurring or custom opportunities. 

  • Manage sponsorship production from kickoff through recap, coordinating communications, assets, production, internal and client approvals, and on-air execution. 

  • Deliver accurate, organized, and timely proof-of-performance materials, including air checks, links, screenshots, and campaign recaps. 

  • Keep WNBC and WNJU sponsorship trackers current and accessible, covering project status, production requirements, approvals, flight dates, and final deliverables. 

  • Identify and implement more efficient ways to track projects, share information, and communicate with Sales and Production partners. 

  • Improve transparency, organization, and cross-functional communication by developing and maintaining workflows in SharePoint, Monday.com, and other collaboration platforms. 

  • Create, update, and customize client-specific sales materials, sponsorship packages, presentations, and other marketing resources based on the needs of the Sales team. 

  • Deliver client-facing materials in the appropriate format and platform, including PowerPoint, SharePoint, and other digital presentation tools. 

  • Source, organize, and distribute relevant video examples and creative assets through Vimeo and other approved content platforms. 

  • Maintain local tentpole, sponsorship, and general-market sales decks, incorporating updates as programming, pricing, inventory, creative elements, or sales priorities change. 

  • Manage relevant SharePoint pages and sales-resource libraries to ensure that current decks, packages, examples, and support materials are organized and easily accessible to the Sales team. 

  • Support NY Live, Acceso Total, and other advertiser integrations by assisting with production coordination, on-site shoots, social media collateral, asset management, and communication with internal creative partners. 

  • Participate in client shoots and integrated-content productions as needed, providing logistical, creative, and project-management support. 

  • Partner with internal teams across NBCU Local, including Research, Content, Sales, Creative Services, and Production, to analyze data and develop marketing solutions that address advertiser and category objectives. 

  • Monitor industry, category, consumer, and media trends to identify relevant insights and proactive opportunities for clients. 

  • Collaborate and brainstorm with internal partners to develop proactive proposals, innovative sponsorship concepts, and strategic sales-marketing initiatives. 

  • Work with sales planners to create dynamic, research-supported plans across linear, digital, social, streaming, and out-of-home platforms. 

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, communicate status and potential issues proactively, and ensure deliverables meet established deadlines and quality standards. 

  • Provide additional support for sales-marketing initiatives, presentations, integrations, and special projects as needed. 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Media, or a related field. 

  • Three years of related experience in sales marketing, media, advertising, creative services, production, integrated marketing, or project management preferred. 

  • Strong proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Canva, and other presentation or design tools. 

  • Experience with collaboration, project-management, content-sharing, and presentation platforms such as SharePoint, Highspot, or Vimeo preferred. 

  • Familiarity with sales and traffic systems such as Salesforce and WideOrbit is a plus. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across internal stakeholders, including Sales, Management, Creative Services, and Production. 

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate projects from initial concept through production, approval, execution, and recap. 

  • Strong project-management and organizational skills for managing concurrent deliverables, trackers, timelines, assets, and approvals. 

  • Ability to create compelling visual presentations and persuasive business cases by analyzing information and translating data, research, and insights. 

  • Strong client-service orientation and the ability to respond quickly and thoughtfully to evolving business needs. 

  • Impeccable attention to detail, accuracy, and consistency. 

  • Creative, resourceful problem solver who improves processes, communication, and workflow management. 

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate successfully across functions and levels. 

  • Self-starter with initiative, accountability, and sound judgment; effective independently and as part of a team. 

  • Ability to prioritize effectively, adapt to changing deadlines, and perform successfully in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Willingness to support production shoots, content integrations, and occasional on-site assignments as business needs require.

job.title: Sr Cyber Event Analyst (Shift: Thursday to Monday | 1:45 PM PDT to 10 PM PDT)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

This is a Second Shift position (1:45 AM PDT to 10 PM PDT) with a schedule of Thursday through Monday.

NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, security event analysis, incident response, threat hunting, and detection and response capabilities across the enterprise. As a member of the Cyber Response team, the Senior Cyber Event Analyst will serve as a senior technical investigator responsible for identifying, analyzing, scoping, and responding to cybersecurity events.

This role requires an analyst who can go beyond the alert. The successful candidate will dive into underlying security telemetry, correlate activity across multiple data sources, develop and test investigative hypotheses, and determine the actual risk and potential impact of security events. The analyst will also help engineer and improve SOAR playbooks, investigation workflows, and response processes.

This is a shift-based role supporting NBCUniversal’s 24x7 Cyber Defense operation and includes participation in an on-call rotation; including the need to cover Company holidays.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and prioritize the queue including the Cyber hotline
  • Perform advanced triage, investigation, scoping, and disposition of security events across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, application, and email environments.
  • Go beyond surfaced alerts by querying and analyzing underlying logs and telemetry to validate detections, reconstruct activity, determine scope, and identify potential impact.
  • Correlate evidence across SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, DNS, proxy, firewall, WAF, cloud, email, application, and threat intelligence data sources.
  • Conduct hypothesis-driven investigations, identifying the additional evidence required to confirm or disprove malicious activity.
  • Assess security risk based on technical evidence, including affected identities and assets, privileges, persistence, lateral movement, data access, exposure, and business context.
  • Develop clear, evidence-backed dispositions documenting investigative findings, scope, confidence, risk, and recommended response actions.
  • Maps observed attacker behaviors and techniques to MITRE ATT&CK and other applicable security frameworks.
  • Collect and preserve endpoints, identity, network, cloud, and application artifacts to support investigations.
  • Design, build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain SOAR playbooks and investigation workflows for enrichment, evidence collection, containment, and response.
  • Translate manual investigation procedures into scalable automation using APIs, Python, PowerShell, JSON, or similar technologies.
  • Identify gaps/tuning opportunities in detection logic, telemetry, logging, and response processes and partner with Detection Engineering to implement improvements.
  • Perform technical peer reviews and mentor analysts on investigative methodology, query development and telemetry analysis.
  • Maintain detailed investigation records, technical runbooks, and shift handoffs to ensure continuity and analytical rigor.

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, relevant certifications, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in SOC, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, or Cyber Defense.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex security events beyond the information provided in the initial alert.
  • Hands-on experience querying and analyzing security telemetry using SIEM, security data lake, and/or log analytics platforms.
  • Experience correlating data across endpoints, identity, network, cloud, email, and application security technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Windows/Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, identity and authentication, enterprise networking, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience investigating threats such as credential compromise, malware, phishing/BEC, endpoint or network intrusion, suspicious cloud activity, and unauthorized data access.
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and incident response methodologies.
  • Experience developing, modifying, or troubleshooting SOAR playbooks and security automation workflows.
  • Experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies.
  • Ability to clearly distinguish and communicate confirmed evidence, analytical conclusions, risk, assumptions, and investigative gaps.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to support shift-based operations and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Ability to cover Company holidays to ensure 24x7 all year-round coverage.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience with query languages such as KQL, SPL, SQL, or equivalent.
  • Experience analyzing Windows Event Logs, Sysmon, EDR telemetry, authentication logs, DNS, network telemetry, cloud audit logs, and application logs.
  • Experience with endpoint/network forensics, packet analysis, or attack-path reconstruction.
  • Advanced experience developing SOAR automation, API integrations, or analyst enrichment tools.
  • Experience supporting Cyber Defense or Incident Response within a large, globally distributed enterprise or Media and Entertainment organization.
  • Relevant technical certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GIAC, or equivalent.

Additional Requirements

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $95,000 - $120,000

NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, security event analysis, incident response, threat hunting, and detection and response capabilities across the enterprise. As a member of the Cyber Response team, the Senior Cyber Event Analyst will serve as a senior technical investigator responsible for identifying, analyzing, scoping, and responding to cybersecurity events.

This role requires an analyst who can go beyond the alert. The successful candidate will dive into underlying security telemetry, correlate activity across multiple data sources, develop and test investigative hypotheses, and determine the actual risk and potential impact of security events. The analyst will also help engineer and improve SOAR playbooks, investigation workflows, and response processes.

This is a shift-based role supporting NBCUniversal’s 24x7 Cyber Defense operation and includes participation in an on-call rotation; including the need to cover Company holidays.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and prioritize the queue including the Cyber hotline
  • Perform advanced triage, investigation, scoping, and disposition of security events across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, application, and email environments.
  • Go beyond surfaced alerts by querying and analyzing underlying logs and telemetry to validate detections, reconstruct activity, determine scope, and identify potential impact.
  • Correlate evidence across SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, DNS, proxy, firewall, WAF, cloud, email, application, and threat intelligence data sources.
  • Conduct hypothesis-driven investigations, identifying the additional evidence required to confirm or disprove malicious activity.
  • Assess security risk based on technical evidence, including affected identities and assets, privileges, persistence, lateral movement, data access, exposure, and business context.
  • Develop clear, evidence-backed dispositions documenting investigative findings, scope, confidence, risk, and recommended response actions.
  • Maps observed attacker behaviors and techniques to MITRE ATT&CK and other applicable security frameworks.
  • Collect and preserve endpoints, identity, network, cloud, and application artifacts to support investigations.
  • Design, build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain SOAR playbooks and investigation workflows for enrichment, evidence collection, containment, and response.
  • Translate manual investigation procedures into scalable automation using APIs, Python, PowerShell, JSON, or similar technologies.
  • Identify gaps/tuning opportunities in detection logic, telemetry, logging, and response processes and partner with Detection Engineering to implement improvements.
  • Perform technical peer reviews and mentor analysts on investigative methodology, query development and telemetry analysis.
  • Maintain detailed investigation records, technical runbooks, and shift handoffs to ensure continuity and analytical rigor.

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, relevant certifications, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in SOC, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, or Cyber Defense.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex security events beyond the information provided in the initial alert.
  • Hands-on experience querying and analyzing security telemetry using SIEM, security data lake, and/or log analytics platforms.
  • Experience correlating data across endpoints, identity, network, cloud, email, and application security technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Windows/Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, identity and authentication, enterprise networking, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience investigating threats such as credential compromise, malware, phishing/BEC, endpoint or network intrusion, suspicious cloud activity, and unauthorized data access.
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and incident response methodologies.
  • Experience developing, modifying, or troubleshooting SOAR playbooks and security automation workflows.
  • Experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies.
  • Ability to clearly distinguish and communicate confirmed evidence, analytical conclusions, risk, assumptions, and investigative gaps.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to support shift-based operations and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Ability to cover Company holidays to ensure 24x7 all year-round coverage.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience with query languages such as KQL, SPL, SQL, or equivalent.
  • Experience analyzing Windows Event Logs, Sysmon, EDR telemetry, authentication logs, DNS, network telemetry, cloud audit logs, and application logs.
  • Experience with endpoint/network forensics, packet analysis, or attack-path reconstruction.
  • Advanced experience developing SOAR automation, API integrations, or analyst enrichment tools.
  • Experience supporting Cyber Defense or Incident Response within a large, globally distributed enterprise or Media and Entertainment organization.
  • Relevant technical certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GIAC, or equivalent.

Additional Requirements

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Summary

This position is responsible for leading the Sourcing and Procurement functions for Universal Studios Hollywood, overseeing daily procurement operations, sourcing strategies, and supplier relationships.  The Sr. Manager will deliver procurement efficiency, beneficial spend economics and savings via utilization of sourcing strategies /best practices, on-time ordering accuracy, supplier compliance, and consistent execution across all Food & Beverage categories.  This role will also oversee sourcing readiness and onboarding for all new ventures, ensuring that new concepts are fully supported through SKU setup, vendor engagement, and procurement readiness.  Additionally, this position will serve as the primary liaison to the Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) for all R&D and New Venture sourcing efforts, ensuring alignment with Universal’s sourcing governance framework and overall corporate strategy. 

This position requires a candidate with proven leadership ability to facilitate, guide, and implement improvements within the sourcing organization and operation of the company. This position will lead a team of sourcing professionals and must have the ability to motivate others to meet the challenges of a face paced, collaborative, and results driven environment. This position will work to ensure Sourcing initiatives are executed efficiently, industry best practices are adopted, and corporate Sourcing policies are adhered to for Universal’s domestic properties; may require global interaction with stakeholders and other UPR Sourcing professionals.  Travel is required.

 

Essential Functions

  • Lead a high performing team in sourcing and procurement execution for Universal Studios Hollywood (USH) Food & Beverage, ensuring daily operational continuity, cost visibility, and vendor compliance.
  • Design and implement sourcing programs, including bid specifications, distributor and manufacturer negotiations, and supplier development strategies.
  • Design and execute RFX Processes- RFI, RFP, RFQ - and negotiate economically beneficial contracts with suppliers to deliver competitive product and service pricing across categories.
  • Responsible for delivery of on-time ordering and accuracy for replenishment levels of warehouse and direct shipment items for responsible site and New Ventures sites
  • Oversee procurement processes within Eatec/S4 to ensure accurate purchase orders, on-time delivery, and full adherence to Universal’s governance model.
  • Serve as the primary liaison to the GPO for all R&D and New Venture sourcing efforts, ensuring project transparency, data accuracy, supplier compliance, and measurable value delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional alignment with Culinary, Operations, Shared Services, and IT for USH and all new venue onboarding, including SKU creation, sourcing timelines, and supplier readiness.
  • Partner with the Cost Control team to ensure budget alignment, identify cost-saving opportunities, and support margin expansion initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain procurement policies and sourcing procedures to enhance efficiency, transparency, and alignment with Universal’s national sourcing governance.
  • Design and execute category sourcing strategies that deliver short and long term benefits across pricing, delivery, storage and supplier utilization/management.
  • Design and execute procurement ordering and replenishment strategies and/or playbooks that deliver operational efficiency and cost effectiveness across product portfolio.
  • Analyze procurement data and supplier performance to identify cost reductions, supplier consolidation, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Forecast demand and usage patterns to optimize inventory levels and procurement scheduling.
  • Ensure sourcing compliance, sustainability standards, and food safety requirements are met across all vendors.
  • Drive completion of key projects by proactively considering new alternatives and applying critical thinking to achieve optimal results.
  • Provide leadership and mentoring to the USH Sourcing & Procurement team to promote continuous improvement, accountability, and best-in-class performance.
  • Build and foster relationships by collaborating with internal stakeholders, external suppliers, and UDX leadership.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established USH policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Various projects as assigned

Requirements:

  • Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Food & Beverage sourcing or procurement, including at least 3–5 years in a management or leadership capacity.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; Certified Professional Food Manager (CPFM) preferred.
  • Strong understanding of ERP systems (Eatec/S4) and procurement workflow automation. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio.
  • Deep knowledge of multi-step strategic sourcing, bid management, and category management strategies. Proven success in cost modeling, supplier negotiation, and analytics-driven decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams in a high-volume, fast-paced environment with multiple competing priorities. Skilled in cross-functional partnership and influencing without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical acumen with the ability to translate data into insights and actions. Capable of balancing strategic vision with executional precision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills at all organizational levels, with a focus on clarity, persuasion, and professionalism.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and results-driven. Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence.
  • Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong leader with the ability to motivate and develop a high-performing team in a collaborative, results-driven environment.
  • Deep understanding of product life cycle, price elasticity, COGS, and program-building concepts.

The Product Manager is an individual contributor responsible for hands-on product delivery across assigned Enterprise Rights products, platforms, and workstreams. Reporting to the Manager, Product, this role operates within the product vision, strategy, roadmap, governance, and priorities established by the Manager and translates them into requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, prioritized backlogs, sprint plans, releases, and measurable outcomes.

The role provides hands-on delivery support across discovery, requirements definition, backlog management, sprint execution, testing, release readiness, adoption, and continuous improvement. It works closely with business stakeholders, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Quality Assurance, Operations, and vendors, while escalating priority conflicts, delivery risks, dependencies, and decisions outside the assigned scope to the Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assigned Product Delivery and Workstream Execution
    • Execute assigned work within the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities established by the Manager, with accountability for requirements quality, backlog readiness, sprint execution, release coordination, and outcomes within the assigned scope.
    • Translate portfolio objectives, roadmap direction, and business needs into clear product capabilities, sequenced delivery plans, requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
    • Raise options and recommendations for delivery decisions within the assigned scope and escalate decisions affecting product direction, roadmap, funding, resources, or cross-portfolio priorities to the Manager.
    • Maintain epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog priorities, sprint boards, dependencies, risks, defects, release status, and supporting documentation in Jira and Confluence.
    • Escalate cross-portfolio priorities, unresolved dependencies, capacity constraints, material risks, and strategic decisions to the Manager.
  • Requirements, Agile Delivery, and Release Execution
    • Support discovery and lead detailed requirements development, backlog creation and grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and outcome tracking for assigned initiatives; provide analysis and recommendations to planning and prioritization led by the Manager.
    • Coordinate day-to-day product delivery through implementation, integration, migration, testing, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
    • Facilitate and actively manage Agile delivery ceremonies for assigned workstreams, including sprint planning, backlog grooming and refinement, daily stand-ups, estimation, sprint reviews, demos, retrospectives, release planning, and continuous-improvement activities.
    • Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Operations, and vendors to evaluate options, clarify tradeoffs, and support technically sound delivery decisions.
    • Use data, analytics, user feedback, and operational insight to guide product decisions and measure results.
  • Enterprise Rights Domain Leadership
    • Translate complex rights, licensing, contractual, title, territory, windowing, exclusivity, restriction, avails, and distribution requirements into scalable product capabilities.
    • Lead product activities across Legal, Business Affairs, Content Acquisition, Distribution, Finance, Operations, Data, Architecture, Engineering, and Product for assigned scope.
    • Ensure assigned solutions account for upstream sources, downstream consumers, reporting, integrations, data quality, governance, and operational workflows.
    • Contribute to RMS and related Enterprise Rights transformation initiatives as assigned, while maintaining alignment with the overall portfolio roadmap and governance model.
  • Data, Automation, and AI
    • Identify and prioritize practical opportunities to apply data, analytics, workflow automation, and AI within assigned products or workstreams.
    • Partner with Data, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Security, and business teams to evaluate use cases and move approved concepts from discovery into delivery.
    • Ensure proposed capabilities are grounded in reliable data, clear business value, measurable outcomes, and responsible governance.
  • Stakeholder and Team Collaboration
    • Build alignment among business and technology stakeholders, resolve priorities within the assigned scope, and communicate decisions clearly.
    • Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and other delivery resources to maintain requirements clarity, backlog readiness, sprint commitments, and timely issue resolution.
    • Communicate roadmap status, delivery health, risks, options, and recommendations in a concise, decision-oriented manner.
    • Support change management, training, operational readiness, and adoption for delivered capabilities.
    • Contribute to consistent product-management practices established by the Manager across discovery, planning, requirements, delivery, documentation, and outcome measurement.

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Media & Entertainment, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of product management, product ownership, business analysis, or Agile delivery experience supporting enterprise or platform products.
  • Demonstrated experience translating established product direction and roadmaps into requirements, prioritized backlogs, sprint plans, releases, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  • Experience leading enterprise transformation, implementation, integration, migration, or modernization initiatives.
  • 3+ years of media and entertainment experience supporting rights, licensing, content acquisition, distribution, or media supply-chain functions.
  • Strong understanding of rights-in, rights-out, avails, contract metadata, title management, territories, windowing, exclusivity, restrictions, and distribution workflows.
  • Strong technical fluency across enterprise integrations, APIs, data platforms, reporting, cloud or legacy modernization, security, and interconnected system landscapes.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Agile delivery methods, including Scrum and Kanban, and experience managing epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlogs, sprint boards, dependencies, defects, releases, dashboards, and documentation in Jira and Confluence.
  • Ability to influence without authority, challenge assumptions, navigate ambiguity, and drive decisions across senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, problem-solving, and organizational-change skills.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience with enterprise rights-management platforms such as Rightsline, Vistex, RightsLogic Media Maestro, FilmTrack, or similar solutions.
  • Experience with enterprise architecture, APIs, data platforms, reporting tools, and cloud or legacy-system modernization.
  • Practical experience using SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools to analyze data and support product decisions.
  • Experience partnering with Data Engineering, Analytics, or Data Science teams on decision-support capabilities.
  • Experience working within product operating models, portfolio governance structures, and outcome-based planning practices.
  • Working knowledge of Figma or similar design and collaboration tools, with experience reviewing prototypes, supporting requirements discussions, and collaborating with UX/UI and product teams.
  • Scrum, Agile, or product-management certification, such as CSPO, CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or an equivalent credential.

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

As our CDN Engineer, you’ll join the Content Delivery Engineering team within NBCUniversal’s Global Video Engineering organization. Your mission is to help deliver outstanding VOD, live event, and linear streaming experiences to millions of viewers across our US, UK, EU services—including Peacock, TVE,  SkyShowtime and NOW/WOW.

You’ll collaborate daily with colleagues and vendors across the US, UK, and beyond - excellent communication skills are essential. Our team specializes in large-scale Multi-Content Delivery Network design and operations, performance telemetry and analytics, selection & interfacing with content origins via multiple workflows, dynamic ad insertion, manifest manipulation and integrating new player technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Design new and optimize existing content delivery design to improve performance, scalability, resilience, and capabilities across our products and services.
  • Create and update CDN configurations using Terraform, with version control and diligent peer review of every change, to ensure configuration consistency.
  • Drive zero-impact, issue-free deployments with the goal of zero production incidents.
  • Focus on using log analysis and observability systems to troubleshoot, diagnose issues and drive in-depth analysis for rapid resolutions.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of functional (FT) and non-functional (NFT) testing methodologies and procedures.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive operational runbooks, deployment procedures, and checklists to ensure consistent and reliable production delivery.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation, taking ownership of operational issues, service degradation, and production incident resolution.
  • Attain a comprehensive understanding of NBCUniversal's streaming products, platforms, and supporting technologies to ensure effective end-to-end technical ownership.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a relevant field is preferred.
  • Minimum three years of experience creating and/or managing complex CDN or web server/proxy configurations.
  • Sound understanding and use of TCP/IP, IPv4/v6, DNS, HTTP, TLS and load balancing in production.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based networking, firewall, security and data products.
  • Skilled with using software repositories, CI/CD pipelines and writing test automation.
  • Familiarity with large-scale, distributed performance testing, including Functional/Non-Functional Testing (NFT), is a plus.
  • Use of automation, scripting and/or programming to solve problems and reduce effort.
  • Well versed, working with SRE teams & technologies to assist safe, consistent technology operations.
  • Ability to work effectively in a distributed, multi-cultural team, collaborating across time zones.

job.description:

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems to help shape the foundations that power experiences across our global streaming portfolio.

You’ll help evolve our global design system, creating the components, patterns, frameworks, and tools that enable teams to build cohesive, accessible, and scalable experiences across TV, web, mobile platforms.

This role is anchored in systems thinking and sits at the intersection of product design and engineering. You'll partner closely with Product Design, Product Management, Engineering, and Brand teams to turn product needs into reusable solutions, strengthen the connection between design and code, and make it easier for teams to build high-quality experiences at scale.

We’re looking for someone who sees patterns beyond individual screens, enjoys solving complex platform challenges, and believes a great design system should empower teams rather than constrain them.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and evolve our design system. Design scalable components, patterns, and foundations, using thoughtful component architecture, variables, modes, and tokens to support experiences across products and platforms.
  • Bridge design and engineering. Partner closely with engineers to translate designs into production-ready components, defining properties, states, behaviors, and specifications while strengthening design-to-development workflows.
  • Solve at the system level. Identify patterns across products, standardize where it creates value, reduce unnecessary complexity, and turn individual product needs into flexible solutions that can scale across experiences.
  • Drive adoption and enable teams. Create clear documentation, usage guidance, and contribution processes. Partner with teams through design reviews, consultation, and office hours to help them effectively use and contribute back to the system.
  • Design with accessibility at the foundation. Incorporate accessibility into components and patterns from the start, applying WCAG standards at the component level and supporting consistent experiences across platforms.
  • Improve how the system works. Explore tooling, automation, and emerging technologies that can improve system maintenance, documentation, QA, and design-to-code workflows.
  • Shape what’s next. Explore how tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows can improve how we build, maintain, document, and use the system.
  • Balance today's needs with long-term system health. Help prioritize system evolution based on product needs, adoption, and system health while balancing near-term delivery with the long-term sustainability of the system.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of product design experience, with at least 2+ years of direct experience building, scaling, or implementing design systems.
  • A portfolio demonstrating design systems work, including your approach to components, patterns, systems thinking, and implementation.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including component architecture, variants, auto layout, variables, modes, and library management.
  • Hands-on experience with design tokens, theming, and scalable component architecture.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to translate design system decisions into production components.
  • Strong systems-thinking skills and the ability to identify patterns, understand tradeoffs, and translate complex product needs into scalable solutions.
  • Strong understanding of interaction design, visual design, and accessibility, including WCAG standards.
  • Experience designing systems that support multiple platforms, products, or devices.
  • Knowledge of and interest in AI-assisted design and development workflows.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and tradeoffs across Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and move complex initiatives forward across multiple teams.

As our Senior Software Engineer, you’ll join the Content Delivery Engineering team (CDE) within NBCUniversal’s Global Video Engineering organization in New York City, USA. Your mission is to get involved with delivering outstanding VOD, live event, and linear streaming experiences to millions of viewers across our US, UK, EU, and Africa services - including Peacock, SkyShowtime, Showmax, and NOW/WOW.

You’ll collaborate daily with colleagues across the US, UK and beyond – excellent communication skills are essential. Our team specializes in large-scale Multi-Content Delivery Network design and operations, performance telemetry and analytics, selection & interfacing with content origins via multiple workflows - dynamic ad insertion, manifest manipulation and integrating new player technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance software systems and features—primarily in Go—used to deliver world-class video content at massive scale for brands like Peacock, SkyShowtime, Showmax, and NOW/WOW.
  • Build reliable, testable, and user-focused services supporting key streaming workflows, such as VOD, live events, linear channels, dynamic ad insertion, and manifest manipulation.
  • Participate in thoughtful and consistent code reviews that promote high code quality, clear architectural patterns, and healthy engineering culture.
  • Partner closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to architect systems that are highly available, resilient, performant, and fault-tolerant across multiple regions.
  • Leverage observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces) and performance analytics to detect issues proactively and drive fast, data-driven root-cause analysis.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of multi-CDN strategies, routing logic, and origin workflows that ensure exceptional global streaming performance.
  • Collaborate daily with engineers across the US, UK, EU, and Africa—requiring clear communication and strong documentation skills.
  • Influence technical direction, system architecture, and best practices as a senior member of the Content Delivery Engineering team.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development in Go (preferred) or Python.
  • Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) using containers and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD workflows and experience using Git-based repositories, automated testing frameworks, and build pipelines.
  • Practical experience with Site Reliability Engineering concepts such as reliability targets (SLIs/SLOs), auto-scaling, distributed systems reliability, or incident response.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to articulate design decisions and collaborate with distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with CDNs (e.g., Akamai, CloudFront, Fastly, Cloudflare) or streaming media delivery systems.
  • Understanding of video streaming technologies such as HLS, DASH, manifests, origins, or content routing.
  • Experience building systems that support global scale, multi-region deployments, or high availability architectures.

NBCUniversal is looking for a Staff Data and Analytics Engineer focused on the studio business. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to shape and configure the SAP Analytics Cloud tools and SAP BPC within Corporate Technology Engineering. You’ll help deliver a dynamic SAP Data and Analytical capability that caters to the unique needs of Studio business sectors. Join us!

NBCU has deployed SAP to run financial, logistics and HR processes. SAP Data and Analytics tools are used to run planning processes at enterprise and division level. NBCU Entertainment division has globally developed SAP solutions to perform planning & accounting functions of high complexity.

D&A manager is to provide feasible planning/accounting solutions by creating necessary blueprint documents for functional requirements, technical specifications, design & implement planning and reporting solutions, review the work performed by engineering team members as per established standards & requirements. It is also expected that manager will review current standards and revise them to ensure best practices.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of SAP D&A solutions for Studio group, ensuring system reliability and performance.
  • Lead the design and build of SAC, SAP BPC and other SAP D&A solutions for planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial consolidation.
  • Build Data models for studios using SAP technologies like SAP BDC, SAC, BPC and BW/4 HANA
  • Deliver effective planning solutions in SAC Planning.
  • Design and build new SAC Planning solutions in SAC and migrate existing BPC solutions into SAC Planning.
  • Oversee and coordinate SAP Products (BPC, BW, SAC) maintenance, upgrades, enhancements, and troubleshooting.
  • Build SAC models, stories and dashboards
  • Lead the triage and resolution of business-reported data and analytics issues, collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify root causes, implement sustainable fixes, and improve overall data platform reliability and performance.
  • Implement security, access control, and governance best practices for D&A applications.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and best practices guidance to the SAP D&A team.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues, ensuring system stability and performance.
  • Write technical specifications from functional specifications and build solutions according to the technical specifications
  • Review design recommendations to ensure quality and consistency across the footprint
  • Perform fit-gap analysis via discovery by engaging with business units and other corporate systems team members
  • Review and/or participate in solution build and test activities on BPC & SAC implementations, rollouts, or upgrade projects; may be asked to step in to conduct project management activities from time to time
  • Advise on solution roadmap for studio business projects considering current BW4HANA footprint for BPC & SAC solutions.
  • Conduct comparative research and recommend strategies for future roadmaps for BPC & SAC solutions.
  • Collaborate with peers in Corp Tech to apply best practices to integrate between SAP applications (S4, BW4, BO and BPC)
  • Become the trusted internal advisor for key business users

  • Hands-on experience with SAC, DSP, EPM Add-in, Analysis for Office (AO), and BPC reporting tools.
  • Work on data modeling, blending, and transformation to ensure efficient and optimized reporting.
  • Integrate SAC with SAP BW, SAP HANA, S/4, and other data sources for seamless analytics.

  • 7+ years of progressive SAP BPC and/or BPC Netweaver hands on experience leading up to Architect level work in an IT capacity implementing TV accounting and planning solutions of high complexity and large scale.
  • Experience with Studio planning functions such as Planning, Pacing, Amortization calculations.
  • Migration experience from BPC Solutions to SAC platform.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Willingness to work off business hours and weekends as needed in a demanding environment
  • Project management familiarity/experience

  • SAP BPC Certification is a plus.

job.description:

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. As the Staff DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for leading our DevOps and platform engineering initiatives, fostering a culture of automation, continuous integration, observability, reliability, and delivery. Your efforts will support consumer data-driven advertising and marketing products, standardized consumer identity solutions, machine learning platforms, and emerging AI-powered applications across NBCUniversal and its brands. 

You will partner with engineering, data, security, and AI teams to design and operate scalable cloud platforms that enable application development, analytics, machine learning, and AI workloads. Your expertise in AWS services, Infrastructure as Code, container orchestration, observability, platform automation, and cloud architecture will be critical in building secure, resilient, and cost-effective environments that accelerate innovation while maintaining enterprise governance and operational excellence. You will operate in an individual contributor capacity, but as a Staff Engineer, you will lead and mentor more junior DevOps Engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and platform-first thinking. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and lead the implementation of DevOps, Platform Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices to improve the efficiency, scalability, reliability, and security of cloud-based applications and services. 
  • Design, build, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines that automate software delivery, infrastructure deployment, platform provisioning, and operational workflows. 
  • Architect, deploy, and manage scalable AWS cloud infrastructure supporting applications, data, machine learning, and AI workloads. 
  • Implement and manage containerization and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, EKS) to ensure consistent, secure, and resilient environments across development, testing, and production. 
  • Establish and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and Git Ops practices to improve platform consistency, governance, and operational efficiency. 
  • Build and support ML Ops and AI platform capabilities, including model deployment automation, inference platform operations, AI workflow orchestration, secure API integration, and lifecycle management for AI-enabled services. 
  • Enable secure integration of AI platforms, LLM-based applications, vector databases, agent frameworks, and machine learning services while ensuring compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. 
  • Develop observability solutions using logging, monitoring, tracing, and operational analytics platforms to proactively detect performance issues, infrastructure anomalies, security risks, and AI workload health concerns. 
  • Design scalable cloud architectures that support high availability, disaster recovery, cost optimization, and AI workload scalability. 
  • Partner with Security, Data, and Architecture teams to implement cloud security controls, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance requirements across traditional and AI-enabled platforms. 
  • Drive automation of infrastructure operations, environment provisioning, platform governance, and operational processes to reduce manual effort and improve developer productivity. 
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, operational runbooks, architecture standards, and platform governance processes 
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience operating at a senior or technical leadership level. 
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, including building, deploying, and maintaining cloud infrastructure at scale. 
  • Deep experience with AWS and core cloud services such as EC2, EKS, ECS, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, and VPC networking. 
  • Strong experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes, EKS/ECS, and Docker. 
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, or similar tools. 
  • Experience supporting high-traffic, high-throughput consumer-facing applications or platforms, with demonstrated knowledge of scalability, performance, availability, and production reliability. 
  • Experience implementing observability and monitoring using tools such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or CloudWatch. 
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, secrets management, networking, and secure infrastructure design. 
  • Experience designing scalable platform architectures that balance reliability, performance, governance, and cost optimization. 
  • Ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while remaining a hands-on individual contributor. 
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, data, security, and architecture teams. 

Desired / Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience supporting large-scale, high-volume platforms processing 5,000+ transactions per second (TPS). 
  • Experience supporting high-visibility live or tentpole events where traffic can increase significantly and platform availability is business-critical. 
  • Experience working in multi-cloud environments, particularly Microsoft Azure in addition to AWS. 
  • Experience with data pipeline orchestration and supporting data-intensive platforms. 
  • Experience deploying or operating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or similar technologies. 
  • Familiarity with agentic AI architectures, agent workflows, AI skills, and AI-enabled application infrastructure. 
  • Experience supporting LLM-based applications, AI/ML workloads, model-serving infrastructure, inference services, or related AI platform capabilities. 
  • Familiarity with AI platform security, governance, operational monitoring, and secure API integrations. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need.

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers

Media Group: The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.   

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Ad Innovation Product: The Ad Innovation Product team develops new advertising experiences and capabilities across NBCUniversal’s portfolio. This intern will gain exposure to the product development lifecycle, including discovery, requirements, testing, launch planning, and performance analysis. Working with product managers and cross-functional partners, the intern will support projects that improve advertiser outcomes and audience experiences.
  • Global Streaming Product, Commerce: Our team shapes the end-to-end commerce experience that enables customers to sign-up, activate, and subscribe to our streaming services across mobile and TV platforms, as well as through enterprise partnerships. We focus on driving subscriber growth by making it easier for customers to get started, choose the right plan, and enjoy a seamless subscription experience. As an intern, you’ll work alongside Product Managers and cross-functional partners to research opportunities, support product development, analyze performance, and help improve customer journeys across devices and partner experiences for Peacock in the U.S., as well as for NOW and SkyShowtime internationally.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in product management, business, marketing, media, computer science, data analytics, or a related field.
  • Foundational understanding of product development, digital media, advertising technology, or related coursework and projects.
  • Proficiency with presentation and spreadsheet tools; experience with project-management, analytics, design, or prototyping tools is a plus.
  • Foundational exposure to product, design, analytics, or technology concepts through coursework, personal projects or self-directed learning.
  • Interest in AI tools and a willingness to learn and leverage them for product work. Hands-on experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot is a plus.

The Studio Transformation team partners closely with Studio Finance, Technology, and Business stakeholders to modernize financial processes, systems, and ways of working across the Studio organization.
