Universal Television Entertainment is responsible for world-class television entertainment. The division programs and markets content across leading entertainment brands Bravo, NBC and Peacock, and produces over 3,000 hours of television annually through Universal Studio Group, the studio business comprised of Universal Television, Universal Global Television and Universal Television Alternative Studio.

 

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Brand Marketing-Bravo: Intern will support a highly dynamic marketing team in concepting, developing, and executing marketing campaigns for Bravo. This includes brand initiatives including experiential marketing programs, tentpole cultural events and activations, strategic partnerships, and E-commerce merchandising initiatives. The intern will also be responsible for monitoring cultural trends on both a macro and micro level and conducting competitive research to inform our marketing and promotional strategies. The ideal candidate will have a creative sensibility and strategic acumen, will be a highly organized self-starter while demonstrating thorough attention to detail, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Bravo & Peacock Multiplatform Strategy & Planning: The Bravo Multiplatform Strategy and Planning Team within NBCU oversees promotional scheduling on linear, Peacock, digital, and other platforms. The team works with a variety of different partners in marketing to create and execute promotional strategies, which helps promote all linear and streaming programming on a daily basis. We are looking for an exceptional intern who will be tasked with planning and scheduling daily graphic logs on Bravo, pulling data reports, entering various metadata into our system and working with the wider Multiplatform Team on any ad-hoc projects/assignments.
  • Digital Content Strategy, Bravo Digital: Intern will assist with/create NBCU IP intelligence reports for entertainment marketing teams and stakeholders (search, social, AI, etc.), conduct keyword research for editorial team and other relevant teams, assist with bravotv.com homepage programming tasks, assist with other intelligence or performance reports and presentations, assist with Bravo Insider editorial and fan acquisition initiatives (creating blog posts, monitoring fan submission initiatives, etc.), and assist with social/short form video cutting (Daily Dish Instagram, other SFV needs).
  • Communications-Unscripted: Support communications efforts by maintaining and updating press lists, preparing for press junkets, monitoring press breaks and compiling clip packets, researching media outlets & contacts, and compiling coverage reports, assist with press releases and various writing assignments/research projects.  
  • Communications-Platform Publicity: The platform publicity comms team supports PR efforts for all scripted series across NBCU broadcast and cable TV networks. While every day will be different, the scripted comms intern can expect to work with team members across both coasts and on a variety of series. Opportunities include (but are not limited to) helping track big stories surrounding series, research journalists, publications and trends, garner experience in PR-centric writing, attend team and series meetings, and more. 
  • Late Night & Specials Publicity: Our team oversees publicity for the late night shows and various specials programming across the NBCU portfolio. Our intern can expect to gain an in-depth understanding of publicity and insight into the numerous strategies the Entertainment PR team employs, and how they differ from show to show. Interns can also expect to gain a heightened ability to efficiently and effectively prioritize, organize, and communicate. They will receive exposure to any virtual press days/junkets, interviews, and events.   
  • NBC & Peacock Marketing: The NBC & Peacock Marketing team communicates with all departments to build strategies and marketing campaigns for NBC Entertainment primetime and late-night programming, in addition to leading promotional activations. The marketing intern will support the brand team throughout these processes, partake in weekly trainings, attend meetings and assist in daily tasks to understand brand’s role throughout a show’s lifecycle. 
  • NBC Late Night Digital Marketing: Intern will work with The Tonight Show and Late Night with Seth Meyers teams to ensure show calendars are up to date, accurate and aligned with confirmed guest listings, organize and maintain guest images for each show, collaborating with talent teams and stakeholders to ensure consistent imagery across all channels, write original and accurate guest biographies for show talent using strong research skills and relevant SEO keywords, support the team in brainstorming and creating compilation content for The Tonight Show, Late Night with Seth Meyers and Saturday Night Live and more.
  • Social Media Marketing: Monitor fan social sentiment/conversation and utilize social listening tool Sprout Social, identify trends on TikTok and Instagram, and ideate ways for NBC & Peacock to participate in trending conversations, curate a weekly top performing posts report to highlight wins of the week, perform social media marketing and competitive research as needed, and more.

 

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Familiarity with Muck Rack, Cision, and Google Alerts a plus, but not required.  
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.   
  • Experience or familiarity with the Adobe Creative Suite a plus (Premiere, Photoshop).   
  • Familiarity with HTML & Web technologies.   
  • Familiarity with content management systems or a willingness to learn. 
  • Strong writing skills, with ability to write clean copy quickly and efficiently for short-form, digital and promotional content.  
  • Knowledge of social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, TikTok, Threads) and each platforms’ distinct role in the media landscape.

Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 
  • At our Universal City office interns will have access to the NBCUCommutes program, which provides fully subsidized transit passes to full-time lower lot employees, good for unlimited rides on all Metro bus and rail, such as the Metro Red Line.

 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Universal City, CA.

 

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

 

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

 

Universal Television Entertainment is responsible for world-class television entertainment. The division programs and markets content across leading entertainment brands Bravo, NBC and Peacock, and produces over 3,000 hours of television annually through Universal Studio Group, the studio business comprised of Universal Television, Universal Global Television and Universal Television Alternative Studio.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Campaign Project Management: Intern will support Production Assistants and Bravo teams across on-air and off-air campaigns. Responsibilities include managing assets and trackers, assisting with press materials, reporting music usage, and pitching promotional content, ideal for students interested in entertainment marketing, production, and project management.
  • Casting: Intern will support NBC Entertainment by tracking talent across current series, reading scripts, watching cuts, and curating daily casting news. Interns gain exposure to casting, talent research, and competitive reporting while working with teams behind award-winning programming for NBC, Bravo, and Peacock.
  • Creative Acquisitions: Intern will maintain department databases of incoming and outgoing IP submissions, format and create copy for internal memos, read prospective material to succinctly pitch or pass in internal meetings, cover desks, phones, and administrative tasks for coordinators, spearhead special research projects and create presentation decks. Interns should have a voracious appetite for books and a general understanding of publishing landscape.
  • Production & Operations: Intern will attend and participate in meetings to stay up to date with projects, help to manage NBCU’s internal screening system, review and audit postproduction materials in wrap bibles, support Production Managers/Coordinators with document review, updating production spreadsheets, and distributing production information, work with other departments to find most up to date information and documents for shows in production and more.
  • Scripted Programming: Intern will develop original scripted programming for NBC and Peacock, supporting Comedy Development, Drama Development, and Current Programming from pitch through premiere. Interns assist with weekly newsletters, script coverage, creative call and pitch notes, and administrative support for department coordinators, while also helping manage office needs and contributing to additional projects that support daily operations.
  • Television & Streaming Inclusion: Intern will support NBCU LAUNCH, contributing to efforts that champion authentic and compelling content across NBCUniversal. Responsibilities include reviewing project materials and providing feedback to department, research, social media and internal communications, and administrative support across talent development programs - ideal for students interested in television, inclusion, and programming strategy.
  • UGT Creative Development and Current Programming: Intern will organize incoming submissions, maintain talent lists and writer samples, and track international festival films, review scripts, books, IP and other project materials and provide feedback to the department, participate in weekly submission meetings to log and track new books, IP and materials coming to market, maintain talent, festival, roadmap strategy, monthly agent/buyer, staffing, OWA and ODA tracking grids, and more.
  • Unscripted Content- Alternative, Documentary, Formats, and True Crime: Intern will support alternative, formats, and crime/documentary projects for NBC, Bravo, and Peacock, gaining exposure to the full development process. Responsibilities include research, development grids, case checks, watching cuts, and providing creative input on pitches and talent—ideal for students interested in television development.
  • UTE Programming Content Acquisitions: Intern will play a key role in post-deal partner relationships, collaborating cross functionally with NBCU leadership and business teams to ensure strategic and operational alignment. If you’re fluent in media and technology and excited to help guide partners through onboarding, this opportunity is for you.
  • UTV Programming & Creative: Intern will provide desk coverage across the departments as needed, including scheduling, rolling calls, and emailing with both internal personnel and external assistants, read scripts and provide written coverage, that includes a summary and comments on if the material would be well suited to adapt for TV, helping the UTV coordinators with keeping grids and reports up to date, and participating in a self-guided project to hone industry knowledge and skills relevant to the intern’s career aspirations in entertainment.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Strong interest in the entertainment industry, particularly television and streaming content (scripted, unscripted, or genre programming).
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize information and contribute ideas.
  • Organized and detail‑oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities with guidance.
  • Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively in a team‑based environment.
  • Proactive, motivated, and eager to learn; able to take direction and adapt to new assignments.
  • Basic working knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Suite (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides).
  • Familiarity with creative, editing, or media tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar).
  • Interest in inclusive storytelling, content creation, or talent development within media and entertainment.

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

job.title: Vendor Management (VMO) Analyst
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBC News Group Digital’s Vendor Management Office (VMO) is seeking a detail-oriented Vendor Management Analyst to support the oversight of third-party vendor relationships. This role will partner with business stakeholders, Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, Privacy, AI, Cyber Security, and external vendors to help ensure services are delivered on time, contractual commitments are met, risks are tracked, and vendor processes are managed accurately. The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, collaborative, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist with end-to-end vendor lifecycle management by supporting intake requests, onboarding, ongoing governance, renewal tracking, and offboarding activities.
  • Conduct market research and comparative analysis across multiple vendors to evaluate capabilities, service offerings, pricing models, rate structures, and overall value. Support vendor benchmarking efforts by gathering data, summarizing findings, and providing clear recommendations to help stakeholders make vendor selection decisions.
  • Monitor vendor performance against service levels, deliverables, milestones, and key performance indicators. Document performance concerns and service-level issues/outages, escalate as appropriate, and track corrective actions through completion.
  • Prepare and maintain scorecards, dashboards, reports, and data summaries.
  • Monitor contract expirations, renewal windows, amendments, and key obligations using the vendor dashboard.
  • Support vendor risk and compliance activities, including assessments, security reviews, privacy requirements, audit requests, and remediation plans.
  • Coordinate financial aspects such as review invoices, purchase orders, and spend data to identify discrepancies, and savings opportunities; partner with finance on financial requests and approvals.
  • Cross-functional collaborations with internal teams to ensure vendor activities align with company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain accurate vendor documentation and records, including contract details, statements of work, purchase orders, compliance documentation, and related contract materials.
  • Coordinate vendor engagements, business reviews, operational check-ins, standups, and action-item follow-ups.
  • Recommend process improvements to strengthen vendor governance, reporting, documentation, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the VMO team on additional projects as needed.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or 1 - 2 years of experience in vendor management, procurement, supplier management, contract administration, business operations, finance, risk management, or related function.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines, requests, and priorities across various stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong listening skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  • Self-starter who is resourceful, organized, and able to manage time efficiently.
  • Ability to support, mentor, and encourage team members when appropriate.
  • Ability to retain detailed information related to technical projects and operational processes.
  • Proficiency with Smartsheet, Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, Visio, databases, PowerPoint, and Excel macros/formulas.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Comfortable leveraging AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Anthropic.
  • Experience using or creating agents and GPTs to improve daily workflows.
  • Experience with scorecards, SLAs, KPIs, quarterly business reviews, or governance programs.
  • Familiarity with procurement, contract management, Jira ticketing, or workflow tools such as SAP, SNAP, Purchase Manager, ServiceNow, Smartsheet, Domo, or Figma.
  • Exposure to third-party risk management, information security reviews, privacy requirements, compliance tracking, or audit support.
  • Experience with invoice validation, budget tracking, purchase order management, or spend analysis.
  • Ability to prepare clear reports, dashboards, and leadership-level presentations.
  • Process improvement mindset with the ability to identify gaps and recommend practical solutions.

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the Vendor Management Office with contract intake, routing, execution, amendments, renewals, and closeout activities.
  • Maintain accurate records for master agreements, statements of work, amendments, change orders, purchase orders, trial agreements, proofs of concept, NDAs, addenda, service-level agreements, compliance documents, and supporting materials.

  • Review invoices, purchase orders, and spend data to help identify discrepancies, trends, renewal impacts, and cost-saving opportunities.

  • Support internal audits, records requests, and vendor risk or compliance reviews as needed.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen administration, governance, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
  • Handle confidential vendor, financial, and contractual information with discretion.

  • Strong team player and self-motivated learner with a problem-solving attitude and excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.
  • Ability to listen actively and retain detailed information across technical projects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex contract terms clearly.
  • Ability to negotiate effectively and support mutually beneficial agreements.
  • Understanding of relevant legal principles and contract law.
  • Ability to interpret basic contract terms, statements of work, renewal language, service levels, pricing, payment terms, purchase orders, invoices, and performance data.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and external vendors or service providers.
  • Ability to analyze contract terms and identify potential risks.
  • Ability to manage large volumes of contracts and supporting documentation efficiently.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate records and documentation.
  • Ability to manage confidential information professionally and responsibly.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint; experience with tools such as Atlassian Jira, Slack, Figma, Zendesk, Snap System, Basware, Purchase Manager, Agile1, and Smartsheet.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience supporting a Vendor Management Office, Procurement, Legal Operations, or Third-Party Risk Management team.
  • Experience with scorecards, SLAs, KPIs, quarterly business reviews, repositories, or governance programs.
  • Familiarity with contract lifecycle management, procurement, ERP, ticketing, or workflow tools such as DocuSign CLM, Agile1, SAP, Oracle, Purchase Manager, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Smartsheet, Netlify, Jira, or Domo.
  • Exposure to third-party risk management, information security reviews, privacy requirements, insurance documentation, compliance tracking, or audit support.
  • Experience with invoice validation, budget tracking, purchase order management, spend analysis, or renewal planning.
  • Ability to prepare clear reports, dashboards, and leadership-level presentations.
  • Process improvement mindset with the ability to identify gaps and recommend practical solutions.

The Vice President, Advanced Advertising Strategy will shape the long-term vision, strategic direction, and innovation agenda for NBCUniversal’s advanced advertising business, translating market shifts, technology advancements, and evolving client needs into growth opportunities.

The role will take emerging ideas from their earliest stages through validation and toward commercial viability, working with Product and Strategy teams and ad-tech ecosystem partners to develop scalable businesses and capabilities aligned with NBCUniversal’s broader priorities and technology roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the long-term strategy. Set NBCUniversal’s advanced advertising vision, strategic roadmap, and investment priorities across audience intelligence, performance advertising, data collaboration, retail media, identity, measurement and attribution, emerging media channels, and AI-enabled advertising.
  • Incubate and validate new growth opportunities. Take emerging ideas from initial thesis through business-case development, market validation, testing, and commercial readiness. Establish disciplined experimentation frameworks to determine which opportunities merit further investment and scale.
  • Partner deeply with Product and Strategy. Work closely with Product teams to connect market opportunities to technology and capability roadmaps, and with Strategy teams to ensure advanced advertising priorities align with NBCUniversal’s broader strategic direction.
  • Identify and assess market disruption. Evaluate shifts in technology, consumer behavior, regulation, competitive dynamics, and advertising business models to identify where NBCUniversal should invest, partner, build, or experiment.
  • Build connectivity across the ad-tech ecosystem. Develop relationships with operators, entrepreneurs, technology companies, platforms, and other innovators across the advertising ecosystem to surface emerging ideas, capabilities, partnership opportunities, and potential strategic investments.
  • Advise senior leadership. Translate complex market developments and emerging opportunities into clear executive recommendations, strategic narratives, and investment priorities.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing strategy team. Build a team that combines strategic rigor, intellectual curiosity, commercial orientation, and a bias toward action, while effectively leading initiatives that require influence across organizational boundaries.
  • 10+ years of experience in business strategy, corporate strategy, management consulting, advertising technology, media, digital advertising, technology, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience developing new strategies, businesses, products, or capabilities from early-stage concept through validation and commercialization, connecting opportunities to client needs, market adoption, and business value.
  • Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem; experience in advertising technology, programmatic, CTV, audience and identity, performance advertising, data collaboration, measurement, or related areas strongly preferred.
  • Established credibility and relationships within the advertising and technology ecosystem, with the ability to engage effectively with technology operators, entrepreneurs, platforms, partners, and other industry leaders.
  • Exceptional strategic and analytical capabilities, including assessing emerging technologies, business models, partnerships, and investment opportunities; structuring ambiguous problems; and translating complex information into actionable strategies.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, and manage, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.
  • Strong executive presence and exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and actionable.
  • Highly proactive and intellectually curious, with a strong bias toward action and the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree a plus.

NBCUniversal’s Global Advertising & Partnerships team is leading the transformation of premium video advertising. This leader will be responsible for driving programmatic adoption across NBCU’s streaming portfolio, forging senior-level relationships, and aligning with agency partners on data, technology, and automation strategies that deliver measurable business outcomes for clients. Client Relationships

  • Serve as a senior lead across agency holding companies, focused on programmatic investment, innovation, and automation

  • Represent NBCU’s streaming and programmatic vision in strategic partnership discussions, agency joint business planning, QBRs, as well as attending key industry conferences

Strategic Growth & Partnership Development

  • Champion the adoption of NBCU’s programmatic and tech capabilities across the streaming ecosystem, including programmatic guaranteed, private marketplace, and audience-based buying
  • Expand programmatic access to NBCU’s most premium inventory, including live sports, tentpole events, and high-demand entertainment, while protecting the premium value and growing demand
  • Collaborate with agency partners to create new programmatic and product solutions leveraging data, technology, and measurement innovation
  • Partner closely with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of streaming and programmatic solutions into broader client strategies
  • Identify and unlock new partnership opportunities with data collaboration/data clean room, identity, measurement, supply and ad tech platforms that strengthen agency value propositions

  • Stay ahead of evolving digital & streaming trends, marketplace shifts, and emerging technologies to help NBCU and its partners innovate
  • Represent NBCU at key industry events and thought leadership forums related to streaming, programmatic and automation
  • Translate agency feedback and marketplace signals into product requirements, pricing, and packaging recommendations to keep pace with continued streaming evolution
  • Lead internal education and external sales commercialization for new streaming ad products and innovations, such as retail media networks, data clean rooms, agentic, contextual and ad product suites

Leadership & Team Management

We are seeking an experienced Video Streaming Engineer to design, develop, operate, and optimize large-scale live and linear video streaming workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with audio and video encoding, live video processing, cloud-based media services, and streaming technologies.

This role involves working with cross-functional engineering, operations, and partner teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and scalable streaming experiences. The candidate will also leverage scripting, automation, and AI-powered tools to improve operational efficiency, accelerate troubleshooting, and streamline engineering workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Audio and Video Encoding: Design, configure, troubleshoot, and optimize live video encoding workflows, including video codecs, audio formats, bitrate profiles, frame rates, resolutions, HDR, and adaptive bitrate (ABR) streaming.
  • AWS Media Services: Configure and manage AWS Elemental MediaLive and related AWS media services to support live video processing, encoding, and delivery workflows.
  • Live Streaming Operations: Support live and linear streaming pipelines, investigate video and audio quality issues, and ensure reliable delivery during high-profile live events.
  • Streaming Protocols and Formats: Work with HLS, MPEG-DASH, CMAF, MPEG-TS, and related streaming technologies, including manifest analysis, segment validation, and playback troubleshooting.
  • Automation and Scripting: Develop scripts and tools using Python, Bash, or similar languages to automate operational tasks, validate streaming configurations, analyze logs, monitor workflows, and reduce manual effort.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Apply AI-powered tools and coding assistants to accelerate script development, automate repetitive tasks, analyze logs, assist with troubleshooting, and improve engineering productivity.
  • Monitoring and Reliability: Develop and improve monitoring, alerting, diagnostics, and automated health checks to identify issues proactively and improve service reliability.
  • Performance and Cost Optimization: Analyze encoding performance, resource utilization, latency, bitrate efficiency, and cloud infrastructure costs to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Incident Management: Participate in troubleshooting production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, document findings, and implement preventive measures.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with software engineering, SRE, QA, video operations, and external technology vendors to test, qualify, deploy, and maintain streaming platform enhancements.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides, and share knowledge across engineering and operations teams
  • 5+ years of experience in video streaming, broadcast engineering, media processing, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Strong understanding of audio and video encoding concepts, codecs, compression, bitrate control, frame rates, resolution, and audio/video synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Media Services, MediaKind VOS360, Ateme, or other cloud-based vendors used for encoding and packaging Experience with live streaming workflows and protocols such as HLS and MPEG-DASH.
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, or another scripting language for automation and troubleshooting.
  • Experience analyzing streaming manifests, media segments, encoding logs, and playback issues.
  • Understanding of live streaming reliability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production incident management.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve coding productivity, automate workflows, or accelerate technical problem-solving.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, communication, and collaboration skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with AWS Elemental MediaPackage, MediaConnect, MediaTailor, CloudWatch, and related AWS services.
  • Familiarity with FFmpeg, media probing tools, and automated audio/video quality validation.
  • Knowledge of HEVC/H.265, AVC/H.264, AV1, AAC, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby Vision, HDR10, or other modern media formats.
  • Experience with low-latency streaming, live event delivery, adaptive bitrate ladders, and content protection/DRM.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, APIs, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and configuration management.
  • Experience developing AI-assisted operational tools, log-analysis workflows, intelligent alerting, or automated incident diagnostics.
  • Experience supporting large-scale live sports, entertainment, or broadcast streaming events.
  • Knowledge with Server Side Ad insertion (SSAI), transcoding and packaging

What’s In It For You?

  • Working for a well-known, globally leading Media Streaming organization
  • Exposure to high-level business professionals in a variety of departments and geographic locations
  • Opportunity to work and grow your career in fast-paced environment

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. NBC News seeks a Vice President to join the Standards & Practices team in Washington, D.C., and provide enterprise-level leadership, strategic counsel, and editorial guidance across all platforms of NBC News Group. The Vice President will serve as a senior advisor to newsroom and business leaders, helping ensure that journalism is accurate, fair, ethical, legally sound, and aligned with NBC News editorial values and compliance requirements. 

This leader will shape and oversee standards strategy, guide high-risk and high-profile editorial decisions, strengthen consistent practices across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, and emerging platforms, and build a culture of sound editorial judgment throughout the organization. 

Job Duties 

• Provide strategic leadership for News Standards & Practices across NBC News Group platforms, acting as a trusted advisor to senior newsroom executives and editorial leaders. 

• Advise on high-profile, complex, sensitive, and rapidly developing stories, including questions involving accuracy, fairness, sourcing, conflicts of interest, privacy, graphic content, user-generated material, and other editorial risks. 

• Consult with newsgathering teams on anonymous sourcing, ensuring consistent approval processes and ethical decision making on sensitive stories.  

• Exercise senior editorial judgment during breaking news, investigative reporting, live coverage, long-form journalism, and other high-pressure situations. 

• Lead the development, governance, interpretation, and consistent application of division-wide news standards, policies, and guidelines. 

• Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Human Resources, Communications, Security, and other functions on matters with significant editorial, reputational, regulatory, or employee implications. 

• Build strong relationships with leaders and teams across broadcast, cable, streaming, digital, social, and direct-to-consumer platforms, with particular emphasis on digital and OTT operations. 

• Anticipate emerging editorial risks and advise leadership on newsgathering practices, technology, artificial intelligence, social media, audience engagement, and evolving forms of storytelling. 

• Create scalable resources, decision frameworks, and escalation protocols that enable timely, consistent, and well-documented editorial decisions. 

• Lead, mentor, and develop Standards & Practices team members and foster a collaborative, responsive, and solutions-oriented culture. 

• Represent News Standards in senior-level planning and cross-functional discussions, clearly communicating risks, options, and recommendations. 

• Handle confidential and privileged matters with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.

• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, English, History, or a related field of study, or equivalent professional experience. 

• 15+ years of experience in broadcast, cable, digital, or multiplatform news, including significant leadership or management experience. 

• Demonstrated experience making or advising on complex editorial decisions in a major news organization. 

• Substantial experience across breaking news, day-of-air production, long-form journalism, investigative reporting, or digital news operations. 

• Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior executives, newsroom leaders, journalists, producers, editors, and on-air talent. 

• Experience leading teams, developing talent, and driving consistent practices across a complex organization. 

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues clearly and concisely. 

Additional Job Requirements 

• Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered. 

• This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

• Must be available to work evenings, weekends, and during breaking news or other urgent editorial situations, as needed. 

• Must be willing and able to travel occasionally, as business needs require. 

Desired Qualifications 

•  Exceptional news judgment and a strong command of journalistic ethics, sourcing, fairness, accuracy, and editorial risk management. 

• Ability to remain calm, decisive, and solutions-focused in high-pressure and time-sensitive environments. 

• Deep experience with investigative journalism, enterprise reporting, live news, or high-risk editorial review. 

• Expertise in digital journalism, streaming, social media, user-generated content, and emerging technology standards and practices. 

• Demonstrated success establishing or modernizing editorial policies, training programs, and governance processes at scale. 

• Ability to balance editorial independence, speed, audience needs, legal considerations, and reputational risk while preserving sound journalistic principles. 

• Strong executive presence, business ethics, diplomacy, and the ability to build trust across different functions and levels of the organization. 

• A forward-looking approach to new technology and evolving storytelling formats, including the responsible use of artificial intelligence in journalism. 

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple urgent and confidential matters without sacrificing judgment or quality.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $200,000 - $250,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible)

Buffalo Toronto Public Media is your local source for television and radio -

WNED PBS, WNED PBS KIDS, WNED Create, WBFO NPR, WNED Classical, and WBFO The Bridge!

We reach Western New York and Southern Ontario and can be streamed from your favorite device.

Engaging our communities through exploration and entertainment-everywhere.


We're looking for a Broadcast Systems Engineer!


What you'll be doing:

The Broadcast Systems Engineer is a member of the Tech Team responsible for the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting and integration of broadcast and broadcast IT systems supporting BTPM's radio and broadcast operations and systems design. This position serves as a technical bridge between traditional broadcast engineering and increasingly IP-, network- and software-based broadcast infrastructure. The position independently supports radio automation, Audio over IP (AoIP), streaming, broadcast applications, network-connected equipment and related systems while implementing and maintaining transmission and other broadcast infrastructure. This position can be hybrid - a blend of remote and in-office work. In summary, this individual will:

  • Perform the daily operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of broadcast systems and related IT infrastructure, including radio automation, AoIP systems, streaming platforms, digital audio systems, and network connected broadcast equipment and infrastructure
  • Perform installations, removal, configuration, testing, labeling, documentation, and maintenance of broadcast hardware and software, including workstations, servers, audio interfaces, codecs, processors, and other IP connected broadcast devices
  • Support and maintain internet radio streaming, enhanced HD Radio features, metadata delivery, and other digital broadcast services
  • Apply established broadcast audio practices, operating procedures, signal flow, cabling, patching, routing, inventories, and system and equipment configuration; develops and maintains technical documentation accordingly
  • Support broadcast network infrastructure, including IP addressing, VLANs, switches, routing concepts, network connectivity, and troubleshooting in coordination with IT personnel
  • Administer and support radio broadcast applications as assigned, including ENCO automation, Marketron Radio Traffic, NPR Composer, audio editing applications, streaming systems, and other software platforms
  • Troubleshoot broadcast signal paths and system failures across traditional audio, IP, software, and network environments; identifies root causes and implements corrective action
  • Perform transmitter, studio, microwave, satellite, and remote site maintenance activities as assigned, including preparation, documentation, and routine checks
  • Monitor system performance and reliability and performs preventive maintenance, software and firmware updates, backups, and other routine system maintenance
  • Participate in broadcast technology projects, system upgrades, equipment replacements, and integration of new technologies; maintain current knowledge of evolving broadcast technologies, broadcast IT systems, equipment, software, and applicable industry standards
  • Provide technical support and instruction to staff regarding broadcast systems, automation, and technical workflows
  • Coordinate with IT and Engineering personnel to maintain reliable, secure, and compatible broadcast technology environments.
  • Respond to broadcast outages and other urgent technical issues and participate in after hours or on call support as operationally required
  • Participate in scheduled training and hands on development in broadcast engineering practices, equipment, software, safety procedures, and industry standards
  • Follow established safety procedures and maintains knowledge of FCC requirements and applicable broadcast technical standards

What you'll need:

  • Minimum of Associate's degree (Bachelor's preferred) broadcast engineering, electronics, information technology, media technology, networking or related field; equivalent relevant industry/military experience or certifications considered
  • Minimum four (4) years of progressively responsible experience in broadcast engineering, broadcast technology or related technical operations
  • Demonstrated ability to independently install, configure, maintain and troubleshoot broadcast systems and equipment
  • Working knowledge of IP networking concepts including TCP/IP, addressing, VLANs, switching, routing and network troubleshooting
  • Demonstrated experience with AoIP and network-connected broadcast systems
  • Experience supporting Windows-based computers, servers and software applications in a broadcast environment
  • Working knowledge of radio automation, traffic, streaming and digital content-delivery systems.
  • Familiarity with RF transmission systems, transmitters, translators, STL systems and related broadcast infrastructure
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex problems involving multiple interconnected hardware, software, network and broadcast systems
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, system diagrams and signal-flow documentation
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to independently prioritize urgent technical and operational needs
  • Knowledge of FCC broadcast rules and regulations
  • Ability to work collaboratively across Engineering, IT, Programming/Content and other operational departments
  • Authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Current, valid driver's license

Why BTPM?

Because we're awesome! You won't find a better group of talented, energetic people dedicated to quality content and reaching the various communities of our region. We are proud of our culture and promote a realistic balance of both work and personal life. Our benefits package is fantastic and we have free parking!


Salary and Benefits:

This is a full-time, non-exempt hourly position and starting pay will be based on education, experience and interview. Starting range: $23.38 - $29.23 per hour.

  • 12 paid holidays
  • 3 weeks of paid Vacation
  • Sick time (accrued)
  • Medical, Dental, Life, Vision Short- & Long-Term Disability insurance options
  • Health Savings Account (for applicable plans) with employer contribution
  • Flex Spending Account option
  • Voluntary Life, Accident, Critical Illness coverage options
  • Identity Protection option
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Assistance (based on eligibility)
  • Retirement Plan with 7.5% employer match (based on eligibility)

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse.


Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next.


We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join our technology team and work on the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with a focus on infrastructure services, data pipelines, and identity enrichment. Along the way you’ll also participate in the product development of data-dependent systems such as AI answer services, personalization systems, machine learning, and audience services.


You will build and maintain the foundational data services that power analytics and machine learning for our newsroom, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge thoughtful digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside senior engineers, product managers, and data teams, contributing to high-performance systems.


Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate cloud-based data pipelines supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps, and information services.
  • Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery inside AWS and GCP.
  • Develop and maintain data ETL pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code (Python preferred).
  • Collaborate with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs.
  • Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems.
  • Write and present ideas clearly. Document functional requirements for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and agile sprint ceremonies.

Qualifications:

Must-Haves

  • MS or BS in computer science, or related field.
  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark
  • Working knowledge of common AWS and/or GCP services
  • Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools)
  • Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
  • Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tooling, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies.
  • Familiarity with web standards and protocols.
  • Comfort with code reviews, writing unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and exposure to end-to-end testing frameworks.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, thoroughness, and an eagerness to learn.
  • Proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Great-to-Have Experience

  • Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries.
  • Exposure to personalization and recommendation systems.
  • Comfortable with the CLI, Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc.
  • Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.)
  • Familiarity with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices.
  • Scaling techniques in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshooting and debugging experience with internet services.
  • Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus)

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change).


Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. EEO/Disabled/Vets

Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at humanresources@newscorp.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.


Base Pay Range: $85,000 - $115,000

We’re committed to offering competitive and flexible compensation to attract top talent. This pay range reflects our good faith estimate for the role and may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, and other relevant factors.


For bonus-eligible roles, targets are determined based on multiple considerations, including market benchmarks and individual contributions.


For benefits-eligible roles, we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package covering health, retirement, wellbeing, and more, along with optional benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees

job.title: Part-Time Editor
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

The NY Post is looking for an experienced editor for a part-time role (16-24 hours per week) with the Sunday staff. The editor is expected to be a line and assignment editor who possesses fine attention to detail, critical thinking skills, and who can also aggressively transform breaking copy on deadline to sing in The Post's unique tabloid voice.

The editor should be able to mine, assign and edit an array of stories -- impactful, quirky, scandalous, etc. -- on immediate deadline for our website, and also for the Sunday print edition. The editor must be able to give clear direction to our team of award-winning field reporters and in-office journos.

The Sunday team breaks local, national and international news, investigates government corruption, crushes hypocrisy wherever we find it, mines the world for the quirky and the funny, and delivers award-winning, long- and short-form journalism in the boldest tabloid voice.

The NY Post is the nation’s 5th-largest U.S. newspaper by circulation and its website routinely generates tens of millions of pageviews every weekend. The ability to handle anything from a breaking brief to a sprawling news feature, in a wide range of subjects, is needed. And you’ll even get to spitball with the rest of us on our world-famous Page 1 headlines.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher
  • A minimum of 5 years of editing in a busy newsroom
  • Comfortable editing/re-writing both breaking news and long-form stories in lively tabloid prose for web and print
  • A keen understanding of the voice of the Post
  • A knack for finding stories our readers crave
  • A critical eye for facts and tone
  • Broad knowledge base
  • Willingness to collaborate and ability to communicate with a close-knit team of NYC’s best journalists

Note: This position requires onsite work in our Midtown Manhattan office 1–2 days per week, with a regular Friday–Saturday schedule.

The California Post’s Photo Department is integral to our fast-paced newsroom, working across platforms to enhance storytelling with compelling and timely imagery. The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

The New York Post is seeking a talented and creative Part-Time Social Media Editor, Sports (24 hours per week) to join our social team. The ideal candidate will be deeply engaged in the social landscape, skilled in video editing, fluent in emerging trends, and adept at producing compelling content that connects with a broad, news-driven audience.

  • Strong news judgment, with excellent writing and copy-editing skills, ensuring accuracy and clarity in all published content.

job.title: Prepress Technician
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment and pop culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225+ years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


We are looking for a Prepress Technician to join our Prepress Operations team. In this role, you'll play a critical part in our daily newspaper production process, ensuring editorial pages are accurately prepared, technically reviewed, and transmitted to print facilities on time.


The ideal candidate has experience working in a newspaper production environment and understands the fast-paced, deadline-driven nature of daily print publishing. This role requires familiarity with newspaper pagination, production workflows, and print transmission processes.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the transmission of newspaper pages to all print sites, troubleshoot transmission systems, and distribute production schedules.
  • Maintain communication with print sites regarding production updates, deadlines, and page adjustments.
  • Monitor newspaper pages for technical errors and quality issues, coordinating necessary corrections to ensure accuracy and adherence to print deadlines.
  • Track production times and maintain detailed reports.
  • Foster strong, collaborative relationships with editorial staff and photo editors to support daily newspaper production and ensure effective communication.
  • Build and maintain page plans within newspaper production systems according to editorial specifications.
  • Stay current with departmental workflows, procedures, and emerging newspaper production technologies.
  • Proactively suggest improvements to existing processes to enhance production efficiency.

Requirements:

  • 1+ years of experience in newspaper production or prepress operations required.
  • Working knowledge of newspaper pagination, page transmission systems, and troubleshooting production or output issues.
  • Understanding of daily newspaper production workflows, editorial deadlines, and print production requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to monitor pages for technical and quality errors under deadline pressure.
  • Experience with newspaper pagination systems, such as Methode and NewswayX, preferred.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with editorial and production staff.
  • Strong time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize complex or high-scrutiny work under tight deadlines.
  • A proactive approach to process improvement and staying current with emerging prepress technologies.

Note: This role will work five days per week, including one weekend day. Shifts may vary and are expected to fall within the following timeframes: 1:00 p.m.–9:00 p.m., 4:00 p.m.–12:00 a.m., or 6:30 p.m.–2:30 a.m. EST.

job.title: Reporter, Page Six Hollywood
job.description:
Job Description:


Page Six Hollywood is a distinct brand covering the business of Hollywood and the wider entertainment industry. We are looking for a resourceful, well-connected Los Angeles-based Reporter who understands the city’s cultural and industry landscape and knows how to turn access, relationships and firsthand experiences into compelling stories. 


The ideal candidate is plugged-in, energetic and naturally curious, with a genuine feel for the people, places and relationships that make Hollywood tick. Equally comfortable at a film screening, an industry party, a nightclub, an art gallery opening or a major Hollywood event, they will have a strong instinct for what matters, an eye for interesting characters and the ability to develop meaningful original journalism across written, video and social platforms. Strong writing and reporting skills are essential; on-camera confidence, social media fluency and experience creating content across multiple formats are major advantages.



Key Responsibilities:

  • On-the-Ground Reporting: Build a regular presence at events across Los Angeles, from premieres and screenings to industry parties, clubs, gallery openings, cultural gatherings and entertainment business functions, identifying opportunities for original reporting.
  • Hollywood and LA Knowledge: Demonstrate a strong understanding of Los Angeles, its cultural scene and the people and networks shaping the entertainment industry, including executives, talent, agents, producers, creatives and emerging industry figures.
  • Original Story Development: Turn conversations, observations, relationships and access into distinctive stories, uncovering the personalities, trends, tensions and developments shaping the business and culture of Hollywood.
  • Relationship Building and Access: Develop and maintain a broad network of useful contacts across the entertainment industry, nightlife, arts, media and Hollywood’s wider professional and social circles, building trust while pursuing original reporting.
  • Business of Entertainment Coverage: Look beyond the red carpet to identify stories about the commercial, creative and cultural forces shaping Hollywood, from industry dealmaking and changing business models to the people and places influencing its future.
  • Writing and Storytelling: Produce sharp, engaging copy in the distinctive Page Six Hollywood voice, combining strong reporting, vivid detail, original observations and an instinct for what will resonate with readers.
  • Event Coverage and Editorial Initiative: Identify worthwhile events to attend, make the most of opportunities on the ground and proactively pitch story ideas, ensuring coverage delivers original insight rather than simply documenting who was present.
  • On-Camera Reporting: Ideally be confident and engaging on camera, conducting interviews, capturing reactions and delivering concise, personality-driven pieces that bring Page Six Hollywood’s reporting to life.
  • Social and Multi-Platform Content: Understand how to identify and create compelling social media content, including short-form video, interviews, behind-the-scenes footage and other material that extends the reach of original reporting across platforms.
  • Collaboration and Editorial Judgment: Work closely with editors and colleagues to develop story ideas, verify information, identify follow-up opportunities and adapt reporting for newsletters, digital articles, video and social formats, while maintaining strong editorial standards.

Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience in journalism, reporting, entertainment writing, or a related editorial role, preferably covering Hollywood, entertainment, media, or culture.
  • Strong knowledge of Los Angeles, its entertainment industry, cultural landscape, nightlife and social scene.
  • Established relationships and contacts across the entertainment industry, including executives, talent, agents, publicists, producers, creatives and other influential industry figures.
  • Exceptional writing, reporting, interviewing, sourcing and fact-checking skills, with the ability to produce engaging, accurate and well-researched stories.
  • Strong news judgment and a natural instinct for identifying newsworthy moments, developing original story angles and uncovering stories others may overlook.
  • Familiarity with digital publishing and social media platforms, including the ability to identify and create engaging content for digital, video and social audiences.
  • Experience with short-form video, on-camera interviews or other multimedia storytelling is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, to cover premieres, industry events, parties and breaking entertainment news.
  • Must be based in or within commuting distance of Los Angeles, with the ability to regularly attend in-person events throughout the region.

Note: This role will be based in our Century City office, with regular field reporting and attendance at events throughout Los Angeles. All work arrangements are subject to change based on business needs.

job.title: Vice President, Strategy & Business Transformation
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. 


Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. 


We are seeking an experienced, highly analytical, and execution-oriented Vice President, Strategy & Business Transformation. In this role, the incumbent will work closely with the Chief Technology & Strategy Officer and the senior leadership team to build and operationalize enterprise capabilities. Key responsibilities include translating strategic priorities into actionable business decisions, aligning resources around our highest-value opportunities, and driving measurable results.

 

This is a highly visible, hands-on role for a strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between executive-level problem-solving and practical implementation. The successful candidate will help establish the frameworks, processes, governance, and operating rhythms that enable leaders to make informed decisions, prioritize investments, manage competing resources, and accelerate strategic initiatives.

 

The ideal candidate combines the analytical rigor of a management consultant with the pragmatism of an operator. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, influencing senior stakeholders, and turning complex business questions into clear recommendations and measurable outcomes.


Importantly, this role serves as an enabler and facilitator of enterprise strategy. Business leaders retain accountability for decisions and execution within their respective functions.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Enterprise Strategy & Executive Alignment

  • Partner with the Chief Technology & Strategy Officer and executive leadership to translate the enterprise operating model into actionable priorities, processes, and governance.
  • Facilitate executive alignment on strategic priorities, organizational objectives, decision rights, and resource allocation.
  • Help define the Strategy Team’s mandate, operating model, engagement approach, and partnership with business functions.
  • Prepare executive presentations, decision briefs, and recommendations to support critical business decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen cross-functional alignment and accelerate enterprise-wide initiatives.

 

Strategic Portfolio & Initiative Management

  • Establish and maintain a consolidated view of enterprise initiatives, strategic investments, resources, ownership, milestones, and expected business outcomes.
  • Develop consistent evaluation frameworks to assess initiatives based on strategic alignment, financial and operational value, ownership, and execution capacity.
  • Facilitate portfolio reviews and recommend opportunities to accelerate, continue, sequence, redesign, or discontinue initiatives.
  • Identify resource constraints, competing priorities, dependencies, and opportunities to redirect capacity toward higher-value business objectives.
  • Establish transparent portfolio reporting and tracking mechanisms.

 

Business Strategy & Decision Support

  • Lead and support high-priority strategic engagements across the organization, translating complex business questions into actionable recommendations.
  • Develop business cases, financial analyses, scenario models, and strategic assessments to inform investment and resource decisions.
  • Create structured decision-making frameworks that clearly outline business questions, supporting evidence, alternatives, financial implications, risks, and recommendations.
  • Work backward from defined decision milestones to ensure strategic engagements produce timely, actionable outcomes.
  • Challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational effectiveness, and organizational alignment.

 

Strategy Operations & Governance

  • Design and implement the Strategy Team’s operating processes, including initiative intake, prioritization, engagement selection, and delivery tracking.
  • Establish and facilitate regular enterprise strategy reviews, portfolio reviews, and executive decision forums.
  • Develop governance tools, templates, decision logs, dashboards, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Clarify roles and responsibilities across executive sponsors, initiative owners, working teams, and decision-makers.
  • Streamline existing reporting and meeting structures to improve decision velocity and reduce unnecessary administrative processes.

 

Enterprise Performance & Organizational Effectiveness

  • Partner with Finance, Human Resources, Technology, Product, Editorial, and Revenue leadership to connect enterprise strategy with financial investment, organizational capacity, and business performance.
  • Develop an enterprise scorecard and key performance indicators to measure strategic progress, financial impact, execution, audience growth, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Monitor initiative performance, identify barriers to execution, and facilitate timely resolution of cross-functional issues.
  • Support change management and organizational adoption of new strategy processes and operating practices.
  • Build the capabilities, tools, and knowledge transfer necessary to establish a sustainable Strategy Operations function.

 

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Strategy, or a related discipline; advanced degree or MBA preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, business operations, enterprise transformation, or strategy execution.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise prioritization, portfolio management, and strategic operating frameworks.
  • Strong financial acumen, including business case development, financial modeling, investment analysis, and resource planning.
  • Proven ability to partner with CEOs, C-suite executives, and senior functional leaders.
  • Experience facilitating complex business discussions, challenging assumptions, and navigating competing priorities and resource tradeoffs.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, executive communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex information and ambiguity into concise insights, options, and actionable recommendations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
  • Media, digital publishing, advertising, audience development, subscription, product, or technology experience strongly preferred.

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change).

Sales Director, Sponsorship

About the Role

New York Public Radio is seeking an experienced, results-driven Sales Director to join our Sponsorship team and drive revenue growth across NYPR’s portfolio of brands, programming, and platforms. Reporting to the VP of Sponsorship, the Sales Director will lead and manage a team of five sellers while maintaining a strong focus on revenue growth, new business development, and strategic client and agency relationships. The Sales Director will develop and grow relationships with advertisers and agency partners, identify new business opportunities, and create integrated sponsorship solutions that connect brands with NYPR’s audiences. This role will sell across NYPR’s sponsorship portfolio, including audio, digital, events, and custom content opportunities. The ideal candidate is a strategic and consultative seller who combines strong business development skills with excellent client relationship management and a deep understanding of the evolving media and advertising landscape. The Sales Director will work collaboratively across the organization to develop compelling solutions that meet advertiser objectives while supporting NYPR’s revenue goals.

Responsibilities

Drive Revenue Growth Drive sponsorship revenue across NYPR’s portfolio through new business development, expansion of existing accounts, and strategic agency relationships. Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve individual and departmental revenue objectives. Build and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective advertisers and agency partners. Identify new client categories, prospects, and market opportunities that can expand NYPR’s sponsorship business. Develop strategic account plans for priority clients and agencies. Maintain accurate forecasts and actively manage opportunities through all stages of the sales pipeline. Monitor advertising, media, and client trends to identify emerging revenue opportunities. Build Client & Agency Relationships Develop and maintain strong relationships with senior decision-makers across brands, advertising agencies, media agencies, and other prospective partners. Represent NYPR Sponsorship in the advertising marketplace and build awareness of NYPR’s value to advertisers. Lead client meetings, presentations, negotiations, and strategic business discussions.
