job.title: New York Public Radio Careers
job.description:
Producer, Radiolab Radiolab, pioneer of narrative nonfiction podcasting, is seeking a full-time Producer to join the team. Radiolab producers take ideas from pitch to broadcast, participating in all parts of the production process. We’re seeking an ambitious, deep-thinking, deep-feeling journalist who is obsessed with great stories, eager to help our team tackle the big questions facing our world today. The Producer will spend much of their time deep in tape, sorting through vast amounts of audio, crafting the arc of the episode in ProTools, and building out the story. They will work closely with the editorial team, making new drafts of episodes. Sometimes the Producer will work on ideas they’ve pitched; oftentimes they’ll produce other team member’s work. The Producer will help craft the soundscape of the show.

Key Responsibilities

Regularly produce episodes from pitch to broadcast with minimal support Find, pitch more ambitious, nuanced, and successful story ideas Develop the arc of an episodes and craft narratives, with minimal editorial support Executing notes from editors on new drafts of episodes Cut interview selects and tracking tape Source archival tape Research for story ideas, booking guests, arranging logistics (ie ISDN, travel) Pre-interview, book potential guests, engineer in-studio interviews and tracking Perform field reporting and/or recording Conceive of storyboards with the team Write narration and craft the sound design/soundscape of episodes. Create new drafts of episodes in ProTools, experimenting relentlessly with story construction Liaise with fact checker for episodes Write and produce content for web, newsletter, and other platforms as needed Key

Qualifications

At least five years

experience

producing, reporting and/or editing in long-form narrative audio, and/or comparable

experience

in a related field Preferably has

experience

creating stories similar to the ones heard on Radiolab Has a clear grasp of what makes a surprising, impactful and complicated story that could be heard on Radiolab Has a proven ability to develop story arc and narrative Has solid journalism skills including: interviewing, database research and fact checking Has

experience

with linear editing software (ProTools, Logic, et cetera), and an advanced understanding of sound design Sense of humor and musicality are a plus It's important on the Radiolab team for everyone to work hard, be willing to pitch in on whatever is needed to get the job done, have an open mind, demonstrate integrity in their journalism, be wildly curious, and not be afraid to be a little bit weird. Additional Information This is a full-time non-exempt position with a salary range of $87,771-$95,000 and includes eligibility for medical, dental and vision insurance through SAG-AFTRA. This role is based in New York City and is expected to work at our NYC Headquarters two days per week. This position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement between New York Public Radio and SAG-AFTRA. Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion New York Public Radio is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We continuously strive to place our employees at the center of our thinking and elevate inclusive practices to develop and support a more engaged and productive workforce. Our journalism and operations in the service of that journalism benefit from a broad range of perspectives, from all backgrounds, at all levels of the organization. Diversity is essential to honest, authentic, accurate storytelling and reportage; creating an institution in which all voices are encouraged, valued, and heard. equal opportunity employer

committed to achieving the goal of equal employment opportunity for all. Applicants and employees are considered and evaluated for positions without regard to mental or physical disability, race, creed, color, religion, gender, national origin, citizenship status, age, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, employment status or any protected federal, state or local status unrelated to the performance of the work involved. About Radiolab: Created in 2002 by host Jad Abumrad, and now co-hosted by Lulu Miller and Latif Nasser, Radiolab began as an exploration of science, philosophy, and ethics using innovative composition and sound design. Radiolab has expanded and evolved to become a platform for long-form journalism and storytelling. The show challenges its listeners’ preconceived notions about how the world works. Radiolab provokes, it moves, it delights, and it asks its audience to see the world around them anew. In the past year, the show released a series on a Guantanamo Bay detainee named Latif Nasser; covered the pandemic (by looking at the present and the past); composed an experimental non-narrative meditation on the end of the world; reported out topical stories on the power of protest (here and here, too), the risk of Donald Trump trying to steal the election, the

responsibilities

of the police (and lack thereof); and escaped to the bottom of the sea to spend time with an octomom. Since its founding nearly two decades ago, Radiolab has won some of the most prestigious awards in journalism, including two George Foster Peabody Awards, Third Coast awards, The Silver Gavel, as well as other accolades. In 2011 Abumrad received the MacArthur Genius grant. The show has spawned successful spinoff series, like More Perfect, Gonads, The Other Latif, G, Border Trilogy, and Radiolab for Kids. job.description:
A-hed Deputy Editor - Dow Jones A-hed Deputy Editor Dow Jones New York, NY Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Job Description: A-hed Deputy Editor The Wall Street Journal New York City, Full-time

About the Role

The A-hed is one of the most beloved and distinctive features in The Wall Street Journal—the whimsical, front-page story that interrupts the day’s headlines with an arresting and creative tale. We’re looking for an experienced editor to shape and champion these stories: an editor with the judgment to spot a great idea in the wild, the skill to shepherd it from pitch to a polished, dynamic finished piece, and the newsroom relationships to pull great stories from every team. You will report to the Exchange & A-hed Editor on the Features team in New York, and also help edit business features and columns for Exchange. The ideal candidate is a self-starting editor experienced in news-feature editing with proven success producing highly engaging and visual digital-first stories across coverage areas. Stories from the Features team offer a lively lens on the zeitgeist, drawing connections between events and trends in the culture to form original, big-picture theses about the present moment.

What You’ll Do

Edit A-heds—which publish once daily—from pitch to publication, working closely with reporters to sharpen structure, voice and the reporting detail that makes a story sing. Solicit and develop ideas from reporters and editors across the entire newsroom, building a steady pipeline of distinctive stories. Coach reporters, some of whom may be writing their first A-hed, on the craft of the form. Exercise sharp news judgment about which stories work in the day’s mix could be refashioned as an A-hed. Collaborate with the news hub and Page One team on timing, print close and story mix with the rest of the Journal's daily report. Maintain and grow relationships across the newsroom so that good A-hed material reaches you early and often. Help maintain the consistency, surprise and delight that readers have come to expect from the fixture over its many decades. Contribute to other features editing and features projects as needed and assigned Who You Are An editor with 10+ years of

experience

and a strong track record of developing and editing narrative, feature, or enterprise journalism. Widely read and curious across many subjects—business, culture, science, sports, politics and global affairs. Possessed of real energy and enthusiasm for the unexpected, with an instinct for the story idea or headline that makes it to the group chat. A sharp, skilled line-editor of newswriting with a sense for wit, pacing, structure and well-placed reporting detail. Collaborative and relationship-driven, with the interpersonal skills to work across the entire newsroom and Features team. Strong, sound judgment on reporting scruples, legal considerations and tone, making sure every A-hed is meticulously bulletproofed and adherent to overall Wall Street Journal reporting standards. Organized and ready to manage a steady pipeline of stories at different stages, from early pitch to final polish, and take responsibility for managing a robust backlist and active calendar of stable options. How to Apply Please submit a resume, cover letter, and up to five editing samples (ideally including any feature, narrative, or humor writing you've shaped) by December 5th.

Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition. Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

About the Role

As Director - Ethylene Oxide & Derivatives Research & Analysis, you will lead coverage and research across Ethylene Oxide (EO), Ethylene Glycol (MEG/DEG/TEG), Ethoxylate surfactants, Ethanolamines, e-series Glycol Ethers, and related chemical derivatives. You will provide critical commercial, technical, and economic analysis to help clients navigate regional and global EO/EG dynamics. You will report to the Executive Director - Research & Analysis. You Will: Act as the regional focal point and lead analyst for the Americas Ethylene Oxide and derivative value chain, delivering written market commentary, price forecasts, and strategic analyses Maintain and refine quantitative models for short-term and long-term supply/demand balances, unit production cash costs, margin calculations, and capacity tracking for EO and its downstream derivatives Monitor fundamental drivers including ethylene feedstock dynamics, industrial gas integration, regional capacity additions, and regulatory/environmental factors affecting EO manufacturing and distribution Support and expand the client base by delivering routine briefings, engaging in private client discussions, and identifying growth opportunities for Market Advisory Services Collaborate with the global Olefins and Petrochemical research teams to ensure alignment on global trade balances, cost curves, and cross-regional pricing trends Assists the Bespoke Research/Single-Client Consulting group on tailored projects covering asset feasibility, market entry strategy, and supply-chain risk assessments Guide and mentor junior analysts, fostering rigorous research practices and supporting professional development You Have: 10+ years’ commercial or operational

experience

in the chemical industry (within Ethylene Oxide, Glycols, Surfactants, or downstream specialty/performance chemicals is a plus) Strong technical understanding of steam cracker integration, EO safety/logistics, oxide derivatives, and end-use application drivers (antifreeze, PET, detergents, industrial applications) Proven capability in quantitative analysis, econometric price forecasting, and supply-chain modeling Ability to represent the company at key industry conferences and client meetings Knowledge of data analytics tools (Python, VBA, PowerBI a plus) Willingness to travel domestically and internationally Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Business, or related technical discipline -OR- MBA (a plus) -OR- equivalent

job.description:
Editor - HarperCollins Publishers Editor HarperCollins Publishers Nashville, TN Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results

Overview

HarperChristian Resources (HCR) is looking for an Editor to join our dynamic team. HCR creates original Bible study content and Bible study resources based on book content published by Thomas Nelson and Zondervan, as well as other Christian trade book publishers. We publish video Bible studies, Bible study guides, small group study guides, ministry programs, and church campaigns in both print and digital formats. In this position, you will work closely with the acquisitions editors, editors, and managing editor to copyedit final manuscripts of frontlist and some backlist titles. Youwill have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects and be responsible for keeping Bible studies on track as they move through the production process. The ideal candidate will be an organized, detail-oriented individual with strong editorial skills,an ability to discern when content might be confusing or repetitive for readers, and the skills to rewrite or phrase context to fix the problems. The candidate will also be an avid book reader and Bible study user who sharesHarperChristian Resources’ mission to equippeople to understand the Scriptures, cultivate spiritual growth, and live an inspired faith with Bible study and video resources from today’s most trusted voices. Our preference is to fill this position in Grand Rapids, MI or Nashville, TN but we are also open to qualified candidates that are located outside of the area. Travel may be required based on the need of the business.

Responsibilities

Handles the production editorial processin coordination with the acquisitions editors and managing editor from manuscript to final files for 24+ front-list titles a year, utilizing electronic workflow. Works closely with the acquisition editors and assesses manuscripts for copyediting and the styling of all design elements, using proprietary Microsoft Word styles for design and composition. Coordinates with the design teams and freelance editors, collates corrections from freelancers and authors, verifies that corrections have been made, and ensures timely delivery of final files to the printer. Develops excellent working relationships with colleagues, including acquisitions editors, marketing staff, production staff, designers, typesetters, and freelancers. Works with authors and agents to secure permissions, releases, and endorsements, as needed. Assists with various editions of assigned projects, including special editions, international editions, trade paper conversions, and derivative products. Copyedits flap and cover copy and helps proofread and check all stages of jacket/cover proofs as needed. Assists with updating reprint corrections as needed. Attends and contributes to production and other related meetings.

Qualifications

Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat. Expertise in Chicago Manual of Style and/or Christian Writers Manual of Style. A strong grasp of proper English, grammar, and an eagle-eye for errors. Editing experience, including substantive editing, editorial project management, and speaking into aesthetics and design Personal

experience

in leading or participating in a small group and/or Bible study, preferred. Good understanding of the Bible and Christian doctrine, preferred. Understanding the role of the church and ministry for publishing Bible study resources, preferred. Work

Experience

Minimum 3 years’ editorial experience, preferably in trade book publishing.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in English, journalism, or related field. Other majors are welcome when combined with relevant experience. Industry Knowledge: Keeps up with trends in the publishing industry by reading trade magazines, such as Publisher’s Weekly preferred; working knowledge of popular Christian books and authors a plus. Skills: Solid copyediting and proofreading skills; knowledge of industry standards. Must have the ability to shepherd multiple projects while maintaining high standards of quality and hitting deadlines. Strong interpersonal skills and a personal drive for excellence. Strategic and always able to understand the bigger picture. Enjoy working independently and as a member of a collaborative team. Detail oriented; eagle-eyed at catching errors. Able to learn new systems quickly, such as HarperCollins’ proprietary software for managing manuscripts. HarperCollins Christian Publishing is an equal opportunity employer. job.description:
GTM Associate Manager, Reputation Radar - Dow Jones GTM Associate Manager, Reputation Radar Dow Jones New York, NY Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Job Description: Why This Role Reputation Radar is sold, serviced and marketed by Dow Jones teams in New York, while product, engineering, data science and Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy sit with Storyful in Dublin. Today one person in Dublin covers both sides.That works for strategy, messaging, pricing and the Early Access Program, which all sit close to product. It does not work for the parts of GTM that depend on being in the room with sellers, customer success and Dow Jones marketing every day. Three things we cannot do today, and what this role unlocks: Sales and CES enablement inside Dow Jones:Reps and Customer Success (CS) Managers need someone they can grab before a call, sit with after a demo, and hand objections to the same day.This role gives Dow Jones sales and CS a named Rep Radar person in New York, and gives us a live read on sales sentiment to content. Campaigns through Dow Jones channels: Dow Jones B2B marketing, events and SDR teams run their own queues and priorities. Rep Radar competes for attention from Dublin by email. The role works those queues in person, turns GTM priorities into campaigns that ship through Dow Jones channels, creating the content, copy and assets as well as reports what they deliver. A structured competitive and customer insight loop: We track Signal AI, Meltwater, Cision, Brandwatch and Blackbird.AI ad hoc, and we run the risk of hearing about lost deals too late. This role owns competitive tracking, win/loss reporting, and the feedback path from sellers and customers back to product and messaging, so decisions on positioning and roadmap are made on evidence rather than anecdote. This position delivers complementary capacity enabling the Senior Product Marketing Manager to retain full ownership of launch strategy, while providing the local execution support required.

About the Role

Reputation Radar is a decision-grade reputation intelligence platform developed by Storyful and Dow Jones. Combining Factiva's licensed news archive with Storyful's human-verified social intelligence, it helps corporate affairs and communications leaders in financial services see and act on reputational risk. An invite-only Early Access Program is underway and general availability is scheduled for January 2027. Product, engineering and data science are led by Storyful in Dublin, alongside the Senior Product Marketing Manager who owns GTM strategy and the launch.Sales, customer success, revenue operations and B2B marketing are run by Dow Jones in New York. This role is Reputation Radar's presence inside the Dow Jones commercial organization. You will sit with the sellers, customer success managers and marketers who take Reputation Radar to market, make them effective, and bring what they learn back to the product and GTM team in Dublin. You will work in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days a week. What You Will Own Sales and customer success enablement Be the day-to-day Reputation Radar contact for Dow Jones sales and Customer Success in New York Support the build and maintenance of the enablement kit: pitch decks, demo scripts, ICP guides, battle cards and collateral sheets, working from the positioning and messaging set by the Senior PMM Run ongoing enablement cadence, and track which materials get used and which do not Join prospect and customer calls and feed what you hear into messaging, enablement and the product feedback loop Campaigns through Dow Jones channels Work directly with Dow Jones B2B marketing, events and SDR teams to turn Radar GTM priorities into campaigns that ship through Dow Jones channels and audiences Own the campaign calendar for Reputation Radar within Dow Jones marketing, including nurture email, webinars, events and paid or partner activity Coordinate campaign activation in addition to owning collateral production, supporting bandwidth across Dow Jones and Storyful teams Produce and version the collateral those campaigns need: web pages, executive summaries, one-pagers and event materials, on brand and on message Report campaign performance and pipeline contribution back to the Senior PMM and Dow Jones marketing leads, with recommendations on what to scale and what to stop Competitive and customer insight Own competitive tracking across named competitors, and publish a regular competitive brief for product, sales and marketing Run the win/loss program: liaise with sellers and analyze reports to understand our competitive position Work with the Senior PMM to turn the findings into sales enablement updates, messaging and roadmap input Support the structured feedback path from Dow Jones sales, CS and customers back to the Storyful product team, so market signal reaches roadmap and positioning decisions in a usable form Consolidate GTM performance data from Dow Jones systems (sales ops, rev ops, CES) into a single view for the Senior PMM and product leadership You Have 3-5 years of

in product marketing, demand generation, or related GTM roles, preferably in B2B SaaS, media intelligence, data, or risk management solutions Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, concise, polished deliverables independently A commercial mindset with an understanding of how Product Marketing supports Sales, Customer Success and Marketing to drive successful customer and commercial outcomes Proven adaptability and self-direction in matrixed environments with success navigating ambiguous reporting structures, partner effectively and drive progress Strong project management skills with a track record of creating transparent, accessible plans and progress tracking systems The willingness to work in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days each week Nice to Have

In this role, you will help expand how our solutions reach the market through a growing network of strategic partners, while working with teams across one of the industry's most trusted brands.

About the Role

Dow Jones is seeking a Risk & Compliance Partners Manager to help grow and strengthen our partner ecosystem across the Risk & Compliance business. This role is responsible for managing a portfolio of channel and integration partners, deepening strategic relationships, and driving commercial growth through coordinated go-to-market execution. The ideal candidate combines strong partner-management discipline with commercial judgment, cross-functional leadership, and a solid understanding of risk, compliance, financial crime, and third-party due diligence solutions is a plus. They will work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Commercial Policy, Legal, Operations, and technical teams to ensure partnerships are productive, scalable, and aligned with business goals. You Will: Own and manage a defined portfolio of Risk & Compliance partners, with accountability for relationship health, growth plans, and day-to-day engagement. Build and execute partner business plans designed to expand revenue, improve partner performance, and increase market reach. Identify, prioritize, and develop strategic channel opportunities that align with product, regional, and customer growth objectives. Lead regular business reviews with partners, track performance against agreed goals, and drive follow-through on commercial and operational actions. Coordinate joint go-to-market initiatives with internal stakeholders and partner organizations, including enablement, campaigns, pipeline development, and sales support. Work closely with Sales teams to support new opportunities, renewals, expansions, and complex partner-led deals. Evaluate new prospective partners, assess strategic fit, and support onboarding activities in collaboration with commercial, legal, and technical stakeholders. Develop strong knowledge of each partner's business model, target segments, product strengths, geographic footprint, and competitive positioning. Surface market feedback and partner insights to Product and Proposition teams to help inform roadmap priorities and packaging opportunities. Maintain accurate partner records, opportunity visibility, and reporting disciplines across internal systems and team processes. experience

in partner management, channel management, business development, account management, or strategic alliances.

working in risk, compliance, financial crime, regulatory technology, data, SaaS, or B2B information services. experience

managing multiple partners and initiatives at once. Comfort working across global, matrixed organizations with a high degree of collaboration and accountability. The Company comprises leading businesses across a range of media, including: news and information services, digital real estate services, book publishing, digital education, and sports programming and pay-tv distribution.

About the Role

We have an exciting and dynamic opportunity for a Senior Analyst on our Global Continual Service Improvement. This role partners with other members of the Infrastructure, ServiceNow and Operations teams as well as business units within North America and globally. The Senior Analyst, Continual Service Improvement position is responsible for implementing and assessing critical IT Service Management processes and is instrumental in managing processes to meet customer needs. This position is outcome driven and aims to optimize the customer

experience

and seek out continuous service improvement. The position requires the ability to multitask and work collaboratively across business units and within the Continual Service Improvement team. As a global organization, this position will work across geographies to manage global-centric processes including Incident Management, Problem Management, Request Management, Change Enablement, and many other facets of ITSM. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Continual Service Improvement within the Global Technology - Technology Operations.

Responsibilities

Drive end to end reactive and proactive Problem Management, including identification, prioritization, investigation, resolution, and closure. Support effective Change Enablement and Major Incident Management, improving change success rates, reducing service disruptions, and ensuring appropriate governance. Facilitate post-incident reviews and apply structured root cause analysis methodologies, including the "5 Whys," to drive permanent corrective actions. Lead operational reviews and stakeholder forums, prepare management presentations, and track risks, dependencies, decisions, and actions to closure. Leverage AI enabled ITSM capabilities for incident trend analysis, intelligent ticket correlation, root cause investigation, and improved investigation efficiency. Lead structured Continual Service Improvement initiatives to improve service maturity, operational efficiency, service quality, and customer experience. Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Database, Storage, Security, and vendor teams to resolve complex, cross domain service issues. Analyze incident trends, SLA performance, failed changes, capacity reports, and top call drivers to identify systemic issues and improvement opportunities. Maintain and enhance the Known Error Database, ensuring investigation findings, known errors, workarounds, and resolutions are accurately documented. Develop and maintain operational and executive dashboards highlighting service health, emerging risks, performance trends, improvement opportunities, and remediation progress. Key Requirements: Strong expertise in enterprise ITSM, particularly Problem & Change Enablement and Continual Service Improvement. Practical knowledge of AI applications in ITSM, incident correlation, and analytical problem-solving. Strong understanding of ITIL practices, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Major Incident Management, and Configuration Management. Proficiency in data analysis, service performance reporting, and translating operational insights into actionable improvements. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills across global, matrixed teams. Customer focused mindset with a strong commitment to service quality and continual improvement. Must be willing to work in a hybrid model during North American business hours. Skills Required: Dedication toward customer service, quality, and driving continuous improvement.

Experience

with ITSM tools (ServiceNow preferred). Deep

experience

across ITSM domains: Problem Management, Change Enablement, Major Incident Management, Service Transition, and CMDB. Deep

experience

with relevant ITSM frameworks, such as ITIL v3 or ITIL v4. Proven

experience

navigating matrixed and global organizations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Excellent collaboration skills. Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Qualifications

5+ years relevant

experience

in Information Technology, ITSM, or Service Assurance. Graduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities. ITIL 4 Foundation certification preferred, advanced ITIL certification is an advantage.

job.title: Senior Director, Hedge Funds and Asset Management Strategy & Market Development - Dow Jones
job.description:
Senior Director, Hedge Funds and Asset Management Strategy & Market Development - Dow Jones Senior Director, Hedge Funds and Asset Management Strategy & Market Development Dow Jones New York, NY Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Job Description: About the Company: Dow Jones is a global provider of news and business information, delivering content to consumers and organizations around the world across multiple formats, including print, digital, mobile and live events. Dow Jones has produced unrivaled quality content for more than 125 years and today has one of the world’s largest news gathering operations globally. It produces leading publications and products including The Wall Street Journal, Factiva, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Investor’s Business Daily, Financial News, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance and Dow Jones Newswires. Dow Jones is a division of News Corp.

About the Role

The Senior Director, Hedge Funds and Asset Management Strategy & Market Development will own the strategy and market development agenda for Dow Jones’ asset management and hedge fund segment. This senior, externally oriented leadership role will identify where Dow Jones can create the greatest value for investment professionals, shape the growth plan for the segment, and build the relationships and partnerships needed to expand adoption, distribution and commercial impact. The successful candidate will bring deep market credibility and an informed perspective on how hedge funds and asset managers make investment, research, trading, risk and portfolio-management decisions. They will serve as a credible, trusted voice of the client, translating real-world workflows and unmet needs into clear priorities for content, product, coverage, messaging and go-to-market execution. This role will manage a small portfolio of strategic client relationships with a white-glove approach, while influencing a broader network of prospects, partners, platforms and ecosystem participants. The Senior Director will work closely across Sales, Marketing, Product, Technology, Editorial and Newsrooms, Commercial Strategy, Client Delivery and Operations, Customer Service, Risk & Compliance and other relevant teams to connect market insight with execution. You Will: Oversee and guide the hedge fund and asset-management segment go-to-market strategy, including target market definition, strategic priorities, positioning and measures of success. Develop and maintain a growth plan covering client clusters, priority use cases, whitespace opportunities, partner channels and pipeline initiatives. Build a fact-based view of the market, including customer needs, buying processes, competitive dynamics, pricing, emerging workflows and opportunities for differentiated value. Act as a voice of our hedge fund and asset-management clients, bringing structured insight from client conversations into product, content, coverage and service planning. Foster relationships with the top five to 10 strategic accounts, providing high-touch, senior-level experience, help craft messaging strategy for quarterly business reviews, and coordinating internal sales, business and retention teams around account priorities. Cultivate relationships with clients, prospects, integrators, partners, and market practitioners to understand the changing world of investment workflows, information gaps, decision-making processes and evolving business requirements especially in the light of advancing AI tools and methods. Evaluate partnership opportunities and help define the business case, operating model, commercial approach and internal owners needed to move them forward. Partner with Sales and Finance to strengthen account plans, value propositions, messaging, target lists, qualification approaches and commercial opportunities. Develop strategies to expand revenue opportunities at existing clients by identifying additional desks and pods within larger firms. Help develop and maintain competitive intelligence, market narratives and proof points that clearly articulate Dow Jones’ value to hedge funds and asset managers. Identify and advocate for priority content, data, product and workflow enhancements that can improve client outcomes and strengthen market differentiation. Represent Dow Jones at industry events, client forums and relevant external engagements; serve as a credible thought leader on the role of trusted news and business information in investment workflows. Contribute to external communications and online activity that establishes a clear point of view on hedge funds, asset management, markets and information innovation. Create regular updates for senior stakeholders on market developments, client feedback, strategic priorities, pipeline progress, partnership activity and recommended actions. Establish feedback loops that connect market learning to measurable improvements in client engagement, product adoption, distribution and revenue growth. Influence through expertise, relationships and clear recommendations, balancing external market needs with Dow Jones’ editorial standards, product capabilities and commercial priorities. Collaborate with the News Analytics team on commercial strategy. You Have: 15+ years of

experience

in hedge funds, asset management, financial markets, financial information, fintech, media, consulting or a related field, with substantial exposure to institutional investment clients.

as an external market practitioner, client strategist, business leader, product or commercial executive, or comparable role with strong credibility among hedge funds and asset managers. Dow Jones has produced unrivaled quality content for more than 130 years and today has one of the world’s largest news-gathering operations globally. The Customer Insights team supports Dow Jones' strategic goals by providing a clear, actionable understanding of our consumer markets, subscribers, brand positioning, and product offerings through primary market and user research. We partner closely with consumer marketing, brand, strategy, product, and newsroom partners across our consumer media portfolio to convert consumer feedback, synthetic data, and quantitative analytics into high-impact business decisions.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Customer Insights to serve as a senior strategic research lead within our Consumer Organization. In this role, you will lead high-impact quantitative and qualitative research initiatives that directly inform strategic decision-making across Consumer Marketing, Brand, and Ventures for our media properties (including WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, and IBD). As a senior individual contributor, you will not manage direct reports, but you will play a critical strategic leadership role across the Consumer org. You will be responsible for end-to-end execution of complex B2C research projects, overseeing agency and research vendor partnerships, driving modern AI-enabled research workflows, and building collaborative relationships with senior cross-functional stakeholders. The Senior Manager, Customer Insights, will report to the VP, Customer Insights. You Will: Design, execute, and synthesize high-impact primary quantitative and qualitative research projects (e.g., brand health, concept testing, pricing/packaging, audience positioning, message/creative testing, and exploratory market studies) to support Consumer Marketing, Brand, and Ventures goals. Champion modern consumer research methodologies by leveraging cutting-edge GenAI tools, AI agentic systems, AI-powered qualitative-at-scale platforms, and synthetic data models/AI twins to accelerate consumer insights generation and efficiency. Serve as a trusted advisor to senior partners across Consumer Marketing, Brand, Subscription Strategy, and Business Development/Ventures. Translate ambiguous consumer business questions into structured research objectives and deliver actionable, strategic insights. Oversee research agency relationships and third-party vendors (including panel providers and emerging AI research platforms) from briefing and methodology selection through procurement, fieldwork execution, and final deliverables. Manage and evolve core tracking programs and strategic research initiatives. Distill complex quantitative datasets, consumer feedback, and AI-enabled research outputs into concise, executive-ready presentations that influence subscriber growth, engagement, and retention strategies. Partner effectively across the broader Customer Insights team, Data Science/Analytics, UX/Product, and Marketing teams to ensure alignment and maximize the business impact of research findings. You Have: 10+ years of primary qualitative and quantitative consumer market research experience, ideally within digital media, news/publishing, direct-to-consumer (DTC) subscription models, or strategic research agencies. Deep

experience

executing a wide array of primary research methods (surveys, focus groups, IDIs, diaries, online communities) and statistical analysis techniques (correlation, regression, conjoint, max diff, statistical significance) Proficient in standard survey, moderation and data analysis platforms (e.g., Qualtrics, SPSS, Discuss.io, Excel, data visualization dashboards). Hands-on

experience

using generative AI platforms and large language models (e.g., NotebookLM, Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT) for desk research, data synthesis, research brief and questionnaire drafting, and qualitative coding. Familiarity with AI agentic tools, conversational AI interview platforms, AI-assisted qual-at-scale, or synthetic audience models/AI twins. Proven

experience

sourcing, managing, and partnering with research vendors, consumer sample providers, and research platforms and applications. Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships across a matrixed consumer organization, influence senior leaders, and drive research agendas without direct managerial authority. Exceptional storytelling, written presentation, and narrative-building skills—ability to convert raw consumer data into clear strategic recommendations.

managing multiple concurrent projects and deadlines Proficiency with Google Suite Bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences, Business, Marketing, Data Analytics, or a related field (advanced degree highly preferred).

job.description:
Senior Principal Software Engineer - Realtor.com Senior Principal Software Engineer Realtor.com Austin, TX Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Senior Principal Software Engineer Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3186 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user

experience

that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

About the Role

Realtor.com is seeking a Senior Principal Engineer to provide company-wide technical leadership across our consumer applications, search platforms, data and machine learning systems, APIs, and AI-enabled products. This is one of the most senior individual-contributor roles at Realtor.com. You will help define the technical direction for a high-scale digital marketplace used by millions of consumers. You will work across organizational boundaries to solve the company’s most complex engineering problems, shape long-term architecture, and ensure that major technology investments improve customer experience, business growth, reliability, security, and engineering velocity. This role requires both breadth and depth. You must be able to move from executive-level technology strategy to hands-on architectural leadership across web, mobile, search, machine learning, distributed systems, and cloud platforms. Success will come through influence, technical judgment, execution, and the ability to make engineering teams across Realtor.com more effective.

What You’ll Do

Shape Company-Wide Technical Direction Help define Realtor.com’s target architecture and multi-year technology strategy across web, mobile, search, APIs, identity, data, machine learning, AI, and developer platforms. Translate business and product priorities into scalable, secure, and practical technical roadmaps. Identify architectural risks, platform gaps, modernization opportunities, and areas of unnecessary complexity. Establish lightweight standards and reference architectures that improve consistency without slowing teams down. Advise senior engineering and product leaders on major technology investments and build-versus-buy decisions. Lead Critical Cross-Company Initiatives Provide technical leadership for high-impact programs spanning multiple products, platforms, and engineering organizations. Define end-to-end architectures, key interfaces, decision points, and implementation paths. Remain engaged from technical discovery through delivery, rollout, and operational adoption. Step into critical incidents, performance issues, security concerns, or architectural escalations where senior technical judgment is required. Drive alignment when requirements are ambiguous or ownership is distributed across teams. Lead Search, Data, and Machine Learning Architecture Provide architectural leadership for large-scale search, ranking, recommendations, personalization, and location-based experiences. Guide the design of data pipelines, feature platforms, model-serving systems, experimentation frameworks, and real-time decisioning capabilities. Partner with product, data science, machine learning, and engineering teams to move models reliably from experimentation into production. Establish patterns for model evaluation, observability, explainability, cost management, privacy, and responsible AI. Help evolve search and ML platforms that improve relevance, engagement, conversion, and customer trust. Strengthen Platform, Reliability, and Security Guide architecture across APIs, distributed services, event-driven systems, identity, cloud infrastructure, and shared platforms. Improve service boundaries, data ownership, observability, resilience, scalability, and failure isolation. Partner with security teams to embed security, privacy, and compliance into system design. Strengthen service-level objectives, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and incident readiness. Turn recurring operational issues into durable architectural improvements rather than repeated tactical fixes. Develop Realtor.com’s Technical Community Mentor Principal Engineers, Staff Engineers, architects, engineering managers, and emerging technical leaders. Raise the quality of design reviews, technical proposals, architecture decisions, incident analysis, and engineering documentation. Build alignment across teams through technical forums, reference implementations, and shared engineering practices. Communicate complex technical topics clearly to executives, product leaders, and engineering teams. Influence through evidence, clarity, trust, and strong technical credibility rather than positional authority. What You’ll Bring: Extensive software engineering

experience

(15+ years), including leadership as a Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, Chief Architect, or equivalent senior technical role. A proven record of shaping architecture across large, complex, high-scale engineering organizations. Deep

experience

with distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, APIs, data systems, observability, security, and reliability engineering. Strong knowledge of search systems, ranking, recommendations, personalization, and high-volume data platforms.

Experience

building and operating machine learning or generative AI systems in production. Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple organizations without direct authority. Strong judgment in balancing speed, customer value, operational risk, cost, and long-term architectural health. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. A history of mentoring senior engineers and raising technical standards across an organization. Bachelor's degree or15+ years of related

experience

Success in This Role: Success will include clearer company-wide technical direction, stronger alignment across web, mobile, search, ML, AI, and platform teams, measurable improvements in reliability and engineering velocity, reduced architectural fragmentation, and successful delivery of several critical cross-company initiatives. The right leader will be enterprise-minded, technically exceptional, pragmatic, hands-on, influential, and focused on measurable customer and business outcomes How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. Our employees work four days in our Austin headquarters where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. job.title: Senior Product Engineer - Dow Jones
job.description:
Senior Product Engineer - Dow Jones Senior Product Engineer Dow Jones Dublin, IRL Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Job Description:

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Product Engineer to own features end to end on our AI-powered brand reputation and risk monitoring platform. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll take a customer problem and turn it into a shipped feature across the whole stack: the UI, the API, and the cloud and data platform on AWS. You'll report to one of our experienced Tech Leads and work on the product stream alongside product, design, data scientists and QA. We build with AI agents as everyday teammates, so you'll spend your time directing, orchestrating and reviewing agentic work rather than writing code by hand. Why Storyful Storyful has spent more than a decade at the sharp end of social media intelligence, verifying breaking news and spotting emerging narratives for the world's leading newsrooms and brands. Now, as part of Dow Jones, we're turning that expertise into the future of reputation monitoring: an AI-powered platform that helps organisations see risks and opportunities as they emerge, understand what's driving the conversation, and act before a story takes hold. It's an exciting moment to join - the product is growing fast, AI is reshaping what's possible in our space, and we're have a clear path to becoming the market leader. You'll be one of the engineers who gets us there, shaping the platform from the ground up and seeing your work in the hands of customers who rely on it every day.

What you'll do

Ship product features end to end - frontend, API and the cloud/data platform behind them - from ticket to production. Work directly with customers and product to understand the problem, shape the solution and check it actually helped. Build with AI agents every day - plan, delegate and review work done with Claude Code and similar tools, and own the quality of what ships. Design and improve our agent workflows - skills, subagents, review pipelines and automations that make the whole team faster. Build AI features customers use - conversational agents, summaries and explainability, with structured outputs and proper tracing. Keep quality high - tests, code review, observability and cost awareness are part of the job, not an afterthought. Raise the bar for the team - share patterns, mentor others on agentic engineering, and help shape how we work. What we're looking for Senior full-stack

experience

- 5+ years shipping production software across frontend, backend APIs and cloud services. Strong TypeScript across the stack - a modern frontend framework like React, and Node.js APIs backed by a relational database. AWS and infrastructure as code - hands-on with serverless, event-driven design on AWS, and comfortable reading and changing Terraform. Proficient with agentic coding - you use AI coding agents daily and can show real work built with them, not just autocomplete. Deep Claude Code

experience

- you've written your own skills, subagents, hooks or MCP integrations, and know how to manage context and cost. Agent orchestration

experience

- you've run several agents in parallel or built multi-step agent pipelines, and know where they fail and how to verify their output. Strong judgment on AI output - you review agent-written code as critically as a colleague's and own what ships. Customer focus - you talk to users, care about the problem more than the tech, and measure success by what customers get. Clear communicator - you write good tickets, PRs and docs, and explain trade-offs in plain language. Nice to have Production LLM features - you've shipped LLM-powered features with structured outputs, evals, prompt iteration and tracing (Langfuse or similar). Agent frameworks - you've built with LangChain, LangGraph or similar, and know when a framework helps and when it gets in the way. Search and analytics - you've worked with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, dbt or a data warehouse, turning large volumes of data into something customers can act on. Domain

experience

- you've worked on B2B SaaS, media monitoring, social listening or reputation and risk products.

job.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Realtor.com
job.description:
Senior Technical Program Manager - Realtor.com Senior Technical Program Manager Realtor.com Austin, TX Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Senior Technical Program Manager Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3374 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user

experience

that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

About the Role

At Realtor.com , we build products that empower millions of home buyers, renters, dreamers, and real estate professionals. Our mission is to radically simplify the home buying and selling process and help more people achieve the dream of homeownership. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to bring clarity, coordination, and execution discipline to high-value initiatives across our engineering organization. In this role, you’ll partner with engineering, product, security, operations, and business stakeholders to guide complex programs from strategy and planning through delivery and operational readiness. You’ll establish clear outcomes, ownership, milestones, and decision paths; manage dependencies and risks; and help teams make informed tradeoffs. You’ll also strengthen the operating mechanisms that support secure, reliable delivery; from vulnerability remediation and incident follow-through to release readiness and continuous improvement in engineering execution. The right candidate combines sound technical judgment with strong program leadership. You can operate autonomously across multiple teams, communicate crisply with audiences ranging from engineers to executives, and use data to reveal delivery risks and opportunities without reducing team performance to a single metric.

What You'll Do

Lead cross-functional technology programs from definition and planning through implementation, launch, and outcomes measurement; align teams on scope, success measures, accountable owners, milestones, and decisions. Drive quarterly and annual planning, roadmap execution, and ongoing prioritization. Surface cross-team dependencies, constraints, risks, and tradeoffs early, and help stakeholders resolve them. Build and maintain clear program reporting that communicates progress against commitments and OKRs, highlights emerging risks, and gives leaders a trustworthy view of ownership, dependencies, and next steps. Partner with Security and Engineering to mature vulnerability exposure management. Help establish dependable asset and service ownership data and dashboards so exposure can be understood, prioritized, and assigned to accountable teams. Coordinate the vulnerability remediation lifecycle, including risk-based prioritization, automated creation and routing of actionable Jira tickets, clear remediation expectations, and tracking through validation and closure. Escalate aging, blocked, or high-risk items and drive resolution with the appropriate owners. Strengthen incident management practices with engineering and operational partners. Coordinate incident readiness and cross-team response mechanisms, clarify roles and escalation paths, and drive timely post-incident reviews and follow-up actions. Improve change and release management across participating teams. Coordinate risk assessments and approvals where applicable; identify and address process gaps that impact engineering productivity. Facilitate engineering delivery reviews to make progress, outcomes, commitments, and impediments visible. Use a balanced set of delivery and operational indicators to identify systemic improvement opportunities. Help teams and leaders interpret engineering metrics in context, focusing on trends, bottlenecks, quality, and outcomes. Drive continuous improvement by incorporating team feedback, program outcomes, and operational data; share effective practices and contribute to organization-wide operations initiatives. Promote clear documentation, effective meetings, inclusive collaboration, and consistent communication across distributed and multi-office teams. What You'll Bring: 5+ years of

experience

in technical program management, including leading complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from inception through delivery and operational follow-through. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. A strong understanding of modern software development and delivery lifecycles, including Agile planning and execution practices. Demonstrated ability to establish and scale program operating models, coordinate multiple teams, manage dependencies, and drive decisions through ambiguity.

Experience

building effective partnerships with engineering, product, security, and operations stakeholders; able to engage technical teams credibly and translate complex topics for varied audiences.

Experience

using delivery, quality, reliability, or security data to create useful reporting, identify trends and risks, and guide improvement efforts. Working knowledge of security fundamentals and risk-based security practices, with familiarity with frameworks such as the NIST and CIS. Familiarity with vulnerability exposure and remediation workflows, incident response practices, and software change or release management;

experience

coordinating across these areas is a strong plus.

Experience

with Jira and the Atlassian suite; Jira Align

experience

is a plus. Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

Experience

working with distributed or multi-office teams. PMP, CSM, SAFe, or other relevant certification is beneficial, but not required. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our

job.description:

Its exclusives set the news agenda and its campaigns have changed the lives of many. Delivering news, entertainment, and sports coverage to millions of readers every day. With a rich history spanning decades, we are dedicated to providing accurate, insightful, and engaging content across print and digital platforms. Your team: The Sun Online is the biggest digital newsbrand in the UK. The Sun’s multi-award-winning Audience department sits at the heart of our newsroom, with our talented journalists publishing the best coverage of news, sport, TV and showbiz, lifestyle and family values. The team constantly evolves, driving record traffic across all platforms, growing new audiences, and building engagement and loyalty with our readers. Your role: We’re looking for a talented, highly motivated, resourceful individual, with a deep knowledge of social media platforms as well as engagement tools such as newsletters and polls to join our award-winning team at the heart of the newsroom. Please submit your application via the apply now button (include your Twitter (X) and Instagram handle in your CV) Day to day you will: Play a key role in the ongoing development and execution of The Sun's social media and engagement strategy including the transformation of our video distribution strategy. Curate content from across to satisfy a growing range of audience demographics. Edit and maintain The Sun’s social media channels to a high standard in close conjunction with the rest of the team. Curate, edit and distribute our vast range of newsletters every week to our loyal subscribers including implementing new growth strategies.. Contribute to The Sun’s adoption of emerging social platforms and tools, and take responsibility for the growth of The Sun’s new social channels. Work directly with editorial, digital, video, picture, design, commercial and marketing teams, ensuring their respective demands are met. As a team, ensure the newsroom has sufficient insight to produce stories and take responsibility for their subsequent distribution on social media channels and subscribers. Unflappable under pressure and delivering work at a consistently high standard Proactive and display a willingness to take on any task Positive attitude and great team player Take initiative in order to achieve desired results Organised and a good problem-solver, able to eliminate obstacles through creative and adaptive approaches Can demonstrate an understanding of the The Sun brand and audience, both print and digital News UK is one of the leading media businesses in the UK and Ireland. Our newsbrands include The Times, The Sunday Times, The Sun, The Sun on Sunday and The TLS. Our national broadcast brands include talkSPORT, Times Radio and Virgin Radio UK, and we have market-leading local stations across Ireland. Our world-famous brands provide news, analysis, opinion and entertainment to almost 40 million people each month. Spanning print and pixel, audio and video, events and experiences, our multi-format brands are home to a plurality of opinion, representing the diverse communities we serve. Driven by passion, guided by principles and acting with purpose, we exist to promote a fair society, freedom of speech and a little bit of fun. Rethinking continually the business of storytelling, we represent, reflect and reach the nation, telling the stories that matter. At News UK, we embrace a hybrid work model, currently requiring a minimum of three days per week in the office. This approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and team spirit within our workspace. Certain roles may necessitate additional in-office days; please discuss this with your recruiter for specific requirements. Life at News Driven by passion, guided by principles and acting with purpose. We represent, reflect and reach the nation, telling the stories that matter. We inform our audiences so that they can make decisions based on trusted information. We represent, reflect and reach the nation, telling the stories that matter most. To ensure these stories resonate with as broad an audience as possible, it is essential that our organisation reflects the diversity of the people we reach. Whether through age, gender, ethnicity, disability, social class or sexuality, we are committed to representing the rich variety of voices that make up our society. And we champion a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute and thrive as we continue to innovate and drive long term sustainable growth. This is done through our Diversity Strategy. At News UK, we take pride in our exceptional employee-led networks that bring together individuals with shared interests and create a vibrant sense of community. We believe our networks play a vital role in fostering a collaborative and supportive work culture at News UK. Groups that we support include the African & Caribbean Network, Parents and Carers, and LGBTQ+ group News Is Out, and the Apprentice Society.

job.description:
Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Security - Realtor.com Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Security Realtor.com Austin, TX Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Security Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3427 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user

experience

that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

About the Role

Our apps and websites run on APIs. A public API gateway and a federated GraphQL platform carry billions of requests a month, covering listings, search, sign-in, saved homes, and the leads we send to agents. As the founding Staff engineer for API security on our new Edge and API Security team, you'll set the technical direction for how we protect them. You'll decide how every API is authenticated, which operations are allowed, how abuse is detected and stopped, and how new APIs ship secure by default. You'll work hands-on and lead through influence across platform, product, identity and security teams, with leadership backing and a clear mandate. Top Reasons to Apply: A Key technical role on a high impact team. You'll shape its architecture, standards and hiring from day one. Real scale: billions of API and GraphQL requests a month, and abuse that ranges from scraping to account takeover. Direct business impact: your work protects consumer accounts, the quality of leads sent to agents, and the data that powers our business. A modern stack, all managed as code: an API gateway, Apollo GraphQL Federation, Kubernetes and policy-as-code. Room to apply automation and AI to detection and response. Leadership that wants guardrails built into the platform, not more tickets.

What You'll Do

Own the API security architecture across the API gateway and the GraphQL platform, and set the multi-quarter roadmap. Define and enforce an authentication standard for every public API, and lead the migration of existing unauthenticated APIs to it, working with the owning teams. Secure GraphQL end to end: approved-operation lists and persisted queries, depth and cost limits, field-level authorization, and safe schema change. Protect high-value flows such as sign-in, registration, account and lead submission against credential stuffing, account takeover, scraping and fake submissions. Make "secure by default" real, using admission policies, CI checks and gateway policies that stop an unprotected API from reaching production. Build detection and alerting on API abuse, so attacks surface in minutes, not in downstream business reports. Lead response to API attacks and abuse, and turn every incident into a lasting fix. Mentor engineers, set API security review standards, and help hire the rest of the team. What You'll Bring: 8+ years in security, platform or backend engineering, with 5+ years focused on API or application security at large scale. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Deep knowledge of API security: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, API keys and client identity, mTLS, and the OWASP API Security Top 10. Hands-on GraphQL security

experience

federation, persisted queries and safelists, query cost analysis, introspection controls, and authorization patterns.

Experience

operating an API gateway (such as Tyk, Kong or AWS API Gateway), including policy design, rate limiting and key management. Kubernetes and policy-as-code

experience

(ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, OPA or Kyverno), plus infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Strong programming skills in at least one language such as Go, TypeScript or Python, and comfort reading and changing service code.

Experience

with abuse and fraud patterns: credential stuffing, account takeover, scraping and bot-driven form abuse, and how to detect them with logs and SQL. A record of leading multi-team technical initiatives, and of explaining risk to executives in business terms. Nice to Have:

Experience

with Apollo GraphQL Federation and its router, or with Auth0 or similar identity platforms.

Experience

with mobile app attestation (App Attest, Play Integrity) or API bot protection.

Experience

building a security function or team from scratch. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our

The ideal candidate has an extensive background editing across these varied formats. You bring solid news judgment and a passion for video journalism to the table. job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
Nexstar Media Group is America’s largest local television, digital, and media company that produces and distributes local and national news, sports and entertainment content. Nexstar and its subsidiaries and partners own or operate 265 stations in 132 markets across 44 states, reaching more than 70% of U.S. television households. Nexstar’s platform delivers engaging local content and network programming to inform and entertain viewers, while providing premium, scalable local advertising opportunities for advertisers and brands across all screens and devices. Learn more at www.Nexstar.tv.


The Administrative Assistant provides a full range of administrative and clerical support as necessary while serving guests of FOX56 by greeting, welcoming, and directing them appropriately.  Daily tasks consist of managing the front desk, assisting with administrative tasks and clerical support, and other duties as assigned by the GM.  

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

·       Provides administrative and clerical support for the Administrative Department, which includes filing, photocopying, preparing correspondence, preparing files and on-boarding packets

·       Manage front desk and lobby area; welcomes visitors, answer phones and respond to emails in a friendly, timely, and professional manner

job.title: Content creator
job.description:
KGET in Bakersfield is looking for an experienced, imaginative producer to lead our streaming news platform.

The ideal candidate will have experience with traditional broadcast news, a creative understanding of the potential of streaming television and the ability to bring that understanding to fruition.

Download the app and go to KGET+ to see what we have now.

We want to build that streaming channel into an institution equal to our legacy No. 1 broadcast channel.

We’re looking for someone who can routinely envision the streaming potential of broadcast stories and then shepherd those stories – and those reporters – onto our CTV platform.  

The successful candidate also will be able to conceptualize and execute ideas for original streaming programming. He or she will be able to

We’re looking for someone who has the technical know-how to combine several broadcast stories into a single CTV show

Is that you?

If you think so, apply for the job then drop a line to News Director Michael Trihey at michaeltrihey@kget.com. Put “Content Creator” in the guide.

  • Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Collegiality. To work at KGET, you must recognize and practice teamwork and cooperation as a core value.
  • Producing shows and content, being an expert in the technical aspects of creating episodes and getting them into the app, and helping promote KGET+ and its shows across platforms.
  • Curating and aggregating a steady stream of interesting content packaged and promoted to generate engagement and repeat site visitation.
  • Familiarization of all available Nexstar streaming shows; Recognizing which would be of greatest interest to our particular audience; Balancing local and Nexstar content into a 24/7 schedule that draws the biggest audience.
  • Monitoring all forms of media (print, TV, digital, blogs and social) and being the quickest to report breaking news stories and be on the hunt for exclusive and or trending content that will grow engagement and drive loyal, local traffic.
  • Understanding different ways to tell a story, particularly producing short videos and choosing great photos.
  • Building positive working relationships with newsroom staff and management, working collaboratively on enterprise content, and creating opportunities to market web content on broadcast.
  • Training station members in streaming studio operations
  • Overseeing the streaming studios production calendar
  • Working with engineering on issues / needs for streaming studios
  • Ability to work flexible hours, as needed.
  • Additional tasks as needed
  • Typical Day:
  • The Streaming Television Producer will attend local editorial meetings as needed/assigned. He or she will have familiarity with local, regional, and national content and use data to make decisions on what stories to publish and how to showcase them on KGET+. He or she will take stories from newsroom and digital reporters and help package the content for optimal engagement.
  • Physical Demands & Work Environment:
    The Streaming Television Producer  must be able to sit, conduct telephone conversations, use electronic mail, write letters and memos, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, and work indoors in environmentally controlled conditions.  In addition, the Streaming Television Producer must be able to handle, control or feel objects, tools or controls.  Repetitive movements are required.  Work may be conducted in extremely bright or inadequate lighting conditions. 
  • EEO Statement:  Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities / Women / Veterans / Disabled
  • Pay range: $20 - $23.50 per hour, depending on experience

Are you an experienced journalist who delivers news with accuracy, urgency and impact?


Are you at your best when it comes to delivering breaking news in a clear and concise manner?


Are you a leader in your newsroom?


KDVR/KWGN is seeking an experienced news anchor to join our winning evening news team. We are looking for an authentic, dynamic engaging talent who can connect with the audience on all platforms. The ideal candidate will have solid news judgement, play an active role in the daily process to identify topics for coverage and be on top of their game when it comes to covering breaking news and weather.


The ideal candidate will be a newsroom leader who is a self-starter, a good newsroom citizen and an advocate for the target viewer. We are looking for an experienced anchor who thrives on bringing value to our local audience, drives impactful breaking news coverage and does quality in-depth content gathering and reporting when needed.

  • Co-anchors several newscasts
  • Accurate reporting of news stories
  • Conversational anchor skills with the ability to adlib with ease and to connect audiences through professionalism and personality.

  • Ability to identify the developmental needs of others and to coach, mentor or otherwise help others to improve their knowledge or skills.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Salary: $180,000-$240,000 commensurate with experience and skill level.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including group health and dental, paid time off, 401(k) and more.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • Minimum 6 years of on-air experience
  • Minimum of 4 years of regular anchoring experience
  • Proven track record of leadership and newscast ratings growth.
  • Strong journalistic ethics.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines.
  • Positive, solution-oriented attitude and team player.

What We Offer:

  • Hands-on training in television, streaming, and digital advertising.
  • Ongoing professional development and sales coaching.
  • A collaborative, supportive, and award-winning team.
  • The opportunity to build your own client base and grow your career.

Why WFRV Local 5?

WFRV-TV is Northeast Wisconsin's CBS affiliate, bringing together the power of television, live sports, locally produced programming, streaming, social media, and digital marketing.

Our team helps local businesses connect with customers through WFRV-TV, WFRV.com, WFRV+, and advanced digital marketing solutions.

You already know how to work with people. Let us teach you how to turn that skill into a sales career!

 

If you're outgoing, competitive, hardworking, and ready for a new challenge, we'd love to meet you.

Apply today and become a trusted marketing partner for businesses across Northeast Wisconsin!
