OGILVY HEALTH: WE INSPIRE PEOPLE AND BRANDS TO IMPACT THE WORLD

Guided by this vision, Ogilvy Health, part of WPP, combines borderless creativity, scientific precision, cultural fluency, and AI-enabled capabilities to build healthcare's most influential movements. We believe the future belongs to those who can seamlessly blend human ingenuity with emerging technologies, using AI not simply as a tool, but as a catalyst for deeper insights, faster problem solving, and more impactful work. We drive measurable impact and category-defining growth for brands ready to shape what's next. Our approach is powered by fearless creativity that dares to be different, sparks emotional connections, and inspires action, ensuring cultural resonance. Scientific precision translates complex data into stories that resonate, while our impact-obsessed mindset focuses on delivering real-world outcomes.

For more information on us, visit OgilvyHealth.com, or follow Ogilvy Health on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and Threads.

About the Role 

As an Account Executive specializing in Paid Media Buying, Social Analytics, and Generative Impact, you will assist the technical and strategic processes across paid social and digital media activation, social listening, and emerging AI search visibility for leading healthcare and pharmaceutical clients.

This is not a traditional Account Management AE role—you will not be managing day-to-day project logistics, call agendas, or administrative client account management. Instead, your core focus is technical media buying, campaign trafficking, data analytics, social listening, and Ogilvy's proprietary Generative Impact (Generative Engine Optimization / GEO) offering.

What You’ll Do:

Paid Social & Digital Campaign Execution & Media Operations

  • Campaign Setup & Media Buying: Assist in building, launching, trafficking, and managing paid social media campaigns across self-serve ad platforms (e.g., Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, etc.) and support activation and coordination across digital media channels such as GOOH (Digital OOH), Programmatic, Search, Direct Partnership and Sponsorships.
  • Audience & Targeting Strategy: Assist in building and implementing compliant audience targeting parameters tailored to healthcare stakeholders (HCPs, patients, caregivers) in alignment with platform policy and healthcare privacy regulations.
  • Medical/Legal/Regulatory (MLR) Compliance: Ensure all paid social assets, ad copy, and targeting parameters comply with brand guidelines, platform policies, and FDA/MLR regulatory requirements.

Generative Impact & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

  • AI Search Visibility Tracking: Support Ogilvy’s Generative Impact offering by tracking, analyzing, and measuring brand visibility, sentiment, and share of voice across generative AI search engines and LLM platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews).
  • GEO Insight Generation: Identify prompt opportunities, content gaps, and source citation trends in AI-generated responses to help optimize healthcare brand discovery.
  • Search-Social Integration: Connect paid social strategy with GEO insights to ensure brand messaging is aligned across both social feeds and AI discovery platforms.

Social Intelligence, Analytics & Listening

  • Data Aggregation & Performance Reporting: Extract performance metrics across paid social campaigns and aggregate data to build weekly, monthly, and post-campaign analytical reporting decks.
  • Social Intelligence & Listening: Utilize enterprise social listening tools (e.g., Brandwatch, YouScan, Quid, Sprinklr) to monitor share of voice, emerging disease-state conversation trends, competitor paid activity, and audience sentiment.
  • Dashboard Management: Maintain and update client analytics dashboards and reporting templates to ensure data accuracy and real-time visibility into KPI performance.

Client Relations

  • Paid Media & Analytics Advisory: Interact directly with clients to answer technical questions regarding paid media execution, social listening findings, platform algorithm updates, and GEO trends.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal creative, strategy, media planning, and account management teams to optimize creative ad assets based on real-time performance data and social listening insights.

What You’ll Need:

  • Experience: 1–2 years hands on in paid social media execution, social listening, or marketing analytics—preferably within an advertising agency or healthcare/pharmaceutical environment.
  • Paid Social & Media: Direct experience trafficking campaigns inside self-serve ad platforms (Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, etc.).
  • Search: Hands on experience supporting paid search campaigns in Google Ads, including keyword research, campaign and ad group setup, ad trafficking and quality assurance, negative keyword management, budget pacing, bid and performance optimization, and reporting.  
  • Analytics, Listening & GEO: Familiarity with enterprise social listening/reporting platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Brandwatch, YouScan, NetBase Quid, Google Analytics, advanced Excel/Google Sheets).
  • Strong interest in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI search platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), and prompt monitoring.
  • Self-motivation, strong organizational skills, attention to detail and excellent time management skills.
  • Healthcare Knowledge: Understanding of pharmaceutical/healthcare marketing, MLR review processes, and healthcare privacy/compliance guidelines is highly desirable.
  • AI Fluency: Demonstrated curiosity and proficiency in using generative AI and applicable emerging technologies. Ability to adapt to new tools and integrate AI responsibly into day-to-day work is expected.

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates. 

 

The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click here for more details.

Pay Range$45,000—$100,000 USD

About the Role  

At Ogilvy Health, we work with ambitious healthcare brands to create work that makes a meaningful difference.

We’re looking for an Account Manager to join us at an exciting time for one of our fast-growing global rare disease accounts. With a strong pipeline of work ahead, you’ll be joining a well-resourced, supportive team where there’s plenty of variety, visibility and opportunity to grow.

You’ll build your global healthcare experience, get involved in major campaign and congress work, and take real ownership of your projects, with an experienced team around you for support.

If you’re ready for your next step in healthcare communications and want a role where you can properly get stuck in, we’d love to hear from you.

 

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Managing multiple projects from brief through to delivery
  • Keeping timelines, priorities and stakeholders on track
  • Working closely with clients and internal teams to make things happen
  • Supporting the development and rollout of campaign materials
  • Getting involved in a broad range of promotional work, which could include e-details, patient profiles and objection-handling materials
  • Playing an important role in preparations for a major European congress next year
  • Building strong relationships and becoming a trusted day-to-day partner to your clients 

It’s a busy account with lots happening at once, so you’ll need to be someone who enjoys spinning a few plates, can work out what needs attention first and is comfortable taking ownership of your own projects.

What You’ll Need  

You’ll ideally already have experience within a healthcare communications agency, with an understanding of how pharmaceutical accounts and promotional work come together.

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Healthcare communications agency experience
  • Experience working with Rx/pharmaceutical brands, ideally across global work
  • Exposure to creating and delivering different types of promotional materials
  • Confidence managing several projects and competing priorities at the same time
  • Strong client and team relationships
  • A proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership rather than waiting to be told what happens next

Congress experience would be useful, but it’s not essential. And if you’re currently a strong Senior Account Executive looking for your first Account Manager role, we’d absolutely be open to hearing from you.

We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. Ogilvy New York is searching for a Consulting Analyst to join our Consulting team.

As a Consulting Analyst, you'll work with consulting teams and business leaders to help clients address complex business, brand, and marketing challenges. You'll combine research, data analysis, strategic thinking, and creative problem-solving to uncover insights and develop actionable recommendations. You'll play an important role in structuring analyses, building compelling narratives and presentations, and supporting the delivery of high-quality consulting engagements.   • Participate in client meetings and workshops, helping prepare materials, document key discussions, and support follow-up actions.

What You'll Need

  • 1–3 years of experience in consulting, brand strategy, marketing strategy, consumer insights, market research, business analysis, or related fields.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to structure problems, interpret data, identify patterns, and develop meaningful insights.

About the Role  

Marketers have never had so much data at their disposal - and they’ve never been more at a loss as to how to use it. This leads to lost opportunities at best, and ineffectual, brand-devaluing efforts at worst.

The Data & Effectiveness team helps make brands matter by leveraging the right data assets in the right way in order to make more inspired decisions for our brands. Better decisions means creating more effective work more consistently. It means learning from the past to be better at influencing the future. It means looking for data-backed evidence on how to drive better business results. And it means more value for the agency - now and in the long run.

For us to harness data, we need to understand what it means. Our Analysts arm our teams by arming them with that understanding and drawing useful implications that inspire the work.

What You’ll Do 

The Analyst’s core responsibility is to our teams are consistently equipped with the necessary evidence to inspire decisions for our clients.

WORK

  • Help strategy development by helping find evidence to test its effectiveness
  • Culling actionable insights from quantitative data sets by performing basic structured analysis
  • Support in Creative development by spotting insights that can be used as a jump-off point
  • Identifying the right KPIs and performance benchmarks for communication efforts
  • Ensuring that analysis reports contain useful insights that can help improve performance

BUSINESS

  • Maintain existing client relationships by delivering work that meets agreed quality standards

TEAM

  • Support more senior Analysts in running day-to-day operations 

ADVANCEMENT

  • Stay updated on the data & analytics landscape

What You’ll Need  

  • 1-2 years experience in an Analytics post inside a Creative or Media agency; graduate of Statistics- or Engineering-leaning courses a plus
  • Have a working knowledge of Digital Analytics tools ( e.g. Google Analytics, native social analytics, social listening)
  • Have a working knowledge of paid and performance media
  • Basic interpretation skills for both quantitative and qualitative data
  • Basic data visualisation and report preparation
  • Basic knowledge of research and measurement methods
  • An understanding of fundamental communication and business principles

The GAD will translate our client's business and brand priorities into effective, culturally relevant, social-first work; build trusted senior client relationships; and lead multidisciplinary capabilities spanning social strategy, influence, community management, creative, content, data, project management and production. The role must create one joined-up client experience across the full Social & Influence team. 

This is a hands-on senior leadership role combining strategic counsel, client stewardship, creative and operational judgement, commercial ownership and cross-functional team leadership. 

 Senior client and business leadership: 

  • Act as the senior day-to-day client lead and primary escalation point for the Social & Influence scope. 
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of the business, category, brand, audiences and commercial priorities. 
  • Translate business needs into clear account priorities, annual and quarterly plans, and actionable briefs. 
  • Lead senior client meetings, strategic presentations, performance reviews and key governance forums. 
  • Provide proactive counsel, identify opportunities and risks early, and constructively challenge the client and agency team when this will improve the work or outcome. 
  • Identify responsible growth opportunities within the accounts remit, without losing focus on delivery of the agreed scope. 

Social & Influence leadership: 

  • Act as the senior social-first client leader on the business, bringing sufficient depth of social expertise to confidently advise and challenge both the client and specialist agency teams. 
  • Understand how social ideas live and evolve across platforms, communities and culture, and be able to recognise the difference between genuinely social-first thinking and the adaptation of traditional campaign ideas into social channels. 
  • Oversee the integration of always-on social, community management, campaigns, content, creators and influencer activity into a coherent programme. 
  • Set a high standard for social strategy, briefs, creative output, channel plans, community engagement and influence recommendations, and ensure the team responds intelligently to platform change, audience behaviour, cultural moments and emerging social formats. 
  • Partner with strategy, data and intelligence specialists to establish objectives, KPIs, learning agendas and actionable reporting. 
  • Oversee influence governance with the relevant specialists, covering creator recommendations, briefs, approvals, brand safety, disclosure, delivery and performance evaluation. 
  • Ensure social and influence activity connects to the wider brand plan while retaining clear ownership of this specialist scope. 

Cross-team leadership: 

  • Function as the unifying business lead for the multidisciplinary Social & Influence team. 
  • Establish clear roles, decision rights, hand-offs, ways of working and escalation paths across account management, project management, production, community, strategy, data, creative and content. 
  • Create a consistent operating rhythm through effective briefing, prioritisation, status management, reviews and decision-making. 
  • Work closely with the allocated Project Manager/Producer to translate the scope into realistic plans, timelines, dependencies and resource requirements. 
  • Resolve competing priorities and resource constraints, escalating early where the agreed allocation or capability is insufficient. 
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable and respectful culture in which the team operates as one unit. 

Delivery, quality and risk management: 

  • Be accountable for the smooth running and quality of the account across strategy, creative, operations and commercial delivery. 
  • Ensure work is properly scoped, briefed, resourced, reviewed, approved and delivered to agreed standards, timing and budget. 
  • Maintain appropriate senior oversight without duplicating the Project Manager/Producer’s detailed project administration. 
  • Anticipate and mitigate delivery, reputational, brand-safety and stakeholder risks, with clear escalation and response protocols and the right senior and specialist input brought in at the right time. 
  • Lead or oversee a disciplined transition from the incumbent agency, protecting business continuity, knowledge transfer and client confidence. 

Commercial stewardship: 

  • Own the financial health of the Social & Influence account, including scope, fees, resource assumptions, forecasting, revenue, profitability and reconciliation. 
  • Develop and maintain accurate scopes of work and change controls in partnership with agency leadership, Finance and delivery leads. 
  • Oversee purchase orders, invoicing, work in progress and financial reporting, ensuring issues are resolved promptly. 
  • Track actual effort against agreed resource allocations and address sustained over- or under-servicing. 
  • Scope incremental opportunities transparently and ensure they are appropriately resourced and commercially viable. 

People leadership and development: 

  • Provide visible functional leadership, clear direction, constructive feedback and coaching to the multidisciplinary team. 
  • Build capability in social-first account leadership and encourage strong collaboration across disciplines and specialist teams. 
  • Support onboarding, role clarity, performance feedback and development planning for people working on the account. 
  • Where formal direct reports are assigned, fulfil the relevant line-management responsibilities, including goal-setting, regular development conversations and performance reviews. 

Agency contribution: 

  • Share learning and effective practices from the account across broader Ogilvy teams and contribute to the development of the agency’s Social & Influence offering, standards and ways of working. 

 Skills & Experiences: 

Essential 

  • 8+ years' agency experience with significant senior client leadership responsibility. 
  • Demonstrable experience leading substantial social-first client business. 
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across complex organisational structures. 
  • Strong working knowledge of creator/influencer marketing and community management. 
  • Ability to lead and challenge senior clients on social strategy and creative work. 
  • Strong commercial/account management capability. 
  • Experience managing complex always-on delivery alongside major campaigns. 

 

Strongly advantageous 

  • FMCG, QSR or another fast-moving consumer category. 
  • Experience with culturally prominent, high-volume consumer brands. 
  • PR and broader integrated communications experience. 

Candidates should be able to demonstrate experience across several of the following: 

  • Leading sizeable always-on social accounts or programmes. 
  • Developing or overseeing platform-native social and content strategies. 
  • Working with creative teams to evaluate and improve social-first creative ideas. 
  • Community management and community-led thinking. 
  • Creator and influencer strategy and activation. 
  • Social listening, trends, audience behaviour and cultural opportunities. 
  • Using social performance and audience insight to improve strategies and work. 
  • Managing fast-response social opportunities, reputational issues and brand-safety considerations.

job.title: Head of Social
job.description:
About Ogilvy  

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

 

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

 

Lead a highly skilled team of social and influence specialists across the Ogilvy Network in ANZ and deliver effective and award-winning social-first strategies for the world’s most successful brands.  

Are you a proven leader in social-first creativity who wants to elevate your career at one of the most successful creative networks?

We are on the hunt for a new Head of Social to inspire an established and specialised team of social strategists, social creatives, advocacy, orchestration, and analytics experts.   

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

In this role, you’ll be responsible for evolving our end-to-end social offering from organic and culture-first social through to business influence and social commerce.  

You’ll play a key role in the realisation of our strategic and creative process as we deliver a truly integrated, social-first and earned-first approach to clients and prospects. You’ll relish the challenge of competing head-to-head with pure play social agencies and developing social-first strategies as the basis for culturally impactful and integrated brand campaigns. 

Working with senior stakeholders across the business, you’ll be responsible for shaping and growing a best-in-class social offering and driving impact with existing and new clients. You'll have the opportunity to shape the role that our clients play in culture, leveraging our proprietary tech stack, deep creative talent pool and proven methodologies.  

The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of culture-first brand strategy, a passion for creative excellence in social and the ability to consult with clients across the full spectrum of social media.  

You’ll be an empathic leader and a highly effective collaborator who drives growth by enabling those around you to deliver the best work of their careers. This role presents a unique opportunity for an established social leader to develop their career on one of the biggest agency stages in Australia and New Zealand with the support of the wider regional and global leadership team.  

With social and influencer marketing firmly on the radar of CMOs and marketers in Australia and New Zealand, there’s never been a better time to take your career in social media to the next level with Ogilvy.      

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Consulting

  • Lead the development and execution of social-first brand strategies that drive cultural relevance and business impact for consumer, corporate, public sector and health clients  
  • Play a lead role in the development of distinctive social strategies for our major clients with a focus on brand building and meaningful cultural impact 
  • Develop social-first creative briefs and guide creative teams through ideation and execution  
  • Manage senior client relationships and serve as strategic advisor on social brand building and drive integration of social strategy across broader marketing and communications programs 

Product & Growth 

  • Lead and evolve the four product offers – commerce, paid, organic and influence – and develop integrated strategies and campaigns that weave specialist teams together 
  • Manage and extend a best-in-class cultural and social listening program to identify reactive and strategic opportunities for brands  
  • Oversee the day-to-day operation of an agile content production engine and collaborate with specialists across the network to deliver high-performing and innovative content-led campaigns   
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through the development of innovative social solutions and product offerings  
  • Join the APAC social media community and partner with colleagues across the region on multi-market client campaigns and regional new business opportunities   
  • Play a lead role in the development of thought leadership initiatives and represent the agency at industry events and in external communications 

Leadership & Operations:

  • Set the direction and growth strategy for Ogilvy’s social and influence offering, working in partnership with the Group Managing Director for PR, Social and Influence and ECD  
  • Build and mentor a team of social specialists, setting performance standards, team values and vision and driving professional development 
  • Inspire and grow the social leadership team within the agency, including strategy and creative specialists, working in partnership with the Head of Influence  
  • Create an unstoppable team culture and ambition and optimise the processes, operations and platforms that we need to deliver effectively, resulting in profitable growth 
  • Manage department P&L, including budget planning, resource allocation, and revenue forecasting  

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • You have 10+ years of experience in social media strategy and/or a GAD or agency leadership role, with a proven track record of building brands through culture-first strategy and platform-first thinking  
  • You're deeply versed in the social media landscape, with hands-on experience developing strategies across established and emerging platforms 
  • You have a natural talent for spotting cultural trends before they peak and can translate these insights into compelling brand opportunities  
  • You've successfully led and grown social teams, with experience mentoring strategists, creatives, community management and analysts, fostering a culture of innovation  
  • You have strong commercial acumen, having managed significant client budgets and department P&Ls in an agency environment  
  • You're an accomplished presenter and relationship builder, comfortable advising C-suite clients on social strategy and brand building  
  • You bring a data-driven approach to strategy, with experience in brand strategy, social listening, performance analysis, and insight development  
  • You have a portfolio of award-winning social campaigns that demonstrate your ability to drive both cultural impact and business results  
  • You've developed and sold innovative social products and services, with a track record of driving agency growth  
  • You're recognised in the industry for your thought leadership, regularly speaking at events and contributing to the broader social media discourse 

WHY YOU'LL LOVE OGILVY:

  • Global opportunities – Access career pathways, projects and connections across the Ogilvy and WPP network.
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave – Gender-neutral leave for all parents and caregivers.
  • Leading AI tools – Exclusive access to WPP Open, our global AI platform.
  • Inclusive culture – A workplace where everyone can belong and thrive.
  • Career development – Personalised growth plans, coaching and ongoing learning opportunities.
  • Extra time off – Birthday leave, Summer Fridays and loyalty leave.
  • Wellbeing support – Health and fitness discounts, wellbeing programs and mindfulness resources.
  • Employee Assistance Program – Free, confidential counselling support.
  • Recognition and rewards – Celebrating great work and long-term contribution.
  • Referral bonuses – Earn rewards for introducing great talent.
  • Exclusive discounts – Savings on major brands through perkSPACE.

At Ogilvy, inclusivity is essential to our success. We're committed to building a workplace that embraces various perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, knowing that diverse teams drive more impactful work. 

We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, Māori, people with disabilities, diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds, all ages, genders, sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions, nationalities, and family structures. 

We believe everyone thrives when they can be themselves. We provide equal opportunities and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential.  

If you require any accessibility adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know at ogv-au-careers@ogilvy.com

_______________________________________________________



Miejsce pracy: Warszawa, Plac Konesera (model hybrydowy) 
Forma zatrudnienia: Umowa o pracę / Umowa zlecenie  

Szukamy zorganizowanej osoby ze świetnym wyczuciem internetu i social mediów, która dołączy do naszego zespołu. Będziesz na co dzień pracować przy naszych kluczowych klientach, łącząc świat influencerów, tworzenia contentu i eventów. 

Nie musisz znać wszystkich procesów agencyjnych od pierwszego dnia - wszystkiego Cię nauczymy! Szukamy kogoś, kto ma naturalną zajawkę na SoMe i trendy, a jednocześnie potrafi skrupulatnie dopiąć formalności, harmonogramy i umowy. 

Twój zakres obowiązków: 

  • Research twórców (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube), weryfikacja ich profilu, sprawdzanie ewentualnych ryzyk i przygotowywanie rekomendacji pod kampanie. 
  • Kontakt z twórcami i ich agencjami, briefowanie, zbieranie materiałów oraz pilnowanie terminów publikacji.
  • Przygotowywanie umów z twórcami, wprowadzanie dostawców do systemów, pilnowanie rozliczeń, faktur i rachunków. 
  • Wsparcie działań PR i biura prasowego – tworzenie komunikatów prasowych, dystrybucja i stały kontakt z mediami 
  • Codzienna współpraca z domem mediowym  -przekazywanie materiałów influencerskich do płatnego promowania zgodnie z harmonogramem. 
  • Wsparcie przy realizacji materiałów na kanały marki. 
  • Pomoc przy organizacji eventów i akcji specjalnych. 
  • Przygotowywanie podsumowań, zestawień i prezentacji kampanii - w dużej mierze w języku angielskim. 

Nasze wymagania: 

  • Świetna organizacja pracy i dokładność: potrafisz zaplanować swoją pracę, dbasz o detale, pamiętasz o formalnościach i terminach bez konieczności stałego przypominania. 
  • Aktywnie korzystasz z TikToka, Instagrama i YouTube'a, wiesz, co jest teraz w trendach, kto jest na fali, a kogo lepiej unikać ze względu na kontrowersje. 
  • Bardzo dobry język angielski (min. B2/C1): będziesz go używać na co dzień przy tworzeniu prezentacji, raportów, rekomendacji oraz w stałej (mailowej) komunikacji z klientem.  
  • Łatwość w nawiązywaniu relacji - u nas każdy członek zespołu ma bezpośredni, partnerski kontakt z klientem, twórcami i dostawcami. 

Mile widziane (duży plus!): 

  • Doświadczenie (nawet stażowe) w agencji PR, digital lub influencer marketingu. 
  • Zmysł wizualny i podstawowa umiejętność montażu wideo na telefonie (np. CapCut, Canva). 

Czego możesz spodziewać się po tym stanowisku? 

  • Świetny projekt na start w branży: rzadka okazja, by w ramach jednego klienta spróbować wszystkiego - od influencer marketingu, przez social media, po PR korporacyjny/produktowy i eventy. 
  • Wyjątkowa kultura i relacja z klientem: projekt, w którym Twoje kreatywne pomysły naprawdę mają szansę na realizację. 
  • Praca z topowymi twórcami: możliwość bezpośredniej współpracy z influencerami, których być może sam(a) na co dzień obserwujesz w sieci. 
  • Pełne wdrożenie i mentoring: trafiasz do zgranego, wspierającego zespołu, który krok po kroku nauczy Cię procesów agencyjnych. 

Benefity: 

  • Dostęp do platform edukacyjnych i rozwoju: szkolenia, webinary oraz narzędzia globalnej sieci agencji (w tym innowacyjne narzędzia AI wspierające codzienną pracę). 
  • Prywatna opieka medyczna o podwyższonym standardzie oraz dofinansowanie do karty sportowej. 
  • Elastyczność i wygoda: model hybrydowy (min. 2 dni z biura, reszta z domu) w nowoczesnej przestrzeni w Centrum Praskim Koneser. 

     

    _______________________________________________________

     

Poniżej podajemy orientacyjny zakres wynagrodzenia brutto na tym stanowisku w momencie publikacji ogłoszenia. Przedział ten odzwierciedla ramy wynagrodzeń obowiązujące w całej naszej globalnej grupie, obejmujące różnorodne Agencje i specjalizacje. W przypadku tej konkretnej roli, nasza propozycja wynagrodzenia zostanie ustalona w ramach wskazanego zakresu, w oparciu o nasze wewnętrzne wytyczne oraz z uwzględnieniem specyficznych warunków rynkowych dla naszej specjalizacji. Ostateczna wysokość indywidualnego wynagrodzenia zależy od wielu czynników związanych z danym stanowiskiem, m.in.: bieżących potrzeb biznesowych, posiadanego doświadczenia, poziomu odpowiedzialności oraz kwalifikacji.

 

Oprócz podanego przedziału wynagrodzeń, oferujemy kompleksowy pakiet benefitów, mający na celu dbanie o Wellbeing naszych pracowników jak i ich rozwój zawodowy. W zależności od Agencji mogą występować różnice w zakresie benefitów, lecz typowe świadczenia obejmują: prywatną opiekę medyczną, możliwości rozwoju zawodowego, programy szkoleniowe oraz elastyczne warunki pracy (w stosownych przypadkach / jeśli jest to możliwe). Niektóre Agencje mogą również oferować dodatkowe benefity.

We are looking for an Midweight Art Director

Attention all creative rockstars! Join Ogilvy Social.Lab South Africa as our new Midweight Art Director! Picture a vibrant, collaborative space where minds ignite, crafting solutions that dazzle, thrill clients near and far, and lure talent and brands with extraordinary brilliance.

We redefine branding by merging genius creative with laser-focused distribution and optimization. Imagine a high-energy, open-plan office – a haven for innovation, fuelled by a friendly vibe that welcomes audacity.

Embrace our entrepreneurial spirit and reshape marketing and communications. Let's rewrite the rules together. Elevate brands in today's dynamic world. Ready to lead the charge? 🌍

About you

You've got an eagle eye for detail that could spot a needle in a haystack! Nothing gets past your keen senses – you're the detail superstar we need. Strategy? Operation? You handle it all like a pro. You're not just about the big ideas – you make them happen, and boy, do you deliver! Results-driven campaigns? That's your playground! Fast-paced? That's where you thrive! You've got a track record of conquering whirlwinds with a smile, turning chaos into pure awesomeness.

So, are you ready to light up the stage, dazzle our clients, and turbocharge Social Lab's business results? Show us what you've got!

Responsibilities

  • Lead brainstorms and conceptualisation
  • Lead the craft and art direction of an idea across multiple channels
  • Provide a clear, focused creative vision to both internal and external partners, refining and improving continuously.
  • Manage external partners to create effective solutions across platforms, tailoring content for each channel.
  • Inspire and uplift our internal teams and external partners (e.g., META, TikTok) to ensure campaigns shine with creativity and innovation.
  • Direct the creation of diverse creative assets, from key art to trailers, encompassing brand-building and direct response ads through our tech tools.
  • Collaborate with the Creative Operations Director to establish and maintain our Tech Stack, ensuring its adoption and consistency across our client portfolio.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 5-8-years’ experience preferably within an advertising agency environment
  • Strong conceptual background
  • Award winning digital work within your portfolio &/or Experience/Key role in Digital transformation within an agency/team.
  • Experience working with junior-mid team members and growing them simultaneously.

Offer

  • A opportunity to work within a growing and trendsetting agency
  • Global client portfolio
  • Attractive package and benefits
  • Continuous trainings. Career conversation and growing opportunities
  • Flexible homeworking policy

Are you passionate about people? Do you thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment? Are you excited about championing diversity and inclusivity in the workplace? If you answered yes to these questions, then we have the perfect opportunity for you!

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced HR Advisor to join our team at the world's leading creative advertising agency. As an HR Advisor, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for providing HR advice and support to our employees across the organisation. You will play a critical role in helping us to, develop, and retain top talent while ensuring that our employees have the support and resources they need to excel in their roles.

As an HR Advisor, you will work closely with our People Partner’s to develop and implement HR strategies, policies, and programs that promote a positive and inclusive workplace culture. You will have the opportunity to partner with our business leaders to provide guidance on a wide range of HR issues, including employee relations, performance management, and talent development.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide HR advice and support to all employees across the organization.
  • Partner with business leaders to identify talent development needs and design and implement strategies to support employee growth and development.
  • Act as a key point of contact for all employee relations matters, ensuring that all concerns are addressed with respect and empathy.
  • Lead and support the performance management process, ensuring that employees receive regular feedback and support to achieve their goals.
  • Develop and deliver training programs on HR policies and procedures, ensuring that all employees have a clear understanding of their rights and responsibilities.
  • Support the recruitment and selection process, ensuring that all candidates are evaluated fairly and without bias.
  • Maintain accurate HR records and ensure that all data is managed in accordance with relevant legislation and best practice.
  • Participate in employee engagement initiatives, ensuring that all employees have a voice and that their feedback is valued and acted upon.
  • Stay up to date with relevant legislation and industry best practices and proactively recommend changes to policies and procedures to ensure ongoing compliance and alignment with best practice.

 

Requirements:

  • Experience in a similar HR Advisor or HR Generalist role, preferably in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Knowledge of HR best practices and relevant legislation, including labour laws and equal employment opportunity regulations.
  • Demonstrated experience in employee relations, performance management, and talent development.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate complex information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a flexible and adaptable approach to work.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Proven problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex situations and develop effective solutions.
  • Passion for diversity, equity, and inclusion, with a commitment to promoting these values in the workplace.

These responsibilities reflect our commitment to promoting inclusivity, equity, and respect for all employees, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate their passion for these values in all aspects of their work.

Department: People team

Location: London/hybrid

Contract type: 6 month Fixed-term contract

Full Time/Part time: Full Time

Reporting into: Chief People Officer

 

The Role:

We are seeking an experienced and commercially astute People Partner to join our People team in our world-leading creative agency. As a strategic business leader, you will own the employee experience and people-related outcomes for a defined part of our business, acting as a primary "Experience Account Manager." You will orchestrate HR products and services to solve real business problems and drive significant change, directly impacting engagement, performance, capability, and retention for your "account" areas.

This role requires a proactive, data-driven individual who can act as a credible 'thinking partner' to senior leaders, translating business strategy into impactful people plans and ensuring Ogilvy remains an employer of choice. You will be instrumental in driving organisational change and transformation, shaping the people narrative, and leveraging HR as a critical toolkit to achieve commercial success and foster our Borderless Creativity culture.

 

Responsibilities:

  1. Strategic Leadership Advisory & Development:
  • Act as a primary "thinking partner" to senior business leaders, providing expert counsel and strategic challenge on people, culture, performance, and organisational risk.
  • Proactively work with leadership to achieve commercial goals, business strategy, and desired culture, using data from 360-degree feedback, engagement surveys, performance reviews, and attrition analysis.
  • Treat your business areas as your "clients," understanding their unique needs and delivering tailored people solutions.
  • Develop and implement strategic people plans aligned with business objectives, driving outcomes such as improved engagement, performance, capability uplift, and retention within your business areas.

 

  1. Organisational Change & Transformation:
  • Partner with your business for significant business initiatives, including restructurings, acquisitions, integrations, and new growth areas, framing the people, culture, and capability implications.
  • Lead organisational design and workforce planning conversations, developing scenario models for structures, critical roles, skills, and future talent needs.
  • Work in Partnerships with centralised Centres of Excellence and HR Operations to ensure effective end to end HR service.
  • Identify and mitigate risks such as culture challenges, leadership bottlenecks, key person dependencies, employee relations and burnout.

 

  1. Planning, Design & Delivery (Product & Portfolio Mindset):
  • Clarify and diagnose critical business problems (e.g., growth, margin, productivity, churn) that can be addressed through people solutions.
  • Partner with specialist HR Centres of Excellence (L&D, TA, Reward, People & Culture and People Operations), acting as the voice of the business leader and employee into the wider People team.
  • Continually look for ways to improve approach/ ways of working to managing ongoing "BAU" People needs (e.g., hiring processes, manager support, benefits, etc), ensuring efficiency and freeing up capacity for truly strategic initiatives. 

 

  1. Commercial & Financial Acumen:
  • Understand the commercial context of your business areas and link HR initiatives directly to business value drivers (e.g., margin improvement, revenue growth, productivity gains, risk reduction).
  • Collaborate closely with finance teams to manage HR-related budgets, analyse data, and ensure people investments deliver clear ROI.
  • Contribute to workforce planning initiatives, assessing staffing needs, developing strategies for talent retention, and succession planning.
  • Lead talent management activities, ensuring robust succession planning, critical role identification, and proactive development pathways.

 

  1. Employee Engagement & Experience:
  • Own and drive initiatives that promote a positive, inclusive work culture and enhance employee engagement across your business areas.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and provide guidance to managers and employees on various HR-related matters, including performance management, employee relations, and career development.
  • Facilitate feedback channels, interpret engagement survey results, and lead the creation and implementation of action plans.
  • Ensure compliance with employment legislation and regulations in the UK, providing clear guidance to managers and employees.

 

Please note that these responsibilities are not exhaustive and may vary depending on the specific needs and priorities of the business. 

 

Key Skills & Experienced Required:

  • Commercial and Financial Literacy: Proven ability to understand P&Ls, budgets, value drivers, and business models. Able to credibly discuss margin, revenue, productivity, risk, and growth strategy with senior leaders.
  • Strategic HR Experience: Significant proven experience as a People Partner in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, ideally within a creative agency or similar industry, and have experience of working within a centralised HR model. Demonstrable track record of owning outcomes and driving business impact through people strategy.
  • Leadership, Coaching & Consulting Skills: Credible peer to senior leaders; able to challenge and support effectively. Highly skilled at framing complex problems, contracting work, and delivering difficult feedback constructively.
  • Change, Communications & Storytelling: Expertise in leading organisational change initiatives. Able to craft compelling narratives, gain leadership buy-in, and understand both behavioural and process change.
  • Data & Insight Fluency: Strong analytical skills with a data-driven mindset. Proficient in using people and business data for diagnosis, prioritisation, and building simple, sharp insight packs for leaders. Experience with HR analytics and metrics to inform decision-making.
  • Organisational Design & Development: Demonstrated knowledge and experience in leading org design, workforce planning, and talent management (succession, critical roles, development).
  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively build trust and influence stakeholders at all levels, including external partners.
  • Technical HR Expertise: CIPD certification (Level 7 preferred). Strong understanding of HR best practices, employment legislation, and regulations in the United Kingdom. Experience with HRIS (Workday implementation experience is a plus).
  • Resilience & Adaptability: Proven ability to thrive in a complex, ambiguous, and continuously evolving environment, managing multiple priorities and driving continuous improvement.

 

Benefits 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day 
  • Bupa Healthcare
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year

We are looking for an experienced PR Consultant (Account Manager) to join our Perth team on a short term contract until July 2027. 

You’ll be based in Perth, working closely with The Brand Agency team locally while collaborating remotely with the Ogilvy PR team in Sydney. 

The role will support communications activity for a major new corporate client, allowing you to work across corporate communications, media relations, and integrated campaigns. You’ll help bring complex business and industry stories to life, identify opportunities to build reputation and influence, and deliver engaging communications across a range of stakeholders. 

You’ll play a key role in the day-to-day delivery of the account, working across both teams to develop stories, manage media relationships, support client communications, and deliver high-quality work. 

Working as part of this wider team, you’ll have access to the expertise and support of the Sydney-based Ogilvy PR team, while being closely connected to the Perth-based TBA team. 

For this project, you’ll have the opportunity to develop communications around a major project, and help translate complex topics into clear, compelling stories for media and broader audiences. 

What You'll Do: 

  • Support the development and delivery of communications campaigns for a major project. 
  • Work closely with The Brand Agency team in Perth and the Ogilvy PR team in Sydney. 
  • Manage day-to-day client communications and campaign activity. 
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with Australian media. 
  • Identify proactive media opportunities and pitch compelling stories. 
  • Develop high-quality communications materials, including media releases, pitches, briefing documents and thought leadership content. 
  • Immerse yourself in the client’s business, networks, issues and industry. 
  • Stay across competitors, industry developments and the broader energy landscape. 
  • Think beyond earned media to identify how stories can come to life across multiple channels. 
  • Support integrated campaigns that connect communications, channels and messages. 
  • Manage multiple projects, timelines and stakeholders with strong attention to detail. 
  • Contribute ideas and strategic recommendations that help achieve client objectives. 

What You'll Bring:

  • PR or communications experience at Account Manager level or equivalent. 
  • Experience working with corporate, business, technology, or related clients. 
  • Strong knowledge of the Australian media landscape and established media relationships. 
  • A track record of developing stories and securing quality editorial coverage. 
  • Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills. 
  • Strong organisation and campaign delivery skills. 
  • Close attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities. 
  • A proactive approach and the ability to work confidently with clients and colleagues.

Senior Account Manager, Consumer Team, Wilson Hartnell 

Earned-first creativity. Social-first execution. Brilliant storytelling. Measurable impact. 

Are you an exceptionally capable communications leader who combines strategic counsel with creative ambition? A trusted partner to consumer brands who can translate cultural insights into headline-grabbing work, navigate complex briefs & spot growth opportunities? 

We’re looking for a Senior Account Manager to join the Consumer Team at Wilson Hartnell; someone with earned first creative mindset & cultural instincts to lead consumer brand portfolios with independence and flair. 

Part of the global WPP network, Wilson Hartnell operates at the intersection of earned-first creativity, social-first engagement and culture. We partner with leading Irish and global consumer brands to shape conversations, build cultural relevance, safeguard reputations and connect with modern audiences where they live, scroll, and share. 

In this role, you’ll act as a primary strategic lead for major consumer accounts, partner closely with Account Directors and Heads of Practice, and step up to lead account teams when required. If you're ready to champion earned-first creative, lead social-first campaigns from concept to execution, and make your mark on award-winning work while mentoring the next generation of talent, we want to hear from you.  

What you’ll do 

  • Lead the development, ideation and execution of earned-first creative campaigns that capture cultural momentum, spark conversation and deliver commercial impact. 
  • Deliver narrative excellence, from earned media strategies and brand storytelling to social content, creator briefs, case studies and press materials. 
  • Lead social and creator strategies across your clients, collaborating with creators, identifying platform trends and integrating social and AI workflows into campaign delivery. 
  • Lead campaign measurement and evaluation, introducing frameworks and digital measurement tools to demonstrate earned media value, social engagement, share of voice and tangible commercial impact. 
  • Proactively mitigate risks, manage sensitive client scenarios and partner with senior leaders on crisis communications & reputation management. 
  • Identify organic growth opportunities within existing client accounts, support new business pitches and manage client budgets. 
  • Lead and inspire junior team members (AEs, SAEs, interns), fostering best practices in earned-first ideation and social campaign, while actively participating in recruitment and career development. 
  • Collaborate across the wider agency and global WPP/Ogilvy creative, social, and strategic resources to deliver fully integrated campaigns.  

What you’ll bring 

You’re an experienced communications professional with a track record of running consumer account portfolios. 

  • Demonstrable track record in a PR, communications, or integrated agency environment (typically 4–5+ years), leading consumer brand campaigns from brief to evaluation. 
  • Proven expertise in earned-first creative thinking and hands-on experience in social-first campaign development and execution, with an instinctive feel for culture, consumer trends and the creator economy. 
  • Proven ability to build rapport and trust with senior brand stakeholders, agency leadership, creators and external partners. 
  • Outstanding writing, editing and content ideation skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives for both traditional media and social channels. 
  • Experience handling fast-paced consumer reputational matters, drafting holding statements, and maintaining steady account leadership during brand challenges. 
  • Comfort managing complex campaign budgets, driving account profitability, and identifying commercial opportunities for organic expansion and new business wins. 
  • Strong supervisory and mentorship skills, with experience delegating work effectively and nurturing the professional growth of junior colleagues. 
  • Fluency in emerging social platforms, creator identification tools,  campaign measurement analytics, and an active appetite for AI technologies shaping the future of PR and social. 

A note on AI - AI is great at many things. But capturing what makes you you? Not so much. So when you're applying, we would love to hear your voice. The things that excite you, the way you think, and a glimpse of your personality help us understand who you are far better than a perfectly crafted AI answer. We love people who use AI smartly in their work, just not to write their application

Location: Perth

Employment type: Fixed-term contract, January 2027 - July 2027. 

We’re looking for a talented Senior Social Media Manager - Corporate & B2B Social and Influence to join our team in Perth, working across Social@Ogilvy and The Brand Agency (TBA).

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on social and influencer expertise, and is keen to help shape and grow a specialist offering in the WA market.

You’ll lead social and influencer activity for a key client, while working collaboratively across creative, strategy, production and media teams to deliver standout work. You’ll also play an important role in developing our broader corporate and B2B social offering, connecting our Perth team with the expertise, capabilities and opportunities across the wider Ogilvy network.

For someone who enjoys building relationships, spotting opportunities and turning great ideas into effective social-first campaigns, this role offers the chance to make a real impact.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO: 

  • Lead social and influence campaigns: Develop and deliver strategic organic social and influencer campaigns that meet client objectives and drive meaningful results.
  • Be a trusted client partner: Provide expert advice on social strategy, content, advocacy and influencer marketing, building strong relationships and identifying opportunities to grow client partnerships.
  • Champion social-first thinking: Work closely with creative, strategy, production and paid media teams to integrate social and influence into broader campaigns from the outset.
  • Bring creator partnerships to life: Build relationships with influencers, key opinion leaders (KOLs), talent managers and platform partners, overseeing negotiations, contracts, usage rights, deliverables and fees.

job.title: Supervisor Tax
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Tax Supervisor is responsible for performing activities related to activities related to Indirect Tax & Statutory compliance procedures for Good and Service tax (GST), Withholding Tax and Corporate Income tax across multiple entities of the Group.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Calculation, filing preparation and remittance - GST, TDS/ Withholding tax
  • Ensuring all Monthly/Annual returns in Form GSTR 1, GSTR 3B, GSTR 6 (ISD) and GSTR 9 and 9C are filed within the due dates
  • Preparation of outward GL and outward report working file. Reconciliation of such working files i.e. Outward report and Output liability GL accounts
  • Preparation of inward GL and inward report working file. Reconciliation of such working files i.e. Inward report and inward GL accounts
  • Discussions with relevant teams in case of differences between outward register and the IRN portal data
  • Review of errors/ observations for outward and inward transactions
  • Co-ordination and discussions with agencies and relevant SSC teams for resolving the errors/ observations
  • Review of ITC matching files which includes the following –
    • Review of split-booking transactions
    • Review of invoices for resolving the transactions with document number mismatch and document date mismatch
  • Preparation of dashboard workings to ensure that the liability is discharged correctly in the monthly return
  • Review of 180 days deferment report shared by EY along with the interest workings
  • Timely payments to tax bank accounts and vendor related TDS payments processing
  • Support team members and Senior team members with audits – GST, client’s audit.
  • Prepare/ Review Vendor and Employee quarterly e-TDS processing and monthly remittances
  • Support Local Finance in Tax compliance documentation as required.
  • Liaise with tax consultant on ongoing matters such as Show Cause Notice, hearings with department, etc.
  • Review Corporate Income Tax calculation.
  • Review documentation prepared for filing of withholding tax
  • Prepare agencies with supporting documentation as per the local tax & statutory requirements
  • Prepare annual financial statements
  • Review Withholding tax calculation and filing preparation
  • Review 26AS Income tax provision, filing, and remittance
  • Income tax assessment and audit
  • Calculate roll forward of deferred income taxes and accrued income taxes payable
  • Estimate annual effective tax rate calculation
  • Ensure timely preparation of Other IPG Tax Reporting Schedules
  • Perform transfer pricing audit and assessment reconciliation
  • Update and send for TL review Month/Quarter end Tax compliance check list.

Other activities:

  • Resolve Agency Local Finance queries within defined timelines by meeting SLAs agreed
  • Assist client and external audit process when necessary
  • Supervising activities within process
  • Assisting Team Leads in productivity and work load management for their respective areas
  • Supporting TLs in Leave and Attendance management for their respective areas
  • Cross training activities
  • Act as Subject matter experts within the team.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

Essential

  • 5-8 years of work experience in a similar role
  • Experience in Advertising and Media industry preferred
  • Minimum Education Qualification – B. com/M. com with Chartered Accountant or other equivalent post qualification
  • Management of a high transaction volumes business, with good knowledge of associated controls and procedures
  • Knowledge of statutory requirements in relation to Tax & Compliance
  • Ability to provide high level of customer service for the R2R process
  • Strong written and oral communications skills in English
  • Strong problem solving, team management and organizational skills
  • Experience in managing people and processes through a sustained period of change
  • Excellent computer skills and competency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
  • Experience in Tax compliance tools, AI and Automation tools, S4 HANA, MS Dynamics or similar ERP systems

A distinct advantage:

  • Experience working in a Shared Services Centre focused on Finance & Accounting activities
  • Experience in document imaging software like SharePoint
  • Good knowledge of working with Government Portal and integrating with ERP.

job.title: 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

  Overview and Responsibilities:   Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician to support engineering maintenance and technical operations for the CBS Network and affiliated production units. This role offers essential support around the clock for broadcast systems that are on-air and in production. It involves setting up, monitoring, and solving problems related to complex technical systems.   We use several systems. These include SDI and ST 2110 IP video routers. We also have channel playout systems, high-speed Ethernet fabrics (25–200GbE), and structured fiber optic cabling. In addition, we utilize media storage and transfer platforms, switchers, and both satellite and terrestrial contribution and distribution systems. Our on-air graphics and internet/cloud streaming encoding systems are included as well.     Basic Qualifications:  
  • 3+ years of engineering support and troubleshooting experience in broadcast environments, including one or more of the following:
  • On-air playout in broadcast and/or streaming environments
  • Live broadcast control room operations, preferably in sports or live entertainment
  • Transmission operations supporting real-time monitoring and distribution across multiple delivery paths
  • Expert-level knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 IP video infrastructure, including uncompressed video (ST 2110-20), audio (ST 2110-30), and ancillary data (ST 2110-40) flows, with solid comprehension of PTP-based timing and synchronization
  • Proficiency with broadcast test and measurement equipment (waveform monitors, vectorscopes, rasterizers, signal analyzers) for validating video/audio integrity across SDI and IP signal paths
  • You need to know about broadcast network design principles for high-bandwidth, uncompressed video. This includes redundancy models such as dual fabric and hitless switching. It is also important to understand multicast design and how to manage essence flow bandwidth.
  Additional Qualifications:   IP & Broadcast Systems
  • End-to-end signal chain troubleshooting across IP, SDI, LTC, L-Band, and ASI signals, with a structured methodology for isolating issues across network, device, and workflow layers
  • Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Evertz IP-based systems, including ST 2110 routing, signal processing, control infrastructure, NMOS integration (e.g., Evertz Magnum), SDP generation/exchange, and control plane vs. data plane separation
  • Knowledge of broadcast engineering best practices related to signal redundancy, failover, and resiliency design
Playout & Monitoring
  • Experience supporting channel origination workflows with Grass Valley AMPP. This work involves playout service orchestration. It also includes graphics insertion, SCTE triggers, and content scheduling.
  • Experience supporting Imagine Communications SNP or equivalent IP gateway systems in live production or playout environments
  • Familiarity with TAG Video Systems multiviewers, including monitoring layout configuration, signal health validation, and alarm interpretation in IP video environments
  • Working knowledge of Telestream PRISM waveform monitors for real-time SDI and ST 2110 signal analysis, including video quality, color space accuracy, and HDR/SDR compliance
Color, HDR & Satellite
  • Knowledge of color space conversion and HDR/SDR compatibility is important. This involves working with LUTs and tone mapping. You should also be able to fix EOTF/gamma errors, address color space metadata mismatches, and ensure consistent HDR/SDR output across devices.
  • Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting IRDs, L-Band routers, and associated RF equipment; solid knowledge of end-to-end satellite downlink signal chains including RF, L-Band, ASI, and IP outputs
Cloud & General
  • Knowledge of cloud-based or hybrid broadcast workflows, including remote production or IP extension of linear streams into AWS or Oracle Cloud environments
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering teams to troubleshoot issues across routing control systems, multicast networking, and downstream playout or monitoring devices
  • Proficient written documentation skills. This includes operational procedures. It also includes troubleshooting guides and engineering run books.
  • You should communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should also be self-directed and able to work in environments where priorities change.


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Paramount Global (NASDAQ: PARA, PARAA) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, Pluto TV and Simon & Schuster, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

Role Details
The Convergent Account Executive owns the full advertising relationship across both linear and streaming for their assigned clients — spanning Broadcast dayparts (Prime, News, Late Night and Daytime), Cable Networks, and the full Streaming/CTV portfolio, including programmatic and direct IO (DIO) channels. This includes regular scheduled programming as well as specials (e.g., The VMAs, Golden Globes, AMAs) and sponsorship/integration opportunities. The Convergent AE is the single point of accountability for delivering unified, cross-platform (“360”) solutions, working in tandem with specialty, programmatic, and AM partners to maximize revenue across the entire Paramount portfolio. This position sets its own sales agenda and is responsible for growing and maintaining a book of business across both linear and streaming properties. 

 

Your Day-to-Day
Account & Revenue Management:

  • Manage a robust account list spanning multiple industries across both linear and streaming platforms
  • Develop and execute account strategies for long-term development and revenue growth across the full portfolio
  • Consistently meet or exceed established revenue targets on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis
  • Generate new sales leads and proactively uncover new linear and streaming sales opportunities
  • Manage a programmatic and direct sales pipeline — including forecasting, prospecting, pipeline management, and reporting

 

Client Strategy & Consultative Selling:

  • Act as a business specialist and trusted advisor on behalf of clients — strategically developing broadcast, streaming, and mixed-media solutions to suit their objectives
  • Establish and cultivate client relationships through a high volume of face-to-face calls
  • Bring proactive, consultative solutions to clients by leveraging Paramount's full sales product suite and delivering strategic insights through QBRs
  • Serve as the key point of contact internally and externally, prioritizing and leading accurate account management across teams

 

Cross-Platform Collaboration:

  • Collaborate across cable, broadcast, sports, and streaming/programmatic teams to generate revenue and deliver holistic client solutions
  • Collaborate with centers of excellence to develop strategic roadmaps and drive revenue across the full portfolio
  • Work in tandem with digital, programmatic, and specialty counterparts to ensure a seamless 360 client experience

 

Programmatic & Marketplace Expertise:

  • Confidently lead conversations about the programmatic landscape (SSP/DSP marketplaces) and direct 1:1 advertiser/agency strategies
  • Sell CTV, sponsorships, and tentpoles across the full streaming ecosystem, leveraging both DIO and programmatic channels
  • Stay ahead of the curve on marketplace trends relating to clients as well as the broader linear and digital advertising industry, actively engaging in events, training, and trade publications
  • Establish oneself as a thought leader across the broadcast and streaming community, evangelizing Paramount's unique cross-platform positioning

 

Leadership & Team Development:

  • Partner with AM Management to mentor AM sales partners, ensuring best-in-class client servicing pre- and post-sale, including deal set-up, deal management, and post-campaign QBRs
  • Collaborate with AM Management to provide assigned AMs with clear day-to-day direction, real-time feedback, and development support to foster team growth, motivation, and performance

 

Qualifications
What you bring to the team:

  • 5+ years of advertising sales experience spanning linear and/or streaming/programmatic, with direct experience in programmatic roles at publishers, ad tech firms, or platform companies preferred
  • Sales professional with an entrepreneurial spirit who thrives in a team, goal-oriented environment
  • Strong desire to win and grow as a cross-platform (linear and streaming) ad sales professional

  • Well-developed presentation skills that demonstrate command of the business, offerings, and client needs
  • Ability to manage stress and balance multiple account priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • High initiative, problem-solving ability, agility, and a growth mindset

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

THE OPPORTUNITY
This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth role built for a broadcast-experienced seller who can do it all — someone who has spent time in local TV knows how to maximize opportunities, and is hungry to excel as a multi-screen, multi-market powerhouse.
As an Account Executive on the Local Ad Sales team at CBS, you will sell across our full O&O footprint — with the ability to close multi-market broadcast deals that span from coast to coast. Layered on top of that is the opportunity to sell Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming inventory, giving clients a truly end-to-end screen solution backed by one of the most recognized brands in media.
You will bring new business to the table. You will build client relationships that outlast any single campaign. And you will deliver results.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Hunt — hard. Prospect relentlessly across local, regional, and national categories. New-to-station and non-traditional revenue is your primary mandate. You don't wait for the phone to ring.
  • Sell all screens. Drive revenue across CBS O&O broadcast, Paramount+ and Pluto TV — in a single, integrated pitch.
  • Think multi-market. Leverage the full 17-market CBS O&O footprint to bring advertisers a scaled broadcast solution to reach audiences across any & all markets.
  • Build don't inherit. Develop direct client and agency relationships from the ground up. Own your pipeline and your outcomes.
  • Be a marketer first. Package custom solutions — tentpole programs, sports integrations, streaming packages, sponsorships — tailored to client business goals, not just available inventory.
  • Own your numbers. Manage quarterly and annual account plans, forecast accurately, and hit your monthly and quarterly revenue goals. 
  • Stay ahead of the market. Know the linear and streaming landscape. Understand where categories are investing and why. Bring category intelligence into every client conversation.
  • Collaborate to win. Partner with Integrated Marketing, Account Management, Traffic, and deliver seamless, high-impact campaigns from pre-sale through post-recap.
  • Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on marketplace trends, category dynamics, and the evolving linear and streaming landscape.
  • Represent CBS Pittsburgh at client meetings, presentations, and station events.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 

Required:

  • 2+ years of local broadcast experience, multi-platform, or local media advertising sales with a verifiable history of hitting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Real hunger—you prospect, you pitch, you close. You don’t wait for business to come to you.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build lasting client partnerships.
  • Experience working with both advertising agencies and direct clients.
  • Outstanding presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume, fast-paced book of business with professionalism and precision.
  • Valid Drivers License

 

Preferred:

  • Experience selling streaming, digital, or OTT inventory in addition to linear television.
  • Familiarity with Paramount+, Pluto TV, or FAST/AVOD platform sales.
  • Experience selling multi-market or national broadcast packages.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Proficient in Wide Orbit, Strata, Salesforce, and Microsoft Excel.

 

CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe.
