job.title: Account Executive, Advanced Advertising
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 


Paramount Advertising is seeking a highly motivated, consultative sales professional to drive growth across Paramount’s vast portfolio through the integration of streaming, programmatic, advanced advertising, data, and convergent media solutions. The ideal candidate brings a sophisticated understanding of today’s evolving media landscape and excels at translating Paramount’s full range of capabilities into integrated solutions that deliver against advertisers’ business objectives—moving beyond traditional demo guarantees and delivery metrics.


As an Account Executive on the Advanced Advertising Team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to agencies and advertisers, helping them navigate and capitalize on the convergence of linear TV, streaming, digital video, programmatic, and data-driven advertising. You will leverage Paramount’s suite of audience, identity, optimization, attribution, measurement, programmatic, and advanced advertising solutions to develop holistic, outcome-oriented media strategies.


The ideal candidate understands how programmatic buying and activation intersect with premium streaming and traditional television, and can articulate the value of bringing these channels together through a unified approach. You will be expected to identify opportunities to expand relationships, drive incremental revenue, and position Paramount as a leading partner for clients seeking greater scale, precision, flexibility, and measurable business outcomes across the entire video ecosystem.


Success in this role requires a balance of revenue generation, executive presence, convergent selling expertise, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with agency investment and strategy teams, programmatic and digital leads, data and analytics partners, and Paramount’s broader sales organization to develop integrated solutions and unlock new sources of growth.


You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, are comfortable selling complex technology and data-enabled solutions, and can move fluidly between high-level business strategy and the details of media activation. You are equally effective influencing senior clients, educating agencies on emerging capabilities, partnering across internal teams, and turning sophisticated media solutions into measurable business results.

 

Results Driven 

  • Consistently meet or exceed established revenue targets on a quarterly and annual basis.
  • Proven capability to sell data-driven and optimized executions across linear and streaming.
  • Manage a Hold Co aligned Advanced Advertising sales pipeline—including forecasting, prospecting, pipeline management, reporting and long-term revenue growth.
  •  Identify and cultivate new Advanced Advertising opportunities across existing and prospective clients.
  • Leverage campaign performance, audience insights, and measurement outputs to uncover incremental revenue opportunities.
  • Establish and cultivate relationships with internal stakeholders and clients by conducting a high volume of face-to-face calls.

 

A Consultative Sales Executive

  • Collaborate across platforms within your Hold Co (including linear, streaming, and sports) to generate revenue across the Paramount portfolio product suite to deliver holistic client solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for both clients and internal counterparts.
  • Develop and present data-driven recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and return on advertising investment.

 

Multi-platform Proficient

  • Understand the complementary value and nuance of representing all platforms and buy types, including programmatic, across a portfolio to execute a unified advertising strategy. 
  • Stay ahead of industry trends by actively engaging in events, training, and trade publications.
  • Confidently articulate the role of audience-first planning, cross-platform activation, and performance measurement in today's fragmented media landscape.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the Advanced Advertising ecosystem and competitive marketplace.

 

A Leader by Example

  • In partnership with AA Management, work closely with and mentor your Account Manager(s) to develop into future sales leaders
  • Create meaningful opportunities for Account Managers to participate in client-facing sales efforts and strategic conversations.
  • Deliver best-in-class client service throughout the campaign lifecycle, including onboarding, stewardship, optimization recommendations, and post-campaign reporting.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Planning, Data Solutions, Measurement, Product, Operations, and Sales teams to deliver seamless client experiences.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of advertising sales or agency experience, with a demonstrated understanding of how data flows throughout the ecosystem, and is applied in planning, execution, and measurement

 

Additional Qualifications: 

  • Strong relationship building skills and a collaborative nature.
  • High initiative, problem solving, adaptability and a growth mindset.
  • Proven ability to simplify complex technical and data concepts into compelling client narratives.
  • Well-developed presentation skills that demonstrate a command of our business, offerings and client needs.
  •  Ability to manage stress well, and balance multiple priorities at once.
  • BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience.

 


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

  • Understanding of SSPs, DSPs, direct programmatic advertising, and agency buying strategies.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. 
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. 
  
Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.  If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!  

  

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking and you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.   

 

 

A position is now available in our award-winning Sydney Sales team for an experienced Ad Sales Account Manager. 

 

The Account Manager role is responsible for driving advertising revenue through strategic account management of a top-tier client portfolio. You will serve as a key liaison between clients, agencies and internal teams to deliver high-impact advertising solutions under the guidance of a Group Client Partner.

 

Functions will include:

  • Leading a dynamic portfolio of clients with accountability for achieving revenue, increasing market share and yield targets across the wider Paramount playground (TV, BVOD, SVOD)
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with key clients, understanding their business objectives and providing tailored solutions
  • Proactively engaging with media agencies via regular in person meetings and presentations to pitch creative opportunities and integrated cross-platform solutions
  • Mentoring and guiding Account Executives and Sales Ops, fostering a positive team culture by providing training and support to enhance the skills and performance of the overall team
  • Taking ownership of individual and group revenue targets, sharing goals and performance KPIs, ensuring consistent delivery against monthly, quarterly and annual budgets across TV, BVOD and SVOD
  • Educating yourself on the evolving media landscape by staying informed on industry trends, competitors and market conditions to identify any potential risks or opportunities for growth
  • Collaborating with all internal stakeholders within the business to provide seamless sales strategies for clients and content led partnership opportunities
  • Championing internal process improvements, identifying opportunities to streamline workflows and enhance productivity in campaign delivery and client service

 

What are we looking for in an Account Manager? What’s important? 

  • Bachelor’s degree in media, Communications, Business, Marketing or related field highly regarded but not essential.
  • Minimum of 2-3 years experiences in sales, with a strong record of achieving targets, preferably from within media and/or agency
  • A customer-focused, sales orientated approach to meeting client expectations.
  • Strong proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications
  • Confident communicator with strong presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and a collaborative working style
  • Proficient at working towards sales targets, KPIs and proven track record of delivering and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Detail oriented, organised, flexible, timely and accurate
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced evolving environment 
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to adapt and meet deadlines
  • A passion for content, streaming, advertising innovation and audience behaviour

 

What are the benefits?  

  • Representing some of the world’s most powerful media & entertainment brands 
  • Working for a Global brand, you will have career development opportunities which expand to countries all over the world
  • Ability to thrive in a highly successful Sales team who are supportive, hard working, and quick to celebrate success 
  • Free subscription to our streaming services
  • Opportunity to work alongside and learn from some of the best in the business

Overview

The Account Manager (AM) is a developmental sales-focused role tasked with supporting day-to-day revenue efforts while developing the skills and experience needed to become a future Account Executive. This role touches all facets of the sales process—from proposal development and client support to campaign execution and stewardship—while partnering closely with Account Executives and internal teams. This is a position designed for high-potential candidates who want to learn the business, build selling skills, and grow into a full-cycle seller with direct ownership of accounts and revenue.

 

 

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to support active accounts, proposals, and revenue opportunities
  • Assist in selling streaming campaigns, with the opportunity to include linear inventory for cross-platform packages
  • Participate in sales calls (virtual and in-person) to gain exposure to client conversations, needs discovery, and selling strategies
  • Support, develop, and cultivate new business and smaller account opportunities as part of the broader AE pipeline
  • Coordinate campaign execution from pre-sale through post-sale, ensuring flawless delivery and stewardship
  • Prepare and update stewardship reports for guaranteed and non-guaranteed campaigns
  • Serve as a client support resource for inbound questions and requests
  • Work with Marketing, Research, Pricing & Inventory (Yield), and Operations teams to develop tailored sales presentations and solutions
  • Project-manage all elements needed for campaign launch, including creative assets, tags, approvals, and timelines
  • Ensure reliable communication and information flow between internal teams, Account Executives, and management
  • Build foundational selling skills, including proposal development, account support, pricing concepts, and inventory management
  • Learn media planning fundamentals and the end-to-end advertising sales lifecycle
  • Gain exposure to the systems, processes, and tools critical to future Account Executive success

 

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience in digital advertising, media, or sales support (Digital Ad Sales, planning, buying, or agency experience preferred)
  • Bachelor's degree required; equivalent combination of education and experience considered

 

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Well-developed desire to build a career in advertising sales and grow into a revenue-owning seller
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, team-oriented sales environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Self-motivated, driven, and willing to learn
  • Experience with sales and ad-tech platforms such as FreeWheel, Google Ads Manager, Salesforce, and/or Operative, and/or WideOrbit is a plus
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Excel, and Google Workspace

•         Write breaking news articles and push alerts for digital platforms
•         Shift requires overnights and weekends!

•         2+ years of proven television news assignment editor experience is strongly preferred, however, a significant background in print reporting or radio news will be considered.

Content Editors play an integral part on the PlutoTV Programming team curating PlutoTV Channels in Canada. Equal parts creative and strategic, we are looking for a Content Editor that curates creative, genre, special event, and show-based channels while monitoring performance and editing content flows to improve success.   This is an active vacancy on the team for a leave coverage, and will be a fixed term 6 month contract.  

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Initiate the creation of PlutoTV owned and operated channels to curate channels based on genre or theme
  • Schedule PlutoTV channels, including owned and operated and single-series, collaboratively with third-party channels
  • Create pop-up channels strategically based on cultural, seasonal or promotional purposes
  • Monitor success of the content
  • Work with the Rights and Inventory teams to influence decisions on acquisitions and renewals
  • Produce analysis, insights and recommendations around content performance of the channels and make edits to the content flow to improve success
  • Review content for potential partnerships for PlutoTV

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of working experience in media, either linear or streaming with a focus on scheduling content

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Interest and deep knowledge of current and throwback content, popular culture and media trends
  • Ability to generate and communicate creative programming ideas
  • Demonstrate experience in making scheduling decisions based on content data and insights
  • Proficient in G Suite (Docs, Sheets, Forms, Slides, etc.) and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint) software
  • Highly organized with keen attention to detail and can prioritize competing deadlines in a dynamic environment
  • Know the competitive landscape well and can provide insight
  • Familiarity with at least one content management system
  • Exemplary communication skills and highly meticulous with a positive and hardworking mentality

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in? We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of motivated people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Collaboratively, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Job Summnary

 

Role and Responsibilities

 

  • Paramount’s Platforms & Intelligent Automation team (Enterprise Solutions & Technology) is creating a knowledge layer for the company. This layer helps AI agents and decisionmakers understand important information. It includes titles and content, rights and contracts, talent and participants, as well as other business data that connects them. As a Data Engineer on Paramount’s Enterprise Data Engineering team, you will build cloud data pipelines, APIs, and MCPs. These tools will change our real-time and relational data into trusted, AI-ready data. This will help our businesses gain insights. With these insights, they can make better and faster decisions. You will work as an individual contributor under general supervision, exercising self-directed judgment on how solutions are built while aligning with management on priorities and direction; this role does not supervise others.
  • This is an in-office position based in Los Angeles.
  • You will design, build, and maintain data integrations. These integrations will enhance the flow of real-time and relational data between enterprise systems. You will make implementation decisions on your own. 25%).
  • Design and build scalable cloud data pipelines. Operate workflows that integrate applications, databases, and documents. These workflows use ETL/ELT methods. This will create trusted data for automation, analytics, and AI. 25%). Deliver reusable data models and knowledge stores that are ready for AI.
  • Ensure data quality, traceability, access controls, and freshness. These factors are important for supporting enterprise search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). 15%). Apply enterprise integration and automation patterns. Use methods such as ESB, API broker, and ETL/ELT. The goal is to consolidate and simplify microservices. This will help to reduce duplicated integrations.
  • Work with the team to identify the architectural direction. 10%). Work with engineers, business users, and other stakeholders.
  • Attend meetings and working sessions to understand their needs. Turn these needs into technical solutions.
  • Clearly communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences. 10%).
  • Manage competing priorities in a dynamic project environment. Make your own day-to-day technical decisions. If there are changes in scope, timeline, or priorities, inform the manager or project team. 10%).
  • Monitor pipelines and address data and integration issues and perform various ad hoc projects as needed (approx. 5%).

 

 

Basic Qualifications

 

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience as a data engineer.
  • Strong ability to develop solutions with Python and SQL, including building APIs and data integrations.
  • In-depth knowledge of enterprise integration and automation patterns (ESB, ETL, ELT, API broker, consolidating and rationalizing microservices).
  • Experience building and operating cloud data pipelines with a focus on data quality, traceability, access controls, and data freshness.
  • Ability to work proficiently in a time-sensitive project environment and manage competing priorities.
  • Ability to function collaboratively as part of a dynamic, customer-oriented team and to perform proficiently as a self-directed producer under general management direction, with a demonstrated willingness to support the team on all levels to get the job done. Superior communication skills in working with technical and non-technical users, with the ability to cultivate and maintain collaborative relationships among all levels of an organization. Ability to travel occasionally.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, or Statistics preferred.
  • Experience with cloud data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, or Big Query.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or Oracle Cloud.
  • AI-ready data skills: experience preparing and serving data for AI use cases, such as knowledge stores, vector stores, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or using AI coding assistants and LLM APIs in data pipelines.
  • AI/ML and knowledge graph skills: exposure to ontologies and knowledge graphs, entity resolution, graph-based learning, or predictive modeling to power knowledge-grounded AI agents.

job.title: Digital Producer, WJZ
job.description:
CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Organizations that wish to receive job vacancy notices from this posting’s television station should contact sf_recruitingsupport@paramount.com.

 

CBS Stations is hiring a part-time digital producer to create compelling, relevant content for CBS Baltimore’s digital platforms. This role is responsible for overseeing local digital breaking news coverage, writing and editing stories across a wide range of topics, clipping and optimizing video on CBSNews.com and on YouTube, and executing on growth initiatives across platforms.

We are looking for someone with strong news judgment who can write and edit clear, accurate, fact-driven copy and craft compelling headlines on deadline in a fast-paced environment. Scrupulous attention to detail, a cool head under pressure, and excellent communication skills are essential.

 

Your day-to-day:

  • Coordinate, produce and update web coverage of news stories, gathering the latest information from a variety of sources, always being mindful of WJZ and CBS News standards
  • React quickly to breaking news, writing and publishing articles and running live blogs as appropriate
  • Execute content and headlines with SEO strategies in mind
  • Clip and optimize videos for CBSNews.com, YouTube and other platforms, writing compelling, SEO-friendly headlines and descriptions
  • Manage the WJZ homepage to present the best of the journalism we produce
  • Work with reporters and producers to publish the best of WJZ to our website
  • Proactively plan content around key news events and tentpoles
  • Track content performance and share content insights across WJZ to help inform story selection across platforms
  • Send push alerts on breaking news, weather and other high-interest stories

 

What you bring to the team:

  • You have 1+ years of experience in a digital breaking news environment and a proven ability to react quickly as news develops
  • You are a skilled writer who can produce quality copy on deadline
  • You have a deep understanding of SEO strategies 
  • You have a knack for framing content in an engaging way for a digital audience
  • You're familiar with analytics platforms like Google Analytics, Omniture, Chartbeat
  • You thrive in a collaborative team environment

 

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $35 - 35.

job.title: Director, Content Operations
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:


The Pluto TV Content Operations team intakes, prepares, and publishes every title on our streaming service. We are a global team, based in the US, South America, and Europe. Each year we support twelve regional instances and tens of thousands of assets for hundreds of partners!

 

We are seeking a Director, Content Operations to guide our US content workflows and team. This role is a true team leader! You will be based in the United States. You will build a skilled, accountable team that keeps growing. You will also be our main voice with partners and teams.

 

You will own the US content pipeline: partner onboarding, ingestion, QC, metadata, packaging, and publishing. Every title ships on schedule, to spec, and at the highest quality! You will also scale the team wisely: developing talent, refining processes, and managing capacity. That way we handle more volume at the same quality and speed.

 

Operational excellence is the standard you set and keep. That means a pipeline that runs smoothly at scale, partners who get clear guidance, and a team energized by finding better ways to work. The ideal candidate pairs a talent for growing people with deep technical skill. You love to invent and automate, using cloud tools and data to build operations that scale.

 

You will work closely with Content Partnerships, Programming, Product, Marketing, and Pluto TV Streaming Operations. You will keep improving the Pluto TV viewer experience. You will also align with our International Content Operations leads in Europe and South America. That keeps global standards, best practices, and one way of working.

 

Responsibilities:

 

Content Delivery & Operational Workflow Leadership

 

  • Oversee the U.S. content operations production workflow, including onboarding, asset delivery, QC, metadata, artwork, closed captions, audio, ad-break structure, and final publishing. 
  • Partner with Programming and Content Partnerships to ensure content scheduling, delivery forecasts, and launch timelines are aligned with platform and partner expectations. 
  • Maintain deep expertise in Pluto TV’s evolving deliverable specifications (video, audio, captions, artwork, metadata, UUID’s, ad markers, localization assets etc.). 
  • Support localization pipelines and delivery of multi-language assets across global markets. 
  • Document, maintain, and continuously refine operational workflows, SLAs, SOPs, and cross-functional 
    communication processes. 

 

Team Leadership & Performance Management 

 

  • Coach and grow a skilled team with clear goals.
  • Plan capacity, coverage, and top tasks.
  • Build a good culture that adapts fast.

 

Partner & Vendor Management 

 

  • Manage daily communication with content partners, labs and preferred vendors. 
  • Oversee vendor bidding, cost analysis, rate negotiations, and operational performance reviews. 
  • Ensure partner expectations are met regarding deadlines, technical requirements, and quality standards. 

 

Cross-Regional Collaboration

 

  • Align U.S. Operations with LatAm/Brazil/Canada and European Content Operations leads on standards, tooling, vendor usage, quality baselines, and global workflows. 
  • Drive consistency across regions while supporting local market nuances (content regulations, ratings practices, localization requirements, etc.). 
  • Participate in global operations meetings and task forces supporting Paramount’s shared streaming infrastructure. 

 

Operational Analytics & KPI’s 

 

  • Track KPIs for output, quality, pace, and partner trust.
  • Build forecasts, budget plans, and staffing plans, and help fix supply chain gaps.

Technology, Tooling & Systems Expertise 

 

  • Maintain proficiency with MAM/CMS tools, cloud-based infrastructures and delivery systems, and automated ingestion workflows (S3, FTP, API, JSON/XML/MRSS feed ingestion). 
  • Partner with Content Systems Product and Engineering to define features that enhance Pluto TV’s content supply chain, automation capabilities, and operational observability. 
  • Ensure operational requirements are represented in tooling roadmaps and platform updates.

Compliance & Standards 

 

  • Follow FCC and platform rules for captions, access, and children's content.
  • Keep up with U.S. and global content rules, ad limits, and ratings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 7+ years in streaming operations, or content supply-chain management. 
  • Leadership experience managing a team of 10+ members.
  • Strong understanding of digital video encoding, UHD, HDR Dolby Vision and acceptance workflows.
  • Experience in defining content systems requirements and working within MAM and CMS’s and scheduling systems. 
  • Experience in managing content compliance elements (Closed Captions & Audio Description) and regional regulatory 
    requirements. 
  • Experience with JSON schema’s, XML and Content Metadata formats. 
  • Expertise in operational documentation, workflow design, and project management. 
  • Experience managing vendors, negotiating rates, and evaluating performance. 
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and industry-standard media operations tools. 
  • Exceptional communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in TV/Film, Media Operations, Digital Production, or related field. 
  • Experience in FAST, AVOD, SVOD, or other streaming environments. 
  • Familiarity with global content operations and regional compliance considerations. 
  • Experience in highly matrixed organizations supporting multiple brands or geographies.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

The Director of Creative Music, Paramount Pictures serves as a key creative partner across Paramount Pictures’ theatrical slate, supporting filmmakers and creative leadership in the development and execution of music for feature films. Operating as an in-house music supervisor, this role oversees all creative music elements from early development through final delivery, ensuring that each film’s musical vision enhances storytelling and supports the filmmaker’s intent.   This position works closely with directors, producers, composers, artists, and internal studio partners to deliver high-quality, filmmaker-driven music for Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases. This position is based at the historic Paramount Lot in Los Angeles.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Partner with directors, producers, and Paramount Pictures creative executives to shape and execute the musical vision for assigned theatrical films.
  • Engage in projects early in development to provide creative guidance on score, source music, and overall music strategy.
  • Serve as a trusted creative collaborator to filmmakers and talent throughout pre-production, production, and post-production.
  • Advocate for the filmmaker’s creative vision while ensuring alignment with Paramount Pictures’ production goals and creative standards.
  • Act as the in-house music supervisor for assigned Paramount Pictures theatrical films.
  • Oversee all creative music elements including score, source music, needle drops, themes, and temp music.
  • Supervise spotting sessions, music reviews, and creative discussions with filmmakers and post-production teams.
  • Ensure music choices support narrative, tone, and emotional impact.
  • Identify, recommend, and help secure composers and music collaborators in partnership with filmmakers.
  • Guide composers creatively throughout the scoring process, maintaining clear communication between creative and post-production teams.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with composers, artists, music editors, and scoring partners.
  • Oversee music workflows through production and post-production, including scoring schedules, recording sessions, and final mixes.
  • Attend scoring sessions, dubbing sessions, and final mixes as appropriate.
  • Ensure all music is creatively approved, delivered on time, and ready for theatrical release.
  • Collaborate with internal Paramount Pictures teams including Production, Post-Production, Creative Affairs, Legal, Business Affairs, Finance, and Marketing.
  • Partner with music clearance and licensing teams to balance creative ambition with budgetary and legal requirements.
  • Support soundtrack, marketing, publicity, and awards initiatives tied to Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in music supervision, film or series music, or creative music roles within theatrical film or television in a studio/network environment.
  • Proven experience supervising music for feature films or series from development through post-production.
  • Prior in-house experience at a major theatrical/TV studio or network
  • Experience working directly with high-profile filmmakers, creative executives and talent.
  • Established relationships with composers, filmmakers, artists, and music industry partners.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong creative instincts with deep knowledge of film scoring and source music.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple films simultaneously across a theatrical slate.
  • Working knowledge of music licensing, clearance, and music budgeting.
  • Filmmaker-first mindset
  • Collaborative and solution-oriented
  • Strong creative judgment and taste
  • Passion for theatrical storytelling and music

job.title: Director, Product Management
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

 

Director, Product Management (CBS Sports Web)
Location: Nashville, TN / New York, NY / Los Angeles, CA Type: Full-Time, On-Site Org: CBS Sports Digital, Product, Design & Engineering


#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We've got the brands, we've got the stars, we've got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet. Now all we're missing is
YOU. Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also
enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together we co-create moments that matter, both for our audiences and our employees, and aim to
leave a positive mark on culture.


Overview
Own the product direction for one of the largest sports sites on the internet. CBSSports.com is the front door to CBS Sports for tens of millions of fans. It is where scores, live gametrackers, news, fantasy, and betting come together during the biggest moments in sports: the NFL, March Madness, The Masters, college football, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full web experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you're in the details.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for CBSSports.com and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on. Own the web plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to
    continue, change, or stop.
  • Treat web as the reach and discovery engine for CBS Sports. Grow organic and direct traffic, sharpen high-intent surfaces like
    gametrackers and scores, and turn anonymous visitors into registered users.
  • Own the role web plays in the broader portfolio: growing registered users at scale and converting web audiences into sticky products
    like the CBS Sports App.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use
    tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held
    the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1 to 2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Partner with editorial to make web the place where great storytelling and great product meet.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.

 

How We Build (The Builder Culture)
We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put
it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions. AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make
ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll
model it and push what's possible further. The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission. 

 

What success looks like:

  • The web product strategy is coherent.
  • People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not
    to do. 
  • Web reliably grows reach, grows registered users, and feeds the rest of the portfolio.
  • The funnel from anonymous visitor to registered user to sticky-product user gets measurably stronger.
  • High-intent surfaces like gametrackers and scores get sharper and convert better, especially during tentpole events when traffic peaks. Ideas are tested before they're committed.
  • Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity.
  • Fewer false starts, less rework.
    PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.


Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer web at scale, ideally high-traffic and real-time. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.


Additional Qualifications

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold site-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Fluency with the levers that move large-scale web: discovery and SEO, performance, identity and authentication, and conversion.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view
    on how AI changes what a product team can do.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

Overview:

If you're excited by the idea of influencing how some of the world's biggest movies are created and launched, then look no further. We're hiring a Director of Strategy and Insights to join us at Paramount Pictures!

 

At Paramount, our Strategy and Insights team sits at the intersection of consumer insights and creative strategy, shaping how upcoming releases are made, marketed, and distributed. This role offers rare exposure to the entire film slate, from original titles to iconic franchises like Mission: Impossible, Transformers, Sonic the Hedgehog, and A Quiet Place.

 

Within the studio, this team serves as the voice of the audience, understanding how moviegoers feel about our films and brands and translating those perspectives into strategies that help us tell stories that connect authentically.   • Present research insights regularly at marketing strategy and management meetings, acting as a trusted, consultative partner to creative and marketing leadership
  • Actively supply ideas and feedback in meetings, presentations, and brainstorming sessions
  • Assess each motion picture’s target audience, opportunities, and challenges
  • Monitor research trends and guidelines to implement innovative approaches across the studio, including evaluating competitive campaigns, expanding statistical analysis, and advancing AI use in research


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field with 8+ years in marketing, content, or audience research
  • MBA or comparable advanced degree in social sciences, business, statistics, marketing, or a related field preferred, but not required where seniority and impact are clearly established
  • Entertainment or related market research experience preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex research into a clear point of view for non-research stakeholders, and to build trust and influence with senior creative and marketing leaders
  • Excellent communication, presentation, professional writing, and problem-solving skills
  • Shown project management and organizational skills


Additional Qualifications: 

  • Experience with data visualization tools and software
  • Strong knowledge of movies and a passion for entertainment

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Position Overview:

The Executive Producer of Face the Nation, America’s #1 most watched public affairs programs, provides editorial leadership and oversees the production, newsgathering, and strategic direction of the broadcast and its digital extensions. This role requires extensive Washington editorial experience, exceptional news judgment, strong leadership and management skills, and a proven track record in writing, field production, and live control room operations.  

Key Responsibilities:

  • Editorial Leadership: Lead the editorial vision and weekly execution of Face the Nation, working in close partnership with the moderator and network leadership to deliver a compelling, authoritative, and timely public affairs program.
  • Staff Leadership: Lead a team of approximately 12 producers, fostering a collaborative, high-performing newsroom and ensuring the highest standards of journalism and production.
  • Guest Booking and Editorial Research: Oversee the booking of newsmaking guests, the development of interview segments, and the editorial research necessary to produce incisive, informative, and news-driven programming.
  • Live Broadcast Production: Supervise all aspects of the live, interview-based broadcast, including editorial planning, scriptwriting, segment development, field production, and control room execution.
  • Digital and Multi-Platform Strategy: Oversee the development and production of the program’s digital extensions and associated content across online platforms, ensuring the journalism reaches audiences beyond the Sunday broadcast.
  • Weekend Newsgathering and Operations: Direct weekend newsgathering in service of the program, coordinating coverage and editorial priorities as news develops. Work closely with technical staff to ensure seamless broadcast operations and readiness for breaking news.
  • Cross-Network Collaboration: Maintain close coordination with the moderator, network executives, correspondents, technical teams, and other editorial stakeholders to ensure alignment on coverage, programming priorities, and production needs.
 

Qualifications:

  • College degree in journalism preferred
  • Extensive experience covering Washington politics, government, and national affairs, with a deep understanding of the political and policy landscape.
  • Significant experience in television news production, including live broadcast execution, writing, field production, and control room operations.
  • Demonstrated success managing producers and leading a fast-paced editorial team.
  • Exceptional editorial judgment, reporting instincts, writing skills, and the ability to identify and develop consequential newsmaking interviews.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and decision-making skills, particularly under tight deadlines and in rapidly changing news environments.
  • Experience developing content for digital platforms and extending broadcast journalism to audiences across multiple formats.
  • Willingness and ability to work weekends and maintain a flexible schedule in response to breaking news and the demands of a live Sunday program.

 

Work Schedule & Model:

This role is on-site in our Washington, DC Bureau and requires a substantial weekend commitment.

Overview:

The Free Press is looking for a Growth Marketer to help drive subscriber acquisition and retention across our fastest-growing channels. We're looking for a hands-on marketing tactician: someone who can plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across paid and owned channels, while using data to know what's working and why. You'll blend creative instinct with a rigorous, test-and-learn mindset to help scale The Free Press's subscriber base. Our ideal candidate is also passionate about using emerging AI tools to move faster, building campaigns, analyzing performance, exploring agentic tools, and automating repetitive work so the team can experiment more and ship more.

 

Please note submitting a cover letter is required.

 

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Plan, execute, and optimize paid marketing campaigns across channels, including paid social, search, video, and O&O, to drive subscriber acquisition.
  • Manage and grow email and on-platform marketing efforts in support of subscriber growth and engagement.
  • Own campaign performance: monitor results, run tests, and adjust tactics in real time to maximize ROI.
  • Build and execute a testing roadmap for offers, creative, and messaging to improve acquisition and retention.
  • Use audience segmentation and subscriber data to tailor campaigns and messaging to different reader groups.
  • Support paywall, pricing, and promotional strategy by helping design and run experiments.
  • Collaborate with editorial, audio, video, and events teams to bring cohesive, on-brand marketing campaigns to life.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate campaign builds, reporting, and workflow automation across the growth function.
  • Help set and track growth and retention goals.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in performance marketing or growth marketing for a consumer subscription product. In media or at a startup is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience running paid social, search, and video campaigns.
  • Comfortable working in email marketing platforms and CRM/subscription management tools.
  • Strong understanding of the subscriber funnel, from anonymous visitor to registered user to paid subscriber, and what moves people through it.
  • Deep comfort and fluency using AI tools for campaign execution, analysis, and workflow automation, with a proactive mindset toward finding new ways AI can drive growth.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Data-savvy: comfortable using analytics tools to evaluate campaign performance and translate results into next steps. SQL or Excel fluency is a plus.
  • Creative thinker with a strategic mindset and a results-oriented, test-and-learn approach.
  • Exemplary writing and communication skills, with the ability to adapt The Free Press's voice across channels and audiences.
  • Thorough understanding of (or strong interest in) the independent media and news landscape. Interest in and familiarity with The Free Press is a plus.
  • Highly autonomous, curious, and proactive, comfortable in a scrappy, fast-moving environment.

job.title: Lead AI Engineer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

  Overview Paramount’s Platforms & Intelligent Automation team is part of Enterprise Solutions & Technology. They create a shared AI agent infrastructure. This infrastructure supports teams in Finance, Legal & Business Affairs, Content Operations, Rights, People, and Technology. It helps these teams complete their business workflows using AI. As our Lead AI Engineer, you’ll build secure, production AI applications that orchestrate large language models, enterprise APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and Automation Anywhere bots. Your applications will execute business workflows with human approvals, audit trails and monitoring built in. In this individual contributor role, you will work directly with business stakeholders. You will use a forward deployed model and take responsibility for applications. This means you will discover problems, develop user interfaces, coordinate with multiple agents, test the applications, deploy them, and manage operations. You’ll make application architecture, agent design, tool design and model selection decisions, while collaborating with the hiring manager and architecture review process on platform standards.     Responsibilities
  • Architect and build secure, full stack AI applications using Python, TypeScript, APIs and React or similar user interface frameworks. Integrate LLMs, including Gemini, Claude, GPT and open weight models through Vertex AI and Azure OpenAI, with enterprise systems, MCP tool servers and Automation Anywhere A360 and Agentic Process Automation bots. Support workflows across ERP, HR, ITSM, finance close, electronic signatures and collaboration platforms.
  • Implement coordination across multiple agents using planner and worker, supervisor and handoff patterns with Google Agent Development Kit, Agent Engine, LangGraph or equivalent tools. Build deterministic guardrails, approval gates, role based permissions and complete audit trails so automated actions are explainable, attributable and reversible. Design state management, retries, idempotency and escalation paths for workflows that run over extended periods.
  • Apply enterprise security controls. Use OAuth2/OIDC and ensure service identities have the least privilege access. Manage secrets and implement defenses against prompt injection and data exfiltration, like Model Armor. Also, make sure to administer PII properly and maintain audit evidence that meets SOX requirements. Partner with Information Security, Internal Audit and Legal to define and maintain the security and production readiness checklist for agentic applications across the enterprise.
  • Build automated evaluation suites covering task success, groundedness, safety, latency and cost. Develop regression tests, CI/CD pipelines, OpenTelemetry tracing of agent steps, token and spend telemetry, SLOs and on call runbooks. Lead production readiness reviews and drive improvements following incidents
  • Partner with business process owners to identify valuable workflows, develop rapid prototypes, define success metrics and ROI, and turn pilots into supported production products. Translate requirements for offshore contractors and vendor engineers, and review their deliverables for quality and security.
  • Contribute reusable MCP servers, agent templates, approval interface components and evaluation harnesses to the shared platform. Create reference architectures and documentation. Mentor engineers in Enterprise Solutions & Technology. Help them understand development practices that encourage self-sufficiency.
  • Support ad hoc projects, including proofs of concept for executive stakeholders and evaluation of emerging models, protocols such as MCP and A2A, and vendor capabilities.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2 years of designing and delivering production LLM applications. The applications should be used by real users on an enterprise scale. They must have features like retrieval augmented generation, tool or function calling, and agents.
  • Expertise in Python or be proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript. Experience in full stack development is required. This means you will create backend services and APIs, like FastAPI or Node. You should also know modern frontend frameworks such as React. It is necessary to have experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores.
  • Extensive functional experience with at least one major cloud platform. Google Cloud experience, including Vertex AI, Cloud Run/GKE, Pub/Sub and IAM, is preferred; AWS or Azure experience is acceptable. Experience must include Docker/Kubernetes, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and CI/CD.
  • Proven experience building agentic systems with orchestration across multiple steps, tool integration including MCP, state management, human approval flows, and systematic evaluation of LLM outputs for correctness, safety and cost.
  • Understand enterprise integration and automation. This includes knowledge of REST and GraphQL APIs. Also, knowledge of event-driven architectures, workflow and business process management concepts, and RPA platforms. Automation Anywhere is preferred; UiPath or Power Automate experience is acceptable.
  • Solid knowledge of application security and compliance. This covers authentication, authorization, secrets management, data privacy, and audit logging. You also need a successful history of passing security and architecture reviews.
  • Great communication skills are important. You need to lead discovery sessions with business partners who might not have technical backgrounds. You should also write clear design documents. Additionally, you will present tradeoffs to senior leaders.
  • Experience coordinating with offshore or globally distributed teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent functional experience.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
  • Experience with Automation Anywhere’s agentic capabilities, including AI Agent Studio, Process Reasoning Engine and Control Room/A360 governance, or building AI agents that invoke RPA bots as tools.
  • Experience with Google’s agent stack, including Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine, Gemini Enterprise and Model Armor, or with Azure OpenAI and Anthropic Claude platforms.
  • Experience authoring MCP servers, working with the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol or contributing to open source agent frameworks.
  • Awareness with LLM evaluation tools such as Vertex AI Evaluation, Ragas, DeepEval and Promptfoo.
  • Prior experience in media and entertainment business operations is preferred. This experience can include rights and royalties, content supply chain, finance procedures, and SOX controls. It can also include legal contract workflows. Alternatively, experience in a consulting role with Fortune 500 clients is acceptable.
  • Experience with token budgeting, caching, model routing and user interface design for enterprise applications.

Job Title: Lead Data Engineer
Team: Technology - Enterprise Solutions
Location: Los Angeles (Burbank)

Overview
Paramount’s Platforms & Intelligent Automation team (Enterprise Solutions & Technology) is building a knowledge layer for the company. This layer helps AI agents and decision-makers access important information, including titles and content, rights and contracts, talent and participants, and the business data that connects them. As our Lead Data Engineer on the Enterprise Data Engineering team, you will own the architecture and technical strategy for how data moves across our business systems and powers AI. You will serve as a senior individual contributor and technical lead for distributed data engineers and analysts. This role has no direct reports. You will work autonomously, with limited supervision. Close collaboration with business users, engineers, and vendors across Enterprise Solutions & Technology and the business units will be key. This is an in-office position based in Los Angeles.

Key Responsibilities
● Architecture and technical strategy (20%). Set the technical direction for our data platforms using existing and emerging technologies. Make design decisions with significant autonomy and align with senior leadership on strategy.
● Data pipelines and integration (20%). Serve as the subject matter expert on data flows across business systems. Design, build, and operate scalable cloud pipelines that turn data from enterprise applications, databases, and documents into trusted data for automation, analytics, and AI.
● AI-ready data and knowledge stores (15%). Deliver reusable data models and knowledge stores that support enterprise search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Ensure data quality, traceability, access controls, and freshness.
● Stakeholder partnership and continuous improvement (15%). Partner with business users, engineers, and vendors to build solutions. Define project goals and deliverables in a time-sensitive environment. Drive improvement through automation, rationalization, and refactoring.
● Ontology, knowledge graphs, and ML (10%). Design and build Paramount’s enterprise ontology and knowledge graphs connecting content, rights, talent, and business data. Develop, evaluate, and deploy ML solutions (graph-based learning, entity resolution, predictive modeling) that power knowledge-grounded AI agents.
● Agentic AI applications (10%). Build secure, full-stack AI applications that orchestrate language models, enterprise APIs, MCP tools, and Automation Anywhere bots to run business workflows. Own delivery from user interface and multi-agent coordination through human approvals, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
● Mentorship and standards (10%). Mentor distributed data engineers and analysts, set standards, and review designs and code, without formal supervisory authority.
● Ad hoc. Perform various ad hoc projects as needed.

Required Qualifications
● 6+ years of hands-on experience as a data engineer.
● Strong Python skills.
● Knowledge of enterprise integration and automation patterns (e.g., ESB, ETL, ELT, API broker, microservice rationalization).
● Experience building and operating cloud data pipelines and AI-ready data models, with a focus on data quality, traceability, access controls, and freshness.
● Experience providing technical guidance to engineers and analysts, including distributed teams, and working directly with clients and business users.
● Strong project management skills: able to define goals and deliverables, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.
● Strong communication skills: able to work with technical and non-technical users at all levels and operate autonomously under general management direction.

Preferred Qualifications
● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, or Statistics.
● Experience with data lakehouse and cloud data warehouse platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery).
● Hands-on experience with a major cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Oracle Cloud).
● Experience preparing and serving data for AI use cases (e.g., knowledge stores, vector stores, embeddings, RAG), or using LLM APIs and AI coding assistants in data pipelines.
● Experience building secure, full-stack AI applications that orchestrate language models, enterprise APIs, MCP tools, and automation bots (e.g., Automation Anywhere), including multi-agent coordination and human approvals.
● Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, and entity resolution to support AI agents.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 


Job Title: Lead ML Engineer
Team: Technology - Enterprise Solutions
Location: Los Angeles (Burbank)

Overview
Paramount’s Platforms & Intelligent Automation team (Enterprise Solutions & Technology) is building a knowledge layer for the company. This layer helps AI agents and decision-makers access important information. It includes titles and content, rights and contracts, talent and participants, and other business data that connects them. As our Lead Machine Learning Engineer for Enterprise Knowledge Graph & Ontology, you will design Paramount’s enterprise ontology and knowledge graphs. You will build machine learning systems to ensure these graphs are precise. This includes tasks like entity resolution, LLM-based information extraction, and graph learning. You will also deploy models and graph services. This will help create knowledge-grounded AI agents. They will have a consistent and semantically linked view of the business. You will set the technical direction for this program. This includes data modeling, MLOps, and production operations. You will work autonomously, with minimal oversight. Close collaboration with data owners, enterprise architects, and agent developers across Enterprise Solutions & Technology and the business units will be key.

Key Responsibilities
● Enterprise ontology and semantic modeling (25%). Design and manage Paramount’s enterprise ontology and domain models. This includes content and title hierarchies. It also covers rights and obligations, talent and participants, organizations, deals, and financial and operational entities. Ensure that all of these align with industry standards. You make the modeling decisions; enterprise-wide changes are ratified with data owners and architecture review.
● Knowledge graph construction and entity resolution (25%). Build scalable pipelines that control both structured and unstructured systems. This includes structured data from rights management, ERP, contract and talent systems, and metadata catalogs. It also includes unstructured sources like contracts, scripts, and documents. The goal is to create knowledge graphs using platforms like Spanner Graph, Neo4j, or Amazon Neptune. Use machine learning for entity resolution and record linkage, along with LLM-based information extraction and data quality scoring. Manage the master-identity process to align entities across these systems.
● Advanced machine learning on graphs (20%). Develop, evaluate, and deploy graph-based learning techniques. These techniques include node and link prediction, graph neural networks, and graph embeddings. Work on predictive and semantic search as well. This includes GraphRAG retrieval, which supports knowledge-grounded agents. Additionally, set the evaluation methodology. Establish the quality standards for the program.
● MLOps and production knowledge services (15%). Use Vertex AI Pipelines and MLflow to productionize models and graph services. Implement versioning and use feature stores. Set up automated evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection. Share knowledge through well-governed APIs and MCP tools. Make sure agent applications can use these tools while meeting security, privacy, and audit requirements.
● Stakeholder partnership and program management (10%). Partner with Rights, Finance, Content Operations, and Talent business leads. Work with engineers in enterprise data governance and AI platforms. Define key questions and service levels. Create a plan. Translate requirements for offshore and vendor data engineers, and review their work.
● Standards, reuse and mentorship (5%). Establish modeling standards, reusable graph and ML components and documentation; mentor engineers and data scientists in knowledge engineering and graph machine learning.
● Ad hoc. Perform various ad hoc projects as needed, including executive proofs-of-concept and evaluation of emerging graph, retrieval and model capabilities.

Required Qualifications
● 8+ years of experience in machine learning, data, or software engineering, including 3+ years building knowledge graphs, semantic data models, or entity-resolution systems in production.
● Expertise in Python and SQL, and proficiency with ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow, plus scikit-learn).
● Hands-on experience with at least one graph database (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph) and one graph query language (Cypher/GQL, SPARQL, or Gremlin).
● Robust knowledge of ontology and semantic-web standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, SKOS) and/or property-graph modeling, with experience turning business concepts into governed, versioned models.
● Proven experience with entity resolution at scale (e.g., probabilistic or embedding-based matching, Splink, Zingg, Senzing) and LLM-based information extraction from documents.
● Hands-on experience with graph machine learning is required. This includes working on graph embeddings and link prediction using PyTorch Geometric or DGL. Experience with classical predictive modeling is also needed. Involving thorough offline and online evaluation.
● Experience deploying ML on a major cloud (Google Cloud preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable) with MLOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, model registry, and monitoring.
● Proficient communication skills: able to gather requirements from business experts, document models clearly, and present trade-offs to senior stakeholders. Experience working with distributed or offshore teams is a plus.
● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science or a related field, or equivalent applicable experience.

Preferred Qualifications
● Media and entertainment experience (e.g., rights and royalties, content metadata, distribution and avails) or experience with rights-management platforms.
● Experience with GraphRAG, including hybrid retrieval (vector search plus graph traversal) and connecting knowledge to agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangGraph) via MCP.  
● Experience with master data management and data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, Google Dataplex), and with data-product or data-mesh delivery.
● Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or Information Science; publications, patents or open-source contributions in knowledge graphs, NLP or graph ML.
● Experience with Wikidata / Wikibase, Palantir Foundry Ontology as  enterprise context layers for AI agents.

 

#LI-JC1

Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

job.description:
