job.title: Sr Accountant
job.description:
Are you a meticulous accounting professional who loves digging into the details and making sense of complex financial data? The E.W. Scripps Company is looking for a Sr Accountant to join our Finance & Accounting team in Cincinnati, Ohio. Under general supervision, you'll perform both routine and complex accounting reviews, processes, and reporting — playing a critical role in keeping Scripps' financial operations accurate, compliant, and running smoothly. From driving the monthly close process to mentoring staff accountants and collaborating across departments, you'll bring structure, insight, and leadership to everything you do. If you're ready to make a meaningful impact at one of the country's leading media companies, we want to hear from you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Prepare journal entries as needed, specifically monthly, quarterly and annual accounting close periods
  • Record and review revenue against forecast
  • Build review and distribute internal financial information
  • Accrual analysis monthly
  • Prepare and analyze balance sheet reconciliations monthly
  • Review expense accounts throughout month and during close
  • Balance sheet review monthly
  • Invoice review during monthly close (search for any liabilities that should have been submitted or might have been accrued and expensed)
  • Review financial structure multiple times throughout close
  • Work closely with other departments to gather accounting support for journal entries, specifically purchasing, accounts payable and human resources
  • Evaluate standing prepaid and standing liabilities quarterly
  • Evaluation of more complex information to determine compliance with standards
  • Quarterly expense analysis
  • Preparation and review of quarterly financial reporting schedules for external reporting
  • Assist in preparation of procedural documentation as appropriate
  • Act as coach to staff accountant(s) by training, answering questions, etc.
  • Serve as a backup to the Manager, GL/Reporting for month end reporting
  • This list is not all inclusive and the staff accountants may performs other reviews or analysis as deemed necessary

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelors of Science Accountancy or related field
  • Minimum 5 years' relevant work experience; public accounting experience preferred
  • CPA preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to effectively leverage technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness of accounting processes and analysis
  • Ability to understand the overall goal and the best way to achieve the goal
  • Ability to evaluate more complex information to determine compliance with standards
  • Ability to identify issues and recommend process improvements
  • Organization and time management skills; Ability to multi-task
  • Personal computing skills including skills with Microsoft Excel and accounting software (e.g., Workday)
  • Sedentary work

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Cincinnati is a vibrant, welcoming city on the banks of the Ohio River with a rich history, a thriving arts scene, and an unmistakable civic pride. The iconic Over-the-Rhine neighborhood — one of the largest intact urban historic districts in the country — is packed with award-winning restaurants, craft breweries, boutique shops, and live music venues. Art lovers will find world-class institutions like the Cincinnati Art Museum and the Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra, while outdoor enthusiasts can explore miles of trails along the Little Miami Scenic Trail or take in sweeping river views from Eden Park.

Cincinnati is a passionate sports town, home to the NFL's Cincinnati Bengals and MLB's Cincinnati Reds, whose games at Paycor Stadium and Great American Ball Park draw enthusiastic crowds throughout the seasons. Families flock to the world-renowned Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden and the thrill rides at Kings Island. The city's diverse neighborhoods — from Hyde Park and Mount Adams to Covington just across the river in Kentucky — offer a wide range of housing options and lifestyles to suit every taste.

With a cost of living well below the national average, a strong job market, and easy access to both big-city amenities and peaceful suburban surroundings, Cincinnati consistently earns praise as one of the Midwest's most livable cities. Whether you're cheering on the home team, sampling the legendary Cincinnati-style chili, or catching a show at Music Hall, there's always something to love about life in the Queen City.

job.title: Sr Reporter, KTVH
job.description:
KTVH is looking for an experienced Senior Reporter who believes local journalism should make a difference. You’ll take on investigations, long-form reporting and major breaking news while building strong connections across the Helena community.


This role is for a journalist who can dig deeper, develop trusted sources and turn complex stories into meaningful, compelling coverage across platforms. You’ll also serve as a newsroom leader, modeling strong journalistic standards and helping elevate storytelling across the team.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop a strong network of sources and local experts throughout the community.
  • Research and investigate stories using public records, personal sources and other contacts.
  • Take the lead on in-depth reporting, long-form journalism and major breaking news.
  • Report live from the field and cover news as it develops.
  • Shoot still photography and video and incorporate strong visuals, graphics and digital elements into your storytelling.
  • Create distinctive content for broadcast, digital and social platforms.
  • Find stories and perspectives that reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.
  • Maintain high standards for accuracy, fairness, objectivity and journalistic ethics.
  • Collaborate with newsroom teams on editorial planning, content strategy, workflows and best practices.
  • Participate in community events and build authentic connections with viewers and community members.
  • Provide backup editorial coverage as needed.
  • Drive a personal or company vehicle to cover assignments throughout the market.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Generally, 5+ years of news reporting experience, including in-depth or long-form reporting.
  • Experience in community, digital and solutions-based journalism preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license and good driving record.
  • Ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company-required insurance limits.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong expertise in investigative, in-depth and long-form journalism.
  • Compelling storytelling skills and a distinct, engaging on-air presence.
  • A strong understanding of what audiences need and expect from local news.
  • Experience with multimedia journalism, including reporting, writing, web publishing, photography, video, infographics, databases and social media.
  • Knowledge of journalism fundamentals, including privacy, ethics, access to information, open meetings and public records laws.
  • High standards for accuracy and fairness.
  • Strong writing and editing skills.
  • Working knowledge of Associated Press style.
  • Ability to use digital tools, video, mapping, social media and other technology to strengthen reporting.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and web publishing tools.
  • Adaptability, sound judgment and strong emotional intelligence.

OUR TEAM:

At KTVH, you’ll be part of a local newsroom focused on journalism that matters to the people we serve. We’re looking for someone who can bring experience and leadership to the newsroom while still being excited to get out into the community, chase stories and report from the field.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Helena gives you something pretty unique: the opportunity to live and report in Montana’s capital city while having the outdoors practically in your backyard. The city manages more than 1,950 acres of open lands, including Mount Helena City Park, and the greater Helena area offers more than 100 miles of trails for hiking, mountain biking and exploring.


When the workday ends, you can head straight for Mount Helena, Mount Ascension or the South Hills trail system, where more than 80 miles of singletrack connect the community to the surrounding landscape.


For a journalist, Helena offers an especially interesting combination: a connected local community, the stories that come with covering a state capital, and easy access to the kind of outdoor lifestyle people move to Montana to find. If you want meaningful reporting without giving up hiking, biking and weekends outside, Helena is a pretty great place to call home.

job.title: Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response
job.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at the intersection of media innovation and client success? Scripps is seeking a strategic Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response to join our dynamic team in New York City. In this role, you'll be the driving force behind strengthening advertiser and agency relationships while delivering integrated media solutions that span linear television, digital, and streaming/CTV platforms. If you're passionate about maximizing campaign performance and building strategic partnerships that drive real business results, this is your opportunity to shine.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage the day-to-day execution, delivery, and performance of assigned accounts and campaigns to meet client objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and performance KPIs.
  • Serve as a contact for advertisers and agencies, developing a strong understanding of their business objectives, target audiences, marketing strategies, and performance goals while providing responsive, solutions-oriented support as well as upselling opportunities.
  • Partner with account executives and sales leadership on media plans, proposals, presentations, pipeline management, account growth, retention, and opportunities to increase advertiser investment.
  • Proactively monitor campaign pacing, delivery, and performance; analyze KPIs including CPA, CPL, ROAS, response, conversion, reach, and frequency; and implement optimization strategies to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  • Analyze campaign and account performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement, and develop client-facing reports, campaign recaps, recommendations, and strategic insights.
  • Coordinate the campaign lifecycle from proposal through order entry, trafficking, scheduling, optimization, reporting, makegoods, and reconciliation while maintaining accurate account, campaign, and revenue information in applicable systems.
  • Partner with Sales, Ad Operations, Traffic, Inventory, Research, Marketing, Content, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure effective planning, execution, issue resolution, and delivery of client commitments.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Demonstrated understanding of national advertising landscapes, agency structures, and enterprise-level client requirements preferred
  • Strong and comprehensive understanding of linear TV, digital, and streaming/CTV media planning, buying, and optimization across integrated platforms
  • Knowledge of Direct Response advertising, performance metrics (CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates), and campaign management processes
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret campaign data, identify optimization opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations
  • Exceptional client-service and communication skills
  • Ability to effectively present strategic recommendations to advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders
  • Demonstrated capability in end-to-end campaign oversight with focus on revenue optimization and strategic partnership alignment
  • Proficiency in CRM, analytics platforms, and Microsoft Office with strong organizational skills to prioritize competing demands in fast-paced environments

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY


New York City is the epicenter of media, advertising, and innovation—and there's no better place to advance your career in strategic account management. As the nation's largest media market, NYC offers unparalleled access to leading agencies, brands, and industry events. Beyond work, the city pulses with world-class dining, arts, culture, and entertainment. From Broadway shows to rooftop bars, Central Park to Brooklyn's vibrant neighborhoods, you'll find endless ways to explore and be inspired. With excellent public transportation and a hybrid work model, you'll enjoy the perfect balance of professional growth and urban living at its finest.

#LI-Hybrid

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits

  • Retirement savings plan with company match

  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. job.title: Sr. Analyst, Strategic Partner Development
job.description:
Are you ready to drive revenue growth and operational excellence in the fast-paced world of digital media? We're looking for a strategic, results-driven Senior Analyst, Strategic Partner Development to lead the optimization of our digital monetization platforms and partner-managed revenue channels. In this role, you'll be at the intersection of technology, revenue strategy, and cross-functional collaboration—maximizing performance, solving complex challenges, and ensuring our digital operations align with business priorities and brand safety standards.


If you thrive on turning data into action, building strong partnerships, and leading initiatives that directly impact the bottom line, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact at Scripps.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external platform partners or clients serving as key operational contact.
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key platform and technology partners, including YouTube/Google, serving as a primary liaison to drive revenue growth, platform optimization, content monetization, and partner success.
  • Lead day-to-day platform performance, revenue activity, and compliance requirements for assigned digital monetization platforms, accounts, or partner channels.
  • Support the development, implementation, and refinement of monetization strategies to improve revenue yield, operational efficiency, content monetization, rights management, brand safety, and policy compliance.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex platform, policy, delivery, reporting, or monetization issues; assess root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Provide timely reporting and analysis to cross-functional teams that connects platform performance, revenue trends, audience behavior, inventory performance, and partner updates to identify risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Content, Product, Sales, Ad Operations, and other stakeholders to identify and execute new monetization opportunities, evaluate emerging platform capabilities, and support business development initiatives that advance Scripps' digital revenue strategy.
  • Maintain a consistent operating rhythm with external platform or technology partners by coordinating updates, tracking follow-through, and communicating changes that may affect revenue, workflows, or compliance.
  • Support cross-functional projects related to platform launches, monetization tools, workflow improvements, reporting enhancements, or partner initiatives.
  • Develop documentation, training materials, and best-practice guidance to support consistency, accountability, and scalability across accounts or platforms.
  • Act as a resource for less experienced team members by providing guidance on complex issues, reviewing work for accuracy, and sharing platform knowledge.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Experience building strategic partnerships with digital platforms, including YouTube/Google, to drive revenue growth and content monetization, is strongly preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Advanced skill with digital ad operations, platform monetization, video operations, or a related digital media role with a track record of increasing responsibility
  • Strong understanding of platform policies, partner requirements, brand safety, rights management, and compliance impacts
  • Ability to analyze complex performance data and translate insights into revenue-focused recommendations
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex, ambiguous, or non-routine issues independently
  • Project leadership skills, including cross-functional coordination, stakeholder influence, and initiative execution
  • Clear communication skills for technical, operational, business, and leadership audiences
  • Strong relationship-building skills with internal teams and external platform or technology partners
  • Ability to mentor others and promote consistent practices across teams or accounts

job.title: Sr. Manager, Sales Assistant
job.description:
Are you a strategic, people-first leader who thrives in the middle of change? Scripps is looking for an experienced manager to lead a virtual Sales Assistant team that powers the engine of our linear and digital sales operation. In this role, you'll set the standard for excellence — building scalable processes, growing talent, and partnering with Sales Leadership to elevate seller productivity and customer experience. If you're energized by transformation, motivated by results, and committed to developing high-performing teams in a fast-moving media environment, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Establish clear performance expectations, accountability measures, and service standards to ensure consistent execution.
  • Oversee staffing, workload balancing, and resource allocation to maximize team efficiency and seller support.
  • Create and lead training, onboarding, and professional development programs that build media sales and systems expertise.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, customer service, and ongoing learning.
  • Serve as a change leader by guiding teams through evolving business priorities, technologies, and transformation initiatives.
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to improve seller productivity, customer experience, and revenue-generating effectiveness.
  • Use KPIs, productivity metrics, and data insights to monitor performance, identify risks, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to influence decisions, support enterprise initiatives, and enhance processes, systems, and organizational effectiveness.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Prior managerial experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Track record of building scalable processes, developing talent, and driving operational excellence
  • Deep understanding of linear and digital media sales operations, advertising workflows, and customer support processes
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities
  • Expertise in change management and organizational effectiveness
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to influence across functions and levels of the organization
  • Experience working within complex, fast-paced, and evolving business environments

job.title: SVP, Marketing
job.description:
Are you a visionary marketing leader ready to shape the future of one of America's most storied media companies? The E.W. Scripps Company is looking for a Senior Vice President of Marketing to define and lead the overall marketing strategy for the organization — with a bold emphasis on creativity, brand excellence, performance, and engagement across multiple platforms. In this high-impact executive role, you will set the vision for Scripps' brands and marketing strategies, ensuring alignment with business objectives to drive audience and ratings growth, strengthen Scripps-owned brands, and support ad sales and distribution value. If you thrive at the intersection of storytelling, data, and innovation, this is your opportunity to leave a lasting mark on a company that has been illuminating communities for generations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Collaborate with leaders across Programming, Ad Sales, Sports, Distribution, News, and Research to develop and execute comprehensive marketing and brand strategies for the enterprise, including news, sports, and entertainment.
  • Lead a team across Brand, Audience growth (performance marketing) and Creative production.

Brand and Creative

  • Define and strengthen brand positioning, architecture and messaging across Scripps' portfolio.
  • Lead creative strategy, development and production to build distinctive brands, drive audience engagement and ensure consistent, compelling storytelling across channels and touchpoints.

Audience Growth / Performance Marketing and Measurement

  • Drive incremental audience growth through audience insights, segmentation and integrated marketing across paid, owned, earned and social channels.
  • Own media strategy, investment allocation, campaign execution and performance measurement.
  • Partner with Market Research to translate consumer insights, viewing behaviors and audience preferences into more effective targeting, media planning and campaign strategies.
  • Continuously optimize marketing effectiveness, efficiency and ROI.

Strategic Partnerships & Commercial Enablement

  • Develop and activate strategic partnerships with leagues, talent, creators, platforms and other ecosystem players to expand audience reach, engagement and brand visibility.
  • Collaborate with Programming, Ad Sales and Distribution to unlock growth opportunities, strengthen advertiser propositions and drive measurable audience and commercial impact.
  • Identify and activate high-impact events, industry forums and external platforms to amplify Scripps' brands and content, extend reach beyond owned properties and build strategic relationships.

Marketing Capabilities, Organization & AI-Enabled Marketing

  • Build a high-performing, future-ready marketing organization by developing talent, capabilities and processes.
  • Establish effective cross-functional ways of working to strengthen collaboration, streamline decision-making and improve execution.
  • Lead the transformation toward an AI-enabled marketing operating model, leveraging data, analytics, automation and technology to accelerate execution, increase efficiency and scale marketing impact.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related field.
  • 15+ years of relevant experience in product/brand marketing, preferably with at least 10 years in media organizations.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Proven experience as a Vice President of Marketing or similar role with a strong track record of success.
  • Demonstrated capability in developing effective strategies and business plans across all marketing aspects, including branding and product promotion.
  • Previous experience in sports marketing preferred.
  • Strong understanding of linear TV and digital measurement; experience using testing and analytics to drive decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of presenting ideas effectively to large groups and senior management.
  • Strong analytical skills with a solid understanding of market research and data analysis methods.
  • Ability to lead and foster collaboration among diverse teams; committed to creating an inclusive work atmosphere.
  • Knowledgeable in contemporary marketing tools and digital marketing strategies, with the ability to apply effective techniques across multiple channels.
  • Familiarity with different business disciplines (e.g., IT, finance) and experience managing marketing operations within a matrix organizational structure.

Priority consideration will be given to all applications submitted by Friday, December 4, 2026.

job.title: Temporary Senior Multimarket Digital Content Producer
job.description:
Scripps is seeking a Sr Multimarket Digital Content Producer who will independently execute, optimize, and improve digital content across an assigned group of local station markets. Apply advanced digital storytelling, social media, video, platform, and analytics knowledge to develop market-specific content approaches, troubleshoot complex content and platform performance challenges, and contribute to measurable audience growth across social media, owned-and-operated (O&O) web platforms, mobile apps, and connected TV (CTV) applications. The Regional Digital Content Producer partners with station teams, Multi-Media Journalists (MMJs), and regional digital leadership to translate Content Strategy 3.0 into actionable digital plans, coordinate priority digital initiatives, and share best-practice recommendations that improve reach, engagement, and platform performance.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Partner with station teams, Multi-Media Journalists (MMJs), and regional digital leadership to translate Content Strategy 3.0 into actionable digital plans, coordinate priority digital initiatives, and share best-practice recommendations that improve reach, engagement, and platform performance.
  • Optimize digital content and web content management for multiple station markets, determining the best approach to meet audience, brand, and platform performance goals
  • Develop and produce priority vertical video content across social and owned-and-operated (O&O) platforms, applying strong video production and content creation judgment to support audience engagement
  • Create and refine social media graphics, thumbnails, and visual packages for priority content, applying graphic design and image editing practices to support performance across platforms
  • Manage above-the-fold execution on station websites, using content optimization, audience behavior, and user experience insights to address performance issues and improve engagement
  • Apply strong video judgment to select, package, and optimize video content for live video streaming on station websites, mobile apps, and owned CTV applications;
  • Implement live video streaming strategy across social platforms in alignment with established KPIs and social media content management standards.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve any issues as they occur to ensure smooth execution in delivery.
  • Develop, publish, and optimize local article strategies supporting Content Strategy 3.0 on individual station websites using advanced content management systems and web content best practices
  • Advise MMJs and station teams on digital-first storytelling approaches, strengthening digital content creation, community connection, audience interaction, and social media content development
  • Use social media listening tools and audience data to identify emerging story opportunities, evaluate user generated content (UGC), and recommend content approaches to station teams
  • Evaluate and apply AI and automation tools to support workflow improvements, process efficiencies, and daily digital content creation, including identifying repeatable practices that may benefit station teams
  • Analyze Parsely real-time data and website analytics to identify performance barriers, recognize trends, develop recommendations, and make content optimization decisions that support O&O results.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


Content Creation & Publishing

  • Digital Content Creation
  • Web Content Management
  • Content Optimization
  • Content Strategy

Social Media & Platform Expertise

  • Social Media Management
  • Social Media Content Development
  • Live Video Streaming
  • Media Platforms

Visual & Video Production

  • Image Editing
  • Motion Graphics
  • Analytics & Tools
  • Website Analytics
  • Digital Analytics
  • Social Network Analysis (SNA)
  • Process Efficiencies

Storytelling & Journalism Support

  • Storytelling
  • Digital Media
  • Journalism

job.title: Traffic Copy Editor - Remote
job.description:
We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. Join the Scripps team as a Traffic Copy Editor, where you'll play an important role in ensuring advertising campaigns are scheduled accurately and commercial content is ready for air.

In this full-time position, you’ll partner closely with account executives, sales management, clients and advertising agencies while supporting the day-to-day traffic operation.


This is a remote position; however, candidates must be located within the Eastern Time Zone and able to work a schedule aligned with Eastern Time business hours.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Secure and enter advertising traffic instructions for advertisers.
  • Enter and maintain commercial copy information using ad management and traffic software.
  • Maintain traffic instruction files, commercial copy libraries and other traffic-related records.
  • Work closely with account executives, sales management, clients and advertising agencies to ensure advertising instructions are accurate and complete.
  • Serve as a backup to the Traffic Log Editor as needed, ensuring commercial inventory is scheduled in the appropriate time slots and the engineering team has the information required for broadcast.
  • Help resolve traffic, scheduling and commercial copy issues while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 1 year of related experience preferred.
  • Previous broadcast experience, particularly experience with ad management or broadcast traffic systems such as WideOrbit or OSI, is preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with account executives, sales teams, clients, agencies and other internal partners.
  • A team-oriented mindset and demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Standard office environment.
  • Limited overtime may be required to provide coverage during vacations and holidays.

job.title: VP, Revenue Operations
job.description:
Are you a transformative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operational excellence? Scripps is seeking a VP, Revenue Operations to provide strategic direction for enterprise revenue delivery and operations capabilities serving its Local Media and Scripps Networks revenue teams. In this high-impact role, you will develop and execute a long-term vision that elevates revenue performance, sales productivity, and customer experience — while leading the evolution toward a future-state operating model built on workflow simplification, automation, technology optimization, and clear accountability. As a trusted cross-functional partner to Sales, Finance, Technology, Product, and Operations leaders, you will build scalable capabilities, establish consistent enterprise practices, and develop high-performing teams that deliver timely, accurate, compliant, and impactful results across the business.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Develop and execute the enterprise Revenue Delivery and Operations strategy in support of revenue growth across Local Media and Scripps Networks.
  • Assess current-state work and design future-state operating models that simplify processes, clarify roles and decision rights, improve efficiency, and scale with the business.
  • Lead enterprise transformation through process redesign, automation, technology modernization, standardization, change management, and the adoption of new ways of working.
  • Establish service expectations, key performance indicators, quality standards, escalation paths, operating controls, and governance practices that strengthen accountability, safeguard revenue integrity, reduce risk, and support compliance.
  • Build a culture of operational excellence centered on customer service, accuracy, responsiveness, efficiency, ownership, and measurable continuous improvement.
  • Partner with senior Sales leaders and cross-functional teams to align priorities, remove barriers affecting seller productivity and the advertiser experience, and deliver enterprise initiatives.
  • Set business priorities for revenue operations technology and work with Technology and Product teams to translate requirements into scalable workflow, data, reporting, and automation solutions.
  • Use operational analytics and performance reporting to identify root causes, prioritize improvements, manage risk, support business decisions, and inform enterprise operating standards.
  • Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing organization with clear expectations, strong leadership capability, succession plans, and readiness for change.
  • Ensure operational readiness for new products, revenue streams, partnerships, sales motions, and go-to-market strategies while bringing forward relevant industry practices and emerging capabilities that enable future growth.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in a related discipline preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Generally, 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, business operations, advertising operations, shared services, or a related field
  • Prior managerial experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Significant leadership and team development capability within complex, cross-functional organizations
  • Proven ability to assess current-state operations and design and implement future-state operating models that improve efficiency, service, scalability, controls, and business outcomes
  • Expertise in revenue operations technology, including WideOrbit
  • Comprehensive knowledge of advertising sales operations, order management, traffic and inventory, campaign execution, revenue delivery, support processes, and related controls
  • Expertise in process redesign, automation, technology modernization, and organizational change
  • Knowledge of the media or advertising industry preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute enterprise operating strategies that support revenue growth and business transformation, balancing enterprise vision, business-specific needs, and day-to-day execution
  • Proven ability to evaluate complex work, define a compelling future state, and translate strategy into practical operating models, processes, roles, measures, and disciplined execution
  • Expertise in process improvement, workflow optimization, automation, operating model design, organizational effectiveness, and change leadership
  • Strong business and operational acumen, with the ability to quickly learn revenue workflows, technology ecosystems, customer needs, and control requirements and apply that understanding to business decisions
  • Working knowledge of internal controls, compliance, risk management, audit readiness, governance, service expectations, quality programs, and continuous improvement practices within a revenue-generating organization
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, and executive presence, with the ability to explain complex operational and technology topics, influence across boundaries, and build trust at all levels
  • Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, create alignment, and deliver results through others
  • Strong analytical, financial, and problem-solving capabilities, with a data-driven approach to establishing performance measures, identifying root causes, prioritizing improvements, and making decisions
  • Demonstrated success building and developing high-performing teams through ambiguity, change, and growth, with an inclusive and accountable leadership style that sets clear direction, develops others, invites diverse perspectives, and creates ownership for outcomes

job.title: Client Coordinator
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

The Client Coordinator sits within Semafor’s Revenue Operations team and plays a central role in supporting sales, client partnerships, and integrated program delivery.

This role is the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Program Management, Events, and Ad Operations. The Client Coordinator supports the execution of integrated media programs by partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams to translate client goals into proposals and ensure seamless delivery across pre-sale functions. This role plays a critical part in maintaining organized workflows, clear communication, and a high-quality client experience across Semafor’s media and events portfolio.

This is an ideal role for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who is excited to learn the media business end-to-end and grow into sales, client strategy, or revenue operations over time.

Key Responsibilities

Media Planning, Pre-Sale Strategy & Sales Support

  • Partner with Sales to support the development of integrated media programs and media plans across newsletters, digital products, custom content, and events.
  • Support pricing inputs, packaging, deal revisions, and rate guidance within established yield and inventory frameworks.
  • Coordinate proposal kick-offs, deal brief creation, internal feasibility checks, cross-functional inputs, and timeline management 
  • Support RFP responses and the creation of polished, visually engaging proposal decks.
  • Prepare for client meetings by compiling research, agendas, and supporting materials; capture notes and draft follow-ups to ensure clear next steps and accountability.

Client Communication & Relationship Support

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for client coordination, ensuring timely communication and follow-through.
  • Build familiarity with client priorities, sensitivities, and goals to anticipate needs.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure clarity on scope, deliverables, and timelines.

The successful candidate will be well-sourced, write with authority, and have a deep understanding of the tectonic shifts underway across the region, and how they are reverberating around the world.

Semafor doesn’t ask its reporters to match others’ stories; instead, we want reporters who deliver their own exclusives and author insightful, reported columns that offer real insights to our elite, sophisticated readers. The successful candidate will take big swings at impactful stories, conduct high-profile interviews with some of the most powerful people in global business and finance, and bring their unique voice to Semafor's briefings, live journalism, and shows, as well as on TV, podcasts, and other media.

  • Appear on TV, podcasts, and Semafor's marquee live journalism, where you'll host on-the-record interviews with the most senior business and finance leaders
  • Be eager to travel and seek out reporting-rich environments

What Makes You Qualified

  • A proven, scoop-hungry reporter with at least five years of experience and a demonstrated track record of sourcing up — and a clear sense of where the next beat of a big story is heading
  • Someone who has developed a voice and smart takes on the biggest news in China and across the region, and who can move fluidly between breaking a story and writing something authoritative and compelling about what it means
  • A comprehensive reader of the competitive landscape, always aware of what's been done and what hasn't

job.title: Associate Development Engineer
job.description:
Join Sinclair Digital, the innovation engine behind one of the largest and most diversified television broadcasting company in the country. We're at the forefront of transforming how local news and television are produced, distributed, and consumed across multiple platforms. We are the digital innovation team for Sinclair Media with affiliations to all major networks and more local television stations than anyone else. 

Sinclair Digital's Cloud Computing team is utilizing a new program to integrate fresh talent with diverse experience, into an exceptional cloud computing powerhouse, from the ground up. Our digital portfolio combines websites, mobile apps, over-the-top (OTT) apps, and our content publishing platform into a seamless user experience. We take pride in our charter to transform Sinclair Broadcast Group with a broadcast-centric company into an every-platform enterprise while maintaining our entrepreneurial spirit. 

Our Cloud Computing team is looking for a highly ambitious and enthusiastic candidate to join the team as an Associate Development Engineer. This candidate will have a verifiable history of critical thinking, teamwork, and leadership. The purpose of this position is to build on previous professional and educational experience for integration into the Sinclair Media paradigm and specialize in the development of Cloud Computing technologies. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in interpersonal communication, as well as have a desire and willingness for collaboration. 


Responsibilities: 

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse technology ecosystem at Sinclair Digital, gaining hands-on experience with client, server, and cloud technologies. 
  • Learn by building new cloud services using CI/CD and IAC development paradigms.

  • Innovate by designing and building applications to discover and implement cutting-edge content delivery methods. 
  • Be a strong team player while collaborating with other team members across the org. 
  • Be ready to discuss and present your ideas to others, taking critical feedback and improving and iterating on design. 
  • Follow best practices and patterns, while continuing to explore new and emerging technologies 

 

Minimum Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Applied Science with a Full Stack Web Development certificate, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 6 months experience in application and/or web development. 
  • Experience working in several languages and tools including JavaScript, Java, Express, Node.js, MySQL, MongoDB, Mongoose, Python, ReactJS, jQuery, HTML5, and CSS. 

 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience with or strong interest in AWS cloud services, Databricks, and modern cloud-native architectures, including Docker containers, microservices, Kubernetes clusters, Terraform, and serverless / event-driven systems, along with a passion for learning and building scalable distributed solutions. 
  • It is preferred  that applicants include a resume, and cover letter that include links to their GitHub, LinkedIn, and a personally developed website.

job.title: Customer Service Manager
job.description:
Are you ready to help customers get clear, timely answers and a dependable support experience? In this fast-paced role, you will guide digital support requests from intake through resolution, helping stations and sales teams get the information they need to keep campaigns moving.

The Customer Support Manager is a part of a team that manages inquiries through the Digital Helpdesk and responds to questions about programmatic delivery, campaign setup, access, products, and performance. The team uses a ticketing system to organize and prioritize work, investigate issues, coordinate with internal teams and vendors, and keep customers informed until each request is resolved.

We value thoughtful communication, accountability, and a strong focus on service quality. If you enjoy solving problems and making support easier for customers, this role offers a meaningful way to contribute to our digital media work.

Customer Support Duties:

  • Manage customer inquiries in the Helpdesk ticketing system from intake through resolution, organizing, prioritizing, and tracking each request.
  • Respond promptly to customer questions and issues, keep requests moving, and resolve them within agreed-upon time frames and service-level expectations.
  • Answer questions about programmatic delivery, campaign setup, product access, and performance in clear language customers can understand.
  • Review ticket history, order details, campaign setup, pacing, and available reporting to investigate issues and identify next steps.
  • Resolve requests directly when appropriate and coordinate escalations to Ad Operations, Analytics, Technical Account Support, Product, Engineering, or vendors when additional expertise is needed.
  • Provide clear status updates, explain next steps, and maintain professional communication with customers and internal partners throughout the resolution process.
  • Maintain accurate ticket notes, supporting details, customer communications, and resolution steps so each request has a clear record and can be followed through to closure.
  • Become an expert in the ticketing system and use its features to manage, monitor, and resolve customer inquiries effectively.
  • Meet or exceed established service-level agreements and other service measures for response, resolution, and ticket quality.

 

Role Requirements

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information in a customer-friendly way.
  • Strong reading comprehension, active listening, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good organization, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through on open requests.
  • Able to prioritize competing requests and work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, hybrid environment.
  • Able to stay calm, professional, and helpful when responding to customer questions or concerns.
  • Commitment to meeting service-level agreements, response and resolution time frames, and quality standards.
  • Willing to learn, receive feedback, and adapt to changing products, systems, and priorities.
  • Customer service, helpdesk, or digital advertising experience preferred.
  • Experience with Jira or another ticketing system is a plus; able to learn ticket workflows and system features in depth.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of programmatic advertising, digital campaign delivery, or ad operations is a plus.
  • Candidates must be available during regular US business hours, including Pacific Standard Time as needed 

 

Qualifications

  • College Degree
  • 2+ years job experience ideally in the digital industry

 

The hourly compensation range for this role is $20.43 to $24.03. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
The Digital Content Producer is responsible for producing, publishing, and managing timely, accurate, and engaging content across the station’s digital platforms, including the website, social media channels, mobile apps, YouTube, and email communications.

This role actively monitors breaking news, gathers information from official sources, and creates digital-first content that keeps audiences informed in real time. The Digital Content Producer collaborates with News, Sales, Promotions, and Station Management to ensure consistent messaging, audience engagement, and strong digital storytelling while maintaining journalistic integrity and brand standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Write, edit, and publish news stories and multimedia content for the station website and digital platforms.
  • Manage and maintain all station social media platforms, including posting content, monitoring engagement, and responding to audience interaction when appropriate.
  • Monitor breaking news and developing stories, gathering information from official sources and public officials when necessary.
  • Conduct phone calls and outreach to law enforcement, public information officers, and other officials to confirm details and obtain updates on developing stories.
  • Create and publish digital-first content across multiple platforms, including social media, YouTube, mobile apps, and newsletters.
  • Review and edit reporter scripts, video, and multimedia assets for digital publication, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and adherence to journalistic standards.
  • Update digital platforms throughout the day with breaking news, live updates, and timely information to keep audiences informed.
  • Coordinate and execute digital promotions and contests in partnership with Sales, News, and Promotions teams.
  • Maintain consistent brand voice and visual standards across all digital platforms.
  • Track digital engagement and content performance metrics as directed by management.
  • Communicate closely with newsroom staff and management to support daily news coverage and digital initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience in digital journalism, news production, or multimedia content creation preferred.
  • Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience managing social media platforms and creating platform-specific content.
  • Familiarity with content management systems (CMS), social media tools, and basic video editing.
  • Ability to work quickly and effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news environment.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across multiple departments.

job.title: Director, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales and marketing strategy. Your main mission will be to amplify our market presence while ensuring we hit our ambitious sales targets. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!


o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by leading the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.


o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement innovative sales and marketing strategies that will amplify our sales performance. You'll be the mastermind behind tactics that not only meet but exceed our sales goals.


o Team Development:  Leading, mentoring, and inspiring a team of sales professionals is no small feat! Your ability to motivate and enhance their skills will be crucial in driving performance and achieving success together.


o Market Analysis: Dive deep into market trends, data, and customer needs. By understanding what drives our clients, you'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.


o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients and stakeholders is crucial. You'll be the driving force behind our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.


What We're Looking For 

o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience as a Sales Director or other sales management and leadership roles, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 


o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.


o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.


o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 


o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.


o A Willingness to Grow:  Do you thrive in unified environments? The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.


The Practical Stuff 

o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 


Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.


o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.


o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)


o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.


AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Editor, Criminally Obsessed
job.description:
About Criminally Obsessed

Criminally Obsessed is Sinclair’s true crime media brand, and it is focused on the cases, investigations and stories that capture the public’s attention. Criminally Obsessed brings together compelling crime news and journalism, expert analysis, exclusive interviews and original storytelling and content across digital platforms.

The Criminally Obsessed Daily Show is a daily crime news and analysis program covering the biggest and most compelling criminal stories making headlines across the country. It goes beyond simply recapping the day’s news. Each episode is built around the most interesting development, question, detail or perspective surrounding a case and is led by an interview that drives the conversation. It is a vodcast and podcast, so the production team constructs each episode keeping in mind that the audience will need to be interested visually and audibly. 

About Sinclair

Sinclair is one of the largest media companies in the United States, with an extensive portfolio in digital media, national programming, local television, news, sports, and entertainment. Sinclair’s portfolio is an asset to Criminally Obsessed, with nearly 30 years of archival content, reporters and photographers on the ground, on the scene and in court. 

Sinclair’s strength is in its wide reach combined with its deep connection to local audiences and journalism. The company continues to expand its digital footprint andcontinues to develop content designed for a multiplatform audience.

About the role

Criminally Obsessed is looking for a talented and creative Editor to join the production team behind the daily show. This is more than a technical editing position. We are lookingfor someone who understands storytelling, pacing, visual language and YouTube audience retention – someone who knows how to turn raw material into a compelling piece of content that makes people want to click, watch and keep watching. 

The Editor for Criminally Obsessed is responsible for the editorial preparation, production, post-production, and delivery of daily and episodic content. This role works closely with the Producer, Senior Producer, Production Assistant, the host, and guests to ensure content is accurate, compelling, visually engaging, technically sound, and delivered on deadline.

The Editor is expected to have a strong understanding of true-crime news, storytelling, editorial standards, broadcast and digital production workflows, and the technical requirements necessary to deliver polished content across multiple platforms. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound editorial judgment, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced production environment. 

We are particularly interested in candidates who understand the unique demands of YouTube as a viewing platform and can bring a digital-first approach to editing, with an eye toward creating content that captures attention, sustains viewer interest, and encourages audiences to keep watching. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Attend Content Strategy Sessions to pitch and produce original social-first true crime content
  • Collaborate with assigned producers and talent to research and gather all necessary creative materials for approved projects
  • Work independently to assemble and edit assigned content through all stages of post-production and the review process
  • Utilize the full Adobe Creative Suite and other design tools to create motion graphics, to deliver high-quality content
  • Design social graphics including thumbnails that maintain brand guidelines
  • Make informed editorial decisions around content, episode length, and metadata, optimizing show for maximum audience growth
  • Advise on workflows to ensure production efficiency; educate both internal and external teams on best practices
  • Keep up with latest trends, software updates, and platform changes to help drive innovative ways to create new content

CORE RESPONSIBILITIESPRE-PRODUCTION

  • Once a topic or editorial angle for the Daily Show has been selected, thoroughly familiarize yourself with the case and the planned story.
  • Develop a working knowledge of the key people, locations, timeline, events, and relevant facts associated with each case. 
  • Review and become familiar with all available editorial, archival, photographic,video, audio, and other media assets.
  • Gather, organize, label, and prepare assets for efficient use during the editing process.
  • Research and obtain appropriate guest information, including names, backgrounds, photographs, video, and information required for lower thirds and other on-screen graphics.
  • Review interview shots and technical setup prior to recording to ensure appropriate framing, lighting, video quality, and audio quality.
  • Be available during recordings to identify and troubleshoot technical or visual issues as they arise.
  • Review raw recordings and correct or flag audio, video, or other technical issues to ensure the highest possible quality before editing.

PRODUCTION / EDITING

  • Edit Producer-created papercuts/scripts, A-roll, and other editorial materials into a polished and cohesive Daily Show segment.
  • Review and incorporate media gathered by the Editor, Senior Producer, Producer, or Associate Producer and identified in the papercut.
  • Select and appropriately place B-roll and supporting visual elements to complement the narration, interviews, and editorial beats of each story.
  • Maintain strong visual storytelling throughout each segment, using appropriatepacing, imagery, graphics, sound, and transitions.
  • Proactively communicate with the Producer and Senior Producer regarding editorial changes, creative opportunities, or potential improvements to the visual presentation, audio quality, pacing, and overall flow of the Daily Show.
  • Create and incorporate graphics for the Daily Show, including fullscreens,dates/courtesies, lower thirds, and other required on-screen elements.
  • Ensure graphics, captions, names, dates, and other editorial information areaccurate and consistent with established production standards.
  • Deliver a clean, polished first pass to the Producer/Senior Producer for review.
  • Implement notes, corrections, and editorial changes efficiently and accurately through subsequent edit passes.
  • Maintain appropriate legal courtesies and source attribution for non-Sinclair content in accordance with established standards and requirements.
  • Complete final edits and deliver finished episodes including accurate time codes for designated advertising breaks.
  • Meet established production deadlines while maintaining a high standard of editorial and technical quality.
     

POST-PRODUCTION

  • Archive and properly organize all content and media assets used in each episode in accordance with established file management and archival procedures.
  • Edit and deliver episodes for a digital broadcast tv network
  • Prepare and edit content intended for broadcast on Sinclair news stations and upload completed materials to location.
  • Edit sales-related audio and video advertisements and promotional materials for sponsorships as assigned.
  • Ensure all final deliverables meet applicable technical specifications, formatting requirements, and deadlines.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Stay current on true-crime content creators, podcasts, news organizations, emerging stories, and relevant industry trends, and proactively contribute compelling content ideas during daily editorial meetings.
  • Maintain awareness of developing stories and potential editorial opportunities that may be relevant to Criminally Obsessed.
  • Collaborate effectively with Producers, Senior Producers, Associate Producers, and other members of the production team.
  • Communicate proactively regarding production challenges, scheduling concerns, technical issues, or potential delays.
  • Maintain organized project files, media, and editorial materials to support an efficient production workflow.
  • Perform other job-related duties and special projects as assigned by the manager.
  • Schedule and hours may flex based on business needs, production requirements, breaking news, or other editorial priorities. Occasional after-hours or weekend coverage may be required when warranted.
  • Travel approximately 10–20% as needed for conferences, training, on-site content coverage, or other business-related assignments.
  • Safely lift, carry, and maneuver equipment or production gear weighing up to 25 pounds, while following all applicable safety procedures and protocols.

PROFESSIONAL EXPECTATIONS

  • Demonstrate strong editorial judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to accuracy.
  • Consistently meet deadlines and communicate promptly when priorities or circumstances may affect delivery.
  • Maintain a collaborative, solution-oriented approach when working with the production team.
     
  • Exercise discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive, graphic, or confidential subject matter.
  • Follow all applicable company policies, editorial standards, legal requirements, technical specifications, and production procedures.
  • Take ownership of assigned projects from initial preparation through final deliveryand archival.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years hands-on experience in all aspects of video production and post production including shooting, lighting, sound recording & editing, and ability to operate and troubleshoot all associated equipment
  • Highly skilled across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Premiere Rush, Photoshop,After Effects, etc), and other creative software
  • Demonstrated experience editing content for an established YouTube channel, with an understanding of YouTube-specific storytelling, audience retention, pacing, and visual engagement.
  • Experience using YouTube performance metrics, including audience retention and watch time, to inform editing decisions and identify opportunities to improve viewer engagement and overall channel performance
  • Strong understanding of video editing techniques and storytelling
  • Demonstrated experience in motion graphics and creating social media video content
  • Strong knowledge of YouTube and its best practices
  • Proficiency in designing graphics, including thumbnails and infographics
  • An eye for quality content, with an understanding of what plays well across various channels
  • This position requires impeccable spelling and grammar, a deep understanding of social media trends and what works on each platform, vertical video editing skills, and the ability to capture well-composed videos on a phone
  • Must be highly motivated, extremely organized, and come to the position with a uniquely creative mind
  • Flexibility to travel and work nights and/or weekends, as projects call for
  • Only applicants with portfolios, sites, or reels of their work will be considered
     

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

job.title: General Assignment Reporter
job.description:

job.title: Human Resources Generalist
job.description:
Sinclair is looking for an experienced Human Resources Generalist to join KABB and WOAI-TV in providing front-line, on-site, day-to-day HR support. The HR Generalist will also support our station in Corpus Christi, TX.

The HR Generalist provides on-site, practical, day-to-day guidance across each of the functional areas of human resources including recruiting, onboarding and offboarding, benefits, leaves of absence, employee relations, training, and performance management. The successful candidate brings three to five years of human resources experience in a fast-paced environment, along with sound judgment, clear communication, reliable follow-through, and strong attention to detail.
 

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with HR colleagues and station leaders to provide responsive, practical support to employees and managers across multiple stations, while building an understanding of each station’s people, operations, and culture.

  • Help ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations, including FMLA, FLSA, workers’ compensation, ADA, and EEO requirements; interpret and apply company policies consistently and help managers understand their responsibilities.

  • Support employee relations matters, including being responsive to complaints and investigations in coordination with the Regional HR Manager.

  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding actions, including preparing materials, presenting information, and collecting required documentation.

  • Support recruiting by posting openings, preparing offer letters, coordinating pre-employment requirements, maintaining accurate tracking records, communicating promptly with candidates, and helping ensure compliant hiring practices.

  • Support benefits administration by maintaining working knowledge of company plans, assisting with Open Enrollment communications and employee education, and participating in audits as needed.

  • Support performance management and review cycles, including compliance tracking, follow-up, and audits.

  • Administer leaves of absence in accordance with company policy, benefit plan requirements, and applicable federal, state and local laws.

  • Respond to unemployment, worker’s compensation claims and employment verification requests.

  • Maintain accurate, confidential electronic HR and personnel records, and handle sensitive employee information with discretion.

  • Help plan and coordinate employee training, morale events, and team activities, manage assigned HR projects and perform other related duties as needed.

  • This is an onsite position supporting our stations in San Antonio, Corpus Christi, with the potential to expand to additional Sinclair stations.

  • Some travel to assigned locations required.

     

 Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources or a related field.
  • Three to five years of human resources experience.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Strong interpersonal and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees and managers at all levels.
  • A positive, service-oriented approach and dependable follow-through on assigned work.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information and sensitive situations, including when under pressure and/or tight deadlines.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, the ability to manage competing priorities, and close attention to detail.
  • Oracle HRIS experience is a plus.

job.title: Investigative Journalist, Spotlight on Maryland
job.description:
Sinclair’s Spotlight on Maryland is looking for Investigative Journalists who are comfortable asking elected leaders and government officials smart, thought provoking, and tough questions. Spotlight on Maryland produces high impact and accountability stories for digital, social, print and television. These stories go beyond the basics of general reporting to expose a problem, hold government and elected leaders accountable for their actions and press for a solution. Our goal is to offer audiences on multiple platforms something meaningful that will have an impact on the communities we serve.   

The ideal candidate will have strong news judgment, be a compelling and fact-based writer, and be able to multitask. We are looking for someone with a clear understanding of how to dig for a story, research it, write it with a thought-provoking edge. Knowledge of the FOIA (Freedom of Information Act) process, computer-assisted reporting, and data-driven reporting is required along with familiarity of legal issues related to investigative news reporting. Strong writing skills and knowledge of current events is essential. Dynamic storytelling skills are a must.

This is a highly collaborative environment. The ability to work as part of a team is a must.

Essential Duties and Requirements include the following:

  • Develop and maintain contacts and sources in the community to enterprise story ideas
  • Identify and pitch investigative angles on big daily news stories
  • Work closely with local and corporate news leadership to refine investigative pitches and story scripts
  • Write online, print and broadcast versions of investigative reports and produce digital specific content for each investigation
  • The position is located on-site in Hunt Valley, MD*
  • Other duties as assigned

 

Qualifications- To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. 

  • Three (3) years of reporting/producing experience preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred
  • Must be a strong storyteller with the ability to make the complicated understandable
  • Must be able to use all available tools to enhance stories, from graphics to social media
  • Should be able to generate story ideas and determine the legitimacy of viewer tips
  • Strong writer, storyteller
  • Must be naturally inquisitive with an interest in holding government officials accountable

 

Please provide a link to examples of your work.

*This is an in-office role, 5 days a week at our Sinclair Headquarters located at 10706 Beaver Dam Road, Hunt Valley, MD 21030.

job.title: IT Engineer

job.title: IT Engineer
job.description:
KOMO is seeking a full-time IT Technician to join our Engineering Department and support the computer, network, and broadcast systems that keep our station operating around the clock.

This hands-on role supports a wide range of technology, including newsroom editing systems, television transmission equipment, broadcast automation, servers, and business workstations. If you enjoy solving technical problems, helping others, and learning how IT powers live television, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Provide responsive technical support to station staff and operational users.
  • Install, configure, troubleshoot, service, and repair PC and Mac workstations, hardware, and software.
  • Assist with server administration, network security, and network services.
  • Support the News Department’s daily technical needs, including newsroom and editing systems.
  • Install and maintain video equipment and assist with the installation and maintenance of master control systems.
  • Assist with LAN and WAN hardware and software maintenance.
  • Develop an understanding of broadcast-specific IT requirements and help support those systems.
  • Deploy regular security updates using Tanium.
  • Maintain accurate equipment inventory records.
  • Support the station’s Microsoft Teams telephone system.
  • Perform technical work and equipment installations in accordance with established engineering standards and practices.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Live Newscast Support

During assigned early morning, evening, and weekend newscasts, responsibilities may also include:

  • Coordinate live shots and interruptible foldback (IFB) audio routing using iNews and station routing systems.
  • Route, initialize, and record incoming feeds.
  • Perform quality-control checks to ensure feeds meet station requirements.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues affecting live news operations.

 

Work Schedule and Availability

This position is primarily scheduled for the day shift. Because KOMO operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week, candidates must be flexible and available to work early mornings, evenings, nights, and weekends as needed. Participation in a rotating on-call schedule is required to support station operations and respond to urgent technical issues outside scheduled work hours.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Associate degree in information technology, electronics, a computer-related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong familiarity with Microsoft Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems.
  • Basic knowledge of video systems and a willingness to learn broadcast technology.
  • Technical aptitude and the ability to complete training on station systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and a commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and complete projects with minimal supervision.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach and dedication to quality work.
  • Flexibility to meet the scheduling and on-call requirements of a 24/7 broadcast operation.
