job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 
At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 
Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat.    Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 
o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales strategies and elevate our market presence. Your main mission will be to lead our sales team to new heights while fostering a culture of success and motivation. We believe that with the right guidance, our team can achieve remarkable results, and that's where you come in. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!
o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by managing the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.
o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement cutting edge sales and marketing plans that not only amplify our reach but also align with our company goals.
o Team Leadership:  Leading a team of sales professionals is no small feat! You'll mentor and inspire them to hit and exceed their targets while cultivating a collaborative environment.
o Market Analysis: Keeping an eye on market trends and customer needs is essential. You'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.
o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients is crucial. You'll be the face of our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.
o Dynamic Oversight: You'll track sales performance metrics and provide insightful reports to senior management, helping us make data-driven decisions.
What We're Looking For 
o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience in sales management or someone fully ready to take their next career step in sales leadership, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 
o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.
o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 
o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, and make a difference.
o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in transformative environments? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.
The Practical Stuff 
o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 
Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 
o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of an agile team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.
o The Compensation Package: Enjoy a competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.
o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)
o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.
AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.       EEO AND INCLUSIVITY  Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Meteorologist in Baltimore, MD. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of meteorology and its application in the context of local weather patterns and events. The Meteorologist will be responsible for providing accurate and timely weather forecasts, and effectively communicating weather-related information to our audience. Additionally, proficiency in managing and posting content across various social media platforms is crucial for this role. Other Responsibilities:
  • Develop and present comprehensive and detailed weather reports for various segments, ensuring clarity and accessibility for a diverse audience.
  • Monitor weather conditions, analyze data, and utilize state-of-the-art technology to provide timely and precise weather updates and alerts.
  • Collaborate with news producers, reporters, and other team members to integrate weather information seamlessly into news broadcasts and other programming.
  • Maintain a strong social media presence by regularly posting weather updates, forecasts, and relevant content across various platforms to engage and inform the community.
  • Develop and implement strategies to enhance the station's digital weather presence, including interactive weather maps, live streaming, and other innovative features.
  • Build and maintain relationships with local authorities, emergency management agencies, and community organizations to ensure effective communication during severe weather events and emergencies.
  • Participate in community outreach events, educational programs, and public speaking engagements to promote weather awareness and preparedness within the local community.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's or master's degree in meteorology, atmospheric science, or a related field.
  • 7-10 years of experience in a professional meteorology role, preferably in a broadcast environment.
  • Profound knowledge of meteorological tools and software, including weather radar systems, satellite imagery, and forecasting models.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with a demonstrated ability to present complex weather information in a clear and engaging manner.
  • Proven experience in managing and leveraging various social media platforms to disseminate weather information and engage with the audience effectively.
  • Ability to work under pressure and in a fast-paced environment, particularly during severe weather situations.
  • Familiarity with the Baltimore, MD, metropolitan area and its unique weather patterns is preferred.
 

If you are passionate about meteorology, possess strong leadership skills, and have a keen interest in leveraging social media for community engagement, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $78,600 to $98,200.  Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, quarterly and annual incentive plan bonuses, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.description:

The ideal candidate is a confident communicator who can explain changing weather conditions, report from the field and connect with viewers across broadcast and digital platforms.

job.title: Morning Anchor/Reporter
job.description:
WCTI has an exciting opportunity for a full-time Morning News Anchor/Reporter. We are looking for a strong journalist who can lead morning newscasts with credibility, connect with viewers, and deliver meaningful stories across television, digital, social, and streaming platforms.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with excellent news judgment, a clear understanding of current events, and a passion for enterprise reporting. You should be able to dig for stories, conduct thorough research, write with clarity and edge, and use compelling storytelling and strong television production to make each story impactful and memorable. Dynamic live television and reporting skills are essential.

Responsibilities:

  • Anchor and help produce morning newscasts
  • Report, shoot, write, and edit news stories for broadcast, digital, social, and streaming platforms
  • Develop and pitch original, enterprise story ideas daily
  • Deliver live reports and breaking-news coverage as needed
  • Research, write, and present stories that are accurate, engaging, and relevant to the Eastern Carolina community
  • Maintain an active and professional social media presence to build your brand, promote stories, and connect with viewers
  • Collaborate with producers, photographers, assignment editors, and the newsroom team to deliver high-quality coverage
  • Perform other duties as assigned by news management


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Previous anchoring experience is required
  • At least one year of on-air reporting experience is required
  • Live-shot experience is required
  • Strong writing, verbal communication, and on-camera presentation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to enterprise stories and tell them creatively across platforms
  • Sound editorial judgment, strong research skills, and a commitment to journalistic ethics
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively in a collaborative newsroom environment
  • A valid driver’s license and good driving record are required
  • A link to recent work or a demo reel is required
     

Why WCTI/WYDO?

At WCTI and WYDO, you'll tell stories that matter while serving communities across Eastern North Carolina. You'll gain hands-on experience covering everything from breaking news and severe weather to enterprise and community-focused reporting—all while working in a newsroom committed to developing the next generation of journalists.

job.title: News Photographer
job.description:
WPEC is looking for a creative full-time News Photographer! 

We are seeking someone who can see beyond the lens and bring back compelling stories. The candidate should have 2 years of ENG experience with a network affiliate news organization. You will cover day to day general, in-depth features and investigative assignments. We are shooting full high definition (HD) on media cards and editing on desktops and laptops. You should have strong editing skills in non-linear edit systems, possess excellent people skills, a strong work ethic, and a great attitude. A passion for story telling is absolutely essential in this position.

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of shooting experience and technical knowledge of editing and photo equipment
  • Team-player who can produce good stories under tight deadlines
  • Must have valid driver’s license, good driving record and be able to operate ENG news vehicles
  • Ability to edit and shoot general assignment stories, lives shots and natural sound packages
  • Must be able to lift and carry between 25 and 50 pounds on a regular basis

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: News Producer
job.description:
WTVC has an immediate opening for a creative News Producer! In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day production of our newscasts. Join News 4-Fox 11 as a News Producer and help shape the stories Northern Nevada viewers count on every day. job.title: Production Manager, Remote & Studio
job.description:
Tennis Channel is seeking a Production Manager to plan and execute full-scale productions for live remote events and studio shows, both domestic and international. This role calls for a highly organized, proactive, and quick-thinking professional with strong communication and interpersonal skills. As a representative of Tennis Channel at events around the world, the Production Manager will maintain a professional appearance and demeanor and serve as an ambassador for the network on an international stage.

What You’ll Do

Remote Production

  • Serve as the primary liaison between production teams and a wide range of partners, including facility management, senior production staff, production and technical crews, talent, site operations, vendors, tournament directors, and other network representatives.
  • Coordinate facilities with host venues and broadcasters, including [V&A] bookings, office space, power, venue logistics, shipping, and transmission.
  • Supervise staffing needs for domestic and international remote productions and help source experienced crews for ATP Masters 1000 events.
  • Oversee the acquisition and distribution of production elements such as event footage, music and music cue sheets, graphics, and equipment.
  • Partner with the Travel and Finance teams to coordinate hotel accommodations.
  • Manage credentials, venue access, parking, catering, and crew scheduling.
  • Plan and track rental equipment, logistics, and shipping.

Studio Production

  • Help supervise studio coordination, staff, and facilities alongside the Production Coordinator.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between internal and external partners during world feed production.
  • Collaborate with production teams to ensure assigned productions meet the network’s creative and technical objectives.
  • Help train new hires in production department processes and procedures.

Across Remote and Studio

  • Create, maintain, and quality-check production books, call sheets, daily crew call times, schedules, trackers, and planning documents using Lasso and established Excel templates.
  • Partner with the Director of Finance and the Production Accountant to manage costs, coordinate crew and show requirements, and ensure timely processing of timecards and contracts/deal memos.

What You Bring

  • Preferred 5+ years of experience in production management or a related role in sports or entertainment production.
  • Proven ability to oversee complex remote productions, manage venue operations and logistics, and work closely with venue management and host broadcasters.
  • Strong ability to multitask and manage several productions from start to finish in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to adapt and thrive in constantly changing environments with unpredictable challenges and a wide range of personalities.
  • Enthusiasm for hands-on work and the resourcefulness to roll up your sleeves and make things happen.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with Smartsheet preferred; familiarity with Lasso is a plus.

Schedule and Travel

  • Domestic and international travel averaging about 4 months per year, including Grand Slams and other tournaments as needed.
  • Willingness to work 50+ hours per week on a flexible schedule that includes days, nights, weekends, and holidays. The tennis season runs January through November, with the heaviest workload from May through September.

 

Tennis Channel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

About Tennis Channel
 

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. Owned by Sinclair, Tennis Channel is also a co-owner of PickleballTV (pickleballtv.com), a joint venture with the Professional Pickleball Association.


About Sinclair

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 185 television stations in 86 markets affiliated with all the major broadcast networks; and owns Tennis Channel and multicast networks Comet, CHARGE!, ROAR, and The Nest. Sinclair's content is delivered via multiple platforms, including over-the-air, multi-channel video program distributors, and the nation's largest streaming aggregator of local news content, NewsON. The Company regularly uses its website as a key source of Company information which can be accessed at www.sbgi.net.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Associate
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: Amplify our sales and marketing team efforts, by helping us to grow our customer base and enhance our brand presence in the market and providing day-to-day business support. This means helping them fulfill orders, manage accounts, craft proposals, create engaging presentations, and develop materials that clearly communicate the benefits of our services. Your creativity will play a huge role here in driving results. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!


o Campaign Development: Work with the sales and marketing team to design and implement campaigns that drive sales and amplify brand awareness across various multimedia platforms.


o Market Research: Conduct in-depth market research to understand trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to amplify our sales strategies.


o Data Analysis:  Data-driven decisions are the name of the game! Report and analyze sales data, providing insights to optimize our strategies for better results.


o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression!


o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams and other departments. Ensuring everyone is on the same page creates a cohesive approach to sales marketing, which is super important for overall success. Connect with internal and external clients, building relationships to understand their needs to provide support. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results!


o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace.


What We're Looking For 

o Proven Business Support Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn): Whether you're a seasoned business support specialist or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.  


o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Analytical thinking is important, as you'll be interpreting data and helping with making informed decisions. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.  


o A Passion for helping Others: You are committed to collaborate with various people and departments, so being adaptable and open to working with others will help you thrive in this role to understanding our teams' needs, providing top-notch administrative and business support, and making a difference.


o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.


Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.


o Attractive Rewards: Enjoy competitive compensation that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.


o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)


o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.


o Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.


AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.   

  

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
job.description:
Make your mark in Broadcasting and Digital Media. Sinclair Broadcast Group and Sinclair Digital Solutions are dedicated to making Sinclair a communications powerhouse! We are the largest and most diversified television broadcasting company in the country. Sinclair owns and operates, programs, or provides services to more television stations than anyone and has affiliations with all major networks. Sinclair Digital group is focused on bringing the most engaging content to web, mobile and over-the-top broadcasting to audiences all over the
country!  Our success is the result of extraordinary employees and an exemplary management team who believe in a vision and are dedicated to ensuring a great future for our employees.  Whether you are an industry veteran or a just starting out, you can find it at Sinclair!  We are advancing the world of Broadcasting and we want YOU to join our winning team!
 
Sinclair Broadcast Group seeks a motivated and experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to join the Cloud Engineering Team. The individual will develop, integrate, and support key Enterprise infrastructure solutions.

Responsibilities:
 

  • Be part of a team that builds programs to design, develop, and govern cloud infrastructure across the enterprise.
  • Collaborate with other internal teams and third-party vendors to define best-in-class solutions.
    Proactively monitor KPIs and address areas of improvement for public, private, and hybrid cloud solutions.
  • Configuration, management, and maintenance of cloud-based solutions across public, private, and hybrid clouds.
  • Configuration, management, and maintenance of Windows and Linux servers across multiple cloud environments.
  • Support and deployment of applications running as containers.
  • Develop and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery processes.
  • Ensure cloud security measures are incorporated into infrastructure implementation.
  • Support and participate in the development of architecture designs for enterprise-wide systems infrastructure environments.
  • Drive efficiencies through process automation and Infrastructure as Code frameworks
  • Work with and support all other Cloud Engineering and DevOps team members.

 

Experience, Skills & Competencies:

  • 7+ years of experience in IT engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience directly building, administering, and supporting cloud solutions including compute, networking, load balancers, storage, identity management, and security.
  • 5+ years of experience with scripting and IT process automation – shell scripting, Terraform, Go, JSON, Jenkins, etc.
  • 3+ years of experience with Python development.
  • 5+ years of Linux systems administration in an enterprise level environment.
  • Experience in the architecture, engineering, and operation of containerization and virtualization technologies.
  • Understanding of industry best practices surrounding proper maintenance and support of a 24x7 cloud infrastructure – service and server hardening, tuning, vulnerability management, and patch management.
  • Demonstrable implementation of infrastructure lifecycles including planning, forecasting, implementation, and tracking of projects/assets deployment.
  • Experience supporting and managing private, public, and hybrid cloud solutions.
  • Experience working within an Agile/SAFe framework.
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong presentation skills with deep experience in data usage in dash-boarding platforms.
  • Advanced understanding and experience with monitoring tools.
  • Advanced experience developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Ability to quickly grasp technical issues and offer solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Outgoing and enthusiastic personality.
  • Professional business demeanor.
  • Customer-focused attitude and desire to interface directly with end-user clients.
  • Relevant AWS Certifications required – Solutions Architect Associate, and SysOps Engineer.
  • Additional AWS Certifications desired – Security Specialty, Advanced Networking Specialty
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent work experience.
  • Immediate authorization to work in the US.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $130,490.25 to $173,987. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Sinclair:

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net.

 About the Team

The life-blood of our organization is our people. We have a compelling story, a goal-oriented culture, and we take really good care of people. How good? Here is a glimpse: great benefits, open-door policy, upward mobility and a strong desire to see you succeed. Ready to be part of a winning team? Let’s talk. 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Senior Creative Producer/Videographer, Original Content
job.description:
AMP Sports is quickly emerging as one of the leading sports media companies producing highly engaging content across podcasts, YouTube, and social platforms. Home to some of the top sports podcasts, including “Cousins with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady,” “The Triple Option with Urban Meyer, Mark Ingram II, and Rob Stone,” “Unfiltered Soccer with Landon Donovan and Tim Howard,” “Post Moves with Candace Parker and Aliyah Boston,” and “Style of Play with Julie Ertz and Kealia Watt” as well as a network of team-focused podcasts, with more shows slated for 2026 and beyond. With a rapidly expanding digital footprint and a reach spanning 180+ broadcast stations and tens of millions of followers, AMP Sports continues to build scalable content ecosystems that drive audience growth, engagement, and revenue.

We are seeking a Senior Creative Producer/Videographer, Original Content to develop, shoot, produce, and launch original, audience-first video and social franchises across the AMP Sports portfolio that expand our shows beyond the core podcast, drive audience growth, and increase the long-term value of our talent and show IP.

Partnering closely with leadership, content, social, production, and marketing, this role will proactively identify programming opportunities, pitch new concepts, and own approved projects from idea through delivery. They will also work with individual show teams to develop more creative, visual, and repeatable in-show formats designed to perform across YouTube, social, and the broader digital ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a highly creative video-first producer and director with exceptional original content instincts and the production experience to turn ambitious ideas into finished programming. They are a creator and storyteller, and understand how talent-led digital brands grow across YouTube and social platforms. They should be equally comfortable developing a franchise, directing talent in the field, managing a production budget and external crew, or helping a show producer build a stronger recurring segment. Strong hands-on video production skills are required.

What You’ll Do

  • Proactively develop, pitch, shoot, and produce premium original video franchises, recurring series, tentpole concepts, and shoulder programming built around AMP Sports shows and talent designed to drive audience growth.
  • Own creative process from concept through delivery, including development, ideation, pre-production through post-production, and final delivery.
  • Partner with show producers to level up existing programming through creative concepts designed to improve audience growth, retention, and engagement.
  • Extend the AMP Sports talent and show IP beyond the core podcast, with a particular focus on premium YouTube video, repeatable franchises, and original concepts.
  • Own the entire production process of original video content in, studio, field, and remote environments, maintaining a high standard of creative and technical execution.
  • Direct on-camera talent, athletes, and creators in studio and on location, with the ability to shape story, conversation, performance, and creative execution.
  • Lead post-production process, partner with editors and post-production teams to shape narrative through the edit, providing creative direction on larger projects.
  • Ideate original programming built for discovery, distribution, and growth across YouTube and social platforms; use audience and performance insights to inform creative decisions.
  • Work with show leads to develop and maintain a pipeline of programming ideas and opportunities; consult on new show launches and talent development when appropriate.
  • Serve as a flexible senior creative resource across the portfolio, with the ability to step into lead producer responsibilities when needed.
  • Assist developing and managing project budgets, and hire and oversee freelance production teams, vendors, and other external resources to execute approved concepts.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

Who You Are

  • 7+ years producing and shooting premium original digital video for a media or production company, sports or entertainment brand, agency, creator-led business, or similar.
  • A highly creative developer and storyteller, with a proven track record of originating compelling programming, video concepts, recurring franchises, or similar and bringing them from concept through execution across YouTube, long-form video, social, and other digital platforms.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional creative instincts and format development skills across premium digital video content.
  • Expertise producing, shooting, and editing content in both field and studio environments across a variety of formats.
  • Exceptional storytelling skills and editorial instincts, with the ability to identify compelling narratives and turn those into high value content that connects with audiences.
  • Experience directing on-camera talent, creators, athletes, and high-profile personalities, maximizing their skillsets.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (or similar), as well as hands-on production skills with cameras, lighting, microphones, etc. in field, studio, and remote settings.
  • Strong understanding of social and YouTube best practices, audience retention, content packaging, SEO, and how content is consumed by audience across platforms.
  • A self-starter, highly collaborative, and able to lead and work across multiple teams while also working independently without oversight.
  • Someone who has a strong passion for creating digital-first content that cuts through the noise and drives significant audience growth.
  • Experience developing and managing production budgets, and onboarding and managing freelancers, vendors, and other external resources is a plus.
  • Highly organized and communicative, ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring all projects stay on timeline and all key stakeholders are involved.
  • Ability to travel and work nights, weekends, or holidays as projects call for.

job.title: Sr. Security Engineer
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced, technically driven security professional to advance Sinclair’s Information Security program. You will serve as a Senior Information Security Engineer focused on Security Operations, incident response, and advanced detection engineering. You will independently investigate complex threats, engineer high-fidelity detections across endpoint, identity, network, and cloud environments, and strengthen incident response through security tooling, workflow orchestration, and automation. You will also help evaluate and apply AI-assisted capabilities where they improve investigation quality and response efficiency. You will partner with internal teams, business stakeholders, and external security providers to improve detection coverage, accelerate response, and reduce enterprise risk.

Responsibilities:

Processes & Execution

  • Lead technical investigation, triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities for complex security incidents across on-premises, cloud, identity, and endpoint environments.

  • Analyze security telemetry, authentication activity, process execution, network traffic, and threat intelligence to determine root cause, attack scope, impact, and appropriate response.

  • Perform proactive threat hunting and retrospective investigations; identify gaps in telemetry, detections, and response capabilities.

  • Own high-severity incident investigations, document evidence-based findings, communicate business impact, and coordinate timely remediation with system owners and external partners.

  • Apply MITRE ATT&CK and other relevant threat-informed methodologies to improve investigation quality, detection coverage, and response effectiveness.

  • Demonstrate independent technical judgment, clear communication, and accountability for outcomes in time-sensitive situations.

Engineering, Collaboration & Partnerships

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and continuously tune complex detection mechanisms for multi-stage attacks, identity compromise, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration, and other advanced adversary behaviors.

  • Correlate endpoint, SIEM, identity, email, network, and cloud telemetry to create behavioral, contextual, and risk-based detections rather than relying solely on static indicators.

  • Develop and maintain detection-as-code content, queries, analytics, and validation tests; assess false positives, data quality, precision, and detection gaps.

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated SecOps and incident response workflows using security platforms, APIs, SOAR technologies, and enterprise ticketing systems to streamline enrichment, investigation, containment, and remediation.

  • Advance security operations automation by integrating AI-assisted analysis and agent-based capabilities, where appropriate, into existing investigation and response processes to improve context, prioritization, and analyst efficiency.

  • Apply established security engineering controls to automated response workflows, including least-privilege access, action validation, approval for high-impact remediation, logging, exception handling, and escalation to analysts.

  • Integrate third-party alert and investigation outputs with internal telemetry to support independent validation, deeper investigation, and consistent remediation.

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, IAM, cloud, endpoint, IT operations, and external security partners to validate detections, remediate threats, and operationalize new capabilities.

Performance Improvement

  • Measure and improve detection coverage, fidelity, mean time to detect/respond, investigation quality, automation success, and analyst effort saved.

  • Continuously test detections and response workflows using attack simulations, adversary emulation, incident lessons learned, and controlled validation.

  • Document engineering designs, investigation procedures, response decision criteria, automation safeguards, and operational runbooks.

  • Identify repetitive analyst tasks suitable for automation while preserving human oversight for uncertain, destructive, or business-disruptive actions.

  • Mentor engineers and analysts through technical reviews, investigation feedback, and knowledge sharing; promote sustainable engineering standards.

  • Evaluate new security detection and response technologies, including AI-assisted capabilities, based on practical operational value, reliability, security, and measurable risk reduction.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, security engineering, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of complex investigations.

  • Demonstrated experience building and tuning advanced detections in a SIEM, EDR/XDR, or cloud security analytics platform; ability to explain detection logic and validate underlying evidence.

  • Strong understanding of attacker techniques, Windows and Linux internals, identity-based attacks, network protocols, cloud security, and incident response methodology.

  • Hands-on experience integrating security platforms through APIs, developing orchestration workflows, and implementing automated investigation or response actions using SOAR tools and enterprise IT service management platforms.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted security investigation, agent-based automation, or LLM-enabled security workflows is a plus; specialized AI development or production AI-agent experience is not required.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with the Microsoft Defender security suite (such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, or Defender XDR) and related Microsoft security/identity technologies, including Entra ID.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies such as Zscaler, CrowdStrike Falcon, Abnormal Security, Tines, Armis, and Splunk, or equivalent platforms; strong experience across multiple tools is expected, but experience with every named product is not required.

  • Proven ability to investigate incidents and engineer or tune detections directly in EDR/XDR, SIEM, network security, email security, and identity platforms, including querying telemetry, investigating alerts, and operationalizing response actions.

  • Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, NIST incident response guidance, and security engineering best practices.

  • Professional security certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, or equivalent preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, cross-functional collaboration, and demonstrated ownership of technical initiatives.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Strategic Sourcing Associate
job.description:
The Procurement team is growing and looking for a full-time Strategic Sourcing Associate to join our team!

This is an excellent opportunity for an early career procurement or supply chain professional looking to build experience in strategic sourcing, vendor management, and purchasing operations. Working closely with the Purchasing Manager, you'll support sourcing initiatives, collaborate with internal stakeholders, assist with vendor purchasing programs, and help identify cost savings opportunities that contribute to the success of the business.

This role offers hands on experience with sourcing, procurement analytics, vendor management, and contract administration while providing opportunities for professional growth and career advancement within Procurement.

The successful candidate will have 0 to 2 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, business operations, or a related field. Internship or co-op experience is welcomed. This position reports to the Purchasing Manager.

Essential Job Functions

  • Assist with vendor contract negotiations, renewals, and purchasing activities while partnering with corporate departments and stakeholders.
  • Support sourcing initiatives and assist in identifying cost savings opportunities across vendor spend.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to assess current and future purchasing needs while identifying opportunities to consolidate spend, improve efficiencies, and increase preferred vendor compliance.
  • Analyze purchasing and spend data to help identify sourcing opportunities, vendor trends, and process improvements.
  • Submit requisitions in the Purchasing system on behalf of business units as needed.
  • Administer various vendor purchasing programs across the company.
  • Partner with the Purchasing Manager on sourcing projects and procurement initiatives throughout the year.
  • Gather feedback from business units regarding vendor performance and assist with resolving purchasing related issues.
  • Obtain vendor quotes and support pricing and contract negotiations with guidance from the Purchasing Manager.
  • Assist in resolving vendor issues related to contract obligations, service levels, product quality, and pricing.
  • Provide support to business units regarding purchasing processes, policies, best practices, and contract submissions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Other Skills

  • Ability to build professional working relationships with employees, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and problem solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively on a team.
  • Strong computer skills and willingness to learn new systems and procurement tools.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Eagerness to learn procurement best practices, vendor management, and negotiation techniques.
  • Adaptable and willing to take on new responsibilities as business needs evolve.

 

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Purchasing, Finance, Operations, or a related field preferred.
  • 0 to 2 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, operations, finance, or another related business function.
  • Internship or co-op experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or sourcing is a plus.
  • Strong interest in procurement, vendor management, and strategic sourcing.
  • Experience organizing or analyzing data in Microsoft Excel is preferred.
  • Knowledge of purchasing principles or vendor management is a plus.
  • Oracle Cloud experience is a plus.
  • Purchasing certification is a plus.

 

This position is on site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Director, Global Benefits & Wellness
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

 

SiriusXM

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

 

How you’ll make an impact:

The Director, Global Benefits & Wellness leads the execution and ongoing improvement of global benefits and wellness programs in alignment with the company’s Total Rewards strategy. Managing a team of benefits professionals and partnering with HR, Finance, Legal, Payroll, and Procurement, this role oversees program performance, financial stewardship, compliance, and vendor delivery to support a competitive, inclusive, and cost-effective employee experience.

 

What you’ll do:

Program Design & Implementation

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of global benefits and holistic wellness programs (physical, mental, financial, and social) within the broader Total Rewards strategy.
  • Evaluate benefits plans across regions, recommend improvements to address gaps and redundancies, and coordinate adaptations to local statutory requirements and employee needs.
  • Financial Responsibility & Program Performance
  • Manage self-insured and fully insured plan performance, including forecasts, renewals, reserve planning, and claims utilization analysis.
  • Develop annual budgets, funding recommendations, and clear analyses of cost, affordability, and program risks for senior leadership review.
  • Implement value-driven cost-containment initiatives that protect care quality, accessibility, and the employee experience.

Vendor Management & Procurement

  • Manage vendor relationships and procurement activities, including RFPs, contract negotiations, service-level agreements (SLAs), and coordination of data security requirements.
  • Use vendor scorecards to evaluate carriers, TPAs, and digital health partners against operational delivery, outcomes, and member satisfaction.

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Maintain program governance, documented policies, controls, and approval processes in partnership with Legal, Tax, and Payroll.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance and implement program updates according to updated program criteria (e.g., 401(k), Deferred Compensation Plans).
  • Oversee compliance monitoring and audit readiness across applicable jurisdictions, coordinating U.S. filings (including Form 5500 and nondiscrimination testing) and international statutory program obligations with internal and external specialists.

Employee Experience, Analytics & Digital Innovation

  • Improve benefits communications, open enrollment, and employee self-service experiences through digital platforms and targeted engagement.
  • Assess opportunities for secure, responsible AI and automation to improve benefits administration and employee support.
  • Track program impact using employee sentiment, ERG feedback, enrollment trends, and clinical/cost analytics to guide continuous program refinement.

Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of benefits and wellness professionals, setting priorities, monitoring service delivery, and building functional expertise.
  • Establish team goals, performance expectations, and clear accountability while fostering collaboration and a service-oriented culture.

 

What you’ll need:

  • 10 or more years of progressive benefits and wellness experience, including 5 or more years of management experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience managing multi-country benefits programs and executing plan redesigns, vendor transitions, or M&A integration activities.
  • Expertise in self-insured health plans, claims utilization analysis, cost drivers, and sustainable cost-containment approaches.
  • Experience with benefits vendor management, competitive procurement, SLA oversight, financial modeling, forecasts, and renewals.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to construct data-driven business cases, budget models, and contract negotiations.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. benefits compliance, ERISA standards, and Form 5500 reporting, maintaining clear plan-sponsor accountability alongside third-party consultants.
  • Working knowledge of international regulatory, tax, and labor environments across diverse regions.
  • Strong communication and change-management skills, with the ability to explain financial and policy trade-offs to cross-functional partners and senior leaders.
  • Familiarity with modern benefits administration platforms, digital health ecosystems, and HR technology, including the responsible use of AI and automation.
  • Experience operating within a publicly traded company, navigating executive visibility, financial controls, and audit-readiness standards.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

 

Skills:

  • Global Benefits & Wellness Program Management
  • Benefits Financial Analysis & Cost Management
  • Vendor Management & Procurement
  • Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management
  • People Leadership & Development
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

 

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $163,000 to $203,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

 

Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. SiriusXM is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, age, disability or handicap, sex, gender identity, marital status, familial status, veteran status, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

 

The requirements and duties described above may be modified or waived by the Company in its sole discretion without notice.

job.title: Global Information Security Officer
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.


This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.


SiriusXM

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.


How you’ll make an impact:

SiriusXM is seeking a Global Information Security Officer (GISO) to lead and continuously advance the company’s enterprise cybersecurity program, safeguarding customers, employees, partners, brands, and business operations against an increasingly sophisticated global threat landscape.


SiriusXM has built its reputation as a leading audio entertainment company and premier programmer and platform for subscription and advertising-supported audio products through high-quality customer experiences and trusted stewardship of customer, company, and shareholder data. The GISO will be entrusted to continuously raise the standard of cybersecurity and resilience across a complex environment spanning multiple businesses, brands, technology platforms, and geographies.


The GISO will have end-to-end accountability for enterprise information security, including security architecture and engineering; governance, risk, and compliance; security operations and incident response; identity and access security; data security; product and application security; cloud and infrastructure security; broadcast and platform security; vulnerability management; third-party risk; and security automation.


The threat landscape now includes AI-enabled attacks, identity compromise, ransomware, software supply-chain risk, cloud and SaaS exploitation, attacks on connected products, and misuse of AI systems and agents. The GISO will lead a resilience-led security program designed to prevent compromise where possible and to detect, contain, withstand, and recover from incidents quickly when prevention fails, while protecting customer trust and enabling the business to innovate with confidence.


As a strategic advisor to the executive team and Board, this leader will translate cyber and technology risk into business impact, investment priorities, risk-informed decisions, and measurable outcomes. The GISO will advance both security for AI, ensuring the responsible and secure use of AI across the enterprise, and AI for security, strategically applying automation and AI to achieve the scale, detection speed, and remediation velocity required to keep pace with increasingly AI-enabled threats. Success will be measured through meaningful reductions in enterprise risk, stronger cyber resilience, improved operational effectiveness, and the organization’s ability to securely enable growth and innovation.


What you’ll do:

  • Lead the execution and continued advancement of SiriusXM’s enterprise cybersecurity strategy, ensuring security priorities and investments remain aligned with business objectives, technology strategy, risk appetite, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements.
  • Strengthen the company’s resilience-led security posture, improving the organization’s ability to detect, contain, respond to, and recover from cyber events while minimizing business disruption and reducing potential blast radius.
  • Continuously safeguard the company’s most critical assets, including customer and employee data, identities, intellectual property, content, revenue platforms, connected products, critical infrastructure, and third-party ecosystems, while enabling the business to operate and innovate with confidence.
  • Advance SiriusXM’s AI security strategy and governance to enable responsible adoption of AI across products, engineering, and enterprise operations while addressing emerging risks associated with AI systems, agents, software supply chains, data use, and AI-enabled threats.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, IT, Infrastructure, Legal, Privacy, Risk, and the AI Steering Committee to embed security into business, technology, and AI workflows from design and development through deployment, operations, monitoring, change management, and retirement.
  • Continuously enhance SiriusXM’s security architecture, engineering practices, and operating model across cloud, SaaS, on-premises infrastructure, connected products, enterprise platforms, and third-party services, using automation and AI where they materially improve scale, effectiveness, detection, and remediation.
  • Advance enterprise cyber defense capabilities, including security operations, threat intelligence, threat hunting, vulnerability management, incident response, digital forensics, crisis management, business continuity, and disaster recovery, ensuring SiriusXM can effectively manage sophisticated and simultaneous cyber events.
  • Strengthen secure-by-design engineering practices, identity and access controls, and security capabilities that make secure delivery the default and provide scalable, self-service approaches wherever practical.
  • Lead the continued maturation of enterprise security governance, risk, and compliance, including policy, control design, risk assessment and acceptance, regulatory and contractual obligations, third-party risk, audit readiness, and evidence-based reporting.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership and the Board, providing clear, business-focused perspectives on cybersecurity strategy, emerging threats, material risks, resilience, investment priorities, and overall security posture.
  • Champion a company-wide culture in which cybersecurity, responsible AI, and risk awareness are shared responsibilities embedded in everyday decision-making through executive engagement, role-based education, clear accountability, and practical guidance.
  • Maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, strategic partners, industry organizations, regulators, and government agencies, representing SiriusXM on matters of cybersecurity, resilience, privacy, and AI security as appropriate.

Leadership and Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This leader will ensure SiriusXM’s cybersecurity capabilities advance in step with the company’s business strategy and technology modernization, enabling secure innovation without compromising resilience, customer trust, or operational excellence.
  • Lead and continue developing a high-performing, distributed cybersecurity organization of employees, contractors, and strategic partners. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, operational excellence, collaboration, and strong succession planning as the company’s business, technology footprint, and threat environment change.
  • Oversee the cybersecurity operating budget and investment portfolio, aligning resources with the company’s highest-priority risks and strategic objectives while demonstrating measurable improvements in risk reduction, resilience, operational effectiveness, and business enablement.
  • Provide strategic leadership while maintaining strong technical credibility across cloud platforms, enterprise infrastructure, data, identity, connected products, AI technologies, and emerging architectures.
  • Lead through influence and collaboration across Product, Engineering, IT, Infrastructure, Data, Legal, Privacy, and business leadership, building trusted partnerships that integrate security into technology and business decision-making.
  • Operate effectively at both executive and technical levels, advising the Board and executive leadership on strategy and risk, making timely risk-informed decisions during high-severity incidents and situations with incomplete information, and engaging deeply enough with architects, engineers, analysts, and product leaders to understand trade-offs and remove execution barriers.
  • Demonstrate a proven ability to advance mature security organizations, lead enterprise transformation, develop future leaders, and build high-performing teams that consistently deliver measurable business outcomes.

What you’ll need:

  • The ideal candidate is an accomplished cybersecurity executive who combines strategic vision with deep technical credibility, sound business judgment, and a collaborative leadership style. They will bring intellectual curiosity, a continuous learning mindset, and a demonstrated ability to advance mature security organizations as technologies and threats change. The successful candidate will have led cybersecurity programs in organizations with a scale, complexity, and risk profile comparable to SiriusXM, while effectively partnering with executive leadership and the Board to enable innovation, strengthen resilience, and manage enterprise risk.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth Engineering - Payments
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories, and music they love wherever they are.

 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

 

We are proud to have launched a new state-of-the-art technology facility in Dublin, Ireland. The Dublin-based team plays a critical role in our continued digital transformation and will function as a centre of excellence for SiriusXM’s global Product and Technology organization.

 

How you’ll make an impact:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Payments team within the Growth Engineering organization.
 The Payments domain is responsible for modernizing how SiriusXM manages payment information and payment processing across its commercial ecosystem, reducing PCI scope, simplifying platform architecture, and creating secure, scalable payment capabilities that can evolve independently of downstream payment providers.
 This team is responsible for building and operating the next generation of payment services that support payment tokenization, secure payment workflows, payment-provider integrations, and the architectural evolution required to reduce enterprise PCI scope.
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate secure, resilient payment services while partnering closely with Product Management, Principal Engineers, and Engineering leadership to deliver high-quality solutions in a complex and evolving problem space. You will contribute to technical discovery, solution shaping, and system design activities while helping ensure the systems we build remain scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable. 

What you’ll do:

● Design, build, operate, and evolve highly available services responsible for payment processing, tokenization, payment-provider integrations, and related commercial platform capabilities.
● Develop secure, scalable, and resilient distributed systems that support critical subscriber and revenue-generating workflows.
● Collaborate with engineers across Growth Engineering, Identity, Commerce, Platform, Data Engineering, and partner teams to deliver reliable end-to-end experiences.
● Participate in technical discovery, requirements refinement, and solution-shaping activities for new Payments domain capabilities.
● Contribute to the evolution of SiriusXM’s payments architecture, helping support initiatives focused on PCI scope reduction and service modernization.
● Drive software quality through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, testing strategies, and operational best practices.
● Investigate production issues, perform root cause analysis, and continuously improve system reliability, observability, performance, and operational readiness.
● Contribute to API and event contract design, ensuring services integrate cleanly and consistently across domains.
● Participate in architecture discussions and help shape the future evolution of SiriusXM’s Payments platform.
● Continuously learn and grow in your engineering craft and domain knowledge.
● Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure swift resolution of production issues involving your systems.

 

What you’ll need:

● 5+ years of professional experience.
● Experience building backend systems in JVM languages such as Scala, Java, or Kotlin; experience with Scala and functional programming paradigms is highly desirable.
● Experience leading the design, development, and operation of complex distributed systems in a modern cloud provider.
● Deep knowledge of REST API design, scalability, fault tolerance, and performance optimization.
● Demonstrated ability to own projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers.
● Significant experience with production infrastructure, observability, incident management, and operational support.
● Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, including source control, CI/CD, testing strategies, and operational readiness.
● Experience with contract-driven development approaches using technologies such as OpenAPI, Smithy, gRPC, or similar frameworks.● Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines and teams.

Preferred Qualifications:
● Experience building or operating payment systems, subscription billing platforms, PCI-regulated systems, tokenization services, or payment-provider integrations.
● Deep familiarity with AWS cloud services across compute, storage, containers, and serverless technologies.
● Experience working with event-driven architectures, streaming platforms, or asynchronous integration technologies.
● Experience with Scala and/or functional programming paradigms.
● Experience working across polyglot service environments, including services written in languages such as Go.

 

Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. ● Drive continuous improvement in engineering effectiveness, leveraging modern delivery practices, platform capabilities, and AI-enabled development workflows to improve developer productivity, software quality, and delivery outcomes.

job.title: Solutions Manager - The Orchard
job.description:
The Orchard have an exciting opening for a Solutions Manager to join us in the Johannesburg offices.

The Solutions Manager is responsible for the end-to-end operational onboarding of clients , content management, and synthesizing all back-office inquiries to resolve administrative and operational issues efficiently and accurately. 

You will serve as the primary client-facing representative for backend teams - including Legal, Finance, and Operations - this role ensures seamless account setups, catalog ingestions, and digital rights workflows.

You will work closely with the Relationship Management team and Operational Support. As Solutions Manager you will navigate complex technical platforms to advocate for client needs, maintain catalog integrity, and manage the full client lifecycle through offboarding.

The Orchard team meet in the office Monday- Thursday.  Most teams usually work remotely on Fridays.

What you'll do:

Client Onboarding & Lifecycle Management

  • Oversee end-to-end onboarding for new artists and labels, managing the path from contract signature and account setup to payment readiness, catalog ingestion, and distribution delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with the Relationship Team and Contract Admin during contract cutovers to guarantee smooth operational transitions.
  • Manage the complete client offboarding process when agreements expire or conclude, ensuring clean catalog handovers and system updates.

Administrative & Back-Office Representation

  • Act as the primary, client-facing liaison for internal back-office teams (Legal, Finance, Operations), addressing client inquiries, gathering feedback, and advocating for client needs.
  • Proactively lead client outreach regarding annual tax drills, royalty statement issues, and administrative legal/finance matters.
  • Resolve financial and account readiness questions, including payment release criteria and royalty statement clarifications.

Release Operations & Content Management

  • Advise clients on product logistics and oversee complex digital release setups tailored to specific label and campaign requirements.
  • Open, own, and resolve Concierge support threads in close coordination with Operations and Relationship Support teams.
  • Review, approve, and manage Tier 1 releases and resolve Content Review escalations across the assigned team roster.
  • Partner with Operations to execute content deletions, takedowns, price tier changes, territory/DSP availability updates, and overall digital catalog maintenance.
  • Manage video delivery workflows, including video release approvals, updates, copyright claims, and channel partnerships.

Technical Expertise & Compliance

  • Complete and maintain required platform certifications (YouTube, Label Management, Metadata tests) and demonstrate expert navigation of internal systems and DSP tools (Zendesk, Spotify Catalog Manager, Apple Music / iTunes Connect).
  • Work directly with the Claims team to engage clients on flagged content issues and resolve rights disputes.

Who you are:

  • Strong understanding of digital music distribution and the end-to-end release lifecycle, from contract onboarding and catalogue ingestion through delivery, maintenance and offboarding.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex client onboarding and account setup processes, including coordinating multiple internal stakeholders and ensuring payment and distribution readiness.
  • Strong understanding of music metadata, digital rights, ownership, territories, DSP availability and content delivery requirements, with a high level of attention to catalogue integrity.
  • Proven ability to manage back-office and operational workflows, including Legal, Finance, Operations, Claims and Contract Administration.
  • Strong technical aptitude and confidence navigating multiple platforms, systems and digital tools; experience with Zendesk, Spotify for Artists/Catalog Manager, Apple Music/iTunes Connect, YouTube CMS and similar platforms is advantageous.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex operational, technical and rights-related issues, identify root causes and drive solutions through to resolution.
  • Experience managing catalogue maintenance and digital rights workflows, including takedowns, deletions, territory restrictions, DSP availability and price-tier changes.
  • Strong understanding of content review, release approvals and quality-control processes, with the ability to make sound decisions while protecting catalogue and client interests.
  • Excellent client service and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex operational or technical issues into clear, practical guidance for clients.
  • Proven ability to act as a strong client advocate, balancing client needs with internal policies, contractual requirements and operational best practice.

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next 
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives 
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There’s also time off over winter break 

Equal Opportunities


As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.

We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.

Privacy Policy
