job.title: Vice President, Privacy, Business & Legal Affairs
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is seeking a Vice President, Privacy, Business & Legal Affairs to serve as a senior legal advisor on privacy, data protection, artificial intelligence, and emerging technology matters across the company's global operations. Reporting to the Associate International General Counsel and Chief Privacy Officer, this role will play a critical part in advancing Sony Music's privacy governance and compliance efforts while helping the business responsibly leverage data, technology, and innovation.

The Vice President will partner closely with senior leaders across Legal, Information Security, Product, Technology, Marketing, Corporate Development, and other business functions to navigate evolving legal and regulatory requirements, support strategic business initiatives, and manage privacy and technology-related risk in a rapidly changing environment.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business and functional leaders on privacy, data protection, artificial intelligence, and emerging technology matters, providing practical guidance that supports innovation while managing legal and regulatory risk.
  • Lead the implementation and ongoing enhancement of privacy compliance frameworks, policies, and governance processes to support compliance with applicable global privacy laws, regulatory requirements, and Sony Music standards.
  • Partner with product, technology, digital, marketing, and information security teams to review new products, services, data uses, and technology initiatives, ensuring privacy, AI, and data governance considerations are appropriately addressed throughout the business lifecycle.
  • Advise on the legal and regulatory implications of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and machine learning, and help develop responsible governance practices that align with business objectives and evolving regulatory expectations.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate privacy and data protection provisions in a wide range of commercial agreements, including technology, vendor, digital services, marketing, licensing, and strategic partnership arrangements.
  • Support mergers, acquisitions, investments, and other strategic transactions by advising on privacy, cybersecurity, and data governance considerations and working closely with transactional attorneys and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Monitor and assess developments in privacy, AI, digital regulation, and related areas, providing insights and recommendations to senior leadership regarding emerging risks, regulatory changes, and business impacts.
  • Support privacy-related audits, investigations, regulatory inquiries, compliance reporting, and enterprise risk management activities, while helping foster a culture of responsible data stewardship and accountability across the organization.
  • Collaborate with Sony Music legal teams globally, Sony Group privacy leaders, and external counsel to promote consistent approaches to privacy governance and compliance across jurisdictions.

Who you are:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Member of the New York Bar in good standing.
  • Significant experience advising on privacy, data protection, technology, digital media, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, or regulatory compliance matters in a law firm, multinational corporation, or similarly complex environment.
  • Deep understanding of global privacy laws, regulatory frameworks, and emerging developments related to artificial intelligence, data governance, and digital technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and partner effectively across highly matrixed organizations.
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to balance legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational considerations.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to independently lead complex matters and drive cross-functional alignment on high-impact business initiatives.
  • Solutions-oriented, intellectually curious, and highly collaborative, with a commitment to delivering practical legal advice that enables business growth and innovation.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

The anticipated annual base salary does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for.  The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.New York Pay Range$230,000—$260,000 USD

job.title: Backend Engineer - Media Streaming
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   SoundCloud is looking for a software engineer to join our Media Streaming Team, with a mission to operate a media streaming platform at global scale, delivering the best possible audio experience to creators, listeners, and partners alike. We are handling petabytes of data and gigabytes per second of traffic. You will join a tightly-knit team where you will help shape how millions of people experience music.  

Read about engineering at SoundCloud

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Contribute to building, scaling and maintaining backend APIs and services that serve millions of users
  • Collaborate closely with Android, iOS, web, and full-stack engineers to deliver seamless end-to-end media experiences
  • Ensure performance, scalability, and maintainability of SoundCloud’s services
  • Debug complex issues across systems, ensuring a consistent experience for users globally
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and roadmap planning
  • Be part of on-call rotation to ensure the reliability and availability of SoundCloud’s systems

Experience and Background:

  • 4+ years of experience in building and operating large-scale backend or distributed systems
  • Proficiency in Go
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform
  • Experience with cloud-native environments such as AWS or GCP
  • Experience with microservices, SQL/NoSQL databases, and container technologies
  • You care about the craft of software engineering: continuous delivery, defensive programming, automated testing, clean code principles
  • You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-moving environments
  • You bring a humble attitude, an eagerness to help your colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team succeed 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing APIs and backend services consumed by multiple client platforms
  • Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages
  • Knowledge of API communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL)
  • Exposure to media streaming, playback, audio engineering or adjacent domains
  • Familiarity with audio/video codecs, streaming protocols (HLS, DASH), and transport container technologies
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools and a strong intuition for their strengths, weaknesses, and emerging opportunities

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard.
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: Director - Internal Communications
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

SoundCloud is looking for a Director of Internal Communications to lead the strategy and execution of our global internal communications program. Based in New York, this role will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, helping employees understand SoundCloud’s business strategy, navigate change, and feel informed, engaged, and connected to our mission.  

Reporting to the Chief Communications Officer, you will shape how we communicate with employees across our global organization, translating complex business priorities into clear, compelling narratives, strengthening leadership communications, and fostering a culture of transparency, trust, and connection.

A significant priority will be leading the migration and launch of SoundCloud's next-generation intranet, establishing a modern, engaging digital office that serves as a central destination for company information, collaboration, and connection. You will oversee the initiative from strategy through implementation and adoption, partnering with stakeholders across People & Culture, IT, Brand, and other functions, and own the platform's ongoing communications strategy, content governance, and evolution.

As part of a lean, collaborative communications team, you will also have opportunities to contribute beyond internal communications, including supporting executive speaking engagements and other high-priority external communications initiatives as needed.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, exceptional storyteller, and trusted executive advisor who is equally comfortable developing high-level communications strategies and rolling up their sleeves to execute. You thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments, bring sound judgment and a collaborative mindset, and know how to turn complex challenges into clear, actionable communications.

This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days/week in our NYC office.

Key Responsibilities:

Internal Communications Strategy and Leadership

  • Develop and lead a comprehensive global internal communications strategy that connects employees to SoundCloud’s mission, business priorities, and strategic direction
  • Serve as a trusted communications advisor to senior executives and functional leaders, providing strategic counsel on leadership messaging, sensitive issues, organizational developments, and employee engagement
  • Translate complex business strategies, decisions, and organizational changes into clear, compelling, and actionable narratives that build understanding, alignment, and trust
  • Proactively identify communications opportunities and risks, recommending strategies that strengthen transparency, employee confidence, and organizational effectiveness
  • Lead communications planning and execution for major company initiatives, organizational changes, and other high-priority business developments

Executive Communications and Employee Engagement

  • Partner closely with Chief of Staff and executive leadership to plan and produce company-wide communications and employee forums, including monthly All Hands, executive AMAs, and other leadership engagement opportunities, owning agenda development, content creation, speaker coordination, and event execution
  • Develop executive messaging, talking points, presentations, and other materials that help leaders communicate authentically, consistently, and effectively with employees
  • Create opportunities for meaningful two-way dialogue between employees and leadership, strengthening transparency, engagement, and trust
  • Partner with People & Culture, DEI, Talent Acquisition, and Workplace teams to develop communications that amplify employee initiatives, foster inclusion, and strengthen engagement and connection across the organization 

Intranet Strategy, Migration and Management

  • Lead the end-to-end migration, launch, and adoption of SoundCloud’s next-generation intranet overseeing the strategic roadmap, cross-functional coordination, content strategy, and change-management approach
  • Serve as the central program lead for a cross-functional working group, establishing clear governance, responsibilities, milestones, and accountability to ensure successful delivery
  • Partner with technical and business stakeholders to ensure the platform meets employee needs and aligns with SoundCloud's brand, security, accessibility, and operational requirements
  • Own the intranet's ongoing editorial strategy, content governance, employee adoption, and continuous improvement, ensuring it remains an engaging, reliable, and effective communications channel

Communications Channels & Effectiveness

  • Oversee SoundCloud's internal communications channels and editorial calendar, ensuring employees receive timely, relevant, and consistent information across global offices
  • Develop engaging, high-quality content across formats and channels, including written communications, presentations, video, and digital experiences
  • Establish and track meaningful metrics to evaluate communications effectiveness, employee engagement, and channel performance, using insights and feedback to continuously improve strategy and execution
  • Stay ahead of emerging trends and best practices in internal communications, employee engagement, and workplace technology, proactively recommend new approaches and innovations to strengthen communication effectiveness 

Employer Branding, Industry Recognition and Cross-Functional Communications

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and People & Culture to strengthen SoundCloud's employer brand through strategic storytelling, employee advocacy, and external platforms such as LinkedIn and Glassdoor
  • Identify and manage opportunities to elevate SoundCloud, its executives, and employees through relevant industry awards and recognition programs, including developing compelling nominations and coordinating submissions
  • Collaborate closely with the broader Communications team to ensure alignment between internal and external messaging, particularly around major company announcements and strategic initiatives
  • Provide support for high-priority external communications initiatives as needed, including staffing executive speaking engagements, coordinating with event organizers, preparing briefing materials, and supporting executives on-site

Experience and Background:

  • 8+ years of experience in internal communications within a global company or agency environment, with demonstrated experience developing and executing strategies that support business priorities, organizational alignment, and employee engagement
  • Demonstrated experience leading a large-scale intranet implementation, migration, or digital workplace transformation involving multiple business and technical functions, including content governance, change management, and employee adoption
  • Strong program and project-management skills, including experience establishing governance, coordinating complex workstreams, managing competing priorities, and holding stakeholders accountable to deadlines
  • Experience leading change-management and employee-adoption programs for new platforms, systems, or ways of working, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and evolving business priorities
  • Ability to translate business, technical, security, and employee-experience requirements into a clear strategy and executable plan
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across cultures, functions, and levels of seniority
  • Proven ability to serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives, providing strategic communications counsel, guidance, and constructive feedback on complex or sensitive matters
  • Exceptional storytelling, writing, editing, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex business information into clear, engaging, and impactful communications
  • Experience developing executive communications and producing high-impact leadership events, including All Hands meetings, town halls, and employee engagement forums
  • Exceptional design and branding acumen, with experience developing presentations, videos, and creative collateral
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail, with a demonstrated ability to drive initiatives from strategy through execution
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, adapt quickly, and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven ability to build alignment, navigate differing stakeholder perspectives, influence without direct authority, and move complex cross-functional initiatives forward
  • Experience using data, analytics, and employee feedback to assess communications effectiveness, measure engagement, and continuously improve programs and channels
  • Strong understanding of internal communications channels, digital workplace platforms, and emerging communications technologies and practices
  • A proactive, resourceful, and hands-on approach, with the flexibility to contribute across internal and external communications priorities within a lean team
  • Willingness and ability to support executive speaking engagements and select external communications initiatives, including occasional travel as needed

The salary range for this role is $160,000- $175,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. job.title: Part-Time Promotions Assistant
job.description:
Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc.

Job Title: Part-Time Promotions Assistant

Reports To: Marketing & Promotions Manager

Position Type: Part-time

Location: San Jose, CA

 


About the Role:

The Promotions Assistant plays a vital role in supporting the marketing and promotional efforts within the Information and Media Services industry. This position is responsible for assisting in the development, coordination, and execution of promotional campaigns that enhance brand visibility and audience engagement. The ideal candidate will work closely with the marketing team to manage promotional materials, track campaign performance, and liaise with external partners and vendors. By ensuring smooth operational support and timely delivery of promotional activities, the Promotions Assistant contributes directly to the growth and success of the organization’s media presence. This role requires a proactive individual who can manage multiple tasks efficiently while maintaining attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality.


Because this position requires the operation of Company and station vehicles, candidates must possess a valid driver’s license and authorize SBS to obtain a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) as part of the pre-employment screening process. Any offer of employment will be contingent upon the candidate having an acceptable driving record and receiving approval to operate Company vehicles under SBS’s applicable insurance requirements. The employee must maintain a valid driver’s license and continued insurability throughout employment in this position.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of marketing principles and promotional strategies.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in the Information and Media Services industry or a related marketing environment.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing tools and social media platforms.
  • Knowledge of graphic design software such as Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Experience with event coordination and vendor management.
  • Ability to analyze marketing data and generate reports.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the planning and execution of promotional campaigns across various media platforms.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to produce and distribute promotional materials.
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of promotional activities and suggest improvements.
  • Maintain accurate records of promotional schedules, budgets, and inventory of marketing collateral.
  • Support event planning and on-site promotional activities as needed to maximize audience engagement.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Employee benefits are available for this position subject to meeting eligibility requirements.

Skills:

The Promotions Assistant utilizes strong organizational and communication skills daily to coordinate promotional campaigns and collaborate effectively with team members and external partners. Proficiency in Microsoft Office enables the creation and management of schedules, reports, and presentations that support campaign tracking and decision-making. Familiarity with digital marketing tools and social media platforms allows the assistant to contribute to online promotional efforts and audience engagement strategies. Knowledge of graphic design software is beneficial for assisting in the development of visually appealing marketing materials. Analytical skills are applied to monitor campaign performance and provide actionable insights that enhance future promotional activities.

job.title: Senior Marketing Manager, Mobile (Remote US)
job.description:
WHO WE ARE:  

Splice is a creative platform for people who make music. Serious producers choose Splice Sounds to bring their ideas to life. A subscription to Splice inspires and accelerates creative success for digital music creators with an industry-leading catalog of sounds and samples and an expanding AI stack. With a rent-to-own marketplace of DAWs and plugins, the Splice experience seamlessly integrates into any music production workflow, regardless of DAW (Digital Audio Workstation). Via Splice, an unparalleled team of sound designers and sample creators are fueling the success of a growing global community of chart-topping producers, students, and DIY creators.

HOW WE WORK:  

At Splice, DISCO is a rallying cry for collaboration, accountability, and unity within our organization; Direct, Inclusive, Splice Together, Creator Centric, and Optimistic. Our shared success depends on our ability to support one another, work well together, and communicate directly. By embracing flexibility and a unified approach, we can navigate anything that’s thrown at us.

Splice embraces a culture of remote work. You’ll see your colleagues showing up from across the US and the UK. In order to keep us working well as a team, we have regular communication, including Town Halls, departmental all-hands and get-togethers.

When you join Splice, you join a network of colleagues, peers, and collaborators. Are you ready?

Senior Marketing Manager, Mobile


LOCATION: Remote

THE ROLE:

In this role, you will be the primary marketing owner of our positioning, strategy, and execution across the full marketing funnel including user acquisition, activation, retention, and reporting. We are looking for a hands-on leader to move fast, make decisions with data, and efficiently grow the app's user base while optimizing for profitable LTV/CAC ratios.

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

  • Set the growth strategy. Define the model, targets, and channel mix that take the app to its user and revenue goals, and own the growth roadmap and budget.
  • Scale acquisition. Build efficient paid (Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, Google UAC), organic, ASO, referral, influencer, and partnership channels, with clear CAC and payback targets.
  • Improve activation. Work with Product and Design to shorten time-to-value in onboarding and lift the share of installs that become active users.
  • Drive retention and engagement. Own lifecycle marketing (push, email, in-app messaging) and the cohort analysis that shows where users drop off and why.
  • Grow monetization. Partner with Product on paywall, pricing, and subscription experiments that raise conversion and LTV.
  • Run an experimentation program. Keep a prioritized backlog, a weekly test cadence, and a clear set of targets that define success.
  • Own measurement. Work with data to set up attribution (MMP, SKAN, incrementality), build trusted growth dashboards, and share results, progress, learnings, and next steps to the company and leadership team.
  • Lead competitive intelligence. Use a variety of analytics tools to monitor and manage competitive strategy and how we win across geos and platforms.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5-7+ years in growth or performance marketing, ideally at a consumer mobile app.
  • A record of scaling mobile app installs and revenue that map to strong CAC, payback, retention, and LTV targets.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of mobile paid channels and attribution, including MMPs and SKAdNetwork-era measurement.
  • Strong analytical skills: you're comfortable in SQL or BI tools and can design and read an A/B test without help.
  • Experience with lifecycle and retention programs, including push and in-app messaging.
  • Clear communication and the judgment to prioritize projects, define targets, and allocate budget appropriately.
  • Experience managing a monthly marketing budget to strict CAC and LTV targets including scale-sequencing as growth levers are identified.
  • Experience managing agencies and/or contractors that may be needed along the way to achieve our ambitious goals.

 

NICE TO HAVES: 

  • Experience with subscription or freemium apps, including paywall and pricing tests.
  • Background in product-led growth, referral loops, or community-driven acquisition.
  • Experience at an early-stage startup, building growth from a small base.
  • Familiarity and connection with the music creation market.

The national pay range for this role is $118,893 - $148,616. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience.

job.title: Accounting Analyst, Content Accounting
job.description: Our Global Content Accounting Operations team makes sure the songwriters behind the music on Spotify are accurately accounted for and paid, everywhere in the world. Reporting to the Manager of Content Accounting, you’ll support songwriter royalty accounting globally and partner closely with Legal, Licensing, Technical Accounting, and Engineering. You’ll also help shape what comes next: rolling out claiming processes in new territories as Spotify expands, finding new ways to show the accounting impact of business decisions, steering updates to our claiming systems, and streamlining month-end close in a fast-growing region.

job.title: Associate Artist Label Partnerships Manager, South Korea
job.description:
Spotify’s Artist & Label Partnerships (ALP) team works with artists, managers, record labels and distributors to help artists grow their audiences and connect with fans.

As an Associate Artist & Label Partnerships Manager on the Korea Music team, you’ll manage relationships with selected partners and lead campaigns that help Korean artists reach more listeners at home and around the world. You’ll work with artist and label teams to understand their goals and turn them into opportunities for fans to discover and engage with their music.

job.title: Associate Director, Music Policy, Spotify for Artists
job.description:
We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions. 

The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

job.title: Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
job.description:
At Spotify, our Subscriptions mission helps make the subscription experience seamless and reliable for millions of listeners around the world. We're building the technology that supports subscribers throughout their journey, from their first purchase to renewals, plan changes, and beyond.

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join Rover, the team responsible for Spotify's core subscription system. Our services manage the lifecycle of every Spotify subscription, including activation, renewals, plan changes, grace periods, and cancellations.

You'll help build and improve the backend services and data systems that millions of subscribers depend on. Whether you're growing your engineering experience or looking for a new technical challenge, you'll have opportunities to learn, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact on Spotify's subscription experience.

job.title: Demand Generation & Campaign Operations Manager
job.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

You run our websites, search, webinars and email across the Spotify Technology portfolio. Your job is to bring people into the funnel and move them through it: from finding us in search or at a webinar, to signing up, to becoming an active user, to a meeting with sales. You also own the numbers. Every week you tell the team what’s working, what isn’t and what we’re changing. You work AI-first, you know our martech stack inside out, and you use the newest features of both.

job.title: Demand Generation & Campaign Operations Manager
job.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. You also own the numbers. Every week you tell the team what’s working, what isn’t and what we’re changing. You work AI-first, you know our martech stack inside out, and you use the newest features of both.

job.title: Editor, UK & Ireland
job.description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify’s end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.

Editorial UK & Ireland sits at the heart of the listener experience on Spotify. We reflect culture and drive artist discovery through playlists, storytelling formats, and tools, with a focus on new music. As our Pop Editor, you’ll bring deep cultural expertise and a data-informed approach to shape how millions of people discover music across playlists, video, and other parts of the app.

job.title: Head of Advertising Business Development, New York
job.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 
Reporting to the VP of Advertising and Commercial Partnerships, you'll own deal architecture end to end. That means deciding which partners we pursue and why alongside cross-functional and strategy leaders, structuring and negotiating the deals, and making sure every partnership is commercially ready to drive revenue once signed.

job.title: Manager, International Audiobook Licensing & Partnerships
job.description:
At Spotify, we’re building a thriving audiobook ecosystem that connects authors and publishers with listeners around the world.

As our audiobook business expands into new markets, we’re looking for someone to grow our international publisher portfolio. You’ll build relationships with publishers of all sizes, help them bring their catalogues to Spotify, and shape scalable ways to onboard and support them. Your goal is to make Spotify a trusted home for publishers audiobooks, combining a welcoming partner experience with sustainable commercial growth.

job.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
job.description:
The Subscriptions Mission builds and scales the products, platforms, and business models that turn free listeners into lifelong Premium subscribers. We focus on attracting new subscribers, improving conversion and retention, and creating seamless commerce experiences that support Spotify's growth and bring fans closer to the creators they love.

At Spotify, subscription data helps shape the decisions and experiences behind our 700M+ monthly active users and 290M+ Premium subscribers. You'll join a collaborative team building the backend systems that power merchandising, personalized experiences, and subscription journeys at a global scale. Your work will help listeners discover the value of Premium and give them more reasons to stay.

job.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Agentic Products
job.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Generative AI is changing what Spotify’s products can do and how they’re built. When listeners can describe what they want in natural language, our products can meet more needs and build richer connections between listeners and the things they love. As Senior Engineering Manager for Agentic Products, you’ll lead multiple teams that prototype, design, and build Spotify’s consumer-facing AI products, and you’ll set technical strategy in a fast-moving space alongside partners across the company.

job.title: Senior Product Manager - Free and Premium Conversion
job.description:
Hundreds of millions of people come to Spotify to listen for free. Our ambition is to make that experience great while helping listeners discover the value of Premium. Getting that balance right is one of the most important opportunities for Spotify's continued growth.

The Freemium Funnel team shapes the journey from Free listening to Premium subscription and beyond. We bring together Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Research, and Marketing to understand what listeners value, remove barriers to conversion, and create experiences that make Premium a compelling choice.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Free and Conversion Surfaces team. You'll shape how listeners engage with Spotify Free, discover Premium, make the decision to subscribe, and experience their first moments as paying subscribers. From Premium education to conversion experiences and early retention, you'll work on meaningful product challenges that directly influence Spotify's growth.

This is an opportunity to think strategically, build at scale, and turn complex challenges into simple, engaging experiences that work for both our listeners and our business.

job.title: Studio & Project Manager
job.description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.

The Artist & Label Partnerships team (ALP) is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels and distributors across Sweden. We're looking for a Studio & Project Manager to make our Stockholm studio a place where artists, labels and fans connect, turning the stories behind artists and releases into sessions, video and formats that reach the next generation of listeners. You'll lead the studio and its projects with support from the wider ALP team, and project manage selected ALP initiatives so key partners see Spotify as their number one partner.

job.title: Tax Manager - Transfer Pricing [Analytics, Models & AI]
job.description: We’re looking for a Tax Manager to join Spotify’s Global Transfer Pricing team, reporting to the Director of Global Transfer Pricing. In this role you’ll focus on analytics, modelling and AI. You’ll drive the development of Spotify’s global transfer pricing models and economic analyses, keeping our intercompany pricing accurate, efficient and defensible in every jurisdiction where we operate. You’ll also help lead the team’s use of AI tools and automation to change how transfer pricing work gets done, from forecasting and projections to audit support. You’ll join a team of skilled, dedicated colleagues in a fast-moving international company, with plenty of room to take on responsibility. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

job.title: Client Strategy Leader, Enterprise AI Solutions
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell (NASDAQ: STGW) is the challenger network built to transform marketing. Founded in 2015 by Mark Penn with backing from former Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer, Stagwell grew from launch to nearly $3 billion in revenue in ten years ($2.9 billion in 2025). Today 13,000+ employees across 70+ agencies in more than 40 countries serve 4,500+ clients, including some of the world's most recognized brands.

Mark, our Chairman and CEO, has spent five decades at the intersection of data, technology, and strategy. He was Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer of Microsoft, CEO of the global communications firm Burson-Marsteller, co-founder of the polling firm Penn Schoen, a presidential pollster and strategist, and author of the bestselling Microtrends. Under his leadership, Stagwell is leaning hard into AI: through Stagwell AI, we build agentic AI solutions that connect data, intelligence, and execution for the world's most ambitious brands.

Agentic AI will change the marketing profession. AI agents that research, plan, create, launch, and optimize alongside marketers will let brands move faster and spend smarter. It is one of the fastest-growing categories in technology (Gartner projects agentic AI software spending will approach $1 trillion by 2030), and marketing is one of the functions where AI is expected to create the most value. Stagwell is building for it: in January 2026 we launched The Machine, which we call marketing's first agentic operating system, and our Machines reach the world's largest brands through Stagwell's agencies and clients.

Stagwell AI is seeking a client-focused, commercially minded Client Strategy Leader, Enterprise AI Solutions to lead how our clients adopt, get value from, and grow with the Machines, our AI-powered marketing solutions. You will join Stagwell's Enterprise AI Solutions go-to-market organization, a new Stagwell-level team that sells the Machines across Stagwell's agencies, clients, and partners. We start with a small founding team in every function and scale on what the data shows works.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the SVP, Enterprise AI Solutions. At launch there is no separate implementation team: you and your customer success managers own go-live, adoption, value realization, and first-line support. You will run the first go-lives personally, and build account strategies with Account Executives and agency client leads that turn a first Machine into a multi-Machine program.

Responsibilities

  • Own the post-sale journey: onboarding, go-live, adoption, value reviews, and renewal readiness.
  • Run the first go-lives personally while building and coaching the customer success team.
  • Build customer success plans, health scores, and playbooks for each Machine.
  • Lead executive business reviews that show measurable outcomes and return on investment.
  • Build account growth plans with Account Executives and agency client leads: which Machine comes next, for which team, and when; hand expansion opportunities to the AE and partner on renewals.
  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, agency delivery teams, and the existing Machine teams on implementation and support.
  • Turn customer feedback into product priorities with Product and Engineering.
  • Report on adoption, account health, and retention to leadership.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in customer success, client strategy, account management, or client services for B2B technology, including team leadership.
  • Experience owning onboarding, implementation coordination, adoption, and renewals for enterprise clients.
  • Track record of improving retention and showing measurable customer outcomes.
  • Builds trusted relationships with senior executives and day-to-day practitioners.
  • Strong analytical and project management skills.
  • Commercial acumen for renewals and expansion.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in SaaS, AI, marketing technology, advertising, or media.
  • Supported customers adopting generative or agentic AI.
  • Built a customer success function from scratch, using platforms such as Gainsight or Planhat.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like 

  • On-time go-lives: New customers go live on schedule without a separate implementation team.
  • Faster time to value: Customers reach their first measurable outcome quickly.
  • Retention and growth: Clients renew and add Machines, with expansion plans agreed with the AE and agency team.
  • A clear health view: Leadership has a reliable view of adoption and account health.

 

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation for this role is $300K OTE (60/40). Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

Required Skills

  • 8+ years in revenue, sales, or commercial operations, including 3+ years leading people.
  • Hands-on with CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, or ServiceNow) and sales technology.
  • Built forecasting models, territory and quota plans, and sales compensation plans.
  • Experience leading sales enablement, deal desk, or analytics teams.
  • Strong analytical, project management, and change management skills.
  • Clear communicator who can influence senior leaders across functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in marketing services, advertising, media, or a multi-business-unit organization.
  • Applied AI and automation to forecasting, reporting, or enablement.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Ready on day one: The CRM, scorecard, quotas, and comp plans are live before the first sellers start.
  • A forecast you can trust: Accurate pipeline and forecast data every week.
  • Enablement that sticks: Sellers and agency teams are certified and ramp on schedule.
  • Decisions on data: Scale-up decisions rest on clear conversion, win-rate, and capacity data.

job.title: Director, Travel & Expense (T&E) Procurement
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell empowers talented, passionate, and creative leaders with vision to deliver breakthrough ideas on behalf of the world’s most ambitious clients.We believe that the differences among us fuel innovation and drive us to achieve extraordinary results. We take great pride in a work force with rich diversity of age, race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, sexual orientation, ability and background. As a network, we seek out a skilled and dynamic talent pipeline, invest in programs that help develop diverse talent for the future benefit of our industry, and strive to build an inclusive environment where all employees can bring their full selves to work.Creating a collaborative environment at our state-of-the-art campuses, where we can bring people together at the office to inspire and innovate, is central to our culture-moving creative edge. We believe that by being together, we can transform marketing. Join us at www.stagwellglobal.com. 

Overview

The Director, Travel & Expense (T&E) Procurement, will be a key leader within the Global Operations team, reporting directly to the VP of Global Procurement. This individual will be responsible for developing and executing the global sourcing strategy for enterprise-wide travel & expense programs. This role owns supplier strategy, commercial negotiations, policy governance, stakeholder engagement, and program performance across key categories including air, hotel, ground transportation, travel management services, expense management platforms, and corporate card programs. 

 

This person will partner closely with Finance, HR, Tax, Treasury, Legal & IT, and business leaders across Stagwell Global to deliver best-in-class traveler experience while optimizing total cost of ownership, supplier performance, compliance, and risk management. This leader will drive strategic initiatives that support operational excellence, policy & program adoption across the Travel & Expense ecosystem. 

Responsibilities

Category Strategy & Leadership 

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive global sourcing strategy for Travel & Expense categories.

  • Establish short and long term category roadmaps aligned with corporate objectives and business growth plans.

  • Continuously assess market trends, supplier innovations, industry benchmarks, and emerging technologies to identify value creation opportunities.

  • Lead strategic sourcing initiatives and enterprise wide procurement projects supporting business priorities. 

Supplier Management & Strategic Sourcing 

  • Direct competitive sourcing events, contract negotiations, and supplier selection processes.

  • Manage strategic relationships with:  

    • Travel Management Companies (TMCs)

    • Airlines

    • Hotel chains

    • Ground transportation providers

    • Corporate card issuers

    • Expense management software providers

    • Meetings and events partners 

  • Establish supplier governance frameworks, scorecards, and business review processes.

  • Identify and implement supplier consolidation, optimization, and cost reduction opportunities. 

Travel Program Management 

  • Oversee the organization's travel program, policies, and preferred supplier agreements.

  • Partner with business leaders to balance cost management, traveler satisfaction, duty of care, and operational effectiveness.

  • Drive traveler adoption of preferred channels and compliance with company policy.

  • Lead initiatives related to traveler experience, sustainability, and digital travel solutions. 

Expense & Payment Program Management 

  • Manage procurement support for expense management platforms and corporate card programs.

  • Collaborate with Finance and Treasury to optimize payment solutions, incentive programs, and controls.

  • Drive compliance with expense policies and identify opportunities for process simplification and automation.

  • Support reporting and analytics to improve employee experience and expense visibility. 

 

Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Serve as the primary procurement advisor for senior executives and key functional stakeholders.

  • Build trusted partnerships across Finance, HR, IT, Treasury, Tax, Legal and Internal Audit.

  • Facilitate governance committees and executive reviews related to travel and expense programs.

  • Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations and business cases. 

Financial Performance & Analytics 

  • Deliver annual productivity, cost savings, and value creation targets.

  • Develop KPIs and dashboards to measure program effectiveness, supplier performance, compliance, and traveler satisfaction.

  • Monitor category spend, market conditions, and supplier economics to optimize commercial outcomes.

  • Leverage analytics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. 

Risk Management & Compliance 

  • Ensure supplier contracts comply with legal, regulatory, data privacy, and security requirements.

  • Partner with Risk Management and Security teams to support traveler safety and duty-of-care programs.

  • Maintain strong internal controls and audit readiness.

  • Monitor geopolitical, operational, and supplier risks that may impact business continuity. 

Team Leadership 

  • Lead, coach, and develop supporting roles.

job.title: Manager, Revenue Operations
job.description:
About Us

The Marketing Cloud (TMC) is Stagwell's technology division, bringing together marketing technology, media intelligence, AI-driven products, and data solutions that help brands better understand audiences and drive growth.

Overview

The Marketing Cloud is seeking a Manager, Revenue Operations to join a team focused on leveraging financial data to help the business scale.  This is a senior position responsible for creating a predictable, scalable, and data-driven revenue engine across Sales, Marketing, and Finance teams supporting a dozen differentiated global brands. The role will build and lead the systems, processes, and insights that power our growing revenue organization. The role will partner with sales leadership across the company to provide timely, fact-based, data-driven decision support to help drive critical revenue decisions supporting our mandate for growth at all costs. This includes forecasting, territory and quota planning, pipeline management, reporting, systems, new product roadmaps, process optimization, and cross-functional GTM planning.  This is a forward-looking team.  We support a global business with a diverse product set and go to market strategy.  The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced and consistently evolving environment.  This role requires an ability to build close working relationships with stakeholders across the business.  A revenue first mindset and constant focus on driving growth and long-term scale is expected, along with a strategic and hands-on approach dynamic enough to establish best practice, bring together disparate data, and handle ad hoc requests with ease.  Excellent communication skills and an ability to work within a global organization are required.  This is a unique opportunity to build processes, take ownership, and make an immediate impact while growing alongside the business.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with C-level and Sales leadership across our brands to develop strategies for scaling the revenue organization, introducing new products and services to market, pricing, packaging, and new monetization opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to improve revenue growth, productivity, and retention through data and operational insights
  • Develop forecasting methodologies, pipeline coverage models, and performance benchmarks
  • Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, sales cycles, win rates, churn, retention, and expansion
  • Identify risks and opportunities within the revenue funnel and proactively recommend actions
  • Establish a single source of truth for pipeline, forecast, and revenue reporting
  • Build and mature scalable processes, playbooks, and workflows across the revenue lifecycle
  • Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and implement solutions that improve conversion, productivity, and time-to-close
  • Drive consistent process adoption across Sales teams
  • Continuously assess whether existing systems and tools are effectively supporting the needs of the business
  • Build scalable infrastructure that can support continued growth and scale
  • Build dashboards, reporting, and analytical models for Sales and executive leadership
  • Translate complex data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations
  • Develop reporting that enables leaders to understand performance, identify trends, and make better decisions
  • Ensure leadership has a clear understanding of the health and trajectory of the pipeline
  • Deeply understand and effectively communicate the business to internal and external stakeholders
  • Use our tools and systems to streamline processes, improve visibility and understanding, and increase team efficiency
  • Identify, develop, implement, and champion financial and non-financial KPIs that are tangible to the business

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of progressive Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or FP&A experience, ideally at a global, technology focused, Rule of 40 company
  • Experience building or significantly scaling a RevOps organization, ideally in a growth-stage company
  • Proven experience with forecasting, revenue planning, territory design, quota setting, pipeline management, and GTM analytics
  • Experience in varied forecasting ERPs (Salesforce, Hubspot, OneStream, and Maconomy a plus)
  • Demonstrated history of working with C-level, board, or senior leadership teams
  • Keen attention to detail and financial data accuracy
  • Strong analytical, financial, and data modeling skills
  • Experience using data and technology to improve revenue performance and operational efficiency
  • A growth mindset

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation for this role is a base of $140K. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

job.description:

job.title: Regional VP, Sales, Enterprise AI Solutions
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell (NASDAQ: STGW) is the challenger network built to transform marketing. Founded in 2015 by Mark Penn with backing from former Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer, Stagwell grew from launch to nearly $3 billion in revenue in ten years ($2.9 billion in 2025). Today 13,000+ employees across 55+ agencies in more than 40 countries serve 4,500+ clients, including some of the world's most recognized brands.

Mark, our Chairman and CEO, has spent five decades at the intersection of data, technology, and strategy. He was Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer of Microsoft, CEO of the global communications firm Burson-Marsteller, co-founder of the polling firm Penn Schoen, a presidential pollster and strategist, and author of the bestselling Microtrends. Under his leadership, Stagwell is leaning hard into AI: through Stagwell AI, we build agentic AI solutions that connect data, intelligence, and execution for the world's most ambitious brands.

The Opportunity

Agentic AI will change the marketing profession. AI agents that research, plan, create, launch, and optimize alongside marketers will let brands move faster and spend smarter. It is one of the fastest-growing categories in technology (Gartner projects agentic AI software spending will approach $1 trillion by 2030), and marketing is one of the functions where AI is expected to create the most value. Stagwell is building for it: in January 2026 we launched The Machine, which we call marketing's first agentic operating system, and our Machines reach the world's largest brands through Stagwell's agencies and clients.

Stagwell AI is seeking a hands-on, coaching-focused RVP of Sales, Enterprise AI Solutions to lead a team of Account Executives who sell the Machines, our AI-powered marketing solutions, to Stagwell's largest clients and to new companies. You will join Stagwell's Enterprise AI Solutions go-to-market organization, a new Stagwell-level team that sells the Machines across Stagwell's agencies, clients, and partners. We start with a small founding team in every function and scale on what the data shows works.

This is a first-line, player-coach sales leadership role reporting to the SVP, Enterprise AI Solutions. You will directly manage a team of about 8 individual contributors: Account Executives for strategic accounts (Stagwell's largest clients) and New Logo (companies not yet Stagwell clients), plus business development representatives. You will work closely with the partnership manager and the sales leaders for agency accounts, join key deals, and carry some personally while the team ramps.

Responsibilities

  • Own your team's pipeline, forecast, and annual contract value target; run weekly deal and forecast reviews.
  • Hire, onboard, and coach your Account Executives and BDRs through ramp to full productivity.
  • Keep account ownership and coverage clear for every seller, working with RevOps on territories and credit rules.
  • Join key deals: discovery, executive meetings, proposals, negotiation, and close.
  • Work with agency teams on co-selling, with Stagwell's growth team on direct pitches, and with the partnership manager on partner deals.
  • Coach on account planning, consultative selling, and deal strategy; inspect activity and pipeline every week.
  • Feed win/loss insight back into our ICP, personas, use cases, and messaging.

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation for this role is $450K - 500K OTE (50/50 split). Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

Required Skills

  • 7+ years of B2B enterprise sales, including 2+ years managing or coaching quota-carrying sellers.
  • Track record of leading teams that meet or exceed targets through new logos, cross-sell, and strategic account growth.
  • Experience selling B2B technology, SaaS, AI, or marketing technology to senior marketing and technology buyers.
  • Strong forecasting, pipeline management, and negotiation skills.
  • Proven ability to recruit, coach, and retain high-performing Account Executives.
  • Entrepreneurial, and comfortable building the playbook while running it.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Sold alongside partners, channels, or agencies as well as directly.
  • Background in advertising, media, or marketing services, with senior client and agency relationships.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Revenue: The team meets or exceeds its annual contract value target.
  • Ramp: New Account Executives and BDRs are hired, certified, and closing on schedule.
  • Machine adoption: More Stagwell clients, brands, and business units buy and expand the Machines.
  • Predictable pipeline: A reliable forecast and healthy coverage for strategic and New Logo accounts.

job.title: Senior Manager, Indirect Procurement
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell empowers talented, passionate, and creative leaders with vision to deliver breakthrough ideas on behalf of the world's most ambitious clients.We believe that the differences among us fuel innovation and drive us to achieve extraordinary results. We take great pride in a workforce with rich diversity of age, race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, sexual orientation, ability and background. As a network, we seek out a skilled and dynamic talent pipeline, invest in programs that help develop diverse talent for the future benefit of our industry, and strive to build an inclusive environment where all employees can bring their full selves to work.Creating a collaborative environment at our state-of-the-art campuses, where we can bring people together at the office to inspire and innovate, is central to our culture-moving creative edge. We believe that by being together, we can transform marketing. Join us at www.stagwellglobal.com.

Overview

The Senior Manager, Indirect Procurement is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies across General & Administrative (G&A) spend categories to optimize cost, mitigate risk, improve supplier performance, and support business objectives. This role reports to the VP, Global procurement and partners closely with functional leaders across Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Business Applications, and other corporate functions to deliver strategic procurement solutions and measurable business value. 

 

The successful candidate will lead sourcing initiatives, manage strategic supplier relationships, negotiate complex commercial agreements, and drive continuous improvement opportunities across the indirect procurement portfolio. This role requires strong business acumen, stakeholder management capabilities, and the ability to influence decisions across a diverse set of functional partners. 

Responsibilities

  • Category Strategy & Execution: As key member of the procurement team you will have an opportunity to shape the category strategy across the Stagwell network, driving initiatives that ensure businesses have the right tools, services, and resources at the best possible value.

  • Contractual Organization: Ownership of category contractual life cycle management across MSA, Pricing, Enterprise and other agreements collaborating with Legal, Finance, Brand CFOs and other cross functional departments to ensure contracts are optimized, compliant, and effectively structured to meet the needs of Stagwell’s global network.

  • Vendor Management & Negotiations: Develop and maintain relationships with key vendors, ensuring quality service delivery, owning the state of the partnership, via continuous improvement and risk mitigation. Negotiate favorable terms and pricing based on an in-depth understanding of business needs and spend data.

  • Spend Analysis & Reporting: Work closely with FP&A, Business Applications and ERP teams to track and analyze category spend across all areas of the business. Use data to identify opportunities for cost optimization, strategic sourcing and consolidation.

  • Tool & Product Knowledge: Gain an in-depth understanding of the category tools, products, and services used by Stagwell businesses, collaborating with internal stakeholders to identify gaps, needs, and opportunities to improve operations.

  • Process Improvement: Partner with VP, Global Procurement to assess and improve procurement processes that enhance efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and service quality. This will include but not limited to; Honing operational needs, reporting, dashboards, initiative tracking, tools, communication and data gathering. 

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, or related field.

  • 5 - 10+ years of procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management experience.

  • Demonstrated success leading strategic sourcing initiatives and supplier negotiations including but not limited to large-scale software, cloud and technology agreements.

  • Experience managing indirect or G&A spend categories.  

  • Strong analytical, financial, and commercial acumen.  

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.  

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and complex stakeholder environments. 

Preferred 

  • Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPSD, C.P.M., CSCP, or equivalent.

  • Experience supporting a global, multinational organization.

  • Experience using sourcing, contract management, and spend analytics platforms.

  • Knowledge of software asset management, FinOps, cloud economics, and third-party risk management practices. 

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation for this role is $110,000–150,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:

We are looking for a skilled Account Executive to find business opportunities and manage customer relationships. You’ll be directly responsible for the preservation and expansion of our customer base. The ideal candidate will have a passion for sales and experience in media and digital advertising with exceptional customer service. The right candidate is a reliable professional able to achieve a balance between customer orientation and a results-driven approach. The goal is to find opportunities and turn them into long-term profitable relationships based on trust and mutual satisfaction.

  • Present products & capabilities to prospective clients

  • Provide professional post-sales support to enhance customer devotion
  • Remain in frequent contact with clients in order to uncover their additional needs
  • Respond to complaints and resolve issues aiming toward customer contentment and the preservation of the company’s reputation
  • Negotiate agreements and keep records of sales and data

  • Outstanding knowledge of MS Office; knowledge of CRM software is a plus
  • Excellent communication/presentation skills and ability to build relationships
  • Organizational and time-management skills
  • A business acumen
  • Enthusiastic and passionate

Education

  • High school diploma
  • BS or BA in business administration, sales or marketing, preferred but not required

Here are the 7 must-have qualities we look for in every Account Executive:

  1. Extremely competitive
  2. Deep need to get others to see things from his/her perspective

job.description:
Department IT Location Montreal

At Stingray, creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology are the pillars of our DNA. Are you ready to rock your career by joining a growing company, a team of music enthusiasts in a stimulating and fun work environment?  

We are looking for a Head of Data & Business Intelligence to join our Data & Business Intelligence team. This position reports to the Director of Software Development Unit – Internal Tools. 

As Head of Data & Business Intelligence, you will drive the technical data vision and strategy for the entire organization. A deeply technical leader, you will have an in-depth command of the systems, architecture, and automations that power our data. Your role will be to keep growing the strategic value of our data, maintaining alignment between our technological capabilities and business objectives. You will act as a key leader in the continued evolution of our culture and practices, connecting technical teams and leadership. 

Your day-to-day

  • Define the strategic vision: Develop and drive the roadmap for data architecture, technology, and warehousing
  • Champion data culture: Promote the importance of data quality, standardize definitions, and implement clear processes to shift the organization toward a predictive approach
  • Guide and unify teams: Lead, mentor, and ensure effective collaboration between local and remote data teams, prioritizing high-impact business initiatives
  • Ensure technical excellence: Oversee the design of a reliable and high-performing data ecosystem, while directly contributing (approximately 30%) to the design of systems, architectures, and automations to stay connected to ground-level realities
  • Agentic leadership: Guide a team already working with agentic development as it migrates our processes onto our in-house agentic platform, putting in place what makes those automations trustworthy: validation, observability, guardrails, and governance

Your qualifications

  • Over 10 years of experience in data, business intelligence, and analytics, including team management
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business objectives into a clear technical vision and strategic roadmap
  • Strong leadership experience, with a talent for mentoring, change management, and aligning multidisciplinary teams, including data science and data engineering
  • Proficiency in data architecture concepts (Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, ETL/ELT, streaming, Pub/Sub) and Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • In-depth command of systems and architecture concepts, with the ability to design end-to-end solutions and assess their robustness
  • Mastery of agentic development and automated software production pipelines (agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, guardrails), and a proven ability to lead a team working this way
  • Ability to build well-founded trust in automated systems: measuring their reliability, understanding their limits, and keeping human judgment where it matters
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization
  • Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken, with strong spoken fluency in both languages

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on experience managing the merger of technology stacks and teams
  • Knowledge of data ecosystems and technologies (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Apache Beam, DBT, Google Cloud Dataflow, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience with the advertising data industry (SSAI, SSP, DSP) 
  • Ability to design business intelligence strategies tailored to different business models (e.g., subscription services, advertising)
  • Knowledge of various programming and database languages (Python, Java, Rust, SQL, etc.) 

The Team You Will Join

  • A technical Data & Business Intelligence team of 8 people, including a technical lead and a project manager in Montreal
  • Collaboration with a remote data science team & a remote data engineering team
  • Collaborative work with leaders across the entire company
