At Stingray, creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology are at the core of our DNA. Are you ready to rock your career by joining a fast-growing company and a team of music enthusiasts in a stimulating and fun work environment? 

Reporting to the Creative Director and working closely with Sales, Operations, and our creative teams, the Manager, Content Strategy & Operations will play a key role in developing content strategies, managing client projects, and supporting the day-to-day delivery of digital signage content across our client networks.

This role combines creative thinking, client engagement, project management, and hands-on digital signage content management. You’ll help shape engaging content experiences, develop creative presentations and proposals, oversee content scheduling and dynamic content development, and contribute to improving the processes that help our teams deliver exceptional work.

We’re looking for someone who can think strategically, manage multiple priorities, build strong client relationships, and roll up their sleeves to get things done.

Please note that this position can be based either in Montréal or Toronto. We welcome applications from candidates interested in either location.

Your day-to-day

Project management

  • Oversee day-to-day workflow and resource planning, helping balance priorities, timelines and team capacity.

job.title: VP Sales, OMG Agencies
job.description:
Department Sales Location New York

Stingray Group Inc. is a leading music, media, and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. As a premium provider of curated direct-to-consumer and B2B services, we reach 400 million subscribers in 156 countries.

Stingray Advertising connects brands to passionate audiences across an expansive, multi-platform music ecosystem. Wherever consumers are watching, listening, or scrolling, Stingray is there.

Anchored by North America’s largest retail audio advertising network—reaching 800+ million monthly shoppers across 25,000+ top retail locations—we offer a seamless, full-funnel media suite across four core touchpoints:

  • In-Store Audio: Point-of-sale reach in major retail hubs like Walgreens and Albertsons.
  • In-Car Audio: Uninterrupted connection with commuters on the move.
  • In-Stream Audio: Digital audio streaming across premium music experiences.
  • In-Screen Audio (FAST/CTV): High-impact connected TV and video environments.

From home to the car to the aisle, we empower brands to connect with active audiences at every step of their journey.

We are seeking a high-performing, well-connected VP of Sales to join the Stingray Advertising US team to exclusively lead and grow our business across Omnicom Media Group (OMG).

Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will be pivotal in positioning Stingray Advertising’s multi-platform music ecosystem—spanning digital streaming audio, CTV audio & video, in-car audio, and North America’s leading in-store retail audio network—to OMG agency leads. You will leverage your existing senior agency relationships to unlock significant agency holdco growth and establish Stingray as a core omnichannel partner.

Your day-to-day

  • Drive Agency Revenue: Meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets by driving adoption and spend across OMG agencies and their client rosters for our entire multi-platform ecosystem.
  • Strategic Account Management: Execute end-to-end account ownership, including accurate revenue forecasting, strategic joint business planning, CRM upkeep, and active pipeline management.
  • Holdco Relationship Leadership: Build, cultivate, and scale deep, senior-level relationships across OMG’s media agencies, digital desks, and investment teams.
  • Full-Ecosystem Value Creation: Constantly challenge the status quo to build innovative, high-value solutions across video, audio streaming, and retail media tailored to OMG clients’ holistic strategies.
  • Internal Collaboration: Actively participate in strategy sessions, internal alignment, and weekly status meetings to streamline cross-platform agency execution.
  • Industry Ambassadorship: Represent Stingray Advertising as a senior leader at major industry conferences, trade events, and agency showcases.

Your qualifications

  • 8+ years of digital media sales experience, with a proven track record in revenue generation across video, audio, or digital channels.
  • OMG Holdco Expertise: Deep, established senior-level relationships across OMG agencies, trade desks, and investment leads.
  • Multi-Platform Experience: Strong familiarity with streaming audio, CTV/video, connected devices, or retail media advertising.
  • Account Mastery: Strong command of sales operations, pipeline forecasting, and strategic account development.
  • Exceptional Presenter: Outstanding written and oral communication skills with the authority and confidence to present multi-platform media strategies to senior decision-makers.
  • Growth Mindset: High-energy, proactive leader with a track record of beating budget targets.

What's in it for you?

  • Executive Leadership: Take ownership of one of the highest-potential holding company portfolios for a leading North American media network.
  • Omnichannel Inventory: Position unique, programmatic-enabled inventory across streaming video/audio, connected car, and physical retail environments.
  • Market Momentum: Capitalize on the convergence of programmatic audio, CTV, and retail media network (RMN) growth.
  • Competitive Package: High-earning potential featuring a strong base salary, revenue-driven uncapped bonus structure, and comprehensive benefits.

**Job Description:**

job.title: Product Manager, Visuals
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno has made it possible for anyone to turn an idea into music. Now we’re exploring how anyone can bring their music to life through video. As the Product Manager for Video, you will take a new product from its earliest stages through launch and growth. You will shape intuitive creation experiences across web and mobile, work with the broader product team to make videos a compelling part of Suno, and help define a business model that can support creators as the product scales. We’re looking for an experienced PM with strong product and design judgment, firsthand

experience

creating videos, and excitement about what generative video makes possible. You should care as much about the people making videos as you do about the technology behind them—and be eager to build tools that help more people express what they hear and imagine. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/visual/cmp_01a1ef02-a4e1-7bae-b9b7-9cf8c6567c7b

What You’ll Do

Define the video creation

experience

— Understand how people want to bring their music to life, then turn those insights into a clear product vision and roadmap. Build from zero to one — Lead the product from early prototypes through launch, making thoughtful choices about creative controls, generative video capabilities, and the path from a song to a finished video. Make video part of Suno — Partner with other product teams to design how creators share their videos and how audiences discover and engage with them across web and mobile. Shape a sustainable business — Explore how video creates value for creators and Suno, and help develop a business model that can grow with the product. Launch and grow the product — Define what success looks like, learn from what creators make and where they get stuck, and improve the

experience

as adoption grows. Who You Are A product manager who loves making creative tools more powerful and accessible 6+ years of product management experience, including launching and growing a consumer product or creative tool Firsthand

experience

creating videos and a strong understanding of video creation tools and workflows Excited by generative video and thoughtful about where AI can help creators without taking away their creative control Able to turn an ambiguous opportunity into a focused product strategy, make tradeoffs, and bring a team along Adept at using user feedback and data insights to understand what’s working and decide what to build next Strong analytical thinking and the ability to connect a valuable creator

experience

to a sustainable business. A clear, proactive partner to Engineering, Design, and other teams in a fast-moving environment Perks &

Benefits

Company Equity Package 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k) Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options) 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave Creative

Education

job.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Bots + Fraud
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

As a Senior/Staff Software Engineer on Suno’s new Bots & Fraud team, you’ll design and build the backend systems behind our defenses against abuse, fraud, and bots. You’ll build real-time services that turn request telemetry, behavioral signals, and device and app attestation into enforcement, such as rate limits, challenges, and account actions, across every layer from the edge to product services. The team is new and pulls together work from across the company, so you’ll help shape what we build and how we build it. You’ll report to the Bots & Fraud Engineering Manager. Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/rieJJLO5xgUm2L0B

What You'll Do

Design and build backend services for real-time abuse, fraud, and bot defense, including rate limiters, challenge flows (CAPTCHA, proof-of-work, 2FA), rules engines, and account enforcement APIs. Deploy defenses from the edge to product services, with detection and enforcement that’s easy to roll back, auditable, and low-friction for real users. Build the logging and metrics that show what’s getting through, what we block, and our false-positive rate. Protect high-value flows, including signup, login, payments, and song generation, from account farming, credential stuffing, card testing, and credit abuse. Contribute to the new Bots and Fraud team's architecture, roadmap, and on-call rotation, and help other engineers grow through code and design reviews. Protect the people Suno is built for, so the platform stays a place where anyone can make music and that becomes part of everyday life.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves 5+ years of software engineering

experience

3+ years of backend development on distributed systems 2+ years of

experience

in trust and safety, anti-abuse, or fraud prevention

Experience

leading projects from design through launch and mentoring other engineers Nice-to-Haves

Experience

with AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, S3), Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and Valkey/Redis

Experience

detecting and stopping automated abuse of public APIs through request telemetry, rate limiting, and challenges

Experience

building or running payments fraud and chargeback systems, whether built in-house or on third-party risk platforms

Experience

using AI to speed up how you build and operate systems, from development workflows to on-call and investigations

Work Location

Policy This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KTHV-TV Little Rock, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Little Rock, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of CBS broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Little Rock's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 3-5 years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed 

Salary: Competitive base + commission

 

#LI-NS1

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com 

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.  

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers. 

  Privacy Notice for California Residents   SMS Messaging Privacy Policy

WWL-TV, the Tegna-owned CBS affiliate in New Orleans, is seeking an engaging Anchor / Multi-Skilled Journalist to anchor newscasts and report stories that matter to southeast Louisiana.

We are looking for a journalist with strong news judgment, clear and conversational on-air delivery, and the curiosity to find the people and context behind the headlines. The successful candidate will work closely with producers and the newsroom team to shape useful, accurate newscasts, while also reporting, shooting, writing and editing original stories for broadcast and digital platforms.

• Ability to shoot and edit video and produce content for broadcast and digital platforms.
• Experience with newsroom systems, editing tools and graphics

• Ability to work any shift in a 24/7 newsroom environment

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Position:        Inventory Specialist
Department:    TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO)
Location:    Any TEGNA market 

Description:
We are hiring! The TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO) team is looking for a talented and motivated person to join our team.
A broadcast Traffic department maximizes revenue for a television station through careful consideration of spot placement and program formatting. We describe our group as “Commercial Operations” because we do more than just place spots on a log; we work hand in hand with the sales, marketing/promotions, programming, news and engineering departments to create an on-air product that generates positive results for both our stations and clients. Our daily workflow has often been described as working a puzzle; we manipulate commercial inventory to maximize an advertiser’s return on investment. 
A successful Inventory Specialist pays attention to detail, is customer-service oriented, shows initiative and can balance multiple projects and requests while meeting daily deadlines.  

Specific job requirements include:
•    Using WideOrbit Traffic software, manage commercial inventory by accurately preempting or placing spots on the broadcast log
•    Meet daily log finalization deadlines and clear oversold inventory 13 weeks out
•    Understand and follow spot placement guidelines to ensure client specifications are met
•    Verify the broadcast log is maximized for revenue and meets product and advertiser separation requirements
•    Collaborate with TCO and station teammates to identify and communicate revenue opportunities to the sales team
•    Process sales orders and assist sales team with accurate order entry
•    Various other duties as assigned


If this sounds like a great fit, we are looking for applicants with the following skills and experience:
•    High school diploma (required)
•    Undergraduate degree in marketing, communications, or a related field (preferred)
•    Broadcasting, cable or radio traffic or sales support experience (preferred)
•    WideOrbit traffic system knowledge (preferred)
•    Proficient with computer software/applications, including Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word and Excel (required)
•    Attention to detail and strong organizational skills (required)
•    Desire to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment (required)
•    If you have relevant work experience, we are willing to train the right candidate
•    Work from home flexibility, must be in a TEGNA market

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. We are looking for a Cloud Team Lead to lead the cloud and DevOps team that builds and operates the infrastructure behind TEGNA's content management and streaming platforms across Azure and AWS. Content management runs on Azure (C#/.NET Function Apps, Service Bus), streaming runs on AWS media services, and cloud-agnostic services run on Kubernetes — all Terraform-managed. Reporting to the Platform Engineering Manager, this is a hands-on technical leadership role: you lead a team of onshore and offshore cloud engineers, own the team's delivery and the reliability of the platform's infrastructure, and stay hands-on in the work. You partner closely with the Cloud Architect — who sets reference architectures and standards and holds production approval — to deliver well-architected infrastructure, and with the microservices pods on their infrastructure needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead a distributed team of cloud/DevOps engineers (onshore and offshore), owning planning, delivery, quality, and day-to-day technical direction.
  • Remain hands-on: contribute to Terraform/infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and Kubernetes workloads across Azure and AWS.
  • Own the reliability, performance, and operational excellence of the platform's infrastructure, including incident response and the on-call rotation.
  • Break infrastructure initiatives and epics into actionable, well-sequenced work, balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform health.
  • Partner with the Cloud Architect to apply the standards, reference architectures, and guardrails they define, and with the dev pods to support their delivery.
  • Drive engineering practices across the team: IaC standards, pipeline safety, observability, and security.
  • Mentor and grow engineers, and manage the throughput and quality of offshore contributors.
  • Run an Agile/Scrum delivery cadence with disciplined source control.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years in cloud, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, including 2+ years leading or mentoring a team.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform/infrastructure-as-code across Azure and/or AWS; multi-cloud experience is a strong plus.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, cloud networking, IAM/identity, observability, and security best practices.
  • Experience operating production infrastructure and leading incident response.
  • Proven ability to lead distributed and offshore teams, keeping quality and velocity high across time zones.
  • Strong communication skills across front-end, architecture, and microservice development teams.
  • Media, streaming, or high-traffic platform experience is a plus.

Why Join TEGNA?

You'll lead the team that keeps modern digital products running at real scale, in a genuinely multi-cloud Azure/AWS environment with a rich media and streaming footprint. This is an opportunity to shape both the reliability of the platform and the engineering culture of the team that powers content management and streaming delivery across all of TEGNA's media properties. We are investing heavily in AI-assisted development, modern cloud-native services, and flexible architecture patterns that let our teams innovate quickly while delivering high-quality, high-impact products.

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for a Data Scientist to help build the data science and applied AI capabilities behind TEGNA’s content platform, the systems that turn a high volume of news and media content into insight, enrichment, and better experiences for millions of users. You’ll work with large, messy, text-heavy datasets and use NLP and large language models to turn them into production solutions that make content more discoverable, better organized, and more useful to editorial, product, and audience teams. You’ll be a technical anchor on the team: framing ambiguous business problems as data science problems, setting the bar for rigor in experimentation and evaluation, and mentoring analysts and mid-level data scientists. You’ll partner with engineering and cloud teams on how models and LLM-based services are deployed, monitored, and operated in production.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and evaluate data science solutions that apply NLP and LLMs to content problems such as classification, tagging and taxonomy, entity extraction, summarization, similarity and recommendation, and semantic search.
  • Develop LLM-powered solutions, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search, and fine-tuning where it is warranted, with a pragmatic eye on cost, latency, and quality.
  • Own evaluation. Define metrics, build benchmark and golden datasets, and run offline and online experiments (including A/B tests) to show that a solution works, and keep checking that it keeps working.
  • Frame ambiguous business and editorial problems as well-defined data science problems, and help convert epics and tech briefs into actionable, well-scoped stories alongside the team lead.
  • Work with engineers to take models and prototypes into production as reliable services, covering monitoring, drift detection, guardrails, and responsible-AI practices such as hallucination, bias, and content-safety controls.
  • Explore, clean, and model large structured and unstructured datasets, and communicate findings and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Set standards for reproducibility, experiment tracking, code quality, and documentation across the team.
  • Mentor analysts and mid-level data scientists, raising the overall technical maturity of the team.
  • Partner with engineering and cloud teams (who own infrastructure realization, CI/CD, and standards).
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined source control.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data science or applied machine learning, with models or analytical solutions delivered into production.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and the core data science stack (pandas, scikit-learn, and a deep learning framework such as PyTorch), plus solid SQL.
  • Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design, and model evaluation, and the judgment to choose the simplest approach that solves the problem.
  • Hands-on experience with NLP (text classification, named entity recognition, topic modeling, embeddings, semantic similarity) and with modern transformer-based approaches.
  • Practical experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings and vector databases, and evaluating LLM output quality. Experience with Hugging Face or comparable platforms is expected.
  • Experience taking data science work to production in a cloud environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and an understanding of MLOps fundamentals: versioning, monitoring, reproducibility, and retraining.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain model behavior, limitations, and trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
  • A track record of mentoring others and elevating team practices.
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
  • Media, publishing, streaming, or high-traffic content platform experience is a plus.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs or Graph-RAG, with Databricks or a managed vector search platform, or with fine-tuning and evaluating open-source LLMs is a plus.
Pay Range$100,000—$125,000 USD

KARE, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Minneapolis, is seeking an innovative and results-driven Director of Sales to lead a high-performing revenue team across linear, streaming, and digital platforms. This leader will drive strategy, grow market share, develop top talent, and help local businesses connect with audiences through modern marketing solutions.

The Director of Sales creates, leads, and executes the station’s sales strategy to achieve or exceed annual revenue goals while growing market share across broadcast, digital, streaming, and emerging platforms. job.title: Evening News Anchor/ MSJ
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KYTX-TV Tyler a TEGNA CBS affiliate in Tyler has an amazing opportunity for a creative, innovative, and enterprising Anchor who is an excellent on-camera communicator to help serve the needs of our audience and community. We are looking for a journalist who excels at both accountability reporting and breaking news. We are seeking candidates who will trailblaze the future of news, find and defend the truth, and tell the stories of our community. This anchor should be someone who is comfortable asking tough but fair questions. This journalist must be able to work with producers to develop smart and engaging newscasts. We are looking for someone who understands the “why” behind stories and excels at impact journalism. The Anchor is a newsroom leader who will be one of the faces of the station in charge of developing contacts and relationships in the community enabling them to create and present unique, compelling, and innovative stories of interest.  

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities: 

  • Use editorial judgment to help determine content of the newscasts.
  • Work with producer and team to create unique, fast-paced innovative newscasts.

job.title: FullStack Engineer (UI/UX)
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer (with UI/UX expertise) to help build and evolve the web applications and supporting services our teams and audiences rely on every day. You’ll work across the stack, from modern React front ends to the APIs and services behind them, and you’ll be a strong contributor to how we structure, ship, and scale user-facing software. We build with micro-frontends so that teams can deliver independently without sacrificing a cohesive experience, and we embrace agentic software development, using AI agents as real collaborators in design, implementation, testing, and review. You’ll take product requirements and technical briefs and turn them into well-structured, well-tested features, working closely with product, design, architecture, and platform partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate full stack features, from React UIs through to the backend APIs and services that support them.
  • Develop and evolve micro-frontend architectures, including module boundaries, shared component libraries, versioning, and runtime integration across independently deployed applications.
  • Use agentic development methods in day-to-day work: directing AI coding agents, writing effective specs and prompts, reviewing and validating agent-generated code, and building guardrails (tests, linting, CI checks) that keep agent output reliable.
  • Set and uphold standards for code quality, testing, accessibility, performance, and observability across the front end and back end.
  • Contribute to technical design for meaningful features and help break epics into actionable, well-scoped stories alongside the team lead.
  • Share what works in agent-assisted workflows, and help teammates build effective habits and practices.
  • Modernize legacy front ends and monolithic UIs into scalable, maintainable, componentized applications.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, architects, and platform teams to deliver cohesive user experiences.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined source control and code review practices.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building production web applications.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, including state management, hooks, performance optimization, and component design.
  • Practical experience with micro-frontend architectures (e.g., Module Federation, single-spa, or equivalent approaches), including managing shared dependencies, design systems, and cross-team integration.
  • Solid backend experience building RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs in a language such as Node.js, C#/.NET, or similar, with a working understanding of databases and data modeling.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic or AI-assisted software development, and good judgment about when to trust, verify, and correct agent output.
  • Strong grasp of web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, accessibility, browser performance, and security basics (authentication, authorization, XSS/CSRF).
  • Strong testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and a genuine concern for code structure and maintainability.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-hosted applications in AWS, Azure, or similar environments.
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
  • Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach, including a willingness to mentor and learn from teammates.
  • Exposure to Docker, monorepo tooling, or design-system development is a plus.
  • Media, streaming, or high-traffic consumer web experience is a plus.
Pay Range$100,000—$130,000 USD

TEGNA's broadcast operations hub in Charlotte, NC seeks a Broadcast Hub Operator to join our team. This position is part of a team responsible for the live operation, monitoring and support of multiple stations 24 by 7 in a single centralized environment. This position will perform duties to ensure the on-air integrity of multiple network programming feeds and provide immediate response to emergency situations that may affect on-air programming. The ideal candidate is a self-starter capable of working independently or as part of a team. Must be willing to work onsite at our facility in Charlotte, North Carolina.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and manipulate on-air playlists, execute program/commercial/marketing changes, support live-event and off-air workflows, send logs for reconciliation and troubleshoot channel playout issues
  • Responsible for the ingest and quality control of broadcast materials into all automation systems
  • Manage commercial integration, including rolling commercial breaks, during taped and live programming
  • Monitor and maintain the continuity and availability for multiple channel streams
  • Ensure continuity of programming by confirming that every piece of material is accounted for and ready for on-air playout
  • Act as first line responders for internal clients
  • Vigilantly protect our air by simulating the experience of a viewer and constantly checking for proper audio, video, captioning and picture quality
  • With the guidance of Technical Managers and supervisors, work as a team to promptly recover from any on-air discrepancies
  • Other duties as assigned

  • BA/BS in a related field or equivalent experience
  • Basic understanding of television production, broadcast operations, and/or news/sports/entertainment technical production requirements
  • Proficient in Excel and the entire Microsoft O365 suite of tools
  • Knowledge of and ability to use electronic equipment and computer hardware and software related to television broadcast operations, including video and audio routing equipment, file servers, remote transmitter monitoring equipment and multi-channel automation systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot, take immediate action, and resolve broadcast issues
  • Strong customer service attributes and skills
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Unwavering composure in high-pressure situations
  • Acute attention to detail
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills
  • Experience working successfully as part of a team
  • Must be willing to work onsite at our facility in Charlotte, North Carolina

job.title: Mobile CMS Team Lead
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for a Mobile CMS Team Lead to lead the team building TEGNA's mobile content experiences — the applications that deliver news and content to audiences on mobile devices, powered by our content management platform. Our content management systems run on Azure (C#/.NET Function Apps, Service Bus), and the mobile apps integrate with those backend microservices and content APIs. Reporting to the Platform Engineering Manager, this is a hands-on technical leadership role: you lead a team of onshore and offshore mobile engineers, own the team's delivery and the quality of the apps, and stay hands-on in the work. You partner with the CMS Solutions Architect, who sets product and platform direction, and with the content and microservices teams whose services your apps consume.

Responsibilities
●    Lead a distributed team of mobile engineers (onshore and offshore), owning planning, delivery, code quality, and day-to-day technical direction.
●    Remain hands-on in mobile development across native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) and/or cross-platform frameworks.
●    Own mobile app quality, performance, and release management — including app store submissions, versioning, and post-release monitoring.
●    Integrate mobile apps cleanly with backend CMS microservices and content APIs, handling offline, error, and failure states gracefully.
●    Break product initiatives and epics from the Solutions Architects into actionable, well-sequenced mobile work.
●    Drive engineering practices across the team: code review, testing, crash reporting and observability, and release safety.
●    Partner with product, design, and architecture, and the web CMS and microservices teams to deliver cohesive experiences.
●    Mentor and grow engineers, and manage the throughput and quality of offshore contributors.
●    Run an Agile/Scrum delivery cadence with disciplined source control.

Requirements
●    7+ years of software engineering experience with significant mobile development experience, including 2+ years leading or mentoring a team.
●    Strong hands-on mobile expertise: native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin). Cross-platform frameworks (e.g., .NET MAUI, React Native) are a plus.
●    Experience integrating mobile apps with backend services and APIs (REST, and ideally event-driven patterns).
●    Solid experience with mobile release management, app store processes, and mobile observability/crash reporting.
●    Proven ability to lead distributed and offshore teams, keeping quality and velocity high across time zones.
●    Strong communication skills across product, design, engineering, and architecture stakeholders.
●    Content, media, or streaming mobile application experience is a plus.

job.description:

WBNS-TV Columbus, the CBS TEGNA affiliate,  is looking for an experienced Multi-Skilled Journalist to help maintain our tradition of superior reporting and newsgathering. If you're a creative storyteller who understands true multi-platform journalism and who is not bound by the methods of traditional TV news – we want to hear from you! 

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

  • Perform authoritative, compelling live shots in a developing story or in breaking news situations
  • Develop story ideas
  • Mine the community to find sources who will keep you informed about events and ideas in their areas of expertise
  • Ability to identify, write and produce stories within a specific framework.
  • Research for facts and credibility.
  • Maintain and develop sources who will help bring our reporting to the next level.
  • Shoot, write, produce and edit on air and online content within deadlines.
  • Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media (viewer pictures, webcam interviews, etc.) to enhance stories.
  • Use social media and digital tools to research, discover and distribute content.
  • Attend editorial meetings and offer story ideas daily.

job.title: Multiskilled Journalist-Sports
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. WFAA is looking for a creative, energetic sports multimedia journalist to join our award-winning sports team. We're looking for someone who can help lead our daily sports coverage, bring fresh ideas to the table and connect with sports fans across North Texas.

This is a unique opportunity for a journalist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about creating content across multiple platforms. From reporting and anchoring in our linear newscasts to co-hosting a daily sports streaming show to driving the DFW sports conversation through compelling digital and social coverage, this person will play an important role in how WFAA delivers sports to our audience.

WFAA is also a broadcast partner with several professional sports properties. This journalist will play an important content role, developing original stories, features and other compelling content that brings these teams, athletes and events to life for our audience. WFAA is uniquely positioned in one of the most dynamic and competitive sports markets in the country. North Texas is home to an incredible range of professional and collegiate teams, high school sports, major golf tournaments, bowl games, auto racing and some of the biggest sporting events in the world. With sports stories and events happening year-round, there is no shortage of opportunities to tell compelling stories, uncover unique perspectives and connect with passionate sports fans across the region.

What You'll Do
•    Produce, shoot, edit and report original sports content, including packaged stories and features, for linear, streaming, digital and social platforms.
•    Co-host a high-energy daily sports streaming show, helping shape the format, develop segments and create engaging content from concept through execution.
•    Anchor sportscasts and deliver daily sports coverage across WFAA's linear newscasts.
•    Maintain a strong pulse on the North Texas sports landscape, from the Cowboys, Mavericks, Rangers, Stars and Wings to college programs and high school sports.
•    Identify compelling stories and emerging trends across the market and turn them into must-watch content for sports fans.
•    Produce cinematic, original, long-form sports stories that showcase the personalities, passion and events.
•    Cultivate strong industry and team contacts, consistently generating leads and serving as a key contributor to breaking sports news and developing exclusive stories.
•    Develop content for sponsored sports franchises and branded content opportunities across dayparts and platforms.

What You Bring
•    5+ years of sports journalism experience in a medium to major market.
•    Strong knowledge of the North Texas sports landscape.
•    Experience shooting with professional ENG cameras.
•    Ability to produce and edit video using Adobe Premiere Pro, Edius or equivalent editing software.
•    A digital-first mindset with demonstrated experience creating content for digital, streaming and social platforms, including an understanding of CTV.
•    Ability to create engaging, conversational sports content that connects with audiences and that sports fans want to click, watch and share.
•    Ability to work under daily deadline pressure while managing multiple priorities.
•    A collaborative, solutions-oriented attitude and a willingness to bring fresh ideas to the table.
•    Bachelor's degree in journalism, Communications, Film and Video or a related field preferred.

Be Part of What's Next in DFW Sports
Join WFAA's tradition of sports excellence and help tell the stories that matter to sports fans across North Texas. We're looking for a journalist who goes beyond the headlines and the final scores to uncover unique stories, fresh perspectives and compelling content that sports fans won't find anywhere else.

job.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.
The Role
We are looking for a Senior FullStack Developer with a strong front-end focus to build the web experiences and modular front-end framework behind TEGNA's digital content management system. You'll work primarily in React and TypeScript, building scalable, reusable interfaces — ideally within a micro-frontend (MFE) architecture — that compose cleanly across teams and product lines. These front-ends are backed by our C#/.NET microservices on Azure, so you'll integrate closely with backend services and APIs. You'll partner with the Solutions Architects, who set the overall platform direction, and with the microservices teams whose services you consume. As a senior, you'll set front-end standards, mentor other engineers, and raise the bar for quality and maintainability across the UI/UX layer.
  Responsibilities
● Build and maintain performant, accessible web front-ends in React and TypeScript, and contribute to our modular, micro-frontend architecture.
● Design reusable UI components and front-end modules that standardize experiences and accelerate delivery across teams.
● Integrate front-ends with backend C#/.NET microservices and APIs (REST and event-driven), handling loading, error, and failure states gracefully.
● Own front-end quality — testing, performance, accessibility, and cross-browser/device behavior.
● Set and uphold front-end standards and patterns, and mentor mid-level engineers on UI architecture and best practices.
● Turn designs and product requirements into well-structured, maintainable implementations, and help shape them with product and design partners.
● Collaborate with the Solutions Architects and microservices teams to align the front-end with the broader platform direction.
● Work cloud-native in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined Git-based source control.
Requirements
● 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong front-end emphasis.
● Deep, hands-on expertise with React and TypeScript, and modern front-end tooling (build systems, state management, component libraries).
● Experience with micro-frontend architecture (e.g., module federation or equivalent composition patterns) is strongly preferred.
● Solid experience integrating front-ends with backend services and APIs (REST, and ideally event-driven patterns).
● Strong grasp of front-end performance, accessibility, and testing practices. ● Full-stack range — comfort working close to the backend; familiarity with C#/.NET is a plus, since our services are .NET.
● A track record of setting front-end standards and mentoring other engineers.
● Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
● Media, streaming, CMS, or high-traffic consumer platform experience is a plus.
Why Join TEGNA?
You'll shape the front-end framework and user experiences that reach more than 100 million people across all of TEGNA's media properties, working at the intersection of modern UI architecture and a rich cloud-native backend. We are investing heavily in AI-assisted development, modern cloud-native services, and flexible, modular architecture patterns that let our teams innovate quickly while delivering high-quality, high-impact products for our users

job.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for a Senior FullStack Developer with a strong front-end focus to build the web experiences and modular front-end framework behind TEGNA's digital content management system. You'll work primarily in React and TypeScript, building scalable, reusable interfaces — ideally within a micro-frontend (MFE) architecture — that compose cleanly across teams and product lines. These front-ends are backed by our C#/.NET microservices on Azure, so you'll integrate closely with backend services and APIs. You'll partner with the Solutions Architects, who set the overall platform direction, and with the microservices teams whose services you consume. As a senior, you'll set front-end standards, mentor other engineers, and raise the bar for quality and maintainability across the UI/UX layer.

Responsibilities:

●    Build and maintain performant, accessible web front-ends in React and TypeScript, and contribute to our modular, micro-frontend architecture.
●    Design reusable UI components and front-end modules that standardize experiences and accelerate delivery across teams.
●    Integrate front-ends with backend C#/.NET microservices and APIs (REST and event-driven), handling loading, error, and failure states gracefully.
●    Own front-end quality — testing, performance, accessibility, and cross-browser/device behavior.
●    Set and uphold front-end standards and patterns, and mentor mid-level engineers on UI architecture and best practices.
●    Turn designs and product requirements into well-structured, maintainable implementations, and help shape them with product and design partners.
●    Collaborate with the Solutions Architects and microservices teams to align the front-end with the broader platform direction.
●    Work cloud-native in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined Git-based source control.

Requirements:

●    5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong front-end emphasis.
●    Deep, hands-on expertise with React and TypeScript, and modern front-end tooling (build systems, state management, component libraries).
●    Experience with micro-frontend architecture (e.g., module federation or equivalent composition patterns) is strongly preferred.
●    Solid experience integrating front-ends with backend services and APIs (REST, and ideally event-driven patterns).
●    Strong grasp of front-end performance, accessibility, and testing practices.
●    Full-stack range — comfort working close to the backend; familiarity with C#/.NET is a plus, since our services are .NET.
●    A track record of setting front-end standards and mentoring other engineers.
●    Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
●    Media, streaming, CMS, or high-traffic consumer platform experience is a plus.


Why Join TEGNA?
You'll shape the front-end framework and user experiences that reach more than 100 million people across all of TEGNA's media properties, working at the intersection of modern UI architecture and a rich cloud-native backend. Senior Software Engineer, Roku

Responsibilities:

- Own the design and delivery of significant features and subsystems, including playback, advertising, deep linking, analytics, and the configuration-driven page and module pipeline.
- Design SceneGraph components and task-based asynchronous flows that stay responsive within Roku's memory and threading constraints.

- Integrate and maintain third-party SDKs for analytics, video quality monitoring, feature flagging, user consent, and attribution.
- Improve test coverage and quality tooling (unit tests, linting, formatting, on-device test runs in CI) and keep releases predictable.
- Manage Roku certification requirements and channel packaging and publishing.
- Lead code reviews, mentor engineers, and make pragmatic decisions about technical debt and refactoring in a long-lived codebase.
- Triage production errors and crashes using monitoring and logging tools.

Requirements:
- 6+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience shipping on **Roku** (BrightScript and SceneGraph), or a comparable connected TV platform with demonstrated ability to become productive in BrightScript quickly.
- Strong understanding of the SceneGraph component model, node and task threading, field observers, and RowList/grid-based UI.
- Experience with video playback on Roku, including HLS and ad integration (e.g., RAF, server-side ad insertion).
- Experience with REST/JSON APIs, token-based authentication, and resilient caching and error-recovery strategies.
- Strong testing and code quality habits, with experience in unit testing frameworks and static analysis.
- Ability to debug on-device, including memory and performance profiling.
- Clear communication and a track record of mentoring other engineers.

**Nice to have**
- Experience with **BrighterScript**, **Rooibos**, bslint/bsfmt, and the Roku developer toolchain.
- Experience with CI/CD for Roku, including automated on-device testing.
- Experience with multi-brand or multi-tenant app builds.
- Familiarity with feature flag platforms, analytics instrumentation, and privacy/consent frameworks (CCPA/GDPR).

job.description:

KHOU 11 is seeking a creative, driven sports storyteller to lead coverage across television, digital, streaming, and social platforms. The role includes producing sports stories and shows beyond regular coverage and working with the wider content team on stories and coverage that goes beyond linear newscasts.

Sports coverage at KHOU 11 should bring audiences closer to the athletes, fans, and communities behind the games. The Sports Producer will work with anchors, reporters, producers, and the digital team to shape the station’s sports coverage and find fresh ways to tell those stories including across new and expanding streaming products

Responsibilities
    • Produce sports segments and stories for broadcast, digital, streaming, and social platforms.
    • Coordinate coverage with Houston sports teams and develop stories and partnerships.
    • Produce live sports shows and coverage of major events.
    • Set direction with newsroom colleagues and coordinate production across teams.
    • Track emerging sports conversations and social trends.
    • Produce newscasts during major news events when needed.

Qualifications
The ideal candidate is an ambitious, collaborative leader who can connect sports with a broad audience. They should be skilled at identifying social media trends, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and ready to work across broadcast, streaming, and social platforms. To succeed you'll need to go beyond the game and have a keen interest in streaming technology including new platforms and tools for storytelling in a live environment. This is not your regular sports job. The successful candidate will be eager to explore the future of how we connect with sports audiences and embrace new and emerging leagues and teams.

Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree preferred in journalism, communications or related field or equivalent years of experience.
1-3 years of news & sports content experience.
Top-notch communication skills are an absolute must.
Solid journalistic judgement and a news philosophy that emphasizes accurate, fair and unique local content, along with community engagement centered on how sports connect people. 
Understanding of the tenets of professional journalism.
Skills in producing engaging, content-driven newscasts and digital content.
Strong social media skills, including an active news hound presence on your preferred social platforms. 
Organizational skills and the ability to work under time pressure deadlines.
Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and changing events.

job.title: Breaking News Intern - Winter 2026/2027
job.description:
Breaking News Internship

The Daily Beast delivers award-winning original reporting and sharp opinions from big personalities in the arenas of politics, pop culture, world news, and more. Fiercely independent and armed with irreverent intelligence, The Daily Beast now reaches more than 20 million readers per month. The Daily Beast is based in New York and is an operating business of IAC (NASDAQ: IAC).

Job Description

The Daily Beast is seeking a talented, motivated, and dependable Breaking News Intern to join our award-winning newsroom on-site in New York as part of the Cheat Sheet/breaking news team. Open to undergraduate juniors and seniors, graduate students, and post-grads, the internship is an exciting opportunity for emerging journalists to learn how a newsroom works while gaining hands-on experience. The roles are full-time (37.5 hours/week) for three-month periods between September through November. It will include evening and weekend shifts.
Ideal candidates are newshounds who can work quickly, write cleanly and with some flair, and both take initiative and direction.

Qualifications

* Experience writing breaking news.

* A voracious news diet and appetite that covers politics, pop culture, power, and big issues in the national and global conversations.

* Prior knowledge of web publishing and using a content management system is a plus.

* Comfort meeting quick deadlines.

To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter that includes links to 4-6 portfolio pieces. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

The pay for this position is $19.00 per hour.

Additional information

Don’t meet every single requirement listed here? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet each and every qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re interested in joining the Beast but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with this job description, we encourage you to give it a shot all the same. It might turn out that you're just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

job.title: Editorial Lawyer
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We’re now looking for an Editorial Lawyer to provide legal support and advice to our publications. 

 

The GNM Editorial Legal Department provides pre- and post- publication legal advice to all our editorial departments. You’ll be working alongside some of the top journalists and editors. The editorial lawyers have worked on many exciting news and investigative projects.

 

About the Role

Editorial lawyers work closely with our journalists and editors to make sure that what we publish is legally defensible. This involves reading stories before they are published and checking for legal risk in areas such as defamation, privacy and data protection, contempt and copyright. It can be a fast moving and demanding environment. In addition to this pre-publication review, editorial lawyers also advise on the merits of any court cases that may be threatened and / or filed against GNM, working with the appropriate journalists, editors and executives to define a strategic defence and/or approve settlements of disputes where warranted, as well as selecting, retaining, managing, and evaluating any outside solicitors or counsel as needed.

 

Additional responsibilities include:

  • Pre-publication legal and editorial code review on a real-time basis on all content-related issues

  • Managing pre and post publication litigation (including libel, breach of confidence, privacy, data protection, freedom of information, contempt of court (publication), production orders, copyright, open justice + challenging reporting restrictions)

  • Contributing to policy and lobbying discussions and documents

 

About You

  • 2-4 years post qualified experience or equivalent

  • Experience of civil and/or criminal litigation including ability to handle own caseload

  • Background in/knowledge of media law (including libel, breach of confidence, privacy, data protection, freedom of information, contempt of court (publication), production orders, copyright, open justice + challenging reporting restrictions and broadcast

  • Ideally proven experience of pre and post publication litigation work

  • Background in / knowledge of complaint handling and responding

  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role

 

We actively encourage applications from candidates from other groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media and legal profession. 

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people at the Guardian. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve,

where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for.

 

The closing date for applications is 6pm, Tuesday 1st December 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Please contact Sean on sean.brinkley@guardian.co.uk to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

 

Culture & wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace.

 

You will also have the opportunity to hear unique insight from our journalists in our morning conference, a live discussion on the news story of the day.

 

We offer great tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including free yoga and pilates. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Learning & development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships. 

 

Our working environment

We take pride in our surroundings and are pleased to offer versatile meeting rooms and colourful communal areas. We have a brilliant canteen that caters to breakfast, lunch and dinner, with views overlooking Regent’s Canal.

 

Additional benefits & policies

We offer 30 days annual leave per annum, plus an additional 5 day holiday purchase scheme. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to life cover, income protection, healthcare, sick pay and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

job.title: Multimedia Editor (Training)
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are looking for a multimedia editor (training) to help build multimedia capability across our newsroom, in line with the Guardian’s Project Berger transformation. You’ll identify skills and development needs, design and deliver practical training, and work directly with journalists to help them create ambitious, engaging video and off-platform storytelling.

 

Combining hands-on video production expertise with coaching and mentoring, you’ll work directly with editors, reporters and production staff to develop their skills and confidence. You’ll provide practical support, tailor training to different levels of experience and help teams collaborate effectively with specialist multimedia producers. You’ll work closely with the Project Berger team throughout.

 

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract or staff secondment aligned to a 12-month training programme.

 

About the role

  • Work with journalists from predominantly text-based backgrounds to identify opportunities for ambitious and distinctive video/social storytelling, championing a visual, multi-format approach to our journalism.
  • Deliver practical, hands-on training, working directly with journalists to develop their multimedia skills, confidence and enthusiasm for video and off-platform journalism.
  • Support journalists to understand how to adapt stories and angles for different platforms, audiences and formats.
  • Help colleagues understand audience needs and behaviour across platforms, including the Guardian, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.
  • Use audience data, feedback and learning evaluation to help assess what works and inform future training.
  • Support journalists and editors to understand how text, video, photography and graphics can work together to tell stories effectively.
  • Help colleagues develop practical production skills across a range of formats, including filming, editing, loops, carousels, headline cards and social graphics.
  • Work closely with other Guardian training teams and offices to ensure a coordinated approach to skills development, sharing expertise and avoiding duplication. Contribute to wider training programmes and masterclasses where required.

 

About you

  • Experience of designing, delivering or supporting training, coaching, mentoring or other learning and development activity.
  • Demonstrable experience of developing video stories and an understanding of how to structure compelling visual narratives for different platforms.
  • Ability to communicate technical and editorial concepts clearly to colleagues with different levels of experience.
  • Experience of creating video journalism for social platforms, including an understanding of different audience needs and behaviours.
  • Strong knowledge of video production equipment and editing and visual design tools, such as Adobe Premiere Pro and Figma.
  • Experience of video production, including practical filming, editing and working with contributors and presenters. 
  • Understanding of effective learning and development principles, including different learning styles and approaches.
  • Strong understanding of Guardian editorial standards, accuracy, verification, copyright and legal considerations relevant to video/social production.
  • Experience of managing projects, schedules and competing priorities.
  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role. 

 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.

 

We operate in a hybrid environment working at least three days a week from our offices in King’s Cross in London.

 

The salary band for this role starts at £68,000, with the final offer determined by the successful candidate's skills, experience, and responsibilities.  

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for.

Working closely with the multimedia editor (training), production staff, reporters and editors, you’ll provide practical guidance, run workshops and masterclasses while supporting colleagues as they develop their video and social storytelling skills. You’ll work closely with the Project Berger team throughout.

 

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract or staff secondment aligned to a 12-month training programme.

  • Work with journalists from predominantly text-based backgrounds to identify opportunities for ambitious and distinctive video/social storytelling, championing a visual, multi-format approach to our journalism.
  • Work directly with journalists to develop multimedia skills, confidence and enthusiasm for video and off-platform journalism.
  • Deliver practical, hands-on training, working directly with journalists to develop multimedia skills, confidence and enthusiasm for video and off-platform journalism.
  • Support journalists to understand how to adapt stories and angles for different platforms, audiences and formats.
  • Help colleagues understand audience needs and behaviour across platforms, including the Guardian, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.
  • Use audience data, feedback and learning evaluation to help assess what works and inform future training.
  • Support journalists and editors to understand how to make text, video, photography and graphics work together to tell stories effectively.
  • Work closely with other Guardian training teams and offices to ensure a coordinated approach to skills development, aligning training plans, sharing expertise and avoiding duplication. Contribute to wider training programmes and masterclasses where required.
  • Providing constructive feedback on scripts, edits, rough cuts and finished video.
  • Identifying skills gaps and developing targeted training and resources to address them.

  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling and how to make text, photography, graphics and video work together.
  • Practical experience of creating visual content in a range of formats, including loops, carousels and graphics for social platforms.

job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account.
