job.title: #1 Operator in Press - 3rd Shift
job.description:
Job Description

We are hiring an experienced Lead/#1 Press Operator for our printing plant team in Eagan, Minnesota. As a Lead/#1 Press Operator, you will be responsible for the performance of the production line and crew on our Core Publishing Solutions team. You will be operating state of the art offset and digital web presses. You would also be eligible for a $2,500 signing bonus upon being in the role for 90 days.


Hours of Work – Eagan, Minnesota

  • 3rd Shift 10:30p - 6:30a
  • Occasional overtime up to 4 hours per day and occasional weekend shifts

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a Lead/#1 Press Operator, you will be responsible for:   

  • Providing leadership, work direction, and training/developing the skills of the crew to consistently optimize overall performance
  • In addition to ensuring that the line is running smoothly and producing a quality product for our customers, Lead Operators are expected to facilitate Tier 1 meetings and Gemba Walk discussions to drive communication and improvements to the processes associated with the equipment
  • Training for crew members who are temps or are coming in from another area to support workload
  • Motivating others and creating a team environment

Required Qualifications 

You’re a fit for the role of Lead/#1 Press Operator if your background includes:

  • Possess a High School Diploma/GED or higher. Candidates with a vocational/technical degree are strongly preferred
  • Experience leading and training others
  • Experience working in an industrial setting with a wide range of production machinery
  • Strong mechanical and technical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot, make decisions and resolve machine issues
  • Experience with Lean and continuous improvement
  • Good communication skills including experience sharing information across shifts and departments
  • Proven success as a trainer
  • The ability to run multiple pieces of equipment is required
  • Previous experience as a Lead on 1-2 Color Web Offset Presses and 4 Color Sheetfed Offset Presses
  • Competent with rulers and measurement
  • Able to read, interpret and explain documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and production orders
  • Can regularly lift at least 5 lbs. above the shoulder as well as push, pull and lift at least 10 lbs occasionally up to 50 lbs
  • Regularly standing walking, crouching, bending, reaching and kneeling

Preferred Qualifications

N/A


#LI-CB1

 

 

What’s in it For You?

  • Compensation: 2nd shift differential of $4.00 per hour, 3rd shift differential of $5.00 per hour, and a bonus plan.

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. We provide on-the-job coaching ∧ learning, leadership capability development, Harvard Management Courses, key talent programs.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include 3 weeks vacation, 10 sick days, 9 company holidays, 3 floating days, uniform and laundry service, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

job.description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about the chance to bring your extensive technical experience to manage development team through complex, full life cycle implementation in a world class company? The Corporate and Commercial Engineering Organization within Thomson Reuters is looking to add a strong CPQ Lead Solution Engineer to a well-established global engineering team. This position requires someone who is a passionate about technology, a strong team player, and is comfortable working with a variety of people and technology stacks. This is a chance to get in and make an impact transforming the way our customers interact with us as we shape the next generation of an enterprise-wide experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the Engineering strategy, planning, design, and implementation of Conga configure, price and quote (CPQ), Conga Turbo Price, Conga Digital Commerce, and PROS Pricing solutions.  
  • Provide technical leadership by establishing best practices, enforcing quality standards, conducting code reviews, and mentoring team members to drive high performance.
  • Lead technical research, prototyping, and solution evaluation to recommend optimal tools and architectures, while staying current with updates in Salesforce and Conga.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, technical leads, architects, and third parties to deliver solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, delivering timely remediation and ensuring system stability and scalability.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, learning, innovation and deployment.
  • Prepare solution development estimates and technical planning, identifying dependencies and risks.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of CRM technical experience, including but limited to 4+ years of hands-on Conga CPQ customization and configuration along with AI-driven solutions (Agentforce or similar agent-based technologies), with expertise integrating Conga CPQ, Turbo Price, Digital Commerce, and/or PROS Pricing to streamline sales workflows and improve productivity. 
  • Knowledge of Conga product configuration management, pricing management, and workflow approval processes, including price dimensions and rulesets, with AI-assisted optimization and seamless integration with Salesforce.
  • Strong technical knowledge of product modeling, pricing, quotation, contract lifecycle, and data migration, including CPQ approvals and discounts.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and integration tools such as Dell Boomi, Apigee, and Informatica, with exposure to integrating AI services and APIs

job.description:
Job Description

As a Deployed AI Strategist, you will serve as the primary technical liaison between our product and end users. You will lead the hands-on deployment of AI solutions directly within audit firms, embedding yourself in their workflows to ensure successful adoption. You are the trust-layer: a credentialed professional who speaks the language of the customer, understands the regulatory environment, and guides practitioners through natural language workflow construction as a trusted advisor. You will partner closely with forward-deployed engineers to translate client needs into technical requirements and rapidly iterate on solutions in the field. This role requires strong collaboration with internal teams (product management, engineering, sales, and customer success) to deliver customers a seamless experience with new-to-market AI solutions. 


Key Responsibilities: 

In the role of Deployed AI Strategist, you will: 

  • Lead customer discovery to understand existing processes, identify automation opportunities, and assess use case feasibility 
  • Guide customers through workflow construction using natural language prompting, building reusable skill templates and a prompt library scalable across service lines 
  • Identify, document, and escalate edge cases, output quality issues, and domain-specific gaps to product and engineering; participate in feature testing to close the feedback loop 
  • Partner with sales during pre-close engagements to provide technical credibility and workflow demonstrations 
  • Track and report on value realization metrics for assigned accounts, including time saved, review cycles reduced, and engagement throughput 
  • Develop and deliver training resources to customers, enabling them to self-serve on identified use cases 

Required Qualifications

You are a fit for the role of Deployed AI Strategist if you have: 

  • An active CPA license or equivalent professional credential (required) 
  • 3-8 years of public accounting experience, ideally at a regional or national firm (Big 4 experience preferred) 
  • Hands-on experience in audit and assurance, or advisory/financial analysis 
  • Deep familiarity with AI tools and comfort working in early-stage, ambiguous environments 
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong organization and project management skills 
  • Willingness to travel for on-site customer workshops

This is a high-impact customer-facing role, giving you the opportunity to shape our AI deployment strategy. job.title: Deputy General Counsel, Innovation & Product
job.description:
Job Description


As Deputy General Counsel, Innovation & Product you will report to our General Counsel & Company Secretary and lead a team of legal professionals. You will contribute to the success of Thomson Reuters, both in your capacity as a lawyer and as a member of the General Counsel’s Office leadership team. You will have primary responsibility for leading our Innovation & Product team, which supports the Company’s strategic protection of its intellectual property. You will have the experience and capability to handle and oversee a broad range of complex legal, compliance and transactional matters. You will lead strategy formulation for the Company’s intellectual property portfolio, including identifying potentially important patentable inventions, conducting invention review boards, preparation and prosecution of patent applications, coordination of domestic and foreign patent prosecution and portfolio reviews. You will also liaise with other Thomson Reuters lawyers across a broad range of businesses and functional areas. You will supervise legal work handled by external and internal legal resources.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with the Product, Engineering and Marketing organizations across the full product lifecycle, from ideation and design through launch, operation and sunset, anticipating legal issues early in the roadmap
  • Advise on AI regulation, governance and data ethics as they relate to product development and maintenance, including IP considerations for training data, third-party models and AI-generated outputs
  • Partner with the Privacy and Information Security organizations to build data protection and security requirements into product design and customer-facing commitments
  • Assertively and successfully pursue litigation/defend various patent demands/litigations and proactively advocate in the public sector in defense of strategic Thomson Reuters positions to enable future growth
  • Provide intellectual property due diligence with respect to acquisitions, including evaluation of third-party intellectual property
  • Provide assessment and advice on open-source software issues
  • Participate in seminars, public-facing meetings and roundtables to provide thought leadership and position Thomson Reuters as a leader in its field
  • Advise commercial lawyers on intellectual property issues as they arise
  • Identify legal, regulatory and compliance requirements and risks associated with business initiatives, and develop and implement appropriate mitigation strategies
  • Operate within policy guidelines and requirements set for Thomson Reuters lawyers to ensure compliance and consistency. Work with lawyers in practice groups and business units across Thomson Reuters to provide resources for the business
  • Drive innovative and efficient delivery of legal support, including developing contract templates, playbooks and guidance for product and commercial teams, adopting legal technology and automation, and training the business on IP, product and AI legal policies and processes
  • Contribute to and help lead diversity and inclusion and corporate responsibility initiatives within Thomson Reuters and the General Counsel Office
  • Participate as a member of the leadership team for the General Counsel’s Office
  • Coordinate hiring and supervision of external counsel. Occasional travel on an as-needed basis
  • Operate within given budget guidelines and resources and uphold departmental code of conduct and guidelines
  • Provide practical and insightful business and strategic advice, leveraging deep experience in the practice of law and the legal profession
  • Undertake other reasonable duties as requested

Required Qualifications:

  • Significant post qualification experience in private practice and/or as in-house specializing in patent law or advising product teams; industry experience preferred
  • Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to drive execution, put colleagues in position to succeed and develop/elevate your team on an ongoing basis
  • Experience drafting and prosecuting patent applications and preparing patent opinions
  • Familiarity with IP management plus strong commercial experience in negotiating relevant agreements, including support agreements, license agreements, confidentiality agreements, technology agreements, including AI, cloud/SaaS, data licensing, API, and alliance/partner agreements, and enterprise agreements
  • Ability to think strategically and creatively to identify and resolve legal issues
  • Excellent communication, organization and analytical skills, including the ability to explain complex legal and technical concepts clearly to non-lawyers and to prioritize effectively across competing demands and tight deadlines
  • Working knowledge of software, cloud and AI/machine learning development, with the ability to understand new technologies quickly and apply the law to them
  • Authorized to practice law in Canada, the United States or relevant local jurisdiction

        

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to positively influence behaviour of multiple stakeholders, as well as to successfully balance the interests of the customer with maintaining a good legal, fiscal and compliance position for the Company
  • Ability to successfully work in a team environment and in a matrixed organization and ability to work well as a team member and build rapport and trust with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to act as advisor and coach to other team members, facilitating growth and professional development.

Education / Certifications:

  • Law degree and current practicing lawyer; technical degree or background in engineering, computer science or a related field is a plus

job.title: DevOps Engineer - Mid Level
job.description:
Job Description

As a Mid Level DevOps Engineer, you will support the delivery of customer projects and the ongoing operation of production services. You will be involved throughout the technical delivery lifecycle, including planning, client meetings, cloud-infrastructure deployment, Imagen software installation, and workflow automation.

You will work as part of the wider delivery team to ensure deployments are fully operable at go-live, maintain existing service levels during change and transition, and improve service quality through automation, incident reduction, and effective recovery processes.

The role requires strong technical knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, scripting, networking, and Windows Server environments. You will communicate with customers and internal stakeholders while contributing to consistent operational standards and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a Mid Level DevOps Engineer, you will:


  • Deploy and Configure Customer Solutions: Deploy and configure cloud-based infrastructure and install the Imagen software solution for customer projects.
  • Configure Platform Environments: Configure ImagenWeb using platform editing tools to deliver customer-specific configurations and finishing touches.
  • Support Data Migration: Write and run bespoke data-migration processes.
  • Develop Automation Solutions: Develop scripts and automation to improve delivery and content-onboarding workflows.
  • Ensure Service Operability: Ensure new services meet operability requirements, including monitoring, alerting, logging, documentation, runbooks, and handover, before go-live.
  • Improve Service Quality: Support the reduction of incident rates through root-cause analysis, problem management, and automation.
  • Support Incident Resolution: Work with first-line operations and technical support to improve service recovery times and resolve customer issues.
  • Maintain Service Levels: Maintain or improve existing service levels during changes and service transitions.
  • Engage with Customers: Communicate with customers through meetings, email, phone, and conference calls, providing a high level of customer service.
  • Contribute to Delivery Planning: Participate in internal weekly planning meetings and contribute ideas for projects.
  • Promote Continuous Improvement: Monitor developments in cloud technology and recommend improvements to working practices.
  • Follow Operational Standards: Follow operational standards, procedures, and best practices while promoting consistency across the team.
  • Provide On-Call Support: Participate in on-call or out-of-hours support as required.

Required Qualifications

You're a fit for the role of Mid Level DevOps Engineer if you have the following required qualifications:


  • Experience with cloud technologies, including AWS or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Lambdas, and Function Apps.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code tools, such as Terraform, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions.
  • Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting proprietary software.
  • Experience with Python or Windows PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience with SQL.
  • Thorough understanding of networking standards and protocols.
  • Experience with the latest Windows Server operating systems, including troubleshooting a range of IT issues.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate ideas and solutions to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to deliver customer deployments to a high standard of accuracy and customer satisfaction.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • This is a hybrid position based in Reforma, Mexico City, requiring two days per week in the office and three days working from home.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or technical operations role.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools.
  • Exposure to ITIL-style incident, problem, and change management.
  • Experience in media, broadcast, or video workflows.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, PHP, and CSS.
  • Understanding of XML and XSL transformation.
  • Relevant certifications, such as Azure Administrator, Azure DevOps Engineer, AWS, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or ITIL 4.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Core Competencies

  • Customer Focus: Builds confidence with clients and delivers work to a high standard.
  • Ownership: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not only assigned tasks.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with support, operations, and delivery colleagues.
  • Continuous Improvement: Uses data and new technology to improve processes.
  • Personal Development: Demonstrates aptitude for learning and professional growth.

job.title: Director Partner Marketing AI & Hyperscalers
job.description:
Job Description

Does working with partnerships, hyperscalers, NeoClouds and AI companies excite you? 

As Director, Partner Marketing for Hyperscalers and AI, you lead the marketing strategy and team behind Thomson Reuters’ most strategic technology alliances, including cloud hyperscalers such as AWS and Google Cloud and frontier AI companies such as Open AI and Anthropic. You turn signed partnerships into pipeline, awareness and customer proof: joint value propositions, co-marketing programs, marketplace and co-sell motions, partner-facing sales enablement, and partner references that put credible voices in front of press, campaigns, and our own sales teams. You also lead the launch of new partner experiences, bringing together analyst relations, PR, social media, content and messaging into one coordinated story.

You sit at the center of a matrix and own the partner marketing relationship. You collaborate closely with Partnerships & Alliances leaders, who own the commercial relationship, and with other marketing and sales leaders to drive awareness, brand and conversion with your partners across the full bowtie of marketing. Your job is to grow the partner marketing relationship, define new programs with these partners and scale. You will tailor programs and lead a team of marketers, measuring success in pipeline contribution and revenue influence. You set the operating cadence and represent Thomson Reuters across marketing and executive counterparts.


Key Responsibilities 

Strategy & Joint Go-to-Market 

  • Own the partner marketing strategy and annual plan for Hyperscaler and AI partners, aligned to Partnerships & Alliances priorities, growth targets and the Partner Marketing operating plan. 
  • Lead joint value propositions and messaging with each strategic partner, adapting this for Legal Professionals, TAAP, Corporates and Government audiences as applicable. 
  • Direct joint go-to-market planning for partner-related product launches and integrations, so that messaging, timing and launch activity are coordinated with communications, social, product marketing and partner teams. 
  • Design creative and innovative messaging and strategies to address To Thru and With partner marketing motions.  
  • Set the investment case for partner marketing: where to scale, hold or stop programs, and how partner funds and Thomson Reuters budget are allocated against measured return. 

Pipeline, Demand & Revenue Impact 

  • Own the pipeline-creation and revenue-influence goals for partner marketing; define the KPIs and attribution approach with Sales Operations, Demand Generation and Partner Development. 
  • Direct co-marketing programs including campaigns, webinars, executive briefings, partner conferences and field events that generate qualified, attributable pipeline. 
  • Build repeatable marketplace and co-sell marketing motions with hyperscaler partners, and the enablement that helps partner and Thomson Reuters sellers use them. 
  • Work with Sales and Partner Sales leaders to identify where marketing can improve deal velocity and win rates in partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals. 

New Partner Experience Launch 

  • Lead the launch of new partner experiences, from new strategic partnerships to major expansions, with an integrated plan that covers analyst relations (AR), public relations (PR), social media, new content development and messaging. 
  • Direct AR and PR strategy for partner launches: analyst briefings, joint announcements, press outreach and executive spokesperson preparation, with Corporate Communications and partner teams. 
  • Set the social and digital approach for launches, including owned and partner channels, executive and employee amplification, and advocate content. 
  • Guide new content development and core messaging for each launch, including narratives, proof points, thought leadership, solution content and sales enablement, so that every channel tells one consistent story. 

People Leadership 

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of Partner Marketing Managers; set goals, manage performance, make hiring and development decisions, and build a bench for future growth. 
  • Set the standard for planning, program quality, measurement and use of AI tools that raise team capacity and campaign speed. 
  • Create a team culture of clear ownership, honest reporting and collaboration across regions and segments. 

Executive & Cross-Functional Engagement 

  • Own the overall marketing relationship with the partners, setting strategies and communicating these effectively internally and externally. Manages escalations professionally and in a timely manner while preserving trust.  
  • Build executive-level relationships with partner marketing, alliance and field leaders; represent Thomson Reuters in joint planning sessions, business reviews and partner events. 
  • Serve as the marketing counterpart to Partnerships & Alliances leadership; align segment marketing, product marketing, communications, sales enablement and operations around shared partner priorities. 
  • Report program performance, risks and investment needs to senior leaders clearly and early, and secure the decisions the team needs. 

Required Qualifications 

  • 10+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing, with significant experience in partner, channel or alliance marketing. 
  • At least 3 years of experience leading a team of marketing professionals, including hiring, performance management and development. 
  • Demonstrated success launching new partner, product or program experiences that combined analyst relations (AR), PR, social media, new content development and messaging. 
  • Demonstrated success planning and executing joint go-to-market programs with technology partners that generated measurable pipeline and revenue influence. 
  • Ability to work effectively with senior leaders and executives, internally and at partner and customer organizations, with strong executive presence. 
  • Clear written and oral communication skills, including executive briefings, messaging and presentations. 
  • Strong collaboration skills, with proven ability to influence and align cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Communications, Legal and Operations) without direct authority. 
  • Ability to manage complexity and ambiguity and to lead multiple projects at once in a fast-moving environment. 
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience defining KPIs, attributing pipeline, managing budgets and reporting results to senior leaders. 
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field. 

Strongly Preferred Qualifications 

  • Direct experience working with hyperscaler (for example AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft) or AI company partner marketing programs, including marketplace and co-sell programs. 
  • Experience with partner references and case study development programs. 
  • Experience marketing to legal, tax, accounting, audit, corporate or government audiences, or in professional-services technology. 
  • Experience managing partner funds or market development funds (MDF) and joint marketing plans. 
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing, marketing automation and CRM platforms (for example Salesforce), and with using AI tools in marketing operations. 
  • Experience leading teams across more than one region or segment. 
  • MBA or other advanced degree. 
  • Willingness to travel up to 15–30% for partner events and meetings; some international travel may be required. 

#LI-TV1

 

 

What’s in it For You?

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

job.title: Director, Sales Development
job.description:
Job Description

 

The Director, Sales Development, leads the Sales Development organization that generates qualified pipeline for the Tax, Audit & Accounting Professionals (TAAP) sales teams. This leader oversees Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) and their managers across outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification, so that sellers spend less time prospecting and more time advancing and closing opportunities. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, and Sales Operations leadership, the role sets the sales development strategy, drives a metrics-driven performance culture, and builds a talent pipeline that prepares SDRs for the next step in their sales careers at Thomson Reuters.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Lead, manage, and develop a high-performing organization of SDR managers and SDRs covering outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification across TAAP’s Strategic and Tax Workflow.
  • Set the sales development strategy and coverage model, aligning SDR capacity, segments, and territories to TAAP sales priorities and pipeline targets.
  • Set and exceed rigorous KPIs tied to pipeline and revenue outcomes, including meetings set and held, qualified opportunities created, conversion rates, and sourced and influenced pipeline.
  • Partner with Marketing to align inbound lead management, lead scoring, campaign follow-up, messaging, offers, and service-level agreements for lead response.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to define qualification and hand-off criteria, territory alignment, and feedback loops so that SDR-generated opportunities convert into closed business.
  • Work with Sales Operations to enhance CRM, sales engagement, data, and AI-enabled prospecting tools and processes across the full funnel, from leads and prospects to pipeline and forecasting.
  • Provide consistent visibility and insight into sales development activity, hand-offs, dispositions, and outcomes by team, product, segment, and individual, using data to identify trends and act on them.
  • Build a culture of learning, coaching, and accountability, actively training and coaching managers and SDRs on prospecting, qualification, discovery, and social selling.
  • Maintain a consistent talent pipeline of high-caliber SDRs and create clear career paths that prepare and promote SDRs into quota-carrying roles across TAAP sales.
  • Participate actively in sales leadership planning and forecasting, presenting performance, insights, and recommendations to senior TAAP leadership.

 

Key Deliverables

 

  • Achievement of sales development targets, including qualified meetings, opportunities created, sourced pipeline, and attributed sales across TAAP business units.
  • Measurable improvement in lead response time, lead-to-opportunity conversion, and conversion of SDR-sourced opportunities to closed business.
  • Accurate, consistent pipeline and activity reporting, with disciplined CRM hygiene and regular insights shared with Sales and Marketing leadership.
  • A documented, scalable sales development playbook, including qualification criteria, messaging, cadences, and hand-off standards, applied consistently across teams.
  • A strong SDR talent pipeline, reflected in hiring quality, ramp time, engagement, retention, and promotion of SDRs into sales roles.
  • Year-over-year improvements in SDR productivity and organizational effectiveness, including speed of execution and alignment with TAAP sales priorities.

 

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of B2B sales or sales development experience, including 4+ years leading SDR, BDR, or inside sales teams; experience leading people managers strongly preferred.
  • A proven track record of building predictable pipeline and meeting or exceeding pipeline and revenue KPIs at scale.
  • Advanced competencies in lead generation, lead qualification, prospecting, social selling, and inside sales across people, process, systems, and data.
  • A solid understanding of demand generation fundamentals and experience partnering with Marketing on inbound lead management.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using CRM (such as Salesforce) and sales engagement platforms to analyze performance, derive insights, and improve results.
  • Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining early-career sales talent and building career paths into quota-carrying roles.
  • Experience working in matrixed organizations, leading change, and building strong relationships with sales, marketing, and operations stakeholders.

job.title: Distinguished Engineer, AI Threat Defense
job.description:
About the Role
 

Thomson Reuters is enhancing its Cyber Defense capability in response to an AI-driven threat landscape that has fundamentally changed the speed, scale, and nature of cyberattacks.
 

The Distinguished Engineer, AI Threat Defense is a senior individual contributor and technical authority within the Cyber Defense organization. Reporting to the VP of Cyber Defense, this role will shape how Thomson Reuters anticipates, detects, investigates, and responds to threats affecting AI-enabled products, services, and enterprise operations.
 

This is a highly influential, hands-on technical role with no direct reports. You will lead through engineering depth, sound judgment, architecture, collaboration, and mentorship—working across SOC Operations, CIRT, Threat Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, Attack Surface Reduction, Cyber Threat Management, Product Engineering, Security Engineering & Architecture, and AppSec.
 

Rather than creating a separate AI security function, you will evolve core Cyber Defense capabilities to address AI-specific threats and responsibly apply AI across established detection, investigation, and response processes.
 

What You'll Do

  • Set the technical direction for AI threat defense across Thomson Reuters, ensuring AI-specific risks are addressed through the organization's core cyber defense strategy, architecture, engineering practices, and operating model.

  • Define how the organization monitors, detects, investigates, and responds to attacks involving AI-enabled products, LLM applications, agentic workflows, models, AI infrastructure, and associated integrations.

  • Develop defensive approaches for AI-specific threats, including prompt injection, jailbreaks and guardrail bypass, sensitive-information and system-prompt disclosure, unsafe downstream execution, excessive agent autonomy, unauthorized tool use, MCP exploitation, model and data poisoning, AI supply-chain compromise, model denial-of-service and denial-of-wallet attacks, model, prompt, and intellectual-property theft, and deepfake-enabled social engineering.

  • Partner with Product Engineering, Security Engineering & Architecture, and AppSec to establish secure, observable, and defensible patterns for AI-enabled applications, services, infrastructure, agents, and tool-use workflows.

  • Ensure AI security requirements, meaningful telemetry, and response readiness are designed into the software development lifecycle and production operating environment.

  • Strengthen existing security telemetry, detection engineering, monitoring, incident investigation, and response practices to identify and contain AI-related threats effectively.

  • Architect the responsible use of AI within the existing 24/7 SOC and CIRT operating model to improve triage, investigation, decision-making, response execution, and analyst effectiveness.

  • Develop detection content, security analytics, investigation methods, playbooks, and response workflows that enable SOC and CIRT teams to investigate and respond to AI-related security events.

  • Maintain appropriate human oversight, evidence quality, auditability, safeguards, and rollback mechanisms as AI capabilities are adopted within Cyber Defense operations.

  • Track emerging offensive AI capabilities, adversary tooling, threat-actor adoption, AI vulnerability research, and changes in the broader threat landscape, translating findings into practical defensive improvements.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship across Cyber Defense, raising organizational capability in AI security, detection engineering, threat analysis, and incident response.

  • Influence technical decisions through architecture reviews, technical standards, direct engineering collaboration, design guidance, and clear communication with technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Represent Thomson Reuters in relevant customer discussions, industry groups, regulatory engagements, and AI security communities.
     

About You
 

You are a deeply technical cybersecurity leader who can operate at a Distinguished Engineer level without relying on formal organizational authority. You enjoy solving ambiguous, high-impact problems, establishing technical direction, and turning complex security challenges into scalable, durable capabilities.
 

You combine strong cyber defense expertise with a practical understanding of AI-enabled systems and how they are deployed, monitored, secured, and attacked. You can work comfortably across strategy and execution: shaping architecture, improving detection and response, partnering with product and engineering teams, and staying close to real-world operational outcomes.
 

You build trust through technical credibility, collaboration, sound judgment, and a commitment to helping others succeed. You can communicate complex AI security risks and trade-offs clearly to engineers, analysts, architects, executives, customers, and regulators.
 

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, security architecture, threat detection, incident response, or a related technical field.

  • Experience operating as a Principal, Staff, Distinguished Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leader within a large, complex organization.

  • Strong hands-on experience in Cyber Defense, including detection engineering, security operations, threat hunting, security analytics, incident response, security architecture, or closely related disciplines.

  • A proven ability to establish technical strategy and deliver security capabilities that are adopted across multiple teams, systems, and operating functions.

  • Practical experience securing or governing AI-enabled systems, including LLM applications, AI infrastructure, models, agentic workflows, AI integrations, MCP, or comparable tool-use patterns.

  • Strong understanding of AI security risks, including prompt injection, data exposure, unsafe model output and downstream execution, agent and tool abuse, model and data poisoning, AI supply-chain risk, and AI-enabled social engineering.

  • Proven experience architecting or delivering AI-assisted detection and response capabilities within a mature 24/7 SOC, CIRT, or comparable cyber defense environment.

  • Experience strengthening an established security organization and driving adoption of security capabilities across SOC Operations, CIRT, Threat Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, and Attack Surface Reduction.

  • Ability to translate AI security risks into clear architectural patterns, engineering requirements, detection logic, and actionable incident-response practices.

  • Experience partnering with Product Engineering, Security Engineering & Architecture, and AppSec teams to embed security into development and production processes.

  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across executive leadership, engineers, architects, analysts, incident responders, customers, regulators, and other stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor technical professionals and raise the technical capability of a broader security organization.

  • Experience operating within a regulated, multi-segment enterprise and partnering across legal, compliance, procurement, governance, engineering, and security organizations.

  • Experience in financial services, legal technology, professional information services, or another highly regulated industry is preferred.

  • Experience embedding significant technical capabilities into an established security operations organization is preferred.

  • Hands-on experience building or operating agentic AI systems across multiple LLMs, including open-weight, hosted, and frontier models, is preferred.

  • Experience applying AI within SAST, AppSec, vulnerability management, detection engineering, or security operations workflows is preferred.

  • Working knowledge of safely operating open-weight or less-restricted models for authorized internal security research is a plus.

  • Familiarity with frontier AI vulnerability research programs or comparable agentic vulnerability-discovery initiatives is a plus.

  • Active participation in AI security research, open-source communities, industry groups, conference speaking, or published research is a plus.

  • Relevant certifications in cybersecurity, cloud security, AI/ML security, or detection engineering are beneficial but not required.

     

#LI-LP2

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

job.title: Lead Applied Scientist
job.description:
About the Role

Are you ready to work at the forefront of applied AI research, where your work reaches real customers instead of staying in a lab notebook?


Thomson Reuters Labs (TR Labs) is the AI Research & Development arm of Thomson Reuters. We experiment, we build, we deliver.

Our mission is to create industry-leading AI solutions for Legal and Tax & Accounting professionals. These people make decisions that affect businesses, courts, markets, and lives.

We systematically explore emerging AI/ML technologies, and we stay focused on real customer problems and opportunities.


The Lead Applied Scientist is a senior, high-influence scientific leader within TR Labs. In this role, you will set the research strategy and lead the initiatives that shape Thomson Reuters' AI/ML roadmap across multiple product features.


You will drive innovation in specialized domains such as legal reasoning, document understanding, and knowledge graphs. You will establish the best practices and technical vision that other teams build on.


You will also serve as a thought leader, both inside Thomson Reuters and in the wider AI community, mentoring scientists across Labs and leading engagement with key stakeholders.


This is a role for someone who wants their ideas to ship. You will work with product, engineering, and business leaders to turn new methods into capabilities that customers use every day.


What You'll Do

  • Define the research strategy for your focus areas and align it with Thomson Reuters' AI/ML roadmap across multiple product features.
  • Lead high-impact initiatives from early experimentation through to production-ready AI capabilities.
  • Drive innovation in specialized domains such as legal reasoning, document understanding, and knowledge graphs.
  • Design, evaluate, and advance RAG architectures, agentic frameworks, and tool-using systems for complex professional use cases.
  • Establish best practices, evaluation methodologies, and technical standards that raise the quality bar across Labs.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer problems and the data that informs them, and translate that understanding into the right AI solutions.
  • Show how novel methods can influence product roadmaps and business outcomes.
  • Lead stakeholder engagement across product, engineering, and business teams.
  • Mentor and grow scientists across Labs, building scientific depth and leadership capability.
  • Provide thought leadership through internal forums, external publications, conferences, and industry communities.
  • Deliver production-quality code with well-managed software and MLOps practices.

About You

You are a scientist who gets energy from turning hard, ambiguous problems into working solutions. You are comfortable moving between research and execution.


You can read a new paper in the morning, prototype an idea in the afternoon, and explain its business impact to a product leader the next day.


You combine deep technical expertise in modern AI with a strong product mindset. You are curious about the professional domains you work in, whether that is law, tax, medicine, or risk, and you want to understand customers' problems well enough to solve them properly.


You lead by influence. You build trust through scientific rigor, clear communication, and a genuine commitment to helping the people around you grow. You can explain complex ideas clearly to scientists, engineers, executives, and customers.


Qualifications

  • PhD or Master's degree with equivalent industry experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience building production IR, NLP, ML, or GenAI systems using modern techniques.
  • Demonstrated experience leading through others in cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end AI capabilities.
  • Strong product mindset, with the ability to translate complex customer problems into successful AI applications.
  • Proven ability to demonstrate novel methods that influence product roadmaps and business outcomes.
  • Outstanding communication and analytical skills.
  • Deep expertise in RAG architectures, agentic frameworks, tool-using systems, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Significant experience developing novel methods for complex professional domains such as medical, tax, or law.
  • Publications at top-tier venues (ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGIR, KDD).
  • Experience delivering production code with well-managed software/MLOps practices.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer AI (Staff Engineer)
job.description:
Thomson Reuters products power professionals shaping the world across legal, tax, accounting, and audit. As a Lead Software Engineer AI (Staff Engineer AI) on Cloud Audit Suite, you will own backend and AI orchestration systems that transform frontier models into reliable, production-grade workflows at scale. You'll also help drive our transition to an AI-native engineering organization where AI accelerates development and engineers provide technical leadership, architecture, and judgment.

About the Role

  • As a Lead Software Engineer AI (Staff Engineer), you will be responsible for the architecture and technical direction of Audit Suite.
  • Define AI engineering patterns for MCP servers, agent frameworks, LLM integration, experimentation, and scalable infrastructure.
  • Build systems operating across millions of documents, structured financial data, evolving regulations, and thousands of concurrent AI interactions.
  • Lead across engineering, product, UX, and AI teams to rapidly design and deliver customer-facing solutions.
  • Set technical direction, mentor senior engineers, and stay hands-on in architecture and code.
  • Drive platform integration strategy across Thomson Reuters audit systems.

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Lead strategic initiatives spanning AI, platform, and infrastructure.
  • Mentor engineers and elevate system design, code quality, and AI engineering practices.
  • Partner with AI/ML teams, researchers, designers, and product managers to convert emerging AI capabilities into trusted customer solutions.
  • Influence roadmap, technical strategy, experimentation, testing, rollout practices, and operational excellence.

Design & Own AI-First Backend Systems

  • Architect and build backend services using C#/.NET, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, and Vercel that power AI-driven workflows and document-centric experiences.
  • Develop AI orchestration capabilities including MCP servers, tool calling, workflow routing, guardrails, reliability, and LLM integrations.
  • Scale, Reliability & Performance
  • Design high-throughput, low-latency AI systems using caching, queuing, rate limiting, failover, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Build retrieval and search systems leveraging large document collections, vector databases, and indexing technologies.
  • Establish observability, SLOs, and incident management practices for auditable and trustworthy AI systems.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years in technical leadership roles and 3+ years building scalable cloud applications, APIs, and AI-enabled products.
  • Proven track record of shipping production-grade AI systems to customers, including deployment, monitoring, evaluation, scaling, and ongoing operational ownership in enterprise environments.
  • Full Stack experience with Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React or Angular.
  • Strong distributed systems expertise, including APIs, data modeling, observability, resiliency, and performance optimization.
  • Proven success leading complex projects from architecture through long-term operation.
  • Deep interest in AI-native software, including LLMs, agents, retrieval, and modern AI development patterns.

Preferred Experience

  • CI/CD experience, including GitHub Actions.
  • Hands-on experience integrating LLM platforms such as OpenAI and Anthropic into production applications.
  • Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval systems.
  • Experience with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL/SQL Server, and cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
  • Experience in highly regulated domains such as tax, audit, legal, fintech, or other compliance-focused industries.

job.title: Manager, GTM Sales Systems
job.description:
Manager, GTM Sales Systems

Job Description

Westbridge Print is an independent company formed on October 1, 2026, when Thomson Reuters completed a joint venture with KKR for its Global Print business. Westbridge Print provides legal and tax information in print and on ProView to legal and tax professionals, governments, law schools, and corporations, and offers commercial printing services to book publishers worldwide. Join us to help shape the next chapter of Westbridge Print.

 

We are hiring a Manager, GTM Sales Systems in our Revenue Operations department in Eagan, Minnesota. This hybrid role is the integrator and technical subject-matter expert between Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and IT. You will translate commercial needs into clear, testable requirements, make sure IT and vendors build to that intent, and make sure the business adopts the results. You will lead the business side of Westbridge Print's transition to standalone GTM systems and then own the long-term health and effectiveness of those systems.

This is a project-management-intensive role. The first priority is a clean, controlled transition to standalone systems. The ongoing priority is continuous improvement that keeps our GTM platform aligned to how we sell. IT and vendors execute the build, migration, and testing. This role provides the business direction, requirements, and acceptance.


Location: Eagan, MN (Opperman Campus), Hybrid
Reports To: Director, Revenue Operations

Key Responsibilities

Standalone Systems Transition

  • Lead the business side of the transition of GTM systems and data to standalone platforms, including planning, cutover readiness, and post-go-live stabilization
  • Define requirements, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and data migration validation criteria, and confirm they are met
  • Map dependencies across Salesforce, quoting and order capture, reporting, and finance systems to protect revenue-critical processes
  • Provide business input into architecture, integration, migration, and vendor selection decisions

Platform Governance

  • Provide business-side design authority for the Salesforce data model, object and field standards, process logic, security, and sharing
  • Facilitate the needs assessment, prioritization, and approval of new or enhanced systems
  • Build, maintain, and communicate a GTM systems roadmap
  • Evaluate every change request for business value, architecture impact, and long-term maintenance before approval
  • Own core GTM data definitions, such as account, opportunity, and product hierarchies, so every report and process uses the same logic
  • Define and enforce change and release governance, including sandbox use, deployment approval criteria, and documentation standards
  • Lead business acceptance testing for every release and major upgrade, define acceptance criteria and test scenarios, and sign off on results
  • Document and maintain clear process and training instructions for users

Business and IT Integration

  • Translate sales and revenue process requirements into prioritized, well-specified requirements that technical teams can build against
  • Confirm through review and traceability that developers and administrators understand business intent
  • Review technical designs and test plans with IT and vendor teams for business fit, and challenge solutions that miss intent
  • Serve as the single point of accountability between business stakeholders and technical teams, from requirement to production to adoption
  • Represent Sales in cross-functional programs where process, system, or metric changes affect go-to-market performance

Revenue Operations Partnership

  • Partner with the Senior Manager, Global Print Revenue Operations to align on business needs, prioritization, and system utilization
  • Hold a shared intake and prioritization cadence with Rev Ops leadership to balance quick wins, compliance needs, and strategic builds
  • Partner with Sales Managers, Sales Ops, and Sales Training to prioritize fixes, provide training, and optimize functionality

Reporting, Data, and Continuous Improvement

  • Define and govern the reporting architecture and standards on the platform data model so leadership works from one version of the truth
  • Partner with Finance and data governance teams to set ownership and stewardship for critical sales data
  • Measure adoption and efficiency of GTM systems against defined metrics

Planning and Governance

  • Lead annual planning and budgeting for GTM systems and tools, including licenses, implementation, and vendor costs
  • Provide business-side governance, prioritization, and acceptance for outsourced or offshore delivery. Delivery leadership sits with IT or the vendor.

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, business systems, or a related role, including ownership of end-to-end business process and system change
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce configuration and automation (Flow, validation rules, formula fields, page layouts), security and sharing model design, reports and dashboards, and sandbox and deployment management, sufficient to assess feasibility, challenge technical designs, and validate delivered solutions
  • Proven project manager who has delivered projects from requirements through production and adoption, including work led by IT or external vendors
  • Demonstrated integrator who is credible with executives, sales leaders, and technical teams, and who can write requirements that engineers and administrators can act on
  • Experience reviewing technical designs and test plans with IT or vendor teams to confirm they meet business intent, without leading development or test delivery
  • Experience leading a system migration, integration, or platform separation
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data, including validating data quality and building metrics people trust
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present technical content to executive and general audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator certification (Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder also valued)
  • Experience with CPQ, order management, or quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience in B2B manufacturing, print, distribution, or industrial sales environments
  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps tools or formal release management
  • Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, computer science, or a related field; graduate degree a plus

Success Measures

First 90 days: A transition plan is agreed with clear owners, dependencies, and cutover risks. Acceptance criteria are defined for every in-flight release.

First 12 months: The standalone cutover is completed without revenue-impacting outages. One GTM systems roadmap is defined, prioritized, and adopted by Sales and IT. Data quality and user adoption improve against targets set in the first 90 days. Every release has documented acceptance criteria and business sign-off before go-live. Requirements are traceable to approved business needs.


What Makes This Role Work

The strongest candidates are pragmatic and organized. They can hold a firm line on scope and quality when pressure builds, explain trade-offs in business terms, and stay calm through ambiguity. They ask the right questions of engineers and testers, and they know when to challenge a design rather than rebuild it. They build trust with Sales by delivering on commitments and build trust with IT by writing clear requirements and respecting technical constraints.

This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

.Manager, Software Engineering, CoCounsel

Job Description

Legal Outbound Integrations Legal professionals don’t do their work in one place. They live in AI assistants, productivity suites, and the practice and document platforms their firms already run on. What if trusted legal AI met them there, wherever they work? Do you want to lead the team that takes the world’s leading legal AI assistant to every surface where legal work happens? CoCounsel Outbound Integrations brings CoCounsel’s legal agent, content, and skills into the platforms lawyers already use: leading AI assistants, enterprise productivity tools, and partner legal applications, built on open standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The first integrations are live and more are coming. Because these platforms change monthly, this is a product that needs dedicated, ongoing ownership, not a one-time build. You will lead a senior, high-ownership, AI-native team that delivers across internal platform teams and external partners

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a Manager, Software Engineering, you will:

•         Lead and empower a senior engineering team: own hiring, performance, career growth, and promotion advocacy, and create the conditions for experienced engineers to own technical direction, backing them with delivery management and organizational air cover.

•         Build an AI-native team: set the bar for how the team builds software with coding agents and spec-driven development, so small squads ship with high leverage and high quality.

•         Own outcomes, not just integrations: be accountable for adoption, reliability, and quality of CoCounsel on every surface the team ships to, and use that data to decide what to build next with product.

•         Ship on platforms you don’t control: plan and unblock work that depends on internal agent, platform, and identity teams and on external platform providers; negotiate scope, favor incremental and feature-flagged releases, and keep pace as partner platforms, protocols, and APIs change underneath you.

•         Invest in the shared integration layer: push the team toward a common core (authentication, tool and API contracts, observability, conformance testing) so each new surface costs less than the last.

•         Work directly with partners and customers: partner with external engineering teams, deployment engineers, and customer IT and security teams to launch integrations and get them through enterprise security and compliance reviews.

•         Own reliability and trust across surfaces: drive monitoring, release safety, and supportability for integrations running in other companies’ environments, to the standard legal professionals depend on

 

Required Qualifications

•         2+ years of direct people-management experience for software engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development.

•         8+ years of overall software engineering experience, including hands-on work building backend services and APIs (Python, TypeScript, or similar), with the technical depth to review designs and prototype yourself, not just discuss them.

•         Experience building or operating integrations, APIs, or extensions on third-party platforms, including managing the dependency when the platform changed underneath you.

•         Hands-on use of AI coding agents in your own work, and experience changing how a team builds software with them.

•         Demonstrated delivery management under fixed external deadlines with much of the critical path outside your team: scope negotiation, incremental delivery, feature-flag strategies, and clear risk communication to leadership.

•         Comfort operating amid organizational and product ambiguity: you stay effective, and keep a team motivated, while ownership boundaries, partner commitments, and scope are still being settled

 

Preferred Qualifications

•         Experience building LLM-powered or agentic products, including hands-on familiarity with MCP, tool calling, or AI assistant extension and plugin ecosystems.

•         Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, or partner ecosystems that external teams build on.

•         Experience taking integrations through enterprise security and compliance reviews, ideally in regulated industries (legal, tax, financial services).

•         Experience leading distributed teams that blend full-time engineers and contractors across time zones.

•         Experience growing senior individual contributors into technical leadership roles.

job.title: Partner Marketing Manager - AI Partners
job.description:
Job Description 

What if you helped shape how trusted professional content and frontier AI come together for the people who rely on them most: lawyers, tax and audit professionals, corporate teams and governments? 

As Partner Marketing Manager for AI & Hyperscaler Partners, you own the joint marketing plans for Thomson Reuters’ relationships with AI companies, such as Anthropic, Open AI, AWS, Google, Microsoft and more. You build the stories, programs and proof points that show why combining Thomson Reuters content and expertise with leading AI models creates value for our customers, and you turn them into campaigns, announcements, enablement and pipeline. You also lead the launch of new partner experiences, including activations across social media, content and messaging. 

AI partnerships move quickly and are closely watched by customers, press and analysts. You will work with Partnerships & Alliances, Product Marketing, Communications, Sales and the segment marketing teams to build messaging and programs that are accurate, differentiated and approved. You will also work with partner marketing and communications counterparts on joint announcements and thought leadership. This is a high-ownership role for someone who likes a fast-moving space and is equally at ease with narrative and with measurement. 


Key Responsibilities

Partner GTM & Narrative 

  • Own the joint go-to-market plan across marketing for your AI partners, defining objectives, target segments, campaign strategy and success metrics, aligned with Partnerships & Alliances priorities. 
  • Develop and maintain joint messaging and value propositions that explain the combined offering clearly for Legal Professionals, TAAP, Corporates and Government audiences. 
  • Coordinate partner-related product and integration launches with Product Marketing, so messaging, timing, claims and launch activity are aligned. 

Pipeline & Revenue Impact 

  • Plan and deliver co-marketing programs including digital campaigns, webinars, executive roundtables, events and content that create qualified pipeline. 
  • Build field-ready programs that help Thomson Reuters sellers bring AI partner offerings into customer conversations. 
  • Define and track KPIs for each program, including pipeline created, influenced revenue, engagement and return on investment, and use the data to optimize. 

New Partner Experience Launch 

  • Lead and coordinate launches of new partner experiences for your AI partners, working across relevant business functions such as analyst relations (AR), public relations (PR), social media. 
  • Plan activity for launches, such as events, social activation, joint announcements and press outreach, with Corporate Communications and partner teams. 
  • Create and run social media plans for launches across Thomson Reuters and partner channels, including advocate and employee amplification. 
  • Develop launch content and messaging, including narratives, solution briefs, web content, thought leadership and enablement assets, aligned across all channels. 

Thought Leadership, PR & Advocacy 

  • Work with Corporate Communications, Brand and partner teams on joint announcements, press and analyst briefings, thought leadership and social content. 
  • Identify and prepare customer and partner advocates for case studies, speaking opportunities, press and campaigns, working with the customer advocacy program and respecting legal and approval requirements. 
  • Help make advocates and proof points accessible to Sales through clear catalogs and guidance. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operations 

  • Serve as a primary marketing contact for Partnerships & Alliances on your AI partners. 
  • Collaborate with Legal, Product, Security and Communications to ensure partner claims, customer references and AI-related messaging are accurate and approved. 
  • Coordinate logistics for co-marketing events and activations, and maintain partner contact records and campaign-generated leads with Marketing Operations. 
  • Use AI tools to increase speed, capacity and quality of campaign planning and content production. 

Required Qualifications 

  • 7+ years of experience in partner marketing, product marketing, alliance marketing or related B2B technology marketing. 
  • Partner marketing domain expertise. 
  • Experience marketing AI, machine learning or generative AI products or partnerships. 
  •   
  • Demonstrated experience building and executing joint go-to-market or co-marketing plans with technology partners. 
  • Experience launching new programs, partnerships or products leveraging PR, social media, new content development and messaging. 
  • Ability to work effectively with senior leaders and executives, internally and at partner organizations. 
  • Clear written and oral communication skills, including executive briefings, messaging and partner pitches. 
  • Strong collaboration skills, with proven ability to influence and align teams across Sales, Product, Communications and Marketing without direct authority. 
  • Ability to manage complexity and ambiguity and to run multiple projects at once, meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Data-driven approach: ability to define success metrics, analyze campaign performance and present insights to senior stakeholders. 
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience with joint announcements, press and analyst relations, or customer advocacy and case study programs. 
  • Experience marketing to legal, tax, accounting, audit, corporate or government audiences, or in professional-services technology. 
  • Familiarity with responsible-AI, security and compliance considerations that affect how AI offerings are described to regulated customers. 
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (for example Salesforce) and with account-based marketing. 
  • Ability to travel up to 20–30% for partner events and meetings. Some potential international travel.

#LI-TV1

 

 

What’s in it For You?

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

job.title: Planning, Assignments & Photography Editor, Africa
job.description:
Job Description


Planning, Assignments and Photography Editor, Sub-Saharan Africa


Reuters is looking for an experienced and highly organised editorial leader to oversee the deployment of journalists, equipment and technology for breaking and daily news coverage in Africa.


This role will ensure Reuters delivers cohesive, high-impact journalism across all formats — text, video and pictures — by aligning field operations across the region with editorial priorities and helping deliver coverage that meets client expectations.


The successful candidate will be detail-oriented with a strategic mindset, able to balance logistics with the broader editorial picture. They will be passionate about equipping journalists with the right skills and technology to deliver lightning-fast breaking news and memorable reporting that reaches the front page and leads the bulletin.

They will work closely with regional Editors to coordinate coverage across formats and platforms. They will bring strong news judgement, excellent communication skills and the ability to prioritise in a fast-moving environment.


The right candidate will also be a specialist in photography, helping ensure Reuters remains "first and best" in news, sport and entertainment coverage. In addition to responsibilities across text and video, they will work with the Global Director of Photography to deliver breadth, speed and quality across the Reuters pictures file while driving innovation through feedback and mentorship.

The successful candidate may also represent Reuters' photographic excellence externally, including meeting with clients, supporting certification and provenance initiatives, and speaking at industry events and photojournalism forums.


Key Responsibilities


  • Coordinate field deployment of journalists and logistics for breaking news coverage.
  • Work with newsroom leaders to determine staffing levels that match the ambition and scope of coverage.
  • Work closely with staff and freelance photographers, as well as the Global Director of Photography, to maintain Reuters' high editorial and visual standards.
  • Provide feedback, mentorship and talent development across the region to foster a strong photographic culture.
  • Troubleshoot and mitigate staffing challenges during fast-moving news cycles.
  • Lead cross-format planning for major news events and editorial initiatives, ensuring cohesive execution across teams.
  • Utilise planning tools to maintain accurate, accessible and client-ready coverage calendars.
  • Communicate with clients in real time regarding coverage as required.
  • Collaborate with commercial and product teams to improve newsroom planning systems and workflows.
  • Work closely with the Editorial Safety Team.
  • Ensure coverage is delivered within agreed budgets and that deployment costs are managed efficiently.
  • Anticipate coverage needs and move people and resources ahead of major developing stories.
  • Make clear deployment decisions quickly as news priorities change.



Required Qualifications


  • Strong editorial judgement and operational decision-making under pressure.
  • Deep understanding of visual workflows and newsroom technologies.
  • Excellent photography and photo-editing skills, with knowledge of the latest developments in photojournalism technology.
  • Outstanding communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills.
  • Familiarity with newsroom safety protocols and planning workflows.
  • Proven track record in planning, production or senior coordination roles within a fast-paced newsroom.
  • Commitment to Reuters Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, develop and retain talent.
  • Strong knowledge of Africa and proven experience working in hostile and challenging environments.
  • Ability to coordinate complex coverage across multiple bureaus and countries.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Proven track record leading cross-format coverage across text, video and pictures, with the ability to coordinate complex, multi-country deployments during major breaking news events.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive newsroom innovation through new technologies, digital workflows, AI-enabled tools or content provenance initiatives.
  • Experience representing a news organisation externally through client engagement, industry forums, training programmes or partnerships.
  • Proven ability to direct coverage of major breaking news, elections, conflicts, disasters or other complex events.
  • Experience directing field teams and coordinating deployment across multiple bureaux.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and their application in planning, research, production or newsroom workflows.
  • A strong record of mentoring and developing journalists, photographers and producers in a high-pressure newsroom.

#LI-JB2

 

 

What’s in it For You?

At Reuters, our people are our greatest assets. Here are some of the benefits we offer for your personal and professional growth:

  • Global Career: As a global company, we can offer a truly international career and progression opportunities.

  • Learning & Development: On the job learning and coaching. We also have a dedicated training team focused on the continuous development of our journalists.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits:  We offer competitive salary packages and market leading benefits including paid volunteering days.

  • Perks: Work alongside Pulitzer Prize-winning journalists and a team who provide unmatched, award-winning coverage of the world’s most important stories.

About Reuters

Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider. Founded in 1851, it is committed to the Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias. With unmatched coverage in over 16 languages, and reaching billions of people worldwide every day, Reuters provides trusted intelligence that powers humans and machines to make smart decisions. It supplies business, financial, national and international news to professionals via desktop terminals, the world's media organizations, industry events and directly to consumers.
