job.title: Principal Architect, E-Invoicing Solutions
job.description:
Job Description


We are seeking a high-impact Principal Architect to serve as our central subject matter expert in global e-invoicing, regulatory compliance, and platform architecture. This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide reach, operating beyond traditional single-project allocation to influence delivery, pre-sales, and customer strategy. In this role, you will be the definitive go-to authority across all delivery projects, pre-sales engagements, and customer-facing interactions. You will leverage your deep mastery of the Pagero platform, hands-on integration expertise, and understanding of national e-invoicing authorities to solve complex technical challenges, shape strategic solutions, and translate intricate regulatory frameworks into clear, actionable guidance for our teams and clients.


Key Responsibilities:


Cross-Project Advisory & Escalation

  • Serve as the senior technical and functional escalation authority across all active delivery projects, resolving complex platform, integration, and compliance roadblocks.
  • Diagnose and solve the most challenging edge cases across the delivery portfolio, including non-standard ERP configurations, complex data transformation requirements, and multi-country mandate flows.
  • Design and establish reusable reference architectures, standard configuration templates, playbooks, and best-practice frameworks to scale delivery quality and consistency across the organization.

Pre-Sales & Commercial Enablement

  • Act as the dedicated Pagero platform and compliance expert for sales and pre-sales teams, providing deep functional and technical insight without holding direct ownership of SOW creation or pricing.
  • Advise solution architects and pre-sales consultants on platform capabilities, limitations, architectural fit, and feasibility.
  • Participate in high-stakes, customer-facing technical discussions for strategic enterprise opportunities.
  • Review proposed solution designs from pre-sales and delivery teams to ensure technical accuracy, platform feasibility, and regulatory alignment.

Customer Mandate & Regulatory Guidance

  • Act as the trusted advisor for enterprise clients navigating complex global e-invoicing mandates, clearance flows, format specifications (e.g., Peppol, UBL, XML), and government platform integrations.
  • Engage directly with customer stakeholders and liaise with national e-invoicing and tax authorities when necessary to secure formal regulatory clarifications.
  • Author and review customer-facing compliance roadmaps, mandate checklists, and country-specific onboarding documentation.

Team Onboarding, Training & Knowledge Management

  • Own the technical onboarding journey for new team members, developing and executing structured onboarding programs that build Pagero platform and compliance proficiency from day one.
  • Foster continuous skill development across delivery teams through tailored training sessions, hands-on coaching, certification guidance, and internal knowledge-sharing forums.
  • Build, maintain, and expand an internal Pagero Knowledge Base and learning curriculum covering country-specific mandates, integration patterns, and platform updates.
  • Partner with delivery leadership to identify capability gaps across teams and deploy targeted technical enablement initiatives.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Deep Pagero Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience and expert-level functional and technical mastery of the Pagero platform ecosystem.
  • Domain Knowledge: Extensive knowledge of global e-invoicing regulations, continuous transaction controls (CTC), clearance models, Peppol networks, and digital tax reporting requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Integration & ERP Proficiency: Strong technical background in enterprise application integration (EAI), API frameworks, and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics), alongside deep familiarity with standard data formats (XML, JSON, EDI, UBL, CSV).
  • Architecture & Advisory Experience: Substantial experience operating in a Lead Architect, Principal Consultant, or Senior Subject Matter Expert capacity across complex enterprise deployments.
  • Pre-Sales Acumen: Demonstrated track record supporting pre-sales teams with technical solution reviews, discovery calls, and RFP responses.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical and regulatory nuances to both executive business leaders and technical engineering teams.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience directly interfacing or collaborating with national tax authorities, e-invoicing standard bodies, or working groups.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing a Center of Excellence (CoE) or structured technical training and onboarding curriculum within an enterprise technology or consulting environment.
  • Relevant industry or architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Cloud Certifications, or ERP-specific accreditations).
  • Multilingual proficiency, particularly in languages relevant to major emerging e-invoicing mandate regions (e.g., Spanish, French, German, Arabic).

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

job.title: Renewals & Retention Lead
job.description:
Job Description


Renewals are the base of Corporates’ recurring revenue. This role partners across functions and helps create and own the early-warning system for churn and contraction and makes sure those signals drive action in Sales, Customer Success, and across our Account and Renewal Specialist teams. You will partner with Finance and Retention leaders and be accountable for renewal outcomes in the revenue forecast, and you will lead the approvals and escalations that come with existing customer contracts.


Key responsibilities

  • Build and run early-warning signals for churn and contraction using usage data, support signals, and account health, working with Finance, Retention Teams, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Produce prioritized at-risk account lists for Customer Success, Sales, and Retention teams, each with a named owner and next step.
  • Partner with Finance and Retention leadership to understand the renewals forecast and be accountable for renewal outcomes in the revenue forecast.
  • In partnership with customer-facing teams, create retention and expansion levers that accelerate revenue, and measure their results.
  • Lead individual approvals, escalations, and non-standard agreements for existing customers and contracts.
  • Work with Pricing on renewal price positions and with Legal on contract terms.

Key partners

  • Finance, Customer Success, Sales, Pricing & Commercial Lead, Deal Desk, General Counsel, and Analytics, BI & Forecasting.

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years in renewals, customer success, account management, or retention leadership in a subscription business.
  • Track record of improving gross and net retention through structured programs.
  • Experience with health scoring or propensity models, and comfort working with usage and CRM data.
  • Experience with enterprise customers and multi-year contracts, and sound judgment on approvals and escalations.

job.title: Sales Executive - Legal Software
job.description:
Job Description


This position drives new business and expansion of Thomson Reuters legal software within small-to-midsize corporate legal departments. You will own legal software quota for Commercial SMB and manage each opportunity from first conversation through closed deal and successful handoff. You will be expected to meet/exceed sales quota and customer engagement activity targets (emphasis on account outreach, discovery conversations, and pipeline progression) as established.


This position supports the efforts of the SMB Corporates organization within Thomson Reuters Legal by helping General Counsels, Legal Operations leaders, Chief Legal Officers, and CFOs control outside counsel spend, streamline matter and contract workflows, and modernize legal operations (products include, but are not limited to HighQ and Legal Tracker).


This role requires an experienced professional, consultative seller who can quickly diagnose each customer’s current workflows, articulate the value of our products, overcome resistance to change, and guide buyers through a smooth purchase and onboarding experience.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prospect and qualify General Counsels, Legal Operations leaders, Finance/Procurement, and end users at assigned SMB corporate legal accounts through outbound calls, email, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and inbound leads, then schedule discovery and demo conversations.
  • Run discovery to uncover pain points around outside counsel billing, matter tracking, contract management, and process bottlenecks, then map those workflows to product capabilities through pre-demo calls, short demos, and in-person or web-based appointments.
  • Own a defined target account list and drive each opportunity from first outreach through close and successful onboarding, identifying and escalating budget, contract, security, or adoption risks with account-specific plans.
  • Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales quotas while maintaining a pipeline of at least 3X quota, and log all activity, stages, and close dates accurately in Salesforce.
  • Deliver accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts and account-level progress reporting, and take on other responsibilities as Sales Management requests.

Solution Positioning and Deal Execution


  • Position Legal Tracker to demonstrate immediate ROI through outside counsel spend visibility, automated invoice compliance, and rate negotiation analytics
  • Position HighQ to demonstrate workflow automation, secure document management, contract intake portals, and collaboration solutions tailored for lean in-house teams
  • Highlight integrations with CoCounsel Legal, Microsoft 365, and the broader Thomson Reuters legal technology portfolio
  • Partner with Legal Solutions Consultants to deliver tailored product demonstrations, and manage proposal creation, pricing negotiations, legal contract reviews, and the closing process
  • Establish and maintain strong sales partnerships with internal sales partners to coordinate coverage and pursue shared opportunities

Relationship Management


  • Serve as the trusted advisor for each assigned account, using consultative discovery to demonstrate clear value and build relationships across Legal, Finance/Procurement, and IT/Security stakeholders
  • Work with organizations (Marketing, Customer Success, Onboarding and Training, Product Specialists, Order Fulfillment, Customer Service, etc.) throughout Thomson Reuters to ensure sales are executed efficiently and accurately and customer issues are resolved in a timely manner
  • Actively contribute to and work responsibly in a team environment, including collaborating with Account Managers, Product Leadership, and key stakeholders who own the broader customer relationship to maximize customer retention and multi-product adoption
  • Capture customer feedback, objections, and competitive insights from conversations and share them to refine playbooks and product strategy
  • Maintain expert knowledge of Legal Tracker, HighQ, and related Thomson Reuters solutions (CoCounsel, Practical Law), along with sales programs and incentives within the sales division
  • Actively participate in meetings, training sessions and individual professional development and skill building

Required Qualifications


  • Minimum of 8 years in a customer-facing role, with at least 3 years of B2B consultative sales experience in SaaS, enterprise software, or legal technology (selling to Corporate customers, preferred), navigating complex, multi-stakeholder deals
  • Proven success managing a defined book of accounts and territory, with outbound outreach experience
  • A consistent record of quota attainment in a fast-paced, high-volume pipeline environment
  • Ability to negotiate pricing, terms, and timelines with customers within set parameters
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to embrace change
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent opportunities and prioritize effectively across the assigned target list
  • Pipeline management skills in a CRM environment, specifically Salesforce
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Qualifications


  • Legal industry knowledge, particularly corporate legal department operations, legal spend management, and the priorities of General Counsels and Legal Operations leaders
  • Law degree or corporate-sector sales experience
  • College degree in business, sales, legal studies, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

job.title: Senior Business Applications Consultant
job.description:
Job Description

If you’re an experienced Senior Business Applications Consultant who is ready to take on the challenge of collaborating with stakeholders, delivering value-added professional services for client facing engagements, this could be the right job for you. This role works alongside the Engagement Manager, Solutions Engineer, and other members of TRCMS for successful delivery of the end to end software solution for our clients. Analyzing requirements, configuring the C-Track solution, participating in data migration activities and provide customer facing training are key functions of this role. The Senior Business Applications Consultant is primarily externally focused and plays a supporting role for product management activities


Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as Senior Business Applications Consultant, you will: 

  • Take the lead in mentoring Business Applications Consultants on the team. 
  • Find innovative ways to reduce implementation time/cost by standardizing team processes, standards, and best practices.
  • Conduct configuration review sessions across teams to ensure optimal implementation of product features to best meet client requirements.
  • Serve as the primary senior C-Track product and solutions expert for both the client and TRCMS advocating a product first approach.
  • Lead or support requirements gathering and business analysis through techniques such as: Review current system documentation, map business requirements to functional specifications, business process modeling, data gathering etc.
  • Organize and analyze materials such as design and test specifications, design documents, and other scoping material. 
  • Complete tasks with input from Engagement Manager or Senior Business Applications Consultant. Work is project-oriented and day to day tasks must be defined by employee and engagement manager. 
  • Support the development of customer specific test plans in collaboration with the Quality Assurance team to test, validate, evaluate new applications and functions, and determine issues in services and software.
  • Lead or support data analysis and mapping activities from one system to another.
  • Travel may be required approx. (5-20%) to support project activities, training, and go-lives.

Required Qualifications

Our ideal candidate brings a strong combination of business analysis experience.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field required.
  • 5-7+ years or relevant work experience required.
  • A passion for learning and mastering complex system functionality and techniques quickly through instruction and self-training. The ability to flexibly adapt to a changing environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to comfortably and confidently present to groups. Must have the ability to communicate complex information in a concise, logical manner.
  • Highly organized and computer literate with excellent analytic and problem-solving abilities.
  • Must have an excellent ability to reach out and build relationships across teams in a remote working environment.

job.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters is seeking a senior techno-functional consultant to lead SAP integration for enterprise indirect tax automation projects. You'll be the SAP integration subject matter expert on engagements that connect ONESOURCE Indirect Tax Determination with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Ariba. You'll work closely with our US consulting team and with client project teams, and you'll help our partners deliver these implementations successfully.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead requirements and analysis workshops with clients to define business, process, functional, and data mapping requirements across SAP S/4HANA (SD, MM, FI) and Ariba.
  • Design and configure the Ariba P2P process and its integration with ONESOURCE Indirect Tax Determination.
  • Configure pricing and tax-related settings in SD, MM, and FI, and build ABAP programs that connect Determination with SAP.
  • Analyze existing SAP code and functionality to design and deliver custom solutions.
  • Install and configure the SAP integration with Determination so it runs reliably in production.
  • Coordinate technical implementation with clients, troubleshoot complex issues, and lead resolution.
  • Build SQL-based custom reports as needed using tools such as SQL*Plus, Toad, and Crystal Reports.
  • Write and execute test scripts and test cases, and guide teams through troubleshooting across testing phases.
  • Support simple S/4HANA system maintenance tasks such as user administration, authorizations, and archiving.
  • Report project status to project managers and mentor junior team members.

  • Education: A Master's or Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably Computer Science or Electrical Engineering.
  • 6+ years of SAP ABAP development and pricing and tax configuration experience in Ariba, SD, MM, and/or FI.
  • 5+ years developing ABAP programs for SD, MM, and/or FI.
  • 5+ years supporting or implementing SD, MM, and/or FI.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Ariba/VIM in P2P processes, including purchase requisitions, invoice reconciliation, MIRO, and FI posting interfaces between Ariba and SAP.
  • Solid understanding of order-to-cash (O2C) and procure-to-pay (P2P) processes and related S/4HANA functionality and configuration.
  • Experience creating and executing test cases and test scripts for SAP S/4HANA implementations.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to lead technical problem-solving.

job.title: Senior Workplace Engineer, Employee Technology Services
job.description:
Job Description:


Thomson Reuters is looking for a Senior Workplace Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft 365, enterprise AI productivity tools, and automation. You'll work hands-on where M365, Copilot, identity, endpoint management, and AI-enabled support meet.

In this role, you'll provide third-line support and engineering for our internal Microsoft 365 and AI productivity tools. You'll be the senior escalation point for complex M365 and Copilot issues and own each incident from investigation through to a permanent fix. You'll also spot recurring support patterns and turn them into automation, self-service tools, and engineered solutions. The goal is less repetitive work, faster resolution, more reliable services, and a better experience for employees.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Act as the senior escalation point for Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and the wider M365 admin tools.
  • Handle support, configuration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management for Microsoft Copilot and other internal AI tools.
  • Diagnose and fix identity, licensing, policy, and integration issues across M365 and AI services.
  • Resolve complex escalations that span multiple services, working independently at the third-line level.
  • Give technical guidance to L1 and L2 support teams.
  • Find the root cause of recurring incidents and drive them to a permanent fix instead of handing them off.
  • Keep knowledge articles, runbooks, and support documentation up to date so L1 and L2 can solve more on their own.
  • Build automation with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, and similar tools to remove repetitive work and keep configurations consistent.
  • Design and deliver AI-enabled support and self-service tools that reduce ticket volume and speed up resolution.
  • Turn recurring incident patterns into permanent engineered fixes.
  • Work across endpoint management, including Intune-managed devices and modern management, wherever it overlaps with M365 and AI tools.
  • Partner with endpoint and identity teams to resolve issues that cross team boundaries.
  • Support the adoption, governance, and reliability of AI productivity tools.
  • Turn technical capabilities into measurable results for employees.
  • Explain technical fixes clearly to non-technical users.
  • Decide sensibly whether an issue needs a quick fix or a permanent engineering solution.

Required Qualifications:


  • 6+ years of IT support and engineering experience, mainly in End User Computing in a modern enterprise environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on Microsoft 365 experience, including configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and third-line support across the core services.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot or similar enterprise AI productivity tools.
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102), or equivalent proven M365 expertise.
  • Automation and scripting experience with PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint management (Intune and modern management) and enterprise identity (Entra ID).
  • A track record of resolving complex escalations independently and turning recurring problems into automated or engineered solutions.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • A customer-service mindset focused on the employee experience.
  • Strong ownership and the ability to see issues through to closure without escalating them.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Microsoft Copilot or other AI-related certifications.
  • Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (Entra ID).
  • Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), or equivalent Intune expertise.
  • Experience delivering AI-enabled self-service and automation in an enterprise workplace.

job.title: Software Engineer, AI Applications
job.description:
Job description:

Thomson Reuters products support professionals across legal, tax, accounting, audit and news. In this role, you will help build secure, reliable AI-powered applications that combine modern full-stack engineering with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows.


You will work with experienced engineers, product managers and domain experts to deliver features from development through production. This is a hands-on software engineering role with meaningful exposure to applied AI systems.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design, build and test AI-enabled product features using Python services.
  • Integrate approved LLM services, such as Anthropic Claude and OpenAI models, through secure APIs and cloud services.
  • Develop and improve RAG workflows, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking and grounded response generation.
  • Build backend APIs and integrations that allow AI applications to use enterprise content and business services safely.
  • Contribute to AI-agent capabilities, including tool calling, structured outputs, workflow state and MCP-based integrations.
  • Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests; participate in code reviews; and support CI/CD and production operations.
  • Instrument AI features for quality, latency, reliability, cost and user feedback; help investigate production issues.

Required qualifications:

  • Approximately 2- 3 years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting production applications.
  • Strong hands-on development skills in Python and experience building REST APIs with a modern framework such as FastAPI, Flask or Django.
  • Practical experience integrating an LLM API or building a GenAI-enabled feature, prototype or production workflow.
  • Working knowledge of RAG concepts, embeddings, semantic/vector search and prompt/context design.
  • Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform, Git workflows, automated testing and CI/CD fundamentals.
  • Understanding of software security, data privacy and responsible handling of enterprise information.
  • English proficiency sufficient to collaborate with distributed product and engineering teams.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI APIs or a comparable managed AI platform.
  • Experience with OpenSearch, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant or another vector/semantic search technology.
  • Exposure to MCP, AI-agent frameworks, structured outputs or multi-step workflow orchestration.
  • Experience using AI development assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor or Amazon Q.
  • Experience in legal, tax, audit, accounting, compliance or another content-intensive professional domain.
  • Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React, or demonstrated ability to contribute across a modern web application stack.

job.title: Sr. Account Executive
job.description:
Job Description


This position is responsible for developing account plans for new and/or existing accounts.  Prospects new customers and new business at existing customers and close full solution sales to corporate customers. 
Location: remote based role, candidate must live in or be close to assigned territory or travel into their assigned territory. The territory for this role is in the US.

Products: Responsible for securing new sales and growing and retaining existing accounts selling Legal Tracker, HighQ, Practical Law Connect, Practical Law, Westlaw, and other legal solution and workflow tools to prospective customer base of attorneys working for Corporations with annual revenue of $500M or greater

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospecting: Prospecting is a must.  Actively seek out new business opportunities with both new and existing customers to build a strong sales pipeline. Keep your sales pipeline clean and up to date, aiming for 3-4 times coverage of your sales targets on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Account Management: Handle a list of major accounts (companies with revenues of $500M+), leading the entire sales process through account planning, to include initial contact, account planning, deal closing to renewal. 
  • Sales Goals: Meet or exceed your revenue targets.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with other teams within the organization to tailor our solutions to address the customer needs. 
  • Relationship Building: Establish and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, understanding their challenges and demonstrating how our solutions can address them.
  • Salesforce Maintenance: Regularly update our CRM system (salesforce.com) to maintain accurate records of your sales activities and to provide reliable sales forecasts. Engage in direct client meetings either in person or via platforms like MS Teams.

job.title: Sr. Account Executive, Overlay
job.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters is looking for an Sr. Account Executive to win new customers. You will sell CoCounsel Legal, our agentic AI product for legal work grounded in Westlaw and Practical Law content, alongside Legal Tracker, into the offices of General Counsel at large corporations that do not hold Thomson Reuters products today.

You will carry a quota and work with the account executives who cover each territory. The deals are complex, multi-stakeholder and increasingly competitive.


Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline generation. Build your own pipeline through account research and outreach, working with sales development and marketing on target accounts. Maintain coverage for the current and following months, and close gaps early.
  • Enterprise deal execution. Work complex enterprise deals to signature. That includes discovery, the business case with General Counsel and their leadership teams, multi-threading into the account and negotiation.
  • Qualification and forecasting. Qualify every opportunity against MEDDPICC. Hold a defensible view of every deal in your forecast, and give your manager an early read when one is at risk.
  • Cross-functional partnership. Work with legal engineering, solution consulting, customer success and professional services on your deals. Give product and marketing a clear read on what you are hearing from new customers.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales, consistently delivering above target on complex deals.
  • A track record in new business acquisition, with an understanding of how a new customer motion differs from expansion selling.
  • Experience building your own pipeline in new accounts through prospecting and account research.
  • Command of MEDDPICC as a deal qualification standard, applied on every opportunity.
  • Demonstrated forecast accuracy, and a clear point of view on what makes a forecast trustworthy.
  • Experience running multi-stakeholder deals with executive buyers, including building and testing champions.
  • Strong executive communication, with customers and internally.

job.description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about the chance to bring your automation and quality assurance experience to a world class organization that is leading the way in both content and technology to serve and protect our citizens home and abroad? Do you have the skills necessary to deliver high-quality client solutions? Then Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for you!

As a Sr. Automation QA Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and reviewing automated solutions, delivering high-quality tests and code contributions. You will be responsible for creating and executing test plans, design, and implementation of the automation framework to support multiple products. As a Sr. Automation QA Engineer, you will also contribute to a variety of areas including:


Key Responsibilities

  • Designing and building test structures that are easily maintainable, resilient, performant, and scalable across multiple products.
  • Working with Product Managers and Engineers to clarify requirements and translate them into test plans.
  • Writing and executing Playwright-based functional tests that cover critical user scenarios and workflows.
  • Writing thorough tests that cover edge cases with appropriate ROI for velocity and quality.
  • Leveraging AI-assisted tooling to accelerate test script creation, maintenance, and refactoring, improving test coverage and reducing manual upkeep.
  • Using AI to analyze test failures, suggest root causes, and recommend fixes, working with technical staff to ensure root causes are investigated and resolved.
  • Applying MCP (Model Context Protocol) to connect Claude with requirements systems, defect trackers, and test execution logs for full-context analysis.
  • Collaborating with software development team to design and implement the automation framework needs and recommending Application improvements.
  • Leading technical decisions on test automation architecture and framework direction, including evaluation and adoption of new tools, techniques, and practices.
  • Preparing project status report and management review reports and participate in project review, quality review and audit with the various stakeholders.
  • Functional testing levels may include application integration, system, system/network integration and acceptance testing; may also include non-functional testing such as performance, volume, load, and fallback.
  • Providing leadership and mentorship to QA team members by guiding skill development, assigning work, and ensuring quality across functional, non-functional, and other testing activities.

Backed by more than $200 million in annual AI investment, our trusted content, deep domain expertise, and AI-powered solutions like CoCounsel, Westlaw, and Checkpoint Edge help the world’s leading law firms, corporations, and governments make decisions with confidence.

We are hiring a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to support our Go-To-Market functions. This is an opportunity to help build the revenue teams behind one of the most significant transformations in professional services, with the scale, stability, and global reach of an established market leader. If you want meaningful, high-impact work with a global team, we’d love to talk.

The Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner, Go-To-Market, will partner with Thomson Reuters sales and commercial leaders to attract, engage, and hire top talent in Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and Professional Services. Sitting within Global Talent Acquisition in the People function, this role owns full-cycle recruiting for some of our highest-volume and most business-critical roles. You’ll act as a trusted advisor and market expert to hiring managers and HR Business Partners, driving hiring velocity and quality of hire while delivering an exceptional candidate experience. You’ll use data, AI-enabled tools, and consistent processes to help shape how Thomson Reuters builds its go-to-market teams for an AI-enabled future.

  • Own full-cycle GTM recruiting — intake to offer acceptance — for Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and Professional Services across multiple locations and business segments.

The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $136,000 USD - $253,000 USD. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $118,400 USD - $219,800 USD. For Ontario, Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $140,600 CAD - $190,600 CAD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

Thomson Reuters makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities, including veterans with disabilities, and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. If you reside in the United States and require an accommodation in the recruiting process, you may contact our Human Resources Department at HR.Leave-Expert@thomsonreuters.com. Disability accommodations in the recruiting process may include things like a sign language interpreter, making interview rooms accessible, providing assistive technology, or other relevant accommodations. Please note this email is not intended for general recruitment questions and we will promptly respond to inquiries regarding accommodations. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.
  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.
  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? Faça parte da nossa equipe e contribua para moldar as indústrias que impulsionam o progresso da sociedade.

Como uma empresa global, confiamos no conhecimento único, perspectivas e experiências de todos os colaboradores para cumprir nossos objetivos comerciais. Para garantir que possamos fazer isso, buscamos colaboradores talentosos e qualificados em todas as nossas operações ao redor do mundo, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo/gênero, incluindo gestantes, identidade e expressão de gênero, origem nacional, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, deficiência, idade, estado civil, status de cidadania, ou outra classificação protegida pela lei aplicável.

Além disso, oferecemos acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiências e para aquelas com crenças religiosas sinceras, conforme a legislação vigente. Você pode encontrar mais informações sobre como solicitar uma adaptação aqui.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive 

*Non-Remote, In-Person Opportunity. * 

 

The Opportunity: 

Townsquare Media is looking for a bright, confident, driven individual to join our multimedia advertising sales team in Bozeman Montana.  Townsquare Media Bozeman is an industry leader in digital advertising and an accredited marketing partner of both Google and Meta as well as home to five top radio stations.   

 

At Townsquare Media Bozeman, we are a team of ambitious individuals who work together to push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally. You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and an unlimited earning potential! 

 

If you’re ready to embark upon an exciting career that affords you the opportunity to form meaningful client relationships, develop creative advertising campaigns using our best-in-class multimedia solutions, all while having your finger on the pulse of Southwest Montana…then we want to hear from you!  

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Identify, pursue, and schedule meetings with local business owners and decision makers to discuss and uncover their marketing needs and challenges 
  • Use our proprietary data, analytics, and multimedia marketing solutions to build, present, and sell customized advertising plans to potential clients  
  • Build, maintain and develop close working relationships with your clients to identify and upsell new advertising solutions 
  • Use your influence and relationship-building skills to provide ongoing customer service, research, and market analysis 
  • You will be responsible for bringing our premier marketing and advertising solutions to local and regional businesses in the Bozeman area and beyond 
  • You will work with and sell integrated advertising solutions including broadcast radio, LIVE event sponsorships and digital including website design, SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Social, Streaming TV and much more 

 

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 1+ year of sales or marketing experience (preferred) 
  • Strong marketing and advertising acumen 
  • Effective verbal and written communications are essential 
  • Experience selling or a working knowledge of digital advertising solutions preferred 
  • Goal-oriented, strong work ethic and a desire to learn and grow a career in Sales 
  • A passion towards customer focused solution sales 
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required) 
  • BA/BS degree (preferred) 

 

What’s In It for You? 

  • Competitive compensation package with UNCAPPED earning potential  
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days) 
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community 
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance 
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
  • Company-provided laptop 
  • Casual, high-energy, supportive, and collaborative work environment 
  • 4-week long sales training program  
  • Unlimited growth opportunities!  

 

Why Townsquare Media Group? 

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions, and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing websites, search engine optimization, social platforms, and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps along with a network of national music/content brands.

job.title: Business Development Representative
job.description:
Business Development Representative

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

This Isn't Another Sales Job. It's Your Chance to Build Something Bigger.

Let's be honest—there are thousands of sales jobs.
Most ask you to sell one product. Make cold calls. Hit a quota. Repeat.
This isn't one of them.

At Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you'll help shape the success of local businesses while representing some of the most recognized brands in West Michigan. You'll have the backing of a company that combines the power of market-leading radio stations, streaming audio, live events, streaming TV, websites, social media, search marketing, programmatic advertising, SEO, websites, and cutting-edge digital solutions—all under one roof.

Every day is different. Every client is different. Every success story is yours to create.

If you're energized by competition, love solving business challenges, and want unlimited earning potential while working alongside an exceptional team, we'd love to meet you.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare Media is one of America's largest and most innovative local media companies, operating 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets nationwide.

In Grand Rapids, we're more than a media company—we're woven into the fabric of the community. Our brands entertain, inform, and connect hundreds of thousands of people every week while helping businesses grow through powerful, measurable marketing solutions.

Our clients don't hire us to buy advertising.
They partner with us to grow their businesses.
That's where you come in.

 

What You’ll Do:

You'll become a trusted marketing advisor to local business owners and decision-makers, helping them navigate today's rapidly evolving media landscape.
You'll work with entrepreneurs, CEOs, marketing directors, nonprofits, and community leaders to develop customized marketing strategies that deliver real business results.

Every day you'll:

  • Build new relationships with businesses throughout West Michigan
  • Create strategic marketing plans using radio, streaming audio, streaming TV, websites, social media, SEO, search marketing, programmatic advertising, events, and more
  • Present creative ideas that help clients grow revenue and strengthen their brands
  • Negotiate and close new business
  • Collaborate with creative, digital, programming, and leadership teams to bring campaigns to life
  • Become a respected business resource within the community

No two days look alike—and that's exactly what makes this role exciting.

 

Who Thrives Here?

Our best Account Executives are naturally curious, highly competitive, resilient, and genuinely enjoy helping people succeed.
They don't see themselves as salespeople.
They see themselves as consultants, entrepreneurs, and problem-solvers.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Love building relationships
  • Enjoy winning new business
  • Are energized by goals and competition
  • Take pride in delivering exceptional client service
  • Want to continue learning in one of the fastest-changing industries in business
  • Believe your income should reflect your performance

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
  • Confidence prospecting and developing new business opportunities
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Uncapped earning potential with a competitive compensation plan
  • Comprehensive onboarding and industry-leading sales training
  • Continuous coaching from experienced local leadership
  • Career advancement opportunities within one of America's leading media companies
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop

 

More Than a Job. Build your future. Build your community. Build something extraordinary—with Townsquare Media Grand Rapids.

When you join Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you're joining a team that celebrates big wins, supports one another, embraces innovation, and believes local businesses deserve world-class marketing.
You'll help launch new ideas, work with recognizable brands, attend exciting community events, collaborate with talented teammates, and build a career where your effort directly impacts your success.
If you're looking for a place where your ambition is rewarded, your ideas matter, and no two days are ever the same, we'd love to talk.

job.title: Market President
job.description:
Market President – Tyler

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Lead the Market. Shape the Future.

Are you a proven sales leader with a passion for developing high-performing teams, driving revenue growth, and making a lasting impact in your community?

Townsquare Media Group is looking for a dynamic Market President to lead our Tyler operation. This is more than a sales management role—it's an opportunity to serve as the local leader of one of the most recognized media organizations in the country.

You'll be responsible for growing revenue across our portfolio of broadcast, digital, live event, and marketing solutions while building a culture of accountability, collaboration, and performance. If you thrive on leading from the front, developing talent, and delivering results, we'd love to talk with you.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Tyler/Longview stations.   

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Market President, you'll be responsible for the overall success of the market, leading revenue growth, developing top talent, and representing Townsquare Media throughout the community. You'll serve as the senior leader for the market, partnering with sales, content, and operational teams to drive performance across all areas of the business.

Lead Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute a strategic vision that drives sustainable revenue and profit growth across broadcast, digital, live events, and marketing solutions
  • Lead market-wide sales initiatives focused on new business development, key account growth, and client retention
  • Partner with sales leaders and Account Executives to secure high-value business opportunities and deliver integrated marketing solutions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, agencies, and business leaders throughout the community
  • Analyze market performance and implement strategies that maximize revenue, profitability, and market share

Lead & Develop the Team

  • Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing sales leaders and Account Executives
  • Establish a culture of accountability, performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Coach leaders and sellers to achieve and exceed individual, team, and market goals
  • Partner with content and programming leaders to ensure brand excellence and audience growth across all platforms
  • Lead regular business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and performance discussions

Build the Market & Community Presence

  • Serve as the face of Townsquare Media within the local business community
  • Represent the company at community events, industry organizations, and key client meetings
  • Build partnerships that strengthen Townsquare's visibility, reputation, and influence within the market
  • Foster a culture that supports both business success and community engagement

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Oversee market budgeting, forecasting, and overall financial performance
  • Ensure compliance with FCC regulations and all federal, state, and local requirements
  • Monitor market performance metrics and implement action plans to improve results
  • Align market resources, talent, and business strategies to achieve long-term growth objectives

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of sales leadership experience in media, advertising, marketing, or a related industry
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding revenue goals and delivering profitable growth
  • Experience leading teams in both traditional and digital advertising environments
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing solutions, including programmatic, social, search, and website strategies
  • Demonstrated success recruiting, coaching, and retaining high-performing talent
  • Ability to create strategic plans and translate vision into measurable results
  • Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, budgeting, and revenue management
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Community-minded leadership style with a passion for local business growth
  • A hands-on, lead-from-the-front mentality—this is not a sit-behind-the-desk leadership role

 

What’s In It for You?

We know exceptional leaders create exceptional results. Here's what you can expect:

  • Competitive base salary with Bonus Plan
  • 3 weeks PTO
  • 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal/floating holidays)
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Pet Insurance
  • 401(K) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Ongoing leadership development and professional growth opportunities
  • The opportunity to lead a market, build a team, and make a meaningful impact in your community

Multi-Media Account Executive

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level:

Are you a driven, goal-oriented seller looking to grow your career in a high-impact role? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re seeking experienced Account Executives who thrive in a fast-paced environment, love building relationships, and are motivated by helping local businesses succeed. If you’re a confident closer with a passion for strategic, consultative sales—this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Texarkana stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a key member of our Texarkana sales team, you’ll take full ownership of building and managing a book of business. You’ll focus on bringing in new clients while maintaining long-term relationships with existing accounts. This is a full-cycle sales role where you’ll:

  • Prospect, qualify, and secure new business using data-driven insights and tools
  • Conduct in-depth needs assessments and present tailored marketing strategies
  • Represent our full portfolio of solutions including broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorships
  • Cross-sell and upsell to expand your clients’ reach and ROI
  • Partner with internal teams and collaborate on campaign execution and strategy
  • Work directly with your Market Leadership to meet and exceed individual and team goals

This is a consultative sales position where success is defined by your ability to build trust, deliver results, and help local businesses thrive.

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales goal
  • Demonstrated success in identifying and securing new business
  • Strong work ethic, drive, and competitiveness
  • Exceptional presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Competitive compensation plan + UNCAPPED earning potential
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Hands-on training and dedicated support from your leadership team
  • Real opportunities for career growth in a fast-moving multi-media organization

 

TOWNSQUARE MEDIA BROADCASTING, LLC MAINTAINS A DRUG-FREE WORKPLACE AND IS AN EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. APPLICANTS MUST BE ELIGIBLE TO WORK IN THE U.S. 

Townsquare Media provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Townsquare Media complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Townsquare Media expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Townsquare Media’s employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

job.title: Part-Time Radio & Digital Media Internship – NYS Broadcaster
job.description:
Part-Time Radio & Digital Media Internship – NYS Broadcasters

Townsquare Media Group | Albany

 

The Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is excited to offer an educational internship program designed to give students hands-on exposure to the radio broadcasting and digital media industry.

As an intern, you’ll gain real-world experience by observing and participating in the day-to-day operations of our radio stations and digital platforms, providing a behind-the-scenes look at how a modern media company operates across broadcast, digital marketing, promotions, and sales. You’ll gain insight into how broadcast and digital media work together to support local businesses, engage audiences, and create impactful marketing campaigns while learning from experienced professionals across multiple departments and seeing firsthand how our teams collaborate to deliver results for clients and communities.

Our goal is to help students build practical skills, develop industry knowledge, and make meaningful professional connections that will serve as a strong foundation for a future career in media, marketing, or communications.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Albany stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Learn & Experience:

As a Townsquare Media intern, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Observe daily operations across radio broadcasting and digital media teams
  • Learn how traditional, non-traditional, and digital marketing solutions are developed and executed
  • Gain exposure to content creation, promotions, advertising, and digital platforms
  • Assist with various department projects and initiatives as appropriate
  • Develop an understanding of how media campaigns are planned, launched, and evaluated
  • Network with media professionals and gain career insights within the industry

This internship is intended to provide hands-on exposure and educational experience, giving students a clearer understanding of career paths within the media and marketing industries.

 

What You’ll Bring to the Program:

We’re looking for students who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn about the evolving media landscape.

Ideal candidates will have:

  • A strong interest in radio broadcasting, digital media, marketing, or communications
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • The ability to work collaboratively in a professional environment
  • A proactive approach to gaining new skills and experiences

 

Program Requirements:

  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must be a resident of New York State and/or attending school in New York State
  • Must be a first-time participant in the Townsquare Media internship program

 

Program Details:

  • Internships are available year-round
  • Compensation is $16/ hour
  • Typically 10–20 hours per week
  • Specific schedules will be agreed upon in advance to accommodate academic commitments
  • Internship experience may include exposure to broadcast operations, digital marketing, promotions, and sales

 

Launch Your Career in Media

This internship is an opportunity to explore the fast-moving world of media while building skills that will translate to a variety of careers in marketing, broadcasting, digital media, and communications.

If you're eager to learn, contribute, and gain valuable industry experience, we’d love to hear from you.

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Grand Junction and Montrose stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Regional Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facilities in the Grand Junction and Montrose markets. 

 

Essential Functions:

Travel & Transportation:

  • Maintain a valid driver's license and reliable transportation
  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations
  • Respond to emergency equipment failures on short notice, including after hours and weekends
  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Technical Operations:

  • Manage activities for a goal of 100% uptime of station on-air and streaming products
  • Inspect, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with FCC technical rules and perform duties of Chief Operator
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Cognitive & Communication:

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports and correspondence
  • Speak effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with Senior Vice President of Engineering and Senior Vice President, Information Technology, as well as other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed.

Safety & Physical Requirements:

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites
  • Maintain situational awareness to prevent falls and injuries
  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, visually inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

  • Technical training school, or two to four years related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience (required)
  • SBE or computer-related certification helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Windows (all versions), Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
  • Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

 

Work Schedule:

  • After-hours and weekend work as required
  • On-call availability for emergency response

 

Disclaimer:

This job description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. The incumbent will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as may be required by the supervisor. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

Benefits:

  • 3 weeks of PTO (+ 9 paid holidays)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunity for upward mobility
  • Company provided laptop
  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Company discounts
  • Pet Insurance
  • Time off for volunteering
  • And much more…

 

About Us:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing web sites, search engine optimization, social platforms and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local terrestrial radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps including legendary brands such as WYRK.com, WJON.com, and NJ101.5.com, along with a network of national music brands including XXLmag.com, TasteofCountry.com, UltimateClassicRock.com and Loudwire.com.

job.title: Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise
job.description:
Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise

*This position requires you to work in-office and on-site as needed. * 

 

Launch Your Sales & Media Career:

Interested in a career in sales, advertising, or digital marketing? Townsquare Media’s Sales Internship gives college students the opportunity to gain real-world experience while learning how businesses use media and marketing to grow.

As a Sales Intern with our Boise team, you won’t spend your internship sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work alongside experienced sales professionals, learn the fundamentals of consultative selling, and gain exposure to the full sales process—from identifying prospective clients and qualifying opportunities to conducting needs analysis and securing appointments.

You’ll also get a behind-the-scenes look at how a local media company operates, with exposure to our radio brands, digital marketing solutions, on-air operations, community events, and the teams that bring it all together.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As an intern on our Boise sales team, you’ll gain hands-on experience with the fundamentals that drive successful sales organizations. You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn how to identify and research prospective local businesses
  • Develop prospecting skills through phone, email, and other outreach
  • Learn how to qualify potential clients and identify strong sales opportunities
  • Practice conducting needs analysis to better understand a business, its goals, and its marketing challenges
  • Build confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers
  • Learn how to secure appointments and create opportunities for our sales team
  • Shadow experienced Account Executives throughout different stages of the sales process
  • Gain exposure to client meetings, sales presentations, and marketing strategy
  • Learn how our team uses broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorship solutions to help local businesses grow
  • Develop an understanding of pipeline management, sales activity, and performance goals

 

You’ll also have opportunities to experience other areas of our Boise operation, including our radio stations, on-air teams, promotions, and off-site events, giving you a broader understanding of how sales connects with the entire organization.

This is a sales-focused internship designed to give you practical experience, meaningful coaching, and a strong foundation in consultative selling.

 

What You’ll Bring:

We’re looking for students who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn. You don’t need previous sales experience—we’ll help you build the skills.

  • Currently pursuing a college degree in Sales, Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field
  • Genuine interest in exploring a career in sales
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Confidence starting conversations and willingness to step outside your comfort zone
  • Coachable mindset and desire to learn
  • Strong work ethic, organization, and follow-through
  • Positive attitude and ability to work collaboratively with a team
  • Interest in media, digital marketing, advertising, or local business is a plus
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

This internship is designed to give you more than something to add to your resume. You’ll leave with real-world experience and a better understanding of what it takes to build a career in sales.

  • Hands-on sales training and coaching
  • Real-world experience in prospecting, qualifying, needs analysis, and appointment setting
  • Opportunities to shadow successful Account Executives
  • Exposure to digital advertising, radio, programmatic marketing, events, and local media
  • Experience working with local businesses and understanding their marketing challenges
  • Opportunities to attend station and community events
  • Direct access to experienced sales and market leadership
  • A chance to build your professional network and résumé before graduation
  • Exposure to potential career opportunities with Townsquare Media

 

If you’re competitive, curious, comfortable talking to people, and interested in learning how great sellers build relationships and create opportunities, we’d love to meet you.

job.title: Senior Multi-Media Account Executive
job.description:
Senior Multi-Media Account Executive

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Take Your Media Career to the Next Level:

Are you a high-performing sales professional with deep expertise in media and digital marketing? Do you bring trusted relationships, strategic insight, and a track record of exceeding revenue goals? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re seeking a Senior Account Executive to drive transformative results for our clients and contribute meaningfully to our local market leadership.

This role is ideal for seasoned sellers who are passionate about making a difference in their community, leveraging cutting-edge solutions, and building long-term partnerships with business decision-makers.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Binghamton stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a Senior Multi-Media Account Executive, you’ll serve as a trusted advisor to high-value clients and prospects. You’ll be responsible for developing strategic marketing campaigns, leveraging your network to grow revenue, and guiding clients through complex buying decisions across a full suite of solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Own and manage a book of business with a strong focus on new revenue generation
  • Leverage your established network to drive opportunities and close high-impact deals
  • Conduct high-level client discovery meetings and present custom, insight-led solutions
  • Lead strategic planning across integrated campaigns—including broadcast, digital, events, and sponsorships
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal departments to ensure successful campaign delivery and client satisfaction
  • Serve as a mentor and subject matter expert within the sales organization
  • Meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience in media, marketing, or advertising (required)
  • Deep understanding of broadcast, digital, and programmatic marketing solutions
  • A proven track record of quota overachievement and strategic new business wins
  • Strong relationships with local business owners and decision-makers in Binghamton
  • Expertise in consultative selling and long-term client relationship development
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • A strong personal drive, professional polish, and collaborative spirit
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Competitive compensation plan + UNCAPPED earning potential
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Hands-on training and dedicated support from your leadership team
  • A respected brand, national resources, and the autonomy to make your market yours

job.title: Senior Multi-Media Account Executive
job.description:
Senior Account Executive, Outside Sales

**This is a remote position that requires you to be located in Tucson, AZ**

 

Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level:

Are you a driven, goal-oriented seller looking to grow your career in a high-impact role? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re seeking experienced Account Executives who thrive in a fast-paced environment, love building relationships, and are motivated by helping local businesses succeed. If you’re a confident closer with a passion for strategic, consultative sales—this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Sierra Vista stations.

 

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a key member of our Sierra Vista sales team, you’ll take full ownership of building and managing a book of business. You’ll focus on bringing in new clients while maintaining long-term relationships with existing accounts. This is a full-cycle sales role where you’ll:

  • Utilizing established relationships within the Tucson community to identify business opportunities
  • Prospect, qualify, and secure new business using data-driven insights and tools
  • Conduct in-depth needs assessments and present tailored marketing strategies
  • Represent our full portfolio of solutions including broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorships
  • Cross-sell and upsell to expand your clients’ reach and ROI
