job.title: Associate Program Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

Position Summary

The Associate Program Director is the first level of program ownership above the Sr. PM. Reporting to the Group Program Director and managing Sr. Program Managers, Managers, and Associates, this role owns and manages complex, multi-channel Tier 1 programs and the delivery health of that program level, owns account-level scope and SOW, manages staffing across the account team, and co-leads client strategy from the delivery angle in true partnership with the Business Director (and GBD on the largest accounts). This is where a Sr. PM steps into the scoping partnership — beginning to co-own scope and SOW alongside Business Leadership rather than executing against it. The Associate Program Director typically owns one large, multi-channel program or account in partnership with a BD.

Responsibilities

Program & Delivery Health

  • Own program and delivery health across the account; lead internal program coordination at the account level
  • Own account / retainer-level scope tracking and SOW; manage staffing across the account team
  • Escalate capacity needs and scope shifts back to the GPD for redesign

Client Partnership

  • Co-lead client strategy from delivery; hold senior client relationships (director / VP) on operations and scoping
  • Partner with the BD as a true partnership; on the largest accounts, co-lead with the GBD

Team Leadership

  • Lead Sr. PMs, project-focused Managers, and Associates
  • Co-lead junior managers with Business Leadership to identify program-management capability

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $105,000 - $126,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

Position Summary

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner across assigned Eli Lilly brands and workstreams. You will build a deep understanding of the client’s business, patient audiences, and category, translating those insights into clear direction and creative opportunities that connect brands with people in meaningful ways.

Working with the account’s Executive Director, you will lead client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, develop Business Leadership talent, and identify opportunities for growth. You will partner closely with Program Management on delivery and account financial health, balancing creative ambition with the rigor of a regulated category and the needs of a fast-growing business.

What You Will Do

Drive Business and Strategic Leadership

  • Act as the day-to-day senior business lead across assigned Lilly brands and workstreams, building trusted relationships with mid-to-senior client stakeholders and proactively shaping the business agenda.
  • Develop a strong understanding of brand priorities, patient experiences, barriers to engagement, and competitive dynamics to inform strategic counsel and creative development.
  • Translate complex client needs and feedback into clear priorities and actionable direction, constructively challenging clients when needed to strengthen the work.
  • Monitor relationship health and business performance, anticipating risks and partnering with the Executive Director to address issues before they affect the partnership.

Lead Creative Solutions with Business Impact

  • Partner with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Analytics to develop culturally relevant work grounded in business objectives, audience insights, and clear measures of success.
  • Champion communication that reflects real patient experiences and makes complex health topics understandable, empathetic, and relevant to everyday life.
  • Ensure work is strategically sound and client-ready, with compelling rationale and alignment to client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.
  • Work with Lilly’s brand teams, internal creative team, and agency partners to clarify roles, align recommendations, and maintain continuity across the work.
  • Partner with Production and Program Management to bring approved concepts to life within agreed scope, timing, and budget, advocating for additional investment when warranted.

Lead Teams and Strengthen Partnerships

  • Guide cross-functional teams with clear priorities, expectations, and decisions, creating a collaborative environment with shared accountability for the work.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Business Supervisors and other assigned Business Leadership team members through regular feedback and meaningful development opportunities.
  • Partner with Program Management, which leads operational planning and delivery, to align client expectations with scopes, schedules, staffing, and review requirements.
  • Work with client stakeholders and Program Management to anticipate approval needs, consolidate feedback, and help teams understand review decisions and their implications.
  • Navigate competing stakeholder needs and resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating significant relationship, commercial, or delivery risks appropriately.

Champion Growth and Financial Health

  • Develop and action growth plans for assigned brands and workstreams, connecting unmet client needs with Translation’s capabilities.
  • Co-own account financial health with Program Management, contributing to scope development, staffing recommendations, forecasting, and profitability management.
  • Identify scope changes and investment needs early, leading clear client conversations about the associated fees, priorities, and trade-offs.
  • Contribute to new business, recruiting, and departmental improvements that strengthen the agency and develop future Business Leadership talent.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities

  • Strong business judgment and strategic fluency, with the ability to learn complex categories and turn ambiguity into clear direction.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, including the confidence to advise clients, explain creative rationale, and navigate sensitive conversations.
  • Ability to balance creative ambition with accuracy and client review requirements, partnering effectively with medical, legal, and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Experience leading integrated campaigns across channels, with a strong understanding of creative development and production.
  • Commercial acumen across scopes, staffing, budgets, and account performance, paired with a collaborative approach to Program Management.
  • A proactive, hands-on leadership style, with sound prioritization, attention to detail, and the ability to develop others in a fast-moving environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of experience in an agency or communications-related industry, with a well-rounded understanding of advertising, marketing, media, creative, production, and agency finance.
  • Proven success managing integrated campaigns, partnering with mid-to-senior-level clients, and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on production experience with large-scale, multi-channel initiatives.
  • Experience coaching junior account team members and contributing to scope development, account financial management, and organic growth.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated brands, including familiarity with medical, legal, and regulatory review processes. Direct pharma experience is a plus, not a requirement; curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.
  • Experience with consumer-facing health communications, patient storytelling, or brand launches.
  • Experience partnering with in-house creative teams and working within a multi-agency environment.
  • Experience developing culturally relevant campaigns, including talent partnerships, social content, or experiential work.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Business Supervisor

Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. The Business Supervisor (BS) is the day-to-day client partnership lead, responsible for managing client communication, translating business needs into actionable direction, and ensuring clarity across internal teams. Serving as the critical connection point between Business Leadership and Program Management, the Business Supervisor helps create exceptional client experiences while enabling efficient delivery.

This role operates with guidance while independently managing day-to-day client relationships and workstreams. Business Supervisors build trusted client partnerships, drive alignment across disciplines, proactively manage expectations, and help ensure every engagement is strategically grounded and executionally set up for success.

What You'll Do

Client Partnership & Communication

  • Own day-to-day client relationships and communication across assigned workstreams.
  • Lead routine client meetings, status calls, working sessions, and follow-up communications.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful partnership.
  • Ensure every client interaction is organized, productive, and aligned against business objectives.

Translation & Alignment

  • Translate client needs, feedback, and business objectives into clear direction for internal teams.
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Business Directors to develop and refine creative briefs.
  • Ensure cross-functional teams understand priorities, expectations, success metrics, and next steps.
  • Create alignment between client goals and agency recommendations throughout the life of a project.
  • Build a working understanding of the client’s brands, patient audiences, competitive landscape, and business priorities to inform day-to-day client partnership and internal direction.

Creative Development Support

  • Prepare clients for presentations and key decision-making moments.
  • Help articulate strategic and creative rationale in a clear, compelling, and client-ready manner.
  • Anticipate client feedback and guide internal teams on effective responses.
  • Support creative development by ensuring work remains aligned to client objectives, approved strategy, and client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.

Risk & Expectation Management

  • Proactively identify risks, ambiguities, or changing client needs before they become issues.
  • Manage client expectations through transparent communication and thoughtful problem solving.
  • Resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating only when appropriate.
  • Ensure alignment between what clients expect and what teams are prepared to deliver.

Team Contribution & Development

  • Mentor junior Business Leadership team members in client communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.
  • Support Business Directors in strengthening client relationships and identifying opportunities for organic growth.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and positive team environment across disciplines.
  • Model strong judgment, professionalism, and ownership in client-facing situations.

Partnership with Program Management

  • Partner closely with Program Management to ensure alignment between client expectations and delivery plans.
  • Support scope definition by helping clarify client objectives, priorities, and desired outcomes.
  • Maintain awareness of timelines, budgets, and executional progress while allowing Program Management to lead delivery.
  • Work collaboratively to ensure clients receive a seamless experience from strategy through execution.
  • Partner with Program Management and client stakeholders to clarify review requirements, consolidate feedback, and ensure teams understand approval decisions and their implications.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, consulting, or related client leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships and manage day-to-day business communications.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Strategy, Creative, Production, Context, and Program Management.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to a collaborative team culture.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative development, and client service best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated brands is a plus, but not required. Curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

job.title: Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans – empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first – disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator to join UnitedMasters! Please note that this role is a Hybrid role: four days in office and one day remote.

The Role

As a Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator, you will help make sure our artists’ music lands in front of the right audiences and their physical product reaches the fans who want it. You will support the Commerce team as the day-to-day connective tissue between UnitedMasters and our DSPs: Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music and others — keeping pitch calendars, release grids and editorial follow-ups running on time, and tracking what placements actually delivered. Alongside that, you will help coordinate physical products: vinyl, CDs and special collector formats, from manufacturing timelines through inventory and retail distribution.

Beyond the commerce remit, you will serve as a coordination point for the broader Music team — running the logistics behind our recurring team and leadership meetings, supporting our Artist Management team on high-priority administrative needs, and helping bring our label events and partner presentations to life. This is a role for someone who is energized by being the person who keeps a lot of moving parts on the rails.

This is an entry-level role built for someone who wants to learn the commercial engine of the music business from the inside while working directly alongside our artist management and label leadership. You will sit close to the decisions that determine how an independent release performs, and the relationships and instincts you build here with DSP partners and our artist-facing teams are the foundation of a career in music.

What You’ll Do

Commerce & DSP

  • Prepare and maintain the DSP pitch calendar for upcoming releases, ensuring every priority release is submitted on time and with complete, compelling supporting materials.
  • Assemble release assets, artist context and performance data for editorial submissions across Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music and emerging platforms, and draft supporting pitch copy in partnership with the Commerce lead.
  • Track playlist adds, editorial placements and store features across all DSP partners, and maintain a shared record the Commerce and Artist Marketing teams can rely on.
  • Pull and format weekly and post-release performance reporting from DSP partner portals, flagging trends, wins and misses to the Commerce lead.
  • Support partner meetings and DSP check-ins by building agendas and one-sheets, taking thorough notes, and driving follow-up items to completion.
  • Maintain a monthly roundup of DSP product changes, new pitch tools and editorial priorities for the broader team.

Physical Product

  • Coordinate physical product timelines for vinyl, CD and special collector formats — tracking manufacturing milestones, test pressings, approvals and in-stock dates against release dates.
  • Support inventory and retail distribution tracking, surfacing stock, reorder and sell-through issues to the Commerce lead and our manufacturing and distribution partners.

Music Team Coordination

  • Coordinate the Music team’s recurring meetings — including the weekly Artist Marketing meeting and the full Music Team meeting — owning agenda and deck preparation, notes, and follow-up to completion.
  • Provide administrative support to the Artist Management team for our highest-priority artists, including payment requests, contracting workflow and travel coordination.
  • Keep Brand Partnerships and Sync current on artist marketing activity through shared calendars, decks and marketing collateral.
  • Support the planning and execution of UnitedMasters label events and partner presentations, from run-of-show through day-of logistics.

Across Both

  • Set up vendors, process invoices and keep budget trackers current for DSP campaigns, physical product runs and artist management requests.
  • Partner with Artist Marketing, Creative and Artist Relations to align commerce moments with release and campaign plans.
  • Organize, catalog and distribute release assets and metadata so partners always have what they need, when they need it.

Who You Are

  • A genuine fan of music with real curiosity about how releases actually perform. You follow charts, playlists and drops because you want to.
  • Entry-level familiarity with the music streaming landscape and how DSPs surface and program music.
  • Comfortable in DSP partner portals — Spotify for Artists, Apple Music for Artists, Amazon Music for Artists — or able to get up to speed on them quickly.
  • Solid working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets: you can build and maintain a tracker, use basic formulas, and turn a raw export into something readable.
  • Experience with project management tools or clear aptitude for keeping many moving deadlines organized in one system.
  • Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the discipline to hold a calendar of dates that cannot slip.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write a clear, persuasive pitch.
  • Strong meeting craft — you can build a clean agenda, capture what actually mattered, and chase follow-ups until they are closed.
  • Genuine comfort with high-touch administrative work in service of senior stakeholders and top-priority artists.
  • Discretion and sound judgment. You will be close to artist contracts, payments and travel, and to leadership-level conversations.
  • A self-starter who can own weekly recurring tasks independently while taking direction from multiple stakeholders across Commerce, Artist Marketing and Artist Management — and who is comfortable asking which priority wins when two deadlines collide.
  • A team player who is not afraid to roll up their sleeves and known as the resourceful, positive person others want to work with.
  • Interest in the operational and commercial mechanics of a music release, from editorial pitching to what it takes to get vinyl into a fan’s hands.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don’t Know We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don’t.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $29-34/ hr (~$60 - 70k)

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA. As a company, we have a location-based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodation

UnitedMasters is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Phishing Scam Warning

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: UnitedMasters is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from UnitedMasters without a formal interview process. job.title: Context Director
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters, Inc. is a first-of-its-kind company that lives at the intersection of culture, tech and storytelling. Through our creative solutions company, Translation, we build ideas that transcend traditional marketing to 

drive business results through cultural impact. Through our music tech platform, UnitedMasters, we power the careers of independent artists through music distribution services and partnership opportunities with the world’s biggest brands. As one-company, we are building a world where cultural capital is equitably exchanged at scale by serving as the go-to source for shared gains between artists and brands. 

If this description makes you feel like running through a brick wall, you’re in the right place.

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

The Role

Context Planning is the connective tissue between what we make and who we’re making it for. This is a team that only exists at Translation and we built it to help brands diffuse their ideas through culture by focusing on where, when and who they live through.

This role is for a leader who can translate raw insight into real influence, help brands find their voice inside the communities they are looking to engage with, and build systems that make great ideas scale. At your core, you're not just a comms planner. You’re a front row student of culture, a campaign conductor, and an idea amplifier. The Context Director is a leadership position that demands creative foresight, cultural nuance, business acumen, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep connection to what’s moving the world today. 

What You’ll Do

Functional Skills

  • Cultural Research: Lead and assign cultural deep dives that inform strategy and creative development.
  • Comms Planning: Own authorship of holistic GTM plans that connect the dots creatively while translating business objectives into actionable rollouts over time and space/channels.
  • Casting & Talent Strategy: Lead authorship of casting filters that help identify talent who personify our campaign message while ensuring brand safety and creative alignment. 
  • Creative World-Building: Analyze hero deliverables (e.g., film scripts) and provide cultural nuance that infuses insider fan perspective in the form Easter eggs, and additional engagement tactics that will resonate with core audience members.
  • Convergence & Collaboration: Facilitate onboarding for new hires to ensure alignment on Context’s function and value. Partner across PR, Media, and Social teams to preserve creative integrity and contextual fluency from pitch to publish.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a core member of the business leadership team, aligning day-to-day execution with our broader One Company Vision. Mentor DRs across IC1–IC3 levels and informally coach team members outside your direct reporting line.

Who You Are

  • A systems thinker who can orchestrate brand storytelling through people, platforms, and moments.
  • A culture junkie with strong intuition and analytical rigor—you know what’s next, and why it matters.
  • A collaborator who’s equally fluent in creative, strategy, talent, and media environments.
  • A researcher at heart, with a passion for ethnography, behavioral analysis, and emerging platforms.
  • A mentor and motivator who uplifts junior talent and brings out the best in cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • 7–9 years experience in cultural strategy, brand planning, or creative strategy roles.
  • Proven experience leading multi-channel campaigns from insight through execution.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills—must be comfortable presenting work to senior leaders and clients.
  • Proficiency in Keynote, Google Suite, and qualitative research tools.
  • Deep understanding of subcultures, niche internet communities, and artist ecosystems.
  • Bonus: Background or minor in a creative craft, artistic discipline, or subcultural space.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $120,000 - $140,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

job.title: Context Planner
job.description:
Who We Are

We are a well-established independent agency and thriving music business, built to help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. In 2022, Translation was awarded the number three spot in Ad Age’s Agency A-List and AdWeek’s Multicultural Agency of the Year. One year before, Translation was awarded Ad Age’s Small Agency of the Year. We’re unapologetically ambitious, but we’re also a tight-knit crew.

We are looking for a Context Planner to join Translation! 

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

What You'll Do

The Context planner is client-facing on a case by case basis and plays a key role in choreographing campaigns and designing integrated go-to-market plans that incite audience participation. It is your responsibility to gain an in-depth understanding of the people, passions, and platforms that matter most to the audience, and to rethink media in new ways to help our brand partners communicate through the places, spaces, times and people that our audience will be most receptive to.

  • Core contributor to comms plans, campaign rollouts, creative ecosystems, and customer journeys 
  • Leadership of social influencer identification, sample social post instructions, and platform best practices
  • Proactively research culturally relevant moments that lead to bespoke activation calendars 
  • Partner with creative teams by contributing out-the-box extension tactics to support big idea platforms
  • Partner with UMT’s “stratpack” to create “Get Smart” research docs in support of project kickoffs that help retrace recent brand activity, categorical trends, consumer insights, and white-space opportunities to inform brand action
  • Lead media partner recommendations and identify unique integration opportunities that amplify the core idea
  • Create risk assessment documents in moments where stakeholders want to pursue a potentially problematic idea
  • Deconstruct best-in-class campaigns to extract key learnings that are applicable to our brand partners
  • Proactively contribute thought leadership throughout the agency (Flash Forecast weekly newsletter)
  • Subscribe to a constant plan of refinements and updates as new tech, media and consumer insights arise

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Recognize patterns and mechanics displayed by people and brands that move culture and incite action. 
  • Become fluent in the sub-cultures our audience subscribes to by immersing yourself in the networks, rituals, artifacts and language they practice.
  • Constantly seek out first-to-market media opportunities that position our brands as category disruptors.
  • Confidence in packaging and presentation of work to inspire both internal and external sell through.
  • Possess and demonstrate a vibrant connection to and fluency in pop culture and brand trends. 
  • Passion for diving deep into research and data to unearth actionable insights that propel the creative.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Possess excellent time management, organization and prioritization skills.
  • Have the proven ability to work under tight deadlines and handle pressure, while consistently paying attention to accuracy and quality of work.
  • Exercise the ability to quickly and effectively adapt to changing needs and expectations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 3-5 years experience in a strategic position in an agency or brand environment
  • 4-year college degree in Marketing, Advertising or Business preferred.
  • Digitally savvy; MUST be proficient in Google Suite and Keynote (Mac preferred).

job.title: Director, Accounting & Financial Planning
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

The Director, Accounting & Financial Planning will lead day-to-day accounting operations, manage the Brooklyn and offshore accounting teams, and oversee the timely and accurate completion of the close and financial reporting processes.

This is a hands-on role focused on accounting execution, team development, and process improvement. The Director will work in partnership with the CFO to establish and apply accounting policies, maintain internal controls, and prepare financial information to support business decisions.

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

What You'll Do

  • Manage accounting operations: Lead the Brooklyn and offshore accounting teams, set priorities, review work, manage deadlines, and support employee development.
  • Own the close process: Manage monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities, including journal entries, account reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and consolidation. Resolve routine issues and escalate significant or complex matters to the CFO.
  • Prepare financial reporting: Prepare consolidated financial statements and supporting schedules in accordance with U.S. GAAP and established company policies for CFO review and approval. Investigate variances and explain accounting results.
  • Coordinate audit execution: Organize schedules, documentation, and responses for financial statement and 401(k) audits. Track deliverables and coordinate day-to-day auditor requests, escalating significant findings and accounting judgments to the CFO.
  • Support technical accounting: Research accounting questions and prepare analyses and supporting documentation for CFO review. Implement accounting treatments and policies approved by the CFO.
  • Maintain internal controls: Execute and monitor established controls, maintain documentation, identify gaps, and implement improvements approved by the CFO.
  • Improve accounting processes: Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, automate recurring accounting tasks, and improve the accuracy and efficiency of the close and reporting processes.
  • Support financial planning: Provide accounting data, reconciliations, and supporting schedules to inform cash forecasting, budgeting, and business performance analysis.
  • Coordinate compliance deliverables: Prepare information and supporting schedules for external tax advisors and other service providers, and track filing requirements and deadlines under the CFO’s oversight.
  • Partner across the business: Work with Finance and other departments to resolve accounting issues and ensure transactions are recorded accurately and promptly.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Solid communication, analytical and management skills.
  • Demonstrated experience with managing core finance process including: closing, financial reporting, working capital, cash & balance sheet efficiency, account reconciliation, flux analysis.
  • Comfortable with technology and agility to improve processes.
  • Passionate about working smarter.
  • Team player who is committed to developing and improving the team.
  • Ability to communicate across functions internally and externally.
  • NetSuite experience a plus.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field; CPA preferred.
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including team management and responsibility for close and financial reporting.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, financial statement preparation, account reconciliations, and consolidations.
  • Experience coordinating audit deliverables and supporting tax compliance.
  • Experience managing distributed or offshore accounting teams.
  • Proficiency with NetSuite and advanced Excel skills; familiarity with Navan is a plus.
  • A hands-on approach, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
  • Sound judgment, including the ability to identify issues requiring escalation and communicate them clearly.                                                                                    

Preferred Qualifications

  • Passionate about work and  outside interests 
  • Creative agency/production, entertainment or music industry experience 

About UnitedMasters 

UnitedMasters has over 2 million artists on its platform and is growing rapidly. Brands like Diageo, Ally, and ESPN come to UnitedMasters to partner with these artists and play a role in moving culture forward. With $170M raised to date and valued at $550M, UnitedMasters is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Apple, Alphabet and Disney amongst others. As a Group Business Director, you will own the health, growth, and performance of a portfolio of Eli Lilly brands and workstreams. You will serve as a senior strategic partner to VP- and SVP-level marketing stakeholders, connecting brand priorities, patient needs, and cultural opportunities into a clear vision for the business.

You will make portfolio-level decisions with minimal executive oversight, lead and develop Business Directors and Business Supervisors, and co-own financial performance with Program Management.   • Strong business judgment and strategic fluency, with the ability to turn complex client needs into clear priorities across multiple brands.
  • Executive presence and exceptional communication skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and navigate difficult conversations.
  • Commercial acumen across scopes, staffing, profitability, and forecasting, paired with a collaborative approach to Program Management.
  • Ability to champion integrated creative work while respecting accuracy and medical, legal, and regulatory review requirements.
  • A decisive, curious leadership style that develops other leaders and builds a culture of accountability and collaboration.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in an agency or communications-related industry, with a well-rounded understanding of marketing, media, creative, production, and agency finance.
  • Proven success leading a portfolio of businesses or a complex multi-brand client relationship, with responsibility for financial performance and organic growth. Experience at a scale comparable to $6M–$10M+ in annual agency revenue.

  • Experience managing and developing senior account or Business Leadership talent and leading integrated, multi-channel campaigns and large-scale production.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated brands and medical, legal, and regulatory review. Direct pharma experience is a plus, not a requirement; curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.

job.title: People Operations Generalist
job.description:
People & Operations Generalist

Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters' music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We’re looking for a People Operations Generalist to own daily employee support, HR systems, and employee lifecycle operations across UnitedMasters, Translation, and Shared Services. You’ll independently manage core People processes, support programs, and use AI and automation to improve how we work. The ideal candidate brings strong HR experience, sound judgment, and the initiative to navigate shifting priorities and take on broader responsibilities. 

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

What You'll Do

  • Employee and manager support: Serve as the first point of contact for day-to-day People questions. Explain policies, resolve routine issues independently, and recognize when to involve People Business Partners, Payroll & Benefits, or People leadership.
  • Employee lifecycle: Own onboarding, employee changes, and offboarding. Coordinate orientation, documentation, I-9 processing, system updates, and communications with employees, managers, IT, and other partners.
  • HR systems and data: Own day-to-day HRIS and People tool administration, including configuration, workflows, permissions, integrations, vendor coordination, and troubleshooting. Maintain accurate employee records and conduct regular data audits.
  • AI adoption and process improvement: Identify and implement practical uses of approved AI tools and automation across People operations, such as drafting knowledge resources, improving employee self-service, and streamlining recurring workflows. Test outputs for accuracy, protect confidential information, and help teammates adopt effective practices.
  • Immigration coordination: Coordinate visa sponsorships, renewals, and related documentation with employees, People leadership, and external immigration counsel. Track deadlines and maintain organized records.
  • Offboarding support: Partner with People Business Partners on separation logistics, including preparing approved documents and ensuring timely handoffs to IT, Facilities, and Payroll.
  • Documentation and reporting: Maintain clear process guides, employee resources, personnel files, and sensitive documentation. Produce routine reports and identify data or process issues that require action.
  • Cross-functional projects: Support HR projects and system implementations by coordinating tasks, testing workflows, maintaining documentation, and following through on assigned deliverables.

Who You Are 

  • 4+ years of progressive HR or People Operations experience, including independently managing employee support and core employee lifecycle processes.
  • Experience administering an HRIS or People tools, maintaining accurate employee data, and improving operational workflows.
  • Experience supporting People programs or HR projects, with demonstrated judgment in handling confidential and sensitive matters.
  • Strong understanding of HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, and the connection between systems, data, and employee experience.
  • Sound judgment and discretion, including the ability to resolve routine matters independently and escalate sensitive or complex issues appropriately.
  • Strong organizational and coordination skills, including managing timelines, communicating with stakeholders, and keeping work on track.
  • Practical understanding of AI tools and automation, including when human review is needed and how to protect sensitive employee information.
  • Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and a service-oriented approach to solving employee and manager needs.
  • Experience with ADP, Culture Amp, Lattice, Google Workspace, or comparable tools.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane — Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect — We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience — We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked — We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness — We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don't Know — We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don't.

job.title: Program Manager
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Program Manager to join Translation!

This role is based in Brooklyn, New York with four days in-office and one day remote.


What You'll Do

  • Own the how. Develop scopes, timelines, budgets and delivery systems for programs ranging from complex to “simple.” Don’t assume one size fits all. 
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings throughout the lifecycle of the program, and maintain close coordination with key stakeholders, including Business Leadership and Production.
  • Deliver strategic and creative deliverables directly to day to day clients. Own contact reports, internally and back to the client.
  • Manage talent allocations week over week. Work with the Group Engagement Director and Business Leadership to ensure programs are planned to achieve successful completion, including coming in on time and on budget.
  • Coordinate internal teams, ensure high quality delivery, and manage back to overarching strategy of the engagement.
  • Develop a strong understanding of client’s business and industry, key competitors, and audience demographics.
  • Help maintain integrated ways of working by reinforcing team processes and managing documentation and communications.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality. You take immense pride in your work. You’re results-driven and detail-oriented, but also passionate about people, culture, and creativity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly, accurately, and succinctly.
  • Stellar time management and organizational skills, able to juggle multiple priorities under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Thick-skinned, persistent, and diplomatic—you handle challenges with optimism and a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable navigating across multiple internal disciplines (creative, production, strategy) and external partners to keep projects moving forward.
  • An understanding of when to escalate challenges and opportunities to the appropriate leads.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a creative agency or similar communications environment, with a strong understanding of advertising, marketing, media, production, and agency finance.
  • Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns across broadcast, digital, experiential and/or social.
  • Experience supporting or leading calls with cross-functional agency teams and interfacing directly with clients.
  • Fluent in Google Suite (especially Sheets and Slides); experience with resource management or workforce planning, as well as project planning tools.
  • Strong curiosity with a strong desire to learn and engage AI tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience directly managing timelines and deliverables for creative and production workstreams.
  • Exposure to or direct experience with production processes.
  • Acted as a producer or account executive in an agency environment with client facing
  • A passion for culture, innovation, and helping brands show up meaningfully in the world.

Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Sr. Business Director to join Translation and lead one of our most visible and consequential client partnerships. The Sr. Business Director is a senior client and business leader responsible for the success, growth, and health of a significant, complex account. This person has already demonstrated success at the Business Director level and brings greater executive influence, commercial judgment, and organizational leadership. They will serve as a strategic advisor to senior clients, lead integrated teams, and remain close to the work while actively shaping and pushing clients forward in culture.

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner, deeply invested in understanding your clients’ business challenges and uncovering opportunities to solve them through innovative, culturally attuned creative solutions. You’ll cultivate strong, proactive client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. With Program Management leading operational excellence, you will focus on shaping strategic agendas, fostering growth, and ensuring our work drives tangible results for both the client and agency.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the overall health, performance, growth, and senior client relationships for a flagship national account.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Director-level stakeholders, shaping agendas, influencing decisions, and constructively challenging clients with a clear point of view.
  • Translate complex business, consumer, category, and cultural dynamics into clear strategic direction and stronger creative work.
  • Lead integrated teams across Business Leadership, Strategy, Context, Creative, Program Management, Production, Analytics, and Partner Agencies, creating clarity around objectives, priorities, roles, and decisions.
  • Ensure work meets Translation’s standards for strategic rigor, creative ambition, cultural excellence, and client readiness before presentation.
  • Develop and drive the organic growth strategy, identifying and converting opportunities across stakeholders, business units, audiences, and workstreams.
  • Co-own account financial health with Program Management, including revenue, profitability, staffing, forecasting, scope performance, and investment recommendations.
  • Anticipate relationship, delivery, and commercial risks, intervening before they affect the client partnership, the quality of the work, team health, or profitability.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Business Supervisors through clear expectations, ongoing feedback, performance reviews, and meaningful development opportunities.
  • Contribute to agency leadership through new business, recruiting, shaping departmental standards, cross-functional improvements, and the development of future Business Leadership talent.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Exceptional business judgment and the ability to connect marketing decisions to broader client goals, organizational dynamics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, including the ability to read complex rooms, tailor counsel to different stakeholders, and navigate sensitive issues with discretion.
  • Strong strategic fluency and the ability to turn ambiguity into clear, actionable direction without prescribing the creative solution.
  • Commercial acumen across scopes, staffing models, forecasting, profitability, and investment decisions.
  • Ability to lead and inspire multidisciplinary teams, resolve tension constructively, and create accountability without relying solely on hierarchy.
  • A growth mindset, with the curiosity and proactivity to identify unmet client needs and translate them into meaningful opportunities.
  • Cultural fluency and a strong understanding of how contemporary culture, audiences, and communities influence brands and business.
  • Sound prioritization and decision-making skills in a high-volume, fast-moving, and highly visible client environment.
  • A coaching orientation and the ability to raise the performance, confidence, and judgment of other leaders.
  • Ability to balance client needs, creative ambition, executional feasibility, team sustainability, and financial health

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience leading integrated client relationships within a creative, marketing, or communications agency, including demonstrated success operating at the Business Director or equivalent level.
  • Proven experience owning senior client relationships, complex integrated campaigns, organic growth, account economics, and cross-functional team leadership for a major consumer brand.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching and developing account leadership talent while independently navigating high-stakes client and business decisions.      

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a large, complex, or matrixed national account across multiple stakeholders and workstreams.
  • Experience in QSR, retail, CPG, telecom, financial services, sports, entertainment, or another high-velocity consumer category.
  • Experience working within/leading an integrated agency team or multi-agency ecosystem.
  • Experience leading culturally specific or multicultural marketing while connecting the work to a broader brand and business strategy.
  • Track record of identifying and converting organic growth opportunities.
  • Experience leading scope development, staffing recommendations, forecasting, and profitability management.
  • Experience supporting new business pitches, agency initiatives, recruiting, or talent development.

job.description:
Who We Are

We are a well-established independent agency and thriving music business, built to help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. In 2022, Translation was awarded the number three spot in Ad Age’s Agency A-List and AdWeek’s Multicultural Agency of the Year. One year before, Translation was awarded Ad Age’s Small Agency of the Year. We’re unapologetically ambitious, but we’re also a tight-knit crew.

We are looking for a Senior Context Planner to join Translation! Please note that this role is a Hybrid role: four days in office and one day remote. 

Summary

The Senior Context Planner leads integrated communications and go-to-market planning that turns brand strategy and creative ideas into audience participation. As a strategic partner to clients and colleagues across disciplines, you define where, when, with whom and why a brand should show up, giving every channel a clear role. You move quickly and independently, form and defend a clear point of view, and translate complex thinking into compelling stories, thoughtfully designed decks and actionable plans.

You pair that planning craft with cultural fluency across sports, music, entertainment and the worlds they intersect with, from creators and fandom to fashion, gaming and internet behavior. With strong social instincts and a sharp creative eye, you understand how ideas come to life in-feed, spot emerging behaviors and formats, and turn those insights into meaningful opportunities for brands.

What You'll Do

Comms Planning.

  • Translate cultural insights and creative platforms into campaign architecture, defining the role of messaging, channels, moments and partners.
  • Build phasing and sequencing that shows how the idea unfolds over time.
  • Communicate the approach clearly and visually, making complex ecosystems simple and actionable

Cultural Insights

  • Identify meaningful cultural shifts, behaviors and communities relevant to the audience and brand.
  • Frame those signals into clear implications and opportunities for strategy and creative.
  • Use research and cultural inputs to sharpen the comms approach, not just report what’s happening, and contribute insights to company thought leadership (e.g. newsletters, social, etc.) beyond client work.

Creative world-building

  • Maintain a clear narrative throughline as the idea extends across the campaign ecosystem.
  • Shape how the idea is expressed across different touchpoints while preserving what makes it distinctive.
  • Identify opportunities for participation and amplification that help the idea travel further.

Campaign casting

  • Synthesize best practices across the talent x brand landscape into clear POVs
  • Develop talent filters and casting recommendations for creators, artists and partners who credibly bring the idea to life.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Build trust through clear and persuasive presentations
  • Collaborate across departments including strategy, creative, business leadership and production, including risk assessments, case studies and awards.
  • Mentor associate and mid level Context Planners, delegating clearly and providing feedback that strengthens their craft.
  • Actively connect with the UnitedMasters team for an understanding of upcoming milestones and priority artists for casting consideration in Translation brand campaigns.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Comfortable working quickly and independently, owning deliverables with light oversight and adapting as priorities shift.
  • Able to form and defend a clear POV, using cultural insights and research to make actionable recommendations.
  • Strong comms planning instincts, connecting audience behavior, brand opportunity and campaign choreography.
  • Sharp information design and visual taste: build strong decks, shape a clear story and make complex ideas simple and actionable.
  • Cultural fluency across sports, music, entertainment and pop culture, including their intersections with creators, fandom, fashion, gaming and internet behavior.
  • A social-first thinker with a strong creative eye for how ideas work in-feed and an instinct for emerging behaviors and formats.
  • Strong collaborator across disciplines, receptive to feedback and confident presenting to internal teams and clients.
  • Resourceful in research, curious about new platforms and media opportunities, and committed to refining the work.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Possess excellent time management, organization and prioritization skills.
  • Have the proven ability to work under tight deadlines and handle pressure, while consistently paying attention to accuracy and quality of work.
  • Exercise the ability to quickly and effectively adapt to changing needs and expectations.                                                                                        

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 4-7 years experience in a strategic position in an agency or brand environment
  • 4-year college degree in Marketing, Advertising or Business preferred.
  • Digitally savvy; MUST be proficient in Google Suite and Keynote (Mac preferred).

About UnitedMasters Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $93,000 - $110,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters 

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters' music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

The Role

You'll partner with platform, data, QA, and product engineers across the organization, owning the intersection of reliability and security: the tooling, monitoring, alerting, emergency response, and systems design the whole org depends on.

A defining part of the role is building how we protect our systems going forward. We're investing in agentic, AI-driven security pipelines that continuously detect, triage, and help remediate vulnerabilities across our codebase and infrastructure — and you'll lead the design and stewardship of that capability.

Above all, though, this is a coaching and consulting role. We're looking for a strong listener, patient collaborator, thoughtful architect, and skilled builder — someone who identifies needs in reliability and security and empowers peer developers to improve them.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with platform, data, QA, and product teams to understand their automation, infrastructure, monitoring, and security needs.
  • Build tooling and processes that solve the problems those conversations surface.
  • Build and maintain an agentic vulnerability detection and mitigation pipeline that will scan, triage, and propose fixes, with human-in-the-loop guardrails.
  • Embed security into the development lifecycle, including threat modeling, supp ly-chain hygiene, secrets management, secure-by-default patterns.
  • Lead security and reliability incident response as first-class operational concerns.
  • Define company-level SLAs, SLOs, and Error Budgets, and help teams set their own.
  • Steer system design toward shared tooling and decisions that ensure reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Join the on-call rotation as a peer to spot process gaps and coach on response.
  • Act as a senior escalation for infrastructure and security issues, helping resolve them while coaching teams to handle the next.
  • Own our AWS infrastructure and set the long-term strategy for our reliability and security posture, balancing scalability and cost.

Who You Are 

  • Senior-to-staff experience as an SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineer, owning production reliability at scale.
  • Hands-on application and/or infrastructure security experience; enough to lead the security conversation without a separate security team in the room.
  • Practical experience building with LLMs and agentic systems. You've shipped something real and understand their failure modes and where human oversight is non-negotiable.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals. You build tools and systems, not just configure them.
  • A coaching instinct: you measure impact by how much you raise the teams around you.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane — Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect — We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience — We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked — We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness — We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don't Know — We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don't.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $195,000 - $240,000

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA. As a company, we have a location-based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world's leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodation

UnitedMasters is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Phishing Scam Warning

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: UnitedMasters is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from UnitedMasters without a formal interview process. Additionally, UnitedMasters will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to TA@unitedmasters.com.

job.title: Temporary People Business Partner
job.description:
Who we are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Temporary People Business Partner to join Translation!

About the role

You will step into a senior, embedded PBP seat as the day-to-day people advisor to our agency leadership team while our PBP is on leave. This is not a placeholder role: you will be in the room for leadership decisions, bring a clear point of view on talent, performance and organizational questions, and handle difficult conversations with confidence. You will also own a live performance review cycle from calibration through delivery.

You will start in early January with three weeks of full-time onboarding alongside the current PBP, then take full ownership before the leave begins in February. You will keep a weekly update log so the transition back is seamless.

What you'll do

Senior leader partnership

  • Serve as the day-to-day people advisor to the agency leadership team and their departments
  • Contribute to the Senior Leadership Team agenda, which meets twice a week, in partnership with our VP of Agency Operations
