job.title: VP, Engineering
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building the world’s most powerful marketplace connecting artists, brands, and fans—empowering over 1.5M independent artists to earn, grow, and own their future. We’ve reinvented music distribution by putting artists first: enabling emerging creators to distribute directly to DSPs while maintaining ownership of their masters and up to 100% of royalties.

Our team is a diverse group of engineers, designers, product thinkers, and storytellers united by a shared mission to help artists succeed on their own terms. We combine deep expertise in technology, music, and culture to build products that unlock opportunity for creators everywhere. With a collaborative, creator-led mindset, we work closely with Translation, our in-house creative agency—to drive innovation at the intersection of culture and tech.

Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Alphabet (Google), Apple, and Disney, we are scaling rapidly across our B2C subscription business and Indie Label B2B platform.

What’s the Role?

UnitedMasters is seeking a Vice President of Engineering to lead and scale an engineering organization across backend, mobile (iOS/Android), web, data, QA, DevOps. This leader will drive the architectural vision, delivery excellence, and technical culture behind our consumer subscription products and our growing B2B indie label business.

A core mandate of this role is leveraging AI to enhance both artist  experience and engineering productivity. You will champion AI-driven personalization, artist tools, recommendations, and automation while also deploying AI-enabled development tooling, test automation, and ML-driven operations to improve engineering velocity and quality.

This is a hands-on, build-it-from-the-ground-up mandate. A top first-year priority is establishing UnitedMasters' “paved path” for agentic software development: defining the agentic-development methodology, making the core architecture and tooling decisions, setting context and documentation standards, standing up the eval and safety framework, coaching engineers through adoption, and demonstrating measurable developer-productivity gains. We're looking for someone who has personally built these capabilities, not sponsored or inherited them from a central platform team.

This role is ideal for a systems-level thinker, an inspiring people leader, and an operator who thrives in a fast-moving, culture-driven environment.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership, AI Innovation & Architecture

  • Define the multi-year technical and AI strategy across the UnitedMasters product ecosystem, championing new technologies, especially AI/ML, automation, and mobile innovation, to drive continuous improvement.
  • Build AI-powered customer-facing capabilities: artist insights, content recommendations, automated marketing, distribution optimization, and ML-driven discovery, monetization, and predictive tools.
  • Deliver measurable improvements from AI-enabled engineering, including gains in delivery speed, cycle time, and quality through capabilities such as code generation, automated testing, code review, debugging, and engineering operations automation.
  • Create and scale the paved path for AI-assisted and agentic software development across engineering: define the methodology and repeatable end-to-end workflows, determine how work is decomposed across sub-agents and tools, select and integrate the tooling, establish the supporting development practices and infrastructure, and drive adoption across the engineering organization.
  • Establish the technical foundations for reliable and secure AI agents in UnitedMasters products, including agent architecture, agent memory and state management, context engineering, RAG, tool use, an evaluation framework, human-in-the-loop controls, and defenses against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and other adversarial risks.
  • Drive architectural modernization and scale initiatives across our web applications, mobile apps, and internal tech platforms.
  • Ensure systems are reliable, performant, secure, and built for global scale.

Organizational Leadership & Global Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop an engineering organization, including managers, and senior ICs.
  • Own engineering competencies, performance systems, and technical excellence standards.

Execution, Delivery & Productivity

  • Drive  SDLC practices with strong CI/CD, automated testing, and AI-enabled developer tools.
  • Foster an environment where teams experiment and ship quickly, backed by strong measurement and rapid iteration.
  • Ensure predictable execution and high-quality delivery across all engineering pods.
  • Partner with Product and Design leadership on prioritization, planning, and resource allocation.
  • Own engineering commitments and ensure exceptional communication around timelines, risks, and dependencies.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Revenue, Marketing, and Artist Relations teams.
  • Translate business goals into clear, actionable technical plans.
  • Improve expectations-setting and visibility with executive stakeholders.

Who We’re Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years engineering experience with 5+ years leading orgs of 25+ engineers, including managers and senior ICs.
  • Proven success as a senior engineering leader at a scaled B2C, marketplace, or subscription-driven technology company.
  • Strong technical background with the ability to dive deep into systems architecture, data modeling, mobile performance, and platform-scale challenges.
    Demonstrated experience deploying AI/ML in both customer-facing features and internal engineering workflows.
  • Track record of improving engineering velocity and developer experience through tooling, process, and automation.
  • Direct, hands-on experience building agentic-development capabilities from the ground up (must-have): methodology, tooling, context standards, and eval/safety frameworks you personally designed and shipped, with measurable developer-productivity gains you drove.
  • Exceptional communication skills and experience partnering with product and executive leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large-scale content distribution, media ingestion pipelines, payments, subscription systems, or rights management.
  • Familiarity with Python/Django, JavaScript/TypeScript, Kubernetes, event-driven architecture, or modern mobile frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of data science, ML infrastructure, and experimentation platforms.
  • Background in creator economy, digital media, or marketplace ecosystems.

Who You Are

  • A people-first leader who inspires teams and takes pride in developing others.
  • A visionary technologist who sees around corners and builds systems that scale with the business.
  • A business-oriented thinker who maps engineering strategy to real outcomes for artists and label partners.
  • A decisive operator who thrives in ambiguity and moves with urgency.
  • A culture-builder who values collaboration, inclusion, and excellence.

Why UnitedMasters?

  • Lead the engineering organization shaping the future of independent music.
  • Build AI-powered products and tools that help artists earn, grow, and be discovered.
  • Drive innovation at the intersection of technology, creativity, and culture.
  • Make a direct impact on millions of creators around the world.

Salary Hiring Range:  $275K - 310K + bonus opportunity 

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. in some cases bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.



About UnitedMasters

UnitedMasters empowers brands and artists to forge authentic connections with audiences at scale by bringing together culture, technology and storytelling. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first—disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their Masters and up to 100% of royalties. UnitedMasters has over 1.5 million artists on its platform and is growing rapidly. Brands like Diageo, Ally, and ESPN come to UnitedMasters to partner with these artists and play a role in moving culture forward. In the past year, UnitedMasters subscribers have grown rapidly. With $170M raised to date, UnitedMasters is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Apple, Alphabet (aka Google), and Disney amongst others.

job.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

We are currently seeking an eager and collaborative individual to serve as the technical resource on CloudOps team. Responsible to provide technical support and guidance regarding cloud-based SAP solutions as well a being a key technical support resource in supporting the greater cloud landscape.


Job Functions:


The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following functions in the Operations organization:

  • Utilize technical skills and tools to coordinate, maintain, enhance, and deploy cloud-based solutions while following corporate standards and best practices
  • Work within a CloudOps team to meet project objectives in a timely fashion
  • Update project status reports (progress/risks/issues/roadblocks) as required by Senior Management
  • Use CloudOps methodology and toolsets to implement and support solutions in AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Implement proposed solutions to ensure the delivery of a quality product or service
  • Ensure cloud resources meet UMG’s operational requirements and are in compliance with UMG infrastructure and security standards
  • Provide documentation and communication to peers and other IT Teams for status, coordination, objectives, and performance
  • Compile and remediate vulnerabilities identified by the securities team
  • Assess and troubleshoot, consult with vendors, and coordinate with other teams for problem resolution
  • Ensure high work standards regarding incident and change management tasks
  • Other tasks as deemed necessary or appropriate

Job Requirements:


Skills/Abilities:


Critical and Required Daily Skills

  • SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) Administration: Deploy, configure, and manage SLES EC2 instances in AWS; troubleshoot boot issues; manage LVM (LVS, VGS, PVS); configure SUID, SGID, Sticky Bit; expand XFS file systems and EBS volumes; manage permissions and ACLs. User/group management, SSH security, package management (zypper, rpm), process/service management (systemd), log analysis, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls), backup/restore, patching and security hardening.
  • AWS Services: EC2, S3, EFS, Storage Gateway, EBS, VPC, VPC Endpoints, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail; provisioning, configuration, monitoring and optimization.
  • Automation & Scripting: Bash/shell scripting, AWS CLI, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Ansible), cron jobs and system automation.
  • Monitoring & Performance: System resource monitoring, capacity planning, AWS monitoring tools, and troubleshooting performance bottlenecks.

Overall Skillset

  • Proficient usage and management of Linux and Windows technology stacks (Ubuntu, Windows Server, Nginx, Apache, MySQL, PHP, IIS, MS SQL, .NET, and more)
  • Proven experience with AWS, GCP, and Azure in an enterprise setting (personal use of these services will not be considered as equivalent)
  • Experienced usage of Kubernetes technology stacks (K8s, EKS, GKE, Helm, Prometheus, Cortex, Grafana, Istio, and more)
  • Accomplished with Modern CloudOps methodologies and toolsets (Chef, Terraform, Jira, Slack, Vault, Python, Cortex)
  • Solid grasp and usage of version control and release management concepts and tools, particularly Git (Github / SVN/Bitbucket) for code branching and merging
  • Understanding of Modern Auth (OIDC, SSO, SAML, Federation)
  • Build and support solutions using both serverless and server-based infrastructure in AWS, Azure, and GCP cloud environments
  • Follow deployment practices using CICD Processes and Technologies (Jenkins, TeamCity, Tekton, Spinnaker, Octopus, CodeDeploy, Automate)
  • Solid understanding of key cloud design concepts such as “High Availability” (HA), “Elastic Load Balancing” (ELB), Principle of Least Privilege, Resiliency, Ephemeral Computing, Stateless Computing, Virtual Networking, and Scaling

UMG West Coast Labels is comprised of Interscope Geffen A&M Music Group and  Capitol Music Group (ICLG). ICLG’s Business Affairs team is seeking a Coordinator who is very efficient and highly attuned to the smallest of details. The right candidate will also possess a strong sense of discretion and confidentiality and will ideally have experience in supporting a team within a Business Affairs or music licensing environment.


The position will perform a variety of duties, and the candidate for this job must be able to liaise with all levels of personnel and departments, to help assist with the release of music and videos by label artists. This position has a strong focus on clearances and problem solving, and doing the necessary work to help accomplish the goals of the label and its artists.


The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter who possesses a strong ability to multi-task, works well under pressure with tight time deadlines, and has a passion for music. UMG’s Digital Rights Administration team is dedicated to monitoring and monetizing content on digital platforms. We are currently seeking eager and exceptional new hires with familiarity to Universal’s artists and catalogue to focus exclusively on managing UMG assets on YouTube. The team’s goal is to maximize value from the rights of UMG’s recording artists in the digital space through content claiming.


How You’ll CREATE:

  • Establish an in-depth understanding of YouTube’s Content Management System (“CMS”) and its relation to the protection and exploitation of UMG music on YouTube
  • Increase advertising revenue by exploring YouTube for popular User Generated Content (“UGC”) and claiming videos that incorporate UMG’s recordings
  • Monitor claims regularly and adapt/change strategies to ensure goals are reached each quarter
  • Manage and assess the accuracy of sound recording-related data in CMS
  • Review videos that have been automatically claimed as UMG property by YouTube’s Content ID system and determine the accuracy of those claims
  • Track uses of the UMG catalogue and take appropriate steps to evaluate and take action on any infringing videos
  • Work with UMG repertoire owners, distributed labels to guarantee the satisfactory use of their recordings, as well as with third-parties to resolve claim disputes and ownership conflicts

  • Surface any issues encountered while using the CMS tool and UMG internal systems to team operations lead and coordinate to develop solutions
  • Engage with other UMG departments as needed, helping to ensure that all stakeholders are aware of our claiming activities
  • Provide UMG staff and/or stakeholders with detailed reports highlighting relevant analytics supplied by YouTube, including summaries of monetized and blocked videos
  • Handle requests in YouTube Operations mailbox on Thursday evenings to ensure proper claiming of new releases

  • YouTube content management or claiming experience preferred
  • Superior organizational skills and task management

  • Forward thinking and ambitious; ability to work in a fast-paced environment

Experience:

job.title: Director, Business Intelligence
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Director of Business Intelligence

CD Baby | A Virgin Music Group Company

Full-Time | Los Angeles, CA / Nashville, TN / New York, NY | Remote Considered

The Opportunity

As Director of Business Intelligence, you will define and own the strategy and roadmap for making data accessible, trusted, and actionable across CD Baby. You’ll establish the metrics that matter most, drive data normalization across teams, and build the infrastructure that enables self-service insights at scale.

You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Finance, Data Engineering and stakeholders across the company to prioritize the highest-impact KPIs, ensure consistent definitions across the organization, and embed data into how decisions get made.

This role is both strategic and hands-on: you’ll architect the BI function while also building dashboards, leading analyses, and translating complex data into clear business recommendations.

What You'll Do

Define the BI Strategy & Roadmap

• Establish a company-wide BI vision and multi-quarter roadmap.

• Standardize core metrics and KPIs across business, product and technology teams.

• Prioritize the highest-impact insights that drive growth, retention, and artist success.

• Build scalable and self-service reporting that reduces ad hoc dependency.

• Evaluate and deploy AI-enabled analytics tools that scale insight generation and reduce dependency on manual reporting

Drive Customer & Product Insights

• Lead segmentation, cohort analysis, lifetime value modeling, and churn analysis.

• Identify growth opportunities, at-risk artists, and high-value segments.

• Define and measure success metrics for new product and feature launches.

• Support experimentation and A/B testing with rigorous statistical analysis.

• Analyze streaming consumption, revenue, and audience trends across digital platforms to identify opportunities for artist growth, monetization, and business performance.

Build Data Analytics Models

• Partner with Data Engineering to continuously improve data quality, modeling, and governance.

• Own the business-facing analytics layer, building scalable data models, reporting infrastructure, and self-service tools that enable trusted, actionable insights across the organization.

• Translate complex datasets into clear, executive-ready narratives.

What You Bring

• 7 or more years of experience in data analytics, customer insights, business intelligence, or a related field.

• Advanced SQL; experience with modern BI tools and cloud warehouses, such as Snowflake,

BigQuery, dbt, Cube.

• Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in enterprise BI tools.

• Strong foundation in customer and commercial analytics, including segmentation, lifetime value,

retention, churn, experimentation, and revenue performance.

• Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and communicate clearly at all levels.

About CD Baby

CD Baby is a music industry pioneer, empowering independent artists to distribute, monetize, and grow

their music careers globally. As a Virgin Music Group company, we combine the entrepreneurial spirit of

an indie platform with the resources and reach of a major music group. Our technology and data teams sit

at the heart of how we serve millions of artists worldwide.

job.title: Director, Privacy and Data Protection
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Director, Privacy & Data Protection

Job Category: Business & Legal Affairs


How We LEAD:

The Director, Privacy & Data Protection will be an experienced privacy attorney supporting Universal Music Group's global privacy and data protection program. Working closely with the Senior Vice President, Privacy & Data Protection, this role will provide practical, hands-on legal support across privacy contracting, data subject rights, cybersecurity incidents, digital marketing and other matters involving the collection, use, sharing and protection of personal data.


As the world leader in music-based entertainment, UMG operates across a broad range of labels, artist businesses, digital platforms, e-commerce experiences, marketing initiatives and fan-facing services. The Director will work with colleagues across Legal, Information Security, Technology, Digital, Marketing, E-Commerce and the business to help UMG use data responsibly while supporting artists, creators and fans around the world.


The ideal candidate will combine strong privacy law fundamentals with excellent drafting and negotiation skills, sound judgment and a practical, business-oriented approach. This role requires an attorney who is comfortable managing a significant volume of day-to-day matters, can independently handle work within established frameworks, and recognizes when novel, sensitive or higher-risk issues require escalation.


How You'll CREATE:

  • Draft, review and negotiate data protection and privacy terms in commercial agreements, including data processing agreements, data-sharing arrangements, international data transfer provisions, information security terms and other privacy-related contractual provisions.
  • Partner with UMG's Business & Legal Affairs teams on privacy issues arising in artist, vendor, technology, platform, licensing, e-commerce, marketing and other commercial arrangements involving personal data.
  • Handle UMG's day-to-day legal work relating to data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including assessing request scope and applicable legal requirements, advising on exemptions and response obligations, coordinating with privacy operations and relevant business teams, reviewing and drafting responses, and escalating complex or sensitive matters as appropriate.
  • Support the privacy-law aspects of cybersecurity and data security incidents, working closely with Information Security, Legal and other stakeholders to assess incident facts and affected data, analyze applicable notification and regulatory requirements, document legal assessments, and draft or review incident-related communications.
  • Assist with investigations of potential privacy and data security issues, including gathering relevant facts, evaluating legal obligations and coordinating with outside counsel where appropriate.
  • Advise business and legal teams on privacy requirements affecting UMG's websites, applications, digital platforms, artist and fan experiences, e-commerce operations, advertising and marketing activities.
  • Provide practical guidance on online advertising and tracking technologies, marketing communications, consent and preference management, and related privacy and consumer protection requirements.
  • Advise on compliance with U.S. federal and state privacy laws, GDPR and other applicable international privacy and data protection requirements.
  • Support privacy reviews of new and evolving business initiatives, technologies, vendors, products and uses of data, including privacy impact assessments where appropriate.
  • Assist with third-party privacy and data protection matters, including vendor diligence, data-transfer requirements, privacy questionnaires and remediation of identified issues.
  • Help maintain and improve privacy policies, procedures, templates, playbooks and other resources that support consistent and scalable privacy practices across UMG's labels, territories and business units.
  • Work with privacy operations, Information Security and business teams to identify recurring issues and improve processes for contract review, rights requests, incident response and other recurring privacy matters.
  • Support responses to regulatory inquiries, audits and other privacy or data protection matters as needed.
  • Monitor relevant developments in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, digital marketing and consumer protection law and provide clear, practical guidance regarding developments relevant to UMG's businesses.
  • Provide privacy guidance and training to Legal, business and operational teams as needed.
  • Support privacy issues arising from emerging technologies and new uses of data as appropriate.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across UMG's labels, business units and territories, handling routine and moderately complex matters independently and escalating novel, sensitive or significant matters as appropriate.

Bring Your VIBE:

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 8+ years of relevant legal experience, with substantial experience in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, technology transactions or a closely related field, gained at a law firm, in-house legal department or a combination of both.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating data processing agreements and privacy, data use and security provisions in commercial agreements.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal and state privacy laws, including CCPA/CPRA and other comprehensive state privacy laws, and meaningful familiarity with GDPR and international data protection requirements.
  • Experience advising on data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including access, deletion, correction and related requests.
  • Experience advising on privacy issues arising from websites, digital advertising, online tracking technologies, e-commerce, marketing and other consumer-facing data practices.
  • Familiarity with consumer protection and marketing requirements relevant to digital and direct-to-consumer activities.
  • Meaningful experience supporting cybersecurity or data security incident response, including familiarity with breach-notification requirements and experience working with information security or technical teams during investigations.
  • Strong legal research, analytical, drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify the issues that matter and provide clear, practical and business-oriented advice.
  • Ability to understand technical and operational facts sufficiently to identify relevant privacy, cybersecurity and digital marketing legal issues.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle a significant volume of matters independently while recognizing when an issue warrants escalation.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple matters and competing priorities in a fast-moving, global and highly collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain complex privacy and data protection requirements clearly to lawyers and non-lawyers.
  • CIPP/US, CIPP/E or another relevant privacy certification preferred.
  • Experience in entertainment, music, digital media, technology, e-commerce, advertising or another consumer-facing and data-intensive industry is a plus.

job.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. How we LEAD:

Universal Music Group is building an Applied AI and Machine Learning function to help our teams discover and develop artists, connect with fans, make stronger commercial decisions, and protect the integrity of the music ecosystem.


We are looking for a Lead Machine Learning Engineer to build, ship, and operate reliable machine learning and AI systems that create durable value across UMG. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who combines strong software and systems expertise with practical knowledge of the AI and ML lifecycle.


You will turn models, data products, and AI workflows into maintainable production capabilities across revenue forecasting, artist, catalog intelligence and talent scouting, release marketing, and rights and ecosystem integrity. The role focuses on reproducible development, rigorous evaluation, safe deployment, observability, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement.


How you’ll CREATE:

Core MLOps & Production Infrastructure

  • Lead initiatives from problem framing and data assessment through deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and sustained adoption (versus reach a well-evidenced decision not to build).
  • Build and operate reliable ML and LLM-powered workflows, including retrieval and grounding, structured outputs, tool and API integrations, orchestration, batch or real-time inference, CI/CD, and safe rollback.
  • Establish AI evaluation and observability using representative and adversarial test sets, regression tests, human review where appropriate, traces, drift detection, latency, quality, safety, usage, and cost metrics.

Data & Feature Engineering

  • Build reliable data and feature pipelines from streaming consumption data, release metadata, social campaign data, catalog information, and commercial finance systems; monitor completeness, freshness, anomalies, and data lineage.
  • Develop and operate models across personalization, recommender systems, search and ranking, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and decision support—choosing a simpler reliable approach whenever is appropriate.

Business Stakeholders

  • Move generative and multimodal AI capabilities from prototypes into dependable, cost-effective workflows that help people make decisions and take action.
  • Partner with ML scientists, data engineers, product managers, designers, domain experts, A&R, Marketing, Finance, and labels; contribute to architecture, code reviews, mentoring, and pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions.

What success looks like in your first 12 months

  • Ship production ML or AI capabilities that improve a meaningful UMG decision or workflow.
  • Establish automated evaluation and regression coverage for AI workflows, with trusted measures for quality, safety, latency, cost, and business usefulness.
  • Improve the reliability, observability, performance, scalability, or cost-efficiency of existing workflows.
  • Move a prototype or manual process into a dependable workflow used for a real decision, such as allocating marketing spend, prioritizing an A&R opportunity, reviewing a forecast, or investigating an integrity alert.
  • Raise the technical bar through documentation, reviews, and mentorship.
  • Effective collaboration and communication with business stakeholders, labels, central teams, and other non-technical partners.

Bring your VIBE:

  • A bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 5+ years of experience in software, machine learning, data, or platform engineering with ownership of production systems and ambiguous, high-impact problems.
  • Experience engineering modern AI systems, including LLM-based workflows, retrieval, grounding, structured generation, tool use, safety controls, and human review, with clear evaluation and monitoring practices.
  • Strong Python and software engineering skills, including testing, code review, version control, debugging, maintainable design, and experience with a second production language or equivalent systems experience.
  • Experience with cloud-based data and ML platforms. UMG workloads use GCP and BigQuery; experience with services such as Vertex AI, Dataflow, or Cloud Composer is valuable, while equivalent AWS or cloud-agnostic experience is also relevant.
  • Experience building and operating data pipelines, distributed systems, APIs, services, workflow orchestration, model serving, batch or online inference, and refresh or retraining processes.
  • Ability to collaborate across technical and business disciplines, communicate tradeoffs clearly, take ownership without formal authority, and choose a simpler reliable solution when it is better than a more complex model.

Especially valuable

  • Experience in music, media, entertainment, streaming marketplaces, advertising, or another industry where culture, consumer behavior, and business conditions change rapidly.
  • Experience working with complex non-tabular data, such as audio, text, images, or video.
  • Experience building decision-support products and automated workflows rather than standalone models or static dashboards.
  • Experience establishing model governance, data provenance, copyright safety protocols, or human-in-the-loop review systems.
  • Experience building systems for artist discovery, catalog understanding, fan marketing, rights management, fraud detection, or trust and safety.

You will be equally comfortable developing a new model, challenging an existing approach, designing an AI evaluation framework, or helping a team turn a promising prototype into a reliable production capability.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 


Software Engineer — Publishing Platform


Downtown Music Publishing is looking for a driven individual to join us as a Software Engineer to help build our next-generation music publishing platform from the ground up. You'll help in shaping the architecture, tooling, and engineering culture of a catalog management platform that powers musical work registration, rights tracking, and royalty collection for publishers worldwide. Currently seeking candidates local to the Nashville Area.


What you'll do


●      Build a new platform from first principles — data model, API design, and infrastructure — rather than maintaining legacy systems, while making pragmatic decisions that hold up at production scale.

●      Design and implement a schema-first GraphQL API (Apollo Server) over PostgreSQL, including multi-tenant data isolation (row-level security), type-safe query layers, and performance patterns like DataLoader batching.

●      Develop React/TypeScript (Next.js) interfaces used by both internal teams and clients to manage catalogs, registrations, and data-quality workflows.

●      Build AI-native features as a core part of the product: AI-assisted data ingestion and matching, agent-accessible APIs via Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLM-powered workflows using the Vercel AI SDK and Amazon Bedrock.

●      Work in an AI-augmented, spec-driven development workflow — architecture specs, agent-assisted implementation, and rigorous automated review are how the team ships, not an experiment on the side.

●      Own components end-to-end: design, implementation, integration testing against real databases, deployment (AWS CDK), and operational responsibility.

●      Model and implement music publishing domain logic — works, writers, shares, agreements, and society registration formats (e.g., CWR) — with the precision that financial and rights data demands.


You are / have


●      Bachelor's degree in computer science, software development, or equivalent experience.

●      5+ years of experience developing web-based software solutions.

●      Experience architecting new systems or services from scratch — you're comfortable with ambiguity, and you document the "why" behind decisions, not just the "what."

●      Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js across the full stack.

●      Solid relational database fundamentals: schema design, migrations, transactions, and query performance in PostgreSQL (or similar).

●      Experience with both traditional software development lifecycle and agentic software development — including spec-driven development, AI-augmented engineering, and working effectively with coding agents.

●      Interest in the music industry — prior experience with rights management, royalties, or metadata standards (CWR, DDEX, ISWC/ISRC) is a plus, not a requirement.


Ideally, significant experience with some of the following technologies or similar tools:


Backend: Node.js, GraphQL (Apollo Server, schema-first), PostgreSQL, etc.

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, modern state management (e.g., Zustand)

AI/Agents: Vercel AI SDK, SpecKit, CodeX, Amazon Bedrock, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM tool design.

Infrastructure: AWS (including CDK), Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions

Testing: Vitest, Testcontainers (integration testing against real databases), Playwright

Observability: Datadog, Sentry, structured logging

job.title: R1 On Air Talent_Talk Host
job.description:
About the Role:

The R1 On Air Talent_Talk Host will serve as the primary voice and personality for our talk radio programming in Raleigh, NC, engaging listeners with compelling content and dynamic conversations. This role is pivotal in creating an entertaining and informative atmosphere that attracts and retains a loyal audience. The host will be responsible for developing show topics, conducting interviews, and facilitating discussions that resonate with a diverse listener base. Success in this position requires a blend of creativity, quick thinking, and excellent communication skills to maintain high listener engagement throughout each broadcast. Ultimately, the host will contribute significantly to the station’s brand identity and market presence by delivering consistently high-quality on-air content.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as an on-air radio host or talk show presenter.
  • Exceptional verbal communication and public speaking skills.
  • Ability to think quickly and adapt to live broadcast situations.
  • Strong knowledge of current events, pop culture, and topics relevant to the local community.
  • Familiarity with radio broadcasting equipment and software.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Broadcasting, or a related field.
  • Experience with social media management and audience engagement strategies.
  • Background in interviewing diverse guests and managing live call-in segments.
  • Ability to produce and edit audio content using industry-standard software.
  • Knowledge of FCC regulations and compliance standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and deliver engaging live talk shows that cover a variety of topics relevant to the target audience.
  • Research current events, trends, and listener interests to develop compelling show content and discussion points.
  • Conduct interviews with guests, experts, and community members to provide diverse perspectives and insights.
  • Interact with listeners through calls, social media, and other platforms to foster community engagement and respond to audience feedback.
  • Collaborate with producers and technical staff to ensure smooth broadcast operations and adherence to station policies.

Skills:

The required skills enable the host to communicate clearly and engagingly, ensuring that each broadcast captivates the audience and maintains their interest. Quick thinking and adaptability are essential for managing live discussions and unexpected situations on air. Research and content development skills support the creation of relevant and timely show material that resonates with listeners. Technical proficiency with broadcasting equipment and software ensures smooth production and high-quality audio delivery. Preferred skills such as social media management and audio editing enhance the host’s ability to expand the show’s reach and maintain a strong connection with the audience across multiple platforms.

job.title: Promotions/On-air Host - Lethbridge, AB
job.description:
Love Radio? Love Country Music? Ready for a Bigger Opportunity?

Vista Radio's 98.1 The Ranch and 94.1 CJOC are looking for an energetic, creative, and community-minded broadcaster to join our Lethbridge team as Promotions for both stations as well as an On-air Host, serving as the Afternoon Drive Host on 98.1 The Ranch.

This is more than just a radio job. It's an opportunity to become a recognizable voice in Southern Alberta while playing an active role in exciting station promotions, events, contests, and community initiatives that connect thousands of listeners with our brands.

Why Lethbridge?

Lethbridge is one of Alberta's best-kept secrets. With a population of over 100,000, it offers the perfect balance of career opportunity, affordability, and lifestyle.

Imagine finishing your show and being minutes from:

World-class hiking, fishing, and camping

Waterton Lakes National Park

The Rocky Mountains

Golf courses, lakes, and outdoor recreation

A thriving restaurant, arts, and live music scene

Some of Canada's sunniest weather, with more than 320 days of sunshine annually

Unlike larger cities, your dollar goes further here. Housing remains significantly more affordable than Calgary or Edmonton, commute times are short, and you'll quickly become part of a welcoming community where local radio still matters.

The Opportunity

As our Promotions/On-air Host, you'll support and coordinate promotional activities for both 98.1 The Ranch and 94.1 CJOC. You'll collaborate with programming, sales, clients, and community partners to bring creative promotional ideas to life through on-air, digital, and community initiatives.

In addition to your promotional responsibilities, you'll entertain and engage listeners during the Afternoon Drive show on 98.1 The Ranch, creating compelling content, connecting with the community, and contributing to the continued success of one of Southern Alberta's leading country radio brands.

This exciting dual-role opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys taking an active part in creating memorable promotional experiences, being behind the microphone, and connecting with listeners.

What You'll Be Doing

Support and coordinate promotional activities for both 98.1 The Ranch and 94.1 CJOC.

Host and produce the Afternoon Drive show on 98.1 The Ranch, delivering an entertaining, live, and locally focused program that connects with listeners.

Maintain an active in-market and on-site presence to support day-to-day station operations, including studio support, team coordination, listener interaction, and voice-tracking additional shifts or stations as required.

Create engaging on-air, online, and social media content that connects with listeners and reflects the station's brand.

Represent both stations at community events, concerts, promotional appearances, and live broadcasts.

Assist with planning, coordinating, and executing station contests, promotions, and community activations.

Support promotional campaigns across radio, digital, and social media platforms.

Collaborate with sales and programming teams to deliver engaging client promotions and station initiatives.

Maintain promotional calendars, track prize inventories, and assist with event logistics and coordination.

Contribute creative ideas to enhance listener engagement, station visibility, and community involvement throughout Southern Alberta.

Assist with the setup, coordination, and execution of promotional events and activities.

Work collaboratively with team members to ensure promotional activities are delivered effectively and on schedule.

What We're Looking For

Previous experience in radio broadcasting, promotions, events, or media is required.

Strong on-air personality with excellent communication and storytelling abilities.

Creative thinker who enjoys contributing fresh ideas for promotions and listener engagement.

Excellent organizational, time management, and coordination skills.

Experience creating social media and digital content.

Ability to multitask, manage competing priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a collaborative, team-oriented approach.

Enthusiasm for engaging with listeners, clients, and community members.

Knowledge of country music and country lifestyle is an asset.

Willingness to participate in community events, promotional appearances, and occasional activities outside regular working hours.

What We Offer

Competitive salary

Extended health and benefits package

Opportunities for professional development

A collaborative and supportive team environment

The chance to make a real impact in your community

Access to major concerts, events, and promotions

A lifestyle that combines career growth with exceptional quality of life

Join the Vista Family

If you're passionate about radio, country music, community involvement, and creating memorable listener experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

Come build your career where local radio is still thriving, your creativity is valued, and you can make a meaningful contribution both on-air and in the community.

Apply today and discover why so many people choose to build their lives in Lethbridge and Southern Alberta.

Vista Radio’s Vault of Benefits

At Vista Radio, we’re more than just a workplace — we’re a community of passionate people making a difference through local storytelling, music, and meaningful connections. We invest in our people with a benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and future — all in a fun, collaborative environment.

Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

🩺 Health & Dental Coverage – Comprehensive plans for individuals and families📈 RRSP Program with DPSP Matching – Vista matches your contributions into a Deferred Profit-Sharing Plan💪 Short-term & Long-term Disability – Income protection when life throws you a curveball🧠 Employee and Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) – 24/7 access to mental health and counseling support🏖️ Annual Vacation & Stat Holidays – Paid time off to relax and recharge❤️ Life & Optional Life Insurance – Protection for you and your loved ones💻 Virtual Care Access – On-demand, 24/7 healthcare wherever you are🌍 Work Where You Live – Make a real impact in the communities we serve

If you’re motivated by results, driven by challenge, and ready to take control of your earning potential, Vista Radio wants you on our team.

Application Instructions

On our company website, click the "Apply" button on the tap left corner of the job posting to get started! Click here: Job Board | Dayforce Jobs

If you experience any difficulty submitting your application, please contact the Human Resources Department at hr@vistaradio.ca.

job.title: Associate Editor, Vulture
job.description:
Associate Editor, Vulture

Vulture is New York magazine's entertainment brand: a leading voice in the cultural conversation and a daily destination for obsessive fans. We cover TV, movies, music, comedy, books, theater, and the internet with wit & rigor.

We're looking for a skilled Associate Editor to play a central role in our editorial operation. You'll shape a high volume of stories across formats, help run the systems that keep our site moving, and bring fresh voices and ideas to Vulture. This is a New York City-based, in-office role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Editing and story development

  • Edit, assign, and manage a range of Vulture formats, including short features, interview rubrics, critical lists, and recurring franchises.
  • Edit on both a story and a line level.
  • Pitch ideas for articles, videos, podcasts, games, and live events, and help develop pitches from colleagues and freelancers.
  • Take part in brainstorms and editorial planning meetings, contributing to coverage plans around major releases, awards seasons, and breaking cultural moments.
  • Bring new writers into the Vulture orbit by reaching out with assignments and encouraging them to pitch.

Cross-platform collaboration

  • Partner with the podcast team to bring episodes to the site, usually as edited transcripts, and find new ways to extend audio content into written stories.
  • Work with the audience, art, and social teams on story packaging, rollout, and community-building projects.

Industry relationships and access

  • Serve as the main point of contact for TV and film publicists and studio reps, coordinating access to screenings and screeners for the team.
  • Help maintain release calendars. 

WHAT YOU BRING

  • At least two years of editing experience at a digital publication, magazine, or comparable outlet.
  • Strong story and line editing skills, with a sharp eye for structure, clarity, and voice.
  • A passion for culture and entertainment, plus familiarity with Vulture's approach to covering it.
  • Experience in a fast-moving digital editorial environment and comfort with quick turnarounds.
  • Confidence pitching story ideas and a good instinct for what Vulture readers want.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders calmly.
  • Clear, professional communication with writers, colleagues, and industry contacts.
  • Familiarity with a CMS, SEO basics, and audience analytics.
  • You’re funny and nice.

job.title: Director, Podcast Partnerships
job.description:
Who We Are

The Vox Media Podcast Network is one of the largest U.S. podcast publishers, home to some of the most popular and influential shows. Reaching a monthly audience of tens of millions across audio, video, and social platforms, our podcasts spark conversations and shape culture, covering everything from politics, technology, and business to food, lifestyle, sports, entertainment, and more. The Vox Media Podcast Network is powered by thought leaders in modern media, and home to a prestigious portfolio of voices from New York Magazine, Vox.com, and The Bulwark. Learn more at podcasts.voxmedia.com.

 

As a Director of Podcast Partnerships, you will be an important revenue contributor responsible for expanding high-value agency and client direct relationships and driving new business growth across the Vox Media Podcast Network. You will serve as a trusted strategic partner to brand and growth marketers and agencies, delivering innovative podcast and talent solutions that connect brands with highly engaged, intellectually curious communities at scale.

Leveraging Vox Media's premium podcast network — including leading shows and high profile talent across technology, business, sports, science, and culture — high-value audiences, and unique scale, you will build partnerships that drive measurable business outcomes. This role demands a consultative mindset, strong relationship-building skills, the ability to influence across all levels of marketing organizations, a passion for podcasts and talent, and a relentless drive to grow revenue in a fast-paced, ambitious environment.

What You'll Do

Lead Strategic Growth: Develop and execute a long-term revenue strategy to expand business with existing and new direct-response clients across the Vox Media Podcast Network.  This role will focus on both upfront deal expansion and 360 campaign partnerships, integrating performance and growth marketers across audio, video and social platforms.

Cultivate Executive-Level Relationships: Build and deepen relationships with key decision-makers at agencies and pertinent client side partners - VPs of Marketing, Heads of Brand & Growth Marketing - positioning Vox Media as a go-to strategic partner for podcast and talent investment.

Proactive Market Engagement: Identify industry trends, evolving buyer behaviors, and client challenges within the performance marketing sector, proactively delivering cross-platform podcast and talent solutions before RFPs are issued.

Consultative Sales Leadership: Translate client objectives into high-impact campaigns using Vox Media podcasts, host talent, video, social and live event capabilities.

Build & Develop Key Relationships:  Bring a deep understanding of the structure, hierarchy, and strategy of the major performance agencies in order to unlock increased investment, new strategic partners, and a diversified buying approach.

Revenue Accountability: Own forecasting, pipeline development, and quarterly and annual sales targets, with full accountability for results and strategic account planning.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with editorial, marketing, creative, production and operations teams to deliver custom, culturally resonant proposals that reflect how performance brands communicate with their audiences.

Brand Advocacy: Represent the Vox Media Podcast Network at key industry events and client forums to expand our presence and thought leadership within the performance marketing  ecosystem.

Who You Are

Proven Media Seller: 7+ years of digital media and/or podcast & talent sales experience with a demonstrated track record of success in direct-response and growth marketing space. This is a NYC based role with potential for additional national travel responsibilities.

Strategic Dealmaker: Skilled in complex, consultative sales to marketing executives and agency leadership, with experience securing large-scale, integrated partnerships.

Podcast & Talent Native: Deep familiarity with the podcast and talent advertising landscape — editorial and talent integrations, multi-platform partnerships, scaled podcast buys — and a genuine passion for the medium.

Visionary & Entrepreneurial: A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with the ability to anticipate market shifts and client needs before they surface.

Influential Communicator: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade at the highest levels of a client organization. Ability to think critically, connect advertiser needs to the right show and talent and communicate the value proposition with clarity and confidence.

Data-Informed Strategist: Comfortable leveraging performance data, audience insights, and category trends to craft compelling, measurable solutions that justify and grow podcast and talent investment.

In this role, you are not just selling media — you are shaping how performance brands connect with audiences through premium audio and video content, trusted voices, and unique scale. As a Director of Podcast Partnerships, your ability to see around corners, anticipate client needs, and deliver category-defining ideas will directly influence Vox Media's position as a leading force in the podcast and talent space!

job.description:
We're looking for an Executive Producer to help shape the future of America, Actually, Vox’s politics podcast. 

You’ll work closely with the host and the team to craft the show’s road to the 2028 presidential election, and oversee the production and publishing of the show, making sure every episode lands as audio, as full-length video, and as a set of clips built to make news.

You'll lead a small team of producers and video staff and work closely with Vox's politics editors, social video team, and audience and membership teams to grow the show. 

This is a leadership role. You'll think big-picture about the direction of the show, and also oversee production and publishing of episodes each week. Candidates should want both halves of that.

This role is based in New York City and will require three days per week of attendance in our New York office. 

What You'll Do

Editorial leadership

  • Set the editorial direction of the show with the host and supervising producer: the big questions we take on, the guests we book, and the angles and formats that make an episode feel distinctly Vox
  • Oversee episodes, giving clear and fast notes and final signoff on each episode 
  • Oversee guest strategy and booking priorities, including building relationships across both parties and with voices outside Washington
  • Partner with Vox's politics desk and standards editors on fact-checking, fairness, and legal review
  • Coordinate with other Vox senior leadership, keeping stakeholders abreast of weekly episodes, and overseeing collaboration across Vox podcasts and verticals

Production and team leadership

  • Manage the show's producers and video staff: hiring, coaching, workload, and career development
  • Oversee production workflows with supervising producer, from booking to publish, including studio and remote shoots, field tapings, and live streams
  • Manage the show budget, freelancer spend, and production schedule

Growth and distribution

  • Partner with the social and audience teams to set audience growth and engagement strategy for the show, and use performance data to sharpen formats and packaging
  • Work with Vox’s head of video and the supervising producer to establish America, Actually’s YouTube strategy: titles, thumbnails, chapters, and long-form packaging
  • Partner with the membership team to develop creative ideas for bonus and member-exclusive content and make sure it ships every week
  • Work with sales and brand development on sponsor integrations, live events, etc as needed

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years producing news or politics programming, including at least 3 years in a senior producer or EP role on a recurring show
  • Experience leading a video-first show with a meaningful social footprint
  • Strong editorial judgment on politics and policy, and a track record of booking and producing high-profile guests
  • Strong people management skills, including experience managing producers, building strong team culture, and giving feedback 
  • Comfort running a fast weekly cadence and making confident calls on deadline
  • Understanding of YouTube and short-form platform publishing best practices  
  • Commitment to fairness and to bringing a wide range of political perspectives on air
  • Entrepreneurial, problem-solving mindset
  • Familiarity with Vox's explanatory approach and editorial standards

job.title: Head of Podcast Growth & Operations
job.description:
Vox Media is seeking three entrepreneurial, action-oriented Heads of Podcast Growth & Operations to own the growth, business performance, and operations for three distinct groups of shows and talent in our fast-growing portfolio: business, tech, and leadership; news, politics, and current affairs; lifestyle, culture, and sports. 

The Head of Growth & Operations will be accountable for day-to-day operations, P&L performance, and audience and revenue growth for each show in their portfolio. They will convene a dedicated cross-functional team spanning sales, sales marketing, production, audience marketing, YouTube and social strategy, and business operations. They will also bring sharp insight on the podcast industry, the creator economy, and the competitive landscape to shape how we grow the category and its key franchises. 

This is a hands-on role: the Head of Growth & Operations is close to the week-to-week details of every show, including release calendars, ad load and inventory, guest booking, episode performance, and production workflows, and steps in directly when something slips.

Key responsibilities

  • Set growth strategy and execution roadmaps for the shows in the category, working with the category team to monitor and drive audience and revenue growth
  • Drive cross-functional progress by setting priorities and KPIs, tracking and managing progress, and leading weekly operating meetings
  • Build strong relationships with host talent, agents, and business counterparts; serve as the show’s first point of contact on all aspects of the business; set and lead regular touchpoints with external partners and leadership
  • Own the category P&L, budgeting and forecasting, and regular business reviews for the category and its key franchises

Qualifications 

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving outcomes across many internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience owning a P&L or business line in media, entertainment, podcasting, or the creator economy, with fluency in KPI tracking and creator and digital media business models
  • A track record of growing audience and revenue across platforms (audio, YouTube, social, and live)
  • Experience managing high-profile talent relationships and complex partnerships, with the empathy and directness to deliver hard news well

Leadership qualities

  • A high-metabolism, action-oriented leader, who will drive progress week-to-week 
  • An ownership mentality, excited to "roll up your sleeves" and get things done
  • A confident, poised, clear communicator with senior audiences
  • A collaborative teammate who leads through influence
  • An ambitious and entrepreneurial mindset
  • A detail-obsessed operator who is as comfortable fixing a missed ad read or a broken release workflow as presenting a business review to leadership.
  • Leads from the front: no task is too small, and you hold the team to a high bar on execution quality.

job.title: Producer, Vox Video
job.description:
WHO WE ARE

Vox candidly shepherds audiences through politics and policy, business and pop culture, food, science, and everything else that matters.

Vox is part of Vox Media, the leading modern media company. We guide our audience from discovery to obsession. We inspire essential conversations about what’s now, what’s next, and what’s possible.

As a community of journalists and storytellers, business professionals, creators and technologists, we believe it is a moral and business imperative to amplify voices: to cultivate diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our organization and media. This applies to our candidates, our teams, our storytelling, our creative work, and our platforms, products, and partnerships.

THE ROLE

Vox is looking for an experienced producer and on-camera host to join our award-winning video team. You will be part of a team that creates thoughtful, original midform videos, preserving the explanatory DNA that is essential to Vox, while also developing new video formats and series. 

Top candidates will have a professional background in video journalism with exceptional reporting, scripting, and editing skills. The producer will be expected to pitch, develop and host original video explainers on deadline and produce best-in-class video storytelling that Vox has become known for. The ideal candidate will have an established track record of timely, relevant video journalism, as well as a portfolio of on-camera work. 

This person will also be a creative thinker who wants to experiment with new storytelling formats. We want someone who’s not afraid to try new things and learn from them. There are many ways to create an explainer, and the right candidate will bring innovation and fresh ideas to the position. 

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life. This role is a part of the Vox Media Union, represented by the Writers Guild of America, East.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Pitch, research, report, script, and host original video stories. 
  • Produce timely, relevant midform videos aligned with the news cycle.
  • Shoot and edit videos in-studio and in the field. 
  • Host videos on camera, bringing a natural presence and a distinct voice to the work.
  • Manage every aspect of video production from start to finish, delivering high-quality results efficiently and on deadline. 
  • Manage multiple projects at various stages of production in a fast-paced setting and maintain a pipeline of work; this role will require strong organizational and time-management skills. 
  • Collaborate closely with journalists across the Vox newsroom to turn our journalism into smart, timely videos.
  • Pitch, develop and test new storytelling techniques, formats, and series.
  • Adhere to all journalistic and legal standards at all times.
  • Complete additional duties as assigned.

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for a creative, enthusiastic producer with a passion for Vox’s explanatory mission. You’ll have:

  • 3-5 years of experience in video journalism. 
  • A portfolio of on-camera journalism that brings clarity to the subject and demonstrates an ability to connect with audiences.
  • A passion for Vox’s mission of helping audiences understand what really matters.
  • An established record of deep research, reporting, scripting and high-quality field production.
  • Expert-level understanding of Adobe Suite, with a high-level of expertise in Premiere and knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Familiarity with YouTube video production and publishing, as well as, vertical video editing tools such as Capcut, Descript.
  • Proficiency with studio lighting setups and field shoots
  • Strong communication, organizational and time-management skills, as well as, attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team player who will enjoy working across the organization.

To apply, please submit a cover letter outlining your skills and experience. Include links to three videos that demonstrate your ability to pitch, develop, script, and edit original video stories. At least one video example should prominently feature your on-camera work.

job.title: Recruiting Lead
job.description:
THE ROLE

Vox Media is looking for a Recruiting Lead to own full-cycle hiring for editorial (New York Magazine & Vox), podcast (Vox Media Podcast Network), revenue, and operations roles across the company. 

This is a role for someone who has run full-cycle recruiting before, is comfortable being a trusted advisor to hiring managers (including senior ones), and genuinely enjoys the craft of matching talented people to the right opportunity, especially in a media environment where roles and needs can shift quickly.

Candidates should be fans of New York Magazine, Vox, and our podcast network.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This job is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting — intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer, and close — for a portfolio of roles spanning editorial, podcast/audio, revenue, and operations functions.
  • Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to scope open roles, build hiring plans, and act as a strategic advisor throughout the search.
  • Build and maintain proactive, representative talent pipelines through sourcing, referrals, and passive-candidate outreach, rather than relying solely on inbound applications.
  • Deliver a high-touch candidate experience that reflects well on Vox Media — timely communication, clear expectations, and thoughtful follow-through.
  • Structure and run consistent, bias-aware interview processes, including writing job scorecards and coaching interviewers on effective, legally sound interviewing.
  • Manage multiple concurrent searches with competing timelines, keeping hiring managers and candidates aligned without dropping the details.
  • Own offer strategy and negotiation in partnership with People leadership, balancing candidate expectations with internal equity and approved compensation bands.
  • Track and report on pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other recruiting metrics, and use that data to flag risks and recommend adjustments.
  • Stay current on the media, journalism, and podcasting talent landscape, and bring market insight back to hiring teams.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • A passion for the art of talent acquisition — aka you love what you do.
  • You're a genuine fan of our brands and shows — and you actually consume them.
  • 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience (strong preference for in-house) — you have a strong track record for closing candidates.
    • Specifically, experience recruiting editorial, creative, and audio/podcast talent.
  • You strive for a positive candidate experience — each open role builds on your ability to grow the talent network.
  • Strong sourcing skills — you don't wait for the perfect candidate to apply; you go find them.
  • Stakeholder management is second nature for you — you feel confident advising and pushing back constructively on hiring managers, including senior leaders.
  • You know that diverse slates alone don't move the needle — you build hiring processes that are equitable by design, from first outreach to final offer.
  • Excellent organizational skills — you can run a busy, varied req load without letting candidates or hiring managers fall through the cracks.
  • Systems expertise — you feel comfortable managing an ATS and partnering with the Head of People to build recruiting process.
  • Clear, warm, and timely communication — you represent Vox Media to every candidate you talk to, whether they're hired or not.

job.title: Senior Product Designer
job.description:
About the Role

This role is on the New York Magazine Product team, which is responsible for the experience of  its digital products. The Senior Product Designer works closely with other members of the product design team and product managers, and collaborates  with Consumer Revenue, Editorial and other teams as necessary..

 

The Product team creates, maintains, evaluates and evolves  the platforms that connect New York Magazine’s journalism with our audiences. We’re adept, curious problem-solvers who transform creative ideas into successful products. Great design and user experience are essential to our ability to connect with our readers. The Product Design team plays an important role, ensuring that our products are engaging, useful, and beautiful.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Create  and shape  user-centric, cross-platform digital experiences & interfaces that our audiences love, and which support our subscription business. .
  • Design and execute projects across the entire product lifecycle, from concepts to multi-platform product launches.
  • Present solutions to stakeholders, frame design decisions, articulate tradeoffs, and advocate for the reader and subscriber, while concurrently driving core business objectives.
  • Solve complex design problems, while synthesizing multiple inputs along the way. 
  • Evaluate, iterate & optimize existing product performance.
  • Contribute to and maintain scalable pattern libraries & design systems that uphold a family of brand identities across platforms and touchpoints.
  • Collaborate cross functionally with engineering, product, and data, as well as consumer revenue and editorial stakeholders on product strategy and execution.
  • Participate in design rituals, give and receive constructive feedback, and help elevate the broader design team's culture and process.
  • You will report to the VP of Product Design, NYmag.com.

Basic Qualifications:

  • A design degree: Product Design, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
  • 5+ years professional experience with a portfolio showcasing end-to-end responsive web and app experiences.
  • 5+ years creating complex typography systems, visual hierarchies, and scalable design systems.
  • 3+ years of experience designing for digital media, editorial, subscription, or commerce platforms.
  • Success translating multiple brand identities across several digital platforms and touchpoints.
  • Enthusiasm toward journalism, New York Magazine’s editorial mission, and its design legacy
  • Meticulous attention to detail, and enthusiasm for design iteration. 
  • Ability to work autonomously, own projects end-to-end, and collaborate effectively within a team.
  • Solid understanding of modern digital technologies, information architecture, and accessibility standards.
  • 3-5 years experience working in Figma, including prototyping, component libraries & design systems
  • 1-2 years experience vibecoding to ship small features, and to build working prototype

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to, (or willingness to learn to) integrate AI tools into design+dev process 
  • Experience with editorial production workflows and digital news publishing environments.
  • Experience using user research and analytics to validate design decisions and measure post-launch impact.
  • Experience designing high-converting subscription funnels and/or promotional messaging systems.

job.title: Senior Video Producer, Pivot
job.description:
Pivot is hiring a Senior Video Producer who will treat our YouTube channel and social video accounts as products in their own right. The successful candidate will use their creativity to produce appealing content and craft strategies that grow each channel.  This is a hands-on role for someone who's obsessed with how YouTube and short-form platforms actually work — not just a content calendar manager, but someone who analyzes the metrics, tests thumbnails and titles, and knows what makes a clip travel. Speed matters as much as strategy here: we record twice weekly, and the producer needs to turn around publish-ready clips fast — same-day or next-day — to capitalize on news moments while they're relevant. You'll also direct a small remote freelance editing team on longer-turnaround pieces. This role blends strategy, fast hands-on editing, and people management.

What You'll Do

  • Turn around quick, publishable social clips fast — same-day or next-day — with clean cuts, captions, pacing, and sound/music design that fit each platform's native style, prioritizing speed without sacrificing quality; this is a daily part of the role. 
  • Write clear, shot-by-shot scripts and edit briefs for social video clips.  
  • Edit short-form social video: clean cuts, captions, pacing, and sound/music design that fit each platform's native style, with fast turnaround as the default expectation. 
  • Optimize clipping workflow with ongoing testing and assessment of AI clipping tools.
  • When necessary, assign and oversee freelance social video editors. (Freelancers are typically reserved for higher-volume days or less time-sensitive content.)
  • Review and QC freelancer cuts for pacing, accuracy, and brand fit, and give direct feedback to keep quality consistent.
  • Partner closely with our podcast production team to guide clip selection and format decisions based on what's performing well.
  • Own YouTube channel strategy end-to-end: titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, and a dedicated YouTube Shorts pipeline. Run a continuous testing process on titles and thumbnails to improve click-through and retention.
  • Set and manage the posting calendar and platform-specific strategy across Instagram, TikTok, and Threads.
  • Deliver monthly analytics reporting (subscriber growth, average view duration, CTR, follower growth by platform) and use it to inform what gets prioritized editorially on social channels.
  • Stay ahead of platform changes and emerging formats, and bring new ideas to the team proactively.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years running YouTube and/or social channels for a media brand, podcast, or creator, with a track record of measurable audience growth.
  • Fast, efficient video editing skills and a demonstrated ability to hit tight, same-day/next-day turnarounds without cutting corners on quality — this is one of the most important skills for the role.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar, with a portfolio of short-form clips you've cut yourself (captions, pacing, sound design, platform-native formatting).
  • Experience writing or directing edit scripts/briefs for other editors, and comfort managing remote or freelance contributors — assigning work, giving feedback, and holding a quality bar.
  • Deep fluency in YouTube Studio analytics and YouTube Shorts; comfort with tools like TubeBuddy or VidIQ is a plus.
  • Strong short-form platform instincts — you can look at a piece of content and tell us whether it will work on TikTok vs. Instagram vs. YouTube Shorts, and why.
  • Experience with news, politics, business, or tech content is a strong plus given Pivot's subject matter.
  • Comfortable working with raw or long-form video/audio content and collaborating with editors on cuts.
  • A strategic, analytical mindset paired with genuine creative instinct and hands-on craft — this role is equal parts data, taste, and execution.

 

PAY TRANSPARENCY
