job.title: Video Producer, America Actually
job.description:
We're hiring a Video Producer to help with production of America, Actually, Vox’s politics podcast hosted by Astead Herndon. This role will wear many hats, and assist with pre-production, video editing, and social video. You'll report to the show's Executive Producer and work daily with the show's producers, Vox's audience team, and our studio and production operations staff.

This role is based in New York City and will require attendance in our New York office. May require some weekend work for fast-breaking stories and field reporting. 

What You'll Do

Pre-production and booking

  • In collaboration with the show’s host and leaders, help book interview guests, manage studio logistics and appearance releases
  • Pitch ideas and topics for episodes 
  • Conduct timely editorial research for each episode, work on first draft of host questions, and coordinate with fact check team ahead of interview shoots 

 

Video production 

  • Manage in-person studio and remote recordings.  Work closely with studio engineers to ensure shots are properly set up and framed, appropriate audio levels are set, and multi-camera recordings are saved and accessible for the team to access.
  • Serve as the backup video editor for episodes when the primary video editor is off
  • Flexibility to travel for field shoots, and provide backup support in collecting audio or managing releases, standing in for second camera operator 
  • Help with publishing tasks for each episode, including writing descriptions, headlines, and working with our art director on thumbnails.

 

Social video editing 

  • In collaboration with show host and leaders, identify, produce and edit 3-5 vertical social clips a week. These can be a combination of episode excerpts and original social videos with the host.  
  • Build captions, on-screen text, and graphics in the show's visual style, and route text through copy edit
  • Cut member-exclusive bonus segments and YouTube assets (Shorts, thumbnail frames, chapter markers) as needed

  • Adhere to all journalistic and legal standards at all times.
  • Complete additional duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in video production, preferably on a news or politics podcast 
  • Expert-level understanding of Adobe Suite, with a high-level of expertise in Premiere and knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator. 
  • Strong experience (with accompanying work samples) producing and editing vertical videos for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts
  • Familiarity with YouTube video production and publishing, as well as vertical video editing tools such as Capcut, Descript.

  • Strong communication, organization, and time-management skills, and attention to detail

job.title: Analyst, Data Analytics
job.description:
At Warner Chappell Music (WCM) - the global music publishing arm of Warner Music Group (WMG) - we shape the culture of songwriting and champion songs that resonate for generations by creating transformational opportunities for songwriters everywhere. Our people and culture are at the epicenter of our company, and we are looking for team members who share our service-oriented mindset and have a passion for looking after our songwriters.

Job Title: Analyst, Data Analytics

Location: Los Angeles


A little bit about our team:  

The Warner Chappell Global Strategy & Growth team is a team focused on delivering and implementing business objectives.  Working closely with our global leaders, we are responsible for driving and embedding our global business strategy. 


The Opportunity:

We're hiring an early-career Analyst (A&R focused) who lives at the intersection of music culture and data. We're open to two different backgrounds for this role: someone who has worked as an A&R coordinator and wants to build real skills in data analytics, SQL, and Python, or someone with analyst experience and SQL or Python skills who has a genuine interest in, or some exposure to, A&R and scouting. Either way, you'll help turn charts, streams, and catalog signals into insight that A&R teams can act on. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on continuous learning, whether that learning is on the technical side or the music industry side.


Your role:

You will translate key A&R questions—such as which artists are breaking, who is the next to break, who is behind a particular song, and which deals warrant attention—into actionable datasets, dashboards, and intuitive tools that empower A&R teams to make informed decisions. With the support of the broader Data Analytics & Automation (DA&A) team, you will also play a critical role in designing and building custom code-based tools and AI agents tailored to the specific needs of our A&R Research Team. You'll work closely with the entire DA&A team, who own the underlying pipelines and platform, while you focus on understanding what A&R actually needs and making sure it's delivered in a form they can use and trust.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Support Publishing Intelligence in Snowflake: Help build and maintain datasets that combine streaming performance, chart movement, and catalog context so A&R can spot momentum and publishing opportunities with confidence.
  • Help Deliver Recurring Insight Products: Contribute to regular briefings and reporting so scouting teams get timely, consistent narratives instead of one-off analyses.
  • Build Self-Service Research Tools: Help develop and improve internal tools that let A&R pull curated artist, writer, and release information without waiting on ad hoc requests.
  • Learn to Unify Internal and Market Data: Work with warehouse data alongside external chart, streaming, and market sources, and learn how we keep identity, such as writers, ISRCs, and credits, consistent at scale.
  • Apply AI Responsibly: Use LLMs and governed data tools to help accelerate research and answer questions, with outputs your A&R stakeholders can verify and act on.
  • Ship with Engineering Discipline: Work from prioritized tickets through documentation and simple code review, so your work is traceable and easy for others to pick up.
  • Partner with A&R Stakeholders: Translate scouting and signing questions into measurable definitions, and build relationships with A&R teams across different markets.
  • Learn and Grow: Actively participate in training and development, whether that means deepening your technical skills in SQL and Python or your music industry and A&R knowledge.

About you:

  • An A&R Background with a Data Interest, or a Data Background with an A&R Interest: You have either worked as an A&R coordinator or in a similar scouting-adjacent role and want to build real SQL and Python skills, or you have worked as an analyst and have genuine interest in, or some exposure to, A&R and the music industry.
  • Market and Repertoire Fluency: A genuine interest in charts, breaking artists, and publishing, including who controls the song versus the master, or a fast learner willing to pick this up from A&R partners.
  • Growing SQL Skills: You are comfortable with SQL already, or very motivated to become comfortable quickly, and understand, or want to understand, how to pull, clean, and structure data from relational databases.
  • Developing Scripting Skills (Python): Some hands-on Python experience, or strong motivation to build it, for data manipulation and light automation.
  • Collaboration with A&R Stakeholders: Ability to translate vague scouting asks into measurable definitions, such as market, genre, major versus indie, home territory, and time window, or a willingness to learn this quickly.
  • Product-Minded and Pragmatic: You have a “get it done” mentality and a knack for finding the most direct path to a useful answer.
  • Highly Autonomous and Collaborative: You take ownership of your own work, but thrive in a tight-knit team where you share ideas and ask for help.
  • Detail-oriented: Ability to pay close attention to detail and keep your work accurate.
  • Strong analytical aptitude: Ability to break down a problem and contribute to a solution.
  • Good communication skills: Ability to clearly articulate ideas and contribute to team discussions.
  • Team player: Ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (or equivalent practical experience), or equivalent experience working in an A&R, scouting, or roster-facing role.
  • Demonstrable SQL and/or Python experience through work experience, coursework, internships, or personal projects is expected from an analyst-background candidate, and a strong plus, though not required at the time of applying, for an A&R-background candidate.
  • Prior A&R, scouting, or artist/roster management experience is expected from an A&R-background candidate, and a plus, though not required, for an analyst-background candidate.
  • Exposure to BI tools or dbt is a plus.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

 

Job Title: Analyst, Income Tracking


A little bit about our team:

The Income Tracking Analyst role falls within the overall structure of the Administration Team and has a direct impact on our songwriters through tracking and recovering revenue from all streams of income. The role will liaise with all areas of our business and work closely with our Finance, Royalty, Copyright and Automation teams. You will have the opportunity to work with international affiliates, licensees and collection societies.


This department is vital to the service Warner Chappell provides to its clients: the songwriters.


Your role:

In this role, you will be responsible for the forensic analysis of income received against income expectations for catalog and new deal income across all major revenue streams and instigate back-claims, adjustments and supplemental payments where required.  You will enjoy the opportunity to provide input into the creation of tools that support Income Tracking as well as the opportunity to collaborate with internal departments to create and improve processes that adapt to the constantly evolving nature of music licensing. If you love music and have a mind for business this could be the position for you! 


Here you’ll get to:

  • Work as an integrated member of a future-facing administration team.
  • Evolve workflows to take our income tracking to the next level.
  • Identify and make claims for shortfalls in income.
  • Provide market share insights to key stakeholders and executives
  • Monitor accurate deal level revenue across all income streams 
  • Deliver monthly updates of deal performance for priority deals
  • Analyze and confirm payment posting of prior publisher income for applicable deals
  • Ensure affiliate income queries relating to domestic income are resolved
  • Support the Admin team on projects including ad hoc queries and income analysis
  • You will work closely with the US Royalty and Copyright teams to both resolve and  proactively prevent against problems arising with the collection of income

About you:

  • You have skills to analyze, extract & manipulate data from high volume data files
  • You have advanced Excel capabilities including Power Pivot & advanced formulae
  • You have a solid understanding of the flow of publishing income and copyright registration
  • You are passionate about music and enjoy working with spreadsheets
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • The ability to manage multiple projects at once and hit time-sensitive deadlines
  • The ability to join dots, think laterally and understand both downstream and upstream impact of events

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience working with PRO’s as well as HFA, MLC, and/or other collection societies
  • Experience with Alteryx, Snowflake, and/or Tableau
  • Ability to design high-quality decks and visual materials using presentation platforms, such as Canva or Google Slides.
  • A proactive approach to integrating Generative AI (e.g., Gemini) into everyday work to support and streamline daily tasks and overall productivity.

job.title: Brand Manager
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team: 

WMX is Warner Music Group’s merchandise and e-commerce services division, focused on helping artists connect with fans through merchandise, physical music, touring, vip ticketing, retail, licensing and direct-to-consumer experiences.

We work at the intersection of creativity and commerce, partnering with artists, managers, and label teams to build thoughtful, high-quality products and experiences that fans care about, and marketing them to drive revenue and add value to our clients business. From artist stores and limited-edition vinyl to tour merchandise and global retail programs, we treat merch and physical products as meaningful extensions of an artist’s creative vision.

WMX combines the global scale of Warner Music Group with an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach. We value collaboration, ownership, and curiosity, and we’re building a forward-thinking team that’s excited to evolve how artists reach and engage their audiences.


 

Your role:

As a Brand Manager, you are responsible for managing artist accounts and developing product strategy with creative oversight across a lineup of artists. You serve as the central lead for each artist, advocating for their vision and business throughout online sales, concert merchandise, premium ticketing, retail, and licensing. You are also responsible for driving projects through internal teams including building, manufacturing, promotional efforts, advertising, data acquisition, ecommerce operations, and finance. You are accountable for maintaining budgets and revenue targets for your roster, while partnering closely with marketing and advertising teams to optimize commercial performance.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Act as the primary point of contact and strategic lead for a roster of artists and their teams

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with artists, management, and label partners

  • Develop and implement artist strategies across ecommerce, touring merchandise, VIP, storefronts, and brand partnerships

  • Drive artist approvals across product, creative, touring, sales, and rights management initiatives

  • Coordinate cross-functionally with creative, production, marketing, ecommerce, and finance teams

  • Own artist calendars, key achievements, and performance tracking

  • Manage budgets, revenue targets, and overall P&L performance for assigned accounts

  • Oversee product development and creative direction in partnership with artists and internal teams

About you: 

  • 2-3 years of experience in an operational or similar role

  • Experience working with or alongside artist management companies and or labels

  • Deep hands-on experience with the systems and day to day operations of a merchandise and/or D2C company

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across creative, social, e-commerce, and operations teams

  • Highly analytical with a creative, forward-thinking approach

  • Great communication skills

  • Has managed a P&L

  • Thrive in a very time-sensitive, deadline-meeting capacity 

  • Ability to adapt smoothly to shifting priorities  

  • Responsible with sensitive/confidential info 

  • Available to work outside of standard work hours for time-sensitive business needs

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Creative abilities or the ability to use Photoshop

  • Experience with social media management

  • An understanding of production methods (namely screen printing and embroidery)

  • A love for artists on Warner Music Group

  • You have a passion for music and entertainment 


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $75,000 to $89,380 Annually Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as work experience and business needs. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

You must be legally authorized to work in the United States as of your first day of employment with WMG. Valid proof of work authorization will be required upon hire in accordance with federal law.


Warner Music Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Coordinator, Digital Production


A little bit about our team:

Our team sets up, schedules, and gathers all the pieces for new digital releases to be delivered to digital service providers like Spotify, Apple, etc., and also new physical releases (Vinyl, CDs, Cassettes), to be manufactured. We ensure that all digital and physical products appear in the marketplace as intended by the label and artist.


Your role:

You will play an integral role in supporting Warner Records, Warner Records Nashville and 10K Projects. This position will handle day-to-day support on products with various digital service providers as well as operations processes. The ideal candidate will be able to work and communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders. Flexibility and the ability to prioritize various tasks in an ever-changing environment will also be key.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Run the production schedules, ensuring their accuracy and sending out to large distribution lists; you’ll also build and send the Daily Schedule Changes memo, with late-breaking changes not yet published in the schedule.
  • Assist with setting up and scheduling products to digital service providers, often making numerous changes to setup both before and after product delivery.
  • Be responsible for coordinating new album and single releases on a weekly basis for releases assigned to you. This includes verifying that audio/video, art, metadata, and scheduling, and pricing are in place and compliant with current industry standards.
  • See your projects through by completing digital bill of materials (dBOM) approval for delivery to digital service providers. 
  • Conduct weekly checks to ensure products assigned to you have successfully completed delivery to accounts and reconcile the release details back to the release intention.
  • Handle takedowns and price changes as requested by the labels.
  • Coordinate the delivery and tracking of all digital releases for your assigned projects.
  • Enter in-network video claims for video products live at YouTube.
  • Utilize automated robot to create still image audio products for delivery to YouTube.
  • Provide coverage for absent team members.

About you:

  • Creative self-starter with exceptional follow-up skills.
  • General understanding of current digital music distribution partners and industry best practices. 
  • Must be able to accept changes readily, both in job responsibilities, as well as in the work environment, and can be flexible in adapting to re-prioritized tasks.
  • Minimum one year experience in the music industry.  
  • Data analysis/research skills.
  • You have knowledge of digital retailer metadata requirements and broad knowledge of the audio production process.
  • You have great people skills, able to work with varied personalities at many levels of the company.
  • You’re extremely flexible, are extremely detail-oriented, like constant change, and are comfortable juggling multiple responsibilities and last-minute requests. 
  • You’re a problem solver with a keen deadline awareness.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • You have excellent computer skills, including working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
  • You possess a genuine interest in music and the music business.
  • You have excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • You’re a team player, who can tolerate ambiguity.

We’d love it if you also had:

• Mastery of Excel, including formulas for date calculation and calendaring.

• Experience with music industry production schedules.

• Experience using and designing workflows in AirTable.



As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $25.00 to $29.00 Hourly Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Coordinator, Sales & Global Physical Product


A little bit about our team:

The Global Catalog division of Warner Music Group specializes in award-winning reissues, deluxe editions, box sets, vinyl releases, and archival projects. The Global Catalog team partners with artists, estates, and internal labels to bring culturally significant recordings to market in premium physical and digital formats.


Your role:

As the Coordinator, Sales & Global Physical Product, you will provide administrative and operational support to the Head of Sales and the US Commercial team while coordinating physical product releases globally. You will be responsible for creating bi-weekly catalog notes, sales reports, global product notes, and project sites, as well as managing release assets, meeting preparations, expense reports, and event logistics.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Own the sales and account meeting lifecycle by preparing agendas and reports, partnering with the Senior Sales Manager on pitch decks, and tracking notes and action items across key departments and during weekly Physical Commerce meetings.
  • Coordinate end-to-end logistics for conferences, account meetings, and store release activations, including travel and dining reservations, physical display assets, and shipments of promotional merchandise.
  • Manage digital release readiness by gathering and organizing launch assets (cover art, product shots, copy, and promo materials), uploading them to the CMS, and keeping product and campaign project sites current.
  • Draft and distribute global product notes, bi-weekly catalog updates, and targeted UK sales notes to align international teams, while maintaining the global note glossary.
  • Consolidate global physical sales data from internal systems and external reports to build territory-by-territory performance analyses and summaries for strategic planning.
  • Provide executive and administrative support to the Head of Sales and the Custom Products Director, managing correspondence, expense reports, and office operations, and serving as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.

About you:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in an executive assistant or coordinator role, preferably within the music or entertainment industry.
  • Ideally, proven experience with a focus on sales and physical product releases.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in the suite of Google applications (e.g., Sheets, Docs, Slides, etc.).
  • Exceptional organizational, project management, and time management abilities, with a strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience with sales reporting software, databases, or project management tools is a plus.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and detail-oriented when handling complex logistics and asset distribution.
  • Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for music and understanding of the music industry landscape and physical product lifecycle.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • A Bachelor's degree.
  • Proven experience with a focus on sales, D2C operations, or physical product releases.
  • Experience with sales reporting software, databases, or project management tools.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Hourly Rate: $20.00 to $24.00

You must be legally authorized to work in the United States as of your first day of employment with WMG. Valid proof of work authorization will be required upon hire in accordance with federal law.


Warner Music Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A little bit about our team:

The legal department is located at the corporate headquarters of Warner Music Group (“WMG”). The legal department supports WMG and its operating companies in all corporate legal matters, including information technology (IT), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), securities, compliance, employment, records management, litigation, digital and intellectual property.


Your role:

This position is a unique opportunity to be a generalist in the corporate legal department of a global entertainment company and participate in a range of corporate activities and practice areas, with a focus on corporate, IT and M&A matters. The Counsel will primarily support the corporate, IT and M&A areas and work on various corporate matters/contracts. 


Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the legal work on domestic and cross-border acquisitions, dispositions, mergers, and carve-outs, including share and asset deals, catalog and rights acquisitions, and acqui-hires.
  • Structure, negotiate, and document joint ventures, strategic partnerships, and commercial alliances, including JV agreements, shareholders' agreements, operating agreements, and related governance, exit, and deadlock provisions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to corporate development and business leaders on deal strategy, structuring, valuation-related terms, and negotiation positions.
  • Draft, review and negotiate various corporate agreements, including non-disclosure agreements, license agreements, facilities agreements, real estate leases and various vendor and services agreements.
  • Assist on corporate secretarial matters managing numerous domestic and global entities of the Company.
  • Work closely with members of the legal group and teams from across the company to support numerous projects, including researching and analyzing various legal issues.

  • 4-7 years of experience with a primary focus on corporate / M&A and at least several years in a major law firm.

  • Developed drafting skills (including, the ability to identify and cultivate creative solutions in areas with evolving legal guidance).

job.description:

At Warner Music Group, our Strategic Finance team serves as the analytical engine that drives both our high-level business strategy and day-to-day operations. By extracting actionable intelligence from core financial data, the team partners seamlessly across Warner Music’s Central Functions, Recorded Music, and Music Publishing to uncover deep business insights. Ultimately, Strategic Finance sits at the forefront of the company, mapping the financial dynamics and emerging trends that are actively shaping the future of the global music industry.

Your role:

As the Data Scientist for Strategic Finance, you will act as the crucial link between our financial strategists and the Technology department. A key part of your mission is collaborating closely with the technology engineers and data scientists who are building our state-of-the-art predictive forecasting platform, ensuring the tool perfectly aligns with business needs. Alongside this, you will deploy modern AI solutions to automate complex financial workflows and transform ambiguous, disparate data into standardized, cohesive datasets—moving the department away from fragile legacy spreadsheets and toward a highly automated, self-service data ecosystem.

Here you’ll get to:

• Partner closely with Technology and Affiliate Finance teams to gather requirements, design, and deploy a robust financial forecasting and planning tool that supports WMG's long-term modeling.
• Spearhead AI and automation initiatives to eliminate manual bottlenecks and streamline workflows across Strategic Finance.
• Enforce data integrity within Strategic Finance by collaborating with data management teams to architect datasets and automate rigorous quality controls.
• Work directly with senior finance collaborators to clarify complex problems and build the right analytical or technology-based approaches using large, dynamic datasets.
• Act as the trusted liaison between Strategic Finance, Technology, and data platform collaborators to ensure all technical solutions perfectly align with business priorities.

About you:

• Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of hands-on, practical experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks), Python-based automation, internal app frameworks (Streamlit), BI/reporting tools, workflow automation platforms (Airtable), and AI-assisted development tools.
• Experience helping teams adopt new tools, new processes, and more modern ways of working while staying grounded in business realities.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and implement data science projects with minimal supervision.
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and model development.
• Experience with machine learning frameworks and statistical tools.
• Strong understanding of SQL and working with large datasets.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical collaborators.
• Strong problem-solving abilities, with a bias towards action and a proactive approach to finding opportunities and challenges.

We’d love it if you also had:

• Familiarity with the streaming music landscape or other digital media
• Experience in finance transformation and EPM implementation
• Knowledge of accounting concepts and revenue recognition principles

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. Job Title: Director, Marketing


A little bit about our team:

Warner Records is looking for a visionary, data-driven Senior Director of Marketing. This is a high-impact role designed to bring cutting edge marketing ideas to some of the most iconic artists at Warner Records. You will be responsible for architecting marketing and strategy for album and on-roster catalog releases for Warner Records artists. 


Your role:

You will be the lead marketing & product manager for a roster of artists that includes all marketing strategy, physical and digital product production and be the architect for the overall artist’s vision. You will get to navigate all elements of marketing for the artist and be responsible for their success.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Develop marketing strategy across all phases of artist + campaign development that position our artists as global stars, differentiate them in the marketplace, ensure a unified story / creative across all consumer touch points and leads to commercial success
  • Oversee the development and execution of innovative marketing campaigns for iconic rock, pop and country music artists at Warner Records
  • Manage marketing budgets across your roster of artists
  • Leverage data to identify "super-fan" segments and tailor marketing efforts toward high-value audiences
  • Create an overall Marketing vision for the artist to be shared across the company, starting from signing and updating with each launch
  • Work with production and A&R oversee all product creation and development
  • Lead Campaign Development and collaborate with all departments to develop innovative, fully integrated marketing campaigns that drive cultural relevance, audience growth, and commercial success
  • Drive revenue by working with A&R / Commerce to develop music streaming and physical product ideas that generate incremental revenue and drive fandom
  • Be digital minded and make sure digital marketing is part of every campaign

About you:

  • 5+ years of music marketing experience at a Record Label or management company
  • You have successfully led campaigns that resulted in measurable growth (e.g., Chart positions, RIAA certifications, or significant streaming milestones)
  • Expert-level understanding of the DSP landscape (Spotify, Apple Music, etc.) and social ecosystems (TikTok, Instagram, Discord)
  • Exceptional presentation skills; you can sell a vision to an artist and a boardroom alike
  • Outside of the box marketing thinking, not doing the tried and true but finding new ways to connect to fans, drive streams and sales of Warner Records music
  • Experience in international campaign coordination
  • Excellent executive presence with the ability to pitch strategy directly to A-list talent and their managers

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Great problem solving skills
  • A passion for music and the ability to market it
  • Outside the box thinking and new ways to bring fans into the inner circle to drive engagement
  • Experience with packaging, production and product development
  • Photoshop/Illustrator experience
  • Experience and deep knowledge of social and streaming analytics
  • Strong knowledge of catalog marketing for music

Job Title: Executive Assistant, A&R


A little bit about our team:

The A&R department at Warner Records Group is responsible for both finding and developing musical artists to sign as well as producing artists and driving creative content for all forms of media.


Your role:

Job responsibilities include (but are not limited to) handling all administrative aspects of work for the EVP of A&R at Warner Records as well as more detailed project management and independent projects on various levels. Requires a committed, flexible, proactive, organized, and independent person who is willing to engage in typical administrative/clerical duties as well as more complex project work related to all aspects of the record-making process.  


Here you’ll get to:

  • Manage and schedule the executive's numerous day-to-day events such as- setting up conference calls, running point for in-person meetings, and coordinate their calendar, scheduling, and meeting logistics
  • Receive and direct visitors and make the office a welcoming environment
  • Handle the executive's timeliness by ensuring they are timely for each call and meeting, take diligent notes in meetings, and build action item lists where needed 
  • Serve as a reliable contact between internal and external partners, communicate high priorities to the executive in a timely manner 
  • Prepare correspondence (memos, emails) as required; Read and speak to materials and documents, recognize critical data and information, and effectively communicate vital information
  • Process and maintain T&E expenses for the executive via Concur 
  • Coordinate frequent travel for executives and artists both domestic and internationally 
  • Complete ad hoc projects, as needed, for executive 
  • Uphold and conduct work within the standards and procedures of the company’s Code of Conduct and core values 
  • Partner with Facilities and IT to ensure the offices of executives and Company are maintained and conference rooms are in working order 
  • Handle general office duties such as processing packages, mail, and keeping stock of general office supplies 

About you:

If you want an incredible education in how the global music business works. If you love to travel. If you love how music dovetails into different cultures all over the world. IF you want to help develop your artists careers outside of the USA.


This position will be responsible for spearheading strategic international marketing and commerce campaigns for audio and video releases, for a defined roster of artists, across all 50+ Warner Music Group affiliates and licensees.  Will also act as liaison between artists, managers, and Warner Records International affiliates.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.


A Little Bit About Our Team:

The Record to Report (RTR) Accounting Team serves as the central operational backbone for financial integrity, revenue recognition, cash management, and financial reporting across Warner Music Group.

Operating within our Shared Services / Global Business Services framework, the Recorded Music RTR team provides specialized accounting expertise, revenue assurance, and critical month-end closing support across WMG’s renowned domestic and international record labels. We work with the GBS Revenue Team translating complex data into accurate financial reporting under US GAAP.


Your Role:

As the lead Lead Revenue Operations Analyst for Recorded Music, you will serve as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for our recorded music revenue accounting life cycle. This role bridges technical accounting, data analytics, and financial systems design. You will take ownership of the end-to-end accounting for high-volume, multi-source revenue streams, drive compliance with ASC 606, spearhead systems automation, and unlock actionable financial insights through advanced data mining. In addition to technical execution, you will provide training and education to other members of the Recorded Music RTR team.


Here you'll get to:

  • Lead the technical accounting, accrual modeling, and reconciliation for all Recorded Music revenue streams, including Digital Streaming Partners (Spotify, Apple, YouTube, Amazon), Digital Downloads, DMCA statutory royalties, Physical manufacturing and distribution (vinyl, CD, merch), Synchronization (film, TV, gaming, advertising), Master Licensing, and foreign affiliate distributions.
  • Architect and maintain robust ASC 606 recognition schedules, monthly flash revenue accruals, deferred revenue tracking, and automated reversals based on consumption ingestion files vs. actual cash settlements.
  • Query, clean, and analyze Revenue Operational Reporting datasets across disparate DSPs using Analysis for Office and Gemini AI Tools.    Reconcile Multi-System Reporting from Source to Financial Ledger.
  • Bridge consumption metadata (streams, downloads, play counts, tier rates) with transactional general ledger activity to detect anomalies, underreported royalties, missing catalog codes, and system mismatches.
  • Conduct granular month-over-month (MoM) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) variance analyses; present variance drivers to label finance leaders.
  • Serve as the RTR business lead for financial systems optimization across SAP (ECC / S/4HANA), BlackLine, and proprietary music revenue sub-ledgers.
  • Design, test, and implement automated reporting simplify manual journal entries and compress the monthly close cycle.
  • Direct the monthly and quarterly close deliverables for recorded music revenue, reviewing high-volume journal entries, complex accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Review work products prepared by staff accountants and offshore shared service partners (e.g., Shopify D2C sales tie-outs, DSP settlement matching, clearing account reconciliations), providing structured guidance and establishing standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Actively investigate and resolve persistent balances in revenue clearing, suspense, and partner withholding accounts.
  • Maintain and enhance internal control matrices under Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX 404), ensuring proper segregation of duties, automated validation checks, and data lineage documentation.
  • Serve as primary revenue audit liaison for internal and external auditors (e.g., Big 4), providing PBC audit schedules, roll-forwards, sample testing support, and technical accounting memos.
  • Partner proactively with Label Finance VPs/Directors, Commercial Revenue Operations, Business & Legal Affairs, IT/Data Engineering, and Corporate Royalty teams to align accounting treatments with evolving contract structures and deal terms.

About you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related analytical field required.
  • Active CPA license (or international equivalent) strongly preferred.
  • Master’s Degree (MAcc, MBA) or coursework in Financial Data Analytics / Information Systems is a significant plus.
  • 10 to 15+ years of progressive, hands-on accounting experience in Corporate Accounting, Shared Services, or Big 4 Public Accounting.
  • Extensive specialization (7+ years) in high-volume revenue accounting, billing assurance, or royalty accounting within the music, digital entertainment, streaming media, or intellectual property/licensing sectors.
  • Proven track record leading technical ASC 606 revenue recognition implementations or oversight for complex multi-element arrangements.
  • Demonstrable experience directing and reviewing work performed by distributed, hybrid, or offshore delivery centers.
  • Deep experience working with enterprise ERPs (specifically SAP FI/CO, S/4HANA) and automated balance sheet reconciliation tools (such as BlackLine or Cadency).
  • Expert-level Microsoft Excel proficiency (SAP Analysis for Office, Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/macros, advanced nested logic).
  • Experience with eCommerce and digital billing platforms (e.g., Shopify, DSP vendor reporting portals) is highly desirable.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Ability to untangle intricate data anomalies and synthesize findings into clear executive summaries.
  • Proactive drive to evaluate status-quo manual workflows and design scalable, automated alternatives.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to collaborate across label executives, data engineers, and external auditors.
  • Proven capacity to manage high-pressure close deadlines and competing stakeholder requests with composure and precision.

A little bit about our team and the role:


The Manager, Corporate Development will be an integral part of WMG’s Corporate Development team. Working horizontally across the organization, the role will have direct exposure to global leaders around WMG, touching various aspects of our business. The right candidate must be comfortable working with various internal and external partners and businesses. They should quickly analyze and explain key drivers in music, media, and technology.


Here, you’ll get to:


  • Support the origination, evaluation, negotiation, and structuring of acquisitions, minority investments, and joint ventures
  • Generate comprehensive analysis of investment opportunities through market research, financial modeling (including discounted cash flow analysis, merger analysis, etc.), alignment analysis, and strategic integration/activation planning
  • Assist, and lead where necessary, due diligence and post-merger integration on potential acquisition/investment targets
  • Support internal transaction approval process, including preparation and presentation of transaction summaries and recommendations to senior management

  • Develop and maintain external network of dealmakers and industry experts in support of identifying key market trends and sourcing new opportunities

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills (verbal and written)
  • Comprehensive understanding of major media platforms/businesses and emerging technology trends
  • Ability to analyze, structure, and negotiate transactions of varying complexity, from seed-stage investments to M&A
  • Relationships in the digital media / digital music arena as well as with venture capital and banking firms who work in the sector are preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines and work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to find opportunities to integrate AI into the deal lifecycle - from target sourcing to diligence to integration

A little bit about our team:

WMG's Digital Strategy & Business Development team is responsible for leading the global deal negotiations with digital service providers on behalf of Warner Music Group. We strike deals with global distribution platforms and find new business opportunities in hopes of reaching audiences, growing monetization, and creating value for our labels and artists.

Your role:

In this role, you will support the ongoing efforts to strike global deals across the music streaming landscape by using your analytical skills, industry knowledge, and ability to negotiate complex partnerships.  The ideal candidate is passionate about understanding the intersection of music, technological innovation, and consumer behavior.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Work with key digital partners (e.g., Spotify, Apple, YouTube, Amazon, Meta, TikTok, etc.) to support the structure, negotiation, and execution of global agreements, representing the strategic view of WMG.
  • Analyze partner data and create financial models to help inform key decision making.
  • Find new ways to drive WMG revenues and create business opportunities on new and existing platforms (e.g., AI, etc.).
  • Partner with legal on drafting and carrying out contract amendments, renewals, term sheets and longform agreements.
  • Serve as a point of contact and communicate matters about the digital agreements and partnerships at WMG. Share information with WMG’s senior management, other internal divisions, and global affiliates.
  • Monitor emerging technologies, and media & consumer tech ecosystem trends for the purpose of developing new strategic initiatives.
  • Develop long-term strategies focused on WMG’s relationship with DSPs and diversification of WMG’s revenue and capabilities.
  • Learn to lead deal negotiations with long tail partners across various music licensing use cases.

About you:

  • 2+ years of relevant work experience
  • Consistent track record working in an analytical capacity, with large data sets to create complex models around deal, partnership, and industry trend forecasting.
  • Music, media, or entertainment industry content licensing experience is preferred, as is experience with deal-focused analyses.
  • Driven, and inclined to take ownership of all facets of dealmaking, from inception to execution.
  • Proven track record supporting deal and project-based teams. 
  • Strong Excel and Google Workspace suite of tools.
  • Proactive attitude and strong work ethic.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience at a top tier investment bank or management consulting firmBasic understanding of financial principles (e.g., revenue forecasting and recognition, cashflows, artist royalty obligations) to inform various internal collaborators. .
  • Experience crafting, presenting, and completing new central initiatives.
  • Established record in applying innovative approaches and structures to deal making.
  • Excellent analytical ability, written communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Bachelor's degree. Finance, business, economics or accounting are preferred.

Job Title:  Manager, Global Digital Accounts 

Your role:

The Global Commercial Services team maximizes WMG revenue and market share, leading through best practices, platform expertise, and forward-thinking solutions that support our recorded music strategy. As a key member of the WMG YouTube team, you will spearhead revenue maximization by transforming actionable insights into high-impact growth opportunities. You will serve as a cross-functional partner and subject matter expert, leveraging data-driven storytelling to optimize account performance and amplify our global YouTube presence. This role offers a 360-degree view of the YouTube ecosystem, providing a unique opportunity to collaborate on elevating our artists and maximizing commercial success.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Work directly with team leadership to deliver on annual goals and achievements and revenue optimization targets.

  • Drive cross-functional projects dedicated to identifying and accomplishing high-impact, revenue-generating opportunities across assigned accounts.

  • Provide strategic, data-driven insights to global teams and senior leadership to optimize account performance, improve campaign return on investment, and unlock new revenue streams.

  • Design and maintain performance dashboards to visualize and quantify the direct revenue impact of account initiatives and projects.

  • Conduct performance testing and ad-hoc data analysis to refine optimization strategies and accelerate revenue growth.

  • Act as a subject matter expert, educating internal collaborators, labels, and affiliates on YouTube guidelines and platform features that directly contribute to increased monetization.

  • Serve as the team’s lead data resource, using Snowflake and Python to analyze metrics and generate revenue-focused reporting for projects and monthly business reviews.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for resolving network-wide issues, ensuring operational consistency to protect and sustain revenue flow.

  • Manage commercial programs for assigned accounts, coordinating artist campaigns and partner relationships to drive incremental revenue growth and increase brand presence.

  • Manage day-to-day operational relationships with external third-party partners, ensuring alignment on strategies that support continued revenue growth and business needs.

 

About you:

  • Strong understanding of YouTube.

  • 3–5 years experience in data analytics, preferably in music, entertainment, or digital media.

  • Strong prioritization and organizational skills, and ability to work autonomously.

  • Proven success in turning data into actionable business strategies.

  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth, cross-functional environment.

  • Experience with Python and/or SQL.

  • Communication and storytelling skills—able to bridge the gap between data and creative teams.

  • Detail-oriented, with a strong sense of curiosity and problem-solving instincts.

  • Proficiency in Google productivity tools (e.g. Gmail, Sheets, Docs, etc.).

 

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Knowledge of the YouTube CMS.

  • Understanding of online video trends and practices.

job.description:

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

Distribution operations are the specialist team within the WEA Global Operations dept that supports WMG’s distribution business including ADA. In the Distribution Operations department, we work to ensure that releases from independent labels and artists are delivered on time and in accordance with industry standards, DSP guidelines, and the creative strategy of our partners. This is a collaborative role that interfaces with internal business entities as well as other Global Operations teams as well as external label partners and artists. We’re a group of creative problem solvers whose goal is to support independent music and position labels and artists for success. Getting products to market is the backbone of a distribution company!


Your role:

As Manager of Revelator Distribution Operations, you will play a critical role in supporting key clients and internal teams during US business hours. You will build deep expertise in the Revelator platform to oversee end-to-end operational workflows. In this position, you will drive seamless catalog ingestion support, monitor release deliveries, resolve technical DSP issues, optimize metadata and assets, and deliver actionable operational reporting to ensure independent labels and artists are set up for success across global digital service providers.


Here you’ll get to:


  • Catalog ingestion & delivery - provide support to the DSCO Catalog Ingestion team as they lead on catalog creation and delivery into Revelator
  • Delivery monitoring - Monitor delivery feeds and supply chain events daily; identify failed, stalled and rejected deliveries and action them within agreed turnaround time
  • Delivery monitoring - Manage (Investigate and resolve) DSP delivery errors, metadata rejections and asset failures
  • Delivery monitoring - bring up relevant issues to engineering with reproducible detail where a platform fix is required.
  • Delivery monitoring - Raise, track and chase tickets with DSP partners (Apple, Spotify, YouTube, Amazon and others) through to closure.
  • Metadata & asset optimization - Identify and optimize metadata including artist disambiguation / profile mapping, contributor enhancement, artwork / audio replacement, 
  • Operational reporting - Produce recurring operational reporting on delivery volumes, error rates, open partner tickets and ingestion progress.
  • Operational reporting - Respond to internal and client queries on delivery and catalogue status within agreed service levels
  • Key direct operational contact - provide key direct operational support to US time zone business entities

About you:

  • 2–4 years' experience in digital distribution, digital supply chain or content operations within the music, media or entertainment industry.

The Finance Transformation team is a group of professionals across the WMG organization brought together to re-imagine our processes and systems to establish more standardized and efficient ways of working that will drive WMG’s growth and business aspirations. 


Your role:

The OTC Manager holds a global remit and is responsible for defining the future state Order to Cash (OTC) processes and measures within SAP S/4 HANA and Fiori that are aligned with organizational strategies, country-specific knowledge, and operational requirements. This process lead will strive to assemble opportunities, reviewing existing and best-practice workflows, tools, and data. The role moves through design, architecture, implementation, release, and steady state with an ongoing focus on continuous improvement and the integration of OTC finance processes into the overall WMG landscape. Specific accountability from revenue to the sales order and billing documents (plus ebilling where required) for digital, physical, D2C, 3rd party licensing and merchandise revenue streams.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Support the transformation team by leading cross-functional and virtual teams in the review, design, development, and implementation of global processes and procedures, including customer master data, credit management, order management/billing, accounts receivable (AR), collections, cash application, and revenue recognition. 
  • Lead process design meetings with internal Subject Matter Resources (SMRs) and third-party vendors through design, implementation, and release. 
  • Lead technical and operational teams to conduct testing, defect resolution, and ongoing configuration of SAP SD/FI-AR modules and associated sub-systems. 
  • Be responsible for OTC testing across credit limit setting, billing, cash application, dispute management, credit/debit memo processing, customer statement generation, and collaborate with sales, distribution, and licensing platforms. 
  • Work closely with the SAP Master Data Management team to ensure customer master data configuration and governance are consistent with global processes. 
  • Work closely with WMG Tax to solve complex scenarios involving worldwide tax.
  • Act as representative for intercompany billing between service centers and transformation.
  • Leverage OTC and industry process and systems knowledge/experience to implement standardization of global, regional, and/or local processes, challenging the status quo while taking input from SMRs and program partners to understand required localizations. 
  • Lead the design, documentation, and ongoing socialization of end-to-end OTC processes. 
  • Obtain consensus for Finance Transformation from key WMG partners across the globe by credibly communicating deep operating process and systems knowledge and an appreciation of the impact at a local level. 
  • Attend and/or present in update meetings as required for key decision, issue, and risk points. 
  • Work with collaborators to ensure Product / Policy / Process / Procedure / System decisions account for territory variances, commercial needs, and local legal/regulatory requirements. 
  • Partner with IT to identify integration points between commercial/sales operations systems, billing platforms, and core finance systems. 
  • Partner with people and change management resources to develop job aids, communications, and training approaches to embed new ways of working and systems training for the OTC area. 
  • Act as a spokesperson across the WMG organization for the benefits delivered by the Finance Transformation in the OTC space. 
  • Represent the OTC Business Process at individual Fit/Gap sessions in markets to ensure all business requirements are considered (and documented via User Requirements Specification). Ensure that any business needs driving a requirement for customization are strongly challenged and options for process redesign are considered. Where customizations are needed, ensure justification is documented and changes progress via the governance model. 
  • Update relevant OTC documentation based on changes to the global template (including SOPs, User Guides, and training materials). 
  • Participate in the preparation of OTC training materials. 
  • Be responsible for the resolution and review of OTC issues, risks, and business impacts for the owned process. 
  • Proactively and on an ongoing basis identify internal and external OTC guidelines (e.g., automation in cash application, AI-driven credit scoring, streamlined collections) that will enable improvement of the standard end-to-end process. 

About you:

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Business, Finance, Accounting, Business Information Systems, Management Science, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Daily user of SAP with deep knowledge of OTC Processes focusing on OTC processes (Credit, Collections, Cash Application, Billing, AR) or related finance transformation experience. 
  • Strong Order to Cash process and systems knowledge, preferably within a music, media, digital licensing, or entertainment industry context. 
  • Facilitative style, with prior experience leading workshops and engaging collaborators through a series of approaches that require a targeted level of consensus. 
  • Relevant operational OTC experience supervising credit management, order fulfillment/billing workflows, cash management, dispute resolution, AR ledger management, and internal controls. 
  • Technically savvy with a robust organizational change skillset. 
  • Experience with a previous SAP implementation (specifically SAP SD, FI-AR, or FSCM) is crucial. 
  • Exemplary collaborator engagement and management skills internationally and within complex, multi-faceted organizations. 
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to perform complex dispute, credit risk, and receivables analysis. 
  • Ability to develop, articulate, and build support around a long-term OTC vision and implement incremental turning points in support of that vision. 
  • Team player who can participate and collaborate with varied business units (sales, licensing, supply chain, legal, finance) to effectively implement transformation initiatives. 


We’d love it if you also had:

  • Transformational leadership experience. 
  • Media, entertainment, digital distribution, or music industry experience preferred. 
  • Familiarity with SAP FSCM (Credit Management, Dispute Management, Collections Management) and modern automated cash application tools.

A little bit about our team:

Warner Music's Center of Excellence for Shared Services is the home to the financial, legal and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our US Recorded Music and Publishing businesses. The Finance Department is responsible for managing all of the center's accounting and cash management functions.

As a critical component of Finance, the Order to Cash (OTC) team is responsible for measuring and monitoring financial risk related to the extension of credit terms, and for the timely recovery and efficient application of incoming cash (receivables). This role is fully remote.


Your role:

Lead Label Services Order to Cash end to end for merch, licensing, label and related receivables in the Americas: cash application, credit for venues and other third parties, collections for tour settlements, disputes and deductions. You will lead a hybrid team of onshore and offshore resources as the day-to-day owner of priorities, SLAs and quality, and you will represent OTC with WMG label management and label finance teams (for example, Atlantic), tour venues and their merch vendors, and internal audit. You will own the key controls and audit readiness for Label Services. You will identify where processes rely on manual workarounds, quantify their labor and control impact, and work with the Global Process Owners and Finance to redesign them in SAP S/4HANA rather than adding new workarounds. You will work closely with the Director, OTC and report to the Senior Director, OTC.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the Label Services OTC operation: set weekly priorities, SLAs and KPIs for the onshore analysts and the offshore team, and run a regular performance cadence.
  • Direct the offshore team on the recording, coding, depositing, researching and application of checks and transactions for US and Canada D2C and Tour Merch in SAP S/4HANA.
  • Lead calls and working sessions with label, finance, legal and tax partners, and make sure the team arrives prepared with accurate information.
  • Assess team capacity and skills. Coach, develop and hire onshore talent, and recommend the right onshore and offshore mix as volume grows.
  • Onboard mergers and acquisitions, including newly acquired labels, entities and affiliates, into OTC processes.
  • Own collections for the assigned customer portfolio, including large retail customers, third-party distributors and sellers, and tour venues and their merch vendors.   • Oversee Revenue processes including Managed Tour, Tour Supply, and Merch. Follow artist tour schedules and work with Tour Managers to oversee and reconcile cash receipts.

About you:

  • Strong, hands-on SAP S/4HANA experience in Receivables, including invoicing, cash application and deduction or dispute handling.

  • Analytical, detail oriented, highly organized and highly accurate. Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to manipulate data in a heavy-volume spreadsheet environment.
  • Ability to see the big picture, prioritize multiple projects simultaneously, make collection decisions quickly and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Job Title: Sr. Accountant II

A little bit about our team:
The Record to Report Accounting Team is responsible for managing all the center's accounting and cash management functions. As a critical component of the Record to Report Accounting Team, the Accounting Operations Group provides accounting services and support to WMG's US record labels and businesses.


Your role:
The Senior Accountant II is responsible for performing and managing advanced accounting and reporting activities across labels/affiliates and reviewing the work of staff and offshore resources.


Here you'll get to:

  • Review the work of entry-level staff members and provide feedback for corrections and process improvements
  • Perform advanced accounting tasks and analyses to support monthly and quarterly financial reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

  • Perform variance analyses related to system reconciliations and ad hoc requests, providing timely support and explanations to stakeholders.
  • Assist with the global intercompany reconciliation process by monitoring and resolving intercompany mismatches that impact the financial close.
  • Collaborate with offshore team members by reviewing deliverables, providing feedback, and supporting the accurate and timely completion of assigned activities.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities within BlackLine to enhance the close process and improve operational effectiveness.
  • Ensure compliance with SOX requirements, internal controls, accounting policies, and U.S. GAAP.
  • Assist with internal and external audit requests, tax reporting requirements, and the preparation of supporting schedules and documentation.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with business unit finance teams and other stakeholders while supporting cross-functional initiatives and special projects as needed.

About you:


Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance

5-10 years of experience in Shared Service or Corporate Accounting and/or experience with a Big 4 CPA firm

job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Sr. Manager, Brand Management 


A little bit about our team: 

WMX is Warner Music Group’s merchandise and e-commerce services division, focused on helping artists connect with fans through merchandise, physical music, touring, vip ticketing, retail, licensing and direct-to-consumer experiences.


We work at the intersection of creativity and commerce, partnering with artists, managers, and label teams to build thoughtful, high-quality products and experiences that fans care about, and marketing them to drive revenue and add value to our clients business. From artist stores and limited-edition vinyl to tour merchandise and global retail programs, we treat merch and physical products as meaningful extensions of an artist’s creative vision.


WMX combines the global scale of Warner Music Group with an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach. We value collaboration, ownership, and curiosity, and we’re building a forward-thinking team that’s excited to evolve how artists reach and engage their audiences.

Your role:

As a Brand Manager, you are responsible for managing artist accounts and developing product strategy with creative oversight across a roster of artists. You serve as the central lead for each artist, advocating for their vision and business across ecommerce, touring merchandise, VIP ticketing, retail, and licensing. You are also responsible for driving projects through internal teams including creative, production, marketing, advertising, data acquisition, ecommerce operations, and finance.


You are accountable for maintaining budgets and revenue targets for your roster, while partnering closely with marketing and advertising teams to optimize commercial performance. As a leader within the Brand Management team, you are also responsible for ensuring topline revenue and profitability goals are met. In addition, you manage relationships with label partners, ensuring alignment with their priorities and successful execution of shared objectives.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and strategic lead for a roster of artists and their teams
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with artists, management, and label partners
  • Develop and execute artist strategies across ecommerce, touring merchandise, VIP, retail, and licensing
  • Drive artist approvals across product, creative, touring, retail, and licensing initiatives
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with creative, production, marketing, ecommerce, and finance teams
  • Own artist calendars, key milestones, and performance tracking
  • Manage budgets, revenue targets, and overall P&L performance for assigned accounts
  • Oversee product development and creative direction in partnership with artists and internal teams
  • Lead key business reviews and planning meetings with internal and external partners

About you: 

  • 5-7 years of experience in an operational or similar role
  • Experience working with or alongside artist management companies and or labels
  • Deep hands-on experience with the systems and day to day operations of a merchandise and/or D2C company
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across creative, social, e-commerce, and operations teams
  • Highly analytical with a creative, growth-oriented mindset
  • Great communication skills
  • Has managed a P&L 
  • Thrive in a very time-sensitive, deadline-meeting capacity 
  • Ability to adapt smoothly to shifting priorities  
  • Responsible with sensitive/confidential info 
  • Available to work outside of standard work hours for time-sensitive business needs

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Creative abilities or the ability to use Photoshop
  • Experience with social media management
  • An understanding of production methods (namely screen printing and embroidery)
  • A love for artists on Warner Music Group


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $80,000 to $87,500 Annually Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as work experience and business needs. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

You must be legally authorized to work in the United States as of your first day of employment with WMG. Valid proof of work authorization will be required upon hire in accordance with federal law.

job.title: SVP, Global Supply Chain Transformation
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
