  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Your role:

We are seeking a world-class, execution-focused Senior Vice President (SVP) of Global Supply Chain Transformation to lead the comprehensive modernization of our physical operations. In this role, you will redefine the future-state of our physical operations—spanning global manufacturing partnerships, distribution hubs, e-commerce fulfillment, and inventory optimization—while spearheading the end-to-end implementation of a modern, enterprise-wide Supply Chain Management (SCM) system.


While our industry is music, prior music industry experience is not required. We are specifically seeking a sophisticated supply chain leader trained in best-in-class Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), retail, or high-volume manufacturing and shipping environments who can bring world-class operational discipline, predictive data modeling, and rigorous systems architecture to our global physical business.


Here you’ll be responsible for:

  • Operational Transformation: Evaluate, re-engineer, and optimize our global physical supply chain network , physical media, and merchandise) to improve speed-to-market, reduce fulfillment costs, and scale for massive demand spikes around global release cycles.
  • Systems Architecture & Rollout: Serve as the executive sponsor for the selection, design, and phased global implementation of an advanced enterprise SCM / ERP technology platform, moving the organization away from tech debt accumulated in  legacy, fragmented systems.
  • CPG-Style Rigor & Planning: Introduce sophisticated demand forecasting, sales and operations planning (S&OP), and inventory replenishment models tailored to a highly variable, hit-driven physical product lifecycle.
  • Change Management: Direct a comprehensive organizational change management strategy, ensuring corporate stakeholders, global territory leads, and physical warehouse operators successfully adopt new digital workflows and standardized processes.
  • 3PL & Vendor Optimization: Partner with operational leadership to create a framework enabling them to standardize and hold global third-party logistics (3PL) providers, manufacturers, and freight forwarders accountable to strict, data-driven SLAs
  • Executive Leadership: Partner closely with the C-suite, technology teams, and global business unit heads to integrate supply chain capabilities into the broader corporate data ecosystem.

About you:

  • 15+ years of progressive supply chain leadership experience, with a proven track record as a VP or SVP managing large-scale physical logistics and distribution network footprints.
  • Deep operational, foundational experience within a premier CPG, retail, or fast-moving consumer goods environment 
  • Proven success as the business lead for a large-scale, global SCM or ERP system implementation (e.g., o9 solutions, SAP) from blueprinting through to post-go-live optimization.
  • Mastery of advanced demand planning, data-driven inventory optimization, and setting up rigorous KPIs across a complex, multi-region distribution network.
  • Exceptional cross-functional influence and communication skills; the ability to translate complex, rigid supply chain methodologies into agile strategies that support a creative, fast-paced industry.
  • A proven track record of delivery in a creative or similarly unpredictable environment, driven by high pressure or release date driven deadlines.

We’d love it if you also were:

  • Excellent communicator, and dedicated professional with strong organization skills
  • Goal Oriented - setting both short- and long-term goals for teams, motivating them towards high performance.
  • Relationship Builder - develops internal and external relationships globally to accomplish business and revenue goals.
  • Strong Leader who exhibits problem-solving skills to drive and motivate cross functional team members and major projects or initiatives.
  • Capable of establishing and maintaining excellent relationships with top level executives globally and decision-makers, continuously communicating priorities and exploring new opportunities to drive new revenue.
  • Commercially-minded, with sound and practical business judgment


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $225,000 to $275,000 Annually Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as work experience and business needs. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

job.title: Creative Strategist
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Creative Strategist is an integrated marketer who translates client challenges and objectives into clear, insights-driven creative partnerships that leverage the full power of The Washington Post as a global media brand and technology company.


A strategic storyteller committed to exploring new creative territories, the ideal candidate can turn cultural trends, industry realities, audience insights, and emerging opportunities into compelling marketing ideas, crafting unique partnership opportunities and branded content strategies that help clients achieve their goals.


As a member of WP Studios' Creative Strategy team, this role supports the pitch function of The Washington Post’s advertising sales organization, developing strategic responses to RFPs and proactive opportunities across branded content, live experiences, media, creator-led programs, sponsorships, and other emerging formats.


This role is based in New York, where the Creative Strategy team and much of the broader advertising sales marketplace are based.


What Motivates You

  • You are a writer who knows how to build coherent, insights-backed integrated proposals that solve client challenges by capitalizing on The Post’s content, technology, audience, and creative capabilities in inventive ways.
  • You are a storyteller who likes to put yourself in the shoes of clients and understand their objectives and desired outcomes.
  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and excited to help win new and returning business.
  • You have a passion for developing original branded content ideas and exploring emerging formats, including creator-led opportunities.
  • You take pride in your ideas and storytelling abilities while remaining open to feedback and ready to pivot when needed.
  • You believe creativity thrives through collaboration and diverse perspectives.
  • You enjoy working with stakeholders across Sales, Creative, Product, Operations, Editorial, Research, and other teams to bring strong ideas together.
  • You can balance proactive projects with deadline-driven proposal development.
  • You excel in a fast-paced environment and can manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • You have a strong interest in technology, digital content, social media, culture, and emerging trends that shape how brands engage audiences.
  • You are interested in using AI thoughtfully to accelerate research, ideation, and early drafts while applying human judgment to strategy, storytelling, and client needs.
  • You are inspired by the opportunity to support the mission of a purpose-driven organization and the business model that sustains its journalism.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Develop high-value, cohesive, strategically led client proposals that may incorporate original branded content, live events, advertising media, newsroom priorities and collaborations, sponsorships, creator-led programs, and emerging formats.
  • Ideate and pitch custom content and partnership strategies that address client objectives and business challenges.
  • Translate client briefs, RFPs, audience insights, cultural trends, and business context into clear creative strategies and compelling proposal narratives.
  • Manage collaboration among Sales and cross-functional stakeholders whose expertise and contributions are needed to develop strategic pitches and proposals.
  • Build and finalize client-facing proposal materials, including presentations, one-sheeters, decks, and other pitch materials.
  • Work with agility across multiple concurrent RFP responses, proactive pitches, and new-business opportunities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Partner effectively with Sales and internal teams to assess ideas, incorporate feedback, and ensure recommendations align with client goals and The Post’s capabilities.
  • Contribute to projects that improve the organization, accessibility, and flow of Creative Strategy resources, information, and best practices across the team and WP Studios.
  • Use AI-enabled tools appropriately to accelerate research, early ideation, and first drafts while maintaining ownership of strategic judgment, creative quality, and final recommendations.
  • Provide additional pre-sale creative and strategic support as needed.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience developing client-facing creative proposals or integrated marketing solutions for brands, media agencies, publishers, advertising organizations, or related environments.
  • Strong strategic writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate client objectives, insights, and complex information into clear and compelling proposals.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple proposals, deadlines, and stakeholder inputs simultaneously.

job.title: Justice Reporter
job.description:
Application Instructions

Please list all professional experience and explain any gaps in employment history. All of your application materials, which may include PDF files of work samples and/or links to audio, video, photography or graphics, must be uploaded to the field labeled Resume/Cover Letter/Work Samples to be considered for the position.


Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking an experienced, rigorous journalist to cover the Department of Justice, the FBI and other federal law enforcement agencies and those institutions’ relationships with the White House, Congress, and candidates for federal office. This reporter will break news and produce authoritative journalism about federal investigations, prosecutions and law enforcement policy across a wide range of subjects. 


This is a highly competitive beat that requires persistence, discretion and an ability to distinguish significant developments from the noise surrounding high-profile investigations. The successful candidate will help readers understand not only what federal law enforcement is doing, but how decisions are being made, what forces are influencing them and what the consequences are for individuals, institutions and the country.


This coverage is central to The Post's mission and frequently intersects with politics, national security and other major areas of our report. A collaborative spirit and enthusiasm for partnering with journalists across the newsroom are essential.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom.


What Motivates You

  • You are driven to break consequential news and uncover what is happening inside powerful institutions.
  • You thrive on developing sources and building the trust necessary to produce sensitive, exclusive reporting.
  • You are fascinated by the intersection of law enforcement, politics, national security and power.
  • You enjoy moving between fast-breaking developments and deeper enterprise work.
  • You are committed to fair-minded reporting, particularly when covering allegations, investigations and prosecutions with significant consequences for the people involved.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Break news on the Justice Department, FBI and other federal law enforcement agencies, developing authoritative coverage of investigations, indictments, prosecutions and major policy decisions.
  • Develop and maintain a deep network of sources across federal law enforcement, the legal community, government and other institutions relevant to the beat.
  • Cover major investigations involving prominent individuals and institutions.
  • Produce smart, timely analysis that helps readers understand the significance of complicated legal and investigative developments.
  • Develop ambitious stories that reveal how federal law enforcement operates and hold officials and institutions accountable.
  • Handle highly sensitive source reporting with exceptional judgment, discretion and attention to verification.
  • Report and write quickly as urgent news requires while continuing to develop longer-term reporting targets.
  • Translate complex legal proceedings, investigative processes and institutional dynamics into clear, accessible journalism for a broad audience.
  • Collaborate closely with colleagues across Politics & Government, Investigations, National, International and other departments on stories that cross coverage areas.
  • Work with visual journalists and social video teams to identify the most compelling ways to present complex and consequential stories.
  • Adhere rigorously to the highest standards of accuracy, fairness and journalistic ethics, including giving subjects of our reporting meaningful opportunities to respond.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • A demonstrated track record of high-profile scoops, exclusive reporting and consequential accountability journalism.
  • Knowledge of federal law enforcement, criminal justice and the institutions and processes surrounding them.
  • A strong source base — or a demonstrated ability to develop one — among federal law enforcement officials, attorneys and others relevant to the beat.
  • Proven ability to cover breaking news with speed, precision and authority.
  • Experience handling sensitive sourcing and reporting on investigations in which accuracy, fairness and discretion are paramount.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce ambitious enterprise, investigations and compelling explanatory journalism.
  • Excellent writing skills and an ability to make complicated legal and institutional subjects understandable to a broad audience.
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to manage multiple competitive storylines simultaneously.
  • A collaborative mindset and eagerness to work with journalists throughout the newsroom.
  • A commitment to accuracy, fairness and the highest standards of journalism.

Interested candidates should upload a cover letter, résumé and three examples of their work (as PDFs) to our jobs portal. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, but those received by Nov. 25 will be prioritized. The cover letter should be addressed to Justice Editor Maria Glod, Deputy Politics & Government Editor Jennifer Liberto, Politics & Government Editor Nick Baumann and Managing Editor Peter Spiegel.

job.title: Manager Treasury Operations
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

Treasury operations protect The Washington Post’s liquidity, enable timely payments and collections, and provide leaders with a clear view of near-term cash needs. The Manager, Treasury Operations leads the day-to-day team and operating routines that make this possible. This role improves the performance of GSD, establishes a practical treasury measurement cadence, and represents treasury needs in the NetSuite implementation. It also helps establish a reliable 13-week cash flow forecast so Finance can manage near-term cash needs with greater visibility and confidence.


What Motivates You

  • You are energized by making treasury operations reliable, measurable, and easier for colleagues and business partners to navigate.
  • You enjoy leading a small team and working with service partners through clear expectations, sound judgment, and continuous improvement.
  • You are fluent in the connection between cash collections, payments, working capital, operational discipline, and business performance.
  • You like translating finance needs into practical system design and can work productively with implementation partners and technology teams.
  • You bring rigor to forecasting, data quality, and controls while staying adaptable as business conditions and priorities change.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Lead the treasury operations team by managing, coaching, and developing direct reports; setting clear priorities and accountability; and building a collaborative, control-conscious team that delivers dependable daily execution.
  • Oversee GSD service delivery by maintaining service expectations, operating routines, escalation paths, and performance reviews that help ensure timely, accurate, and efficient treasury support.
  • Maintain a treasury KPI dashboard by capturing pre-GSD performance baselines, tracking agreed measures, and reporting trends that make service quality, control performance, and operating improvements visible to Finance leaders.
  • Recommend operational performance targets by using relevant industry standards and internal baselines for measures such as cash collections cycle time, unapplied cash, payment timeliness, forecast accuracy, exception volume, and reconciliation quality, then coordinating improvement activity toward approved goals.
  • Represent treasury in NetSuite process design by partnering with Cameron, Plative, and internal Finance and Technology stakeholders to document current-state needs, test proposed workflows, and validate treasury requirements, controls, reporting, and user needs.
  • Coordinate ERP implementation readiness by supporting treasury testing, data validation, cutover preparation, documentation, and training so the team can adopt the new system effectively.
  • Help build the 13-week cash flow forecast by organizing the methodology, data inputs, forecast calendar, and reporting cadence required to produce a credible rolling view of liquidity and short-term cash needs.
  • Manage the cash forecasting cadence by updating forecasts, analyzing forecast-versus-actual results, identifying material variances and drivers, and escalating emerging cash risks and decisions to the Controller and Finance leaders.
  • Partner across Finance by working closely with Accounting, FP&A, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Tax, Technology, and business leaders to connect operational data to cash outcomes and resolve barriers to performance.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • 5-7 years of progressive experience in treasury, cash management, financial operations, accounting, FP&A, or a related finance discipline, including experience leading or supervising people or outsourced service delivery.
  • Working knowledge of cash forecasting, working capital management, cash collections, payment operations, bank administration, reconciliations, and treasury controls.
  • Experience defining operational KPIs, building performance dashboards, establishing service-level expectations, and leading data-informed improvement efforts.
  • Experience participating in ERP implementation or transformation work, including process design, requirements definition, user acceptance testing, data validation, change readiness, and training; NetSuite experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with operational and financial data to identify trends, explain variances, and make practical recommendations.
  • Sound judgment in managing financial controls, confidential information, risks, and exceptions, with a commitment to accuracy and responsible stewardship.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners, manage external consultants or service providers, and communicate complex operational issues clearly to Finance leaders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience; CTP, CPA, or comparable credential is a plus.

job.title: Senior Product Manager, Subscriptions
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Subscriptions. Our product team shapes how readers discover our subscription, decide to join, and build habits as long-term subscribers. We own the flows people move through on the way to becoming a subscriber, and we work closely with our subscriptions marketing team to bring new readers in.

 

The Senior Product Manager, Subscriptions, leads a cross-functional team focused on turning unknown users into known users, and known users into paying subscribers. You will dig into how people behave, find the spots where they hesitate or drop off, and turn what you learn into a clear roadmap. You will also work with our revenue science team on the models that help us show the right offer to the right user at the right time.


What Motivates You

  • You get energized by the puzzle of why people choose to subscribe and what makes them stay.
  • You like working across teams and are good at turning ideas from marketing, design, data science, and engineering into something everyone can build toward.
  • You're curious about customers. You want to understand what they need, where they get stuck, and what would make the experience feel easy.
  • You care about the mission and values of the organization and bring determination and good organization to the work.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Own the roadmap for conversion and acquisition flows, from a reader's first visit through registration, checkout, and early onboarding.
  • Develop strategies that move unknown users to known users and known users to payers.
  • Partner with the revenue science team on the models and testing that inform which offer reaches which user, and when.
  • Partner closely with the subscriptions marketing team to plan and launch experiments and campaigns that bring in new subscribers.·       Work with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and QA to ship high quality products on a steady rhythm.
  • Write clear requirements and prioritize features against our acquisition and revenue goals.
  • Use A/B testing and other experimentation to learn what works, then apply it to the next round of improvements.
  • Spot roadblocks early and clear them before they slow the team down.
  • Share updates, risks, and new opportunities with leadership on a regular basis.
  • Keep up with trends in subscription products, conversion optimization, and consumer behavior.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in digital subscriptions.
  • Experience improving conversion funnels or acquisition flows, ideally in a B2C digital subscription product. This is a strong plus.·      
  • Experience using data to inform decisions, including a track record of running experiments and combining numbers with customer feedback to decide what to build.
  • Comfort working with data science or analytics partners on models and personalization, even if you aren't building the models yourself.
  • A collaborative style and the ability to build good working relationships with marketing, design, engineering, and analytics partners.    
  • Strong attention to detail, and the ability to juggle several projects in a fast-moving environment.

job.title: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

  • The Senior Systems Engineer helps keep The Washington Post’s identity, collaboration, endpoint, and core IT service platforms secure, reliable, and available.
  • This role serves as a senior technical resource for Identity and Access Management, supporting Active Directory, Okta, single sign-on, and automated user-lifecycle processes.
  • Through hands-on systems engineering, administration, integration, and automation, this role improves the reliability and efficiency of technology services used across the organization.
  • Working with IT Operations, Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, HR, and other partners, this role helps translate operational and security requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • As an individual contributor, this role provides technical guidance and project leadership but does not have formal people-management responsibilities.

What Motivates You

  • You enjoy solving complex systems and infrastructure problems through careful analysis and hands-on technical work.
  • You are interested in identity management, enterprise platforms, automation, and secure service delivery.
  • You look for practical ways to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and strengthen operational controls.
  • You take pride in building solutions that are documented, supportable, and sustainable for the broader team.
  • You are comfortable responding to immediate operational needs while continuing to improve the underlying systems and processes.
  • You enjoy collaborating with cybersecurity professionals, administrators, engineers, and business partners to solve shared problems.
  • You value sharing your knowledge and helping colleagues develop their technical capabilities.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Administer and improve Identity and Access Management services, including Active Directory, Okta, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, and role-based access, supporting secure and reliable access to enterprise systems.
  • Design and implement automated provisioning, deprovisioning, and access-change workflows within established security and platform standards, improving the accuracy and timeliness of identity administration.
  • Develop and maintain integrations among platforms such as Workday, Okta, Active Directory, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, and ServiceNow, improving the consistency of data and service workflows.
  • Engineer and support assigned enterprise platforms, which may include Google Workspace, storage and collaboration services, endpoint-management tools, asset-management systems, and ITSM platforms, maintaining reliable day-to-day operations.
  • Use APIs, scripting, and systems-management tools to automate recurring administrative and operational processes, reducing manual effort and preventable errors.
  • Troubleshoot complex incidents involving identity, access, integrations, endpoints, systems administration, and enterprise applications, restoring service and identifying corrective actions.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity and Compliance to implement approved security configurations, access controls, and remediation plans, reducing identity and infrastructure risk.
  • Support the technical implementation of data-retention requirements, legal holds, and e-discovery requests in partnership with Legal, Cybersecurity, and designated data owners, ensuring requests are executed accurately and securely.
  • Contribute technical expertise to system upgrades, platform changes, integration projects, and service improvements, helping projects meet operational, security, and delivery requirements.
  • Maintain system documentation, technical procedures, integration records, and operational runbooks, improving service continuity and reducing reliance on individual knowledge.
  • Recommend improvements to system configurations, workflows, and working methods, strengthening the effectiveness and reliability of the IT Operations team.
  • Provide technical guidance, cross-training, and mentoring to engineers and administrators, helping colleagues resolve issues and work effectively within established standards.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Five or more years of relevant experience in systems engineering, systems administration, enterprise infrastructure, Identity and Access Management, or a related discipline.
  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, Okta, SSO integrations, multifactor authentication, access provisioning, and role-based access controls.
  • Experience administering Google Workspace in a large or complex environment, including experience with the Google Admin SDK, OAuth, and service accounts.
  • Hands-on experience integrating enterprise systems, SaaS applications, IAM tools, HR platforms, or IT service-management platforms.
  • Proficiency in at least one relevant scripting language, such as Python, JavaScript, Bash, PowerShell, or Google Apps Script.
  • Experience working with REST APIs and troubleshooting system-to-system integrations.
  • Practical experience implementing identity, endpoint, configuration, or access controls in partnership with cybersecurity or compliance teams.
  • Experience supporting ITSM, CMDB, asset-management, endpoint-management, storage, or enterprise collaboration platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to identify root causes and resolve issues involving multiple systems.
  • Ability to manage assigned projects and technical work independently while recognizing when decisions or risks require escalation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and recommendations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience creating technical documentation, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring without formal supervisory authority.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, or other modern systems-engineering practices is preferred.
  • Experience supporting legal holds, e-discovery, data retention, or information-governance processes is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, training, and practical experience.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

job.title: Front-End Privacy Engineer
job.description:
About Local Now

Local Now is a free, ad-supported streaming service delivering local news, weather, sports, and lifestyle programming to viewers across virtually every connected device. As part of Allen Media Group, we operate at meaningful scale across mobile, smart TVs, streaming sticks, set-top boxes, and the web. We are now investing in a ground-up rebuild of our streaming platform with a privacy-first architecture, modern shared-code strategy, and the engineering rigor needed to grow sustainably. We build for audiences who expect frictionless playback on any device, and for advertisers who depend on us to deliver reliable, high-quality monetization. As a privacy-centric platform, our commitment to data protection is a core pillar of our technology and our business.

The Role

We are hiring a Front-End Privacy Engineer to help build and maintain the client-side privacy architecture of Local Now's consumer apps. You will work on a small, senior frontend team building shared, cross-platform code that powers our experience across iOS, Android, mobile, tablet, and connected TV surfaces. As a key contributor in privacy engineering, you will assist with the technical implementation of Consent Management Platforms (CMPs), privacy SDKs (such as OneTrust or Ethyca), and client-side tracking governance.

This is a greenfield rebuild with a privacy-first architectural posture, an aggressive but quality-conscious delivery cadence, and meaningful AI-assisted developer tooling baked into how we work. You should be passionate about cross-platform data flow architecture, curious about how third-party SDKs operate under the hood, and energized by the challenge of enforcing strict privacy controls without compromising a polished streaming experience.

What You Will Do

  • Implement and Manage CMPs: Integrate and maintain Consent Management Platform SDKs (e.g., OneTrust, Ethyca Fides, Ketch) across React Native (iOS/Android) and web environments.

  • Govern Consent State: Develop and maintain centralized state management to ensure user consent and preferences propagate seamlessly to ad insertion (CSAI/SSAI), video players, analytics tools, and third-party vendors.

  • Enforce Data Minimization: Implement privacy-first patterns into the client, including data-minimization at the source and preventing unauthorized data leakage from third-party tags.

  • Automated Privacy Signals: Implement client-side support for global privacy signals, including Global Privacy Control (GPC), and ensure compliance with frameworks like the IAB TCF or GPP.

  • Audit Tracking & Network Traffic: Inspect network traffic using tools like Charles Proxy to audit data flow, verify API compliance, and govern cookies, local storage, and tracking pixels.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with backend, platform, and CMS engineers to integrate privacy-safe APIs, while collaborating with legal teams to translate privacy policies into strict technical controls.

  • Team Collaboration: Collaborate with peers, uphold privacy-by-design principles through code review, and use AI-assisted development tooling effectively to multiply your output.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 4+ years of mobile or front-end engineering experience, with 2+ years working in React/React Native production codebases.

  • Privacy Expertise: Experience or strong familiarity with implementing and configuring CMPs (OneTrust, Ethyca, Sourcepoint) and navigating consent orchestration in consumer applications.

  • Frontend Fundamentals: Strong fundamentals in React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern mobile/web architecture patterns.

  • Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with how global privacy regulations (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, VCDPA) influence front-end architecture and client-side tracking mechanisms.

  • Platform Familiarity: Familiarity with native iOS (Swift/Objective-C) or Android (Kotlin/Java) sufficient to debug and interface with native privacy modules when required.

  • Quality & Delivery: Comfort with build pipelines, CI, app store submission, and release engineering for mobile. A demonstrated eye for quality—treating performance, polish, and reliability as features.

  • Testing & Tooling: Experience debugging and testing APIs, writing API smoke tests, and inspecting network traffic (e.g., Charles Proxy). Experience with modern AI tools for test case generation, such as Cursor and Claude Code.

Nice to Have

  • Streaming Video Context: Experience with streaming video ecosystems, including ad insertion (CSAI/SSAI), ExoPlayer, AVPlayer, or commercial player SDKs.

  • Connected TV: Experience targeting connected TV form factors (tvOS, Android TV/Google TV, Fire TV) from a React Native or shared-code codebase.

  • Ad-Tech Standards: Familiarity with IAB Tech Lab privacy standards, such as the Global Privacy Platform (GPP) or the US Privacy String.

  • Automated UI Testing: Exposure to automated testing tools like Playwright for automatically testing the UI of web, mobile, and TV platforms.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these characteristics. We are dedicated to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination.

job.title: Privacy Business Analyst/QA Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Contract to Hire, Privacy BA/QA Analyst to bridge the gap between our privacy program and the digital teams building our products. You’ll translate privacy requirements into testable acceptance criteria, validate that new systems, features, and data flows meet our privacy obligations, and help ensure privacy is designed in from day one; not bolted on after launch. You’ll work within frameworks including COPPA, the Video Privacy Protection Act, CCPA and other comprehensive state privacy laws, and applicable federal privacy requirements. Your scope spans web, mobile, connected TV apps and streaming platforms.

Key responsibilities: 

  • Partner with backend and frontend engineering teams during sprint planning and refinement to surface privacy requirements early. 

  • Write and maintain privacy test cases covering data collection, consent flows, retention, deletion, and cross-border transfers. 

  • Execute QA on privacy impacting features before release, including cookie banners, consent management platforms, subject rights workflows, tracking technology and privacy controls within connected TV apps, mobile and web. 

  • Conduct ongoing technical control testing across technical assets; access controls, consent signal enforcement, data minimization checks, and automated monitoring where tooling allows. Document findings, track remediation, and report metrics to privacy leadership. 

  • Support privacy operations, privacy impact assessments by gathering technical details from engineering across web, mobile, and CTV surfaces.

  • Help evaluate and onboard privacy tooling like OneTrust and Ethyca. 

  • Stay current on evolving state privacy legislation and translate new requirements into practical controls and test plans.

  • Ability to review or audit consumer facing streaming properties to assess usage of tracking technologies including pixels, cookies, sdks, etc. 

  • Work experience with Agile methodologies.


Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, business, or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Two or more years, QA related to privacy ideally supporting digital product teams.

  • Working knowledge of COPPA, VPPA, CCPA and CPRA, and state privacy laws Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, and others. 

  • Experience testing web, mobile, and ideally CTV/ streaming applications. 

  • Familiarity with consent management platforms, tag management, and privacy engineering tooling. 

  • Strong written communication and ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, and product teams. 


Relevant privacy certifications a plus: CIPT, CDPSE, or similar.

Additional certifications a plus:  CSM, CSPO, CSBA or similar

job.title: Product Manager, Streaming Experience
job.description:
About the role

We build and run streaming brands for viewers on connected TVs, mobile and the web, across free ad-supported (FAST), on-demand and subscription experiences. Our apps live on every major platform, from Roku and Fire TV to Samsung, LG, Vizio, Apple TV and Google TV.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager to lead product experience strategy for Local Now, one of our flagship streaming brands. You'll own the multi-platform viewer experience for the features that you work on end to end, from how people discover and watch content to how the business grows users, keeps them, and earns from every hour viewed. Great user flows and UX are at the center of the job.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll set the vision and roadmap, run fast experiments, and partner with engineering, content, ad sales and platform partners to ship. Our product and engineering teams build with AI, which takes ideas from concept to prototype to production in days, not quarters. You'll move at that speed: testing more ideas, learning faster, and turning ideas into results sooner.

What you'll own

  • Brand outcomes. Own the metrics for your brand: user growth and churn, engagement and viewing time, ad impressions and yield. You set the targets with leadership and report against them.

  • What gets built, and what doesn't. Set and defend the roadmap. Decide priority, scope and what "done" means, and approve what goes into each sprint. Say no to work that can't show a path to revenue or audience.

  • User flows and UX. Understand how viewers move through your apps, from launch and onboarding to browse, search, playback, sign-up. Map and redesign those flows for remote, touch and web, partner with design on every key screen, and cut friction wherever viewers drop off.

  • Fast experiments. Run a steady cadence of tests and proofs of concept with quick revenue and audience reads. Build clickable prototypes and demos yourself with AI tools so ideas get validated before they reach an engineering sprint.

  • Backlog and requirements, through AI. Direct AI to do the product owner and business analyst work. It turns PRDs into epics, stories and acceptance criteria, keeps the Jira backlog groomed and ordered, documents requirements and business rules, maps workflows and edge cases, and traces each requirement to its tickets and tests.

  • Quality of AI output. Review the AI's work where judgment matters: the concept, the success criteria, and anything users will see. Spot-check tickets and specs against the code and the business intent, and catch requirements that look complete but aren't.

  • The AI workflow itself. Maintain the PRD and ticket templates, prompts, skills and Jira automations your team relies on. Measure their accuracy, fix what breaks, and make the workflow run for vendor engineering teams as well as in-house ones.

  • Intake and reporting. Route requests from ad sales, content, marketing and legal through AI for first-pass triage and sizing. Have AI prepare sprint goals, release notes and status updates from Jira and analytics data, so your time goes to decisions.

  • Engineering partnership. Lead in-house and vendor engineering teams on priorities and trade-offs. Make decisions in hours, not sprints, so faster engineering turns into faster results.

  • Audience and data. Know your viewers: who they are, what they watch, why they leave. Use analytics, A/B testing and ad stack data to decide, not just to report.

  • Partners and stakeholders. Work with platform partners (Roku, Amazon Fire TV, Samsung, LG, Vizio, Apple TV, Google TV and others), ad sales, content and programming, marketing, and legal and privacy.

What you bring

  • A portfolio of shipped work, ideally including 10-foot TV interfaces, mobile apps and video or streaming experiences. We'll ask you to walk us through the problem, your process, what shipped, and what changed in the numbers.

  • Deep fluency in 10-foot design: focus-driven navigation, remote and D-pad interaction, overscan and safe areas, type and contrast for viewing distance, and designing for slow hardware and limited input.

  • Working knowledge of each major platform's design guidelines and quirks (Roku SceneGraph constraints, tvOS focus engine, Tizen, Fire TV/Vega, Google TV, Vizio).

  • Strong player UX instincts: trick play, live and linear patterns, ad pod experience, captions, and accessibility on TV.

  • Mastery of Figma (components, variables, prototyping) and comfort building interactive prototypes with AI tools or code.

  • Accessibility experience: WCAG, captions and audio description, screen readers and voice control on TV and mobile.

  • Experience designing for experimentation: variants that are cheap to build, testable and measurable.

  • Ability to write specs engineers can build from without a design handoff meeting.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FAST/linear UX: EPG and channel guide design, channel-surfing behavior, and lean-back discovery

  • Motion design and micro-interaction skills.

  • Experience with design systems that span native and cross-platform frameworks.

  • Familiarity with consent and privacy UX (CMP flows, GPC, age or region gating).

  • Some front-end or prototyping code experience.

Purpose of Role  - Conducting Strategic Sourcing, Market Intelligence, Opportunity Assessment, Spend Analytics, Contract Analytics, Category Strategy development support, Contract Extension & Renewals, spot buys, tactical sourcing, market engagement and buying channel optimization, tail spend management, executing projects through GEP S2C platform, perform risk, governance & compliance checks, supporting procurement operations etc. and thereby optimize the way we source & procure and generate value.

  • Providing specialist administrative support from beginning to end of a tendering project/RFP ensuring the integrity of the process.
  • Keeping an audit trail for each project and ensuring required documentation is in place.
  • Providing a professional, efficient and effective response to stakeholders when handling clarification questions and responding to other enquiries.

Competencies, Knowledge and Experience -

Digital Dexterity, Collaboration, Critical Thinking, Developing Self (Learning to Learn) Curiosity, Creativity and Innovation, Stakeholder Management and Business, Partnership, Strategic Business Acumen, Responsible Procurement, Managing Supplier Relationships, Contract Development, Negotiation, Contract and Performance Management, Change Management, Leadership, Strategic Sourcing, Managing and Developing People, Category Planning.

What you'll need:

  • Proficient in strategic sourcing and procurement methodology and process.
  • Experience in working on Source2Contract platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to devise and provide insight on spend categories and supply markets based internal & external category profiles.

job.title: Business Development Representative
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Summary

Bottle Rocket helps clients plan, build, and improve digital products, leading with defined, outcome-oriented offerings. The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the engine at the top of the sales funnel and a key driver of the company’s growth. This role owns outbound prospecting, turning a strong volume of leads into calls, calls into meetings, and meetings into new clients.

The ideal BDR is driven, tenacious, and a great active listener. They understand the front-end digital experience and the back-end that enables it. They can distill the needs behind a prospect’s business challenges, connect them to the right Bottle Rocket solution, and hand a well-qualified opportunity to the Business Development Executive team.

Essential Functions

  • Drive a high volume of outbound activity (calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, and multi-touch cadences) to create a consistent flow of new leads
  • Convert leads into live conversations, and conversations into qualified first meetings booked for the Business Development Executive team
  • Own and consistently hit weekly and monthly targets for activity, conversations, meetings booked, and pipeline generated
  • Lead outreach with Bottle Rocket’s productized offerings, positioning each around the business problem it solves rather than a list of services
  • Spot buying signals in research and discovery calls, and connect them to the right Bottle Rocket services:
    • Strategy & Research (Experience Strategy, Research & Insights): unclear priorities, fragmented experiences, a new idea to validate
    • Design & Build (Design & Development, Experience Optimization): aging or low-rated apps, redesigns, falling engagement or conversion
    • Enterprise Engineering (Technical Modernization, Cloud Enablement, AI & Data, Application Engineering): legacy platforms, cloud migration, AI pilots, integration gaps
  • Research and build targeted account and contact lists in priority industries (Healthcare, Gaming, Hospitality, Financial Services, and QSR) with Business Development leadership
  • Qualify prospects on pain points, fit, budget, decision-making authority, and timeline, and hand off to Business Development Executives with clear notes and context
  • Partner with Marketing on go-to-market (GTM) campaigns for each offering, and share feedback on messaging, objections, and what is resonating in market
  • Prepare meeting agendas, follow-up emails, and other prospect communications
  • Keep activity, lead, and opportunity data accurate and current in the CRM
  • Track and report on funnel metrics: activity → conversations → meetings → opportunities → new clients
  • Work closely with Business Development, Marketing, and Product Strategy to align on GTM goals, KPIs, and metrics

Additional Duties and Responsibilities

  • Stay current on trends in digital products, AI, cloud, and tech modernization, and on the business priorities of target industries
  • Learn Bottle Rocket’s offerings, case studies, and delivery model well enough to speak credibly with prospects
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, or a related field
  • 2–3 years of experience (post-college) in an outbound sales role, such as SDR or BDR, selling Technology or Consulting Services, SaaS, software, or similar technology products or services
  • Related backgrounds are welcome, such as technology-enabled services, digital agencies, or IT consulting
  • Proven, measurable record of meeting or exceeding activity, meeting, and pipeline targets

Key Competencies

  • Driven and tenacious: persistent follow-up, energized by high outbound volume, and quick to bounce back from a “no”
  • Great active listener: asks sharp questions, listens more than talks, and picks up on what a prospect isn’t saying
  • Technical curiosity: recognizes buying signals across Technical Modernization, AI & Data, Application Engineering, and Cloud Enablement, and can discuss them credibly at a business level (an engineering background is not required)
  • Problem-first, consultative approach that leads with outcomes rather than feature lists
  • Competitive, goal-oriented, and metrics-driven; thrives on clear targets and a visible scoreboard
  • Strong written communication, with the ability to write concise, compelling, personalized outreach
  • Confident and professional communicating with Director, VP, and C-level executives
  • Highly organized; keeps high activity volume and multiple cadences on track
  • Coachable, with a growth mindset and the ambition to step up into a Business Development Executive role
  • Self-starter who works well independently and as part of a fast-paced, collaborative team
  • Experienced using Microsoft Excel and Apple Keynote (preferred) or Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Regular attendance at work is required for successful performance

Preferred Skills

  • Experienced with CRM software; Salesforce preferred
  • Experience with sales engagement tools; Salesloft preferred
  • Experience with prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator or ZoomInfo
  • Experience with video conferencing (Zoom or Teams) and call recording tools; Gong preferred
  • Uses AI tools to research accounts and personalize outreach
  • Exposure to software development, cloud, or data concepts through a prior role, coursework, or personal projects
  • Experience selling into Healthcare, Gaming, Hospitality, Financial Services, or QSR
  • Previous experience in an entrepreneurial, small-company environment

Supervisory Responsibilities

No direct reports.

Contacts with this Position

Works primarily within GTM teams (Business Development and Marketing) and with the Product Strategy team to stay aligned on offerings. Frequently works with potential customers in the earliest stages of the sales process.

Physical Requirements (the info from here to the end must remain for EEO reasons)

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Lift and carry up to 10 lbs.
  • Dexterity
  • Clear speech in the English language                                     
  • Reach with hands and arms throughout day
  • Talk clearly
  • Hear within normal range
  • Stand, walk, and bend several times per day

Mental/Reasoning Requirements

  • Reading – Complex
  • Writing – Complex
  • Analysis/Comprehension
  • Judgment/Decision Making
  • Advanced Math skills

Vision Requirements

  • Good vision with color perception
  • Near vision – able to see details at close range

Working Conditions

The physical environment requires the employee to work primarily inside. The employee may be requested to work overtime and weekends for special program events.

Required Use of Machinery, Tools, Equipment and Personal Protective Equipment

  • Company-issued computer
  • Business equipment

job.title: eDiscovery & Forensics Analyst
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

We are seeking a skilled eDiscovery & Forensics Analyst to join our team on a 12-18 month contract, providing dual support across both eDiscovery and Digital Forensics 
functions. This role is ideal for a candidate who can bridge investigative technology with legal/compliance requirements, while also possessing a strong technical understanding of how breaches occur and how malicious activity can be traced, analysed,and reported.
The successful candidate will conduct forensic investigations, malware analysis, and eDiscovery searches, and will be responsible for producing clear, evidence-based reports and findings that can be presented to senior stakeholders to support business, legal, and security decision-making

What you'll be doing:

Conduct digital forensic investigations across endpoints and enterprise systems, identifying indicators of compromise (IOCs) and root cause of security incidents.

Perform malware analysis (static and/or dynamic) to understand behaviour, impact, and scope of compromise.

Use Magnet Axiom and NUIX to acquire, process, and analyse digital evidence, and to build clear, defensible reports of findings.

Conduct searches and investigations using Microsoft Purview (eDiscovery, Content Search, Audit) to support legal holds, HR investigations, and compliance requests. 

Perform audit log searches (e.g., Microsoft 365 unified audit log, Azure AD signin/audit logs) to reconstruct user activity, timeline events, and identify anomalous 
behaviour.

Support the eDiscovery team with data collection, search term development, and review workflows

Support the business with breach investigations, chain-of-custody documentation, and technical write-ups.

Translate complex technical findings into clear, concise reports and presentations suitable for senior stakeholders, legal counsel, and non-technical audiences.

Maintain detailed and defensible documentation throughout all investigations to support potential legal or regulatory proceedings.

Stay current on emerging threats, attacker techniques (TTPs), and forensic/eDiscovery tooling best practices.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, HR, IT, and Security teams as needed.

What you'll need:

Essential Skills & Experience:

Hands-on experience in acquiring and preserving digital evidence, forensic artifacts, and forensic images across multiple operating systems (Windows, Mac and Linux) to 
support forensic analysis, and legal investigations.
Experience with forensic tooling such as Magnet Axiom, NUIX, FTK, or equivalent enterprise forensic platforms.
Solid understanding of how security breaches occur, common attack vectors, and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Experience conducting audit log analysis and reconstructing timelines from system/user activity logs.
Solid experience with Microsoft Purview (eDiscovery, Compliance, Audit Search)
Ability to produce clear, well-structured investigative reports for both technical and executive/non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.

Desirable Skills & Experience:

Experience supporting both eDiscovery and forensics functions concurrently.
Relevant certifications such as surrounding Magnet/NUIX vendor certifications.
Understanding around Microsoft Azure
Prior experience presenting findings to senior stakeholders, legal teams, or regulators.
Scripting/automation experience (PowerShell, Python) to support investigative workflows.
Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE).

A candidate who is naturally curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in high-pressure investigative environments. Someone who can flex between the technical depth required for malware/forensic analysis and the structured, defensible process needed for eDiscovery — while communicating findings confidently to senior  leadership

job.title: Finance Director, Burson
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Finance Director - Burson

Reporting to: Norway and Sweden Market Leader & EMEA CFO

Location: Sweden

 

Who we are:
Burson is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

Burson is part of WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), the creative transformation company. For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More About the role

Burson is seeking a commercially focused Finance Director, to lead finance across our Swedish market, with oversight of Norway. This is a senior market finance leadership role, partnering closely with local and regional leadership to drive financial performance, strengthen operational discipline and support sustainable growth across the two markets.

The role will be responsible for financial planning, reporting, forecasting, controls, compliance and commercial finance support across a business of approximately $10m revenue. It requires someone who can operate strategically, but who is also comfortable being close to the detail in a smaller market environment.

We are looking for a pragmatic, hands-on and commercially astute finance leader who can provide clear insight, challenge and counsel to leadership teams, while ensuring strong governance, accurate reporting and effective financial management.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Lead finance across Sweden and Norway, ensuring strong financial management, governance and commercial discipline across both markets.
  • Act as a trusted finance partner to both market leadership, providing clear insight, challenge and counsel to support business performance and decision-making.
  • Own the budgeting, forecasting and planning processes, ensuring alignment with local market priorities, regional expectations and group reporting requirements.
  • Provide accurate, timely and meaningful financial reporting, including revenue, profitability, margin, cost management, cash flow and working capital performance.
  • Translate financial data into clear commercial insight, identifying trends, risks and opportunities that help leaders make informed decisions.
  • Partner with client and business leads on pricing, profitability, resourcing and commercial decision-making to support sustainable growth.
  • Oversee month-end, quarter-end and year-end close processes, working closely with local, regional, shared service and group finance teams.
  • Ensure the integrity of financial records, reporting and controls, maintaining compliance with Burson/WPP policies and relevant Swedish and Norwegian requirements.
  • Lead on audit, tax, statutory reporting and external advisor relationships, ensuring deadlines are met and risks are managed effectively.
  • Drive improvements in finance processes, systems and ways of working, creating greater consistency, efficiency and accountability across the markets.
  • Support strong operational discipline around revenue recognition, billing, collections, approvals and project financial management.
  • Lead, support and develop the local finance function, building strong relationships across a matrixed, international environment.

Experience You’ll Bring:

  • Significant experience in senior finance, financial control, Financial Planning & Analysis or commercial finance roles, ideally within a professional services, communications, consulting, agency or matrixed international environment.
  • Strong understanding of financial management within a smaller or mid-sized market, with the ability to balance strategic input with hands-on delivery.
  • Proven experience partnering with senior leaders to improve financial performance, commercial discipline and operational decision-making.
  • Strong budgeting, forecasting, reporting, variance analysis and performance management experience.
  • Good understanding of accounting, controls, audit, tax and compliance requirements across Sweden; exposure to Norway or wider Nordic markets would be advantageous.
  • Experience working with regional or group finance teams, ideally in an international network or multinational organisation.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial information and turn it into clear, actionable insight.
  • High level of integrity, sound judgement and confidence in providing constructive challenge.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain finance matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.
  • Fluent English is essential; Swedish language skills are highly desirable. Norwegian language skills or experience working with Norway would be an advantage.

job.description:

Why we're hiring:

WPP is embarking on a major, multi-year global CRM transformation to create a simpler, more connected and consistent approach to managing our clients and growth opportunities across the organisation. The programme will consolidate CRM platforms and processes, standardise core client, pipeline and opportunity management practices, and strengthen the data, integration and governance foundations needed to provide a trusted global view of our clients.

We’re looking for a Global Programme Director, CRM to lead this transformation end to end, turning our ambition into an executable global programme and bringing together business, technology, data, architecture and change teams across agencies and markets.

This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who can navigate the complexity of a federated global organisation, challenge legacy ways of working and drive the decisions, delivery discipline and adoption needed to establish a common global CRM capability.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the global CRM transformation vision, roadmap and delivery strategy, translating strategic ambition into a clear, executable multi-year programme across agencies and markets.
  • Lead the consolidation and simplification of CRM platforms and processes, establishing a clear approach to global standardisation while managing legitimate local requirements.
  • Drive the adoption of common global processes across client and contact management, pipeline and opportunity management, forecasting, client planning and cross-agency collaboration.
  • Lead programme delivery across CRM product, architecture, data, integrations, security, testing, migration, cutover and deployment, working closely with Enterprise Technology and business leaders.
  • Ensure CRM integrates effectively with the wider enterprise technology landscape and that client, account, contact and opportunity data is structured, governed and managed consistently.
  • Own the integrated programme plan, governance, dependencies, RAID, assurance and stage-gate process, providing clear visibility of delivery confidence, risk, decisions, budget and benefits.
  • Define and lead the global deployment, business readiness and adoption strategy, sequencing agencies and markets based on value, readiness, data quality and change capacity.
  • Establish robust go/no-go, cutover, hypercare and stabilisation processes to protect business continuity and ensure each deployment is successfully embedded.
  • Own the programme business case, budget, forecast and benefits framework, ensuring investment remains linked to measurable business outcomes.
  • Manage system integrators, CRM product partners and other third parties against clear deliverables, commercial commitments, milestones and quality expectations.
  • Act as the principal programme interface for executive sponsors and senior agency, market, technology and functional leaders, creating alignment and driving timely decisions.
  • Challenge complexity, local exceptions and assumptions that could undermine the global outcome, balancing business requirements with simplicity, scalability and long-term value.
  • Build and lead a high-performing, global matrixed programme team spanning programme management, product, process, architecture, data, testing, change and deployment.
  • Create an evidence-led delivery culture built on transparency, disciplined decision-making, early escalation and shared accountability for outcomes

What you'll need:

  • Extensive experience leading large-scale, multi-year global transformation programmes within a complex, matrixed or federated organisation.
  • Significant experience delivering major enterprise CRM transformation, ideally involving platforms such as Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365.
  • A strong understanding of how CRM transformation connects technology, business process, operating model, data and organisational change, rather than treating CRM as simply a technology implementation.
  • Experience consolidating fragmented platforms or processes and establishing greater global standardisation across multiple businesses, markets or geographies.
  • Strong programme leadership across areas such as architecture, integration, master data, data migration, testing, security, deployment and business readiness.
  • A proven track record of managing complex programme governance, integrated plans, interdependencies, risks, stage gates and executive-level assurance.
  • Strong commercial and financial capability, including ownership of significant programme budgets, business cases, forecasting, benefits realisation and vendor performance.
  • Experience managing system integrators, software providers and strategic delivery partners in complex enterprise environments.
  • Exceptional senior stakeholder leadership, with the presence and credibility to influence executive sponsors, challenge constructively and secure decisions across competing priorities.
  • Experience leading large, geographically dispersed and matrixed teams across business and technology functions.
  • Strong change and adoption capability, with experience embedding new processes and ways of working and measuring whether transformation has genuinely landed.
  • The ability to translate complex programme, technology and data issues into clear executive-level decisions, risks and trade-offs.
  • A pragmatic, resilient and outcome-focused leadership style, comfortable operating through ambiguity and making difficult decisions when delivery is at risk

Desirable

  • A recognised programme or project management qualification such as MSP, PgMP or PRINCE2.

Why we're hiring:

The Head of FinOps is a Senior Leadership role within the Business Platform Delivery Organisation accountable for WPP’s end-to-end FinOps capability, covering cloud and SaaS spend management, cost allocation, forecasting, optimisation, recharges and Ttechnology Support. The role leads the FinOps team as the primary point of support for cost visibility, reporting, recharge management, user guidance, and platform access across OpCos, projects and clusters.

Working closely with budget holders, the Cloud Hub, platform teams, ET Finance, and Procurement, the role will strengthen financial governance, improve spend transparency, resolve cost and recharge-related challenges, and embed FinOps best practices into Enterprise Technology decision-making. The role is also responsible for establishing a robust support model for Cloudability Premium and IBM Apptio, ensuring platform stability, effective service ownership, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to optimise cloud consumption and maximise value from technology investments.

 

What you'll be doing:

Key Roles and Responsibilities

FinOps Strategy, Governance & Leadership

  • Define and lead the enterprise FinOps strategy, operating model, governance framework, and roadmap for cloud, SaaS, and technology financial management.
  • Own the end-to-end FinOps function, ensuring effective cost allocation, recharge, forecasting, optimisation, financial control, and consumption transparency across the enterprise.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing FinOps organisation, establishing clear accountability, succession planning, and capability growth.

FinOps Platform & Product Ownership

  • Serve as the executive owner for FinOps Platforms such as IBM Apptio, Cloudability Premium, TBM Studio and associated solutions.
  • Define and drive the FinOps tooling strategy, ensuring platforms remain scalable, resilient, business-aligned, and continuously improved.
  • Own platform lifecycle management, support governance, adoption, and long-term sustainability.

Financial Management, Optimisation & Value Realisation

  • Lead enterprise-wide cloud and SaaS financial management, ensuring transparency, accountability, and effective stewardship of technology spend.
  • Drive optimisation initiatives across cloud and SaaS estates, identifying cost-saving opportunities and delivering measurable financial benefits.
  • Provide strategic insight and recommendations to maximise return on technology investments and support business decision-making.

Reporting, Analytics & Data Governance

  • Lead the enterprise FinOps reporting and analytics capability, delivering accurate, timely, and actionable financial insights.
  • Ensure Cloudability, IBM Apptio, and related platforms are integrated with cloud, SaaS, and financial systems to provide a trusted source of financial and consumption data.
  • Establish reporting standards, KPIs, dashboards, and governance frameworks that enable informed technology and financial decisions.

Executive Stakeholder & Commercial Leadership

  • Act as the senior FinOps partner to Enterprise Technology, Finance, Procurement, Cloud Engineering, and business leadership.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to align technology consumption with strategic, operational, and financial objectives.
  • Lead vendor, commercial, and support governance for FinOps platforms and services, ensuring supplier performance, value realisation, and commercial effectiveness.

Risk, Control & Compliance

  • Establish robust financial controls, policies, and governance frameworks to ensure accuracy, auditability, compliance, and accountability for technology spend.
  • Proactively identify and manage financial, operational, and service risks across the FinOps ecosystem.
  • Ensure executive visibility and timely escalation of risks impacting business continuity, financial reporting, platform performance, or operational effectiveness.

    • Strong knowledge on budgeting and forecasting process
    • Proven ownership of enterprise cloud and SaaS cost management, allocation, forecasting, recharge, optimisation and financial governance.
    • Experience with IBM Apptio, including Cloudability, TBM Studio, Planning and Recharge knowledge is advantageous.
    • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional programmes and internal transformation or continuous improvement portfolios.
    • Strong experience establishing portfolio governance, delivery controls, standards, executive reporting and management information.
    • Demonstrated ability to define KPIs and metrics and convert complex delivery data into clear leadership insight.
    • Experience working across globally distributed teams, vendors and delivery partners.
