job.title: SVP Product, Measurement
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and transformative SVP, Product to lead the critical capability area of Marketing Performance within the WPP Open platform. This is a truly unique opportunity to define the future of how WPP measures and attributes marketing effectiveness across our vast and diverse agency and client ecosystem. 

Leveraging WPP's pioneering agentic marketing platform, you will lead the development of best-in-class solutions that turn live signals into predictive intelligence, empower our agencies and clients to drive superior outcomes, and solidify WPP Open's competitive edge. Your mandate will extend beyond traditional paid media measurement, encompassing a holistic view of performance across the entire Paid, Earned, Shared, and Owned media spectrum. 

This role demands a leader who can not only set a compelling product vision, but also inspire and lead a multi-disciplinary team, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. You will directly contribute to achieving key WPP Open priorities, including driving profitability, maximizing strategic advantage, and delivering an integrated, intelligent experience for our users and clients. 

JOB PURPOSE 

The SVP Product, Measurement will be responsible for defining and executing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for all capabilities related to marketing measurement, attribution and reporting within the WPP Open platform. This includes the development of visualizations and user experiences to democratize and utilize campaign and performance data, and the development of advanced analytics capabilities to enable Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and Geo-experimentation.  Including the use of agentic tooling for automated analytics outputs and conversational data analytics. 

You will build, inspire, and mentor high-performing, 'full-stack' product teams comprising product managers, engineers, data scientists, UX/UI designers, and enablement specialists. A core part of your mandate will be to foster a culture of agility, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, making decisive progress over perfection in a fast-paced environment. 

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES

Strategic Product Vision & Leadership:

  • Define and champion the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Marketing Performance within WPP Open, ensuring seamless alignment with WPP's overarching business goals, strategic product drivers, and client needs. 
  • Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and client needs assessment, relentlessly pursuing truly differentiating products that provide a clear competitive advantage. 
  • Translate complex business problems and evolving client challenges into clear, actionable product requirements and features, with a strong emphasis on holistic performance measurement. 
  • Develop and execute a clear strategy for integrating, harmonizing, and evolving existing performance measurement and reporting products/features into a unified, AI-enabled WPP Open offering, moving from customization to configurability. 

 Product Leadership & Team Transformation:

  • Lead, inspire, and mentor high-performing, multi-disciplinary 'full-stack' teams (Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX/UI, Enablement specialists), fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
  • Set clear Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and performance metrics for the Marketing Performance product area and individual team members, ensuring product KPI metrics track adoption, impact, and performance. 
  • Cultivate an environment where innovation thrives, talent flourishes, and every team member is empowered to deliver their best work. 

 Commercial Acumen & Growth:

  • Own a significant operating and capital expenditure budget for the Marketing Performance product area, making critical decisions within the financial framework. 
  • In partnership with commercial teams, define and manage the product commercials for your portfolio, including pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, and profitability analysis, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. 
  • Demonstrate ruthless prioritization to maximize business value and achieve ambitious goals, continually identifying and addressing customer pain points and opportunities. 
  • Ensure maximized product investment impact by simplifying the product portfolio and rationalizing product priorities effectively. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:

job.title: Technical Security Governance Lead - Application Security
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring 

We are looking for a Lead Application Security Engineer to strengthen Secure Development across WPP. 

Working within TSG, you will partner with software engineers, architects and product teams to establish practical security guardrails, help teams build the capabilities needed to meet them, and develop technical assurance that demonstrates whether those controls remain effective. 

You will not own development pipelines, security tooling or software delivery. Instead, you will provide the technical leadership, evidence and challenge that helps engineering teams build security into the way they develop software and continuously improve their security practices. 

Success requires strong technical credibility with engineers, a practical understanding of modern software development, and the ability to influence technical outcomes without direct authority. 

The role sits within Technical Security Governance (TSG), reporting to the Director, Security Governance & Posture within the Group CISO organisation. 

 What you'll be doing 

  • Act as WPP’s technical lead for Application Security, providing senior judgement on Secure Development, assurance and software-security risk. 
  • Understand how software is designed, built, tested and released across WPP, identifying where common guardrails and engineering capabilities will most improve security. 
  • Define practical Secure Development guardrails across secure design, threat modelling, coding, dependencies, software supply chains, CI/CD, cloud-native and AI-enabled development. 
  • Work directly with software engineers, architects and product managers to help establish the security capabilities and practices needed to meet those guardrails. 
  • Develop technical assurance capabilities that continuously demonstrate whether Secure Development controls are present, operating and effective. 
  • Use engineering evidence, security tooling and targeted validation to identify gaps, challenge assumptions and drive meaningful improvement. 
  • Help engineering teams understand recurring weaknesses and improve their own ability to identify, prioritise and address software-security risk. 
  • Provide evidence and technical challenge where controls are ineffective or risks remain, while keeping implementation and remediation ownership with the teams responsible for the software. 
  • Continuously evolve WPP’s Secure Development approach as engineering practices, technologies and threats change. 
  • Own Application Security Risk Factors through their lifecycle, raising and documenting issues, advising teams on remediation, tracking progress and challenging where exposure is not being addressed effectively. 

What you'll need 

Essential criteria: 

  • Strong practical understanding of modern software development and how security fits across design, development, testing, CI/CD and release. 
  • Meaningful experience in Application Security, Product Security, DevSecOps or Secure Development, with enough technical depth to work credibly with software engineers and architects. 
  • Ability to translate security expectations into practical engineering guardrails that teams can understand and implement. 
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers and senior management. 
  • Sound technical judgement, balancing security outcomes with engineering constraints and knowing when to challenge and when different approaches can achieve the same outcome. 
  • Ability to lead through technical credibility, evidence and influence rather than direct authority. 

Nice to have: 

  • Previous hands-on experience in software development, software engineering, DevOps or a closely related engineering role; 5+ years would be particularly valuable. 
  • Experience establishing or improving Application Security, Secure Development or DevSecOps practices with engineering teams. 
  • Familiarity with common capabilities such as threat modelling, SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets detection, CI/CD security, API security or software-supply-chain controls. 
  • Experience using technology, automation or engineering evidence to provide security assurance at scale. 
  • Experience influencing technical decisions where security and delivery priorities compete. 
  • Security Champions, paved roads, developer enablement or similar experience. 
  • Cloud-native, SaaS or highly distributed application experience. 
  • AI-enabled application or AI-assisted development security experience. 
  • OWASP SAMM, ASVS, NIST SSDF, SLSA or similar frameworks.

job.title: Technical Security Governance Lead - Exposure Management
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

We are looking for a lead for Exposure Management to provide deep technical investigation of suspected security exposures across WPP's global technology estate. 

Working within TSG, this role will investigate vulnerabilities and attack opportunities across a highly diverse environment spanning cloud, infrastructure, operating systems, identity, applications, AI and emerging technologies. You will use modern security, exposure and adversarial-testing capabilities to understand whether weaknesses are genuinely exploitable, how they could combine into realistic attack paths, and which exposure deserves attention first. 

This is a hands-on technical role with enterprise-wide reach. You will investigate complex security questions, challenge assumptions with evidence, identify systemic patterns, and translate technical findings into clear priorities for the teams responsible for remediation. You will not own every fix. Your role is to establish technical reality, determine what matters, and direct attention towards the improvements that will most meaningfully reduce WPP's exposure. 

The role sits within Technical Security Governance (TSG), reporting to the Director, Security Governance & Posture within the Group CISO organisation. 

What you'll be doing:

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as WPP’s technical Principal for Exposure Management, providing senior technical judgement on attack paths and systemic exposure across the global technology environment.
  • Investigate suspected vulnerabilities across infrastructure, operating systems, identity, cloud, applications, data and AI.
  • Follow the evidence beyond the tool output, combining information from multiple sources to determine what is genuinely exploitable, how weaknesses connect, and what actually matters.
  • Assess attack paths and systemic exposure, maintaining enough perspective to distinguish significant enterprise risk from isolated or technically interesting findings.
  • Establish technical priorities for mitigation, helping teams focus effort on the exposures most likely to materially improve WPP's security posture.
  • Work with TSG specialists across Cloud, Identity, Data, Infrastructure, Application and AI to understand findings in context and develop technically credible recommendations for system owners.
  • Provide broad technical security expertise on complex security questions, technologies and protective approaches, including areas such as encryption, security tooling and emerging threats.
  • Support major security events where rapid technical investigation, exposure analysis and remediation prioritisation are required.
  • Continuously improve how WPP understands exposure, identifying recurring patterns, challenging assumptions and helping us get better at finding the problems that actually matter. 

What you'll need:

Essential: 

  • 5+ years of hands-on technical security experience, with meaningful practical experience investigating, defending or validating real enterprise technology.
  • Strong foundations across enterprise technology, such as networks, infrastructure, operating systems, identity, cloud, applications or security operations, with enough breadth to understand how weaknesses interact across domains.
  • Practical attacker and defender knowledge, with the ability to reason about vulnerabilities, exploitability, attack paths, defensive controls and realistic attack opportunities.
  • Strong investigative and critical-thinking skills, including the curiosity to challenge assumptions, question tool output and follow evidence until the underlying technical reality is understood.
  • The judgement to prioritise, knowing when to investigate deeply, when enough is known to act, and when an interesting technical issue is not the most important problem.
  • Professional English, sufficient to investigate, collaborate and communicate effectively across WPP's global technology and security organisation.
  • Ability to work primarily from WPP's São Paulo office as part of the wider security team. 

Desirable: 

  • Practical experience in one or more of Red Team, Blue Team, Purple Team, Vulnerability Management, Exposure Management, Security Engineering, Security Research, Vulnerability Research, adversarial validation or attack-path analysis.
  • Experience translating complex technical findings into clear priorities and recommendations that other technology teams can act on.
  • Experience working across multiple technology domains rather than remaining exclusively within a single technical specialism.
  • Experience operating with substantial autonomy, creating structure from ambiguity and maintaining perspective across competing technical problems.
  • Experience influencing technical outcomes through expertise, evidence and collaboration, rather than relying on direct authority.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work equally well with deep technical specialists and senior stakeholders.
  • 10+ years of broader IT or cybersecurity experience, ideally including earlier hands-on experience with enterprise infrastructure, networks, operating systems, applications or security operations.
  • Experience with enterprise vulnerability, attack-surface, exposure, BAS or security-posture platforms, particularly where multiple sources must be correlated to understand the real picture.
  • Experience investigating exposure across cloud, identity, applications, AI or agentic systems.
  • Experience supporting major incidents, urgent remediation programmes or complex technical investigations under time pressure.
  • Experience designing or improving technical security methodologies, processes, metrics or prioritisation approaches.
  • Relevant technical education or certifications. Practical experience and demonstrated technical judgement matter more than certification volume.

job.title: Technology GRC Analyst
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 Technology GRC Analyst
  • Department: Data & Technology Solutions (DTS)
  • Reports To: SVP Security and Compliance
  • Location: [London/Hybrid 2 days a week in office]
  • Position Type: Full-Time

Role Purpose

The GRC Technology Analyst is responsible for managing and continuously improving the Information Security Management System (ISMS) across Data & Technology Solutions. You will ensure that security policies, controls, risks, exceptions, and governance processes are properly maintained, evidenced, reviewed, and acted upon.

Reporting to the SVP Security and Compliance, you will provide the operational backbone for security governance across DTS. This is a hands-on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) role. You will collaborate across security, product, engineering, infrastructure, architecture, legal, risk, compliance, and delivery teams to transform security governance into a dynamic, working management system rather than a static documentation exercise.

Key Responsibilities

1. ISMS Ownership & Operation

  • Manage the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the DTS ISMS.
  • Maintain the ISMS framework, documentation, control library, policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Ensure the ISMS accurately reflects how DTS operates across products, platforms, infrastructure, data, and engineering.
  • Support alignment with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA (where applicable), and wider WPP security requirements.
  • Ensure ISMS artefacts are version-controlled, approved, reviewed, and communicated appropriately.
  • Maintain clear evidence of security governance activity, control operation, risk treatment, and management reviews.

2. Policy Management & Control Governance

  • Own the lifecycle of DTS security and compliance policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation.
  • Coordinate policy reviews with Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Technology stakeholders.
  • Ensure policies are practical, clear, enforceable, and aligned with DTS's operating reality.
  • Track policy exceptions, waivers, compensating controls, and review dates.
  • Ensure policy changes are communicated and seamlessly embedded into operational processes.

3. Risk Review Board Operation

  • Establish and continuously run the DTS Risk Review Board.
  • Define the Board’s cadence, agenda, inputs, outputs, attendees, and escalation routes.
  • Prepare comprehensive risk packs, dashboards, decision logs, and action trackers.
  • Ensure risks are presented clearly, consistently, and with appropriate supporting evidence.
  • Track decisions, owners, due dates, mitigations, exceptions, and residual risks.
  • Escalate risks exceeding agreed thresholds to the SVP Security and Compliance, DTS leadership, the CISO office, or other appropriate forums.

4. Risk Register Management

  • Own and maintain the central DTS security and compliance risk register.
  • Capture, assess, categorise, and maintain security, compliance, privacy, operational resilience, third-party, and technology risks.
  • Ensure all risks have clear descriptions, owners, likelihood/impact ratings, inherent risk scores, mitigations, residual risk scores, treatment plans, and target dates.
  • Partner with risk owners to ensure mitigations are realistic, funded, and actively progressed.
  • Track overdue risk actions and escalate insufficient progress.
  • Produce regular risk reporting for DTS leadership and wider WPP governance forums.

5. Control Assurance & Evidence Management

  • Support ongoing assurance activity by ensuring controls are consistently evidenced, tested, and reviewed.
  • Maintain control evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2, client assurance, internal audits, and other compliance needs.
  • Coordinate evidence collection from Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Product, HR, Legal, and Enterprise Technology.
  • Identify gaps between documented controls and actual operating practices, tracking remediation plans.

6. Compliance Support & Audit Readiness

  • Support DTS compliance obligations (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR-related controls, and client-specific requirements).
  • Help prepare for internal/external audits, client reviews, security questionnaires, and due diligence exercises.
  • Maintain an organized, always-ready evidence library and audit trail.
  • Support management reviews required by ISO 27001 and other governance frameworks.

7. Exception, Waiver & Remediation Tracking

  • Manage the formal process for security exceptions, policy waivers, risk acceptances, and remediation plans.
  • Ensure exceptions are documented, reviewed, approved, time-bound, and assigned to accountable owners.
  • Track compensating controls, monitor residual risk, and manage the renewal/escalation of expired exceptions.

8. Third-Party & Supplier Risk Support

  • Help assess security and compliance risks associated with vendors, partners, tools, platforms, and managed services.
  • Maintain supplier risk records and coordinate with Procurement, Legal, CISO, Enterprise Technology, and Product teams.
  • Ensure third-party risk is appropriately integrated into the DTS risk register and Risk Review Board.

9. Security Governance Reporting

  • Produce clear, reliable, and actionable governance dashboards and reports for the SVP Security and Compliance and DTS leadership.
  • Translate complex governance and technical data into clear business language, highlighting trends, overdue actions, and material risks.

10. Stakeholder Engagement & Culture

  • Foster a collaborative and practical security governance culture across DTS.
  • Coach risk owners on how to describe, assess, treat, and monitor risks.
  • Ensure risk processes support business delivery rather than becoming bureaucratic overhead.

Key Accountabilities

The ISMS and Risk Officer will be directly accountable for:

  • Effective operation, accuracy, and maintenance of the DTS Senior Technology Risk Analyst.
  • Continuous, disciplined operation of the DTS Risk Review Board.
  • Up-to-date, approved, and realistic security policies, standards, and control documentation.
  • Structured tracking of risks, exceptions, waivers, and remediation plans.
  • Audit-ready evidence management and reliable governance reporting to leadership.

Skills & Experience

Required:

  • Proven experience in information security governance, risk management, compliance, audit, or ISMS operation.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001 and practical ISMS management.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, cloud security, SaaS platforms, and enterprise security controls.
  • Experience maintaining risk registers, policy frameworks, control libraries, and audit evidence repositories.
  • Experience running or supporting risk committees, governance forums, or control review boards.
  • Excellent technical writing skills (policies, standards, risk statements, and governance reports).
  • Ability to collaborate with technical teams and translate technical issues into business risk/compliance language.
  • Strong organizational skills, high attention to detail, and a constructive yet persistent approach to driving action.

Preferred:

  • Experience operating within a complex, matrixed, enterprise environment is highly valued.

Leadership Expectations

  • Disciplined & Reliable: Bring structure, order, and high standards of documentation to risk and compliance processes.
  • Pragmatic & Delivery-Aware: Build trust with technical teams by making governance useful, proportionate, and aligned with delivery.
  • Proactive: Follow through persistently on actions, dates, and evidence, and escalate bottlenecks clearly.
  • Collaborative: Support the SVP Security and Compliance in building a mature, transparent, and well-governed security function.

Success Measures

  • A current, well-maintained DTS ISMS with zero "reactive" compliance rushes.
  • Security policies and standards reviewed, updated, and communicated on schedule.
  • The Risk Review Board operating systematically with clear actions and high leadership engagement.
  • DTS risk register actively used by leadership to drive risk-based decisions.
  • Audit and certification evidence organized so there are "fewer surprises" during external audits and client reviews.
  • Security governance fully embedded as a natural part of daily DTS operations.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

Lead the end-to-end Business Support function for WPP Production, ensuring reliable 24/7 support across front-line application support, client-facing digital support and technology service management. The role owns the support operating model from initial demand and L1 triage through L2 service ownership and escalation to L3 engineering, vendors or managed service providers. It is accountable for establishing, maturing and owning the Service Introduction capability, alongside service governance, operational readiness and acceptance, platform stability, stakeholder communication and continual improvement. Working side by side with Product, Engineering and DevSecOps, the role will address the current Service Introduction capability gap by creating a consistent, proportionate and risk-based approach through which frequent product change, major releases and increasingly complex integrations transition efficiently into BAU support. The role also provides governance and performance oversight for managed service providers, including alignment of service-introduction and acceptance requirements.

What you'll be doing:

KRA 1: Service Leadership and Operational Performance
• Set and lead the 24/7 support strategy, service model and operating structure across retained and managed service teams, with clear escalation routes to L3 engineering and suppliers.
• Ensure demand received through service management channels is understood, categorised, prioritised, resolved or routed appropriately, with clear ownership and communication through to closure.
• Maintain a responsive, SLA-driven service for internal teams and client agencies, minimising disruption and ensuring support interactions are clear, structured and professional.

KRA 2: Service Introduction, Transition and Operational Readiness
• Establish, mature and own the Service Introduction and support-acceptance capability for new and changed services, addressing the current capability gap and ensuring changes transition efficiently into BAU support.
• Design, implement and continuously improve proportionate, risk-based Service Introduction and operational-readiness criteria for incremental product change, major releases, new platforms and complex integrations.
• Work with Product, Engineering, DevSecOps, delivery teams and service providers early in the lifecycle so support requirements, dependencies, monitoring, documentation, knowledge transfer and escalation models are established before release.
• Ensure service-introduction and operational-readiness requirements align with the acceptance standards of relevant managed service providers, including Kyndryl where applicable.
• Establish clear ownership and support models for end-to-end integrations that span applications, engineering teams, suppliers and service providers.

KRA 3: Service Governance, Stability and Risk
• Define and maintain service governance, support structures, change enablement, path-to-production and regular service reviews, with clear boundaries between delivery ownership and support acceptance.
• Safeguard the health, reliability, scalability and long-term stability of business-critical workflow, production and digital platforms through monitoring, maintenance, upgrades and production control.
• Ensure releases and changes are operationally ready and followed by appropriate validation and service-health checks.
• Ensure appropriate processes for user access, permissions, password resets and application licence administration, including coordination with service providers where required.

KRA 4: Incident, Problem and Escalation Management
• Provide senior oversight for major or complex incidents; ensure timely escalation from L1 to L2 and onward to L3 engineering or suppliers, with effective stakeholder updates.
• Drive proactive Problem Management, recurring-incident reduction, root-cause analysis and follow-through of corrective actions.

KRA 5: Managed Service Provider and Supplier Management
• Govern managed service providers and key support suppliers, ensuring clear operational interfaces, performance management, escalation, service reviews and continuous improvement.
• Ensure retained and outsourced support teams operate as an effective end-to-end service and that provider acceptance requirements are integrated into Service Introduction.

KRA 6: Continuous Improvement and Service Performance
• Drive process optimisation, automation, documentation, reporting and system improvements that increase service quality, efficiency and operational resilience.
• Establish measures for both BAU service performance and the maturity and effectiveness of Service Introduction, including transition quality, operational readiness and avoidable post-release support issues.

KRA 7: People Leadership
• Lead and develop the three managers and their distributed teams, building clear accountability, capability, succession and effective collaboration across support levels and service providers.

KRA 8: Commercial and Financial Management
• Oversee platform cost management, purchase orders and invoices, and support Enterprise Technology budget and forecasting activity for the agencies, subject to agreed ownership.
• Support effective commercial and performance governance of managed service providers and suppliers.

KRA 9: Cross-functional Alignment
• Work alongside Product, Engineering, DevSecOps, Finance, delivery teams, managed service providers, vendors and business stakeholders so supportability is designed in early, operational risks are identified and operational needs are represented in delivery decisions.

What you'll need:

Qualification Requirements (Desirable)

  • A degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, service management, business systems or a related discipline.
  •  ITIL or comparable service-management qualification is desirable, supported by strong practical knowledge of incident, request, problem, change enablement, release, Service Introduction, operational readiness and service-review disciplines.
  • Leadership or management experience is desirable for leading multi-team, distributed support functions.
  • Experience (desirable) with Serval
  • Training or certification in supplier, managed service, project, change or risk management would be advantageous.

Skills / Experience Requirements

  • Proven leadership of multi-team, distributed 24/7 support or service-management functions in a business-critical environment.
  • Strong practical experience of establishing or maturing Service Introduction and operational-readiness capabilities, and transitioning product and engineering change into BAU support within an Agile delivery environment.
  • Ability to establish proportionate service-acceptance controls appropriate to the risk, complexity and scale of change.
  • Strong practical knowledge of incident, request, problem, change enablement, release and service-review disciplines.
  • Experience governing managed service providers, including service performance, operational interfaces, escalation, acceptance requirements and continuous improvement.
  • Credibility across enterprise applications, workflow and production platforms, digital products, complex integrations, environments and support escalation models.
  • Ability to influence senior business, Product, Engineering, DevSecOps, Finance, delivery and supplier stakeholders and translate competing needs into clear priorities.
  • Strong analytical and risk-based decision-making, calm incident leadership and a focus on sustainable root-cause resolution.
  • Experience supporting budgets, forecasts, platform costs, licences, purchase orders, invoices and supplier performance.
  • Clear, concise and confident communication with technical and non-technical audiences, including during incidents and service change.
  • Previous experience of building or maturing service-management capabilities and improving support performance through process design, automation, reporting, documentation and capability development.
  • Experience leading large-scale, enterprise-wide technology transformation, including M365 tenant consolidation, identity and access management, application remediation, migration governance and complex stakeholder/change management across multiple businesses.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

JOB OVERVIEW

The Business Consulting Director is a senior consulting leader responsible for leading global branding and global marketing consulting for Japan's leading B2B corporations. As a core member of VOJ's Business Consulting practice, you will own the full engagement lifecycle — from originating new client relationships and structuring complex business challenges, to developing strategy and directing creative development — ensuring that brand thinking translates into tangible business value on a global stage. Working in English with overseas offices and global client stakeholders, you will design and facilitate cross-functional workshops, lead multiple engagements in parallel, and serve as the bridge between client leadership and our creative teams. This role combines consulting rigor, a deep understanding of global B2B business, and a genuine appreciation for creativity, contributing directly to the global brand value and business growth of our clients.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Business Development & Client Growth
  • New Client Acquisition: Proactively identify, approach, and develop new client opportunities, leading the strategic development of proposals and pitches for major Japanese B2B corporations.
  • Proposal Development: Create compelling, well-structured proposals and planning documents that clearly articulate client challenges, recommended approaches, and expected business outcomes.
  • Trusted Client Partnership: Build deep, trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, positioning VOJ as a long-term business partner in their global brand and marketing agenda.
  1. Global Branding & Marketing Consulting
  • Issue Structuring: Diagnose and structure clients' business and brand challenges, translating complex, multi-stakeholder situations into clear problem definitions and priorities.
  • Strategy Development: Lead the development of global brand strategies, positioning, and marketing strategies that support clients' international business growth.
  • B2B Business Insight: Apply a strong understanding of global B2B business models, buying processes, and decision-making to ensure recommendations drive measurable business value.

III. Workshop Facilitation & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Workshop Design & Facilitation: Plan and facilitate high-impact client workshops that bring together multiple departments, driving alignment, consensus, and co-creation of solutions.
  • Cross-Departmental Coordination: Align diverse client stakeholders and internal agency teams around shared objectives, managing differing interests and building momentum toward decisions.
  • Global Communication: Communicate effectively in English with overseas offices, global clients, and the wider network, including meetings, presentations, and English-language proposals.
  1. Creative Direction & Integrated Delivery
  • Creative Briefing: Write clear, incisive creative briefs that translate consulting outputs into inspiring direction for creative teams.
  • Creative Collaboration: Engage actively in discussions with creative teams, providing strategic input to idea development and evaluating creative work with constructive feedback.
  • Strategic Consistency: Ensure that creative and communication output remains grounded in the agreed brand and marketing strategy and business objectives from concept through execution.
  1. Engagement Management & Practice Contribution
  • Multi-Project Leadership: Lead multiple consulting engagements in parallel, managing scope, timelines, resources, and quality to maximize client value.
  • AI-Enabled Ways of Working: Actively leverage generative AI and other AI tools to enhance the speed, depth, and quality of research, analysis, and deliverables.
  • Practice Development: Contribute to the growth of the Business Consulting practice by sharing knowledge, refining consulting methodologies, and supporting colleagues.

SKILLS and QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience in brand consulting, marketing strategy, or a related field, including hands-on experience in global B2B business.
  • Branding & Marketing Knowledge: Solid foundational knowledge of marketing and branding principles, and the ability to apply them to complex B2B business challenges.
  • Business-Level English: Ability to lead meetings and presentations, read English-language materials, and write proposals in English.
  • Workshop Facilitation: Proven ability to facilitate workshops involving multiple departments and stakeholders, driving productive discussion and alignment.
  • Creative Understanding: A sound understanding of creativity, with the ability to write creative briefs and to evaluate and give feedback on creative ideas.
  • Multi-Tasking: Ability to drive multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Digital & AI Proficiency: Practical, day-to-day proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word, and the ability to make effective use of generative AI and other AI tools in daily work.
  • Preferred Background: Experience at a global agency, brand consulting firm, or consulting firm, or in a B2B company (e.g., marketing, brand, or corporate planning functions). Basic knowledge of and experience with CRM is a plus.
  • Personal Attributes: A constant drive to take on new challenges; a passion for engaging deeply with clients' business issues and solving them through the power of brand and creativity; and self-driven leadership in a fast-changing environment.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Workday HCM Product Delivery Lead (12-month FTC)

 

Why we're hiring

WPP is undertaking a major global People Technology transformation to deploy Workday HCM across the organisation, simplifying the People landscape, improving data consistency, strengthening core People capabilities, and enabling scalable adoption of AI- and data-led insights.

The move from multiple local HR systems to a centrally governed global platform represents a significant shift in ways of working across markets, functions, and agencies.

The Product Lead – People Technology (Workday) is responsible for leading the delivery and evolution of key People capabilities through Workday. The role will partner with senior business leaders, HR Centres of Excellence, People Technology and external partners to define product strategy, future-state processes and priorities, and drive technology-enabled transformation across Recruitment, Total Rewards, Performance Management, Learning and other talent-related functions.

This individual will act as both a Product Lead and transformation delivery leader, translating business needs into a clear product roadmap and partnering with technology to deliver scalable, sustainable Workday solutions that deliver measurable organisational outcomes.

What you'll be doing

Product Leadership & Transformation

  • Own and drive the product vision, roadmap and priorities for key People capabilities delivered through Workday.
  • Lead the transformation of People functions through the effective use of Workday and supporting technologies.
  • Partner with HR and business leaders to understand business needs and define future-state processes and product requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into clear product priorities, capabilities and delivery outcomes.
  • Drive standardisation, simplification and optimisation of People processes across global markets.
  • Challenge existing ways of working and identify opportunities to improve employee and manager experiences.
  • Facilitate strategic workshops and design sessions with executive and senior stakeholders to align on vision, scope, priorities and outcomes.
  • Balance business priorities, user needs, Workday capabilities and delivery constraints when shaping the product roadmap.

Workday Product & Delivery Leadership

Lead the end-to-end delivery and evolution of Workday capabilities across:

  • Workday Recruiting
  • Workday Learning
  • Workday Performance Management
  • Workday Compensation and Total Rewards
  • Workday Talent and Succession (desirable)
  • Ensure solutions align with business requirements, industry best practices and Workday capabilities.
  • Own requirements and priorities, working with functional and technical teams to translate these into scalable Workday solutions.
  • Partner with Technology to influence solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, change management and hypercare.
  • Manage product enhancements and continuous improvement following implementation.
  • Collaborate with implementation partners, Workday specialists and internal delivery teams to ensure successful outcomes.

Roadmap & Programme Delivery

  • Develop and maintain product roadmaps aligned with People strategy and business priorities.
  • Manage complex transformation initiatives from inception through delivery.
  • Prioritise initiatives and requirements based on business value, user impact, dependencies and delivery feasibility.
  • Establish delivery roadmaps, governance structures, budgets and resource plans.
  • Track milestones, risks, dependencies and issues, ensuring timely escalation where appropriate.
  • Provide regular product and delivery updates to programme sponsors and executive stakeholders.
  • Drive accountability across multiple workstreams, delivery teams and vendors.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong relationships with senior HR, People Technology, Finance and business leaders.
  • Act as a key connector between People COEs, technology teams and delivery partners.
  • Influence product and investment decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear communication.
  • Facilitate steering committees, design workshops, leadership reviews and governance forums.
  • Manage conflicting priorities and drive alignment across global stakeholder groups.

Change, Adoption & Product Outcomes

  • Ensure organisational readiness for new People processes and Workday capabilities.
  • Partner with Change Management and Communications teams to support adoption and engagement.
  • Develop transition plans and support business teams through change.
  • Monitor product adoption, utilisation and user experience.
  • Use feedback, adoption data and business outcomes to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Measure and report on product performance and the value delivered through Workday.

What you'll need

  • Significant experience leading large-scale HR technology, product or transformation programmes.
  • Strong experience operating as a Product Lead, Product Owner, Workday Delivery Lead, Transformation Lead or similar role within a complex enterprise environment.
  • Proven delivery experience across multiple Workday modules, particularly:
    • Recruiting
    • Total Rewards / Compensation
    • Performance Management
  • Strong understanding of Talent, Learning, Performance and Reward operating models.
  • Experience developing product or technology roadmaps and translating business requirements into prioritised delivery plans.
  • Experience managing global implementations across multiple regions and stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated success facilitating workshops and influencing senior executives.
  • Experience working with system integrators, consulting partners and third-party vendors.
  • Strong programme and project delivery expertise with a track record of delivering complex initiatives successfully.
  • Ability to balance product strategy, business requirements and delivery execution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Product, Agile or project management certification such as Scrum Product Owner, Agile, PMP or PRINCE2 desirable.
  • Workday certification or extensive Workday implementation experience preferred.

job.title: WPP Production | Freelance Print Production Manager
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 


ポジション概要
本ポジションは、当社の最重要クライアントのビジネス目標達成を支援するため、世界水準のコミュニケ ーション制作を高い品質で開発・実行する役割です。勤務地は東京です。 プリント・プロダクションマネージャーは、さまざまな素材に印刷する制作物について、優れたプロジェ クトマネジメントスキルを活かし、制作スケジュールを管理します。対象となる制作物には、パッケージ 、各種販促物、店舗ウィンドウおよび店内グラフィック、イベント用グラフィック、サイネージ、ギフト カード、プレミアム・販促品などが含まれます。 候補者には、高い色彩分析力に加え、プリプレス、大判・小判のオフセット印刷、各種加工技術に関する 幅広い知識が求められます。また、デジタル媒体および写真媒体の制作経験と、現場での施工・設置作業 を監督した経験が必要です。

主な業務内容
• 印刷案件を管理し、サプライヤーへ適切なブリーフィングを行います。必要に応じて、印刷管理業務 を外部のプロダクションエージェンシーへ委託します。
• 色校正、カラーマネジメント、印刷工程においてサプライヤーを監督します。これには、印刷現場お よび製本現場での確認、加工、品質管理、キット内容の抜き取り確認が含まれます。キットの梱包お よびフルフィルメントに最適な方法を提案し、定期的にフルフィルメント現場を訪問します。
• 外部のプロダクションエージェンシーが上記サービスを提供する場合、その業務を監督します。 • 他チームと密接に連携し、エージェンシーおよびサプライヤーが制作仕様とスケジュールを厳格に遵 守していることを確認します。
• 色に関するガイダンスを提供し、品質管理に最適な方法について助言します。
• 外部ビジネスパートナーとともに印刷現場に立ち会い、必要に応じて品質や使用素材の観点から納品 物を最適化します。 • すべてのプロジェクトについて、制作状況をクライアントへ随時報告します。 

応募要件
• 大学卒業資格を有し、広告代理店または企業内のグラフィックデザイン部門において、4～6 年の印刷 制作経験があること。
• 主体性があり、高い整理・管理能力を備えていること。複数の業務を同時に進めることに優れ、プレ ッシャーのある状況でも落ち着いて対応し、チームの一員として効果的に働けること。
• Adobe Creative Suite の使用経験があれば望ましいですが、必須ではありません。
 • 業務上必要な出張に対応できること。

このポジションで重視される専門性
• 印刷制作における進行管理、スケジュール管理、サプライヤーおよび外部エージェンシーのマネジメ ント
• プリプレス、オフセット印刷、大判・小判印刷、製本・表面加工・仕上げ工程に関する実務知識
• 色校正、カラーマネジメント、品質管理、印刷立ち会いに関する専門性
• 店舗・イベント向けグラフィックやサイネージなどの現場施工・設置監督経験


WPP Productionについて

私たちWPP Productionは、WPPグループ内のあらゆるコンテンツプロデューサー、スタジオ、そして制作（クラフト）の専門家を結集し、ひとつの繋がった組織として統合されたグローバル・プロダクション・カンパニーです。

世界最高峰の人間によるクラフトマンシップ（熟練した制作技術）と次世代テクノロジーを融合させ、大規模なマルチチャネル・コンテンツシステムを企画・デザインし、世界へと届けています。

job.title: Analyst, Newsroom Data
job.description:
Job Description:


WSJ Newsroom | Data Analyst (September 2026)

Title: Data Analyst, Newsroom Analytics

The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Data Analyst to join our newsroom data team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Analytics. You will work alongside our senior analysts to produce the reports, dashboards, and analyses the newsroom relies on to make editorial, audience, and product decisions every day.

This role is a chance to build real analytical range in a fast-moving newsroom environment. You will spend most of your time in SQL, pulling data, building and maintaining dashboards, and helping the newsroom get answers quickly. You will use AI tools to accelerate this work, building lightweight utilities and automations that improve efficiency across the team and free up time for deeper analysis. You will collaborate closely with more senior colleagues as you take on progressively more independent work, from ad hoc analyses to experiment analysis and measurement projects.

This position will be based in our New York office.

You will:

  • Write SQL to answer questions from newsroom editorial, audience, and product partners, translating requests into clean, well-scoped queries and clearly communicated results.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports that expand self-serve access to newsroom data.

  • Support deep-dive analyses on major news events, high-priority moments, and shifts in performance.

  • Help keep the reporting stack reliable by troubleshooting data quality issues, tracing problems back to their source, and partnering with data engineering to resolve them.

  • Contribute to A/B tests and experiment analysis in partnership with senior analysts, growing into independent experiment ownership over time.

  • Learn the newsroom's taxonomies, instrumentation, and foundational datasets, and help maintain shared documentation and analytical patterns the team pulls from.

You have:

  • 1 to 2 years in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, or an equivalent internship and project background.

  • Proficient SQL skills, with experience writing queries against non-trivial datasets.

  • Comfort with a modern BI or dashboarding tool (Looker, Tableau, Mode, or similar).

  • Curiosity and speed in picking up new technical concepts and frameworks, and a track record of getting productive on unfamiliar stacks.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical partners.

  • Care for accuracy and detail in work the newsroom will act on.

Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more of the following:

  • Experience with large-scale data warehouses like BigQuery or Snowflake, or with dbt.

  • Familiarity with Python for analysis, data wrangling, or automation, and comfort maintaining code in Git.

  • Exposure to A/B testing and applied statistics.

  • A background or strong interest in journalism, media, or content, and enthusiasm for driving journalistic outcomes.

  • Comfort using AI/LLM tooling to speed up analytical workflows.

job.title: Associate Director - Aromatics Research & Analysis
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

As Associate Director - Aromatics Research & Analysis, you will be covering market research and analysis of the Aromatics markets across the Americas. You will be responsible for leading our North American Paraxylene (PX) and Purified Terephthalic Acid (PTA) research services. You will direct market analysis, supply/demand modeling, and price forecasting to deliver actionable insights to subscribers across the refining and polyester value chains. You will report to the Executive Director - Market Research. 



You Will:
  • Serve as the primary regional subject matter expert for North, Central, and South American PX and PTA value chains, converting market knowledge into high-value analysis and research
  • Construct and maintain robust short-term and long-term supply/demand models, capacity databases, quarterly balances, and World Analysis outlooks in coordination with the global aromatics and intermediates teams
  • Provide regular weekly and monthly market updates and analysis to clients through Market Advisory services
  • Maintain econometric production cost models to determine cash costs, operating margins, and price forecasts across primary product lines
  • Actively expand client relationships and market exposure through routine client briefings, industry association engagement, and executive presentations at conferences and webinars
  • Partner with commercial teams to proactively market World Analysis and Market Advisory services, meeting annual subscription growth targets
  • Delivers subject matter expertise and tailored analytical support to the Bespoke Research Single-Client Consulting group for single-client advisory projects



You Have:
  • At least 10 years’ extensive technical or commercial experience in the petrochemical or refining industry - with a focus on reforming, xylenes, or polyester products
  • Deep understanding of global and regional aromatics, refining and polyester market drivers, commercial contract structures, production economics, and cross-regional trade flows
  • Demonstrated track record in managing supply/demand balances, econometric cost modeling, and commercial price forecasting
  • Established, broad network of contacts across the North American petrochemical industry
  • Strong track record in quantitative analysis, econometric modeling, price forecasting
  • Public speaking skills with proven presentation skills before client and industry groups
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally
  • Familiarity with VBA, Python, or data visualization tools such as Tableau and PowerBI (a plus)
  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, business or technical discipline -OR- an MBA or relevant advanced degree (a plus) -OR- equivalent work experience

job.title: Client Director
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role

The Client Director is responsible for driving revenue growth and building strategic client relationships within the Financial Services sector by representing the full portfolio of Dow Jones media, marketing, and advertising solutions. This role requires a consultative seller with deep category knowledge, strong executive presence, and a track record of developing integrated, multi-platform partnerships that deliver measurable client value.

Leveraging expertise in media sales, advertising, client leadership, and business development, the Client Director will create and execute strategic account plans, identify and convert new business opportunities, and expand existing partnerships across digital, print, custom content, video, podcasts, live events, and other brand and media solutions. The role is accountable for meeting and exceeding revenue goals, maintaining accurate forecasts, and building long-term client relationships that drive retention, growth, and advocacy.


Success in this role will be defined by the ability to grow revenue within the Financial Services category, build durable executive-level client relationships, deliver strategic and innovative solutions, maintain a strong and accurate pipeline, and help position Dow Jones as a market-leading partner for media, marketing, and business intelligence solutions.

This role reports to the VP, Sales and supports the Financial Services category.



You Will:

  • Own a portfolio of Financial Services clients and agencies, with responsibility for revenue growth across new business, renewals, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Develop and execute strategic account and relationship plans that position Dow Jones as a preferred media and marketing partner.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client and agency stakeholders, including C-level, marketing, brand, and business leaders.
  • Lead consultative sales conversations by identifying client objectives, understanding business challenges, and aligning Dow Jones solutions to deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Create and sell integrated marketing programs across Dow Jones brands and platforms, including digital, print, custom content, events, video, podcasts, and other high-impact solutions.
  • Partner closely with internal sector, strategy, marketing, insights, editorial, events, and solutions teams to develop compelling proposals, presentations, and partnership recommendations in a timely manner.
  • Maintain strong pipeline discipline and forecasting accuracy in Salesforce and other sales tools, with clear visibility into revenue performance and opportunity progression.
  • Demonstrate strong negotiation and deal leadership skills to close complex media partnerships with significant annual revenue impact.
  • Stay current on Financial Services industry trends, competitive activity, media innovation, and client priorities in order to proactively identify new opportunities.
  • Represent Dow Jones externally at client meetings, industry events, and thought leadership forums as needed.
  • Use AI-enabled tools and data-driven insights to improve prospecting, account planning, proposal development, workflow efficiency, and client solutioning.

You Have:

  • 10+ years of client-facing sales experience required, with strong preference for media, advertising, sponsorship, marketing solutions, or consultative sales experience.
  • Deep Financial Services sector experience and understanding required, including familiarity with key subsectors such as banking, wealth management, asset management, fintech, payments, and insurance.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets and closing complex, multi-platform deals.
  • Demonstrated success developing senior-level client relationships and influencing executive stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of the digital media landscape, integrated marketing solutions, and evolving client expectations around measurement, audience strategy, and performance.
  • Experience using AI tools productively and responsibly in sales environments, including research, planning, content development, and workflow optimization.​​Excellent presentation, communication, and storytelling skills in both one-on-one and group settings.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally to deliver best-in-class client solutions.
  • Superior negotiation, organizational, and account management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and related sales productivity tools.

job.title: Client Success Manager
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Our team brings together the capabilities to position, commercialize, and grow Dow Jones’s B2B and enterprise portfolio. We translate customer needs, audience insight, and market intelligence into product strategy, clear value propositions, differentiated positioning, and relevant product and content experiences.


We enable commercial performance through sales operations, go-to-market enablement, and cross-functional coordination. We also help drive client outcomes across onboarding, adoption, engagement, and retention. Working in close partnership with Product, Editorial, Sales, and Client Success, we ensure Dow Jones’s enterprise solutions are compelling in the market, equipped for commercial success, and deliver sustained value to clients.


About the Role

We are seeking a Client Success Manager to support the post-sale client journey for assigned new business accounts from signed deal through launch, activation, early adoption, and handoff into ongoing account management. This role sits within Client Success and serves as the day-to-day point of contact for a portfolio of standard accounts. The Client Success Manager works closely with Client Success Managers, Sales, Regional Sales Coordinators, Operations, Engagement, Customer Care, and Account Management partners.


The objective of the role is to deliver a consistent, high-quality onboarding experience at scale by reducing friction, accelerating time to value, flagging risk early, and making sure clients are connected to the right resources.


The Client Success Manager owns onboarding and early adoption execution for a portfolio of standard accounts and supports Client Success Managers on larger or more complex launches. This role follows established playbooks and success milestones to keep launches on track, and escalates to the Director of Client Success when an account needs more strategic or specialized support.


This role does not carry a direct revenue quota, renewal target, or quota-carrying expansion responsibility. Success is measured by how effectively clients launch, activate, adopt key products and workflows, engage early, and transition cleanly into ongoing account management.


You Will:

  • Serve as the primary post-sale point of contact for assigned standard accounts from signed deal through onboarding and early adoption.
  • Participate in the handoff from Sales and document client goals, use cases, stakeholders, and launch priorities in CRM.
  • Execute structured 60 to 90 day onboarding milestones and success plans using established templates, so clients know what success looks like and achieve early wins quickly.
  • Maintain regular, proactive communication with clients and internal stakeholders to keep launches on schedule.
  • Partner with Client Success Managers on strategic, complex, or multi-stakeholder launches, owning assigned workstreams such as user provisioning tracking, training scheduling, and status reporting.
  • Prepare launch materials, meeting agendas, recap notes, and action trackers to keep cross-functional teams aligned.
  • Work with Regional Sales Coordinators to track sales order processing, account setup, account changes, billing requirements, and CRM updates through to completion.
  • Work with Operations and Fulfillment teams to confirm provisioning, entitlements, and technical readiness ahead of launch.
  • Follow up on open items and escalate operational blockers to the Director of Client Success.
  • Deliver standard onboarding and product training sessions using playbooks, success milestones, and training guidance.
  • Make sure clients understand how to get started, what steps are required for activation, and how to build early product usage habits.
  • Recognize when a client needs more specialized support and escalate to the Director of Client Success.
  • Connect clients to the right communications, campaigns, webinars, and enablement programs from Engagement Strategy & Performance and Customer Lifecycle Marketing.
  • Use engagement reporting, health signals, and recommended plays to prioritize outreach across the portfolio.
  • Monitor usage, activation milestones, and health signals across assigned accounts to spot stalled onboarding, weak adoption, or early churn risk.
  • Flag risks promptly to the Director of Client Success with context and recommended next steps.
  • Log and route client issues to Customer Care and follow through to resolution.
  • Document client feedback, pain points, and feature requests, and share recurring themes with Client Success Managers and Client Success leadership.
  • Prepare handoff documentation covering account context, progress, risks, stakeholders, and adoption status so Account Managers can continue without losing momentum.

Cross-Functional Partnerships

The Client Success Manager will work closely with:

  • Client Success Managers for collaboration on complex or strategic launches.
  • Sales Account Executives for post-sale handoff and account context.
  • Regional Sales Coordinators for order processing, account setup, account changes, and billing coordination.
  • Operations and Fulfillment for provisioning, entitlements, and technical readiness.
  • Engagement Strategy & Performance and Customer Lifecycle Marketing for health monitoring, engagement plays, and in-life programs.
  • Enterprise Customer Care & Voice of Customer for issue resolution, escalations, and feedback loops.
  • Account Managers for transition planning and relationship continuity.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in client success, onboarding, implementation, account coordination, customer engagement, or related post-sale roles in a B2B, SaaS, media, or subscription-based environment.
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts at once while keeping timelines and commitments on track.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to follow structured playbooks and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort leading client calls and training sessions.
  • Working knowledge of CRM and customer success tools, and comfort using data, reporting, and health indicators to monitor adoption and flag risk.
  • Sound judgment about when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate.
  • A proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented approach to client coordination.
  • A strong client-first mindset and a passion for helping clients realize value through usage, adoption, and engagement.

  • Paid Time Off

job.title: Consulting Senior Analyst I
job.description:
Job Description:

About the Team:


Dow Jones Energy enables energy and chemical stakeholders around the global to improve operational efficiency and make strategic decisions with deep insights, future outlooks, price discovery and consultation from a celebrated team of subject matter experts. We offer short- and long-term
market coverage for more than 200 core building-block chemicals with a full suite of advisory services and top-tier events held around the globe. Our bespoke consulting team has experience from upstream oil, gas, and minerals operations to chemicals, plastics and downstream end-use markets.
This rich expertise equips us with a deep understanding of the industry’s most significant challenges, allowing us to collaborate closely and deliver the best solution that fits the needs of our clients. The worldwide chemical and energy industry looks to Dow Jones Energy to guide decisions and help manage risk across the entire value chain.


Job Summary:


The Consulting Senior Analyst I will be a key contributor to our consulting practice, bringing expertise in the energy and chemical sectors to deliver insightful market analysis and strategic advice to our clients. Projects will revolve around multiple business lines including energy, feedstocks, olefins,
plastics, aromatics, inorganics, syngas, and other materials. This position requires experienced graduates with a strong background in analytics and market consultancy. The position is based at our New Delhi office and will require working closely with our global team on a regular basis.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct comprehensive research and analysis for consulting projects.
  • Review and analyse market and pricing data from Dow Jones Energy’s internal databases and publications and carry out secondary / desk research as required.
  • Apply deep knowledge of the energy/petrochemical/chemical sector to deliver commercial and techno-economic recommendations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional consulting and research teams to drive project success.
  • Act as a key team member and lead execution of project specific tasks, ensuring timely delivery and client satisfaction.
  • Assist in preparation of project proposals for the clients.
  • Utilize understanding and expertise in the energy/petrochemical/chemical sector to provide commercial or technoeconomic insights to the consulting projects.
  • Contribute to team discussions on various consulting projects as a knowledgeable stakeholder.

Qualifications:

  • B.Sc./B.Eng./B.Tech. degree in chemical engineering or chemistry, or equivalent experience
  • A postgraduate degree in science or business management will be considered as an advantage.

Experience:


  • At least 2 years of experience in a commercial or techno-economic role in the energy, refining or petrochemical industry or within energy/refining/petrochemical market consultancy is required.
  • Broad understanding of the energy and petrochemicals business, the structure of industry, the production technologies, and economic aspects such as energy and chemical markets and pricing is desirable.
  • Proven track record of analytics and market consultancy work is essential.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to conduct thorough research and analysis.
  • Good command of the English language in written and spoken forms.
  • Experience in writing analytical reports is desirable.
  • Excellent communication skills for effective client interaction and team collaboration.
  • Additional language skills are a plus.
  • Proficiency in MS Office suite of programs.

job.title: Director - Chemical Research & Analysis, Resins Markets (Americas)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

As ​​Director - Chemical Research & Analysis, Resins Markets (Americas), you will lead the Global Engineering Resins Market Advisory Service and be responsible for developing and supporting the Chemical Market Analytics resins practice in the Americas by providing market research and insights relative to the polyethylene and polypropylene markets. You will provide thought leadership relating to supply, demand, price, and economics, as well as competitive dynamics and changing industry structural elements. You will serve as a key external interface for these markets and provide coordination with relevant internal functions. You will report directly to the Head of Plastics.



You Will:
  • Complete primary research and analysis for the Americas resins markets 
  • Establish and maintain a reputation for resins market expertise
  • Build and manage North American and Latin America resins industry contact relationships across producers, consumers, distributors, traders, and the financial community
  • Regularly provide unique, neutral and objectively written Global Resins Market Advisory Service content including the monthly report, Focus Reports and the World Resins Analysis
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of Chemical Market Analytics supply/demand, econometric price forecast, and trade grid models 
  • Maintain the North America and Latin America production capacity database and supply-demand balances and price forecasts
  • Develops new and unique approaches to leverage Chemical Market Analytics data and models for enhanced predictive services.
  • Develop and deliver market presentations at Chemical Market Analytics and external events
  • Pursue opportunities to present information in client meetings and at conferences; and actively market Chemical Market Analytics services
  • Contribute to global resins team dynamics to ensure consistent global market coverage and analysis
  • Support the Circular Plastics Service by analyzing circular plastics trends impacting the  resins markets
  • Identify new business opportunities for sales and consulting follow-up
  • Provide polyolefin related market expertise for Chemical Market Analytics Consulting projects and Sales client development
  • Operate as a key liaison with the Port of Houston and understand regional and global logistics
  • Develop relationships with principal packaging facilities to understand critical export dynamics of the region
  • Solid understanding of key polyolefin technologies applicable to producers and processors
  • This individual will possess a solid understanding of plastics recycling and sustainability initiatives
  • Lead base chemical weather special reports in response to industry events such as hurricanes, freezes, fires, force majeure events, etc.



You Have:
  • At least 12 years’chemical industry experience, including commercial resins experience and team leadership experience
  • Understanding of the Chemical Market Analytics business model
